examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 waai6 si6 zung6 lat1 pei4 lat1 gwat1, m4 hang2 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了壞事還厚顏無恥，不肯道歉。
examples.english_sentence: He did something bad and is still shameless, refusing to apologize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下佢噉樣，真係甩皮甩骨，無一點羞恥心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 gam2 joeng6, zan1 hai6 lat1 pei4 lat1 gwat1, mou4 jat1 dim2 sau1 ci2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看他這樣，真是厚顏無恥，一點羞恥心都沒有。
examples.english_sentence: Look at him like that — truly shameless, without a shred of shame.

mandarin_meaning: 失常、發瘋、行為失控（俚語）
english_meaning: to lose it; go berserk; act erratically (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「甩碌」是香港粵語俚語，通常用來形容人突然失常、發瘋或行為不受控制，也可形容機器或系統出故障、出亂子。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to describe someone suddenly losing control or acting crazy; can also describe a device/system malfunctioning or something going awry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先喺會議上突然甩碌，亂咁講嘢，大家都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 dat6 jin4 lat1 luk1, lyun6 gam2 gong2 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛才在會議上突然失常亂說話，大家都不知道怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly lost it during the meeting just now and started spouting nonsense; everyone didn't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 脫稿（脫離稿子，即興發揮；亦可指未能交稿）
english_meaning: to go off-script / to perform without the prepared script; (less commonly) to fail to submit a manuscript
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指在主持、演出或演講時沒有按照事先準備的稿子念，臨場即興發揮。有時也可用來表示作者未能準時交稿（次義）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to deviate from the prepared script / perform without notes — to improvise on the spot. Less commonly it can mean failing to hand in a manuscript.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日主持嗰陣甩稿，成場冷場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zyu2 ci2 go2 zan6 laat3 gou2, sing4 coeng4 laang5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天主持時脫稿，現場一片冷場。
examples.english_sentence: He went off-script while hosting today; the whole event fell into awkward silence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚會甩稿，所以準備咗好多筆記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 wui5 laat3 gou2, so2 ji5 zeon2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 bat1 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕會脫稿，所以準備了很多筆記。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid I'll go off-script, so I prepared a lot of notes.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）失控、發瘋；（少用）斷線、失去聯絡
english_meaning: To lose control or go crazy (slang); less commonly, to get disconnected/lose connection
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，通常用來形容一個人情緒或行為突然失控、表現異常或發瘋。有時也可比喻為「斷線」或失去聯絡（較少見）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term typically used to describe someone suddenly losing control emotionally or behaving erratically/going crazy. Less commonly used to mean 'become disconnected' or 'lose contact.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日喺會議上突然甩線，講啲好離譜嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 dat6 jin4 lat1 sin3, gong2 di1 hou2 lei4 pou2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天在会议上突然失控，說了些很離譜的話。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly went off the rails during the meeting today and said some outrageous things.

mandarin_meaning: 脱缰的猴子；形容人失去约束、行为放纵或失控
english_meaning: literally 'monkey off the leash' — someone who has lost restraint and acts wildly or uncontrollably
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語 / 短語（名詞，亦可形容行為）
partOfSpeech_english: slang / phrase (noun; can describe a person or behaviour)
explanation_mandarin: 常用的廣東話俚語，用來形容一個人失去約束、放縱或行為失控，像脫繩的猴子四處亂跑、胡鬧。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase used to describe someone who has lost restraint and behaves wildly or uncontrollably — like a monkey that slipped its leash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一飲醉就甩繩馬騮，將屋企搞到一鑊粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau6 laat3 sing4 maa5 lau1, zoeng1 uk1 kei5 gaau2 dou3 jat1 wok6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝醉就失去控制，像只脱缰的猴子，把家里弄得一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: When he gets drunk he goes completely wild, like a monkey off the leash, leaving the house a mess.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）喊破嗓子、拼命唱或喊、大聲嚷叫
english_meaning: Cantonese slang meaning to shout/sing at the top of one's lungs; to give one's all vocally; to scream or shout very loudly
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，字面是「喊到肺都甩」，用來形容大聲喊、唱到很投入或非常用力地吶喊，也可泛指喊得很厲害或拼命做某件事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning 'lose one's lungs.' It describes shouting or singing extremely loudly (as if with all one's strength) or exerting oneself vocally — e.g., shouting one's lungs out or singing one's heart out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺演唱會度唱到甩肺，成個場都好high。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui6 dou6 coeng3 dou3 lat1 fai3, sing4 go3 coeng4 dou1 hou2 hai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在演唱會上唱到嗓子都快喊破了，全場都很嗨。
examples.english_sentence: He sang his lungs out at the concert; the whole crowd was really hyped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路喺公園玩到甩肺，返到屋企就攰死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 hai2 gung1 jyun4 waan2 dou3 lat1 fai3, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 zau6 gui6 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩在公園玩得又喊又鬧，回到家就累死了。
examples.english_sentence: The kids played and shouted their lungs out at the park, and were exhausted when they got home.

mandarin_meaning: 褪色 / 掉色
english_meaning: to fade (color); dye to run or come off
explanation_mandarin: 指衣物、布料或表面上的顏色因洗滌、摩擦或時間而脫落或變淡。口語中也常用來描述顏色流失或外觀變差。
explanation_english: Refers to the loss or fading of color on clothing, fabric, or surfaces due to washing, friction, or time. Informally used to describe dyes running or an item's appearance deteriorating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫甩色喇，唔好同白褲一齊洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 lat1 sik1 laa3, m4 hou2 tung4 baak6 fu3 jat1 cai4 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫会掉色，别和白裤子一起洗。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt will lose its color; don't wash it together with white pants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條牛仔褲甩色，要小心洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 ngau4 zai2 fu3 lat1 sik1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条牛仔裤会褪色，洗的时候要小心。
examples.english_sentence: These jeans will fade; be careful when washing them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲相紙唔好用熱水，會甩色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 soeng2 zi2 m4 hou2 jung6 jit6 seoi2, wui5 lat1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些相纸不要用热水，会褪色。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use hot water on these photo papers; they'll fade.

mandarin_meaning: 不知廉恥；無恥、厚顏無恥
english_meaning: shameless; brazen; behaving without shame or decency
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語 / 形容詞（可作述語）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (slang); can function as a predicative phrase
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容人言行無廉恥、厚顏無恥或失去體面。常用以批評別人不知羞恥的行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing someone who is shameless or brazen — acting without decency or regard for propriety. Used to criticize shameless behaviour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做，甩質到無朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 zou6, lat1 zat1 dou3 mou5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這樣做，無恥到沒有朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's so shameless he has no friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你當住大家面講啲咁嘅嘢，真係甩質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dong3 zyu6 daai6 gaa1 min6 gong2 di1 gam2 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 lat1 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你當著大家的面說這些話，真是無恥。
examples.english_sentence: Saying such things in front of everyone is really shameless.

mandarin_meaning: 脱身、摆脱牵连（口语）
english_meaning: to get away, wriggle free, evade responsibility or slip away
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示摆脱牵连或责任、脱离某个麻烦或悄悄离开，不再受牵累。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to escape from a responsibility or troublesome situation, or to slip away/get out of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢畀老闆鬧，但最後竟然搵到藉口甩身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5 bei2 lou5 baan2 naau6, daan6 zeoi6 hau6 ging2 jin4 wan2 dou3 zek3 hau2 lat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事被老板骂，但最后竟然找到借口脱身。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up and got scolded by the boss, but in the end he found an excuse to get out of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想去應付嗰啲麻煩，所以諗住搵藉口甩身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 jing1 fu6 go2 di1 maa4 faan4, so2 ji5 nam2 zyu6 wan2 zek3 hau2 lat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想去应付那些麻烦，所以打算找借口脱身。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to deal with those hassles, so I'm planning to find an excuse to get out of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁夜深人靜悄悄甩身走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 je6 sam1 jan4 zing6 ciu1 ciu1 lat1 san1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁夜深人静悄悄脱身离开了。
examples.english_sentence: He slipped away quietly in the dead of night.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）發神經、精神失常或行為失常；也可指事物出故障、失靈
english_meaning: Slang: to lose one's mind / go crazy / act erratically; can also mean something malfunctions or goes haywire
explanation_mandarin: 「甩轆」是廣東話俚語，用來形容一個人精神失常、發瘋或行為怪異，有時亦用來形容機器或計劃出錯、失靈。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to go crazy or behave erratically; can also be used figuratively for things that malfunction or go wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日甩轆，講嘢好亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 lat1 luk6, gong2 je5 hou2 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近老是發神經，說話很亂。
examples.english_sentence: He's been acting crazy lately and talking nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一遲到就甩轆，對人好兇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ci4 dou3 zau6 lat1 luk6, deoi3 jan4 hou2 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一遲到就發神經，對人很兇。
examples.english_sentence: He loses it whenever he's late and is pretty aggressive with people.

mandarin_meaning: 失控；發瘋、胡鬧
english_meaning: to lose control; to go berserk/go crazy; to act erratically
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，形容某人情緒或行為失去控制、變得瘋狂或胡鬧，類似「失控」或「發瘋」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term describing when someone loses control emotionally or behaviorally and acts wildly or erratically—similar to 'lose it' or 'go berserk.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日甩鉸，成班人都驚咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 gam1 jat6 laat3 gaau2, seng4 baan1 jan4 dou1 geng1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天失控了，整班人都被嚇到了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost it today; the whole group was frightened.

mandarin_meaning: 摆脱麻烦；逃避责任／脱身
english_meaning: to get out of trouble; to wriggle out of responsibility; to dodge blame
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話，表示設法擺脫麻煩、責任或處罰，類似「脫身」或「逃避責任」。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term meaning to find a way to avoid trouble, responsibility, or punishment — similar to 'get off the hook' or 'wiggle out'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日想甩難，遇到麻煩就搵藉口推開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 soeng2 lat1 naan6, jyu6 dou3 maa4 faan4 zau6 wan2 zek3 hau2 teoi1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天想甩難，遇到麻煩就找藉口推開。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to wriggle out of trouble; whenever problems arise he finds excuses to push them aside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要問責時，有人甩難成功，有人就頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 man6 zaak3 si4, jau5 jan4 lat1 naan6 sing4 gung1, jau5 jan4 zau6 deng2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要問責時，有人甩難成功，有人就頂不住。
examples.english_sentence: When the company needs to assign blame, some people manage to get off the hook while others can't handle it.

mandarin_meaning: 被（戀人）拋棄、被分手
english_meaning: to be dumped (by a romantic partner)
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話俚語，表示被戀人或伴侶拋棄、分手，相當於「被甩／被分手」。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese slang meaning to be dumped by a romantic partner; equivalent to 'to be dumped' or 'to be broken up with.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明畀女朋友甩青喇，佢依家好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Aa3 ming4 bei2 neoi5 pang4 jau5 laat3 ceng1 laa3, keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明被女朋友甩了，他現在很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: Ming got dumped by his girlfriend; he's really unhappy now.

mandarin_meaning: 做事马虎/敷衍
english_meaning: sloppy; careless; half‑hearted (doing something)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俗語，形容從開始到結束都做得不仔細、不負責任或敷衍，馬虎草率。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese slang describing someone doing things carelessly or half‑heartedly — sloppy or incomplete from start to finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好甩頭甩尾啦，要認真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 lat1 tau4 lat1 mei5 laa3, jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要马马虎虎，要认真一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be sloppy when you work; be more serious.

mandarin_meaning: 放肆胡鬧、失去控制
english_meaning: to act wildly or uncontrollably; to behave in a reckless, unrestrained way
explanation_mandarin: 口語或俚語，用來形容一個人行為放肆、胡鬧或失去控制，常帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression used to describe someone behaving unrestrainedly, rowdily, or out of control; often carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺街度甩頭甩髻，好似冇人管佢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 lat1 tau4 lat1 gat1, hou2 ci5 mou5 jan4 gun2 keoi5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在街上胡鬧，好像沒人管他似的。
examples.english_sentence: He always runs wild on the street, as if nobody's in charge of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣唔好甩頭甩髻，尊重下其他人先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 lat1 tau4 lat1 gat1, zyun1 zung6 haa5 kei4 taa1 jan4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會的時候不要失態，先尊重其他人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act out of control during the meeting; show some respect for others first.

mandarin_meaning: 出差错；出毛病；失常（口語）
english_meaning: to go wrong; to malfunction; to mess up (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「甩骹」是香港廣東話的口語用法，常與正字「甩轆」互用，讀作 lat1 luk6。用來形容機器出故障、事情出差錯，或人表現失常、出包。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression (often written as 甩轆) pronounced lat1 luk6. It describes something going wrong — a machine breaking down, a plan failing, or someone making a blunder or acting out of sorts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 支車喺半路甩骹，成班人要等拖車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 ce1 hai2 bun3 lou6 lat1 luk6, sing4 baan1 jan4 jiu3 dang2 to1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 車在半路壞了，整班人要等拖車。
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down halfway; the whole group had to wait for a tow truck.

mandarin_meaning: 口語：不顧場合地說出粗魯或冒犯的話；衝動脫口而出
english_meaning: Colloquial: to speak bluntly or rudely without restraint; to blurt out offensive or inappropriate words
explanation_mandarin: 「甩鬚」是廣東話口語，指不經思考或不顧場合地說出粗俗、冒犯或不合時宜的話，常帶有衝動或不謹慎的語氣。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial usage, "甩鬚" refers to speaking without restraint — blurting out coarse, offensive, or inappropriate remarks, often impulsively or carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時甩鬚，講咗啲令大家唔開心嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 lat1 sou1, gong2 zo2 di1 ling6 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一時甩鬚，說了些讓大家不高興的話。
examples.english_sentence: He blurted something out and said things that upset everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺正式場合千祈唔好甩鬚，講嘢要有分寸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 sik1 hoi6 gaan1 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 lat1 sou1, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 fan1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在正式場合千萬不要甩鬚，說話要有分寸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blurt things out at formal occasions; be careful with what you say.

mandarin_meaning: 甫（fǔ）——剛、方才；亦作姓氏。
english_meaning: Just; only a short time ago (classical); also a surname.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞（文言） / 名詞（姓氏）
explanation_mandarin: 「甫」多用於文言文或書面語，表示剛剛、方才的意思；亦可作為姓氏使用。
explanation_english: A classical adverb meaning 'just' or 'only a short time ago'. It is mainly used in literary or formal contexts. It can also appear as a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢甫一踏入屋企，就同我傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu2 jat1 daap6 jap6 uk1 kei2, zau6 tung4 ngo5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一回到家，就和我聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He had just come home when he started chatting with me.

mandarin_meaning: 擺姿勢（擺Pose）；裝腔作勢、賣弄
english_meaning: to pose (strike a pose); to show off or put on airs (slang, from English 'pose')
explanation_mandarin: 「甫士」為香港粵語俚語，源自英語「pose」，指擺姿勢（尤其是拍照時）或故意賣弄、裝腔作勢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang borrowed from English 'pose'. It refers to striking a pose (especially for photos) or showing off/putting on airs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺社交媒體成日甫士，淨係為咗吸引注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 seng4 jat6 fu2 si6, zing6 hai6 wai6 zo2 kap1 jan5 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在社交媒體上總是在擺甫士，只是為了吸引注意。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is always posing on social media just to attract attention.

mandarin_meaning: 明信片
english_meaning: postcard
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中的借詞，口語用法，指英語 'postcard'，即明信片。常見於香港用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial loanword for the English word 'postcard' (明信片). Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到你寄嘅一張甫士咭，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 nei5 gei3 ge3 jat1 zoeng1 fu2 si6 gat1, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了你寄的一張明信片，很開心。
examples.english_sentence: I received the postcard you sent; I'm very happy.

mandarin_meaning: （地名）宁波的简称；亦指甬江等相关地名
english_meaning: Yong (abbreviation for Ningbo); refers to place names such as the Yong River
explanation_mandarin: 「甬」本为古地名，用作浙江宁波的简称，也常见于河名（如甬江）及与宁波相关的地名或称呼。
explanation_english: Originally a place-name, '甬' is commonly used as an abbreviation for Ningbo (Zhejiang) and appears in related place names such as the Yong River (Yongjiang).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個朋友喺甬度做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 pang4 jau5 hai2 jung2 dou6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有个朋友在甬（即宁波）工作。
examples.english_sentence: I have a friend working in Ningbo.

mandarin_meaning: 田；田地（农田）
english_meaning: field; farmland; paddy
explanation_mandarin: 指可耕作的土地或農田，常用於描述農作物生長的地方或作地名的一部分。
explanation_english: Refers to arable land used for farming, a field or paddy; often used to describe where crops grow or as part of place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有好多田，啲農夫喺度種緊菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 tin4, di1 nung4 fu1 hai2 dou6 zung3 gan2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多田，农民在这里种菜。
examples.english_sentence: There are many fields here; the farmers are planting vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個喺鄉下長大，屋企後面有一片稻田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 coeng4 daai6, uk1 kei5 hau6 min6 jau5 jat1 pin3 dou6 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候在乡下长大，家后面有一片稻田。
examples.english_sentence: He grew up in the countryside; there's a paddy field behind his house.

mandarin_meaning: 田园（鄉村、農田與鄉村風光）
english_meaning: countryside; rural; pastoral
explanation_mandarin: 指田地與鄉村的景象或環境，常用來描述農村或田園式的生活、景色或氛圍。
explanation_english: Refers to fields and rural scenery; commonly used to describe the countryside or a pastoral way of life, landscape, or atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搬去鄉下，過返田園生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun1 heoi3 hoeng1 haa6, gwo3 faan1 tin4 jyun4 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搬到鄉下，過起田園生活。
examples.english_sentence: He moved to the countryside and started a rural/pastoral life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫有濃厚嘅田園氣息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 jau5 nung4 hou5 ge3 tin4 jyun4 hei3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫有濃厚的田園氣息。
examples.english_sentence: This painting has a strong pastoral/countryside atmosphere.

mandarin_meaning: （戲稱）土地管理部門／土地局（非正式、帶諷刺意味的叫法）
english_meaning: A jocular/slang name for a land-management department (e.g., Lands Department); an informal, often mocking way to refer to the office that handles land or farmland issues
explanation_mandarin: 「田土廳」是粵語俚語，用來戲稱或戲謔指代管理土地、農地或地政相關事務的政府部門，通常帶有調侃或非正式語氣。
explanation_english: “田土廳” is a Cantonese slang term used jokingly to refer to a government office that manages land or farmland (e.g., the Lands Department). It is informal and often carries a teasing or mocking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊地唔係我哋管，要去問田土廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 dei6 m4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gun2, jiu3 heoi3 man6 tin4 tou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊地不是我們管的，要去問田土廳。
examples.english_sentence: This plot of land isn't under our jurisdiction; you'll have to ask the 'Land Office' (田土廳).

mandarin_meaning: 田地
english_meaning: field; farmland; (figuratively) situation or condition
explanation_mandarin: 指可用來耕作的土地；在書面或引申語境中也可指人的處境或境地。
explanation_english: Refers to land used for cultivation (fields, farmland). In literary or figurative contexts it can also mean a person's situation or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊田地好肥沃，啱種菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 tin4 dei6 hou2 fei4 wok6, aam1 zung3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊田地很肥沃，適合種蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: This plot of land is very fertile and suitable for growing vegetables.

mandarin_meaning: 田埂（tián gěng）：田地中分隔田塊或作為小路的隆起土埂，常見於稻田之間。
english_meaning: A raised strip of earth between fields; an embankment or footpath separating paddies (field ridge).
explanation_mandarin: 指用來分隔田地或作為行走通道的土堤，多見於水田或農田間，方便排水與通行。
explanation_english: Refers to the earthen ridge used to separate plots or serve as a walkway, commonly found between rice paddies to aid drainage and passage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，阿公成日帶我喺田埂上行，教我識得睇秧苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, aa3 gung1 sing4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 hai2 tin4 gang2 soeng6 haang4, gaau3 ngo5 sik1 dak1 tai2 joeng1 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候，爺爺常帶我在田埂上走，教我認識稻田和如何照顧秧苗。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, my grandfather often took me walking along the field ridges and taught me about rice paddies and how to care for seedlings.

mandarin_meaning: （口語寫法，常作「田雞」）青蛙；用青蛙做的菜（如田雞湯、田雞腿）
english_meaning: colloquial form of '田雞' (frog) — the frog itself or dishes made from frog (e.g., frog soup, frog legs)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語口語中，『田基』常作為『田雞』的變體寫法，指青蛙或以青蛙為材料的菜式。屬於口語/俗稱，可見於飲食場合或日常對話中。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial usage, '田基' is often a variant spelling of '田雞' and refers to frogs or frog dishes. It is an informal/colloquial term used in everyday speech, especially in food contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去酒樓食田基，啲田基腿好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 zau2 lau4 sik6 tin4 gei1, di1 tin4 gei1 teoi2 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去酒樓吃田雞，田雞腿很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the restaurant tonight to eat frog; the frog legs are really good.

mandarin_meaning: 田径
english_meaning: track and field; athletics
explanation_mandarin: 指包括跑步、跳高、跳遠、擲鐵餅、擲標槍等在田徑場進行的各類競技項目。
explanation_english: Refers to athletics (track and field) — competitive events held on a track or field, including running, jumping, and throwing disciplines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我中學時有參加田徑隊，主項係長跑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 hok6 si4 jau5 caam1 gaa1 tin4 ging3 deoi2, zyu2 hong6 hai6 coeng4 paau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我中学时参加过田径队，主项是长跑。
examples.english_sentence: I joined the track and field team in secondary school; my main event was long-distance running.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆學校田徑比賽喺星期五舉行，大家要準時到場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gaai3 hok6 haau6 tin4 ging3 bei2 coi3 hai2 sing1 kei4 ng5 geoi2 hang4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 dou3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這屆學校田徑比賽在星期五舉行，大家要準時到場。
examples.english_sentence: The school's track and field meet this term is on Friday; everyone should arrive on time.

mandarin_meaning: 田螺 (tiánluó)：一种淡水或泥滩中的螺类，常作为食材。
english_meaning: field snail; river/mud snail (edible freshwater snail)
explanation_mandarin: 指生活在田间、池塘或泥滩的螺类，肉质可食，常被捕捞后清洗、炒、煮或腌制作菜肴。
explanation_english: Refers to snails found in fields, ponds, or muddy areas; an edible freshwater/mud snail often harvested and prepared as food in various ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去食田螺啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 tin4 lo4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去吃田螺吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat field snails tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場有好多新鮮田螺賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 sin1 tin4 lo4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市场有很多新鲜的田螺在卖。
examples.english_sentence: The market is selling a lot of fresh field snails.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見方言）田螺的堆/一群田螺，或方言中指盛放田螺的處所或器皿
english_meaning: A (rare/regional) term referring to a pile/group of field snails, or a place/container holding field snails
explanation_mandarin: 田螺厴為廣東話中較罕見或地區性的詞彙，常用於鄉村語境，指成堆的田螺、田螺殼，或泛指盛放田螺的容器或聚集處。現代用法不普遍，屬方言詞或俗稱。
explanation_english: A rare or regional Cantonese term used mainly in rural contexts to denote a heap/group of field snails (or their shells), or loosely a place/container where snails are kept. It is dialectal and not widely used in standard Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨，田邊度堆咗幾嚿田螺厴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5, tin4 bin1 dou6 deoi1 zo2 gei2 gau6 tin4 lo4 ngaan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完雨後，田邊堆了幾堆田螺。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, there were several piles of field snails at the edge of the fields.

mandarin_meaning: 形容行駛很慢的車（俚語）
english_meaning: slang for a very slow-moving car (a 'snail car')
explanation_mandarin: 「田螺車」是廣東話口語/俚語，用來形容車輛行駛速度非常慢，像田螺一樣慢，或指駕駛者開車很慢，造成交通阻塞或令人不耐煩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe a car that moves extremely slowly (like a snail), or a driver who drives very slowly, often causing traffic delays or annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面嗰部車真係田螺車，慢到塞住晒條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 go2 bou6 ce1 zan1 hai6 tin4 lo4 ce1, maan6 dou3 sak1 zyu6 saai3 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面的那輛車真是「田螺車」，慢得把路都堵住了。
examples.english_sentence: The car in front is really a 'snail car' — so slow it's blocking the road.

mandarin_meaning: 字面為「田螺魔」，多為俚語或綽號，用來稱呼喜歡捕捉、收藏或對田螺特別著迷的人；也可作戲稱或戲謔用語。
english_meaning: Literally 'snail demon' (field-snail demon). A colloquial nickname or slang for someone who is obsessed with catching or collecting snails; often used jokingly.
explanation_mandarin: 「田螺魔」並非正式書面語，多見於口語或地方用法。字面上指田螺化作的「魔」或非常喜愛田螺的人，常作玩笑性綽號，亦可能用來形容對某種小物件特別執着的人。
explanation_english: Not a formal written term; used mainly in speech as a local or slang nickname. Literally 'snail demon', it refers jokingly to someone who loves catching or collecting field snails, or more broadly someone obsessively fond of small creatures/items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿偉成日去河邊捉田螺，大家都叫佢田螺魔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 wai5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 ho4 bin1 zuk1 tin4 lo4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 giu3 keoi5 tin4 lo4 mo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿偉经常去河边抓田螺，大家都叫他田螺魔。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Wai often goes to the riverside to catch snails; everyone calls him the 'snail demon'.

mandarin_meaning: 田野（田地和野外，乡间）
english_meaning: fields; open countryside; the rural outdoors
explanation_mandarin: 指耕作的田地和廣闊的野外，常用來表示鄉間或自然的開闊地帶。
explanation_english: Refers to cultivated fields and wide open countryside; commonly used to denote rural or natural open areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個週末我哋去田野郊遊，帶埋野餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tin4 je5 gaau1 jau4, daai3 maai4 je5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个周末我们去田野郊游，带上野餐。
examples.english_sentence: This weekend we're going to the fields for an outing and bringing a picnic.

mandarin_meaning: 田鸡（指青蛙，尤指可食用的田鸡/牛蛙）
english_meaning: frog (especially edible frog/bullfrog; used as food)
explanation_mandarin: 指青蛙，常指可食用的田鸡或牛蛙，在廣東、香港菜餚中常見，也可指以田雞為材料的菜式。
explanation_english: Refers to frogs, particularly edible frogs or bullfrogs commonly used in Cantonese cuisine; also denotes dishes made from frog meat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食田雞粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 tin4 gai1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃田鸡粥。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat frog porridge tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅田雞炒得好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 tin4 gai1 caau2 dak1 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的田鸡炒得很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's stir-fried frog is very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚師話要用新鮮嘅田雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 si1 waa6 jiu3 jung6 san1 sin1 ge3 tin4 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨师说要用新鲜的田鸡。
examples.english_sentence: The chef said to use fresh frog.

mandarin_meaning: 田鸡（菜）；青蛙肉；口语中指与田鸡有关的东西/菜肴
english_meaning: frog (meat); frog dish; colloquial term for things/food related to frog
explanation_mandarin: 「田雞」指可食用的青蛙，後綴「東」為廣東話口語中表示「東西/菜餚」的用法。合起來「田雞東」多用來指田雞這類菜餚或與田雞有關的東西（口語用法）。
explanation_english: “田雞” refers to edible frogs; the suffix “東” in Cantonese colloquially means “thing” or “stuff/food.” Together, “田雞東” is a colloquial way to refer to frog meat/dishes or things related to frogs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去食田雞東啦，好耐冇食過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 tin4 gai1 dung1 laa1, hou2 noi6 mou5 sik6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去吃田鸡吧，很久没吃过了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat frog tonight; I haven't had it for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟田雞東好好味，汁濃又鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 tin4 gai1 dung1 hou2 hou2 mei6, zap1 nung4 jau6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘田鸡菜很好吃，汤汁浓郁又鲜美。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of frog is delicious — the sauce is rich and flavorful.

cantonese: 田雞過河 - 各有各撐
jyutping: tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4 — gok3 jau5 gok3 caang1
mandarin_meaning: 各人各自應付；各有各的難處或做法
english_meaning: Everyone fends for themselves; each person has their own way of coping or their own difficulties
explanation_mandarin: 原本字面是田雞過河各自靠自己，後用來比喻每個人或每種情況都有不同的處理方法或難處，不能一概而論，大家各自想辦法應付。
explanation_english: Literally 'frogs crossing the river — each supports themselves'. Used to say that everyone must cope on their own; different people or situations require different approaches and solutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次疫情影響唔同人嘅處境，田雞過河——各有各撐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jam4 cing4 jing2 hoeng2 m4 tung4 jan4 ge3 cyu3 ging2, tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4 — gok3 jau5 gok3 caang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次疫情影響到不同人的處境，大家各自應對，各有各的難處。
examples.english_sentence: This pandemic affects people in different ways — everyone copes on their own; each has their own difficulties.

jyutping: tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4, gok3 jau5 gok3 caang1
mandarin_meaning: 字面：田蛙過河，各自撐住。引申：每個人各自應付，各自承擔；各自為戰、互不相幫。
english_meaning: Literal: frogs crossing the river, each supports itself. Figurative: everyone fends for themselves; each copes in their own way, no collective help.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容遇到困難或危機時，各人各自想辦法、各自承擔，不會或不能互相幫助。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation where, facing difficulty or crisis, everyone must cope on their own; people look after themselves rather than helping one another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司裁員，大家都係田雞過河，各有各撐，要靠自己搵出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4, gok3 jau5 gok3 caang1, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 wan2 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裁員，大家都是各自應付，各有各撐，要靠自己想辦法出路。
examples.english_sentence: With layoffs at the company, everyone is fending for themselves — each copes on their own and has to find a way out.

jyutping: tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4 gok3 jau5 gok3 naan4
mandarin_meaning: 田鸡过河，各有各难 / 各有各的难处
english_meaning: Each has its own difficulties; everyone faces their own problems
explanation_mandarin: 比喻每個人在處理事情或面對困難時情況不同，各有各的難處或做法，不宜一概而論。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning that everyone has their own difficulties or ways of handling things; situations differ and cannot be judged the same for everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好話佢懶，田雞過河，各有各𨅝，佢都有自己要面對嘅困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 waa6 keoi5 laan5, tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4 gok3 jau5 gok3 naan4, keoi5 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 jiu3 min6 deoi3 ge3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说他懒，田鸡过河，各有各难，他也有自己要面对的困难。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call him lazy — each person has their own problems; he has difficulties he has to deal with too.

mandarin_meaning: 田鸡（蛙类，亦指可食用的青蛙）
english_meaning: frog (especially field/bullfrog; often used as food, e.g. frogs' legs)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中常用的詞，字面為「田中的雞」，實指蛙類，尤其指可作食材的田雞。在廣東菜或香港飲食文化中常見。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term literally meaning "field chicken," referring to frogs (especially those used as food). Commonly used in Cantonese cuisine and Hong Kong dining culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去嗰間餐廳食田鷄，佢哋嘅田鷄好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 tin4 gai1, keoi5 dei6 ge3 tin4 gai1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去那間餐廳吃田鸡，他們的田鸡很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to that restaurant tonight to eat frog; their frog is very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语）指田鸡（青蛙）冷冻/冻制的食品，也可泛指用田鸡做的菜肴
english_meaning: In Cantonese, refers to frozen frog (frog meat) or frog dishes (often sold/served frozen or chilled)
explanation_mandarin: 「田鷄」是粤语对田鸡／青蛙的称呼，「東/凍」在此处表示冷冻或冰镇，合起来通常指冷冻或冰镇的田鸡肉或相关菜式，常见于粤菜或街市。
explanation_english: “Tin gai dung” combines the Cantonese word for frog (田鷄) with a character indicating frozen/chilled; it usually denotes frozen frog meat or frog dishes served chilled or sold frozen, common in Cantonese cuisine and markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去酒樓叫碟田鷄東啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 zau2 lau4 giu3 dip6 tin4 gai1 dung3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去酒楼点一道田鸡冻吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's order a plate of frozen/chilled frog at the restaurant tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有賣新鮮嘅田鷄東，可以即買即煮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 maai6 san1 sin1 ge3 tin4 gai1 dung3, ho2 ji5 zik1 maai5 zik1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街市有卖新鲜的田鸡冻，可以买了马上烹调。
examples.english_sentence: The market sells fresh frog (for freezing/cooking); you can buy it and cook it right away.

jyutping: tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4, gok3 jau5 gok3 caang1
mandarin_meaning: 每个人都有各自应付困难或渡过难关的办法
english_meaning: Everyone copes or gets by in their own way; each person has their own way of handling difficulties.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在困境或不利情況下，各人會用不同的方法自力應付、各自度過。
explanation_english: A colloquial saying meaning that in difficult situations people each have their own way of coping or getting by; everyone handles things differently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家經濟唔好，大家田鷄過河，各有各撐：有人做兼職，有人縮減開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, daai6 gaa1 tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4, gok3 jau5 gok3 caang1: jau5 jan4 zou6 gim1 zik1, jau5 jan4 suk1 gaam2 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，大家各有各的应对办法：有人做兼职，有人缩减开支。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad right now; everyone copes in their own way: some take on part-time jobs, others cut expenses.

jyutping: tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4, go3 jau5 go3 faat3
mandarin_meaning: 各有各的做法 / 各人有各人的處理方法
english_meaning: To each his own; everyone has their own way of doing things
explanation_mandarin: 比喻每個人在處理事情或面對問題時會有自己的方式和考量，別人未必適用同一辦法。
explanation_english: A colloquial proverb meaning that people have different ways of handling matters; what works for one person may not work for another — each to their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好強逼佢點做，田鷄過河，各有各𨅝*。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 koeng4 bik1 keoi5 dim2 zou6, tin4 gai1 gwo3 ho4, go3 jau5 go3 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要强逼他怎么做，田鸡过河，各有各的做法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force him how to do it — to each his own.

mandarin_meaning: 從；由；出自（表示起點、來源、原因或被動的施事）
english_meaning: from; by; due to — indicates origin, source, starting point, cause, or agent
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「由」可用來表示動作或事物的起點、來源或原因，也可用於被動句表示施事，部分口語情況下可表示讓渡或授權（如「由佢做」）。具體含義依上下文而定。
explanation_english: Used to indicate the origin, source, starting point, cause, or agent of an action or state. It also appears in passive constructions to mark the agent, and colloquially can mean 'let/allow someone to...' depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路由中環開始，行到銅鑼灣就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 jau4 zung1 waan4 hoi1 ci2, haang4 dou3 tung4 lo4 waan1 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條路從中環開始，走到銅鑼灣就到了。
examples.english_sentence: This road starts from Central; go along it to Causeway Bay and you'll arrive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由佢做就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 keoi5 zou6 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由他做就可以。
examples.english_sentence: Let him do it (that's fine).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫係由學生創作嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 hai6 jau4 hok6 saang1 cong3 zok3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫是由學生創作的。
examples.english_sentence: This painting was created by students.

mandarin_meaning: 由上而下（yóu shàng ér xià）
english_meaning: from top to bottom; top-down; in a hierarchical or descending order
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词短语（表示方式/顺序）
explanation_mandarin: 表示从上到下、由高到低的顺序或以自上而下的方式进行，常用于描述组织、流程、检查或处理方法。
explanation_english: Indicates an order or method 'from top to bottom' — proceeding from higher levels to lower ones. Commonly used to describe organizational approaches, processes, inspections, or perspectives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃係由上而下推行，所有決定都係管理層話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 jau4 soeng6 ji4 haa6 teoi1 hang4, so2 jau5 kyut3 ding6 dou1 hai6 gun2 lei5 cang4 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划是由上而下推行的，所有决定都由管理层做主。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is being implemented from the top down; all decisions are made by the management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要由上而下檢查整棟樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jau4 soeng6 ji4 haa6 gim2 caa4 zing2 dung6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要由上而下检查整栋楼。
examples.english_sentence: We need to inspect the entire building from top to bottom.

mandarin_meaning: 从下到上；自下而上（可指物理方向或自下而上的做法）
english_meaning: From bottom to top; bottom-up (can refer to physical direction or a grassroots/bottom-up approach)
explanation_mandarin: 表示從下往上移動或由基層向上推進，既可描述方向，也可用來形容採取自下而上的工作或決策方式。
explanation_english: Expresses movement from a lower point to a higher one or advancing from the grassroots upward; can describe physical direction or a bottom-up method in organization/processes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要由下而上推行新政策，先要聽基層員工嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 jau4 haa6 ji4 soeng5 teoi1 hang4 san1 zing3 caak3, sin1 jiu3 teng1 gei1 cang4 jyun4 gung1 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要由下而上推行新政策，先要听基层员工的意见。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to implement the new policy from the bottom up, first listening to frontline employees' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 水係由下而上噴出嚟，可能係泵壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi2 hai6 jau4 haa6 ji4 soeng5 pan3 ceot1 lai4, ho2 nang4 hai6 bam1 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水是由下而上喷出来的，可能是水泵坏了。
examples.english_sentence: Water is spraying up from below; it might be that the pump is broken.

mandarin_meaning: 從基層/底層做起
english_meaning: to start from the bottom; to begin at the grassroots and work one's way up
explanation_mandarin: 表示從最低的層次或基層開始做起，逐步累積經驗或提升，常用於工作、事業或學習的語境。
explanation_english: Means to begin at the lowest level or grassroots and gradually accumulate experience or progress upward; commonly used in contexts of work, career, or learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住由低做起，慢慢學多啲經驗，之後再爭上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 jau4 dai1 zou6 hei2, maan6 maan6 hok6 do1 di1 ging1 jim6, zi1 hau6 zoi3 zang1 soeng5 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算從基層做起，慢慢累積經驗，然後再爭取晉升。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to start from the bottom, slowly gain experience, and then try to move up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想搵個肯由低做起嘅人，佢哋重視勤力同埋態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 wan2 go3 hang2 jau4 dai1 zou6 hei2 ge3 jan4, keoi5 dei6 zung6 si6 kan4 lik6 tung4 maai4 taai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想找肯從基層做起的人，他們重視勤奮和態度。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants someone willing to start from the bottom; they value diligence and attitude.

mandarin_meaning: 由来（表示来源、来历、起源）
english_meaning: origin; source; provenance; cause
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物的來源、來歷或起因，常用來詢問或說明某事的來由或起源。
explanation_english: Refers to the origin, source, history, or cause of something; commonly used to ask about or explain how something came to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方嘅由來好有趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 jau4 loi4 hou2 jau5 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方的由来很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: The origin of this place is very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知道呢個姓氏嘅由來？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 dou3 ni1 go3 seng3 si6 ge3 jau4 loi4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道这个姓氏的由来吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know the origin of this surname?

mandarin_meaning: 由来已久
english_meaning: long-standing; has a long history
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或現象自很早以前就存在，歷史悠久。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has existed for a long time or has a long history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座建築由來已久，唔少歷史事件都喺度發生過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 gin3 zuk1 jau4 loi4 ji5 gau2, m4 siu2 lik6 si2 si6 gin2 dou1 hai2 dou6 faat3 sang1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座建築由來已久，很多歷史事件都在這裡發生過。
examples.english_sentence: This building has a long history; many historical events happened here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間老店由來已久，仲有好多老顧客會返嚟買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 lou5 dim3 jau4 loi4 ji5 gau2, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 lou5 gu3 haak3 wui5 faan1 lai4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家老店由來已久，還有很多老顧客會回來購買。
examples.english_sentence: This old shop has been around for a long time; many regular customers still come back to buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 某個習俗由來已久，至今仍然保留喺當地文化入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mau2 go3 zaap6 zuk6 jau4 loi4 ji5 gau2, zi3 gam1 jing4 jin4 bou2 lau4 hai2 dong1 dei6 man4 faa3 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 某個習俗由來已久，至今仍然保留在當地文化之中。
examples.english_sentence: A certain custom has a long history and still remains in the local culture today.

mandarin_meaning: 从始至终 (cóng shǐ zhì zhōng)
english_meaning: from beginning to end; throughout; all along
explanation_mandarin: 表示从开始到结束，强调在整个过程中的持续性或一贯性。
explanation_english: Indicates from the start to the finish; emphasizes continuity or consistency throughout the whole process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由始至終都支持我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 ci2 zi3 zung1 dou1 zi1 ci4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从始至终都支持我。
examples.english_sentence: He has supported me from beginning to end.

mandarin_meaning: 任由；讓（某人）隨意做
english_meaning: to let someone do as they please; to allow; to let (a situation) happen
explanation_mandarin: 表示讓某人隨意做某事或任由某情況發生，語氣上可含放任、不贊成或無奈。
explanation_english: Indicates allowing someone to do as they please or letting a situation occur; often conveys permissiveness, disapproval, or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好由得佢咁樣亂嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jau4 dak1 keoi5 gam2 joeng6 lyun6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別讓他這樣胡亂來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him act recklessly like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸阿媽對佢太溺愛，成日由得佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1 deoi3 keoi5 taai3 nik6 oi3, sing4 jat6 jau4 dak1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他父母對他太寵溺，總是任由他。
examples.english_sentence: His parents spoil him too much and always let him do whatever he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以由得佢欺負你，應該講返句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 jau4 dak1 keoi5 hei1 fu6 nei5, jing1 goi1 gong2 faan1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不可以任由他欺負你，應該說一句話。
examples.english_sentence: You can't let him bully you; you should say something.

mandarin_meaning: 任由他/隨他去、聽其自然（口語）
english_meaning: let him/her/them have their way; allow someone to do as they please; not intervene
explanation_mandarin: 表示不干涉或不能干涉某人，任其自由處理或行事，常用於口語場合。
explanation_english: Indicates allowing someone to act as they wish without intervening or being unable to intervene; commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢爭，算啦，由得佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 zang1, syun3 laa3, jau4 dak1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別跟他爭了，算了，任由他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue with him, forget it, let him be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路成日亂咁玩，我都冇辦法，只能由得佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 lyun6 gam2 waan2, ngo5 dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3, zi2 nang4 jau4 dak1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子老是亂玩，我也沒辦法，只能任由他。
examples.english_sentence: The kid keeps messing around; I can't do anything, I can only let him be.

mandarin_meaning: 由于 (yóu yú)，因为
english_meaning: due to; owing to; because of
explanation_mandarin: 表示原因或理由，多用於書面語，相當於「因為」或「由於……所以……」構句中的原因部分。
explanation_english: Indicates cause or reason; often used in written or formal contexts, equivalent to 'because of' or 'due to'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於今朝落大雨，班機延誤咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 gam1 ziu1 lok6 daai6 jyu5, baan1 gei1 jin4 ng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于今天早上下大雨，航班延误了。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the heavy rain this morning, the flight was delayed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由於身體唔舒服，今日冇返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 jyu1 san1 tai2 m4 syu1 fuk6, gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为身体不舒服，今天没有来上学。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't go to school today because he wasn't feeling well.

mandarin_meaning: 从早到晚；整天
english_meaning: from morning to night; all day long
explanation_mandarin: 表示從早晨到傍晚或夜晚，整天都在做某事，作副詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something from morning until night; used as an adverbial phrase meaning 'all day long'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由朝到晚都喺屋企煲劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 ziu1 dou3 maan5 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 bou1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从早到晚都在家看剧。
examples.english_sentence: He watches TV dramas at home all day long.

mandarin_meaning: 由此可見 / 從此可見（可從前述事實或論據推斷出結論）
english_meaning: from this it can be seen; thus it can be concluded
explanation_mandarin: 表示可以從前面的事實或論據推斷出某個結論，常用於書面或正式語體作為過渡語。
explanation_english: Indicates that a conclusion can be drawn from the preceding facts or arguments; commonly used as a formal transitional phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由此可見，我哋而家要改變策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 ci2 ho2 gin3, ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 goi2 bin3 caak3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由此可見，我們現在要改變策略。
examples.english_sentence: From this, it can be seen that we need to change our strategy now.

mandarin_meaning: 由浅入深 (yóu qiǎn rù shēn)
english_meaning: to go from shallow to deep; to proceed from simple/basic to complex/advanced
explanation_mandarin: 表示講解、教學或說明時，先從簡單或基礎開始，再逐步深入到複雜或詳細的內容，便於理解。
explanation_english: Describes a way of explaining or teaching that starts with simple/basic points and gradually moves to more complex or detailed content to aid understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師教書由淺入深，學生比較容易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gaau3 syu1 jau4 cim2 jap6 sam1, hok6 saang1 bei2 gok3 jung6 ji6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师讲课由浅入深，学生比较容易明白。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher teaches from simple to complex, so students find it easier to understand.

mandarin_meaning: 從小到大
english_meaning: since childhood; from a young age; all one's life
explanation_mandarin: 表示從小到現在、從小時候起一直持續到現在的時間或狀態，常用來描述習慣、性格或經歷的延續性。
explanation_english: Indicates continuity from childhood until now; used to describe habits, character traits, or situations that have persisted since one was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由細到大都好鍾意打籃球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 daa2 laam4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從小到大都很喜歡打籃球。
examples.english_sentence: He has liked playing basketball since he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我由細到大都好聽話，唔鍾意惹事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 teng1 waa6, m4 zung1 ji3 je5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我從小到大都很聽話，不喜歡惹事。
examples.english_sentence: I've been obedient since childhood and don't like causing trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 隨便；由你/由他決定（此表達較少見或非標準）
english_meaning: It's up to you; whatever you prefer (a rare/non-standard expression)
explanation_mandarin: 「由自可」並非常見的粵語表達，字面可拆為「由」（讓）、「自」（自己）、「可」（可以）。用來表示把決定權交給對方或表示自己無意見，相當於「隨便」「由你」。口語中更常用「由你」「隨便」等說法。
explanation_english: A rare or non-standard Cantonese phrase literally composed of '由' (let) + '自' (self) + '可' (can). It indicates leaving the decision to someone—equivalent to 'it's up to you' or 'suit yourself'. In everyday speech speakers usually use '由你' or '隨便'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去唔去由自可，我冇意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 jau4 zi6 ho2, ngo5 mou5 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去不去隨便，你做決定，我沒意見。
examples.english_sentence: Whether we go tonight is up to you — I have no opinion.

mandarin_meaning: 由衷 (yóu zhōng)：發自內心、真摯的感情或態度
english_meaning: sincere; heartfelt; from the bottom of one's heart
explanation_mandarin: 表示由內心深處發出的真誠情感，常用來強調感謝、佩服或悔意的真摯。
explanation_english: Indicates feelings that come sincerely from the heart; often used to emphasize genuine gratitude, admiration, or remorse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我由衷多謝你一直以來嘅支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau4 zung1 do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 zik6 ji5 loi4 ge3 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我由衷感謝你一直以來的支持。
examples.english_sentence: I sincerely thank you for your continued support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由衷承認咗自己嘅錯，大家都鬆一口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 zung1 sing4 jing6 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 sung1 jat1 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他由衷承認了自己的錯，大家都松了一口氣。
examples.english_sentence: He sincerely admitted his mistake, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我由衷佩服佢嘅工作態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau4 zung1 pui3 fuk6 keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 taai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我由衷佩服他的工作態度。
examples.english_sentence: I truly admire his work attitude.

mandarin_meaning: 從零開始
english_meaning: start from zero; start from scratch
explanation_mandarin: 表示從頭開始、沒有基礎地重新開始做某事。常用於描述重建、重啟計劃或學習新技能的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates beginning from zero or starting from scratch with no prior foundation. Commonly used to describe rebuilding, restarting a project, or learning a new skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃失敗咗，我哋要由零開始再諗過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sat1 baai6 zo2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jau4 ling4 hoi1 ci2 zoi3 lam2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個計劃失敗了，我們要從零開始再想一次。
examples.english_sentence: This project failed; we have to start from scratch and rethink it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學一樣新技能要由零開始，唔使灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jat1 joeng6 san1 gei6 nang4 jiu3 jau4 ling4 hoi1 ci2, m4 sai2 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學一門新技能要從零開始，不用灰心。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a new skill requires starting from zero; don't be discouraged.

mandarin_meaning: 起頭 / 開始；原因
english_meaning: beginning/start; reason; from the start
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，「由頭」可指事情的開端或起頭，也可指原因；作副词时常表示「從頭、重新」或「從一開始」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '由頭' can mean the beginning/origin or a reason; used adverbially it often means 'from the start' or 'again'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋由頭開始做一次啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau4 tau4 hoi1 ci2 zou6 jat1 ci3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从头开始做一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's do it again from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇由頭嬲我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 jau4 tau4 nau3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她无缘无故地生我的气。
examples.english_sentence: She got mad at me for no reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由頭到尾佢都冇講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 keoi5 dou1 mou5 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从头到尾他都没讲清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't explain it clearly from start to finish.

mandarin_meaning: 從頭到尾
english_meaning: from beginning to end; from start to finish; the whole time
explanation_mandarin: 表示從開始到結束，強調整個過程或全程都如此。
explanation_english: Indicates from the beginning to the end, emphasizing the entire process or the whole duration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由頭到尾都唔承認自己有錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 m4 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 jau5 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她從頭到尾都不承認自己有錯。
examples.english_sentence: He/She denied being at fault from start to finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我由頭到尾都明白佢嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 ming4 baak6 keoi5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我從頭到尾都明白他的意思。
examples.english_sentence: I understood what he meant from beginning to end.

mandarin_meaning: 甲（jiǎ）：甲胄；外壳；十天干的第一位；表示第一、A级、甲等。
english_meaning: '甲' (jiǎ): armor; shell; the first of the ten Heavenly Stems; denotes 'first' or 'A' grade; top rank.
explanation_mandarin: 「甲」在粤语及汉语中有多种用法：可指护甲或外壳（如动物的甲壳）、十天干中的第一位（用于表示第一位或A级），也用于表示等级（甲等、甲级）。
explanation_english: '甲' has several uses: it can mean armor or a shell (e.g., an animal's carapace), the first of the ten Heavenly Stems (used to mean 'first' or 'A' grade), and more generally a top rank or category (A-level).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到甲級，真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 gaap3 kap1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考到甲级，真厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He got an A (top grade); really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 甲係十天干嘅第一位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaap3 hai6 sap6 tin1 gon1 ge3 dai6 jat1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 甲是十天干的第一位。
examples.english_sentence: 'Jia' is the first of the ten Heavenly Stems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 螃蟹有硬甲保護身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pong4 haai5 jau5 ngaang6 gaap3 bou2 wu6 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 螃蟹有硬甲保护身体。
examples.english_sentence: Crabs have hard shells that protect their bodies.

mandarin_meaning: 甲狀腺功能亢進
english_meaning: hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
explanation_mandarin: 甲亢是甲狀腺功能亢進的簡稱，指甲狀腺分泌過多甲狀腺激素，導致新陳代謝加快，常見症狀包括心悸、手抖、體重下降、易出汗和疲倦等。
explanation_english: Hyperthyroidism (甲亢) is an overactive thyroid condition in which the thyroid gland produces excess thyroid hormones, speeding up metabolism. Common symptoms include palpitations, tremor, weight loss, excessive sweating, and fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為甲亢成日心跳好快、氣短又多汗，所以要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gaap3 kong3 seng4 jat6 sam1 tiu3 hou2 faai3, hei3 dyun2 jau6 do1 hon6, so2 ji5 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為甲亢常常心跳很快、氣短且多汗，所以要看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has hyperthyroidism, so he often has a rapid heartbeat, shortness of breath, and excessive sweating, and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 甲型肝炎（A型肝炎）
english_meaning: Hepatitis A
explanation_mandarin: 由甲型肝炎病毒（HAV）引起的肝臟急性炎症，主要透過糞口途徑傳播，多為自限性，症狀包括發燒、疲倦、黃疸等，可透過疫苗預防。
explanation_english: An acute inflammation of the liver caused by the hepatitis A virus (HAV). It is mainly transmitted via the fecal-oral route, is usually self-limiting, and causes symptoms such as fever, fatigue, and jaundice. Preventable by vaccination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢感染咗甲型肝炎，佢要留院觀察同補水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 gam2 jim5 zo2 gaap3 jing4 gon1 jim4, keoi5 jiu3 lau4 jyun2 gun1 caat3 tung4 bou2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他感染了甲型肝炎，需要留院观察并补充水分。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he contracted hepatitis A; he needs to stay in hospital for observation and rehydration.

mandarin_meaning: 甲子（干支纪年中的第一位），指六十年一周期或滿六十歲。
english_meaning: Jiazi — the first year of the 60-year sexagenary cycle (heavenly stems and earthly branches); also refers to a 60-year cycle or turning sixty.
explanation_mandarin: 「甲子」原指天干「甲」配地支「子」所代表的年份，是干支紀年的第一個組合。引申為六十年一周或人滿六十歲（花甲）。在歷史紀年、命理和文化慶典中常見用法。
explanation_english: Originally denotes the combination of the heavenly stem 'Jia' (甲) and the earthly branch 'Zi' (子), the first position in the 60-year sexagenary cycle. It is also used to mean a full 60-year period or a person's sixtieth birthday. Common in historical dating, calendrical systems, and cultural contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺今年滿甲子，我哋幫佢擺咗壽宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gam1 nin4 mun5 gaap3 zi2, ngo5 dei6 bong1 keoi5 baai2 zo2 sau6 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我祖父今年滿甲子，我們替他擺了壽宴。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather turned sixty this year; we held a birthday banquet for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 甲子係干支紀年嘅第一位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaap3 zi2 hai6 gon1 zi1 gei2 nin4 ge3 dai6 jat1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 甲子是干支紀年中的第一位。
examples.english_sentence: Jiazi is the first position in the sexagenary (heavenly stem and earthly branch) cycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舊屋已經過咗一個甲子，仲好堅固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gau6 uk1 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 jat1 go3 gaap3 zi2, zung6 hou2 gin1 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間舊屋已經過了一個甲子，還很堅固。
examples.english_sentence: This old house has already stood for a full 60 years and is still solid.

mandarin_meaning: 甲板（船隻或大型構築物上的平坦平台）
english_meaning: deck (the flat surface on a ship or similar structure)
explanation_mandarin: 指船隻或其他大型構築物上的平坦平台，供人行走、作業或擺放物品。
explanation_english: Refers to the flat surface on a ship or similar large structure used for walking, working, or placing items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 船上嘅甲板好大，可以擺晒啲貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun4 soeng5 ge3 gaap3 baan2 hou2 daai6, ho2 ji5 baai2 saai3 di1 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船上的甲板很大，可以摆放很多货物。
examples.english_sentence: The ship's deck is large and can hold a lot of cargo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺甲板上睇日落，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaap3 baan2 soeng6 tai2 jat6 lok6, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在甲板上看日落，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: We watched the sunset on the deck; it felt very comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 甲壳；外壳（通常指動物的殼或外層保護結構）
english_meaning: shell; carapace; exoskeleton; outer shell
explanation_mandarin: 指動物的硬殼或任何保護性外殼，如甲殼類動物的外骨骼；也可泛指外層的保護結構。
explanation_english: Refers to an animal's hard shell or any protective outer covering, such as the exoskeleton of crustaceans; can also mean a protective outer layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 螃蟹有硬硬嘅甲殼，可以保護佢嘅身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pong4 haai5 jau5 ngaang6 ngaang6 ge3 gaap3 hok3, ho2 ji5 bou2 wu6 keoi5 ge3 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 螃蟹有堅硬的甲壳，可以保护它的身体。
examples.english_sentence: Crabs have hard shells that protect their bodies.

mandarin_meaning: 甲烷（化學式 CH4），最簡單的烷烴，是無色無味、易燃的氣體，也是重要的溫室氣體，常見於天然氣和沼氣中。
english_meaning: Methane (CH4), the simplest alkane — a colorless, odorless, flammable gas and an important greenhouse gas; commonly found in natural gas and biogas.
explanation_mandarin: 甲烷是最簡單的飽和烴類（烷烴），化學式為 CH4。來源包括地質天然氣、沼澤分解和動物腸道微生物分解。它是主要的溫室氣體之一，能加劇氣候變化，也在能源工業中為天然氣的主要成分。
explanation_english: Methane is the simplest saturated hydrocarbon (an alkane) with the chemical formula CH4. It originates from geologic natural gas, decomposition in wetlands, and microbial processes in animal guts. Methane is a major greenhouse gas and a principal component of natural gas used for energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 甲烷係天然氣嘅主要成分之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaap3 waan4 hai6 tin1 jin4 hei3 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 sing4 fan6 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 甲烷是天然氣的主要成分之一。
examples.english_sentence: Methane is one of the main components of natural gas.

mandarin_meaning: 甲状腺 (位於頸部的內分泌腺，分泌甲狀腺激素)
english_meaning: thyroid gland
explanation_mandarin: 位於頸部、呈蝴蝶形的內分泌腺，分泌甲狀腺激素以調節新陳代謝、生長與發育等功能。
explanation_english: An endocrine gland in the neck (butterfly-shaped) that produces thyroid hormones to regulate metabolism, growth, and development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我嘅甲狀腺有問題，要做進一步檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 gaap3 zong6 sin3 jau5 man6 tai4, jiu3 zou6 zeon3 jat1 bou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的甲状腺有问题，要做进一步检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said there is a problem with my thyroid gland and I need further tests.

mandarin_meaning: 固执、倔强
english_meaning: stubborn; obstinate
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，用來形容一個人很固執、不願意改變主意或聽從別人的建議。屬於口語或俚語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone who is very stubborn and unwilling to change their mind or listen to others' advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁甲由，點都唔肯聽意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 gaap3 jau4, dim2 dou1 m4 hang2 teng1 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這麼固執，怎麼都不肯聽意見。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stubborn; he refuses to listen to any advice.

mandarin_meaning: 甲組球員；一流人物、社會上的大人物（口語）
english_meaning: first-division player; top-tier person; big shot (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，原指甲組（頂級聯賽）的球員或成員，後來引申為地位高、能力強或有份量的一流人物。有時帶敬畏或輕微揶揄意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term originally referring to players or members of the 'first division' (top league); extended to mean a high-status or highly capable person — a big shot. Can carry admiration or mild sarcasm depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係甲組腳，踢波好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5cin4 hai6 gaap3 zou2 goek3, tek3 bo1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是甲組球員，踢球很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a first-division player; he was great at playing football.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面佢係甲組腳，講嘢好有份量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1si1 jap6min6 keoi5 hai6 gaap3 zou2 goek3, gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 fan6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司裡他是個大人物，說話很有分量。
examples.english_sentence: In the company he's a big shot; his words carry weight.

mandarin_meaning: 甲虫（指一类有坚硬前翅的昆虫）
english_meaning: beetle (insect with hardened forewings/elytra)
explanation_mandarin: 指一類有堅硬前翅（鞘翅）的昆蟲，屬鞘翅目，如金龜子等，常統稱為甲蟲。
explanation_english: Refers to insects with hardened forewings (elytra); beetles belong to the order Coleoptera, e.g. scarabs and other similar insects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企後園有好多甲蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei5 hau6 jyun4 jau5 hou2 do1 gaap3 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家後院有很多甲虫。
examples.english_sentence: There are many beetles in my backyard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢捉咗隻大甲蟲，放喺樹下面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zuk1 zo2 zek3 daai6 gaap3 cung4, fong3 hai2 syu6 haa6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抓了一隻大甲虫，放在樹下。
examples.english_sentence: He caught a big beetle and put it under the tree.

mandarin_meaning: 甲醛（jiǎquán）——化学式为CH2O的无色刺激性气体，属于挥发性有机物，常用于树脂、胶合板、防腐剂等，长期接触对人体有害并具有致癌性。
english_meaning: Formaldehyde (CH2O) — a colorless, strong-smelling gas and volatile organic compound used in resins, adhesives and preservatives; toxic and classified as a human carcinogen with potential health effects on prolonged exposure.
explanation_mandarin: 甲醛是一種常見的化學物質，常以氣體或水溶液（福尔马林）形式存在，常見於新裝修材料、家具、纖維板等的揮發釋放，對呼吸系統和皮膚有刺激性，長期接觸具有健康風險。
explanation_english: Formaldehyde is a common chemical that exists as a gas or aqueous solution (formalin). It is emitted from some building materials and household products, can irritate the eyes, nose and respiratory tract, and poses health risks with prolonged exposure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新裝修嘅屋企可能有甲醛，要多啲通風先好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zong1 sau1 ge3 uk1 kei5 ho2 nang4 jau5 gaap3 cyun4, jiu3 do1 di1 tung1 fung1 sin1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新装修的房子可能有甲醛，最好多通风。
examples.english_sentence: A newly renovated home may have formaldehyde; it's best to ventilate it frequently.

mandarin_meaning: 甲骨文（商代刻在龟甲与兽骨上的文字，最早的汉字书写形态之一）
english_meaning: oracle bone script (ancient inscriptions carved on turtle plastrons and animal bones; an early form of Chinese writing)
explanation_mandarin: 甲骨文是刻在甲骨（主要是龟甲和兽骨）上的文字，多见于商代卜辞，是已知最早的汉字书写形态，对于研究古代历史、语言和文字学具有重要价值。
explanation_english: Oracle bone script refers to characters inscribed on turtle shells and animal bones (mainly from the Shang dynasty) used for divination. It is one of the earliest known forms of Chinese writing and is crucial to studies of ancient history, linguistics, and paleography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺博物館見到啲甲骨文，覺得好神奇同有歷史價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 gin3 dou3 di1 gaap3 gwat1 man4, gok3 dak1 hou2 san4 kei4 tung4 jau5 lik6 si2 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在博物馆看到甲骨文，觉得很神奇，也很有历史价值。
examples.english_sentence: I saw oracle bone inscriptions at the museum; they seemed fascinating and have great historical value.

mandarin_meaning: 申（shēn）：申述、申請、申報；姓氏；地支第九（猴）
english_meaning: to state/declare; to apply; to report; a surname; the ninth Earthly Branch (Monkey)
explanation_mandarin: 「申」字常用作動詞，表示陳述、申請、申報或提出意見，也可作為姓氏。在天干地支中為地支第九，對應生肖為猴。
explanation_english: The character '申' is commonly used as a verb meaning to state, apply, or report, or to put something forward. It can also be a surname. In the Chinese sexagenary cycle it is the ninth Earthly Branch, associated with the Monkey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經申請咗簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 san1 cing2 zo2 cim1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經申請了簽證。
examples.english_sentence: I have already applied for the visa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有問題，你可以向上司申訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 man6 tai4, nei5 ho2 ji5 hoeng3 soeng6 si1 san1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有問題，你可以向上司申訴。
examples.english_sentence: If there's a problem, you can file a complaint with your supervisor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個姓係申。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 hai6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓申。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Shen.

mandarin_meaning: 申诉冤屈；向有关方面陈述或抗辩不公，要求平反或讨回公道。
english_meaning: To plead one's innocence or seek redress for being wronged; to appeal for justice.
explanation_mandarin: 指當事人或代理人向有關機構或公眾陳述冤屈、要求平反或伸張正義，常見於法律或社會申訴情境。
explanation_english: To present a complaint or appeal that one has been wronged, asking authorities or the public to correct the injustice or clear one's name; commonly used in legal or public grievance contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向法庭申冤，話自己冇做過嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 faat3 ting4 san1 jyun1, waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 gwo3 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向法庭申冤，说自己没有做过那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He appealed to the court to plead his innocence, saying he didn't do that thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你真係畀人冤枉，就應該盡快去申冤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zan1 hai6 bei2 jan4 jyun1 wong5, zau6 jing1 goi1 zeon3 faai3 heoi3 san1 jyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你真的被冤枉，就应该尽快去申冤。
examples.english_sentence: If you're truly being wronged, you should seek redress as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗封信畀議員作公開申冤，希望引起關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 fung1 seon3 bei2 ji5 jyun4 zok3 gung1 hoi1 san1 jyun1, hei1 mong6 jan5 hei2 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了一封信给议员作公开申冤，希望引起关注。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a letter to the councilor to publicly appeal for justice, hoping to draw attention.

mandarin_meaning: 申报（向有关部门或机构正式报告或声明，如报税、向海关申报等）
english_meaning: to declare; to report; to make a formal declaration to an authority (e.g., customs, tax, government bodies)
explanation_mandarin: 向有關部門、機構或當局正式提交資訊或報告，常見於報稅、向海關或主管機關申報事項的情況。
explanation_english: To formally provide information or a report to an authority or organization. Commonly used for tax declarations, customs declarations, or reporting incidents to relevant authorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入境嗰陣，你要向海關申報帶入嘅物品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 ging2 go2 zan6, nei5 jiu3 hoeng3 hoi2 gwaan1 san1 bou3 daai3 jap6 ge3 mat6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入境的時候，你要向海關申報攜帶入境的物品。
examples.english_sentence: When entering the country, you must declare the items you bring in to customs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年報稅嗰陣要申報所有收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 bou3 seoi3 go2 zan6 jiu3 san1 bou3 so2 jau5 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年報稅的時候要申報所有收入。
examples.english_sentence: When filing taxes annually, you must declare all your income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司發生事故要即刻向有關部門申報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 faat3 sang1 si6 gu3 jiu3 zik1 hak1 hoeng3 jau5 gwaan1 bou6 mun4 san1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司發生事故要立即向有關部門申報。
examples.english_sentence: If the company has an incident, it must report it immediately to the relevant departments.

mandarin_meaning: 申根（指申根区或申根签证）
english_meaning: Schengen (the Schengen Area / Schengen visa)
explanation_mandarin: 指欧洲的申根区（申根协议成员国组成的免签或简化边境检查的区域），也常指申根签证。
explanation_english: Refers to the Schengen Area in Europe (countries participating in the Schengen Agreement that have abolished internal border controls); often used to mean a Schengen visa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咗申根簽證，我哋可以自由喺好多歐洲國家旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zo2 san1 gan1 cim1 zing3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 hai2 hou2 do1 au1 zau1 gwok3 gaa1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有了申根签证，我们可以在很多欧洲国家自由旅行。
examples.english_sentence: With a Schengen visa, we can travel freely in many European countries.

mandarin_meaning: 申索（提出要求或索取賠償、補償等）
english_meaning: to claim; to make a claim (for compensation, benefits, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示向有關方面提出要求或索取賠償、補償、福利等，常見於保險、法律或政府補助等情境。
explanation_english: To make a claim or demand something from a relevant party, often used in contexts such as insurance, legal claims, or requesting compensation or benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你受傷，可以向保險公司申索賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 sau6 soeng1, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 bou2 him2 gung1 si1 san1 sok3 pui4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你受伤，可以向保险公司申索赔偿。
examples.english_sentence: If you are injured, you can claim compensation from the insurance company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向公司申索未俾嘅人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 gung1 si1 san1 sok3 mei6 bei2 ge3 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向公司申索未付的工资。
examples.english_sentence: He claimed unpaid wages from the company.

mandarin_meaning: 申訴（向有關機構或人提出不滿、抗議或要求重新審查）
english_meaning: to lodge a complaint or appeal; to petition an authority for review or redress
explanation_mandarin: 指向有關機關、單位或人表達不滿、要求調查或重新處理的行為，常見於對處罰、裁決或服務不滿時提出申訴或申請復議。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of expressing dissatisfaction to an authority or organization and requesting investigation, review, or redress; commonly used when disputing penalties, decisions, or unsatisfactory services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔滿意，可以向有關部門申訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 mun5 ji3, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 jau5 gun1 bou6 mun4 san1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不滿意，可以向有關部門申訴。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied, you can appeal to the relevant department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生對考試成績有問題，已經向校方申訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 saang1 deoi3 haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 jau5 man6 tai4, ji5 ging1 hoeng3 haau6 fong1 san1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學生對考試成績有問題，已經向校方申訴。
examples.english_sentence: The student had issues with the exam results and has already filed a complaint with the school authorities.

jyutping: san1 sou3 zyun1 jyun4 gung1 cyu5
mandarin_meaning: 申诉专员公署（香港的獨立監察機構，處理公眾對政府部門的投訴）
english_meaning: Office of The Ombudsman (the independent Hong Kong office that handles public complaints about government departments)
explanation_mandarin: 申訴專員公署是香港的一個獨立監察機構，負責接收並調查市民對政府部門或公營機構的不當行政行為或服務投訴，並可提出改善建議。
explanation_english: The Office of The Ombudsman in Hong Kong is an independent statutory body that receives and investigates public complaints about maladministration or poor service by government departments and public organizations, and may make recommendations for improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對政府部門有投訴，可以向申訴專員公署提出申訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 jau5 tau4 sou3, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 san1 sou3 zyun1 jyun4 gung1 cyu5 tai2 ceot1 san1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果对政府部门有投诉，可以向申诉专员公署提出申诉。
examples.english_sentence: If you have a complaint about a government department, you can file it with the Office of The Ombudsman.

mandarin_meaning: 申请
english_meaning: to apply (for)
explanation_mandarin: 表示向機構或當局提出申請或請求，通常用於申請許可、入學、簽證、資助等。
explanation_english: To formally apply to an organization or authority for something, such as permission, admission, a visa, funding, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經申請咗大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 san1 cing2 zo2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经申请了大学。
examples.english_sentence: I've already applied to university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得喺截止日前申請簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 hai2 zit3 zi2 jat6 cin4 san1 cing2 cim1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得在截止日前申请签证。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to apply for the visa before the deadline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經幫我申請咗假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 bong1 ngo5 san1 cing2 zo2 gaa3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经替我申请了假期。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already applied for leave for me.

mandarin_meaning: 申请人
english_meaning: applicant
explanation_mandarin: 指提出申請、要求或登記的人，常用於法律、行政、工作或學校等正式場合，表示接受或處理某項申請的對象。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who submits an application, request, or registration. Commonly used in legal, administrative, job, or educational contexts to denote the person whose application is being received or processed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請人要喺截止日期之前遞交申請表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 jan4 jiu3 hai6 git3 zi2 jat6 kei4 zi1 cin4 dai6 gaau1 san1 cing2 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请人要在截止日期之前递交申请表。
examples.english_sentence: The applicant must submit the application form before the deadline.

mandarin_meaning: 申請書
english_meaning: application form; written application
explanation_mandarin: 以書面或表格形式向機構、單位或當局提出申請、請求或報名的文件。
explanation_english: A written document or form submitted to an organization, institution, or authority to apply for something, request permission, or register.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你填咗張申請書未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tin4 zo2 zoeng1 san1 cing2 syu1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你填好申請書了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you filled out the application form?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請書要連同身份證副本一齊遞交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 syu1 jiu3 lin4 tung4 san1 fan6 zing3 fu6 bun2 jat1 cai4 dai6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申請書需要連同身份證副本一起遞交。
examples.english_sentence: The application form needs to be submitted together with a copy of your ID.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經收到你嘅申請書，會儘快處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 sau1 dou3 nei5 ge3 san1 cing2 syu1, wui5 zeon2 faai3 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經收到你的申請書，會儘快處理。
examples.english_sentence: The company has received your application and will process it as soon as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 申請表
english_meaning: application form
explanation_mandarin: 用來申請某項資格、許可或報名的書面表格。
explanation_english: A written form used to apply for qualifications, permits, enrollment, or other official requests; the document you fill out to submit an application.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請表裏面要填寫你嘅個人資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 biu2 leoi5 min6 jiu3 tin4 se2 nei5 ge3 go3 jan4 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申請表裡面需要填寫你的個人資料。
examples.english_sentence: You need to fill in your personal information on the application form.

mandarin_meaning: 申办（向有关机构申请、办理某项手续或争取承办权）
english_meaning: to apply for; to handle/submit an application; to bid/apply to organize (an event)
explanation_mandarin: 表示向有關機構申請或辦理某項行政手續或權利，例如申辦護照、申辦簽證或申辦舉辦活動的資格。
explanation_english: Indicates applying to an authority or carrying out administrative procedures—for example, applying for a passport or visa, or applying to host/organize an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去入境事務處申辦護照續期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 heoi3 jap6 ging2 si6 mou6 cyu3 san1 baan6 wu6 ziu3 zuk6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去入境事務處申辦護照續期。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the Immigration Department next week to apply for my passport renewal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市政府準備申辦一個年度文化節，歡迎各界參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zing3 fu2 zeon2 bei6 san1 baan6 jat1 go3 nin4 dou6 man4 faa3 zit3, fun1 jing4 gok3 gaai3 caam1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市政府準備申辦一個年度文化節，歡迎各界參與。
examples.english_sentence: The municipal government is preparing to apply to organize an annual cultural festival and welcomes participation from all sectors.

mandarin_meaning: 申辩（向對方或法庭等陳述理由為自己辯護）
english_meaning: to plead in one's defense; to state one's case; to argue in defense
explanation_mandarin: 向對方、法庭或公眾陳述理由或證據，為自己辯護或澄清誤會。
explanation_english: To present reasons, explanations, or evidence to defend oneself, clarify misunderstandings, or rebut accusations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法庭上申辯，話自己冇做過嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng5 san1 bin6, waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 gwo3 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在法庭上申辯，說自己沒做過那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He pleaded in court, saying he didn't do that thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我準備好文件去向公司申辯我嘅立場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 man4 gin2 heoi3 hoeng3 gung1 si1 san1 bin6 ngo5 ge3 laap6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我準備好文件去向公司申辯我的立場。
examples.english_sentence: I prepared documents to present my defense/position to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有傳聞講佢出事，佢請記者會出面申辯同澄清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cyun4 man4 gong2 keoi5 ceot1 si6, keoi5 ceng2 gei3 ze2 wui2 ceot1 min6 san1 bin6 tung4 cing4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有傳聞說他出事，他召開記者會出面申辯並澄清。
examples.english_sentence: There were rumors that he was involved in an incident; he held a press conference to defend himself and clarify the matter.

mandarin_meaning: 申述（向有關方面正式陳述自己的意見、理由或事實，常用於法律或申訴場合）
english_meaning: to state or present one's case; to formally describe or explain facts/reasons (often in legal or complaint contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 以正式方式向有關機構或人員陳述事實、理由或意見，常見於法庭、投訴或申訴程序中。
explanation_english: To formally present or explain facts, reasons, or opinions to relevant parties; commonly used in courts, complaints, or appeal procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師喺庭上為當事人申述案情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 si1 hai2 ting4 soeng6 wai6 dong1 si6 jan4 san1 seot6 on3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律師在庭上為當事人申述案情。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer presented the case on behalf of the client in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔滿意判決，可以向上級申述。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 mun5 ji3 pun3 kyut3, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 soeng6 kap1 san1 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不滿意判決，可以向上級申述。
examples.english_sentence: If you're dissatisfied with the verdict, you can appeal to a higher authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 受害人向警方申述事發經過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau6 hoi6 jan4 hoeng3 ging2 fong1 san1 seot6 si6 faat3 ging1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 受害人向警方申述事發經過。
examples.english_sentence: The victim told the police the sequence of events.

mandarin_meaning: 申领（向有關單位申請並領取某項款項、證件或福利）
english_meaning: to apply for and receive; to claim (benefits, payments, documents, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 向有關機構或部門提出申請以領取款項、證件、補助或其他福利的動作或程序。
explanation_english: The action or procedure of applying to an authority or organization in order to receive an item, payment, document, subsidy, or other benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你已經去政府部門申領失業救濟金未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 ging1 heoi3 zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 san1 ling5 sat1 jip6 gau3 zai3 gam1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已經去政府部門申領失業救濟金了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you already gone to the government office to claim unemployment benefits?

mandarin_meaning: （古）一種昆蟲；有時方言中用來指蟲類
english_meaning: rare/archaic character for an insect; occasionally used dialectally to refer to insects (sometimes cockroaches)
explanation_mandarin: 甴為較少見的漢字，主要出現在古籍或文獻中，用作指稱某種昆蟲。在現代口語中偶爾被方言或俗寫用來代指蟲類。
explanation_english: 甴 is a rare, archaic Chinese character historically used to denote a type of insect. It appears mainly in classical texts; in modern dialectal or colloquial use it is sometimes used to refer loosely to insects (occasionally cockroaches).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字甴好少見，多數喺古書入面用嚟指一種昆蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 zaa1 hou2 siu2 gin3, do1 sou3 hai2 gu2 syu1 jap6 min6 jung6 lai4 zi2 jat1 zung2 kwan1 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字甴很少见，多数在古书中用来指一种昆虫。
examples.english_sentence: The character 甴 is rarely seen; it is mostly used in classical books to refer to a type of insect.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）蟑螂
