examples.mandarin_sentence: 班上有人傳他有異心，大家都不太信任他。
examples.english_sentence: There are rumors in the class that he is untrustworthy; people don't trust him much.

mandarin_meaning: 异性（指与自己性别相反的人）
english_meaning: opposite sex; person of the opposite gender
explanation_mandarin: 指与自己性别相反的人，常用于描述男女之间的性别关系或差异。
explanation_english: Refers to people of the opposite sex or gender; used to describe the other gender in relation to oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想同異性單獨出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 tung4 ji6 sing3 daan1 duk6 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想和异性单独出去。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to go out alone with someone of the opposite sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺職場上，男女應該平等對待，唔可以因為係異性就有差別待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6, naam4 neoi5 jing1 goi1 ping4 dang2 deoi3 doi6, m4 ho2 ji5 jan1 wai6 hai6 ji6 sing3 zau6 jau5 caa1 bit6 doi6 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在职场上，男女应该平等对待，不能因为是异性就有差别待遇。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace, men and women should be treated equally; you shouldn't discriminate just because someone is of the opposite sex.

mandarin_meaning: 異性戀 (yìxìngliàn)
english_meaning: heterosexuality; heterosexual
explanation_mandarin: 指對異性有情感或性吸引的性取向。
explanation_english: A sexual orientation characterized by emotional and sexual attraction to people of the opposite sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係異性戀，對同性冇興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ji6 sing3 lyun6, deoi3 tung4 sing3 mou5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是異性戀，對同性沒有興趣。
examples.english_sentence: They are heterosexual and not attracted to the same sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會上大多數人係異性戀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 soeng6 daai6 do1 sou3 jan4 hai6 ji6 sing3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會上大多數人是異性戀。
examples.english_sentence: Most people in society are heterosexual.

mandarin_meaning: 异性缘
english_meaning: attraction/appeal to the opposite sex; luck with the opposite sex
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人在異性中容易獲得好感或有較多異性緣分，常用來形容在愛情或社交方面與異性相處時較受歡迎的特質或運氣。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's attractiveness or luck with the opposite sex — the tendency to attract romantic interest or to be popular among members of the opposite sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有異性緣，成日有人約佢出去飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 ji6 sing3 jyun4, seng4 jat6 jau5 jan4 joek3 keoi5 ceot1 heoi3 jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她很有异性缘，经常有人约他/她出去喝东西。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is very popular with the opposite sex; people often ask him/her out for drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢樣子唔係咁靚，但佢好有異性緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jyun4 keoi5 joeng6 zi2 m4 hai6 gam3 leng3, daan6 keoi5 hou2 jau5 ji6 sing3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他/她长得不算漂亮，但很有异性缘。
examples.english_sentence: Although he/she isn't that good-looking, they have strong appeal to the opposite sex.

mandarin_meaning: 指不切实际、荒唐或天马行空的想法
english_meaning: to have fanciful, unrealistic, or wildly imaginative ideas; daydreaming or absurd notions
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 形容想法不切实际、荒唐或天馬行空，常帶有批評或戲謔的語氣，指某人的構想不現實。
explanation_english: Describes ideas or plans that are unrealistic, absurd, or wildly fanciful. Often used to criticize or tease someone for having impractical notions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日異想天開，話要發明一部會飛嘅單車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ji6 soeng2 tin1 hoi1, waa6 jiu3 faat3 ming4 jat1 bou6 wui5 fei1 ge3 daan1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是異想天開，說要發明一輛會飛的單車。
examples.english_sentence: He's always coming up with fanciful ideas, saying he'll invent a flying bicycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好異想天開，以為唔做功課都可以考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji6 soeng2 tin1 hoi1, ji5 wai4 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3 dou1 ho2 ji5 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別異想天開，認為不做功課也能考得好成績。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fanciful and expect to get good grades without doing any homework.

mandarin_meaning: 異教徒（yì jiào tú）
english_meaning: heretic; person of a different faith; non-believer (often derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指信仰不同宗教或被視為異端的人，常帶貶義，用於指出某人與主流宗教或教義不同。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who follows a different religion or is regarded as heretical; often used pejoratively to label someone whose beliefs differ from the mainstream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人話係異敎徒，搞到好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 ji6 gaau3 tou4, gaau2 dou3 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人說是異教徒，弄得很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He was called a heretic, which made him very unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 异教徒（yìjiàotú）：信奉與某一宗教不同的信徒
english_meaning: infidel; heathen; someone who follows a different religion
explanation_mandarin: 指屬於或信奉不同宗教的人，常出現在宗教、歷史或文化討論中；有時帶貶義或宗教色彩。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who belongs to or practices a different religion; commonly used in religious, historical, or cultural contexts and can carry pejorative or sectarian connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺嗰度俾人話係異教徒，因為佢信唔同宗教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go2 dou6 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 ji6 gaau3 tou4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 seon3 m4 tung4 zung1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那裡被人說是異教徒，因為他信仰不同的宗教。
examples.english_sentence: He was called an infidel there because he practices a different religion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中世紀好多異教徒畀人當成異端，受到迫害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 sai3 gei3 hou2 do1 ji6 gaau3 tou4 bei2 jan4 dong3 sing4 ji6 dyun1 sau6 bik1hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中世纪许多异教徒被视为异端，受到迫害。
examples.english_sentence: In the Middle Ages many non-believers were considered heretics and persecuted.

mandarin_meaning: 异数（yìshù）：异常值、例外情况或特例
english_meaning: an outlier; an anomalous case; an exception
explanation_mandarin: 指在某個統計或常規情況下與大多數不同、偏離常態的數值或個案，也可用來形容例外的人或事。
explanation_english: Refers to a value or case that deviates from the majority or norm in a statistical or typical situation; can also describe an exceptional person or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢嘅分數係一個異數，平時成績一直都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 ge3 fan1 sou3 hai6 jat1 go3 ji6-sou3, ping4 si4 sing4 zik1 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他的分数是一个异数，平时成绩一直都很高。
examples.english_sentence: His score on this exam is an outlier; his usual grades have always been much higher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司整體業績有增長，但呢間分店係個異數，業績反而下跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing2 tai2 jip6 zik1 jau5 zang1 zoeng2, daan6 ni1 gaan1 fan1 dim3 hai6 go3 ji6-sou3, jip6 zik1 faan2 ji4 haa6 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司整体业绩有增长，但这家分店是个异数，业绩反而下跌。
examples.english_sentence: The company's overall performance rose, but this branch is an outlier — its performance actually declined.

mandarin_meaning: 异于常人（yì yú cháng rén）
english_meaning: different from ordinary people; unusual; extraordinary
explanation_mandarin: 表示在性格、行為或能力等方面與一般人不同，既可用來稱讚某人非凡出眾，也可指其行為怪異、反常。
explanation_english: Indicates being unlike ordinary people in personality, behavior, or ability. Can be used positively (remarkable, outstanding) or negatively (odd, abnormal).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為異於常人，有時會令人覺得奇怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 ji6 jyu1 soeng4 jan4, jau5 si4 wui5 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 kei4 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为异于常人，有时会让人觉得奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is different from ordinary people; sometimes it can make people feel strange.

mandarin_meaning: 異曲同工
english_meaning: Different methods/styles produce similar results; different works show the same level of skill or effect.
explanation_mandarin: 成語，原意是不同的曲調卻有相同的巧妙或效果。比喻方法、風格或表現形式雖然不同，但效果、功力或價值相當。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom literally meaning 'different tunes, same workmanship.' It describes situations where different methods or styles yield similar results or exhibit comparable skill or merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩位導演拍嘅電影風格完全唔同，但觀眾都話異曲同工，各有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 wai2 dou6 jin2 paak3 ge3 din6 jing2 fung1 gaak3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4, daan6 gun1 zung3 dou1 waa6 ji6 kuk1 tung4 gung1, gok3 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩位導演拍的電影風格完全不同，但觀眾都說異曲同工，各有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The two directors' films have completely different styles, but audiences say they're equally accomplished — each has its own merits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 儘管你嘅方法同我唔一樣，但結果竟然異曲同工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeon2 gun2 nei5 ge3 fong1 faat3 tung4 ngo5 m4 jat1 joeng6, daan6 git3 gwo2 ging2 jin4 ji6 kuk1 tung4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儘管你的方法和我的不一樣，但結果竟然異曲同工。
examples.english_sentence: Although your method is different from mine, the results turned out to be the same.

mandarin_meaning: 異樣（不同尋常、奇怪的樣子）
english_meaning: unusual; strange; different appearance
explanation_mandarin: 表示與平常不同或奇怪的樣子，可用來形容表情、氣氛或事物的異常。
explanation_english: Indicates something unusual or strange; used to describe an abnormal appearance, expression, atmosphere, or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我嘅時候即刻露出異樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 ngo5 ge3 si4 hau6 zik1 hak1 lou6 ceot1 ji6 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我的時候立刻露出異樣。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw me, he immediately showed a strange expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜嘅味道有啲異樣，不過都幾好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 ge3 mei6 dou6 jau5 di1 ji6 joeng6, bat1 gwo3 dou1 gei2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這道菜的味道有點不一樣，不過還挺好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The flavor of this dish is a bit different, but it's still quite tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 異物（指外來的物質或物件）
english_meaning: foreign object; foreign body (an object or substance that does not belong in a given environment, especially inside the body)
explanation_mandarin: 指不屬於當地組織、系統或環境的物質或物件，常用於醫學或安全場景，例如氣管、傷口或食物內發現的異物，需要移除或處理。
explanation_english: Refers to a substance or object that does not belong to the host tissue, system, or environment. Commonly used in medical or safety contexts (e.g., a foreign body in the airway, wound, or food) that usually requires removal or disposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺手術期間，醫生發現傷口入面有異物，需要即刻清除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sau2 seot6 kei4 gaan1, ji1 sang1 faat3 jin4 soeng1 hau2 jap6 min6 jau5 ji6 mat6, seoi1 jiu3 zik1 hak1 cing1 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在手術期間，醫生發現傷口裡有異物，需要立即清除。
examples.english_sentence: During the operation, the doctor found a foreign object in the wound and needed to remove it immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果食物入面有異物，就唔好食，應該通知店員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 sik6 mat6 jap6 min6 jau5 ji6 mat6, zau6 m4 hou2 sik6, jing1 goi1 tung1 zi1 dim3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果食物裡有異物，就不要吃，應該通知店員。
examples.english_sentence: If there is a foreign object in the food, don't eat it and inform the staff.

mandarin_meaning: 異狀（yìzhuàng）：異常的情況或表現
english_meaning: abnormality; unusual condition or symptom
explanation_mandarin: 指出現與正常情況不同、異常的徵象或變化，常用於描述身體症狀、機械故障或情勢異常。
explanation_english: Refers to an abnormal or unusual sign/condition; commonly used to describe bodily symptoms, mechanical malfunctions, or irregular situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話病人有異狀，要再檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 beng6 jan4 jau5 ji6 zong6, jiu3 zoi3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說病人有異狀，要再檢查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the patient showed abnormalities and needs further tests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議期間，佢舉動有啲異狀，大家都留意到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 kei4 gaan1, keoi5 geoi2 dung6 jau5 di1 ji6 zong6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 lau4 ji3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議期間，他的舉動有些異常，大家都注意到了。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, his behavior was somewhat unusual; everyone noticed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車輛出現異狀，駕駛員即刻停車檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 loeng6 ceot1 jin6 ji6 zong6, gaa3 si2 jyun4 zik1 haak1 ting4 ce1 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 車輛出現異狀，駕駛員立刻停車檢查。
examples.english_sentence: The vehicle showed abnormal signs, and the driver stopped immediately to inspect it.

mandarin_meaning: 不同的樣子；外貌或表現有所改變
english_meaning: a different appearance; a changed look or aspect
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外表、樣子或表現與過去或預期不一樣，常指變化明顯而容易辨認的改變。
explanation_english: Used to describe an appearance, look, or aspect that differs from before or from expectation; often implies a noticeable change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下呢張舊相，佢而家個人異相哂，完全認唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 zoeng1 gau6 soeng2, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 go3 jan4 ji6 soeng2 saai3, jyun4 cyun4 jing6 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看這張舊相，他現在的樣子完全變了，根本認不出來。
examples.english_sentence: Look at this old photo — he looks completely different now; I can't recognize him.

mandarin_meaning: 異端（指與正統教義或主流觀念相悖的思想或教說）
english_meaning: heresy; heterodoxy — beliefs or doctrines considered contrary to established or orthodox doctrines
explanation_mandarin: 指與宗教或思想上的正統觀念相違背的見解或教說，常帶有被排斥或指責為錯誤的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to beliefs or doctrines that go against established religious or ideological orthodoxy, often carrying a sense of being rejected or condemned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺教會入面，佢啲理念被人話係異端。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gaau3 wui6 jap6 min6, keoi5 di1 lei5 nim6 bei6 jan4 waa6 hai6 ji6 dyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在教會裡，他的理念被人說成是異端。
examples.english_sentence: In the church, his ideas were labeled as heretical.

mandarin_meaning: 異能（超能力、特殊能力）
english_meaning: supernatural ability; special power; psychic power
explanation_mandarin: 指超出常人範圍的特殊能力或超能力，常見於小說、漫畫、電影等虛構作品或討論超自然現象時使用。
explanation_english: Refers to abilities beyond normal human capabilities, often used in fiction (novels, comics, movies) or in discussions of supernatural phenomena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有異能，可以操控物件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 ji6 nang4, ho2 ji5 cou1 hung3 mat6 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她有異能，可以操控物體。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has a special power and can manipulate objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校有啲人相信異能係真實存在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jau5 di1 jan4 soeng1 seon3 ji6 nang4 hai6 zan1 sat6 cyun4 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校裡有些人相信異能是真實存在的。
examples.english_sentence: Some people at school believe that supernatural powers really exist.

mandarin_meaning: 异议；不同意见
english_meaning: dissent; differing opinion; objection
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事持不同的意見或觀點，常用於正式或書面語，亦可指對政策或決定的反對意見。
explanation_english: Refers to a differing opinion or objection, often used in formal or written contexts; can denote disagreement with a policy, decision, or proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議入面有人提出異見，討論咗好耐都未搵到共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 jau5 jan4 tai4 ceot1 ji6 gin3, tou2 leon6 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mei6 wan2 dou3 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议里面有人提出异议，讨论了很久都还没找到共识。
examples.english_sentence: Someone raised dissenting opinions during the meeting; they discussed for a long time but still couldn't reach a consensus.

mandarin_meaning: 异见人士 / 持有不同观点或政见的人
english_meaning: dissident; a person holding dissenting views (often political)
explanation_mandarin: 指在政治或社會議題上持有不同意見或反對主流觀點的人，常用於描述反對者或批評政府的人士。
explanation_english: Refers to people who hold opinions that differ from or oppose mainstream or government views, often used for political dissenters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方拘捕咗幾位異見人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gu1 bou6 zo2 gei2 wai6 ji6 gin3 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方逮捕了几位异见人士。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested several dissidents.

mandarin_meaning: 異議 (yìyì)，表示不同意見或反對的意見
english_meaning: objection; dissent; disagreement
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（可作「提出異議」）
partOfSpeech_english: noun / verb (can be used as 'raise an objection')
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個決定、意見或提議不贊同或提出異議，常見於正式或法律語境中。
explanation_english: Expresses disagreement or objection to a decision, opinion, or proposal; commonly used in formal or legal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個決定有異議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 jau5 ji6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對這個決定有異議。
examples.english_sentence: I have objections to this decision.

mandarin_meaning: 异象，指不寻常的现象、异兆或宗教性的异象（异常的景象或显现）
english_meaning: anomalous phenomenon; strange sight; portent; (religious) vision
explanation_mandarin: “異象”通常用來描述不尋常或超出常理的現象，可指自然界的怪異景象、被視為徵兆的異狀，或宗教、靈異場合所稱的異象／顯現。
explanation_english: “異象” refers to unusual or extraordinary phenomena. It can denote strange natural sights, portentous signs, or visionary/supernatural manifestations often mentioned in religious or cultural contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話夜晚見到奇怪嘅異象，天上好似有光柱射落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 je6 maan5 gin3 dou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 ji6 zoeng6, tin1 soeng6 hou2 ci5 jau5 gwong1 cyu5 se6 lok6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說晚上看到奇怪的異象，天上好像有光柱射下來。
examples.english_sentence: Some people said they saw strange phenomena at night — it looked like beams of light shooting down from the sky.

mandarin_meaning: 异军突起（yì jūn tū qǐ）——指原本不被注意的势力或人物突然兴起，迅速崛起并产生重大影响。
english_meaning: To suddenly emerge as a new force; to rise to prominence unexpectedly and make a significant impact.
explanation_mandarin: 指原本不被注意或处于弱势的团体、个人或事物，在短时间内迅速兴起并造成显著影响。
explanation_english: Refers to a previously unnoticed or minor group, person, or phenomenon that rapidly rises to prominence and exerts significant influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年有幾間初創公司異軍突起，改變咗成個行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 jau5 gei2 gaan1 co1 cong3 gung1 si1 ji6 gwan1 dat6 hei2, goi2 bin3 zo2 sing4 go3 hong4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来有几家初创公司异军突起，改变了整个行业。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years several startups have suddenly risen to prominence and changed the whole industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅獨立樂隊最近異軍突起，好受年青人歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 duk6 laap6 ngok6 deoi6 zeoi3 gan6 ji6 gwan1 dat6 hei2, hou2 sau6 nin4 cing1 jan4 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的独立乐队最近异军突起，很受年轻人欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: Independent bands in Hong Kong have recently risen to prominence and are very popular with young people.

mandarin_meaning: 異邦（外國、他鄉）
english_meaning: foreign land; foreign country
explanation_mandarin: 指外國或非本國的地方，語感偏書面或文言，可用來強調陌生或遙遠的他鄉。
explanation_english: Refers to a foreign country or land different from one's own. The term is somewhat literary/formal and can emphasize being in a strange or distant place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺異邦生活咗十年先返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji6 bong1 saang1 wut6 zo2 sap6 nin4 sin1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在異邦生活了十年才回來。
examples.english_sentence: He lived in a foreign land for ten years before returning.

mandarin_meaning: 异乡（指非故乡或他乡）
english_meaning: a foreign land; a place away from one's hometown; an unfamiliar place
explanation_mandarin: 指非本地或非故鄉的地方，常用來表達離鄉背井或感到陌生的環境。
explanation_english: Refers to a place that is not one's native home; often used to express being away from home or feeling unfamiliar in a new environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺異鄉打工，成日好掛住屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji6 hoeng1 daa2 gung1, sing4 jat6 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在异乡打工，经常很想念家。
examples.english_sentence: He works in a foreign place and often misses home.

mandarin_meaning: 異類／格格不入的人或不同類型的事物
english_meaning: a different kind; an oddball; an outcast; a distinct category/type
explanation_mandarin: 指與大多數不同的人或事物，常帶貶義，用來形容怪異、格格不入或不屬於同一類別的個體或現象。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing that is different from the majority; often negative (an oddball/outcast), but can also mean something belonging to a distinct category or type.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司裏面，佢成日唔守規矩，大家覺得佢係個異類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 sau2 kwai1 zuk1, daai6 gaa1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hai6 go3 ji6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司裡面，他經常不守規矩，大家覺得他是個異類。
examples.english_sentence: At the company, he often doesn't follow the rules; everyone thinks he's an oddball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現得太突兀，成日畀人話係個異類，但其實佢好有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 jin2 dak1 taai3 dat6 ngat6, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 go3 ji6 leoi6, daan6 kei4 sat6 keoi5 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表現得太突兀，常被人說是個異類，但其實他很有創意。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is too striking; people often call him an oddball, but actually he's very creative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲菌同其他唔同，係屬於一種異類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 kwan2 tung4 kei4 taa1 m4 tung4, hai6 suk6 jyu1 jat1 zung2 ji6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些菌跟其他不同，屬於一種異類。
examples.english_sentence: These bacteria are different from the others; they belong to a distinct type.

mandarin_meaning: 异体；指文字或形体的不同形式（如异体字）
english_meaning: variant form; a different form of a character, symbol, or body (e.g. variant character)
explanation_mandarin: 指同一字、符號或形體的不同寫法或形式，常用於描述異體字或不同字形。
explanation_english: Refers to different forms or variants of the same character, symbol, or form; commonly used for variant characters and alternative glyphs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字有好多異體，一啲係古代用法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 jau5 hou2 do1 ji6 tai2, jat1 di1 hai6 gu2 doi6 jung6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字有很多异体，有一些是古代用法。
examples.english_sentence: This character has many variant forms; some are archaic usages.

mandarin_meaning: 异体字（指同一汉字的不同书写形式或字形变体）
english_meaning: variant character; a variant form of a Chinese character
explanation_mandarin: 指同一個漢字在不同時代、地域、字書或書寫習慣中出現的不同字形或書寫形式，可能是異體字形、簡繁差異或字形演變的結果。
explanation_english: Refers to different glyphs or written forms of the same Chinese character that appear across periods, regions, reference works, or writing conventions; includes variant shapes arising from historical evolution or orthographic differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本字典列出咗好多漢字嘅異體字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 zi6din2 lit6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 hon3 zi6 ge3 ji6 tai2 zi6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本字典列出了很多漢字的異體字。
examples.english_sentence: This dictionary lists many variant forms of Chinese characters.

mandarin_meaning: （1）当然；理所当然（2）把……当作、视为；担任、充当（3）当（典当，抵押）
english_meaning: (1) of course; naturally (2) to regard/treat as; to serve as (3) to pawn
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 副词 / 连词
explanation_mandarin: 「當」在粵語中有多種用法：作副詞時可表示「當然」；作動詞時可表示擔任、充當或把某物視為某物；亦可表示「當（典當）」的意思。不同詞組中可能讀音有別（常見讀音為 dong1 或 dong3）。
explanation_english: "當" has multiple uses in Cantonese: as an adverb meaning "of course"; as a verb meaning to serve as, to regard/treat as; and as a verb meaning to pawn. Pronunciation may vary by context (commonly dong1 or dong3).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當然我會幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 jin4 ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当然我会帮你。
examples.english_sentence: Of course I'll help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當老師已經十年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 lou5 si1 ji5 ging1 sap6 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當老師已經十年了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been a teacher for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去當舖當咗個金鍊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 dong3 pou3 dong3 zo2 go3 gam1 lin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去當鋪把一條金鍊當了。
examples.english_sentence: He pawned a gold necklace at the pawnshop.

mandarin_meaning: 當中 (dāngzhōng) — 在多個事物或人之間、中間或其中
english_meaning: among; in the middle of; in the midst
explanation_mandarin: 表示在多個事物或人之中，指位於中間或在其中，常用來說明範圍或位置。
explanation_english: Indicates being among multiple things or people, located in the middle or within; commonly used to describe scope or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班當中有幾個學生已經考得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 dong1 zung1 jau5 gei2 go3 hok6 saang1 ji5 ging1 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們班當中有幾個學生已經考得很好。
examples.english_sentence: Among our class, a few students have already done very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢堆文件當中，你可以搵到合約嘅副本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 deoi1 man4 gin6 dong1 zung1, nei5 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 hap6 joek3 ge3 fuk1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這堆文件當中，你可以找到合約的副本。
examples.english_sentence: Among these documents, you can find the copy of the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺眾多選擇當中，我揀咗呢一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung3 do1 syun2 zaak6 dong1 zung1, ngo5 gaan2 zo2 ni1 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在眾多選擇當中，我選了這一個。
examples.english_sentence: Among many options, I chose this one.

mandarin_meaning: 当之无愧（实至名归，配得上荣誉或称号）
english_meaning: fully deserving; well deserved; worthy of (a title, honor, or praise)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事完全配得上某種榮譽、稱號或讚揚，毫無愧疚或不配之處。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something fully deserves a title, honor, or praise — there is no cause for shame or feeling unworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憑住呢部電影攞咗最佳男主角，當之無愧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 zyu6 ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 lo2 zo2 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3, dong1 zi1 mou4 kui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他凭这部电影获得了最佳男主角，当之无愧。
examples.english_sentence: He won Best Actor for this film — well deserved.

mandarin_meaning: 当事人
english_meaning: the party concerned; person involved (in an incident or legal case)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某件事件或法律案件中直接涉及的人，例如原告、被告或其他相關當事者。
explanation_english: Refers to a person directly involved in an event or legal case, e.g., the plaintiff, defendant, or other relevant parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要聯絡當事人了解詳情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lyun4 lok3 dong1 si6 jan4 liu5 gaai2 zoeng1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要聯絡當事人了解詳情。
examples.english_sentence: We need to contact the party concerned to understand the details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭要求當事人出庭作證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 teng4 jiu1 kau4 dong1 si6 jan4 ceot1 ting4 zok3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院要求當事人出庭作證。
examples.english_sentence: The court requested the party involved to appear in court to testify.

mandarin_meaning: 當作交學費；把失敗或損失視為學習的代價，從中吸取教訓
english_meaning: to treat a loss or mistake as paying tuition; to take an experience as a lesson and learn from it
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示把犯錯、損失或挫折視為學習成本，不抱怨而從中吸取教訓、改進自己。
explanation_english: Used to say that one treats a mistake, loss, or setback as the cost of learning, accepting it and learning the lesson rather than complaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做錯咗就認，當交學費，下次小心啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 co3 zo2 zau6 jing6, dong1 gaau1 hok6 fai3, haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做错了就承认，當作交學費，下次小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: If you made a mistake, admit it and treat it as paying tuition — be more careful next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢筆損失雖然貴，但我當交學費，至少學到咗經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bat1 syun2 sat1 seoi1 jin4 gwai3, daan6 ngo5 dong1 gaau1 hok6 fai3, zi3 siu2 hok6 dou3 zo2 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔损失虽然昂贵，但我当作交学费，至少学到了经验。
examples.english_sentence: Although this loss was expensive, I take it as paying tuition — at least I gained experience.

mandarin_meaning: 當仁不讓 (dāng rén bù ràng) — 不推讓應盡的責任或崗位；遇到應該承擔的事勇於擔當。
english_meaning: To not shirk one's duty; to willingly take on responsibility or step forward when required; to not yield in doing what is right.
explanation_mandarin: 「當仁不讓」出自儒家語境，意指面對應承擔的道義或責任時，不退讓而勇於承擔，常用以稱讚一個人有擔當。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to step forward and assume responsibility when duty calls; often used to praise someone for being willing to take charge or act with moral courage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺重要場合，佢總係當仁不讓，主動發言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung6 jiu3 coeng4 hap6, keoi5 zung2 hai6 dong1 jan4 bat1 joeng6, zyu2 dung6 faat3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在重要場合，他總是當仁不讓，主動發言。
examples.english_sentence: At important occasions, he always steps up and speaks up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，佢當仁不讓，主動承擔責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, keoi5 dong1 jan4 bat1 joeng6, zyu2 dung6 sing4 daam1 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出事，他當仁不讓，主動承擔責任。
examples.english_sentence: When the company ran into trouble, he did not hesitate to take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 当今；如今；当前
english_meaning: nowadays; at present; the current time
explanation_mandarin: 表示現在或當前的時代、情況，常用來引出對當下狀況的描述或評論，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Refers to the present time or current era; used to introduce descriptions or comments about the contemporary situation. It is relatively formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當今社會嘅節奏越來越快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 gam1 se5 wui6 ge3 zit3 zau6 jyut6 loi4 jyut6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当今社会的节奏越来越快。
examples.english_sentence: The pace of today's society is getting faster and faster.

mandarin_meaning: 当代
english_meaning: contemporary; modern; of the present era
explanation_mandarin: 表示属于当今这一时代，常用于描述思想、文化、艺术、社会现象等与当下时代相关的事物或概念。
explanation_english: Refers to things belonging to the present era; commonly used to describe ideas, culture, art, or social phenomena relevant to the current age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意研究當代藝術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 jin4 gau3 dong1 doi6 ngai6 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢研究当代艺术。
examples.english_sentence: He likes studying contemporary art.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當代社會有好多問題需要面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 doi6 se5 wui6 jau5 hou2 do1 man6 tai4 seoi1 jiu3 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当代社会有很多问题需要面对。
examples.english_sentence: Contemporary society has many problems that need to be addressed.

mandarin_meaning: 当着（某人）的面；在……面前
english_meaning: in front of (someone); to one's face; openly/in public
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某人或某些人面前做某事或說某話，強調當著對方的面、公開地進行。
explanation_english: Used to indicate doing or saying something in someone's presence or openly in front of others; emphasizes that the action is done to someone's face or publicly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好當住佢講啲咁嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dong3 zyu6 keoi5 gong2 di1 gam2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要当着他/她说这些话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say those things in front of him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當住大家批評我，我好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 zyu6 daai6 gaa1 pai1 ping4 ngo5, ngo5 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当着大家批评我，我很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He criticized me in front of everyone; I felt uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以當住我講真話，我唔會嬲你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 dong3 zyu6 ngo5 gong2 zan1 waa6, ngo5 m4 wui5 nau1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以当着我说实话，我不会生你的气。
examples.english_sentence: You can tell me the truth to my face; I won't be mad at you.

mandarin_meaning: 把……当作 / 把……看作（视为）
english_meaning: to treat/regard/consider (someone or something) as
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人或某事物看作、视为某种身份、性质或类别，常用来引出对对象的归类或评价。
explanation_english: Used to indicate regarding or treating someone/something as a particular identity, quality, or category; commonly used to classify or evaluate the object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好當作我唔識做，有咩問題就問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dong1 zok3 ngo5 m4 sik1 zou6, jau5 me1 man6 tai4 zau6 man6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把我当作不会做事的人，有问题就问我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat me as someone who can't do it; if there's a problem, ask me.

mandarin_meaning: 把自己當神一樣／擺架子
english_meaning: to act as if one is a god; to act high-and-mighty
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人擺出自以為很了不起、居高臨下或自大態度，通常帶有諷刺或不滿的語氣。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who behaves arrogantly or self-importantly, as if they're above others. Often carries a sarcastic or critical tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好當你神噉拜啦，唔係所有人都要聽你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dong1 nei5 san4 gam2 baai3 laa3, m4 hai6 so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 jiu3 teng1 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把自己當神一樣，並不是每個人都要聽你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like you're a god; not everyone has to listen to you.

mandarin_meaning: 把他/她當作沒來（或不存在）
english_meaning: to treat someone as if they aren't here / to ignore someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人當作不存在或假裝沒看到他/她，通常用來形容冷落、忽視或不理會某人。
explanation_english: Means to treat someone as if they don't exist or to deliberately ignore them; commonly used to describe snubbing or excluding someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日當佢冇到，佢都想幫手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dong3 keoi5 mou5 dou3, keoi5 dou1 soeng2 bong1 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別總把他當作沒來，他也想幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always act like he's not here; he wants to help too.

mandarin_meaning: 把某人當作透明人；忽視某人
english_meaning: to ignore someone; to treat someone as if they are invisible
explanation_mandarin: 口語（廣東話）表達，意思是刻意不理會某人，像看不見對方一樣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to deliberately ignore someone, treating them as if they are invisible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司成日當我透明，連句招呼都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 dong3 ngo5 tou4 ming4, lin4 geoi3 ziu1 fu1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司總是把我當作透明人，連一句招呼都不理。
examples.english_sentence: He always treats me like I'm invisible at the company; he doesn't even say hello.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你覺得佢當你透明，你應該直接問清楚發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dong3 nei5 tou4 ming4, nei5 jing1 goi1 zik6 zip3 man6 cing1 co2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你覺得他把你當透明，你應該直接問清楚發生什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: If you feel he's treating you like you're invisible, you should directly ask what's going on.

mandarin_meaning: 值班
english_meaning: to be on duty; to stand a shift
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某個時間段負責值班或當班，通常指在醫院、學校、警署等需要輪值的崗位上工作。
explanation_english: Indicates being responsible for duty during a specific time period, usually referring to working a shift at places like hospitals, schools, or police stations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我當值，要留喺醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1maan5 ngo5 dong1 zik6, jiu3 lau4 hai2 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我值班，要留在醫院。
examples.english_sentence: I'm on duty tonight; I have to stay at the hospital.

mandarin_meaning: 当作 / 当做 (把…视为)
english_meaning: to regard as; to treat as; to consider
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“當做”用來表示把某人或某事看作、視為某種身份、狀態或性質，相當於普通話的“當作/當做”。通常用於把一件事或一個人歸類或視為某種情況。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '當做' is used to indicate treating or regarding someone or something as a particular person, status, or quality. It corresponds to Mandarin '當作/當做' and means 'to consider' or 'to treat as.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以當做冇發生過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 dong3 zou6 mou5 faat3 sang1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以当做没发生过。
examples.english_sentence: You can treat it as if it never happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將我嘅建議當做批評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 ngo5 ge3 gin3 ji5 dong3 zou6 pui1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把我的建议当作批评。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take my suggestion as criticism.

mandarin_meaning: 服兵役；當兵
english_meaning: to serve in the military; to enlist
explanation_mandarin: 指加入軍隊進行訓練或履行兵役的行為，可作口語或書面用語。
explanation_english: Refers to joining the armed forces or performing military service; used in both colloquial and formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿哥已經去當兵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3go1 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dong3 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哥哥已經去當兵了。
examples.english_sentence: His older brother has already gone to serve in the military.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想當兵，因為我想繼續讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 dong3 bing1, jan1 wai6 ngo5 soeng2 gai3 zuk6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想當兵，因為我想繼續讀書。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to join the military because I want to continue my studies.

mandarin_meaning: 當時 / 那時候
english_meaning: at that time; then
explanation_mandarin: 表示在那個特定時間（當時）。語體上較偏書面或較正式的用法，可用於敘述過去情況。
explanation_english: Indicates a specific time in the past ('at that time'). Often used in more formal or literary contexts to describe past situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當其時我哋仲未識佢，依家已經成為好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 kei4 si4 ngo5 dei6 zung6 mei6 sik1 keoi5, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 當時我們還不認識他，現在已經成為好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: At that time we didn't know him; now we've become good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話當其時冇得選擇，只好跟住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 dong1 kei4 si4 mou5 dak1 syun2 zaak6, zi2 hou2 gan1 zyu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說當時沒有選擇，只好跟著做。
examples.english_sentence: He said at that time there was no choice, so he had to go along.

mandarin_meaning: 當作不存在 / 當作沒發生
english_meaning: to pretend something didn't happen; to act as if it doesn't exist; to ignore
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示把某件事視作不存在或沒發生過，表示忽略、不再追究或放下。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to treat something as if it never happened — to ignore it or stop pursuing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚唔嚟，我哋就當冇到，繼續開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 m4 lai4, ngo5 dei6 zau6 dong3 mou5 dou3, gai3 zuk6 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚不來，我們就當沒發生，繼續開會。
examples.english_sentence: He's not coming tonight — let's just pretend it didn't happen and continue the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次嘅誤會你就當冇到啦，唔好再提。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 ge3 ng6 wui6 nei5 zau6 dong3 mou5 dou3 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次的誤會你就當沒發生吧，不要再提了。
examples.english_sentence: Just treat that misunderstanding as if it never happened; don't bring it up again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔肯道歉，算啦，我哋當冇到呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 hang2 dou6 hip3, syun3 laa1, ngo5 dei6 dong3 mou5 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不願意道歉，那就算了，我們當沒這回事。
examples.english_sentence: If he won't apologize, forget it — we'll act like this never happened.

mandarin_meaning: 当初（在事情开始的时候；原本）
english_meaning: at first; originally; at that time
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某事在最開始、當時的情況或原本的想法，常用作時間狀語或回顧過去時的引導詞。
explanation_english: Used to indicate the beginning of something or the situation/thoughts at that time; often functions as a temporal adverb or as an expression when referring back to the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當初我諗住唔去，依家好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 co1 ngo5 lam2 zyu6 m4 heoi3, ji1 gaa1 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当初我打算不去，现在很后悔。
examples.english_sentence: I originally planned not to go; now I regret it a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你當初點解唔同我講？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dong1 co1 dim2 gaai2 m4 tung4 ngo5 gong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你当初为什么不跟我说？
examples.english_sentence: Why didn't you tell me at the time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當初嗰間公司條件好好，但我冇接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 co1 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 tiu4 gin6 hou2 hou2, daan6 ngo5 mou5 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当初那间公司的条件很好，但我没接受。
examples.english_sentence: That company's offer was very good at first, but I didn't accept it.

mandarin_meaning: 当前；目前
english_meaning: current; at present
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示現在或目前的狀態或情況，常用於描述當下的局勢或條件。
explanation_english: Used to indicate the present or current situation; often used to describe the existing state or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺當前嘅情況下，我哋要集中資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dong1 cin4 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaap6 zung1 zi1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在当前的情况下，我们要集中资源。
examples.english_sentence: Given the current situation, we need to concentrate our resources.

mandarin_meaning: 当务之急
english_meaning: the most urgent matter; top priority
explanation_mandarin: 表示當前最緊迫、最需要立即處理的事情或問題。
explanation_english: Refers to the most pressing matter that requires immediate attention or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家呢個項目唔可以拖，係當務之急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 m4 ho2 ji5 to1, hai6 dong1 mou6 zi1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在這個項目不能拖延，是當務之急。
examples.english_sentence: This project at the company can't be delayed; it's the top priority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院而家人手唔夠，救治傷者係當務之急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 ji4 gaa1 jan4 sau2 m4 gau3, gau3 zi6 soeng1 ze2 hai6 dong1 mou6 zi1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院現在人手不足，救治傷者是當務之急。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital is understaffed right now; treating the injured is the most urgent task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風過後，重建交通同安置居民係當務之急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 gwo3 hau6, cung4 gin3 gaau1 tung1 tung4 on1 zi3 geoi1 man4 hai6 dong1 mou6 zi1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風過後，重建交通和安置居民是當務之急。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, restoring transport and rehousing residents are urgent priorities.

mandarin_meaning: 當地（某地的、本地的）
english_meaning: local; the locality; locally
explanation_mandarin: 表示屬於某一地區或位於該地區，亦可作名詞指該地區本身或當地的人事物。
explanation_english: Refers to something belonging to or located in a particular area; can also be used as a noun to mean the local area or local people/things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去當地嘅市場買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 dong1 dei6 ge3 si5 coeng4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去當地的市場買東西。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to buy things at the local market.

mandarin_meaning: 当场；当堂（在同一堂课或在现场、当时立刻）
english_meaning: on the spot; immediately; during the same class/session
explanation_mandarin: 表示在同一堂课或在现场、當時就發生或處理，含有立刻、當場的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens or is dealt with immediately, on the spot, or during the same class/session.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當堂就改咗答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 tong4 zau6 goi2 zo2 daap3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當場就改了答案。
examples.english_sentence: He changed the answer on the spot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師當堂解釋咗嗰條題目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 dong1 tong4 gaai2 sik1 zo2 go2 tiu4 tai4 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師當堂解釋了那道題目。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher explained that question during the same lesson.

mandarin_meaning: 当场（在现场或当时，立即）
english_meaning: on the spot; at the scene; immediately
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某個現場或當時立刻發生或處理，意思是“在場、當時、當下立即”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens at the scene or immediately at that time; used like 'on the spot' or 'at the scene'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察到場後，嫌疑人當場被捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 dou3 coeng4 hau6, jim4 ji4 jan4 dong1 coeng4 bei6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察到场后，嫌疑人当场被捕。
examples.english_sentence: After the police arrived, the suspect was arrested on the spot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當場答應幫手，冇諗咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 coeng4 daap3 jing3 bong1 sau2, mou5 lam2 gam2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当场答应帮忙，没有多想。
examples.english_sentence: He agreed to help on the spot, without thinking long.

mandarin_meaning: 当天 (在同一天、當日)
english_meaning: on the same day; that day
explanation_mandarin: 表示在同一天或當日，常用作時間副詞，說明某事發生於該日或在該日內完成。
explanation_english: Indicates 'on the same day' or 'that day'. Commonly used as a temporal adverb to state that something happened or is completed on that particular day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋當天就收到通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dong1 tin1 zau6 sau1 dou3 tung1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們當天就收到通知。
examples.english_sentence: We received the notification that same day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會喺當天出席會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 hai6 dong1 tin1 ceot1 zik6 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說會在當天出席會議。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would attend the meeting on that day.

mandarin_meaning: 應當像／應該是
english_meaning: ought to be like; should be
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 助動詞片語（或書面語詞組）
explanation_mandarin: 「當如」屬書面或文言色彩的用法，表示應該像…、應當如此，用來提出模範或主張某種做法。
explanation_english: A literary/archaic phrase meaning 'ought to be like' or 'should be'. Used to state how something ought to be or to propose an example or ideal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對社會不公，我哋當如勇敢發聲，爭取公義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 se5 wui6 bat1 gung1, ngo5 dei6 dong1 jyu4 jung5 gam2 faat3 sing1, zang1 ceoi2 gung1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對社會不公，我們應該勇敢發聲，爭取公義。
examples.english_sentence: Facing social injustice, we should bravely speak out and fight for justice.

mandarin_meaning: 當家 (dāngjiā)：掌管家庭或負責管理（家務、事務或機構）
english_meaning: to be in charge; to run the household; to take charge of affairs
explanation_mandarin: 表示負責管理或主持家務、家庭事務或在組織中擔任主要負責人的動作或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates taking responsibility for managing or running household affairs, or acting as the person in charge of a group or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日開始當家，照顧屋企嘅大小事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 dong1 gaa1, ziu3 gu3 uk1 kei2 ge3 daai6 siu2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天開始當家，照顧家的大小事。
examples.english_sentence: He started running the household today, taking care of the family's affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司冇人當家，啲決定遲遲做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mou5 jan4 dong1 gaa1, di1 kyut3 ding6 ci4 ci4 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司沒有人當家，決定一直做不成。
examples.english_sentence: With nobody in charge at the company, decisions can't get made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽唔返工，主要係佢當家，打理屋企同照顧細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 m4 faan1 gung1, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 keoi5 dong1 gaa1, daa2 lei5 uk1 kei2 tung4 ziu3 gu3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽不外出工作，主要由她當家，打理家庭並照顧孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Mom doesn't work outside; she mainly runs the household, managing the home and looking after the kids.

mandarin_meaning: 當家作主 (dāngjiā zuòzhǔ)：掌握主導權，做決定；負責處理事務
english_meaning: to be in charge; to take control; to call the shots; to make decisions
explanation_mandarin: 表示掌握主導權或決策權，常用來說某人負責安排或做決定。
explanation_english: Indicates having the authority to make decisions or taking responsibility; used to say someone is in charge or calls the shots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家你一個人住，要學識當家作主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6, jiu3 hok6 sik1 dong1 gaa1 zok3 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在你一個人住，要學會當家作主。
examples.english_sentence: Now that you're living alone, you need to learn to take charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個項目係你當家作主，大家聽你安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 hong6 muk6 hai6 nei5 dong1 gaa1 zok3 zyu2, daai6 gaa1 teng1 nei5 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次項目由你當家作主，大家聽你的安排。
examples.english_sentence: This project is yours to lead; everyone will follow your arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日想當家作主，唔畀啲人講意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 soeng2 dong1 gaa1 zok3 zyu2, m4 bei2 di1 jan4 gong2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是想當家作主，不讓別人發表意見。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to call the shots and won't let others voice opinions.

jyutping: dong1 gaa1 fong1 zi1 caai4 mai5 gwai3
mandarin_meaning: 當你負責料理家務或管理家計時，才會體會到生活必需品（如柴米）昂貴；比喻管理家庭或經濟不容易
english_meaning: Only when you take charge of a household do you realize how expensive daily necessities are; used to express that running a household or managing finances is difficult
explanation_mandarin: 這句諺語表示只有親自打理家務、掌管家計，才會體會到柴米等生活必需品的昂貴，常用來形容管理家庭或經濟的不易。
explanation_english: This proverb means you only appreciate the cost and difficulty of maintaining a household when you are responsible for it; commonly used to describe how challenging family or financial management can be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明搬出去同太太一齊住之後，先真正體會到當家方知柴米貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 bun1 ceot1 heoi3 tung4 taai3 taai1 jat1 cai4 zyu6 zi1 hau6, sin1 zan1 zing3 tai2 wui6 dou3 dong1 gaa1 fong1 zi1 caai4 mai5 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明搬出去和太太一起住之後，才真正體會到當家方知柴米貴。
examples.english_sentence: After Ah Ming moved out and started living with his wife, he truly realized how expensive it is to run a household.

mandarin_meaning: 当局；有关政府或机构
english_meaning: the authorities; the relevant government or official body
explanation_mandarin: 指有权处理某事的政府或机构，常用以泛指负责该事项的当事方或官方单位。
explanation_english: Refers to the government or organization that has the authority to handle a matter; commonly used to denote the responsible or relevant official body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當局已經就事件作出回應，並展開調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 guk6 ji5 ging1 zau6 si6 gin6 zok3 ceot1 wui4 jing3, bing6 zin2 hoi1 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当局已就事件作出回应，并展开调查。
examples.english_sentence: The authorities have responded to the incident and launched an investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 當局者迷（成語）：身處其中的人常常看不清全局或真相
english_meaning: Those involved are often confused (idiom); people directly involved may fail to see the whole situation clearly
explanation_mandarin: 此成語表示身在局中者因為身處其中，容易被情緒或細節迷惑，看不清整體情況；通常與「旁觀者清」成對使用。
explanation_english: This idiom denotes that those who are involved in a situation tend to be confused or unable to see the whole picture because they are too close to it; often contrasted with "onlookers see more clearly."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家親身喺度，當局者迷，可能睇唔清楚成件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 can1 san1 hai2 dou6, dong1 guk6 ze2 mai4, ho2 nang4 tai2 m4 cing1 co2 seng4 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你現在親身在其中，當局者迷，可能看不清整件事。
examples.english_sentence: You're involved right now — those who are involved are often confused; you may not see the whole situation clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當局者迷，旁觀者清，唔好淨係靠自己作決定，聽吓朋友嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 guk6 ze2 mai4, pong4 gun1 ze2 cing1, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 kaau3 zi6 gei2 zok3 kyut3 ding6, teng1 haa5 pang4 jau5 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 當局者迷，旁觀者清，不要只靠自己做決定，聽聽朋友的意見吧。
examples.english_sentence: Those involved are often confused while outsiders see clearly; don't rely only on yourself to decide — listen to friends' opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 當差 / 做差事、當值、當差役
english_meaning: to do duty; to serve as a constable/official; to work on shift or do menial/temporary jobs
explanation_mandarin: 表示擔任差役或值班，或從事差事、臨時、基層的工作。常用於指警察、衙役或跑腿、打雜等工作。
explanation_english: Used to indicate serving on duty or as a constable/official, or doing menial, temporary, or errand-type work. Often refers to being on patrol or on shift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺差館當差，經常要值夜班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 caa1 gun2 dong1-caai1, ging1 soeng4 jiu3 zik6 je6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在差館當差，經常要上夜班。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently serving at the police station and often has to work night shifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我阿伯做過當差，搵嚟幫補家用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 aa3 baak3 zou6 gwo3 dong1-caai1, wan2 lai4 bong1 bou2 gaa1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我伯父做過當差，賺錢貼補家用。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young my uncle did odd jobs/served as a constable to help support the family.

mandarin_meaning: 当年（指过去的那些年、往昔）
english_meaning: in those years; back then; in former times
explanation_mandarin: 表示回忆过去某段时间，指‘那时候’或‘往年’。
explanation_english: Used to refer to a past period of time; means 'back then' or 'in those days'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當年我哋仲細個，成日去呢度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 zung6 sai3 go3, sing4 jat6 heoi3 ni1 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当年我们还小，经常来这里玩。
examples.english_sentence: Back then we were still kids and often came here to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當年佢係公司嘅上司，宜家已經退休喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 nin4 keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 soeng5 si1, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 teoi3 hau3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当年他是公司的上司，现在已经退休了。
examples.english_sentence: He was the boss at the company back then; now he's already retired.

mandarin_meaning: 当庭（在法庭上；当场、当即）
english_meaning: in court; on the spot; there and then; immediately
explanation_mandarin: 表示在法庭當場或當下立即進行某事，也可泛指當場、當即處理或發生。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something in court or immediately on the spot; can also mean resolving or occurring there and then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法院當庭判決被告有罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 jyun2 dong1 ting4 pun3 kyut3 bei6 gou3 jau5 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院当庭判决被告有罪。
examples.english_sentence: The court pronounced the defendant guilty in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當庭道歉，話唔會再做同樣嘅錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 ting4 dou6 hei3, waa6 m4 wui5 zoi3 zou6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当庭道歉，表示不会再犯同样的错误。
examples.english_sentence: He apologized on the spot and said he would not repeat the same mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到爭拗嘅時候，我哋最好當庭解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 zang1 aau3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 dong1 ting4 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到争执的时候，我们最好当庭解决。
examples.english_sentence: When disputes arise, it's best to settle them there and then.

mandarin_meaning: 当心 / 小心
english_meaning: be careful; watch out; take care
explanation_mandarin: 用于提醒别人注意安全或小心，常用口语表达。
explanation_english: Used to warn someone to be careful or watch out; a common colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當心，地上有水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 sam1, dei6 soeng6 jau5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心，地上有水。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, there's water on the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路當心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 lou6 dong1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路要當心一點。
examples.english_sentence: Be more careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當心俾人騙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 sam1 bei2 jan4 pin3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 當心被人騙！
examples.english_sentence: Watch out so you don't get scammed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當心！有車！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 sam1! jau5 ce1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心！有車！
examples.english_sentence: Watch out! There's a car!

mandarin_meaning: 當作；視為
english_meaning: to treat as; to regard as; to consider as
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人、某事或某物視為某種身份、性質或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates regarding or treating someone/something as a certain identity, nature, or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係當成朋友，佢其實鍾意你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dong1 sing4 pang4 jau5, keoi5 kei4 sat6 zung1 ji3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別只把他當成朋友，他其實喜歡你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just treat him as a friend; he actually likes you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想將呢件事當成小事處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoeng1 ni1 gin6 si6 dong1 sing4 siu2 si6 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想把這件事當成小事處理。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to treat this matter as a minor issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當成笑話，我係真係咁講嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong1 sing4 siu3 waa6, ngo5 hai6 zan1 hai6 gam2 gong2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把它當成笑話，我是真的這麼說的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it as a joke; I really said it that way.

mandarin_meaning: 有實力、可堪重用；處於黃金時期（如「當打之年」）
english_meaning: capable, promising, in one's prime; able to play an important role
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或事具備實力或潛力，能擔當重要角色；也常用於短語「當打之年」表示處於事業或體能的黃金期。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that has strength or potential and can take on important roles; often appears in the phrase '當打之年' to indicate someone's prime years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家正係當打，樣樣都好出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4gaa1 zing3 hai6 dong1 daa2, joeng6 joeng6 dou1 hou2 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在正值當打，樣樣都很出色。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently in his prime, excelling at everything.

mandarin_meaning: 当政；执政
english_meaning: to be in power; to hold/govern in office
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握政权或担任政府、机构的治理工作，负责施政与决策。
explanation_english: To hold political power or be in office, responsible for governing and making policy decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從新政府當政以嚟，政策改變咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 san1 zing3 fu2 dong1 zing3 ji5 loi4, zing3 caak3 goi2 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从新政府上台执政以来，政策变化了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Since the new government came to power, policies have changed a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 當天 / 那日
english_meaning: on that day; the same day
explanation_mandarin: 表示特定的那一天或當時，等同於「當天」或「那日」，可作時間副詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to that particular day or at that time (the same day). Equivalent to 'that day' or 'the same day', used as a temporal adverb or noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋當日就去咗尖沙咀買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dong1 jat6 zau6 heoi3 zo2 zim1 saa1 zeoi2 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們當天就去尖沙咀買東西。
examples.english_sentence: We went to Tsim Sha Tsui to buy things on that day.

mandarin_meaning: 当时
english_meaning: at that time; then
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某个过去的时间点或那段时间，相当于“那时/那时候”。常作时间副词使用，用来说明动作或情形发生的时间。
explanation_english: Indicates a point or period in the past; equivalent to "at that time" or "then." Commonly used as an adverb of time to specify when an action or situation occurred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我當時喺街度，冇見到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dong1 si4 hai2 gaai1 dou6, mou5 gin3 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我当时在街上，没有看到你。
examples.english_sentence: I was on the street at that time and didn't see you.

mandarin_meaning: 當時是可以/合情合理/被接受的
english_meaning: It was acceptable/allowed/appropriate at the time
explanation_mandarin: 表示在當時情況下某種做法或決定是合適、可以或被接受，常用來為過去的行為或選擇辯解或說明背景。
explanation_english: Used to say that something was appropriate, acceptable, or permitted at that time. Often used to explain or justify past actions or decisions by referring to the context back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好怪佢，當時得令，大家都係咁做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gwaai3 keoi5, dong1 si4 dak1 ling6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 gam2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別怪他，當時這樣是可以的，大家都是這麼做的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame him — it was acceptable at the time; everyone did the same.

mandarin_meaning: 当晚（那晚、當時的夜晚）
english_meaning: that night (the night in question)
explanation_mandarin: 用來指代某件事發生的那一個夜晚，表示時間點或時間範圍。
explanation_english: Used to refer to the night when a particular event occurred; indicates a specific time (that night).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我記得當晚我哋喺酒吧見過面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei3 dak1 dong1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 hai2 zau2 baa1 gin3 gwo3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我记得那晚我们在酒吧见过面。
examples.english_sentence: I remember that night we met at the bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當晚警方已經展開調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 maan5 ging2 fong1 ji5 ging1 zin2 hoi1 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当晚警方已经展开调查。
examples.english_sentence: The police had already launched an investigation that night.

mandarin_meaning: 值夜班 / 當夜更
english_meaning: to work the night shift; to stand night watch
explanation_mandarin: 「當更」指在夜間值班或擔任夜間巡更、看守的工作，常用於保安、值勤人員或口語描述上夜班。
explanation_english: “當更” means to be on night duty or to stand night watch, commonly used for security guards, night-shift workers, or colloquially to say someone is working the night shift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我要當更，唔可以去飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 jiu3 dong1 geng1, m4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要值夜班，不能去喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work the night shift tonight, so I can't go out drinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日要當更，所以經常唔夠瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jiu3 dong1 geng1, so2 ji5 ging1 soeng4 m4 gau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常要值夜班，所以經常睡眠不足。
examples.english_sentence: He often has to work night shifts, so he frequently doesn't get enough sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 當機立斷（在關鍵時刻迅速且果斷地做出決定）
english_meaning: Act decisively at a critical moment; make an immediate, resolute decision
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語；可作動詞或形容詞（表示果斷行動）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom; can function as a verb or adjective (denoting decisiveness)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在關鍵時刻立即做出果斷的決定，不再猶豫。
explanation_english: Indicates making a prompt and decisive decision at a critical moment without hesitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司面對危機時，經理要當機立斷，先至可以保住生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 min6 deoi3 ngai4 gei1 si4, ging1 lei5 jiu3 dong1 gei1 lap6 dyun6, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 bou2 zyu6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司面對危機時，經理要當機立斷，才能保住生意。
examples.english_sentence: When the company faces a crisis, the manager must act decisively to save the business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺球場表現好差，教練當機立斷換佢落場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kau4 coeng4 biu2 jin6 hou2 caa1, gaau3 lin6 dong1 gei1 lap6 dyun6 wun6 keoi5 lok6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在球場上的表現很差，教練當機立斷把他換下場。
examples.english_sentence: He performed poorly on the field, and the coach made an immediate, decisive substitution.

mandarin_meaning: 掌握權力；執政
english_meaning: to hold power; to be in authority; to govern
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握政治或組織上的權力，處於能夠決定或控制局面的地位。
explanation_english: Refers to holding political or organizational power; being in a position to make decisions or exercise control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從新政府當權之後，政策有好大改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 san1 zing3 fu2 dong1 kyun4 zi1 hau6, zing3 caak3 jau5 hou2 daai6 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從新政府當權之後，政策有很大的改變。
examples.english_sentence: Since the new government came to power, there have been major policy changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢長期當權，唔太聽其他人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng4 kei4 dong1 kyun4, m4 taai3 teng1 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他長期掌權，不太聽取其他人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in power for a long time and doesn't really listen to others' opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 擔任正式職位；轉為正式（職工）；擔任主要／頭號角色
english_meaning: to be appointed to a permanent/official position; to take the main/lead role; to be made permanent (job)
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語動詞，指由臨時、代理或試用期轉為正式任用，或被安排擔任主要職務／主角。書寫上常見為「擔正」，有時亦見寫成「當正」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to be made permanent/official in a job or to take on the main/lead role. Commonly written as 擔正 and sometimes written as 當正.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年臨時工，終於當正喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 lam4 si4 gung1, zung1 jyu1 daam1 zeng3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了幾年臨時工，終於轉為正式（職員）。
examples.english_sentence: He worked as a temp for several years and finally got made permanent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢當正做主角，唔係配角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 daam1 zeng3 zou6 zyu2 gok3, m4 hai6 pui3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次他被安排擔任主角，不是配角。
examples.english_sentence: This time he's been cast as the lead role, not a supporting part.

mandarin_meaning: 当归（中药名，Angelica sinensis）
english_meaning: Dong quai (Angelica sinensis), a traditional Chinese medicinal herb
explanation_mandarin: 當歸是一種常用的中藥材，學名為當歸（Angelica sinensis），主要用於補血、活血、調經等，亦常用於煲湯或藥膳中。
explanation_english: Dong quai (Angelica sinensis) is a commonly used traditional Chinese medicinal herb, primarily used to nourish and invigorate the blood, regulate menstruation, and often included in soups or medicinal dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話我需要食當歸補血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 sik6 dong1 gwai1 bou2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医说我需要吃当归补血。
examples.english_sentence: The Chinese medicine practitioner said I need to take dong quai to replenish my blood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我用當歸同豬骨煲湯，湯好補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 jung6 dong1 gwai1 tung4 zyu1 gwat1 bou1 tong1, tong1 hou2 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我用当归和猪骨炖汤，汤很补。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I'll use dong quai and pork bones to make a nourishing soup.

mandarin_meaning: 装死；假装不理、不闻、不回应
english_meaning: to play dead; to feign ignorance or pretend not to notice/respond
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容故意裝作沒看見、沒聽見或不回應，通常為迴避責任或不想介入。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression meaning to pretend to be dead — i.e., to feign ignorance, ignore, or deliberately not respond, often to avoid responsibility or involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我哋有事，就係度當死唔理我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 ngo5 dei6 jau5 si6, zau6 hai6 dou6 dong3 sei2 m4 lei5 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我们出事，就在那里装死不理我们。
examples.english_sentence: He saw we were in trouble and just played dead there, ignoring us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當死啦，畀啲反應啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong3 sei2 laa1, bei2 di1 faan2 jing3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別裝死了，給點回應吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dead — give some response!

mandarin_meaning: 當替罪羊；遭遇不幸、倒楣（口語用法）
english_meaning: to be made a scapegoat; to be blamed unfairly; (colloquial) to suffer misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 「當災」是廣東話口語，通常指某人被當作替罪羊承擔責任或倒楣遇到不幸，也可指被人指責、頂罪。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to be made a scapegoat or to suffer bad luck; often used when someone is unfairly blamed or has to take the fall for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係要佢當災，明明係其他人錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jiu3 keoi5 dong1 zoi1, ming4 ming4 hai6 kei4 taa1 jan4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次真的要讓他當替罪羊，明明是其他人的錯。
examples.english_sentence: They really want to make him the scapegoat this time; clearly it was someone else's fault.

mandarin_meaning: 当然
english_meaning: of course; certainly; naturally
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情理所当然、毫无疑问或肯定的语气，用来强调某事是显而易见或必然的。
explanation_english: Used to express that something is obvious, certain, or to be expected; it emphasizes that there is no doubt or that something is natural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你會幫我搬屋嘅？當然會啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wui5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1 ge3? dong1 jin4 wui5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会帮我搬家吗？当然会啦。
examples.english_sentence: Will you help me move? Of course I will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當然識開車啦，佢係司機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 jin4 sik1 hoi1 ce1 laa1, keoi5 hai6 si1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当然会开车，他是司机。
examples.english_sentence: He can of course drive — he's a driver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你而家忙，我當然可以等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ji4 gaa1 mong4, ngo5 dong1 jin4 ho2 ji5 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你现在忙，我当然可以等你。
examples.english_sentence: If you're busy now, of course I can wait for you.

mandarin_meaning: 當真（把某事當作真實或認真對待）
english_meaning: to take (something) seriously; to treat as real/genuine
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某事視為真實或認真對待；常用於提醒別人不要把玩笑、批評等當真（如「別當真」）。
explanation_english: Indicates treating something as true or taking it seriously; often used in contexts like warnings not to take jokes or remarks literally (e.g., "don't take it seriously").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當眞，我只係講笑啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong1 zan1, ngo5 zi2 hai6 gong2 siu3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當真，我只是在開玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it seriously; I'm just joking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係當眞咗佢啲話？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 dong1 zan1 zo2 keoi5 di1 waa6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真的把他的话當真了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Did you really take what he said seriously?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該當眞處理呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 dong1 zan1 cyu5 lei5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該認真處理這個問題。
examples.english_sentence: The government should take this issue seriously.

mandarin_meaning: 当真；把……当作认真的/当作真的
english_meaning: to take (something) seriously; to treat as true; (in negative) don't take it seriously
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某事或某人的話當作認真看待或相信；在口語中也常用於勸對方不要把玩笑或批評放在心上（如「唔好當真」）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate treating something or someone's words as serious or believing them. In colloquial use it is often used to tell someone not to take a joke or criticism to heart (e.g. "don't take it seriously").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講笑啫，你唔好當真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 siu3 ze1, nei5 m4 hou2 dong1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是開玩笑，你不要當真。
examples.english_sentence: He's just joking; don't take it seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來以為佢當真，但原來佢係講笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 loi4 ji5 wai6 keoi5 dong1 zan1, daan6 jyun4 loi4 keoi5 hai6 gong2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本來以為他是認真的，但原來他在開玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: I originally thought he was serious, but it turned out he was joking.

mandarin_meaning: 顯眼；醒目；引人注目
english_meaning: eye-catching; conspicuous; noticeable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某物或某人容易被注意到、很顯眼、引人注目，屬於口語用法。
explanation_english: Used to describe something or someone that easily attracts attention — conspicuous or eye-catching. Commonly used colloquially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好當眼，好多人都望住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 dong1 ngaan5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很显眼，很多人都盯着看它。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is very eye-catching; many people are staring at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺咗張當眼嘅海報喺門口，吸引咗好多人入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 zo2 zoeng1 dong1 ngaan5 ge3 hoi2 bou3 hai2 mun4 hau2, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放了一张显眼的海报在门口，吸引了很多人进来。
examples.english_sentence: He put up an eye-catching poster at the entrance, which attracted many people to come in.

mandarin_meaning: 当众；在众人面前
english_meaning: in public; publicly; in front of everyone
explanation_mandarin: 表示在许多人面前、公开地做某事，常用作副词。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something in front of others or publicly; commonly used as an adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當眾道歉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 zung3 dou6 hip3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当众道歉了。
examples.english_sentence: He apologized in public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想當眾講呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 dong1 zung3 gong2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想当众说这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to discuss this in public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師當眾表揚咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 dong1 zung3 biu2 joeng4 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师当众表扬了他。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher praised him in front of everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 把（某人）當作神一樣崇拜；把人捧得像神
english_meaning: to worship or idolize someone like a god; to fawn over or overly glorify someone
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，表示把某人過度崇拜或捧得像神一樣，通常帶有批評或諷刺意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to treat or worship someone as if they were a god—i.e., to idolize or overly glorify someone; often used with a critical or ironic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日當神咁拜佢，佢都係普通人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dong1 san4 gam2 baai3 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老是把他當神一樣崇拜，他也是普通人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't constantly idolize him; he's just an ordinary person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲粉絲喺演唱會上當神咁拜偶像，氣氛好誇張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fan2 si1 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2 soeng5 dong1 san4 gam2 baai3 ngau5 zoeng6, hei3 fan1 hou2 kwaa1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 粉丝在演唱会上把偶像当神一样崇拜，气氛很夸张。
examples.english_sentence: Fans at the concert worshiped the idol like a god; the atmosphere was over the top.

mandarin_meaning: 把某人当作神来崇拜或摆出高高在上的态度（过度崇拜或自以为是）
english_meaning: to treat someone as if they were a god (overly worship) or to act like a god (be arrogant and expect reverence)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常用來形容過分崇拜某人，把對方捧到神壇上，或形容某人擺出盛氣凌人的姿態，想要別人崇敬、服從。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese phrase used to describe excessive worship of someone (treating them like a deity) or someone behaving arrogantly as if they deserve worship and unquestioning respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好當神噉拜佢，佢都只係個普通人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dong3 san4 gam2 baai3 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 zi2 hai6 go3 pou2 tung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別把他當成神來拜，他也只是個普通人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat him like a god; he's just an ordinary person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日當神噉拜，一副唔使理人嘅樣，令人好反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dong3 san4 gam2 baai3, jat1 fu3 m4 sai2 lei5 jan4 ge3 joeng6, ling6 jan4 hou2 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天擺出高高在上的樣子，令人很反感。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts like he's above everyone else, which really puts people off.

mandarin_meaning: 當票（dāngpiào），指在當舖抵押物品後取得的憑證，用於贖回或證明抵押）
english_meaning: pawn ticket; pawn slip (a voucher issued by a pawnshop as proof of an item pledged)
explanation_mandarin: 當票是在當鋪將物品抵押時由當鋪發出的憑證，憑此可在約定期限內贖回物品或作為抵押的證明。
explanation_english: A pawn ticket is the receipt or voucher issued by a pawnshop when an item is pawned. It serves as proof of the pledge and is required to redeem the item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個舊錶去咗當鋪，當票喺屋企個枱上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 gau6 biu1 heoi3 zo2 dong3 pou3, dong3 piu3 hai2 uk1 kei2 go3 toi2 seong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的舊錶拿去當鋪了，當票在家裡的桌上。
examples.english_sentence: I took my old watch to the pawnshop; the pawn ticket is on the table at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 贖返嘢要帶當票先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 faan1 je5 jiu3 daai3 dong3 piu3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贖回東西要帶當票才行。
examples.english_sentence: To redeem the pawned item you have to bring the pawn ticket.

mandarin_meaning: 当红；受欢迎、很热门
english_meaning: in vogue; very popular; currently in the limelight
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某事物當下非常受歡迎、流行或備受矚目。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is currently very popular, fashionable, or in the spotlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係當紅嘅歌手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 dong1 hung4 ge3 go1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是当红的歌手。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a popular singer right now.

mandarin_meaning: 当红炸子鸡
english_meaning: a current hot favorite; a very popular or in‑demand person/thing
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或事物當前非常受歡迎、炙手可熱，常用於娛樂圈、時尚或市場熱門商品等情況。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is extremely popular and in high demand at the moment; often used for celebrities, trendy products, or hot topics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家係當紅炸子雞，成日都有廣告邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hai6 dong1 hung4 zaa3 zi2 gai1, sing4 jat6 dou1 jau5 gwong2 gou3 jiu1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是當紅炸子雞，經常有廣告邀約。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently a hot star and constantly receives advertising offers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款手袋而家係市場上嘅當紅炸子雞，成日賣晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 sau2 doi2 ji1 gaa1 hai6 si5 coeng4 soeng6 ge3 dong1 hung4 zaa3 zi2 gai1, sing4 jat6 maai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款手袋現在是市場上的當紅炸子雞，經常賣光。
examples.english_sentence: This handbag is currently a hot seller in the market and often sells out.

mandarin_meaning: 当红炸子鸡（指目前非常受欢迎、走红的人或艺人）
english_meaning: a current hot star; someone who is extremely popular right now
explanation_mandarin: 「當紅炸子雞」是粵語俗語，形容當紅、人氣高、很受歡迎的人或藝人，常用來指當前的流量明星或熱門人物。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who is currently very popular or in high demand—often used for hot celebrities or trending figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家係當紅炸子鷄，成日都有演唱會同代言廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hai6 dong1 hung4 zaa3 zi2 gai1, seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 tung4 doi6 jin4 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是当红炸子鸡，经常有演唱会和代言广告。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently a hot star, constantly booked for concerts and endorsements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今季嘅偶像選秀出咗幾個當紅炸子鷄，粉絲多到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gwai3 ge3 ngau5 zoeng6 syun2 sau3 ceot1 zo2 gei2 go3 dong1 hung4 zaa3 zi2 gai1, fan2 si1 do1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本季的偶像选秀出了几个当红炸子鸡，粉丝多得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: This season's idol show produced several breakout stars; they have an enormous number of fans.

mandarin_meaning: 被陷害；被栽贓；被當作替罪羊（口語）
english_meaning: to be framed; to be set up; to be made a scapegoat (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「當紮」為香港粵語口語用法，意指某人被他人設計陷害或栽贓，成為替罪羊或承擔責任。屬非正式說法，常見於會話中。
explanation_english: “當紮” is a Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone is framed, set up, or made into a scapegoat. It is informal and commonly used in spoken contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己冇做，點解會俾人當紮？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6, dim2 gaai2 wui5 bei2 jan4 dong1 zaat3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己沒有做，為什麼會被人陷害？
examples.english_sentence: He says he didn't do it. Why would he be set up?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做任何決定之前要小心，唔好俾人當紮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jam6 ho4 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 dong1 zaat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做任何決定之前要小心，別讓人陷害你。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful before making any decision; don't let people set you up.

mandarin_meaning: 擺老、擺架子；裝出有權威或自以為是的樣子（粵語口語）
english_meaning: to put on airs; to act bossy or superior (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語（香港口語），用來形容某人擺出老資格或擺架子的態度，覺得自己高人一等或愛指手畫腳。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression (Hong Kong) used to describe someone who puts on airs or acts superior/authoritative, behaving as if they're above others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日當老肯，冇人鍾意同佢做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dong1 lou5 hang2, mou5 jan4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天擺出老資格，沒人想跟他一起工作。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on airs; no one likes working with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度當老肯，大家平等傾吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 dong1 lou5 hang2, daai6 gaa1 ping4 dang2 king1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在這裡擺架子，大家平等談談吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act superior here; let's all talk as equals.

mandarin_meaning: 把別人的話當作耳邊風；對勸告或意見不放在心上（等於「充耳不聞」「置若罔聞」）
english_meaning: To treat someone's words as wind in the ear; to ignore advice or not pay attention to what someone says.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對別人的勸告、意見或警告不理會、不放在心上。
explanation_english: An idiomatic expression meaning to disregard or pay no attention to someone's advice, warnings, or remarks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講咗好多次，佢都係當耳邊風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3, keoi5 dou1 hai6 dong3 ji5 bin1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跟他說了很多次，他都當耳邊風。
examples.english_sentence: I told him many times, but he just ignored it.

jyutping: dong1 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei5 dak1 gaa3 laa3
mandarin_meaning: 把（別人的地方）當成自己的家／像在自己家一樣行事（含有隨便或越界的意味）
english_meaning: to act as if it's your own home; to make yourself at home (often implying being overly casual or presumptuous)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容在別人地方言行舉止非常隨便、像在自己家一樣，有時帶有批評或指責的語氣，表示對方不夠禮貌或越界。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone behaving very casually or presumptuously in another person's place, as if they were at home. Often carries a critical tone, implying a lack of courtesy or boundaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好當自己屋企得㗎喇，講嘢要有分寸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dong1 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei5 dak1 gaa3 laa3, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 fan1 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把這裡當成自己的家，說話要有分寸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like this is your own home; be careful what you say.

jyutping: dong3 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei5 dak1 laa3
mandarin_meaning: 就當作自己家/把這裡當成自己的家
english_meaning: Make yourself at home; treat this place as your own home
explanation_mandarin: 用來邀請或安慰客人，表示可以放鬆、把主人家當成自己的家，不用拘束。
explanation_english: Used to invite or reassure a guest, telling them to relax and treat the host's place as their own—don't feel constrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲入嚟，當自己屋企得喇，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 jap6 lei4, dong3 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei5 dak1 laa3, m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快進來，就當作自己家，不用客氣。
examples.english_sentence: Come on in, make yourself at home, don't be formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚就喺屋企食，大家當自己屋企得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zau6 hai6 uk1 kei5 sik6, daai6 gaa1 dong3 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei5 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚就在家裡吃，大家就當作自己家吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're eating at home tonight; everyone just make yourselves at home.

mandarin_meaning: 當舖 / 典當行
