english_meaning: pawnshop
explanation_mandarin: 提供以物品作抵押換取短期現金借款的店舖，物品在還款前由當舖保管，若未能償還貸款則物品被當舖處理或出售。
explanation_english: A shop that accepts items as collateral and provides short-term cash loans. The items are held by the pawnshop until repayment; if the loan is not repaid, the pawned items may be sold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將隻手錶拎去當舖典當換現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zek3 sau2 biu1 ling1 heoi3 dong3 pou3 din2 dong3 wun6 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把一隻手錶拿到當舖典當換現金。
examples.english_sentence: He took his watch to the pawnshop to pawn it for cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你急住要錢，可以去當舖典當啲貴重嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gap1 zyu6 jiu3 cin2, ho2 ji5 heoi3 dong3 pou3 din2 dong3 di1 gwai3 zung6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你急需用錢，可以去當舖把貴重物品典當。
examples.english_sentence: If you urgently need money, you can pawn valuables at a pawnshop.

mandarin_meaning: 當眾 / 当众
english_meaning: in public; publicly; in front of everyone
explanation_mandarin: 表示在許多人面前、公開地做某事。常用作副詞，說明行為是在公眾面前發生。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something in front of many people or publicly. Commonly used as an adverb to mark that an action happens before others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當衆鬧佢，佢會好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong1 zung3 nau6 keoi5, keoi5 wui5 hou2 gaan1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要當眾責備他，他會很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold him in public; he'll be very embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當衆承認自己講錯咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 zung3 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 gong2 co3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當眾承認自己說錯了。
examples.english_sentence: He admitted in public that he was wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 在街上；當眾；公開地（在大街上進行某事）
english_meaning: on the street; in public; openly (doing something out on the street or in full view)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某個動作或情況發生在大街上或當眾、公開地進行，常用來強調在公共場所發生的行為。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or situation occurs on the street or publicly; used to emphasize that something happens in a public place or in full view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋當街打交，嚇到好多行人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dong1 gaai1 daa2 gaau1, haak3 dou3 hou2 do1 hang4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們當街打架，嚇到很多行人。
examples.english_sentence: They fought in the street, scaring many pedestrians.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢比人當街羞辱，覺得好冇面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 dong1 gaai1 sau1 juk6, gok3 dak1 hou2 mou5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人當街羞辱，覺得很沒面子。
examples.english_sentence: He was humiliated in public on the street and felt very embarrassed.

mandarin_meaning: 街頭巷尾；到處
english_meaning: all over the streets and alleys; everywhere; ubiquitous in public streets
explanation_mandarin: 表示在街道和小巷的每個地方，形容某事非常普遍、到處可見，常用作副詞或描述範圍的成語。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is present throughout the streets and alleys; used to describe that something is widespread or seen everywhere, functioning as an adverbial phrase or idiom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲海報喺當街當巷都見到，真係好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 hoi2 bou3 hai2 dong1 gaai1 dong1 hong6 dou1 gin3 dou2, zan1 hai6 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的海報在街頭巷尾到處都能看到，真的很出名。
examples.english_sentence: His posters can be seen all over the streets and alleys; he's really famous.

mandarin_meaning: 被當作壞人／被責備；被當替罪羊（口語）
english_meaning: to be blamed; to be made the scapegoat; to be treated as the bad person (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示被人責備、被當作壞人或替罪羊，有時亦可指遇上倒霉或不幸。常與「畀人／被人」搭配使用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb phrase meaning to be blamed, treated as the bad person, or made the scapegoat; can also imply being unlucky. Commonly used with a passive marker (e.g. '畀人/bei2 jan4').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日畀人當衰，明明唔係佢嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 dong3 seoi1, ming4 ming4 m4 hai6 keoi5 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常被人當作壞人，明明不是他的錯。
examples.english_sentence: He often gets blamed and is made out as the bad guy, even though it's clearly not his fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，佢又畀人當衰，做替罪羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, keoi5 jau6 bei2 jan4 dong3 seoi1, zou6 tai3 zeoi6 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出了事，他又被人當作替罪羊。
examples.english_sentence: When the company ran into trouble, he was again made the scapegoat.

mandarin_meaning: 把（某人）當作透明／無視某人
english_meaning: to treat someone as invisible; to ignore someone deliberately
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容故意不理會某人，好像對方不存在。常用於人際關係或社交場合，屬口語用法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to deliberately ignore someone as if they do not exist. Used in interpersonal or social contexts; informal/slang usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺會議入面亂插嘴，我就當佢透明，唔理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 lyun6 caap3 zeoi2, ngo5 zau6 dong3 keoi5 tau3 ming4, m4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天在會議上亂插嘴，我就當他透明，不理他。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps interrupting during meetings; I just treat him as invisible and ignore him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分手後佢仲想復合，但我決定當佢透明，繼續向前行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sau2 hau6 keoi5 zung6 soeng2 fuk1 hap6, daan6 ngo5 kyut3 ding6 dong3 keoi5 tau3 ming4, gai3 zuk6 hoeng3 cin4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分手後他還想復合，但我決定當他透明，繼續向前走。
examples.english_sentence: After the breakup he still wanted to get back together, but I decided to treat him as invisible and move on.

mandarin_meaning: 當季；正值產季，品質好且供應充足
english_meaning: in season; seasonal (especially produce at its peak quality and availability)
explanation_mandarin: 指水果、蔬菜或其他農產品在生產季節，品質較佳且供應較多。也可引申為事物正值興盛或流行的時期。
explanation_english: Indicates that produce or goods are in their season—at peak quality and plentiful supply. It can also be used metaphorically for something at the height of popularity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲士多啤梨係當造，買返去即刻食最好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 si6 do1 be1 lei4 hai6 dong1 zou6, maai5 faan1 heoi3 zik1 hak1 sik6 zeoi3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在的草莓正當季，買回家立刻吃最好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Strawberries are in season now — they're best eaten right after you buy them.

mandarin_meaning: 当选；在选举中被选为某职务或公职
english_meaning: to be elected; to win an election
explanation_mandarin: 指在選舉過程中獲得足夠票數而被選為某個職位或職務。
explanation_english: To obtain enough votes in an election to be chosen for a position or office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺上次選舉中成功當選市議員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng6 ci3 syun2 geoi2 zung1 sing4 gung1 dong1 syun2 si5 ji5 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在上次选举中成功当选为市议员。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully got elected as a councilor in the last election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想當選，你要多啲同選民接觸同宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 dong1 syun2, nei5 jiu3 do1 di1 tung4 syun2 man4 zip3 zuk6 tung4 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想当选，你要多跟选民接触并做宣传。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to be elected, you need to interact more with voters and do publicity.

mandarin_meaning: 假裝隱形／裝作看不見（以避開別人或責任）
english_meaning: to pretend to be invisible; to deliberately avoid attention or interaction; to act as if one doesn't see or isn't there
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，指故意裝作沒看到或不存在，以避開某人、某事或不想被發現，常用於社交場合表示迴避或不理會。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression meaning to deliberately act as if invisible or unseen, used to avoid someone or something, to not respond or draw attention in social situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日唔想同人傾計，打算當隱形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 soeng2 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2, daa2 syun3 dong3 jan2 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不想跟人聊天，打算裝作隱形。
examples.english_sentence: I don't feel like chatting with anyone today; I'll pretend to be invisible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到前男友入嚟，即刻當隱形，唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 cin4 naam4 jau5 jap6 lai4, zik1 hak1 dong3 jan2 jing4, m4 gam2 ceot1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看到前男友進來，立刻裝作沒看到，不敢出聲。
examples.english_sentence: She saw her ex come in and immediately acted invisible, not daring to make a sound.

mandarin_meaning: 当面（当着某人的面；面对面）
english_meaning: to someone's face; face-to-face; in person
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某人面前、直接面对面地做某事或说某话。
explanation_english: Indicates doing or saying something directly in front of someone; face-to-face or in person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以當面同佢講，唔好喺背後講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 dong1 min6 tung4 keoi5 gong2, m4 hou2 hai2 bui3 hau6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以当面跟他/她说，不要在背后说。
examples.english_sentence: You can tell him/her to his/her face; don't say it behind their back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當面拒絕咗我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 min6 geoi2 zek6 zo2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当面拒绝了我。
examples.english_sentence: He refused me to my face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想當面交還啲嘢畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 dong1 min6 gaau1 waan4 di1 je5 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想当面把东西还给他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I want to return the items to him/her in person.

mandarin_meaning: 当头棒喝：比喻因受严厉批评或突如其来的警示而被惊醒或警觉。
english_meaning: A sharp reprimand or a sudden wake-up call that jolts someone into awareness.
explanation_mandarin: 原指禪宗用棒喝擊打或喝斥以驚醒參禪者，現比喻給予嚴厲的警告或突然的提醒，使人警覺或改正錯誤。
explanation_english: Originally referred to Zen practice of striking or shouting to awaken a meditator; now used metaphorically for a severe reprimand or sudden admonition that serves as a wake-up call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司業績差，老闆喺會議上當頭棒喝，叫大家警醒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jip6zik1 caa1, lou5baan2 hai2 wui6ji5 soeng6 dong1tau4 bong6 hot3, giu3 daai6gaa1 ging2sing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司业绩不好，老板在会议上当头棒喝，叫大家警醒。
examples.english_sentence: With poor company performance, the boss gave a sharp reprimand at the meeting as a wake-up call for everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 處於風口；成為眾矢之的，暴露在批評、攻擊或輿論之下
english_meaning: to be exposed to criticism or attack; to be in a vulnerable/exposed position or under public scrutiny
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示某人或某事處於容易被攻擊、責難或受輿論注目的位置，往往需要承擔批評或壓力。
explanation_english: A colloquial phrase meaning someone or something is exposed and vulnerable to criticism, attack, or public scrutiny — often used when a person becomes the target of blame or attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司一出咗事，老細即刻變成當風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jat1 ceot1 zo2 si6, lou5 sai3 zik1 hak1 bin3 sing4 dong3 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司一出事，老闆馬上就成了眾矢之的。
examples.english_sentence: When the company had a problem, the boss immediately became the target of criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講好容易當風，最好小心措辭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 hou2 jung6 ji6 dong3 fung1, zeoi3 hou2 siu2 sam1 co3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說很容易成為攻擊對象，最好注意措辭。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that can easily expose you to criticism; it's best to be careful with your wording.

mandarin_meaning: 被當作配菜／被利用、被視為可有可無
english_meaning: to be treated as filler / to be used or taken for granted
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，字面為「被當作生菜（配菜）」，比喻被別人當作配角、墊場或利用，視為可有可無、不被重視。
explanation_english: Colloquial phrase literally meaning 'treated as lettuce (a filler).' Figuratively it means being treated as filler, used, or taken for granted — regarded as unimportant or merely for someone else's convenience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係嚟搵我傾偈，成日當我係食生菜，唔尊重我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 lai4 wan2 ngo5 king1 gai2, sing4 jat6 dong3 ngo5 hai6 sik6 saang1 coi3, m4 zyun1 zung6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是來找我聊天，總是把我當作配菜/利用我，不尊重我。
examples.english_sentence: He only comes to chat with me, always treats me like filler and uses me — he doesn't respect me.

mandarin_meaning: 當飯吃；賴以為生
english_meaning: to serve as a means of living / to provide one's livelihood; to be enough as food or basic sustenance
explanation_mandarin: 原意為“當作飯吃”，引申為能夠作為生活來源或維持生計。常用來形容某份工作或收入是否足以維持生活。
explanation_english: Literally 'serve as food'; figuratively used to say something can be relied on for sustenance or livelihood. Commonly used to describe whether a job or income is enough to live on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工夠我當飯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 gau3 ngo5 dong1 faan6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作夠我當飯吃。
examples.english_sentence: This job is enough to support me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫漫畫係興趣，仲未可以當飯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 maan6 waa2 hai6 hing3 ceoi3, zung6 mei6 ho2 ji5 dong1 faan6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他畫漫畫是興趣，還不能當飯吃。
examples.english_sentence: Drawing comics is his hobby; it still can't support him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲副業可以暫時當飯食，但唔係長久之計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fuk6 jip6 ho2 ji5 zaam6 si4 dong1 faan6 sik6, daan6 m4 hai6 coeng4 gau2 zi1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些副業暫時可以當飯吃，但不是長久之計。
examples.english_sentence: These side jobs can temporarily provide for living, but they're not a long-term plan.

mandarin_meaning: 顶罪；替人承担责任（俚语）
english_meaning: to take the fall; to be a scapegoat; to take the blame for someone (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「當黑」是香港廣東話俚語，指替別人頂罪或承擔別人的責任，通常含有被利用或被犧牲的意思。
explanation_english: “當黑” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang meaning to take the blame for someone else or act as a scapegoat, often implying being used or sacrificed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔會幫佢當黑，錯係佢做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wui5 bong1 keoi5 dong1 hak1, co3 hai6 keoi5 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不會幫他頂罪，錯是他做的。
examples.english_sentence: I won't take the blame for him; he's the one who did it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司叫佢當黑去掩蓋嗰宗醜聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 giu3 keoi5 dong1 hak1 heoi3 jim2 goi3 go2 zung1 cau2 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司叫他頂罪以掩蓋那宗醜聞。
examples.english_sentence: The company asked him to take the fall to cover up that scandal.

mandarin_meaning: 畸形、不正常、不完整（多用於合成詞，如「畸形」）
english_meaning: abnormal; malformed; irregular (often used in compounds, e.g. "畸形" = deformity)
explanation_mandarin: 表示不正常或發育、形狀有缺陷，多出現在複合詞中，表示畸變、異常的狀態。
explanation_english: Denotes abnormality, malformation, or irregularity. Commonly appears in compounds (e.g. "畸形") to describe deformities or atypical conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為先天畸形，要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sin1 tin1 gei1 jing4, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為先天畸形，需要做手術。
examples.english_sentence: He needs surgery because of a congenital deformity.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語、貶義）指男同性戀者或被認為女性化的男子（含侮辱意味）
english_meaning: Derogatory Cantonese slang for a gay man or an effeminate/queer man
explanation_mandarin: 「畸佬」是廣東話的俚語/貶義詞，用來指稱男同性戀者或被視為陰柔、女性化的男性。此詞帶有侮辱和歧視意味，不宜使用。
explanation_english: “畸佬” is Cantonese slang and a derogatory term used to refer to gay men or men perceived as effeminate. It carries insulting and discriminatory connotations and is inappropriate to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用「畸佬」嚟形容人，咁樣好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 'gei1 lou2' lai4 jing4 jung4 jan4, gam2 joeng6 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用「畸佬」来形容别人，这样很伤人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use '畸佬' to describe someone — it's hurtful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街度有人用畸佬嚟嘲笑其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 dou6 jau5 jan4 jung6 gei1 lou2 lai4 caau4 siu3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上有人用「畸佬」嘲笑別人。
examples.english_sentence: People on the street use '畸佬' to mock others.

mandarin_meaning: 怪人；古怪的人（粵語俗稱）
english_meaning: an eccentric person; a weirdo; oddball (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「畸士」是廣東話俗語，用來形容行為古怪或思想異於常人的人，語氣可戲謔或帶輕微貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for someone who behaves oddly or is eccentric. It can be used jokingly or with mild disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日行為古怪，真係個畸士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haang4 wai6 gu2 gwaai3, zan1 hai6 go3 gei1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常行為古怪，真是個怪人。
examples.english_sentence: He often behaves strangely; he's really an oddball.

mandarin_meaning: 畸形 (qíxíng)，發育或形態不正常
english_meaning: deformed; malformed; abnormal (in form or development)
explanation_mandarin: 指器官、形體或發展不正常、構造異常。也可引申為事物發展失衡或不合常規。
explanation_english: Refers to physical deformity or abnormal development; can also be used figuratively for distorted or abnormal conditions or structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話隻嬰兒有畸形，要進一步檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 zek3 jing1 ji4 jau5 gei1 jing4, jiu3 zeon3 jat1 bou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说那个婴儿有畸形，需要进一步检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the infant has a deformity and needs further examination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅財務結構有啲畸形，影響長遠發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 mou6 git3 gau3 jau5 di1 gei1 jing4, jing2 hoeng2 coeng4 jyun5 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的财务结构有些畸形，影响长远发展。
examples.english_sentence: The company's financial structure is somewhat distorted, affecting long-term development.

mandarin_meaning: 畸形的胎兒；在醫學上亦可指畸胎瘤（teratoma）
english_meaning: a malformed fetus; (in medical contexts) a teratoma
explanation_mandarin: 指胚胎發育異常、出現先天畸形的胎兒；在病理或臨床語境中，有時亦用於指由多種組織構成的畸胎瘤。
explanation_english: Refers to a fetus with developmental malformations or congenital defects; in pathology/clinical contexts it can also denote a teratoma, a tumor composed of multiple tissue types.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話個胎係畸胎，話繼續懷孕有風險，建議終止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 go3 toi1 hai6 kei1 toi1, waa6 gai3 zuk6 waai4 jan6 jau5 fung1 him2, gin3 ji5 zung1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说胎儿是畸胎，继续怀孕有风险，建议终止妊娠。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the fetus is malformed; continuing the pregnancy is risky, and termination was recommended.

mandarin_meaning: 畿（jī）：古代指王都或都城周圍的地區，泛指首都附近的地帶。
english_meaning: The area surrounding the capital; capital hinterland; vicinity of the capital.
explanation_mandarin: “畿”為書面語，常見於詞語如“京畿”，指君主或國都周邊的行政或地理區域，在歷史、地理或文化語境中使用較多。
explanation_english: A literary term, often seen in compounds like “京畿”, referring to the region around a royal or national capital. Used mainly in historical, geographical, or cultural contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座古廟喺京畿一帶，歷史可以追溯到唐代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 gu2 miu6 hai2 ging1 gai1 jat1 daai3, lik6 si2 ho2 ji5 zeoi1 sou3 dou3 tong4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座古廟位於京畿一帶，歷史可追溯到唐代。
examples.english_sentence: That old temple is located in the area around the capital; its history can be traced back to the Tang dynasty.

mandarin_meaning: 几内亚（西非国家）
english_meaning: Guinea (a country in West Africa)
explanation_mandarin: 指位于西非的国家，正式名称为几内亚共和国。書寫上常見寫法為「几内亚／幾內亞」，「畿內亞」亦可視為變體寫法。
explanation_english: Refers to the country Guinea in West Africa, officially the Republic of Guinea. The common Chinese spelling is 幾內亞/几内亚; 畿內亞 can be seen as a variant form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾內亞係西非嘅一個國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 noi6 aa3 hai6 sai1 fei1 ge3 jat1 go3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 几内亚是西非的一个国家。
examples.english_sentence: Guinea is a country in West Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去幾內亞做義工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 gei2 noi6 aa3 zou6 ji6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去几内亚做义工。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Guinea next month to do volunteer work.

mandarin_meaning: 幾內亞比紹（西非國家，英文：Guinea-Bissau）
english_meaning: Guinea-Bissau (a country in West Africa)
explanation_mandarin: 位於西非的國家，全名為幾內亞比紹共和國，首都是比紹，官方語言包括葡萄牙語及多種本地語言。
explanation_english: The country Guinea-Bissau in West Africa. Officially the Republic of Guinea-Bissau, its capital is Bissau; Portuguese and various local languages are used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上年去過畿內亞比紹，見到好多傳統市集。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 nin4 heoi3 gwo3 gei1 noi6 aa3 bei2 siu6, gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 cyun4 tung2 si5 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去年到過幾內亞比紹，看見很多傳統市場。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Guinea-Bissau last year and saw many traditional markets.

mandarin_meaning: jiāng — 边界；疆域；领土；常用于地名（如新疆）
english_meaning: border; frontier; territory; region (as in Xinjiang)
explanation_mandarin: 表示國土的邊界或領土，常見於複合詞如「疆域」、「邊疆」、「新疆」。
explanation_english: Refers to the border or territory of a country or region. Commonly appears in compounds such as '疆域' (territory), '邊疆' (frontier), and place names like 'Xinjiang'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 國家應該保衛自己嘅疆域。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwok3 gaa1 jing1 goi1 bou2 wai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 goeng1 wik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 国家应该保卫自己的疆域。
examples.english_sentence: A country should defend its territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去咗新疆旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 san1 goeng1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去过新疆旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We traveled to Xinjiang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊疆地區需要更多扶持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 goeng1 dei6 keoi1 seoi1 jiu3 gang1 do1 fu4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 边疆地区需要更多扶持。
examples.english_sentence: Border regions need more support.

mandarin_meaning: 疆土；领土；国家所拥有或控制的土地
english_meaning: territory; land under a state's sovereignty; domain
explanation_mandarin: 指國家或政權所擁有、統治或主張權力的土地範圍，包括邊界內的領土與所屬地區。
explanation_english: Refers to the land area that a state or authority possesses, controls, or claims—essentially the territory within recognized or asserted boundaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要守護國家嘅疆土。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau2 wu6 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 goeng1 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要守护国家的疆土。
examples.english_sentence: We must defend the country's territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時帝王用疆土嚟表示佢哋嘅勢力範圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 dai3 wong4 jung6 goeng1 tou2 lai4 biu2 si6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sai3 lik6 faan6 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时帝王用疆土来表示他们的势力范围。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, emperors used territory to indicate the scope of their power.

mandarin_meaning: 疆域（jiāngyù）：國家或政權控制的領土範圍
english_meaning: territory; the land area or borders under the control of a country or political authority
explanation_mandarin: 指國家、政權或團體所屬或控制的土地範圍與邊界。
explanation_english: Refers to the land area and borders that belong to or are controlled by a country, government, or group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 國家要保護自己嘅疆域。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwok3 gaa1 jiu3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 goeng1 wik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 國家要保護自己的疆域。
examples.english_sentence: A country must protect its territory.

mandarin_meaning: 疆界（jiāngjiè）：边界、界限
english_meaning: boundary; border; limit; scope
explanation_mandarin: 指領土或地區的邊界；也可指抽象的範圍或界限。
explanation_english: Refers to the border or boundary of a territory or region; can also mean an abstract limit or scope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條河係兩個村嘅疆界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 ho4 hai6 loeng5 go3 cyun1 ge3 goeng1 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条河是两个村庄的疆界。
examples.english_sentence: This river is the boundary between the two villages.

mandarin_meaning: 往昔；田地、類別（書面語、古語用法）
english_meaning: former times; field/realm; category (literary/classical usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「疇」為書面或古語用字，可指往昔、田地或類別，常見於詞組如「疇昔」。現代口語中較少使用。
explanation_english: A literary/classical Chinese character meaning 'the past' or 'field/realm/category'. Commonly appears in compounds like '疇昔' (the days of old). Rare in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起疇昔嘅日子，感到好懷念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 cau4 sik1 ge3 jat6 zi2, gam2 dou3 hou2 waai4 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他談起往昔的日子，感到很懷念。
examples.english_sentence: He talked about the days of old and felt nostalgic.

mandarin_meaning: 叠；折叠；堆叠；重叠
english_meaning: to fold; to stack; to pile up; to overlap; (can imply repeated action)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把物品折叠或堆放，也可表示事物重叠或（口語中）反复多次。
explanation_english: Indicates folding or stacking items; can also mean things overlapping or (colloquially) doing something repeatedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我將件衫疊好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 gin6 saam1 dip6 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫我把衬衫叠好吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please fold the shirt for me.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）志同道合或經常一起活動的朋友，相當於「死黨／老友」
english_meaning: slang: a close friend or buddy who often hangs out or does things together; similar to 'close pal' or 'best mate'
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語非正式用語，用來稱呼與自己志趣相投、經常一起出現或互相幫忙的朋友。語氣口語且帶地方色彩，主要在日常會話或網絡用語中出現。
explanation_english: An informal Hong Kong Cantonese slang term for a friend with whom one frequently hangs out or collaborates. It's used in casual speech and online, and carries a regional, colloquial flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅疊友，成日一齊打機同埋去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 dip6 jau5, sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 daa2 gei1 tung4 maai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的疊友，經常一起打遊戲和去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He's my 'dip yau' — we often play games together and go travelling.

mandarin_meaning: 大家有相同的喜好或傾向；都看中同一樣東西，達成一致
english_meaning: To share the same preference or favor the same thing; to all fancy the same option / reach a consensus on a preferred choice
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，表示多人對某事或某物有相同的心水（喜好/偏好），也可指達成一致的選擇。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning several people share the same '心水' (favourite/choice). It indicates that everyone likes the same thing or has reached agreement on a preferred option.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家今晚居然都疊埋心水，齊齊買咗嗰件T恤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 gam1 maan5 geoi1 jin4 dou1 daap6 maai4 sam1 seoi2, cai4 cai4 maai5 zo2 go2 gin6 T seot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家今晚居然都喜歡同一件，齊齊買了那件T恤。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight everyone surprisingly fancied the same one, and we all bought that T‑shirt.

mandarin_meaning: 叠字；重复使用同一字或音节的词素（如“天天”、“看看”），常用于表示轻微程度、亲昵、拟声、反复等
english_meaning: reduplicated character(s); the repetition of a character or syllable (e.g. “天天”, “see-see”), often used for diminutive/affective, onomatopoeic, iterative, or intensifying functions
explanation_mandarin: 疊字指在詞語中重複相同的字或音節。中文裡疊字可以用來表示親昵（如「乖乖」）、動作反覆（如「看看」）、擬聲（如「叮叮」）或加強語氣，廣泛見於口語、兒童語和歌詞中。
explanation_english: “疊字” refers to the repetition of the same character or syllable in a word or phrase. In Chinese, reduplication can mark affection (e.g. “goody-goody”), iterative actions (e.g. “take a look”), onomatopoeia (e.g. “ding-ding”), or intensification. It is common in spoken language, children’s speech, and song lyrics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句歌詞入面有疊字，聽落幾可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 go1 ci4 jap6 min6 jau5 dip6 zi6, teng1 lok6 gei2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句歌词里面有叠字，听起来很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: This line of lyrics contains reduplicated characters; it sounds quite cute.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/非標準）相當於「疊幾多/疊幾個」，用於詢問堆疊、折疊或某物的數量；也可能為個別社群的俚語，具體含義視上下文而定。
english_meaning: (colloquial/non-standard) roughly 'how many stacked?' or a contraction of 'how many (of them) to stack/fold'; used to ask about quantity or amount of piled/folded items. May be dialectal or slang depending on context.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語短語 / 疑問短語
explanation_mandarin: 「疊幾」在標準粵語中並不常見，通常為口語縮略，可能來自「疊幾多」或「疊幾個」。用於詢問把東西疊、堆或折疊了多少，或要求對方說出數量。具體含義需依上下文或說話者社群判斷。
explanation_english: Not a common standard Cantonese term; typically a colloquial shortening of phrases like '疊幾多' ('how many stacked?'). It is used to ask how many items are stacked/folded or to refer to the amount. The precise meaning depends on context and may be regionally/slang-specific.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢話嘅「疊幾」係咩意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 waa6 ge3 'dip6 gei2' hai6 me1 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他說的「疊幾」是什麼意思。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what he meant by '疊幾'.

mandarin_meaning: 正好；恰好（口语）
english_meaning: exactly; just right; coincidentally (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「疊正」是廣東話口語用詞，表示某事物正好符合、恰巧或剛剛好與另一事物相合或同時發生。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning something fits perfectly, happens to coincide, or is just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅時間疊正我有空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 si4 gaan3 dip6 zeng3 ngo5 jau5 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的时间正好我有空。
examples.english_sentence: The time you mentioned is exactly when I'm free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫疊正啱你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 dip6 zeng3 aam1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服正好适合你。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing fits you perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰句同我諗嗰句疊正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 geoi3 tung4 ngo5 nam2 go2 geoi3 dip6 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的那句和我想的那句正好一样。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is exactly what I was thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 層層疊起的水流；階梯式或分層的瀑布或人工層疊水景（書面或景觀描述用語）
english_meaning: tiered or cascading water; a cascade or tiered waterfall; layered water feature
explanation_mandarin: 「疊水」多用於書面或用來描述地景，指水流呈層疊、逐級跌落的狀態，既可指天然的階梯式瀑布，也可指人工造的層疊水景。並非日常口語中非常高頻的詞彙。
explanation_english: A literary/landscape term for water forming tiers or cascades — for example a tiered waterfall or a layered water feature. It can refer to natural stepped falls or man-made cascading water installations and is not a very high-frequency everyday spoken word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山邊有幾處疊水，好靚，啲水由高處逐級跌落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 bin1 jau5 gei2 co3 dip6 seoi2, hou2 leng3, di1 seoi2 jau4 gou1 co3 zuk6 kap1 dit3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山边有好几处叠水，很漂亮，水从高处逐级跌落。
examples.english_sentence: There are several tiered waterfalls by the mountain; they're beautiful — the water falls from higher levels down step by step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面整咗個人工疊水，夏天細路仔鍾意喺度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 zing2 zo2 go3 jan4 gung1 dip6 seoi2, haa6 tin1 sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 hai2 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面造了一个人工叠水，夏天小朋友喜欢在这里玩。
examples.english_sentence: They built an artificial tiered water feature in the park; kids like to play there in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 喜歡在賭桌上疊籌碼或不斷加注的賭徒
english_meaning: a gambler who stacks chips or repeatedly increases bets (someone who chases bets)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，通常指在賭場或賭桌上把籌碼堆起來下注，或不斷加碼追贏的賭客，有時帶有輕蔑或戲稱意味。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for a gambler who stacks chips or keeps upping the stakes at the table; often used with a slightly derogatory or teasing tone to describe someone who chases losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去賭場做疊碼仔，最後輸晒老本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 coeng4 zou6 dip6 maa5 zai2, zeoi6 hau6 syu1 saai3 lou5 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常去賭場當疊碼仔，最後把本錢都輸光了。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the casino and stacks chips, and in the end he lost all his capital.

mandarin_meaning: 叠罗汉（把人或物一層層堆疊成塔／比喻層層疊加或擠在一起）
english_meaning: to stack people (form a human pyramid) or to have things/people piled up; figuratively, layered accumulation or crowded piling
explanation_mandarin: 原指把人（或物）一層層疊起像羅漢像般堆成一塔，粵語口語可用來形容人多擠迫或事物層層疊加的情況，有時帶危險或混亂的意味。
explanation_english: Originally refers to stacking people (or objects) layer upon layer like a pile of arhats; in Cantonese it commonly describes people crowded together or things piled up in layers, often implying danger or disorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 玩遊戲嗰陣，佢哋疊羅漢，結果有人跌傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan2 jau4 hei3 go2 zan6, keoi5 dei6 dip6 lo4 hon3, git3 gwo2 jau5 jan4 dit3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩游戏的时候，他们叠罗汉，结果有人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: While playing a game, they formed a human stack; as a result, someone got injured.

mandarin_meaning: 叠词／重叠词（由重复的语素构成的词，如“人人”、“慢慢”）
english_meaning: reduplicated word; reduplication (words formed by repeating a morpheme, e.g. '人人', '慢慢')
explanation_mandarin: 疊詞指語言中由同一語素重複構成的詞形，常見於表狀態、強調、親昵或輕聲語氣，如「慢慢」、「人人」、「細細」。在粵語中，疊詞用途廣泛，既可作形容詞、副詞，也可用於擬聲或稱呼。
explanation_english: A '疊詞' (reduplicated word) is formed by repeating the same morpheme. Reduplication commonly marks aspect, emphasis, diminutive or colloquial tone (e.g. 'maan6 maan6' slow-slow, 'jan4 jan4' everyone). In Cantonese, reduplication is widely used across adjectives, adverbs, vocatives and mimetic words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講嘢時，佢成日用疊詞，好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 je5 si4, keoi5 sing4 jat6 jung6 dip6 ci4, hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說話時，他經常使用疊詞，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: When he talks, he often uses reduplicated words — it's very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 字面上是「把馬重疊」，但在香港粵語中極為罕見，常被視為錯寫或口語誤用，可能原想寫／講的是「疊碼」（把籌碼堆疊、再加注）。
english_meaning: Literally 'stack horses'. Extremely rare in Cantonese; often considered a misspelling or colloquial mistake. It may be intended to be '疊碼' meaning to stack chips or increase a bet.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語／罕見詞（可能為錯寫或誤用）
explanation_mandarin: 「疊馬」從字面上可解為把馬匹重疊，但並非常見的慣用語。在香港口語中較常見的相關詞是「疊碼」，與賭博時把籌碼疊起來或加注有關。遇到「疊馬」時，需注意可能為打錯或聽錯。
explanation_english: Although literally 'to stack horses', this form is not commonly used idiomatically. In Hong Kong Cantonese the related and meaningful term is '疊碼' (dip6 maa5), referring to stacking betting chips or placing additional bets. '疊馬' is therefore likely a rare usage or a misspelling/mishearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽人講「疊馬」呢個詞，但好罕見，可能係打錯字，真正想講係「疊碼」——即係堆籌碼或再加注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 jan4 gong2 "dip6 maa5" ni1 go3 ci4, daan6 hou2 hon2 gin3, ho2 nang4 hai6 daa2 co3 zi6, zan1 zeng3 soeng2 gong2 hai6 "dip6 maa5" — zik1 hai6 dui1 cau4 maa5 wo6 zoi3 gaa1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听人说“疊馬”这个词，但很罕见，可能是打错字，真正想说的是“疊碼”——即把筹码堆起来或再加注。
examples.english_sentence: I heard people say the term '疊馬', but it's very rare and may be a typo; what they probably meant is '疊碼' — i.e., stacking chips or increasing a bet.

mandarin_meaning: pǐ（量词，用于计布匹、马匹等）
english_meaning: measure word (for horses, bolts of cloth); classifier
explanation_mandarin: “疋”是一个量词，用来计量布匹、马匹等。此字为传统或古体用法，现代汉语常用同音字“匹”作为简化或通用写法。
explanation_english: “疋” is a classifier used for counting horses, bolts of cloth, etc. It is a traditional/archaic form; in modern usage the simplified character “匹” or the same classifier pronunciation is commonly used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有三疋馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 saam1 pat1 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有三匹马。
examples.english_sentence: He has three horses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢疋布好靚，幾多錢一疋？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pat1 bou3 hou2 leng3, gei2 do1 cin2 jat1 pat1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這匹布很漂亮，一匹多少錢？
examples.english_sentence: This bolt of cloth is beautiful — how much is it per bolt?

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋、傻瓜（粗俗的罵人詞）
english_meaning: idiot; blockhead (vulgar insult)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的粗俗俗語，用來罵人愚蠢、沒用或討厭，語氣較重，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar slang term used to insult someone as stupid, useless, or annoying. Common in Hong Kong speech and carries a strong tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗件好蠢嘅事，真係個疋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gin6 hou2 ceon2 ge3 si6, zan1 hai6 go3 pat1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了一件很蠢的事，真是個笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He did something really stupid — what an idiot.

mandarin_meaning: 疍（dàn）：指以船為家、以打魚為生的船民；也作「疍家」「疍民」。
english_meaning: 疍 (daan6): refers to boat-dwelling people or sampan/boat communities (boat people); often seen in compounds like '疍家' or '疍民'.
explanation_mandarin: 「疍」字在粵語中多用於複合詞，表示以船為家或從事捕魚的群體，如「疍家」「疍民」。該字單獨使用較少，常見於地理或人群描述中，尤指廣東、珠江三角洲及沿海一帶的船民。
explanation_english: The character '疍' is primarily used in compounds in Cantonese to denote people who live on boats or make a living from fishing, such as '疍家' or '疍民'. It is rarely used alone and commonly appears in descriptions of coastal or riverine communities (notably in Guangdong and the Pearl River Delta).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係疍家出身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daan6 gaa1 ceot1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是疍家出身。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from a boat-dwelling (boat people) family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東有啲疍民依然住喺舢舨上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 jau5 di1 daan6 man4 ji1 jin4 zyu6 hai2 saan1 baan2 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 广东有些疍民依然住在舢板上。
examples.english_sentence: In Guangdong, some boat people still live on sampans.

mandarin_meaning: 疍家（疍民）——指以船为家、世代居住在水上的群体，尤指分布于广东、香港等沿海地区的水上人家。
english_meaning: Tanka / boat people — a traditional community who live on boats, traditionally found in southern China (e.g., Guangdong, Hong Kong).
explanation_mandarin: 历史上指以船为居所、以捕鱼或水上生活为生的群体，具有地域与文化特性，常与广东沿海一带的水上社区相关联。
explanation_english: Refers to a traditional group of people who make their homes on boats and often subsist by fishing or other water-based livelihoods. Commonly associated with coastal and riverine communities in southern China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係疍家出身，屋企世代住喺船上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daan6 gaa1 ceot1 san1, uk1 kei5 sai3 doi6 zyu6 hai2 syun4 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是疍家出身，家族世代住在船上。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from a Tanka (boat people) background; his family has lived on boats for generations.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）摸別人的私處或暗中猥褻；字面上指疍家（舢舨艇上的人）婦女用手摸蜆覓食
english_meaning: (slang) to grope someone (sexually) or to fondle surreptitiously; literally a Tanka woman feeling for clams
explanation_mandarin: 來源於疍家婦女用手摸蜆覓食的形象比喻。現多用作粗俗俚語，指偷偷或猥褻地摸人，也可引申為用手摸索、笨拙地尋找。
explanation_english: Derived from the image of Tanka (boat-dwelling) women feeling for clams by hand. Used as a coarse slang term meaning to grope someone furtively or indecently; can also figuratively mean to fumble or search by feel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好疍家婆摸蜆人啦，尊重啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daan6 gaa1 po4 mo2 hin2 jan4 laa1, zyun1 zung6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要隨便摸別人，尊重一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't grope people; show some respect.

mandarin_meaning: 疍家话（疍家人的方言，亦称船民语）
english_meaning: Tanka dialect / Tanka language (the speech of the Tanka or boat people)
explanation_mandarin: 指疍家（俗稱船民或水上人）所使用的方言，主要分布於廣東沿海和珠江三角洲一帶。該語言與廣府話有關聯，但具有獨特的詞彙、發音和口音特徵，常用以指代疍家人的語言或口語表達。
explanation_english: Refers to the dialect spoken by the Tanka (boat people), traditionally living on boats along the southern Chinese coast and the Pearl River Delta. It is related to Cantonese but has distinctive vocabulary, pronunciation, and accent. The term is used to denote the Tanka people's language or speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆仲識講疍家話，講起舊日船上生活好懷念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 zung6 sik1 gong2 daan6 gaa1 waa6, gong2 hei2 gau6 jat6 syun4 seong6 sang1 wut6 hou2 waai4 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶還會說疍家話，說起過去在船上的生活很懷念。
examples.english_sentence: Grandmother still speaks the Tanka dialect; when she talks about life on the boats in the past she feels very nostalgic.

mandarin_meaning: 如魚得水 / 得心應手
english_meaning: to be in one's element; to feel right at home; to thrive in a familiar environment
explanation_mandarin: 「疍家」指傳統在水上生活的疍民（俗稱「疍家」或「蜑家」）。成語字面是「疍家（的人）的雞看到水」，在粵語口語裡用來比喻人在熟悉或合適的環境中表現自在、得心應手。這是一個帶有地方色彩的粵語俗語，常用來形容一個人在某個場景或工作上特別有自信和舒服。
explanation_english: Daan6 gaa1 refers to the Tanka or boat-dwelling people. Literally 'a Tanka's chicken sees water', this colloquial Cantonese phrase is used to describe someone who is in their element—comfortable, confident, and performing well in a familiar or suitable environment. It is a regional idiom with a playful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強一落到碼頭就疍家雞見水，成個人開心得不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 jat1 lok6 dou3 maa5 tau4 zau6 daan6 gaa1 gai1 gin3 seoi2, sing4 go3 jan4 hoi1 sam1 dak1 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强一到码头就如鱼得水，高兴得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as Ah Keung arrived at the pier he was in his element and couldn’t have been happier.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻遇到陌生或危急情況時慌張、不知所措
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to panic or be flustered when encountering something unfamiliar or alarming
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞（比喻用法）
explanation_mandarin: 源自疍家（船民）生活，形容像見到水的雞一樣驚慌失措，用來比喻人在陌生或緊張情況下表現慌亂、不適應。
explanation_english: Literally 'a Tanka (boat people) chicken seeing water.' Used figuratively to describe someone who becomes panicked, flustered, or unable to cope when faced with unfamiliar or stressful situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次上船，細佬淨係驚，成隻疍家鷄見水咁，手足無措。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng5 syun4, sai3 lou2 zing6 hai6 geng1, sing4 zek3 daan6 gaa1 gai1 gin3 seoi2 gam2, sau2 zuk1 mou4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次上船，弟弟非常害怕，像隻見到水的疍家雞一樣，手足無措。
examples.english_sentence: On his first boat trip my younger brother was terrified, like a Tanka chicken seeing water, totally at a loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去到台上，佢即刻疍家鷄見水，講唔出嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 dou3 toi4 soeng5, keoi5 zik1 haak1 daan6 gaa1 gai1 gin3 seoi2, m4 sik1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到了台上，他立刻像見到水的疍家雞一樣，說不出話來。
examples.english_sentence: Once on stage he froze like a Tanka chicken seeing water and couldn't speak.

mandarin_meaning: 疏（shū）：表示疏远、疏忽、疏通或稀疏等意义，常用于构成复合词如“疏忽”“疏通”“疏远”“稀疏”。
english_meaning: Indicates being negligent or sparse, or the action of clearing/unblocking or creating distance; appears in compounds like '疏忽' (neglect), '疏通' (unblock), '疏远' (alienate), '稀疏' (sparse).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词、形容词（视词组/用法而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示不密、不近、疏远或不仔细，也可表示把阻塞的地方弄通。常與其他字組合使用以表達不同意義。
explanation_english: Used to express being sparse, distant, or negligent, or the action of making something unobstructed; commonly used in compounds to convey specific meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁疏忽，下次要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 so1 fat6, haa6 ci3 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么疏忽，下次要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so negligent; be more careful next time.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）疏忽、粗心、忽視（相當於「疏忽」）
english_meaning: careless; negligent; to be negligent/not pay proper attention (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「疏乎」是廣東話口語用法，常用來表示對事情不夠留意或有疏忽，與普通話的「疏忽」意思相近，但屬口語或俗寫。
explanation_english: “疏乎” is a colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate carelessness or negligence. It is similar in meaning to Mandarin 疏忽 but is informal and often used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁疏乎，重要嘢要記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 so1 fu1 zung6 jiu3 je5 jiu3 gei3 dak1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么疏忽，重要的事要记得。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless; remember important things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為工作疏乎咗啲細節，結果出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gung1 zok3 so1 fu1 zo2 di1 sai3 zit3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为工作疏忽了一些细节，結果出错。
examples.english_sentence: He neglected some details because of work, and as a result made mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 輕鬆舒服、無拘無束、痛快
english_meaning: relaxed, comfortable, carefree; pleasantly satisfied
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，形容人心情或處境輕鬆、舒服、無拘無束，帶有愉快暢快的感覺。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing a relaxed, comfortable, and carefree state — feeling pleasantly free and satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放咗假喺屋企，冇嘢做，真係疏乎爽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 zo2 gaa3 hai2 uk1 kei5, mou5 je5 zou6, zan1 hai6 so1 fu1 song2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放了假在家，沒事做，真的很輕鬆舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I took time off and stayed home with nothing to do — it feels so relaxed and carefree.

mandarin_meaning: 冷淡、疏遠、態度冷漠
english_meaning: aloof; cold and distant in manner; unfriendly
explanation_mandarin: 「疏冷冷」是廣東話的口語表達，用來形容一個人對別人態度冷淡、疏遠或不太熱情，帶有冷漠、不親切的感覺。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who is aloof, distant, or emotionally cold—giving an unfriendly or unwelcoming impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近對我疏冷冷，見到我都冇打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 deoi3 ngo5 sou1 laang5 laang5, gin3 dou2 ngo5 dou1 mou5 daa2 ziu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近對我冷冷淡淡，看到我也不打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: Lately he's been cold toward me; he doesn't even say hello when he sees me.

mandarin_meaning: 亂七八糟／一團糟
english_meaning: a complete mess; in utter disarray
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，用來形容事物或場所非常凌亂、混亂或一團糟。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used to describe something that is extremely messy, chaotic, or in complete disarray.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝間房散到疏哩大𡃈，唔知點樣先收得返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 gaan1 fong2 saan3 dou3 sou1 lei1 daai6 gok3, m4 zi1 dim2 joeng6 sin1 sau1 dak1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天房間亂得一團糟，不知道怎麼才能收整好。
examples.english_sentence: The room is a complete mess this morning; I don't know how to tidy it up.

mandarin_meaning: （口語、蔑稱）笨蛋、傻瓜（用作罵人或不滿的表達）
english_meaning: a colloquial insult meaning 'idiot' or 'fool' (used to express disdain or frustration)
explanation_mandarin: 疏嘞𡃈是廣東話中的俗稱，帶有貶義，多在口語中用作罵人或表達對行為的強烈不滿。該詞較為俗俚、地區性強、屬非正式用語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese insult used to call someone an idiot or to express strong disapproval of someone's actions. It is informal, vulgar in tone, and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係疏嘞𡃈，點會做出咁嘅決定？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 sou1 laak3 ngaak3, dim2 wui5 zou6 ceot1 gam2 ge3 kyut3 ding6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是個笨蛋，怎麼會做出這樣的決定？
examples.english_sentence: You're really an idiot — how could you make such a decision?

mandarin_meaning: 空堂；課堂出席稀少或無課的時段
english_meaning: an empty class / free period; a class session with low attendance
explanation_mandarin: 指課表上沒有課、教室空置或出席人數稀少的課堂時段，類似「空堂」。此用法較少見或屬地方口語。
explanation_english: Refers to a class period with no scheduled lesson, an empty classroom, or a session with low attendance (i.e. a free period). This usage is relatively uncommon and may be regional or colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日有一堂係疏堂，我可以出去食午飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau5 jat1 tong4 hai6 so1 tong4, ngo5 ho2 ji5 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 ng5 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有一节是空堂，我可以出去吃午饭。
examples.english_sentence: There's a free period today, so I can go out for lunch.

mandarin_meaning: 疏导：引导、疏通、缓解（如疏导交通、疏导情绪）
english_meaning: to guide/direct; to channel or divert; to ease or relieve (e.g., traffic, emotions)
explanation_mandarin: 表示引導或疏通某種狀況或情緒，例如疏導交通、疏導群眾或疏導情緒壓力。
explanation_english: Means to guide or clear a situation or feelings, e.g. directing traffic, managing crowds, or counseling emotions/stress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺十字路口疏導交通，減少塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 sou1 dou6 gaau1 tung1, gam2 siu2 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在十字路口疏导交通，减少堵车。
examples.english_sentence: Police are directing traffic at the intersection to reduce congestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社工幫手疏導失業人士嘅情緒同壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 gung1 bong1 sau2 sou1 dou6 sat1 jip6 jan4 si6 ge3 cing4 ceoi3 tung4 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社工幫助疏導失業人士的情緒和壓力。
examples.english_sentence: Social workers help to counsel the emotions and stress of unemployed people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師要疏導學生嘅情緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jiu3 sou1 dou6 hok6 saang1 ge3 cing4 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師要疏導學生的情緒。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher should help students manage their emotions.

mandarin_meaning: 疏忽（shūhu）——不注意、粗心、疏漏；可指行為上的疏忽或對細節的不留意。
english_meaning: careless; negligent; to neglect; oversight — lack of attention or care resulting in mistakes or omissions.
explanation_mandarin: 表示因不注意或粗心而產生的遺漏或錯誤，可用作形容詞（疏忽的）或動詞（疏忽了某事）。
explanation_english: Refers to mistakes or omissions caused by lack of attention or care. Can be used adjectivally (careless) or verbally (to neglect/overlook).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我因為疏忽，答錯咗幾條題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jan1 wai6 sou1 fat1, daap3 co3 zo2 gei2 tiu4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我因为疏忽，答错了好几道题。
examples.english_sentence: I got several questions wrong on this exam because I was careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為疏忽漏咗交報告，依家要重寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sou1 fat1 lau6 zo2 gaau1 bou3 gou3, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 cung4 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为疏忽没交报告，现在要重写。
examples.english_sentence: He failed to submit the report due to negligence and now has to redo it.

mandarin_meaning: 疏忽職守（疏忽履行職責；玩忽職守）
english_meaning: neglect one's duty; dereliction of duty; fail to properly perform one's responsibilities
explanation_mandarin: 指未能盡到應有的職責或在工作中馬虎、疏忽，導致失誤或損失。
explanation_english: Refers to failing to fulfill one's duties or being careless/negligent in performing responsibilities, which may lead to mistakes or losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為疏忽職守，導致公司損失重大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 so1fat1 zik1sau2, dou6 zi3 gung1si1 syun2sat1 zung6daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為疏忽職守，導致公司損失重大。
examples.english_sentence: Because he neglected his duties, the company suffered heavy losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係因為疏忽職守造成嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 jan1wai6 so1fat1 zik1sau2 zou6sing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事是因為疏忽職守造成的。
examples.english_sentence: This incident was caused by a neglect of duty.

mandarin_meaning: 疏散 (shū sàn)：使人群分散或從危險地區撤離
english_meaning: to evacuate; to disperse; to scatter people from a dangerous or crowded area
explanation_mandarin: 表示使人群分散或從危險地區撤離，以避免傷害或減少擁擠。
explanation_english: To cause people to disperse or to leave a dangerous area, often used in the context of emergencies or crowd control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發生火警，請大家疏散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 saang1 fo2 ging2, ceng2 daai6 gaa1 sou1 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 發生火警，請大家疏散。
examples.english_sentence: There is a fire alarm; please evacuate.

mandarin_meaning: 爽快；舒暢；（性格）直爽
english_meaning: refreshed; relieved; also candid/straightforward (personality)
explanation_mandarin: 表示心情或身體感覺舒暢、輕鬆，也可形容人為直率、爽快。
explanation_english: Indicates a feeling of being refreshed or relieved; can also describe someone who is candid and straightforward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完辣嘢沖個涼，成個人即刻疏爽晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 laat6 je5 cung1 go3 loeng4, seng4 go3 jan4 zik1 hak1 sou1 song2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完辣的東西沖個涼，我整個人立刻覺得很舒暢。
examples.english_sentence: After eating spicy food and taking a shower, I immediately felt refreshed.

mandarin_meaning: 稀稀疏疏、零零散散（形容分布不密集）
english_meaning: sparse; thinly scattered; scattered and not dense
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物分布得很稀疏、不密集，常用於描述樹木、人群、建築等分佈情況。
explanation_english: Describes something that is sparsely or thinly scattered, not densely packed. Commonly used for trees, crowds, buildings, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個山頭上面嘅樹疏疏列列，望落去覺得好空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 go3 saan1 tau4 soeng6 min6 ge3 syu6 sou1 sou1 lit6 lit6, mong6 lok6 heoi3 gok3 dak1 hou2 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整個山頭上的樹稀稀疏疏，看上去很空。
examples.english_sentence: The trees on the hillside are sparse and scattered; it looks very empty.

mandarin_meaning: 稀疏、零落、不密集
english_meaning: sparse; scattered; thin; intermittent
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物分佈稀疏、不密集或間斷，常用於描述人群、建築、樹木、留言等零散狀況。
explanation_english: Describes something that is sparsely or thinly distributed, scattered, or intermittent; often used for crowds, shops, trees, messages, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街嘅舖頭疏疏落落，好似冇咁熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ge3 pou3 tau2 so1 so1 lok6 lok6, hou2 ci5 mou5 gam2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街的店铺零零散散，好像不那么热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The shops on this street are sparse; it doesn't seem very lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲朋友疏疏落落，社交活動唔多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5 so1 so1 lok6 lok6, se5 gaau1 wut6 dung6 m4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的朋友很稀少，社交活动不多。
examples.english_sentence: His friends are few; he doesn't have much social activity.

mandarin_meaning: 漏洞、疏漏、缺失
english_meaning: a gap, flaw, omission, or loophole
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指事物、文件或說話中的漏洞、疏漏或缺失，常用來指出需要補正或改進的地方。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a gap, flaw, omission, or loophole in something (e.g., a report, plan, or argument); used to point out parts that need fixing or補正.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有疏窿，要補返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 so1 lung4, jiu3 bou2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有漏洞，需要补回。
examples.english_sentence: This report has gaps/loopholes; it needs to be fixed.

mandarin_meaning: 冷落、不再寵愛（某人）；被疏遠或忽視
english_meaning: to be neglected or fall out of favor; to be sidelined or no longer cherished
explanation_mandarin: 表示原本受寵或受重視的人，後來被冷落、不再受到寵愛或關注。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone who was once favored or attended to is now neglected or no longer given special attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從公司請咗個新助理，佢就俾上司疏竉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 zo6 lei5 , keoi5 zau6 bei2 soeng5 si1 so1 cung2 zo2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從公司請了新的助理，他就被上司冷落了。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company hired a new assistant, he has been sidelined by his boss.

mandarin_meaning: 稀疏的籬笆；比喻界限或關係鬆散
english_meaning: a sparse (or flimsy) fence; figuratively a loose boundary or a not-close relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指稀疏、間隔不緊密的籬笆。也常用作比喻，形容界線、關係或聯繫不嚴密、較為鬆散。
explanation_english: Refers to a fence that is sparse or not closely spaced. It is also used metaphorically to describe a loose boundary, a weak link, or a not-close relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後園嗰段疏籬已經倒晒，要重整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 jyun4 go2 dyun6 syu1 lei4 ji5 ging1 dou3 saai3, jiu3 cung4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 後院的那段疏籬已經倒了，需要重修。
examples.english_sentence: The section of sparse fence in the back garden has collapsed and needs to be repaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅關係好似疏籬，唔係好緊密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 syu1 lei4, m4 hai6 hou2 gan2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們之間的關係像疏籬，不太緊密。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is like a sparse fence—it's not very close.

mandarin_meaning: 疏肝（中醫術語），即疏導肝氣、緩解肝氣鬱結或肝火；口語中常用來指透過活動（如喝一杯、傾訴、運動）來紓解情緒或發洩不快。
english_meaning: Literally 'soothe the liver' (TCM): to disperse liver qi stagnation or relieve 'liver fire'; colloquially used to mean relieving frustration or venting (e.g., by having a drink, talking, or doing something to blow off steam).
explanation_mandarin: 「疏肝」原為中醫術語，指疏通肝氣、舒緩情緒不暢或肝火旺盛的狀態。日常口語中也用來表示透過某些方式（如飲酒、聊天、運動）來紓解鬱悶或怒氣。
explanation_english: Originally a Traditional Chinese Medicine term meaning to unblock or soothe the liver qi and relieve emotional stagnation or 'liver fire'. In everyday speech it commonly means to relieve frustration or vent feelings by doing something like having a drink, talking, or exercising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係頂住啲氣，出去飲杯嘢疏肝啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 deng2 zyu6 di1 hei3, ceot1 heoi3 jam2 bui1 je5 so1 gon1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只把氣憋在心裡，出去喝一杯，疏解一下情緒吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just keep it all inside—let's go out for a drink to blow off some steam.

mandarin_meaning: 疏通（疏通阻塞或改善溝通）
english_meaning: to clear/unblock; to facilitate or smooth communication
explanation_mandarin: 指清除管道或通道的阻塞（如下水道、管線等），或指改善、促進人與人之間的溝通與交流，使運作或關係順暢。
explanation_english: Refers to clearing blockages in pipes or channels (e.g., drains, conduits), or to improving/facilitating communication between people so that processes or relationships run smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要唔要搵人嚟疏通下落水喉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 sou1 tung1 haa5 lok6 seoi2 hau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要不要找人來疏通一下下水道？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to get someone to unclog the drain?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司派咗人去疏通員工同管理層之間嘅溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 paai3 zo2 jan4 heoi3 sou1 tung1 jyun4 gung1 tung4 gun2 lei5 cang4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司派了人去疏通員工與管理層之間的溝通。
examples.english_sentence: The company sent people to facilitate communication between employees and management.

mandarin_meaning: 疏远（關係變得不親近或保持距離）
english_meaning: to become distant or estranged; distant; to keep at a distance
explanation_mandarin: 表示人際關係變得疏離、不親近，或對人保持距離。可用作動詞（使⋯疏遠）或形容詞（關係疏遠）。
explanation_english: Indicates that a relationship has become distant or estranged, or that someone is keeping a distance from another. Can be used as a verb (to estrange) or an adjective (being distant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最近越嚟越疏遠，冇以前咁熟絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 gan6 jyut6 lei4 jyut6 so1 jyun5, mou5 ji5 cin4 gam2 suk6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們最近越來越疏遠，沒有以前那麼熟絡。
examples.english_sentence: They have been growing increasingly distant recently and aren't as close as before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好對佢咁疏遠，試下主動聯絡下佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 deoi3 keoi5 gam2 so1 jyun5, si3 haa5 zyu2 dung6 lyun4 lok3 haa5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要對他那麼疏遠，試著主動聯絡他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so distant with him; try reaching out to him.

mandarin_meaning: 疏遠；門庭冷落（形容家中或人際關係冷清）
english_meaning: to be estranged; neglected; (of a household) quiet or in decline
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（方言用法，可作狀態描述）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語或方言詞，表示關係疏遠、被冷落或門庭冷清，不常見於書面普通話。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/dialectal term describing estrangement, being neglected, or a household/person being quiet and out of favor. Not common in standard Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從細佬去咗外國，屋企就疏門晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 sai3 lou2 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3, uk1 kei5 zau6 sou1 mun4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從弟弟去國外後，家裡就冷清了。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since my younger brother went abroad, the house has been quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同朋友越來越疏門，唔再聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 pang4 jau5 jyut6 loi4 jyut6 sou1 mun4, m4 zoi6 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和朋友越來越疏遠，不再聯絡。
examples.english_sentence: He and his friends have grown increasingly estranged and no longer keep in touch.

mandarin_meaning: 疏离（shūlí）：（感情或關係）變得疏遠、冷淡、缺乏聯繫
english_meaning: alienated; estranged; distant (describing a relationship or feeling of detachment)
explanation_mandarin: 表示人與人之間的情感或聯繫變得冷淡、不親近或疏遠，常用來形容關係、互動或情緒上的隔閡。
explanation_english: Describes a state in which people or relationships become distant, detached, or emotionally cold; often used for relationships, interactions, or feelings of estrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢同我嘅關係有啲疏離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 jau5 di1 sou1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他和我的關係有點疏離。
examples.english_sentence: Lately his relationship with me has become a bit distant.

mandarin_meaning: 怀疑；疑问
english_meaning: to doubt; suspicion; to be puzzled
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事或某人不確定、不信任或有疑問的心態，常用於構成複合詞（如懷疑、可疑、疑惑）。
explanation_english: Expresses doubt or suspicion toward something or someone, or a sense of puzzlement; commonly appears in compounds (e.g., 怀疑/懷疑, 可疑, 疑惑).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢有啲懷疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 jau5 di1 waai4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他有些怀疑。
examples.english_sentence: I have some doubts about him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事令人好疑惑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 jan6 hou2 ji4 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事让人很疑惑。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very puzzling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人走私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 zau2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方怀疑有人走私。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone of smuggling.

mandarin_meaning: 疑似（疑為、看起來像是）
english_meaning: suspected; seemingly; appears to be
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞/形容詞（表示懷疑或不確定）
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某事物被懷疑是某種情況或屬於某類，帶有不確定性，例如疑似病例表示可能感染但未確診。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is suspected to be a certain case or type, expressing uncertainty—e.g., a 'suspected' case that has not been confirmed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有個疑似病例已經送咗去醫院檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 go3 ji4 ci5 beng6 lik6 ji5 ging1 sung3 zo2 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有一個疑似病例已經被送往醫院檢查。
examples.english_sentence: A suspected case has already been sent to the hospital for examination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報道話發現疑似病例，政府而家正喺跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 waa6 faat3 jin4 ji4 ci5 beng6 lik6, zing3 fu2 ji4 gaa1 zing3 hai2 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞報導指出發現疑似病例，政府正在跟進。
examples.english_sentence: The news reported suspected cases have been found; the government is following up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢疑似忘記咗約會嘅時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 ci5 mong4 gei3 zo2 joek3 wui6 ge3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他疑似忘記了約會的時間。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have forgotten the appointment time.

mandarin_meaning: 疑凶（yí xiōng）— 嫌疑犯；被怀疑犯下罪行的人，尤指重大案件的嫌疑者
english_meaning: Suspect; a person suspected of committing a crime (often used for serious crimes)
explanation_mandarin: 指被懷疑犯下罪行的人，常用於新聞報導或警方通報，尤指重大案件（如謀殺案）的嫌疑者。
explanation_english: Refers to a person suspected of committing a crime. Commonly used in news reports and police statements, especially for serious cases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方已拘捕一名疑兇，並帶返警署問話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geng2 fong1 ji5 kau1 bou6 jat1 ming4 ji4 hung1, bing6 daai3 faan1 ging2 cyu5 man6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方已拘捕一名疑凶，並帶回警署訊問。
examples.english_sentence: The police have arrested a suspect and brought them back to the police station for questioning.

mandarin_meaning: 疑犯；被怀疑是犯罪的人
english_meaning: suspect; a person suspected of committing a crime
explanation_mandarin: 指被怀疑是犯罪嫌疑人的人，常見於警方通報或新聞報導，含「嫌疑犯」的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a person suspected of committing a crime; used in police reports or news to mean a suspected criminal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方話已經捉到一名疑匪，會帶返警署問清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waa6 ji5 ging1 zuk1 dou3 jat1 ming4 ji4 fai2 wui5 daai3 faan1 ging2 cyu5 man6 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方说已经抓到一名疑匪，会带回警署问清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The police said they have arrested a suspect and will take them to the station for questioning.

mandarin_meaning: 疑问（对事物不确定或需要澄清的问题或怀疑）
english_meaning: doubt; question; query; something that raises uncertainty or needs clarification
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事感到不確定或有懷疑，或指需要向他人詢問、澄清的問題或疑點。
explanation_english: Refers to a feeling of doubt or a question — an uncertainty that may require clarification; can denote a query or point of suspicion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個計劃有疑問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ji4 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个计划有疑问。
examples.english_sentence: I have doubts about this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有任何疑問，歡迎提出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 jam6 ho4 ji4 man6, fun1 jing4 tai4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有任何疑问，欢迎提出。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any questions, you're welcome to raise them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅聲明惹起公眾嘅疑問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 sing1 ming4 je5 hei2 gung1 zung3 ge3 ji4 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的声明引起了公众的疑问。
examples.english_sentence: The government's statement has raised public doubts.

mandarin_meaning: 疑团；令人疑惑的问题或未解之处
english_meaning: a matter of doubt or puzzlement; an unresolved question or mystery
explanation_mandarin: 指令人感到疑惑、尚未弄清楚或解释的问题、矛盾之处或谜团。
explanation_english: Refers to something that causes doubt or puzzlement — an unresolved question, inconsistency, or mystery that has not been clarified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事情仲有好多疑團未解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 cing4 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ji4 tyun4 mei6 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事情还有很多疑团没有解开。
examples.english_sentence: There are still many unresolved questions about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方對案件中嘅疑團仲喺調查中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 deoi3 on3 gin6 zung1 ge3 ji4 tyun4 zung6 hai6 diu6 caa4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方对于案件中的疑团仍在调查中。
examples.english_sentence: The police are still investigating the unresolved aspects of the case.

mandarin_meaning: 怀疑；不信任（心态）
english_meaning: suspicion; distrust; a suspicious feeling
explanation_mandarin: 表示對他人或事物心存懷疑、不信任的感覺或心理狀態。
explanation_english: A feeling or state of doubt and mistrust toward someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我有疑心，成日問我去邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 jau5 ngai4 sam1, seng4 jat6 man6 ngo5 heoi3 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對我有疑心，成天問我去哪裡。
examples.english_sentence: He is suspicious of me and keeps asking where I go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁有疑心，大家其實冇講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 jau5 ngai4 sam1, daai6 gaa1 kei4 sat6 mou5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別這麼多疑，我們其實沒說什麼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so suspicious; we actually didn't say anything.

mandarin_meaning: 疑心生暗鬼（疑心會引起無端的恐懼或懷疑）
english_meaning: Suspicion breeds ghosts — to let suspicion create imaginary fears; to be overly suspicious and imagine problems that aren't there.
explanation_mandarin: 因為多疑或不信任而胡思亂想，產生沒有根據的恐懼或誤會。
explanation_english: An idiom describing how excessive suspicion leads someone to imagine threats or wrongdoing that don't actually exist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日疑心生暗鬼，冇必要咁緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 ji4 sam1 saang1 aam3 gwai2, mou5 bit1 jiu3 gam2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是疑神疑鬼，沒有必要這麼緊張。
examples.english_sentence: You're always imagining problems out of suspicion; there's no need to be so anxious.

mandarin_meaning: 疑惑（yíhuò）：感到不明白或对某事持怀疑态度
english_meaning: to feel puzzled or doubtful; perplexed; to have doubts
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某件事不清楚、难以理解或心存怀疑的状态或动作。
explanation_english: Indicates a state or action of being unclear, unable to understand something, or harboring doubt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢咁嘅做法感到好疑惑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 gam2 ge3 zou6faat3 gam2 dou3 hou2 ji4 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他/她这样的做法感到很疑惑。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very puzzled by his/her way of doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話有證據，但我對佢嘅說法仍然有啲疑惑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jau5 zing3geoi3, daan6 ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 syut3faat3 jing4jin4 jau5 di1 ji4 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说有证据，但我对他的说法仍然有些疑惑。
examples.english_sentence: He says there is evidence, but I'm still a bit doubtful about his claim.

mandarin_meaning: 疑虑 (對某事感到懷疑或擔心，有顧慮)
english_meaning: doubt; misgiving; concern; reservation
explanation_mandarin: 指對某件事或情況有疑問、不放心或擔心，心裡有顧慮。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling doubt, worry, or reservation about something; having concerns or misgivings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個計劃有啲疑慮，唔知道可唔可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 di1 ji4 leoi6, m4 zi1 dou3 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對這個計劃有些疑慮，不知道能不能成功。
examples.english_sentence: I have some doubts about this plan; I'm not sure if it can succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完醫生嘅解釋之後，佢嘅疑慮少咗啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jyun4 ji1 sang1 ge3 gaai2 sik1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 ji4 leoi6 siu2 zo2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽完醫生的解釋之後，他的疑慮少了一些。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the doctor's explanation, his concerns decreased somewhat.

mandarin_meaning: 疑案（yí'àn）：可疑的案件，或尚未查明真相、存有疑点的案件（多指刑事案件）。
english_meaning: a suspicious or mysterious case; an unsolved or doubtful criminal case.
explanation_mandarin: 指在调查中存在疑点、尚未查明真相或令人怀疑的案件，通常用于刑事或司法语境。
explanation_english: Refers to a case that is suspicious, mysterious, or not yet clarified; commonly used in legal or criminal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方話呢宗係疑案，仍然要再調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waa6 ni1 zung1 hai6 ji4 on3, jing4 jin4 jiu3 zoi3 tiu4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方称这起案件是疑案，仍需进一步调查。
examples.english_sentence: The police said this case is a suspicious case and still needs further investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單疑案至今仲未偵破，大家都好關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 ji4 on3 zi3 gam1 zung6 mei6 zing1 po3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这宗疑案至今还未侦破，大家都很关心。
examples.english_sentence: This suspicious case hasn't been solved yet; everyone is very concerned.

mandarin_meaning: 嫌疑犯；犯罪嫌疑人
english_meaning: suspect (in a crime); criminal suspect
explanation_mandarin: 指被懷疑涉及犯罪的人，通常在警方或司法調查階段被稱為疑犯或嫌疑人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person suspected of being involved in a crime; typically used during police or judicial investigations to denote someone under suspicion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方拘捕咗一名疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 geoi1 bou6 zo2 jat1 ming4 ngai4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方逮捕了一名嫌疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested a suspect.

mandarin_meaning: 疑神疑鬼
english_meaning: to be overly suspicious; paranoid
explanation_mandarin: 形容過分多疑，對周圍的人或事常存不必要的猜疑或恐懼。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is excessively suspicious or paranoid, constantly suspecting people or things without good reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日疑神疑鬼，連朋友嘅好意都唔信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 ji4 san4 ji4 gwai2, lin4 pang4 jau5 ge3 hou2 ji3 dou1 m4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近總是疑神疑鬼，連朋友的好意都不相信。
examples.english_sentence: He's been paranoid lately, even distrusting his friends' goodwill.

mandarin_meaning: 疑点；疑问（有怀疑之处）
english_meaning: a doubt; a point of suspicion; a lingering question or misgiving
explanation_mandarin: 指事情中讓人懷疑、不易解釋或需要進一步查證的地方或問題。
explanation_english: Refers to aspects of a matter that arouse suspicion or doubt and require further clarification or investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事仲有好多疑竇未解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ji4 dau6 mei6 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事还有很多疑点未解。
examples.english_sentence: There are still many unresolved doubts about this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 疑難 (yínán)：難以理解或解決的問題或疑問
english_meaning: difficult problem; a puzzling or hard-to-resolve issue
explanation_mandarin: 指難以解決或理解的問題或疑問，常用於「疑難雜症」、「疑難問題」等詞組中。
explanation_english: Refers to problems or questions that are hard to understand or resolve; commonly appears in compounds like '疑難雜症' (difficult medical cases).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個疑難問題好棘手，我哋未必可以即刻解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji4 naan4 man6 tai4 hou2 gik6 sau2, ngo5 dei6 mei6 bat1 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個疑難問題很棘手，我們未必能立刻解決。
examples.english_sentence: This difficult problem is very tricky; we may not be able to resolve it immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 疑难杂症 (yí nán zá zhèng) — 难以诊断或处理的复杂疾病；比喻棘手、难解的问题
english_meaning: intractable/complicated ailments; difficult and miscellaneous problems (often used figuratively for hard-to-solve issues)
explanation_mandarin: 原指医学上难以诊断或治疗的复杂病症，亦常用于比喻那些棘手、难以解决的问题或情况。
explanation_english: Originally refers to complicated medical conditions that are hard to diagnose or treat; also used metaphorically for tricky, hard-to-solve problems or situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間醫院有專門醫疑難雜症嘅科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 jau5 zyun1 mun4 ji1 ji4 naan4 zaap6 zing3 ge3 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家医院有专门治疗疑难杂症的科室。
examples.english_sentence: This hospital has a department that specializes in treating complicated and hard-to-diagnose conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係疑難雜症，暫時都搵唔到解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 ji4 naan4 zaap6 zing3, zaam6 si4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真是疑难杂症，暂时都找不到解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really an intractable problem; for now we can't find a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 疑云：对某事存在怀疑或可疑之处，疑点
english_meaning: a cloud of suspicion; doubts or suspicious circumstances surrounding something
explanation_mandarin: “疑雲”常用来比喻围绕某件事产生的怀疑或不明之处，表示有可疑的迹象或令人存疑的情况。
explanation_english: “疑雲” (a cloud of suspicion) metaphorically refers to doubts or suspicious signs surrounding an event or situation, indicating something unclear or questionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭職之後，圍繞佢嘅離職原因仲有好多疑雲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zik1 zi1 hau6, wai4 jiu5 keoi5 ge3 lei4 zik1 jyun4 jan1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ji4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职之后，围绕他的离职原因还有很多疑云。
examples.english_sentence: After he resigned, there remained many clouds of suspicion surrounding the reasons for his resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方發現有啲唔一致嘅情況，令案件蒙上疑雲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 faat3 jin6 jau5 di1 m4 jat1 zi3 ge3 cing4 fong3, ling6 on3 gin6 mung4 soeng5 ji4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方发现有些不一致的情况，使案件蒙上疑云。
examples.english_sentence: The police discovered inconsistencies that cast a cloud of suspicion over the case.

mandarin_meaning: 疑点；可疑之处，值得怀疑或需要进一步查证的地方
english_meaning: point(s) of doubt; suspicious point(s); something questionable that requires further verification or investigation
explanation_mandarin: 指在事情、說法或證據中讓人產生懷疑的地方，通常需要進一步查證或解釋。
explanation_english: Refers to aspects of a matter, statement, or evidence that arouse suspicion or doubt and typically require further verification or explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有幾個疑點，可能要再調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 gei2 go3 ng4 dim2, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zoi3 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有几个疑点，可能要再调查。
examples.english_sentence: There are a few points of doubt in this report; it may need further investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 病字旁（表示疾病、病痛的部首）
english_meaning: the 'sickness' radical (a semantic component indicating disease or illness)
explanation_mandarin: 疒不是常用作獨立字的詞彙，主要作為漢字的部首（又稱病字旁），用來組成與疾病、病痛相關的字，例如「病」「瘋」「瘦」等，表示與病有關的意義。
explanation_english: 疒 is not commonly used as an independent character; it functions as a radical (the 'sickness' or '病字旁') in Chinese characters that relate to illness or sickness, such as 病, 瘋, 瘦. It serves as a semantic indicator for disease-related meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「疒」係「病」字嘅部首，代表疾病和病痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nik6 hai6 beng6 zi6 ge3 bou6 sau2, doi6 biu2 zat6 beng6 wo4 beng6 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「疒」是「病」字的部首，代表疾病和病痛。
examples.english_sentence: The radical 疒 is the component of the character '病', representing illness and sickness.

mandarin_meaning: （常见于“疙瘩”）指皮肤或物体上的小凸起，也可比喻为心中的芥蒂、不愉快或纠纷
english_meaning: Used mainly in the compound '疙瘩' — a small lump/bump on the skin or an object; figuratively an annoyance, knot or unresolved issue
explanation_mandarin: ‘疙’常用于口語，如‘疙瘩’，表示皮肤或物体表面的凸起（如小包、瘤），引申可指心裡的不快或雙方之間的矛盾、小問題。
explanation_english: ‘疙’ appears mainly in colloquial Cantonese compounds like '疙瘩' and denotes a small bump or lump on the body or an object; by extension it can mean an annoyance, grudges, or a small unresolved problem between people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頸上有個疙瘩，要唔要去睇醫生？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng2 soeng6 jau5 go3 gat1 daa2, jiu3 m4 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我脖子上有个疙瘩，要不要去看医生？
examples.english_sentence: There's a lump on my neck — should I see a doctor?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢之間有啲疙瘩，仲未講開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zi1 gaan1 jau5 di1 gat1 daa2, zung6 mei6 gong2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他之间有些疙瘩，還沒說開。
examples.english_sentence: There are some unresolved issues between me and him; we haven't talked them through yet.

mandarin_meaning: 内疚、愧疚
english_meaning: guilty; remorseful; having an uneasy conscience
explanation_mandarin: 表示對自己或自己行為感到內疚、愧疚或不安。常見於「內疚」「愧疚」等詞語中。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of guilt or remorse, an uneasy conscience about one's actions. Often appears in compounds such as "內疚" (feel guilty) and "愧疚" (ashamed and remorseful).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做錯咗，覺得好疚，唔知點同佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 co3 zo2, gok3 dak1 hou2 gau3, m4 zi1 dim2 tung4 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做错了，感到很内疚，不知道该怎么跟他说明。
examples.english_sentence: I did something wrong and feel very guilty; I don't know how to explain it to him.

mandarin_meaning: 疝（疝气）：指器官或组织通过腹壁或其他腔体的缺损突出，常见如腹股沟疝（鼠蹊疝）。是一种医学名词，通常需要诊断与治疗，有时需手术修补。
english_meaning: hernia: a medical condition in which an organ or tissue protrudes through a weak spot or opening in the muscle or tissue that normally contains it (commonly inguinal/inguinal hernia).
explanation_mandarin: 在醫學上指內臟或腸管經由腹壁或其他體腔的缺損或薄弱處突出到體腔外面或鄰近腔體，常見為腹股溝（鼠蹊）疝，症狀可包括腫塊、疼痛或不適，嚴重時需手術治療。
explanation_english: A medical term for when an internal organ or tissue (often intestine) pushes through a defect or weak spot in the abdominal wall or another cavity, producing a bulge that can cause pain or discomfort; treatment may require surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有疝氣，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 saan3 hei3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有疝气，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He has a hernia and needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢係腹股溝疝，要做手術先可以改善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 fuk6 gu2 gau1 saan3, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 sin1 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他是腹股沟疝，要做手术才能改善。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has an inguinal hernia and needs surgery to correct it.

mandarin_meaning: 疝气 (shàn qì) — 疝气，指腹腔内的器官或组织通过腹壁的薄弱处或缺损突出
english_meaning: hernia — a condition in which an organ or tissue protrudes through a weak spot in the abdominal wall
explanation_mandarin: 疝氣是一種常見的外科疾病，常見類型包括腹股溝疝、臍疝和切口疝。症狀可為局部腫塊、疼痛或不適，嚴重者可能需手術修補缺損。
explanation_english: A hernia is a common surgical condition in which abdominal contents push through a weakened area of the abdominal wall. Common types include inguinal, umbilical, and incisional hernias. Symptoms may include a bulge, pain, or discomfort; severe cases often require surgical repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我有腹股溝疝氣，要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 fuk1 gu2 kau1 saan3 hei3, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我有腹股沟疝气，要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I have an inguinal hernia and need surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 疤、疤痕
english_meaning: scar
explanation_mandarin: 指皮肤受伤或手术后愈合留下的痕迹，也可泛指心理或事件留下的痕迹（比喻用法）。
explanation_english: A mark left on the skin after a wound or surgery has healed; can also be used figuratively for lasting emotional or historical marks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面上有一道好深嘅疤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 soeng6 jau5 jat1 dou6 hou2 sam1 ge3 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脸上有一道很深的疤。
examples.english_sentence: He has a deep scar on his face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 刀傷通常會留疤，記得要好好護理傷口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 soeng1 tung1 soeng4 wui5 lau4 baa1, gei3 dak1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 wu6 lei5 soeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刀伤通常会留下疤，记得要好好护理伤口。
examples.english_sentence: Cuts usually leave scars; remember to take good care of the wound.

mandarin_meaning: 疤痕 (bāhén)
english_meaning: scar (a mark left on the skin after injury or surgery; can also be used metaphorically for psychological wounds)
explanation_mandarin: 皮膚受傷、手術或燒燙傷後留下的永久性痕跡；也常用作比喻，指心理或情感上的創傷痕跡。
explanation_english: A mark left on the skin after an injury, surgery, or burn; often used metaphorically to refer to psychological or emotional wounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手臂有一道好深嘅疤痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 bei3 jau5 jat1 dou6 hou2 sam1 ge3 baa1 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手臂上有一道很深的疤痕。
examples.english_sentence: He has a deep scar on his arm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間可以淡化肉體嘅疤痕，但有啲經歷會留低心理嘅疤痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 ho2 ji5 daam6 faa3 juk6 tai2 ge3 baa1 han4, daan6 jau5 di1 ging1 lik6 wui5 lau4 dai1 sam1 lei5 ge3 baa1 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 時間可以淡化肉體的疤痕，但有些經歷會留下心理的疤痕。
examples.english_sentence: Time can fade physical scars, but some experiences leave psychological scars.

mandarin_meaning: （指）疫情、疫病、瘟疫
english_meaning: epidemic; infectious disease; plague
explanation_mandarin: 表示傳染性疾病或流行病，常與其他字組成複合詞，如「疫情」「疫苗」「疫症」。
