explanation_english: Refers to an epidemic or infectious disease; commonly appears in compounds such as 'epidemic' (疫情) and 'vaccine' (疫苗).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近疫情好嚴重，大家要戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jik6 cing4 hou2 jim4 zung6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近疫情很严重，大家要戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: The epidemic has been severe recently; everyone should wear masks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院話下個月會有新冠疫苗供應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 jau5 san1 gun1 jik6 miu4 gung1 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院说下个月会有新冠疫苗供应。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital said there will be COVID-19 vaccines available next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場疫令到生意大受影響，唔少公司要收縮規模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 jik6 ling6 dou3 saang1 ji3 daai6 sau6 jing2 hoeng2, m4 siu2 gung1 si1 jiu3 sau1 suk1 kwai1 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场疫让生意受到很大影响，不少公司要缩小规模。
examples.english_sentence: This epidemic has greatly affected business; many companies have to downsize.

mandarin_meaning: 疫區（指發生傳染病或疫情擴散的地區）
english_meaning: epidemic area; quarantine zone; area affected by an outbreak
explanation_mandarin: 指發生傳染病或疫情嚴重、需要管制或隔離的地區。
explanation_english: Refers to an area affected by an infectious disease outbreak — a region under epidemic conditions that may be subject to quarantine or movement restrictions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係疫區，市民唔好入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 jik6 keoi1, si5 man4 m4 hou2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡是疫區，市民不要進入。
examples.english_sentence: This area is an epidemic zone; residents should not enter.

mandarin_meaning: 疫區；出現傳染病或流行病的地方（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: an epidemic-stricken place; a locality with many infectious cases (colloquial/slang, often pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「疫埠」為廣東話口語，指發生疫症或傳染病流行的地區，常帶貶義或用作警告人們避免前往該處。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term referring to a place affected by an epidemic or with many infectious cases. It is often used pejoratively or as a warning to avoid the area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近嗰個區成咗疫埠，好多人都病咗，唔好去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 go2 go3 keoi1 sing4 zo2 jik6 bou6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 beng6 zo2, m4 hou2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近那個區成了疫埠，很多人都生病了，最好不要去。
examples.english_sentence: Lately that district has become an epidemic-stricken area; many people are sick, so it's best not to go.

mandarin_meaning: 傳染病的流行或爆發情況
english_meaning: epidemic; outbreak; the situation of an infectious disease spreading (epidemic/pandemic)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某種傳染病在一段時間內擴散、流行或爆發的情況，常用於描述疾病傳播的嚴重程度與範圍。
explanation_english: Refers to the situation in which an infectious disease spreads, becomes prevalent, or breaks out over a period of time; commonly used to describe the severity and scope of disease transmission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近疫情嚴重，要記得戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jik6 cing4 jim4 zung6, jiu3 gei3 dak1 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近疫情嚴重，要記得戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: The epidemic has been severe recently; remember to wear a mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府公布咗最新嘅疫情數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gung1 bou3 zo2 zeoi3 san1 ge3 jik6 cing4 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府公布了最新的疫情數據。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced the latest epidemic data.

mandarin_meaning: 流行性疾病；傳染病（常指疫情）
english_meaning: epidemic disease; infectious disease; epidemic
explanation_mandarin: 「疫症」在粵語中通常指傳染性或大規模流行的疾病，等同於「疫情」或「傳染病」的概念，常用於報道或討論防疫措施時。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '疫症' refers to an infectious disease or an epidemic outbreak. It is used when discussing epidemics, public-health situations, and related containment measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有新嘅疫症爆發，大家要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi6 gan6 jau5 san1 ge3 jik6 zing3 baau3 faat3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有新的疫症爆發，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: There's an outbreak of a new epidemic recently; everyone should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院因應疫症，實施咗嚴格嘅檢疫措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jan1 jing3 jik6 zing3, sat6 si1 zo2 jim4 gaak3 ge3 gim2 jik6 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院因應疫症，實施了嚴格的檢疫措施。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital implemented strict quarantine measures in response to the epidemic.

mandarin_meaning: 疫苗 (yìmiáo)
english_meaning: vaccine
explanation_mandarin: 用于预防或减轻传染病的生物制剂，通过刺激免疫系统产生针对特定病原体的免疫力。
explanation_english: A biological preparation that provides active acquired immunity to a particular infectious disease by stimulating the immune system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇打疫苗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 daa2 jik6 miu4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有打疫苗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you been vaccinated?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友要準時打疫苗，咁佢哋先至可以保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 jiu3 zeon2 si4 daa2 jik6 miu4, gam2 keoi5 dei6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友要按时接种疫苗，这样他们才能保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: Children should receive vaccinations on schedule so they can protect themselves.

mandarin_meaning: 疱（pào）：皮肤上的小囊状水肿或疱疹，常见于水疱、疱疹等。
english_meaning: blister; vesicle — a small fluid-filled sac or lesion on the skin (as in blisters or vesicular rashes).
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚表面出現的充滿液體或發炎的囊狀突起，常見於水疱或疱疹等皮膚病，也多出現在複合詞中，如「水疱」、「疱疹」。
explanation_english: Refers to a small fluid-filled or inflamed sac on the skin (a blister/vesicle). Commonly appears in compounds such as '水疱' (blister) and '疱疹' (vesicular rash/herpes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻腳起咗水疱，要小心唔好爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 goek3 hei2 zo2 seoi2 paau3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他腳起了水疱，要小心別弄破。
examples.english_sentence: He got a blister on his foot; be careful not to pop it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話係疱疹，開咗藥畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 hai6 paau3 zan2, hoi1 zo2 joek6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說是疱疹，給他開了藥。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said it's a vesicular rash (herpes) and prescribed medicine.

mandarin_meaning: 疱疹（由病毒引起的皮膚病，如單純皰疹或帶狀皰疹）
english_meaning: herpes; a viral skin condition causing blisters (e.g. herpes simplex or shingles)
explanation_mandarin: 由病毒（如單純皰疹病毒或帶狀皰疹病毒）引起的皮膚疾病，常表現為小水泡、紅腫或疼痛，常見類型有單純皰疹與帶狀皰疹。
explanation_english: A viral skin condition that produces blisters, redness, and sometimes pain. Common types include herpes simplex (cold sores/genital herpes) and herpes zoster (shingles).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近得咗疱疹，成個嘴邊都起咗水泡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 dak1 zo2 pou3 zan2, seng4 go3 zeoi2 bin1 dou1 hei2 zo2 seoi2 paau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近得了疱疹，嘴角起了水泡。
examples.english_sentence: He recently got herpes; blisters appeared around his mouth.

mandarin_meaning: 疲劳；疲倦
english_meaning: tired; fatigued; weary
explanation_mandarin: 表示身体或精神感到困倦、无力或精力不足，常与其他字组成词语（如“疲倦”、“疲劳”）。
explanation_english: Indicates physical or mental tiredness, weariness, or lack of energy. Often appears in compounds (e.g., '疲倦', '疲劳').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好疲，想返屋企瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 pei4, soeng2 faan1 uk1 kei2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很累，想回家睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very tired and want to go home and sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 疲乏（疲倦、無力、感到乏力）
english_meaning: tired; fatigued; weary; lacking energy
explanation_mandarin: 指身體或精神感到疲倦、無力或缺乏精力，常需休息恢復。
explanation_english: Describes a physical or mental state of tiredness or lack of energy; often implies a need to rest and recover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日做咗成日嘅工作，覺得好疲乏，要休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou6 zo2 seng4 jat6 ge3 gung1 zok3, gok3 dak1 hou2 pei4 fat6, jiu3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天做了一整天的工作，感到很疲乏，需要休息。
examples.english_sentence: I worked all day today and feel very fatigued; I need to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 疲倦 (pí juàn)：身體或精神感到疲勞、無力
english_meaning: tired; fatigued; weary
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體或精神狀態感到疲累、想休息或缺乏精力。
explanation_english: Describes a state of physical or mental tiredness or lack of energy; feeling in need of rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日做咗一日嘅工，我而家好疲倦，想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zou6 zo2 jat1 jat6 ge3 gung1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 pei4 gyun6, soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天做了一整天的工作，我現在很疲倦，想睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: I worked all day today; I'm very tired now and want to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長時間對住電腦，眼睛同身體都覺得疲倦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 si4 gaan3 deoi3 zyu6 din6 nou5, ngaan5 zing1 tung4 san1 tai2 dou1 gok3 dak1 pei4 gyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 長時間對著電腦，眼睛和身體都覺得疲倦。
examples.english_sentence: After long periods in front of the computer, both my eyes and my body feel fatigued.

mandarin_meaning: 疲劳 (píláo)，指身心或身体感到疲倦、无力的状态
english_meaning: fatigue; tired; weary — a state of physical or mental exhaustion or lack of energy
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述身體或精神上感到疲倦、沒有力氣的狀態；亦可作名詞表示疲勞感或勞累。
explanation_english: Used to describe a state of physical or mental tiredness or lack of energy; can also function as a noun referring to the feeling of fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日做咗成日，覺得好疲勞，想早啲瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou6 zo2 seng4 jat6, gok3 dak1 hou2 pei4 lou4, soeng2 zou2 di1 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天做了一整天，覺得很疲勞，想早点睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: I worked all day today and feel very tired; I want to go to bed earlier.

mandarin_meaning: 疲劳轰炸（被持续的工作、任务或刺激消耗，使人身心疲惫）
english_meaning: fatigue bombardment; being worn down by continuous exhausting tasks or stimuli
explanation_mandarin: 指因連續不斷的工作、任務或外在刺激而造成的身心疲憊，形容像被不斷「轟炸」般被消耗。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of being worn out by continuous tasks, demands, or stimuli — as if being repeatedly 'bombarded' by fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近工作量太多，成日畀疲勞轟炸，連假日都冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 zok3 loeng6 taai3 do1, sing4 jat6 bei2 pei4 lou4 hung1 zaa3, lin4 gaa3 jat6 dou1 mou5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作量太多，經常被疲勞轟炸，連假日都沒精神。
examples.english_sentence: I've had too much work recently and am constantly being fatigue-bombarded—I have no energy even on days off.

mandarin_meaning: 虚弱、乏力
english_meaning: weak; feeble; exhausted
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體或精神缺乏力量、無力或感到疲憊。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of physical or mental strength; feeling weak, feeble, or exhausted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排太忙，成日冇瞓好，成個人好疲弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 taai3 mong4, sing4 jat6 mou5 fan3 hou2, sing4 go3 jan4 hou2 pei4 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近太忙，經常睡不好，整個人很疲弱。
examples.english_sentence: I've been so busy lately, not sleeping well, and feeling very weak.

mandarin_meaning: 疲态（pítài）：表现出疲劳的样子，疲惫的神情。
english_meaning: Signs or appearance of tiredness; a weary or fatigued look.
explanation_mandarin: 表示呈現出疲勞或倦怠的樣子，形容一個人看起來精神不足、無精打采的狀態或神情。
explanation_english: Describes the appearance or expression of being tired or fatigued — someone who looks weary, listless, or worn out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連續加班幾日，成日帶住疲態返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 zuk6 gaa1 baan1 gei2 jat6, sing4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 pei4 taai3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连续加班好几天，常常带着疲态上班。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working overtime for several days and often comes to work looking tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友病咗一陣，老師見到佢有啲疲態，就放佢返屋企休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 beng6 zo2 jat1 zan6, lou5 si1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 jau5 di1 pei4 taai3, zau6 fong3 keoi5 faan1 uk1 kei2 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友病了一阵子，老师看到他有些疲态，就让他回家休息。
examples.english_sentence: The child has been ill for a while; when the teacher saw he looked a bit weary, she let him go home to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 疲乏、疲倦；身心非常疲累
english_meaning: exhausted; very tired; fatigued
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容身體或精神極度疲倦、缺乏力氣或活力。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme physical or mental tiredness, lacking energy or strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日做咗成日嘢，返到屋企已經覺得好疲憊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou6 zo2 sing4 jat6 je5, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 ji5 ging1 gok3 dak1 hou2 pei4 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天做了一整天的工作，回到家後已經覺得很疲憊。
examples.english_sentence: I worked all day today and felt very exhausted when I got home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連日加班，我而家真係覺得好疲憊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 jat6 gaa1 baan1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 pei4 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 連續幾天加班，我現在真的覺得很疲憊。
examples.english_sentence: After working overtime for several days, I really feel exhausted now.

mandarin_meaning: 疲于奔命（pí yú bēn mìng）：形容因奔波忙碌而感到疲倦、應付不來。
english_meaning: to be exhausted and overwhelmed from constantly running around; to be swamped with nonstop tasks
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因為事情繁多或被動地到處奔走而感到疲憊，難以應付。
explanation_english: Describes being worn out and unable to keep up due to nonstop errands or overwhelming workloads; often implies being forced to run about attending to many tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排我忙到冇時間休息，真係疲於奔命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 ngo5 mong4 dou3 mou5 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1, zan1 hai6 pei4 jyu1 ban1 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我忙到没有时间休息，真是疲于奔命。
examples.english_sentence: I've been so busy lately I don't even have time to rest — I'm truly worn out from running around.

mandarin_meaning: 疲倦、疲劳
english_meaning: tired; fatigued; weary
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體或精神感到疲憊、沒有力氣，常用來形容工作或活動後的疲勞狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates physical or mental tiredness or lack of energy, often used to describe fatigue after work or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日做足成日，依家真係好疲累。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou6 zuk1 sing4 jat6, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 hou2 pei4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天工作了一整天，現在真的很疲倦。
examples.english_sentence: I worked the whole day today; I'm really tired now.

mandarin_meaning: 疲软 (píruǎn)：无力、疲乏或不强劲
english_meaning: weak; limp; soft; slack (lacking strength or vigor)
explanation_mandarin: 形容缺乏力氣、無精神或不強勁，常用來描述經濟、市場走勢或身體狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a lack of strength, energy, or vigor; commonly used for economies/markets or a person's physical condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟有啲疲軟，生意唔太好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 jau5 di1 pei4 jyun5, saang1 ji3 m4 taai3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济有些疲软，生意不太好。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is a bit weak right now; business isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完之後我覺得成身好疲軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 seng4 san1 hou2 pei4 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完之后我觉得全身很疲软。
examples.english_sentence: After the run I felt my whole body very weak.

mandarin_meaning: 病；疾病（書面或古字用法）
english_meaning: illness; sickness (archaic/literary usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「疴」用作表示病痛或疾病，常見於書面或古漢語，現代口語較少使用。有時與「痾」「病」意義相近。
explanation_english: The character 疴 denotes illness or sickness. It is chiefly an archaic or literary term and is uncommon in everyday speech. It is similar in meaning to 病 or disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有疴，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 o1, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有病，需要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He is ill and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 瑕疵；缺陷；毛病（cī）
english_meaning: flaw; defect; blemish; fault
explanation_mandarin: 「疵」指物品、作品或言行上的缺陷或瑕疵，常見於複合詞如「瑕疵」。
explanation_english: Refers to a flaw, defect, or blemish in an object, work, or behavior; commonly appears in compounds such as "瑕疵".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有個疵，出街會唔太好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 go3 ci1, ceot1 gaai1 wui5 m4 taai3 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服有个瑕疵，出门会不太好看。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing has a flaw; it won't look very good when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 黃疸（皮膚和眼白發黃的症狀）
english_meaning: jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes)
explanation_mandarin: 醫學術語，指因肝臟或膽道功能異常導致血中膽紅素升高，使皮膚、眼白呈黃色的病徵或狀態，常見於新生兒或肝膽疾病患者。
explanation_english: A medical term for a condition caused by elevated bilirubin, usually from liver or bile duct dysfunction, that produces yellowing of the skin and the whites of the eyes; commonly seen in newborns or people with liver/biliary disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嬰兒出疸通常係肝功能問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 ji4 ceot1 daan6 tung1 soeng4 hai6 gon1 gung1 nang4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿出现黄疸通常是肝功能问题。
examples.english_sentence: Infants developing jaundice usually have liver function problems.

mandarin_meaning: 疹子，皮膚出現的紅色或凸起的斑點或疹狀反應
english_meaning: rash (skin eruption)
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚表面出現的紅色、凸起或斑點狀的病變，常見於感染、過敏或其他皮膚反應，如出疹、皮疹。
explanation_english: Refers to an eruption on the skin characterized by red or raised spots; commonly occurs with infections, allergic reactions, or other dermatological responses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友身上出咗疹，可能係過敏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pong4 jau5 san1 soeng6 ceot1 zo2 zan2, ho2 nang4 hai6 gwo3 man5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友身上起了疹子，可能是過敏。
examples.english_sentence: The child has developed a rash on their body; it might be an allergic reaction.

mandarin_meaning: 疼／疼爱（疼惜、痛）
english_meaning: to ache; to hurt; to dote on; to feel affection or pity
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體某處感到疼痛，也可表示對人疼愛、疼惜或同情。
explanation_english: Indicates physical pain in a body part; can also mean to dote on someone or to feel pity/concern for someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻腳好疼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 goek3 hou2 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的脚很疼。
examples.english_sentence: My foot really hurts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽好疼細路仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hou2 tung4 sai3 lou6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很疼小孩。
examples.english_sentence: Mom really dotes on the child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭疼到瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 tung4 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他头疼到睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: His head hurts so much he can't sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 疼爱、怜惜
english_meaning: to cherish; to feel tender affection and pity; to care for lovingly
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人或事物抱有疼愛和憐惜的情感，常用來形容對小孩、親人或弱者的關懷與照顧。
explanation_english: Expresses tender affection and pity toward someone or something; commonly used to describe caring, protective attitudes toward children, relatives, or the vulnerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好疼惜個細路，成日照顧佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tang4 sik1 go3 sai3 lou6, sing4 jat6 ziu3 gu3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼惜那個小孩，常常照顧他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very fond of the child and often looks after him.

mandarin_meaning: 疼爱（疼愛）
english_meaning: to dote on; to love and care for tenderly
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人（多指子女或晚輩）給予溫柔的愛護和關懷，有時帶有溺愛的含義。
explanation_english: Expresses giving tender love and care to someone (often a child or younger person), sometimes implying doting or spoiling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爸爸好疼愛佢個囝，成日買玩具俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa4 baa1 hou2 tang4 oi3 keoi5 go3 gaan2, sing4 jat6 maai5 waan6 geoi6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸很疼爱他的儿子，经常买玩具给他。
examples.english_sentence: Dad dotes on his son and often buys him toys.

mandarin_meaning: 疼痛（身體不適或疼痛的感覺）
english_meaning: pain; ache
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體某處感到不舒服或刺痛、酸痛的感覺，可用作名詞或動詞，在醫療或日常描述疼痛時常用。
explanation_english: Refers to physical pain or an aching sensation; can function as a noun (pain) or a verb (to ache). Commonly used in medical contexts or everyday descriptions of discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻牙好疼痛，今晚訓唔着覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 ngaa4 hou2 tang4 tung3, gam1 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的牙很疼，今晚睡不着覺。
examples.english_sentence: My tooth hurts a lot; I can't sleep tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你感到胸口疼痛，應該即刻去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gam2 dou6 hung1 hau2 tang4 tung3, jing1 goi1 zik1 hak1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你感到胸口疼痛，應該馬上去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: If you feel chest pain, you should see a doctor immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 疼爱；宠爱；溺爱
english_meaning: to dote on; to cherish; to pamper
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示對某人非常疼愛、關心或寵溺，常用於父母對子女、長輩對晚輩，或戀人之間表達愛護與寵愛。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to show strong affection, doting or pampering someone. Commonly used for parents toward children, elders toward juniors, or between romantic partners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽好疼錫細佬，成日買糖俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hou2 tang4 sek3 sai3 lou2, sing4 jat6 maai5 tong4 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很疼爱弟弟，总是给他买糖。
examples.english_sentence: Mom dotes on my younger brother and always buys him candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細佬畀阿媽疼錫到，乜都唔使做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 lou2 bei2 aa3 maa1 tang4 sek3 dou3, mat1 dou1 m4 sai2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的弟弟被妈妈宠惯了，什么都不用做。
examples.english_sentence: His younger brother is spoiled by their mom and doesn't have to do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好疼錫女朋友，成日送花同帶佢出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tang4 sek3 neoi5 pang4 jau5, sing4 jat6 sung3 faa1 tung4 daai3 keoi5 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼爱女朋友，总是送花并带她出去。
examples.english_sentence: He dotes on his girlfriend, always bringing her flowers and taking her out.

mandarin_meaning: 疾病；（書面）迅速；（文言）痛恨
english_meaning: disease; illness; (literary) rapid; (archaic) to hate
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞（書面）/ 動詞（文言）
explanation_mandarin: 「疾」常用作表示疾病或病症的名詞，在書面語或文言中也可表示快速（如「疾速」）或表示痛恨。現代口語多用於複合詞如「疾病」。
explanation_english: Commonly used as a noun meaning disease or illness. In literary or classical usage it can mean rapid (e.g. '疾速') or, archaically, to hate. In modern speech it's mainly seen in compounds like '疾病'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一種罕見嘅疾，成日要返醫院檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 zung2 hon2 gin3 ge3 zat6, sing4 jat6 jiu3 faan1 ji1 jyun2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一種罕見的疾病，經常需要回醫院檢查。
examples.english_sentence: He has a rare disease and often needs to go back to the hospital for check-ups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察聽到呼救聲即刻疾步衝入屋內。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 teng1 dou3 fu1 gau3 seng1 zik1 hak1 zat6 bou6 cung1 jap6 uk1 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察聽到呼救聲後立刻疾步衝進屋內。
examples.english_sentence: When the police heard the cries for help, they immediately ran into the house.

mandarin_meaning: （大聲地）呼喊、呼救或急切呼籲
english_meaning: to cry out loudly; to shout urgently; to call for help or call attention emphatically
explanation_mandarin: 表示用大聲或急切的方式呼喊，常用於呼救、呼籲或喚起注意，語氣較強烈，帶有緊迫感或激動情緒。
explanation_english: Denotes shouting or calling out loudly and urgently, often to beg for help, make an appeal, or attract attention; carries a strong, urgent tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 目擊者見到意外之後，即刻疾呼救命，並通知警方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: muk6 gik1 ze2 gin3 dou2 ji3 ngoi6 zi1 hau6, zik1 hak1 zat6 fu1 gau3 ming6, bing6 tung1 zi1 ging2 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 目击者看到意外后，立即疾呼求救，并通知警方。
examples.english_sentence: The eyewitness, after seeing the accident, immediately cried out for help and notified the police.

mandarin_meaning: 疾病
english_meaning: disease; illness; sickness
explanation_mandarin: 指身體或心理方面的病痛或異常狀況，泛指各種疾病或病症。
explanation_english: Refers to a disease, illness, or medical condition affecting the body or mind; a general term for various medical conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為長期患上疾病，要定期覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 coeng4 kei4 waan6 soeng5 zat6 beng6, jiu3 ding6 kei4 fuk1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為長期患上疾病，要定期複診。
examples.english_sentence: He needs regular follow-up appointments because of a chronic illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 預防疾病最好從改變生活習慣開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 fong4 zat6 beng6 zeoi3 hou2 cung4 goi2 bin3 sang1 wut6 zaap6 gwaan3 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 預防疾病最好從改變生活習慣開始。
examples.english_sentence: Preventing disease is best started by changing lifestyle habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻疫苗可以預防某啲傳染性疾病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 jik6 miu4 ho2 ji5 jyu6 fong4 mau5 di1 cyun4 jim5 sing3 zat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個疫苗可以預防某些傳染性疾病。
examples.english_sentence: This vaccine can prevent certain infectious diseases.

mandarin_meaning: 疾苦（jí kǔ）：痛苦、苦難，常用於書面語
english_meaning: suffering; hardships; afflictions
explanation_mandarin: 指遭受的痛苦和苦難，多用於書面或正式語境，強調長期或嚴重的困苦。
explanation_english: Refers to pain, suffering, or hardships endured; often used in formal or written contexts to emphasize prolonged or severe affliction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生受盡疾苦，仲可以咁開朗，真係令人佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 saang1 sau6 zeon6 zat6 fu2, zung6 ho2 ji5 gam2 hoi1 long5, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 pui3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生受盡疾苦，還能這麼開朗，真令人佩服。
examples.english_sentence: He has endured suffering his whole life, yet can still be so cheerful — truly admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭帶來無窮嘅疾苦，令好多家庭破碎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zeng1 daai3 loi4 mou4 kung4 ge3 zat6 fu2, ling6 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 po3 seot3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争带來了无尽的疾苦，讓許多家庭破碎。
examples.english_sentence: War brings endless suffering, causing many families to be torn apart.

mandarin_meaning: 痱（痱子）；古代亦指疫病、皮膚疹
english_meaning: prickly heat (heat rash); archaic: pestilence or skin eruption
explanation_mandarin: 「疿」為一個較少用的漢字，常用意為痱子（由於暑熱或出汗導致的皮膚疹）。在古籍中亦曾用以指疾病或疫病的總稱。現代口語多以「痱子」或「熱疹」表達。
explanation_english: A rare character typically meaning prickly heat (heat rash), a skin eruption caused by heat and sweating. Historically it was also used to refer more generally to pestilence or illness. In modern speech people usually say "prickly heat" or "heat rash."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天佢細個成日起疿，好痕又唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 keoi5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 hei2 fei3, hou2 han4 jau6 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天他小時候經常長痱子，又癢又不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: When he was a child he often got prickly heat in summer; it was itchy and uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 痂（皮膚受傷後形成的硬皮）
english_meaning: scab; crust on a healing wound
explanation_mandarin: 皮膚受傷或潰爛後在傷口表面形成的乾硬皮層，用以保護傷口並促進癒合，通常會自行脫落。
explanation_english: A hard crust that forms over a healing wound or sore; it protects the wound and aids healing and usually falls off on its own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好摳傷口上嘅痂，畀佢自然脫落就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 kau1 soeng1 hau2 seong6 ge3 gaa1, bei2 keoi5 zi6 jin4 tyut3 lok6 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，别抠伤口上的痂，让它自然脱落就行。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't pick the scab on the wound; let it fall off naturally.

mandarin_meaning: （罕用）皮膚上的疙瘩、痂或膿皰等病變
english_meaning: a rare/archaic term for a skin lesion — scab, pustule, or similar skin bump
explanation_mandarin: 「痄」為較罕見或古代字，常見於醫學或方言語境，用以指皮膚上的疙瘩、痂、膿皰等病變，現代漢語中較少單獨使用，常以「痂」、「疹」等字代替。
explanation_english: 痄 is a rare or archaic character, historically used in medical or regional contexts to denote skin lesions such as scabs, pustules, or bumps. It is seldom used in modern Mandarin on its own; more common words like "scab" or "rash" are usually used instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手臂上有啲痄，可能係皮膚感染，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 bei3 soeng6 jau5 di1 zaa3, ho2 nang4 hai6 pei4 fu1 gam2 jim5, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手臂上有些痄，可能是皮膚感染，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has some zaa (skin lesions) on his arm; it might be a skin infection and he should see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 腮腺炎（流行性腮腺炎）
english_meaning: mumps (parotitis)
explanation_mandarin: 由腮腺炎病毒引起的传染性疾病，主要症状是腮腺肿大、疼痛和发热，常称为腮腺炎或流行性腮腺炎。
explanation_english: An infectious viral disease (parotitis) caused by the mumps virus, characterized by swelling and pain of the parotid (salivary) glands, fever, and other symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬痄腮，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zaap3 soi1, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟得了腮腺炎，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother has mumps; he needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 病；疾病；生病
english_meaning: illness; disease; to be ill/sick
partOfSpeech_english: noun / verb (informally used as an adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體有疾病或不適（名詞），亦可作動詞表示生病或患病；口語中「有病」可作罵人的話或表示行為怪異、不合理。
explanation_english: Refers to an illness or disease (noun); can be used as a verb meaning to be ill. Colloquially, phrases like "have a sickness" (e.g. "有病") are used as insults or to say someone's behavior is unreasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我病咗，要休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 beng6 zo2, jiu3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我病了，需要休息。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sick and need to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係醫生，專門睇病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ji1 sang1, zyun1 mun4 tai2 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是醫生，專門看病。
examples.english_sentence: He is a doctor who treats illnesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日遲到，真係有病定懶？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 jau5 beng6 ding6 laan5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你總是遲到，真是有病還是懶？
examples.english_sentence: You're always late — are you messed up or just lazy?

mandarin_meaning: 病人 (bìngrén)
english_meaning: patient (a person who is ill or receiving medical care)
explanation_mandarin: 指有疾病或需要醫療照顧、接受治療的人。
explanation_english: A person who is sick or receiving medical care; someone under treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話呢位病人要多啲休息，同埋準時食藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 wai6 beng6 jan4 jiu3 do1 di1 jau1 sik1, tung4 maai4 zeon2 si4 sik6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说这位病人要多休息，并按时吃药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said this patient needs more rest and should take their medicine on time.

mandarin_meaning: 病人服／病號服
english_meaning: patient gown; hospital gown
explanation_mandarin: 指病人在醫院穿的專用服裝，通常為方便檢查和治療設計的寬鬆衣物。
explanation_english: Refers to the garment worn by patients in a hospital, typically loose-fitting and designed for ease of examination and treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手術後佢著住病人衫喺病房瞓緊覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 seot6 hau6 keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 beng6 jan4 saam1 hai2 beng6 fong4 fan3 gan2 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手术后他穿着病人服在病房睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: After the surgery, he's wearing a patient gown and sleeping in the ward.

mandarin_meaning: 病例 (bìnglì)：病人的個案或疾病個別案例
english_meaning: medical case; case (of a disease); case record
explanation_mandarin: 指病人或疾病的個案記錄或報告，常用於診斷、統計、追蹤和醫學研究。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual medical case or case record of a disease, used for diagnosis, statistics, contact tracing, and medical research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話今日新增咗一百宗確診病例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 gam1 jat6 san1 zang1 zo2 jat1 baak3 zung1 kok3 zan3 beng6 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說今天新增了一百宗確診病例。
examples.english_sentence: The government said 100 new confirmed cases were added today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗做研究，醫生要收集更多病例資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zou6 jin4 gau3, ji1 sang1 jiu3 sau1 zaap6 geng3 do1 beng6 lai6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了做研究，醫生要收集更多病例資料。
examples.english_sentence: For research, doctors need to collect more case data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份病例記錄得好詳細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 beng6 lai6 gei3 luk6 dak1 hou2 coeng4 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份病例記錄得很詳細。
examples.english_sentence: This case record is very detailed.

mandarin_meaning: 病假（因生病而請的假）
english_meaning: sick leave (leave taken because of illness)
explanation_mandarin: 指因為生病而請假的時間或假期類別，亦常用來表示申請病假或獲准休息的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to time off from work or school taken because of illness; also used to refer to requesting or being granted such leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要請病假，去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 cing2 beng6 gaa3, heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要請病假，去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to take sick leave tomorrow to see the doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求我攞病假紙先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 lo2 beng6 gaa3 zi2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求我拿病假單才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires me to bring a sick note.

mandarin_meaning: 病假证明 / 病假条（医生出具，证明患者需请病假的书面证明）
english_meaning: sick leave note / medical certificate (a doctor's note confirming need for sick leave)
explanation_mandarin: 由醫生出具的書面證明，證明病人需要休息或請病假的文件，常用於向公司或學校請假時提交。
explanation_english: A written certificate issued by a doctor stating that a patient needs rest or sick leave; commonly submitted to employers or schools when requesting sick leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日唔舒服，要請病假，醫生開咗張病假紙畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, jiu3 ceng2 beng6 gaa3, ji1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 zoeng1 beng6 gaa3 zi2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不舒服，要请病假，医生给我开了张病假证明。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not feeling well today and need to take sick leave; the doctor gave me a sick note.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要睇埋張病假紙先肯批長期病假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 tai2 maai4 zoeng1 beng6 gaa3 zi2 sin1 hang2 pai1 coeng4 kei4 beng6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要看病假证明才肯批准长期病假。
examples.english_sentence: The company will only approve long-term sick leave after seeing the medical certificate.

mandarin_meaning: 病情嚴重到無法醫治；比喻情勢已到無可挽回的程度（拼音：bìng rù gāo huāng）
english_meaning: Literally 'the illness has entered the vital organs' — an incurable condition; used metaphorically to describe a situation beyond remedy or hopeless
explanation_mandarin: 原指疾病深入胸膈中的膏肓部位而無法治癒，後來用來形容事情或情況嚴重到無法挽回、無可救藥。
explanation_english: Originally described an illness that had penetrated the vital organ (gao huang) and was incurable; now used figuratively to describe a situation that is severe and beyond remedy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經病入膏肓，醫生都冇辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 beng6 jap6 gou1 wong1, ji1 sang1 dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經病入膏肓，醫生也無能為力。
examples.english_sentence: His illness has already reached an incurable stage; even the doctors are powerless.

jyutping: beng6 dou3 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1
mandarin_meaning: 病得很嚴重，面容色澤異常或看起來非常虛弱
english_meaning: extremely ill; looking very sick or in very poor health
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，形容一個人生病得很厲害，面色、精神都很差，外表看起來很虛弱或異常。
explanation_english: A colloquial idiom describing someone who is very ill — their complexion and energy look abnormal or weak, indicating serious sickness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病到五顏六色，上個星期都冇返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dou3 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1, soeng6 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 mou5 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病得五顏六色，上星期都沒去上學。
examples.english_sentence: He's extremely ill and didn't attend school last week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁樣，真係覺得已經病到五顏六色，應該快啲睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 keoi5 gam2 joeng6, zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 ji5 ging1 beng6 dou3 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1, jing1 goi1 faai3 di1 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他這樣，真的覺得已經病得五顏六色，應該趕快看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him like that, he really looks very ill — he should see a doctor quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 病危（bìngwēi）：病情極為嚴重，生命垂危
english_meaning: critically ill; in critical condition; life-threatening
explanation_mandarin: 指病人病情非常嚴重，生命有即時危險，可能隨時發生危及生命的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates a patient is in a very severe medical state with an immediate threat to life; the condition is critical and may result in death without urgent care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢而家病危，要即刻入深切治療部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ji4 gaa1 beng6 ngai4, jiu3 zik1 hak1 jap6 sam1 cit3 zi6 liu4 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他现在病危，需要立刻送进加护病房。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he's in critical condition and needs to be taken to the intensive care unit immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 病原体；引起疾病的微生物或病原因子
english_meaning: pathogen; an organism or agent that causes disease
explanation_mandarin: 指能夠引發疾病的微生物或病原因子，例如細菌、病毒、真菌或寄生蟲等。
explanation_english: Refers to microorganisms or agents that can cause disease, such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話呢種病係由未知嘅病原體引起嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 zung2 beng6 hai6 jau4 mei6 zi1 ge3 beng6 jyun4 tai2 jan5 hei2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说这种病是由未知的病原体引起的。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said this disease is caused by an unknown pathogen.

mandarin_meaning: 病友（與自己患同一病或病情相似的患者）
english_meaning: fellow patient; fellow sufferer (someone who has the same illness or similar condition)
explanation_mandarin: 指在醫療環境中與自己患同一疾病或相似病況，能互相支持、交流經驗的患者。
explanation_english: Refers to patients who share the same disease or similar condition, often encountered in medical settings and who can support each other and share experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺醫院識咗幾個病友，大家互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji1 jyun2 sik1 zo2 gei2 go3 beng6 jau5, daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在醫院認識了幾位病友，大家互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: He met several fellow patients at the hospital; everyone supports each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病友組織會定期開會分享治療經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 jau5 zou2 zik1 wui5 ding6 kei4 hoi1 wui2 fan1 hoeng2 zi6 liu4 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病友組織會定期開會分享治療經驗。
examples.english_sentence: The patient support group holds regular meetings to share treatment experiences.

mandarin_meaning: 病史
english_meaning: medical history
explanation_mandarin: 指病人過去與現在的疾病記錄，包括既往病史、家族病史、手術史、用藥紀錄等，常用於醫療場合以評估病情和治療計劃。
explanation_english: Refers to a patient's record of past and current illnesses, including past medical history, family history, surgical history, and medications. Commonly used in medical settings to assess condition and plan treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生會問你嘅病史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 wui5 man6 nei5 ge3 beng6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生会问你的病史。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor will ask about your medical history.

mandarin_meaning: 把病交給庸醫；比喻把重要或複雜的事交給能力不足的人處理，結果只會更糟
english_meaning: To entrust an illness (or a problem) to an incompetent/unsuitable doctor; metaphorically, to give an important or complex task to someone unqualified, making things worse
explanation_mandarin: 原本字面意思是把病交給醫術淺薄的醫生去看，現用作比喻：把重要或棘手的問題交給能力不足或不稱職的人處理，通常會導致更糟的結果。
explanation_english: Literally 'the illness goes to a shallow (inexperienced) doctor.' Used figuratively to describe giving an important or difficult matter to someone unqualified or incompetent, which typically makes the situation worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁嚴重嘅問題交畀佢處理，真係病向淺中醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 jim4 zung6 ge3 man6 tai4 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 cyu2 lei5, zan1 hai6 beng6 hoeng3 cin2 zung1 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把這麼嚴重的問題交給他處理，等於把病交給庸醫。
examples.english_sentence: Entrusting such a serious problem to him is like handing an illness to an incompetent doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 病弱的君主；體弱或生病的國君（偏文言或書面用法）
english_meaning: a sick or infirm monarch; an ill ruler (literary/archaic usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「病君」字面上指病弱或生病的君主，屬較書面或古語用法。在廣東話口語中不常見，有時會被誤寫或誤讀為「病菌」。
explanation_english: Literally 'sick ruler' — refers to an infirm or ill monarch. This is a literary/archaic term and is not common in everyday Cantonese; it is sometimes confused with the homophone '病菌' (germ).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小說入面描寫咗一個病君，朝政都畀太監把持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 seot3 jap6 min6 miu4 se2 zo2 jat1 go3 beng6 gwan1, ciu4 zing3 dou1 bei2 taai3 gon1 baa2 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小说里描写了一个病弱的君主，朝政都被太监把持。
examples.english_sentence: The novel depicts an infirm ruler whose court affairs are controlled by eunuchs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人打錯字寫成「病君」，其實想講「病菌」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 daa2 co3 zi6 se2 sing4 "beng6 gwan1", kei4 sat6 soeng2 gong2 "beng6 kwan2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人打错字写成“病君”，其实想说“病菌”。
examples.english_sentence: Someone mistyped '病君' when they meant '病菌' (germ).

mandarin_meaning: 病因
english_meaning: cause of a disease; etiology
explanation_mandarin: 指出导致疾病发生的原因，可能包括病原体、环境因素、遗传、生活习惯等。
explanation_english: Refers to the cause that leads to a disease, which can include pathogens, environmental factors, genetics, lifestyle, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話未搵到病因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 mei6 wan2 dou3 beng6 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说还没找到病因。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said they haven't found the cause of the illness yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要做多啲檢查先至可以確定病因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zou6 do1 di1 gim2 caa4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 kok3 ding6 beng6 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 需要做更多检查才能确定病因。
examples.english_sentence: More tests are needed to determine the cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時候病因係環境因素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 hau6 beng6 jan1 hai6 waan4 ging2 jan1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时病因是环境因素。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes the cause is environmental factors.

mandarin_meaning: 病得很厉害；病重
english_meaning: very ill; gravely/seriously ill
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示病得很严重或病情恶化，常用来描述病人狀況很糟或提醒不要拖延就医。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to be very seriously ill or gravely sick. Used to describe severe illness or to warn against delaying medical attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢昨日開始發燒，依家病壞咗，要返醫院觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok6 jat6 hoi1 ci2 faat3 siu1, ji4 gaa1 beng6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 faan1 ji1 jyun2 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天开始发烧，現在病得很厉害，要回医院观察。
examples.english_sentence: He started having a fever yesterday and is now seriously ill; he needs to go back to the hospital for observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好等到病壞先去睇醫生，早啲處理會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dang2 dou3 beng6 waai6 sin1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1, zou2 di1 cyu2 lei5 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要等到病得很厉害才去看医生，早点处理会好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wait until you're seriously ill to see a doctor; it's better to deal with it earlier.

mandarin_meaning: （病情）好转；痊愈
english_meaning: to recover from an illness; to get better
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示病情改善或已痊愈。常見用法如「病好咗」表示已經康復。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning that an illness has improved or someone has recovered. Often used in phrases like '病好咗' (has recovered).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你病好咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 beng6 hou2 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你病好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you recovered?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病好咗，可以返工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 hou2 zo2, ho2 ji5 faan1 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病好了，可以回去上班了。
examples.english_sentence: He's recovered and can go back to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你仲未病好，就唔好出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zung6 mei6 beng6 hou2, zau6 m4 hou2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你還沒好，就不要出門。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not yet recovered, don't go out.

mandarin_meaning: 有病；行為怪異或精神不正常（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: Cantonese slang meaning 'crazy' or 'mentally unwell'; used to say someone is acting weird (derogatory, colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「病字邊」是廣東話俚語，字面上可理解為「有病的一邊」，用來形容一個人言行怪異、精神有問題或很瘋狂，常用作罵人或表達不滿的說法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'the sick side.' It describes someone behaving oddly, as if mentally unwell or crazy. It is colloquial and often derogatory or used as an insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你病字邊呀？唔好咁講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 beng6 zi6 bin1 aa3? m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有病嗎？別這麼說了。
examples.english_sentence: Are you crazy? Don't say that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲奇怪嘢，真係病字邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 kei4 gwaai3 je5, zan1 hai6 beng6 zi6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說些奇怪的話，真是有病。
examples.english_sentence: He always says weird stuff — he's really a bit crazy.

mandarin_meaning: 病容（面容顯得虛弱或生病）
english_meaning: sickly appearance; the looks of someone who appears ill or unwell
explanation_mandarin: 指因為生病、虛弱或疲倦而在臉上或神情上顯現出來的病態樣子或氣色不好，看起來沒有精神。
explanation_english: Refers to a facial expression or complexion that shows illness, weakness, or fatigue — a sickly or unwell appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢排冇精神，成日露出病容，應該要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 paai4 mou5 zing1 san4, sing4 jat6 lou6 ceot1 beng6 jung4, jing1 goi1 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近沒精神，經常露出病容，應該去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't looked well lately, often showing a sickly appearance; he should see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 病床；病人臥床的地方
english_meaning: sickbed; hospital bed; the bed where a sick person lies
explanation_mandarin: 指病人躺或住的床，常用於醫院或臥病在家的情況；也可泛指臥病的狀態（臥病在床）。
explanation_english: Refers to the bed where a sick person lies (e.g., a hospital bed); can also refer to the state of being confined to bed by illness (sickbed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，依家瞓喺病床度休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, ji4gaa1 fan3 hai2 beng6 cong4 dou6 jau1sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，現在躺在病床上休息。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick and is resting in bed now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要留喺病床觀察幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1sang1 waa6 jiu3 lau4 hai2 beng6 cong4 gun1cat1 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說要留在病床上觀察幾天。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs to remain in bed for a few days for observation.

mandarin_meaning: 病床（bìngchuáng）
english_meaning: sickbed; hospital bed; a bed where a patient lies (also can mean being bedridden)
explanation_mandarin: 指供病人在醫院或家中臥床休養的床，也可泛指病人長期臥床的狀態（如臥病在床）。
explanation_english: Refers to the bed used by a patient in hospital or at home for recuperation; can also refer to the state of being bedridden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢要留喺病床度休養多幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 lau4 hai2 beng6 cong4 dou6 jau1 joeng5 do1 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他要留在病床上休養多幾天。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he must stay in bed to recuperate for a few more days.

mandarin_meaning: 病從口入
english_meaning: Illness enters through the mouth; many illnesses are caused by what one eats or drinks (a proverb advising caution about food and hygiene; can also imply be careful what you say/eat).
explanation_mandarin: 表示很多疾病是由吃進嘴裡的東西或不注意飲食衛生引起，也可引申為因飲食或言語不慎而招致麻煩。
explanation_english: A proverb warning that many illnesses are caused by what one eats or drinks, so one should be careful about food and hygiene; can also be extended metaphorically to caution against careless words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近唔舒服，醫生話可能病從口入，要注意飲食衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 m4 syu1 fuk6, ji1 sang1 waa6 ho2 nang4 beng6 cung4 hau2 jap6, jiu3 zyu3 ji3 jam2 sik6 wai6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近不舒服，醫生說可能是病從口入，要注意飲食衛生。
examples.english_sentence: He's been unwell recently; the doctor said it might be due to something he ate, so he should pay attention to food hygiene.

synonyms: 病從口入，禍從口出（相關諺語）

mandarin_meaning: （疾病的）徵狀、症狀
english_meaning: symptom; sign of an illness
explanation_mandarin: 指疾病或身體不適所表現出的徵象或症狀，用於描述身體異常的表現。
explanation_english: Refers to signs or indications of an illness or physical condition; used to describe manifestations of health problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出現一啲病徵，應該去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 jin6 jat1 di1 beng6 zing1, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出現了一些病徵，應該去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has developed some symptoms and should see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發燒同喉嚨痛都係常見嘅病徵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 siu1 tung4 hau4 lung4 tung3 dou1 hai6 soeng4 gin3 ge3 beng6 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 發燒和喉嚨痛都是常見的病徵。
examples.english_sentence: Fever and sore throat are common symptoms.

mandarin_meaning: 生病的人；疾病本身（可指病人或病情）
english_meaning: patient (a sick person); illness/disease
explanation_mandarin: 可指罹患疾病的人（病人），也可指疾病本身；詞義偏正式，多見於醫療或書面語境。
explanation_english: Refers to a person suffering from an illness (a patient) or, less commonly, the illness itself; a more formal/medical term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院入面有好多病患需要照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 beng6 waan6 seoi1 jiu3 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院有很多病患需要照顧。
examples.english_sentence: There are many patients in the hospital who need care.

mandarin_meaning: 病情 (bìngqíng)
english_meaning: medical condition; the state or course of an illness
explanation_mandarin: 指疾病的情況，包括嚴重程度、發展或變化等醫療上相關的狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of an illness, including severity, progression, or changes in a patient's medical condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢嘅病情已經穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ge3 beng6 cing4 ji5 ging1 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的病情已经稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his condition is now stable.

mandarin_meaning: 病態 / 病理狀態；指心理或行為異常（也可指變態、扭曲）
english_meaning: pathological state; morbid/abnormal; can describe unhealthy or perverse psychological states or behaviors
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述某種不正常或病理性的狀態，常用於形容心理或行為上的異常、扭曲或變態傾向。
explanation_english: Used to describe an abnormal or pathological condition. Often applied to unhealthy, morbid, or perverse psychological states or behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲行為好病態，成日跟蹤人哋，真係令人害怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 hang4 wai4 hou2 beng6 taai3, sing4 jat6 gan1 zung1 jan4 dei6, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 hoi6 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行為很病態，總是跟蹤別人，真讓人害怕。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is very pathological; he constantly stalks others. It's really frightening.

mandarin_meaning: 病态赌徒
english_meaning: pathological gambler; compulsive gambler
explanation_mandarin: 指對賭博行為無法自制、具有病理性賭博成癮的人，往往不顧個人和家庭的經濟與生活後果。
explanation_english: A person who cannot control their gambling behavior and has a pathological (addictive) gambling problem, often disregarding personal and family financial and life consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借錢去賭，已經係病態賭徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ze3 cin2 heoi3 dou2, ji5 ging1 hai6 beng6 taai3 dou2 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常借钱去赌，已经是病态赌徒。
examples.english_sentence: He often borrows money to gamble; he's become a pathological gambler.

mandarin_meaning: 病房
english_meaning: hospital ward; a hospital room or ward where patients stay
explanation_mandarin: 醫院內用來收治或安置病人的房間或專門區域，可能是普通病房或加護病房等。
explanation_english: A room or area in a hospital where patients are accommodated and treated; can refer to general wards or specialized wards (e.g., ICU).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺醫院入面嘅病房休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 ji1 jyun2 jap6 min6 ge3 beng6 fong4 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在醫院的病房休息。
examples.english_sentence: He is now resting in the hospital ward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要將佢轉去加護病房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jiu3 zoeng1 keoi5 zyun2 heoi3 gaa1 wu6 beng6 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生要把他轉去加護病房。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor needs to transfer him to the intensive care unit (ICU).

mandarin_meaning: 病床；卧病的床榻
english_meaning: sickbed; the bed on which an ill person lies
explanation_mandarin: 指病人臥病時所躺的床榻，多用於書面或正式語境，與「病床」「臥床」類似。
explanation_english: Refers to the bed where a sick person lies. A more literary/formal term similar to 'sickbed' or 'bedridden'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗之後成日留喺病榻上，冇乜力氣起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6 sing4 jat6 lau4 hai2 beng6 taap3 soeng5, mou5 mat1 lik6 hei3 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病後經常臥在病榻上，沒什麼力氣起來。
examples.english_sentence: After falling ill, he often stayed in his sickbed and had little strength to get up.

mandarin_meaning: 病历
english_meaning: medical record; patient file
explanation_mandarin: 病人的醫療記錄，包含病史、檢查、診斷與治療等相關資訊與記載。
explanation_english: A patient's medical record containing history, examinations, diagnoses, treatments, and related documentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生要先睇你嘅病歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jiu3 sin1 tai2 nei5 ge3 beng6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生要先看你的病歷。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor needs to look at your medical record first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就醫時記得帶埋以前嘅病歷嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 ji1 si4 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 ji5 cin4 ge3 beng6 lik6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就醫時記得把以前的病歷帶來。
examples.english_sentence: When you visit the doctor, remember to bring your previous medical records.

mandarin_meaning: 病历卡
english_meaning: medical record card / patient record card
explanation_mandarin: 病歷卡是醫院或診所用來記錄病人基本資料與就診紀錄的卡片，通常用於掛號、查閱過往病史與識別病人。
explanation_english: A card used by hospitals or clinics to record a patient's basic information and visit history; commonly used for registration, retrieving past medical records, and patient identification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去醫院記得帶埋你嘅病歷卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 ji1 jyun2 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 nei5 ge3 beng6 lik6 kaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去醫院記得把你的病歷卡帶上。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your medical record card when you go to the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次睇門診要填病歷卡，請詳細填寫你過去嘅病史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 tai2 mun4 zan3 jiu3 tin4 beng6 lik6 kaa1, ceng2 coeng4 sai3 tin4 se2 nei5 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 beng6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次看門診需要填寫病歷卡，請詳細填寫你過去的病史。
examples.english_sentence: For first-time visits you need to fill out a medical record card; please provide detailed past medical history.

mandarin_meaning: 病历卡
english_meaning: medical record card; patient card
explanation_mandarin: 醫院或診所用來記錄病人個人資料和就診紀錄的一張卡片，方便查閱和登記就診歷史。
explanation_english: A card used by hospitals or clinics to record a patient's personal information and visit history; used for registration and medical records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去醫院記住帶埋你嘅病歷咭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 ji1 jyun2 gei3 zyu6 daai3 maai4 nei5 ge3 beng6 lik6 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去医院记得带上你的病历卡。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your medical record card when you go to the hospital.

mandarin_meaning: 病毒 (bìngdú)
english_meaning: virus
explanation_mandarin: 指能引起疾病的微生物（如病毒），也可指電腦中會自我複製並破壞系統的惡意程式。
explanation_english: Refers to biological agents that cause disease (viruses); can also refer to malicious software that replicates itself and damages computer systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話你感染咗病毒，要休息同埋食藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 nei5 gam2 jim6 zo2 beng6 duk6, jiu3 jau1 sik1 tung4 maai4 sik6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说你感染了病毒，要休息并吃药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you caught a virus; you should rest and take medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦感染咗病毒，啲文件唔見晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 gam2 jim6 zo2 beng6 duk6, di1 man4 gin6 m4 gin3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电脑感染了病毒，文件都不见了。
examples.english_sentence: My computer got a virus and the files disappeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要預防病毒傳播，要經常洗手同戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 jyu6 fong4 beng6 duk6 cyun4 bo3, jiu3 ging1 soeng4 sai2 sau2 tung4 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要预防病毒传播，要经常洗手和戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: To prevent virus transmission, you should wash your hands frequently and wear a mask.

mandarin_meaning: 病灶（病变处、病变部位）
english_meaning: lesion; focus/site of disease; figuratively, the root or focal point of a problem
explanation_mandarin: 在医学上指病变或病灶，即疾病发生或存在的部位；也可引申为社会、组织或系统中的病根或问题根源。
explanation_english: In medicine, refers to a lesion or the focus/site of disease; figuratively, used for the root or focal point of a social, organizational, or systemic problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生喺X光入面發現咗一個病灶，要做活檢先確定係良性定惡性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 hai6 X gwong1 jap6 min6 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 beng6 zou6, jiu3 zou6 wut6 gim2 sin1 kok3 ding6 hai6 loeng4 sing3 ding6 ok3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生在X光片上发现了一个病灶，要做活检才能确定是良性还是恶性。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor found a lesion on the X-ray; a biopsy is needed to determine whether it's benign or malignant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污係一個社會嘅病灶，如果唔徹底整頓，好多問題會繼續擴大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taan1 wu1 hai6 jat1 go3 se5 wui6 ge3 beng6 zou6, jyu4 gwo2 m4 cit3 dai2 zing2 dun6, hou2 do1 man6 tai4 wui5 gai3 zuk6 kwaa3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污是社会的一个病灶，如果不彻底整顿，很多问题会继续扩大。
examples.english_sentence: Corruption is a social malady; if not thoroughly addressed, many problems will continue to grow.

mandarin_meaning: 病床
english_meaning: sickbed; bed for a sick person; being bedridden
explanation_mandarin: 指病人躺臥或安置病人的床位，也可引申為病臥的狀態或處境。
explanation_english: Refers to the bed where a sick person lies; can also be used figuratively to describe the state of being bedridden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢要喺病牀上休息幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 hai2 beng6 cong4 soeng6 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他要在病床上休息幾天。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs to rest in bed for a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯成日喺病牀度喊，大家都好心痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 seng4 jat6 hai2 beng6 cong4 dou6 haam3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 sam1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯父總是在病床上哭，大家都很心痛。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather is always crying on his sickbed; everyone feels heartbroken.

mandarin_meaning: 病症；疾病或症狀
english_meaning: illness; disease; medical condition; symptom
explanation_mandarin: 指身體或心理上的疾病、病情或具體的症狀，可泛指各種病-related狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to an illness, disease, medical condition, or specific symptoms; a general term for health-related problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近有啲奇怪嘅病症，應該去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 di1 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 beng6 zing3, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近有些奇怪的病症，應該去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has recently had some strange medical symptoms; he should see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲長期嘅病症需要長期治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 coeng4 kei4 ge3 beng6 zing3 seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 kei4 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些長期的病症需要長期治療。
examples.english_sentence: These chronic conditions require long-term treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 疾病；身體上的疼痛或病症
english_meaning: illness; ailment; physical pain or sickness
explanation_mandarin: 指身體上的病症或疼痛，既可指疾病本身，也可指由疾病引起的痛楚。
explanation_english: Refers to illnesses or physical pains — can denote the disease itself or the pain caused by it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近身體有啲病痛，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 san1 tai2 jau5 di1 beng6 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近身体有些病痛，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He has been having some ailments recently and needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年紀大咗，免不了會有啲病痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 gei3 daai6 zo2, min5 bat1 liu4 wui5 jau5 di1 beng6 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年纪大了，免不了会有些病痛。
examples.english_sentence: As people get older, it's inevitable to have some illnesses or pains.

mandarin_meaning: 病童（生病的兒童）
english_meaning: sick child; ill child
explanation_mandarin: 指生病的兒童，通常指需要治療或住院觀察的孩子。
explanation_english: Refers to a child who is ill, typically one who requires medical treatment or hospitalization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院已經收咗好幾個病童。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 ji5 ging1 sau1 zo2 hou2 gei2 go3 beng6 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院已经收了好几个病童。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital has already admitted several sick children.

mandarin_meaning: 病菌（病原微生物，如細菌、病毒等）
english_meaning: germ; pathogen; bacteria (organisms that cause disease)
explanation_mandarin: 指能引起疾病的微生物，常用來泛指細菌或其他病原體。
explanation_english: Refers to microorganisms that cause disease; commonly used to refer to bacteria or other pathogens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個房間有病菌，要用消毒劑清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 fong4 gaan1 jau5 beng6 kwan4, jiu3 jung6 siu1 duk6 zai1 cing1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間有病菌，要用消毒劑清潔。
examples.english_sentence: There are germs in the room; you should disinfect it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路喺學校攞到病菌，可能會傳染屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 hai2 hok6 haau6 lo2 dou3 beng6 kwan4, ho2 nang4 wui5 cyun4 jim5 uk1 kei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子在學校帶回病菌，可能會傳染家人。
examples.english_sentence: Children can bring germs home from school and may infect family members.

mandarin_meaning: 病变（指组织或器官因疾病或病理过程发生的改变）
english_meaning: pathological change; lesion; abnormal change in tissue or organ due to disease
explanation_mandarin: 指由疾病或病理過程引起的組織、器官結構或功能的改變，常用於醫學中描述病灶或病理改變。
explanation_english: Refers to changes in tissues or organs caused by disease or pathological processes; commonly used in medicine to describe lesions or pathological alterations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話喺掃描度見到病變，要做進一步嘅檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 hai2 sou3 miu4 dou6 gin3 dou3 beng6 bin3, jiu3 zou6 zeon3 jat1 bou6 ge3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说在扫描中看到病变，需要做进一步的检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the scan showed a lesion, and further tests are needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔及時處理，良性病變都有機會惡化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gap3 si4 cyu3 lei5, loeng4 sing3 beng6 bin3 dou1 jau5 gei1 wui6 ok3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不及时处理，良性病变也有可能恶化。
examples.english_sentence: If not treated promptly, even benign lesions can worsen.

mandarin_meaning: 病貓（字面：生病的貓；引申：體弱多病或膽小、怯懦的人）
english_meaning: sick cat (literal); colloquially: a sickly person or a coward/pathetic person
explanation_mandarin: 「病貓」原指生病的貓，廣東話口語中常用來形容體弱多病的人或用作貶低別人，指其軟弱、膽小或可憐。
explanation_english: Literally 'sick cat.' In Cantonese slang it can describe someone who is physically weak or sickly, and it is also used pejoratively to call someone cowardly, weak, or pathetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做病貓，遇到困難要勇敢面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 beng6 maau1, jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan4 jiu3 jung5 gam2 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要當個病貓，遇到困難要勇敢面對。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a coward; face difficulties bravely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日生病，依家仲係個病貓，體質好虛弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 saang1 beng6, ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 go3 beng6 maau1, tai2 zat1 hou2 heoi1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候經常生病，現在還是個病貓，體質很虛弱。
examples.english_sentence: He was often sick as a child and is still a sickly person with a weak constitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到危險嗰陣佢驚到冇晒膽，真係個病貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 ngai4 him2 go2 zan6 keoi5 geng1 dou3 mou5 saat3 daam2, zan1 hai6 go3 beng6 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到危險時他嚇得沒了膽，真是個病貓。
examples.english_sentence: When faced with danger he lost his nerve — truly a coward.

mandarin_meaning: 因病去世 / 病故
english_meaning: to die of an illness; to pass away due to illness
explanation_mandarin: 表示因病去世，常用于较正式或书面语境。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone has died from an illness; a relatively formal or written expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上個月病逝，家人好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 beng6 sai3, gaa1 jan4 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上个月因病去世，家人非常伤心。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away from illness last month; his family is very sad.

mandarin_meaning: 病情严重；危重
english_meaning: seriously ill; critically ill
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容病情很嚴重，可能危及生命或需要緊急醫療處理的狀況。
explanation_english: Describes an illness that is severe and possibly life‑threatening, often requiring urgent medical care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病重，家人好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zung6, gaa1 jan4 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病重，家人很担心。
examples.english_sentence: He is seriously ill; his family is very worried.

mandarin_meaning: 医院
english_meaning: hospital
explanation_mandarin: 指提供診療、治療和護理服務的醫療機構，與「醫院」同義，廣東話口語或書面均可見。
explanation_english: Refers to a medical institution that provides diagnosis, treatment, and nursing care; synonymous with 'hospital'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要去病院睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 beng6 jyun2 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要去医院看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the hospital tonight to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 病魔（bìngmó）
english_meaning: disease; serious illness; the scourge of illness (often used metaphorically as 'the demon of disease')
explanation_mandarin: 指可怕或難治的疾病，常用來形容折磨人的重大疾病（如癌症），也可比喻難以擺脫的惡習或困境。
explanation_english: Refers to a dreadful or hard-to-cure disease; often used to describe serious illnesses (e.g., cancer). Can also be used metaphorically to describe an affliction or scourge that besets someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀病魔折磨咗好多年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 beng6 mo1 zit3 mo4 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被病魔折磨了很多年。
examples.english_sentence: He has been tormented by illness for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢同病魔搏鬥，仲有機會康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 tung4 beng6 mo1 bok3 dau3, zung6 jau5 gei1 wui6 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他在与病魔搏斗，還有机会康复。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he is fighting the illness and still has a chance to recover.

mandarin_meaning: 症（zhèng）—— 表示病症、疾病或综合征，常用作疾病名稱的後綴，如強迫症、焦慮症。
english_meaning: zing (syndrome/illness) — denotes a disease, disorder, or syndrome; commonly used as a suffix in medical terms (e.g. -syndrome, -itis).
explanation_mandarin: 「症」用來表示某種病理狀態或症狀，常見於疾病名稱的結尾，表示一類病狀或綜合征。
explanation_english: “症” indicates a medical condition, disorder, or symptom. It is frequently used as the ending of disease names to denote a syndrome or pathological state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有強迫症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 koeng4 bik1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她有强迫症。
examples.english_sentence: He/she has obsessive-compulsive disorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有暈車症，一坐車就頭暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 wan4 ce1 zing3, jat1 co5 ce1 zau6 tau4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有晕车症，一坐车就头晕。
examples.english_sentence: I have motion sickness; as soon as I get in a vehicle I feel dizzy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲「選擇困難症」只係口語講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 "syun2 zaak6 kwan3 naan4 zing3" zi2 hai6 hau2 jyu5 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些「选择困难症」只是口语说法。
examples.english_sentence: These so-called 'choice paralysis' are just colloquial expressions.

mandarin_meaning: 症候群（医学术语，指一组相关症状或体征的集合，类似“综合征/综合症”）
english_meaning: Syndrome — a group of related symptoms and signs that occur together and characterize a particular condition.
explanation_mandarin: 指由多种相关症状或体征组成、具有共同特征的临床综合表现，常用于医学命名（如某些遗传或代谢性疾病的症候群）。
explanation_english: A clinical term for a set of associated symptoms and signs that together indicate a particular medical condition; commonly used in medical contexts to name disorders with characteristic symptom patterns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有一種罕見嘅症候羣，仲要做多啲檢查確認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 jat1 zung2 hon2 gin3 ge3 zing3 hau6 kwan4, zung6 jiu3 zou6 do1 di1 gim2 caa4 kok3 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他/她患有一种罕见的症候群，还需要做更多检查确认。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he/she has a rare syndrome and needs further tests to confirm it.

mandarin_meaning: 症候群（綜合症），指一組相關的症狀或體徵共同出現，通常由共同原因或病理機制所致，用於醫學上描述一類病理表現的集合。
english_meaning: Syndrome — a group of signs and symptoms that occur together and characterize a particular abnormality or condition.
explanation_mandarin: 在醫學上用來描述一組常同時出現、有共同特徵的症狀或體徵，可能由同一病因或相關機制引起，並不一定指出單一確切原因。
explanation_english: In medicine, a syndrome refers to a set of signs and symptoms that commonly occur together and characterize a condition; it denotes a pattern of features rather than necessarily a single specific cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個症候群會令病人感到肌肉無力同疲倦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 hau6 kwan4 wui5 ling6 beng6 jan4 gam2 dou3 gei1 juk6 mou4 lik6 tung4 pei4 gyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個症候群會使病人感到肌肉無力和疲倦。
examples.english_sentence: This syndrome causes patients to experience muscle weakness and fatigue.

mandarin_meaning: 症状 (zhèngzhuàng)
english_meaning: symptom; clinical manifestation
explanation_mandarin: 指疾病或身體狀況所表現出來的異常現象或感覺，例如疼痛、發燒、咳嗽等，用於辨識或診斷疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to an abnormal sign or sensation indicating a disease or health condition (e.g., pain, fever, cough); used to identify or help diagnose illnesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有發燒同頭痛嘅症狀，應該去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 faat3 siu1 tung4 tau4 tung3 ge3 zing3 zong6, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有发烧和头痛的症状，应该去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He has symptoms of fever and headache; he should see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話呢啲症狀可能係藥物副作用嘅表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 ho2 nang4 hai6 joek6 mat6 fuk6 zok3 jung6 ge3 biu2 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说这些症状可能是药物副作用的表现。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said these symptoms may be manifestations of drug side effects.

mandarin_meaning: 痊癒；康復
english_meaning: to heal; to recover (from illness or a wound)
explanation_mandarin: 表示傷口或疾病恢復、痊癒，常見於『痊癒／痊愈』等詞語中。
explanation_english: Indicates that a wound or illness has healed or recovered; often appears in compounds like '痊癒' (to recover).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲傷已經痊咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 soeng1 ji5 ging1 cyun4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的傷已經痊癒了。
examples.english_sentence: His wounds have already healed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅病終於痊愈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 beng6 zung1 jyu1 cyun4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的病終於痊癒了。
examples.english_sentence: His illness has finally recovered.

mandarin_meaning: 痊愈 (quányù)，康复
english_meaning: to recover; to heal; to be cured
explanation_mandarin: 指疾病、傷口或心理創傷等完全恢復，不再有病症或痛楚，也可指逐漸康復的過程。
explanation_english: Refers to the complete recovery or healing of an illness, wound, or psychological trauma; indicates no longer being symptomatic or gradually returning to health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做完手術之後，傷口終於痊癒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6, soeng1 hau2 zung1 jyu1 cyun4 jyu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做完手術之後，傷口終於痊愈了。
examples.english_sentence: After his surgery, the wound finally healed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲病人經過長期治療，慢慢都痊癒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 beng6 jan4 ging1 gwo3 coeng4 kei4 zi6 liu4, maan6 maan6 dou1 cyun4 jyu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些病人經過長期治療，慢慢都痊愈了。
examples.english_sentence: The patients gradually recovered after long-term treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 心理上的創傷要時間先可以痊癒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 lei5 soeng6 dik1 cong1 soeng1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 sin1 ho2 ji5 cyun4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 心理上的創傷需要時間才能痊愈。
examples.english_sentence: Psychological wounds need time to heal.

mandarin_meaning: 伤痕、创伤；残存的破坏（常见于词语“残痍”“瘡痍”“滿目瘡痍”）
english_meaning: wound; injury; scar; devastation (often appears in compounds like '殘痍' or '滿目瘡痍')
explanation_mandarin: “痍”本义指伤口或伤痕，引申为残余的破坏或创伤。常见于复合词中如“殘痍”、“滿目瘡痍”，表示被破坏或受创后的痕迹。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a wound or scar; by extension it denotes remnants of damage or devastation. Frequently appears in compounds such as '殘痍' or '滿目瘡痍' to describe visible destruction or injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰後嗰度滿目瘡痍，真係令人心酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 hau6 go2 dou6 mun5 muk6 cong1 ji1, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sam1 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戰後那裡滿目瘡痍，真是令人心酸。
examples.english_sentence: The place was devastated after the war; it's truly heartbreaking.

mandarin_meaning: 痔（痔瘡）
english_meaning: hemorrhoid; piles
explanation_mandarin: 指肛門周圍的靜脈叢因充血或腫大而引起的病變，常表現為疼痛、出血或瘙癢，俗稱痔瘡。
explanation_english: Refers to swollen or inflamed veins around the anus (hemorrhoids), commonly causing pain, bleeding, or itching; also called piles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有痔，成日痕又痛，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zi6, sing4 jat6 han4 jau6 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有痔瘡，整天又癢又痛，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has hemorrhoids; they itch and hurt all the time, so he needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 痔瘡（痔核）
english_meaning: hemorrhoids; piles
explanation_mandarin: 肛門或直腸下端的靜脈叢擴張或發炎，形成腫塊、疼痛或出血的病症，俗稱痔核或痔瘡。
explanation_english: A medical condition in which veins around the anus or lower rectum become swollen or inflamed, causing lumps, pain, or bleeding; commonly known as hemorrhoids or piles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我有痔瘡，要食藥同埋做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 zi6 cong1, jiu3 sik6 joek6 tung4 maai4 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我有痔疮，要吃药并做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I have hemorrhoids and I need medication and surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 痒 / 发痒
english_meaning: itch; itchy; to itch; (colloquial) an urge/impulse
explanation_mandarin: 表示皮膚感到發癢，需要搔抓；口語中也可引申為一種衝動或渴望（如「手痕」表示忍不住想做某事或愛捉弄別人）。
explanation_english: Denotes physical itchiness of the skin, requiring scratching; colloquially it can be extended to mean an urge or impulse (e.g., '手痕' - can't resist doing something / meddling).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好痕，我要搔一搔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 han4, ngo5 jiu3 sou1 jat1 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里很痒，我要抓一下。
examples.english_sentence: This spot is very itchy; I need to scratch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手痕，好鍾意整蠱人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 han4, hou2 zung1 ji3 zing2 gu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手痒，很喜欢整蛊别人。
examples.english_sentence: He's 'itchy-handed' (can't help meddling); he likes to prank people.

mandarin_meaning: 有點癢/微微不舒服（也可比喻想做某事的衝動）
english_meaning: a little itchy / slightly uncomfortable; (figuratively) a little 'itch' or urge to do something
explanation_mandarin: 口語表達，通常用來形容皮膚有點癢或感到微微不舒服；有時也用作比喻，表示對某事有一種想做的衝動或欲望。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression usually describing something that feels a bit itchy or slightly uncomfortable; can also be used figuratively to mean having an urge or itch to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫新買，著咗之後覺得有啲痕痕哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 san1 maai5, zoek3 zo2 zi1 hau6 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 han4-han4-dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服新买，穿上后觉得有点痒。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought this shirt; it feels a bit itchy when I wear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到啲好嘢我就會痕痕哋想買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 di1 hou2 je5 ngo5 zau6 wui5 han4-han4-dei6 soeng2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到好东西我就会有点想买（有冲动想买）。
examples.english_sentence: When I see something good, I get a bit itchy to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 发痒；感到痒（也可比喻心里烦躁或渴望做某事）
english_meaning: itchy; feeling an itch (can also figuratively mean restless or having an urge to do something)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容皮膚有不舒服的瘙癢感，讓人想抓癢；在口語中也可用來比喻心裡有一種想做某事的衝動或煩躁感。
explanation_english: Describes a physical sensation of itchiness that makes one want to scratch. Colloquially it can also be used figuratively to describe a restless feeling or an urge to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手好痕癢，成日想搔吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 hou2 han4 joeng5, sing4 jat6 soeng2 sou1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手很痒，总想去抓。
examples.english_sentence: My hand is really itchy; I keep wanting to scratch it.

mandarin_meaning: 痕迹 (hénjì)
english_meaning: trace; mark; vestige; sign
explanation_mandarin: 指留下的印記或跡象，用來表明曾經發生過某事或某物曾到過某處。
explanation_english: Marks or vestiges left behind that indicate something occurred or that someone/something was present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺現場搵唔到明顯嘅痕跡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 wan2 m4 dou3 ming4 hin2 ge3 han4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在现场找不到明显的痕迹。
examples.english_sentence: The police couldn't find any obvious traces at the scene.

mandarin_meaning: 痘（如青春痘、疱疹的小膿包；亦可指痘瘡、小痘）
english_meaning: pimple; pustule; (in some contexts) smallpox/pock
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚上的小膿包或粉刺，口語常見為青春痘或痘痘；在古書或複合詞中也可指痘瘡（小痘）。
explanation_english: Refers to a small pus-filled lesion on the skin (pimple/pustule). Commonly used for acne or 'zits'; in historical or compound contexts it can also refer to smallpox/pock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個面有粒痘，好痛，冇晒面子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 min6 jau5 lap1 dau6, hou2 tung3, mou5 saai3 min6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我脸上有一颗痘，很痛，有点丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: I have a pimple on my face; it hurts and it's a bit embarrassing.

mandarin_meaning: 痘疤、痘痂或與痘痘相關的皮肤问题
english_meaning: pimple scab / pockmark / acne scab
explanation_mandarin: 指皮肤上因痘痘形成的痂、痘疤或明显的痘印，也可用来泛指脸上的痘痕或粉刺部位。
explanation_english: Refers to scabs, pockmarks, or scars on the skin caused by pimples/acne; can also be used generally for visible acne spots or pimple scabs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面上有好多痘皮，唔好意思近啲睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 dau6 pei4, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 gan6 di1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她脸上有很多痘皮，不好意思靠近看。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has a lot of pimple scabs on their face; I'm uncomfortable looking closely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 洗面嗰陣唔好撳痘皮，會留疤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 min6 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 kam2 dau6 pei4, wui5 lau4 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洗脸的时候不要挤痘痂，会留下疤痕。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pick at pimple scabs when washing your face; they'll leave scars.

mandarin_meaning: 痙（如痙攣）指肌肉不自主收縮或抽動，抽筋、痙攣
english_meaning: Spasm; cramp; convulsion (as in muscle involuntary contraction)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定，常見於複合詞如「痙攣」）
explanation_mandarin: 表示肌肉不由自主的收縮或抽動，常見於抽筋或癲癇發作，在醫學語境常見於「痙攣」一詞。
explanation_english: Denotes an involuntary contraction or twitching of muscles (a cramp or spasm); commonly appears in medical terms like "convulsion" (痙攣).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夜晚突然痙攣，要即刻送院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 je6maan5 dat6jin4 ging3 lyun4, jiu3 zik1hak1 sung3 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他半夜突然痙攣，必須立即送醫院。
examples.english_sentence: He had a sudden convulsion in the middle of the night and had to be taken to the hospital immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 痉挛 (jìngluán)
english_meaning: spasm; convulsion; cramp
explanation_mandarin: 指肌肉不由自主地突然收縮或抽動，可能局部或全身痙攣，某些情況下伴有意識改變，例如癲癇發作或抽筋。
explanation_english: Involuntary, sudden muscle contractions (spasms or convulsions), which may be localized or generalized and can sometimes be accompanied by changes in consciousness (e.g., seizures or cramps).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺廚房跌倒之後開始痙攣，我哋即刻送佢去醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cyu4 fong2 dit3 dou2 zi1 hau6 hoi1 ci2 ging3 lyun4, ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 sung3 keoi5 heoi3 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在廚房跌倒之後開始痙攣，我們立刻送他去醫院。
examples.english_sentence: He began convulsing after falling in the kitchen, and we immediately took him to the hospital.

mandarin_meaning: 疼（tòng），表示身體或心理感到痛苦或不舒服
english_meaning: pain; hurt; to be painful
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體某處感到疼痛，或形容心理上的痛苦、難過。可用於描述具體的身體痛楚或抽象的情感痛苦。
explanation_english: Indicates physical pain or emotional hurt. Used to describe bodily aches or abstract feelings of suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻腳好痛，行唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 goek3 hou2 tung3, haang4 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的脚很痛，走不了。
examples.english_sentence: My foot hurts a lot; I can't walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭好痛，要休息吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 hou2 tung3, jiu3 jau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我头很痛，需要休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: My head hurts a lot; I need to rest for a while.

mandarin_meaning: 痛得不想活/痛不欲生（形容極度疼痛或悲傷）
english_meaning: In unbearable pain; so distressed that one could wish to die
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容身體或心理上的極度痛苦，好像不想活下去。多用來強調痛苦的程度，書面或口語皆可使用。
