mandarin_meaning: 疯牛病／疯牛症（牛海绵状脑病，BSE）
english_meaning: Mad cow disease (Bovine spongiform encephalopathy, BSE)
explanation_mandarin: 瘋牛症（學名：牛海綿狀腦病，BSE）是一種由朊粒子（prion）引起的牛隻傳染性神經退化性疾病，會破壞腦組織並導致行為改變及運動協調障礙。受污染的牛肉與牛製品可能成為傳播途徑，人類食用受污染產品亦與變種克雅二氏症（vCJD）有關。
explanation_english: Mad cow disease (Bovine spongiform encephalopathy, BSE) is a prion disease affecting cattle that causes progressive neurological degeneration, behavioral changes, and loss of motor coordination. Contaminated beef and beef products can transmit the agent, and human cases (variant Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease, vCJD) have been linked to consumption of infected material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講歐洲以前有瘋牛症爆發，令到好多人唔敢食牛肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 au1 zau1 ji5 cin4 jau5 fung1-ngau4-zing3 baau3faat3, ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 m4 gam2 sik6 ngau4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说欧洲以前有疯牛症爆发，导致很多人不敢吃牛肉。
examples.english_sentence: I heard there was once an outbreak of mad cow disease in Europe, which made many people afraid to eat beef.

mandarin_meaning: 疯狂（fēngkuáng），表示极度不理性或强烈的状态或程度
english_meaning: crazy, insane, frantic; extremely (can be used adverbially)
explanation_mandarin: 表示行為或狀態極端、失去理性或強烈的程度，也可用來形容程度很高（口語用法）。
explanation_english: Describes an extreme, often irrational or intense state or behavior; can also be used colloquially to indicate a very high degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近忙到瘋狂，連休息都冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 mong4 dou3 fung1 kwong4, lin4 jau1 sik1 dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近忙得瘋狂，連休息的時間都沒有。
examples.english_sentence: He's been insanely busy lately; he doesn't even have time to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球迷為咗爭門票瘋狂排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 mai4 wai6 zo2 zang1 mun4 piu3 fung1 kwong4 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球迷為了搶門票瘋狂排隊。
examples.english_sentence: Fans were crazily lining up to get tickets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商店搞緊瘋狂減價，大家快啲去搶購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 dim3 gaau2 gan2 fung1 kwong4 gaam2 gaa3, daai6 gaa1 faai3 di1 heoi3 coeng2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商店正在瘋狂打折，大家快點去搶購。
examples.english_sentence: The store is offering crazy discounts; everyone should hurry to grab them.

mandarin_meaning: 狂犬病；也可比喻指像瘋狗一樣失控或暴躁的行為
english_meaning: Rabies (literally 'mad-dog syndrome'); also used metaphorically for extremely aggressive or uncontrollable behavior
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指狂犬病（醫學上稱為狂犬病），在口語中「瘋狗症」也常被用作比喻，形容人或動物表現得極度暴躁、失控或危險。
explanation_english: Literally 'mad-dog syndrome'. Medically refers to rabies. In colloquial Cantonese it can also be used metaphorically to describe someone or something behaving extremely aggressively, uncontrollably, or dangerously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張先生畀條狗咬咗，醫院話要檢查有冇瘋狗症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 sin1 saang1 bei2 tiu4 gau2 ngau5 zo2, ji1 jyun2 waa6 jiu3 gim2 caa4 jau5 mou5 fung1 gau2 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 張先生被一隻狗咬了，醫院說要檢查有沒有狂犬病（瘋狗症）。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Cheung was bitten by a dog; the hospital said he needs to be checked for rabies.

mandarin_meaning: 瘋癲（形容瘋狂、精神異常或舉止古怪）
english_meaning: crazy; mad; insane; wildly eccentric
explanation_mandarin: 表示精神失常或行為、言談極端、古怪，有時口語化用來形容人很瘋狂或誇張的行為。
explanation_english: Describes insanity or extremely odd, eccentric, or wildly exaggerated behavior; commonly used colloquially to call someone or something crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近有啲瘋癲，成日講啲奇怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 di1 fung1 din1, sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近有點瘋癲，總是說些奇怪的話。
examples.english_sentence: He's been acting a bit crazy lately, always saying strange things.

mandarin_meaning: （皮肤上的）结痂；某些皮肤病（如疥癣）所致的痂
english_meaning: scab; crust on the skin (often from skin conditions like scabies)
explanation_mandarin: 指皮肤上形成的痂或由皮肤病引起的结痂状态，常见于复合词如“瘌痂”“瘌痢頭”等。
explanation_english: Refers to scabs or crusts on the skin caused by wounds or skin conditions; commonly appears in compounds such as '瘌痂' (scab on the head).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路頭上有瘌痂，要帶佢去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 tau4 soeng6 jau5 laap3 gaa1, jiu3 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友头上有瘌痂，要带他去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: The child has scabs on his head; we need to take him to the doctor.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）身上有結痂或疥癬等皮膚病；引申為對人骯髒、可惡的辱罵稱呼
english_meaning: (colloquial) a scabby/skin disease condition; derogatorily used to call someone filthy or nasty
explanation_mandarin: “瘌痢”原指皮膚有疤痂或寄生蟲造成的皮膚病狀，廣東話口語中常用來形容人骯髒或作為侮辱性的稱呼（如“瘌痢頭”）。
explanation_english: "瘌痢" originally refers to scabby skin conditions or parasitic skin ailments. In Cantonese slang it is often used to describe someone as dirty or as an insulting epithet (e.g. “瘌痢頭” = "lice-head"/"filthy person").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日冇沖涼，成身瘌痢，好難近佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mou5 cung1 loeng4, seng4 san1 laap3 lei6, hou2 naan4 gan6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是不洗澡，渾身結痂，看起來很髒，很難靠近他。
examples.english_sentence: He never bathes and is scabby all over; he looks filthy and it's hard to get close to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個瘌痢頭，唔好咁講嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 laap3 lei6 tau4, m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個髒兮兮的人，別那樣說話！
examples.english_sentence: You filthy person, don't talk like that!

mandarin_meaning: 瘡、膿腫、潰瘍（皮膚或組織的化膿性病變）
english_meaning: ulcer; abscess (a suppurative lesion of the skin or tissue)
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚或體內組織出現的化膿性包塊或潰爛，常伴隨紅腫、疼痛，有時需要引流或醫療處理。
explanation_english: Refers to a suppurative lesion (an abscess or ulcer) in the skin or tissues, typically accompanied by redness, swelling and pain; may require medical treatment or drainage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手有個瘍，成日痛，仲有啲紅腫，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 jau5 go3 joeng6, sing4 jat6 tung3, zung6 jau5 di1 hung4 zung2, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手上有個瘍，整天疼，還有點紅腫，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has an abscess on his hand; it hurts all the time and is a bit red and swollen — he needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 昏倒；昏厥（口語）
english_meaning: to faint; to pass out (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「瘓」在廣東話口語中常用來表示因為疲勞、過熱或暈眩而昏倒或虛脫，有時也作為形容人非常累或虛脫的說法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial use, 瘓 denotes fainting or collapsing due to exhaustion, heat, or dizziness; it can also be used informally to describe being extremely tired or drained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天熱到人會瘓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 jit6 dou3 jan4 wui5 faan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天熱得人會昏倒。
examples.english_sentence: In summer the heat can make people faint.

mandarin_meaning: 瘙（指皮肤发痒，常与“癢/痒”连用，如“瘙癢”）
english_meaning: to itch; itching (often used in the compound '瘙癢' meaning itching)
partOfSpeech_english: verb / noun (when referring to the sensation)
explanation_mandarin: 表示皮膚發癢的感覺或引起發癢的動作，常見於詞語“瘙癢”。
explanation_english: Refers to the sensation of skin itching or the action causing itching; commonly appears in the compound '瘙癢'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥可以止瘙癢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ho2 ji5 zi2 sok3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这药可以止痒。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine can stop itching.

mandarin_meaning: （醫學）皮膚或皮下的贅生物、小瘤，常見於皮膚表面的贅肉或息肉（如瘜肉）
english_meaning: a small benign skin growth or lump; fleshy lump/polyp (e.g., a skin tag or small tumor)
explanation_mandarin: 「瘜」為醫學或口語中用來指稱皮膚上的小贅生物、瘤或息肉，常見於脖子、腋下等部位，通常為良性，但若有變化應就醫檢查。
explanation_english: Refers to a small skin growth, lump, or polyp (often benign). Commonly used for fleshly growths such as skin tags; if it changes or causes concern, medical evaluation is advised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頸度有粒瘜，要唔要去睇醫生？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng2 dou6 jau5 lap1 sik1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我脖子上長了一個瘜（小贅肉），要不要去看醫生？
examples.english_sentence: I found a small lump on my neck — should I see a doctor?

mandarin_meaning: 皮膚或黏膜上的良性贅生物，如息肉或小瘤
english_meaning: a fleshy growth on the skin or mucous membrane; a small benign tumor such as a skin tag or polyp
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚或黏膜表面凸起的良性贅生組織，常見於頸、腋下或內部黏膜（如鼻或腸），有時需由醫生處理或切除。
explanation_english: Refers to a benign fleshy growth protruding from the skin or mucous membranes, commonly appearing as a skin tag, polyp, or small tumor; may occur on the neck, underarms, or internal linings and sometimes requires medical removal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頸度有一粒瘜肉，打算去睇醫生切除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng2 dou6 jau5 jat1 lap1 wat6 juk6, daa2 syun3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1 cit3 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我脖子上有一顆瘜肉，打算去看醫生切除。
examples.english_sentence: I have a small fleshy growth on my neck; I'm planning to see a doctor to have it removed.

mandarin_meaning: 瘟疫；瘟（指疫病），在廣東話中亦可作形容詞，表示枯燥、乏味或不順利/衰運
english_meaning: plague; pestilence. In Cantonese slang, used adjectivally to mean boring, dull, or unlucky/ill-fated
explanation_mandarin: 本字原指瘟疫、疫病，多見於複合詞如「瘟疫」。在粵語口語中，單獨使用時常帶俗語色彩，可形容人或事物很悶、沉悶或運氣不好（如「好瘟」）。
explanation_english: The character originally denotes plague or pestilence, commonly seen in compounds like "瘟疫". In Cantonese colloquial use, it can be used by itself as slang to describe something or someone as boring/dull or to indicate bad luck (e.g., "hou2 wan1" = very dull/unlucky).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地方爆發瘟疫，政府已經封城。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 fong1 baau3 faat3 wan1 jik6, zing3 fu2 ji5 ging1 fung1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地方爆发瘟疫，政府已经封城。
examples.english_sentence: The area has an outbreak of plague; the government has already locked down the city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影好瘟，我睇到訓着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hou2 wan1, ngo5 tai2 dou3 fan3 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很枯燥，我看着看着就睡着了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie was so boring I fell asleep while watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近運氣好瘟，成日衰嘢發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 wan6 hei3 hou2 wan1, sing4 jat6 seoi1 je5 faat3 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近运气很差，总是倒霉的事发生。
examples.english_sentence: Lately my luck's terrible; bad things keep happening.

mandarin_meaning: 討厭鬼；帶來麻煩或不幸的人
english_meaning: a pest/brat; someone who causes trouble or brings bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 口語、帶有貶義或半玩笑的稱呼，用來形容討人厭、愛惹事或被認為會帶來霉運的人，常見於香港粵語語境。
explanation_english: A colloquial (often pejorative or teasing) term used in Cantonese to describe a nuisance, brat, troublemaker, or someone thought to bring bad luck. Common in Hong Kong slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個瘟仔，成日搞事，真煩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 man1 zai2, sing4 jat6 gaau2 si6, zan1 faan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個討厭鬼，總是惹事，真煩！
examples.english_sentence: You little pest, always causing trouble — so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嚟到就衰事連連，大家都話佢係個瘟仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lai4 dou3 zau6 seoi1 si6 lin4 lin4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 go3 man1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一來就倒楣事接二連三，大家都說他是個帶衰的人。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever he shows up, bad things happen one after another — everyone calls him a jinx.

mandarin_meaning: 瘟君／瘟神；帶來災禍或麻煩的人（貶義）
english_meaning: plague lord; a person who brings misfortune or trouble; a jinx/pest (pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指民間信仰中掌管瘟疫的神祇，現多用作貶稱，形容經常帶來不幸、麻煩或像『晦氣』的人。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the folk deity of plague. Colloquially used as a pejorative to describe someone who frequently brings bad luck, trouble, or is considered a jinx.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日帶嚟麻煩，大家都話佢係瘟君。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daai3 lei4 maa4faan4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 wan1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是帶來麻煩，大家都說他是瘟君。
examples.english_sentence: He always brings trouble; everyone calls him a plague/jinx.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）很無聊/很沉悶；形容氣氛或人枯燥、沒生氣，或令人掃興
english_meaning: colloquial expression meaning 'so dull/boring' or 'so dead' (describing atmosphere, person, or situation)
explanation_mandarin: 「瘟咁」是粵語口語，常用來形容場面、氣氛、談話或人很沉悶、無生氣、令人掃興或尷尬，不一定帶罵人的意思，偏向抱怨或形容枯燥。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to describe something (an atmosphere, person, or situation) as dull, lifeless, boring, or awkward. Often expresses annoyance or disappointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝條街好瘟咁，冇乜人入去買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 tiu4 gaai1 hou2 wan1 gam2, mou5 mat1 jan4 jap6 heoi3 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上这条街很冷清，没什么人来买东西。
examples.english_sentence: The street was so dead this morning; hardly anyone came to shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日講嘢好瘟咁，完全笑唔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gong2 je5 hou2 wan1 gam2, jyun4 cyun4 siu3 m4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天说话很无趣，完全让人笑不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was so dull talking today; he couldn't make anyone laugh at all.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俚語）指被認為帶來厄運、令人討厭或不討喜的女人；含貶義。
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for a woman regarded as unlucky, unpleasant, or bringing bad luck; derogatory.
explanation_mandarin: 「瘟」在廣東話裡常用來形容不吉利、倒楣或討厭，與「女」組合成「瘟女」，用於形容某位女性令人不快或被視為帶來霉運，語氣負面且具侮辱性。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 瘟 (wan1) commonly describes something unlucky, unpleasant, or ominous. Paired with 女 (neoi5), 瘟女 becomes a derogatory slang term for a woman perceived as annoying, unlucky, or a bringer of bad fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，唔好成日話人係瘟女，咁樣好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 waa6 jan4 hai6 wan1 neoi5, gam2 joeng6 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，不要老是說別人是瘟女，那樣很傷人。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't keep calling someone a 'wan neoi' — that's hurtful.

mandarin_meaning: 瘟疫；传染性疾病的大规模流行（如鼠疫、流感等的爆发）
english_meaning: epidemic; plague; a widespread outbreak of infectious disease
explanation_mandarin: 指传染病在某一地区或更大范围内大规模爆发，导致大量人群感染、发病，甚至死亡，对公共卫生和社会生活造成重大影响。
explanation_english: Refers to the large-scale outbreak of an infectious disease in a region or beyond, causing many people to become infected or ill and often having serious public health and social impacts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排聽講有瘟疫爆發，大家要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 teng1 gong2 jau5 wan1 jik6 baau3 faat3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近听说有瘟疫爆发，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: I heard there's an epidemic outbreak recently; everyone should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瘟疫期間，醫護人員好辛苦，要加倍保護佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan1 jik6 kei4 gaan1, ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 hou2 san1 fu2, jiu3 gaa1 bui3 bou2 wu6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 瘟疫期间，医护人员很辛苦，要加倍保护他们。
examples.english_sentence: During the epidemic, healthcare workers are working very hard and need extra protection.

mandarin_meaning: 沒精神、萎靡不振、悶悶不樂（口語）
english_meaning: listless; low-spirited; sluggish; feeling down (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 用於形容人沒精神、情緒低落或顯得沉悶、無精打采，屬廣東話口語表達。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who is listless, low in spirits, or appearing dull and unenergetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢成日瘟瘟沌，唔知道發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 sing4 jat6 wan1 wan1 deon6, m4 zi1 dou3 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他成天萎靡不振，不知道發生什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been listless lately; I don't know what's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾日，依家仲瘟瘟沌，未有精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 jat6, ji4 gaa1 zung6 wan1 wan1 deon6, mei6 jau5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了好幾天，現在還沒好，仍然沒精神。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for a few days and still looks listless.

mandarin_meaning: 形容人無精打采、憔悴或邋遢的樣子
english_meaning: describing someone who looks listless, dispirited, sickly, or shabby
explanation_mandarin: 「瘟瘟沌沌」為廣東話口語，通常用來形容一個人看起來沒精神、面容憔悴或有點邋遢、疲倦，帶有輕微貶義或同情意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe someone who appears listless, pale, weary, or a bit shabby. It often conveys mild disapproval or concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日點咁瘟瘟沌沌，係唔係病咗呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 dim2 gam2 wan1 wan1 deon6 deon6, hai6 m4 hai6 beng6 zo2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天怎麼這麼沒精神，是不是生病了？
examples.english_sentence: Why do you look so listless today — are you sick?

mandarin_meaning: 瘟神（指帶來不幸或瘟疫的神；引申為帶衰、招惹不幸的人或事）
english_meaning: plague god; (colloquial) a jinx or person/thing that brings bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 原本指傳說中帶來瘟疫的神祇，現在常用作俚語或貶義稱呼會給人帶來厄運或不幸的人或事，有時帶開玩笑或自嘲意味。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a deity causing plagues; now commonly used colloquially to label a person or thing that brings misfortune or bad luck. Often used jokingly, pejoratively, or self-deprecatingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日出事，大家都話佢係個瘟神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ceot1 si6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 go3 wan1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是出事，大家都說他是個瘟神。
examples.english_sentence: He always runs into trouble; everyone says he's a jinx.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做瘟神，嚟到我屋企帶衰啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 wan1 san4, lai4 dou3 ngo5 uk1 kei2 daai3 seoi1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做瘟神，來到我家就會帶來衰運。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a jinx and bring bad luck to my home.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦弱；（土地）貧瘠
english_meaning: emaciated, thin; barren (of land), infertile
explanation_mandarin: 「瘠」常用於書面語，指人或動物瘦弱、消瘦；也可用於形容土地貧瘠、不肥沃。
explanation_english: A literary adjective meaning thin or emaciated (for people/animals) and barren or infertile (for soil/land).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊地好瘠，種唔到好嘅作物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 dei6 hou2 zik6, zung3 m4 dou2 hou2 ge3 zok3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块地很瘠薄，种不出好的作物。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of land is very barren; you can't grow good crops on it.

mandarin_meaning: 疮；皮肤上的溃烂、溃疡或脓肿（亦可引申为心理创伤）
english_meaning: sore; ulcer; boil; abscess (can also be used figuratively for an emotional wound)
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚表面的潰爛、膿腫或疹子，例如瘡、膿包、疖子等。口語或書面語中亦可比喻心靈上的創傷或難以癒合的痛處。
explanation_english: Refers to a skin sore, ulcer, abscess, or boil (e.g., pustule, carbuncle). In both colloquial and literary use it can also be used metaphorically for a painful emotional wound that's hard to heal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻腳有個瘡，好痛，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 goek3 jau5 go3 cong1, hou2 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的腳上長了一個疮，很疼，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: I have a sore/boil on my foot; it hurts a lot and I need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面頰起咗個大瘡，成日流膿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 hap6 hei2 zo2 go3 daai6 cong1, sing4 jat6 lau4 nung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他臉頰上起了一個大疮，經常流膿。
examples.english_sentence: He has a big sore on his cheek that keeps oozing pus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說話喺我心入面留低咗個瘡，好難愈合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3 waa6 hai2 ngo5 sam1 jap6 min6 lau4 dai1 zo2 go3 cong1, hou2 naan4 jyu6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的話在我心裡留下了一個疮，很難愈合。
examples.english_sentence: His words left a sore in my heart that's hard to heal.

mandarin_meaning: 疮疤；伤疤；（比喻）心理或名誉上的创伤
english_meaning: scar or sore (on the skin); (figurative) emotional or reputational scar
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚上因潰爛或傷口癒合後留下的痕跡，也可用來比喻心靈或名譽上的創傷與痛處。
explanation_english: Refers to a scar or sore on the skin left after wounds or ulcers heal; can also be used figuratively for emotional or reputational wounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手有個瘡疤，係細個嗰陣跌親留低㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 jau5 go3 cong1 baa1, hai6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 dit3 can1 lau4 dai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手上有个疤，是小时候跌伤留下的。
examples.english_sentence: He has a scar on his hand; it's from a childhood fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件事成咗佢心入面嘅瘡疤，提起都仲會痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 si6 sing4 zo2 keoi5 sam1 jap6 min6 ge3 cong1 baa1, tai4 hei2 dou1 zung6 wui5 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件事成了他心里的创伤，一提起来还会痛。
examples.english_sentence: That incident became an emotional scar for him; even mentioning it still hurts.

mandarin_meaning: 瘤（如腫塊、腫瘤）
english_meaning: tumor; lump; swelling (abnormal growth)
explanation_mandarin: 指身體表面或內部長出的異常腫塊，可為良性或惡性，也可泛指類似的突起或贅生物。
explanation_english: Refers to an abnormal lump or growth on or inside the body, which can be benign or malignant; can also be used generally for a protruding mass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話個瘤係良性嘅，唔使太擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 go3 lau4 hai6 loeng4 sing3 ge3, m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说那个瘤是良性的，不必太担心。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the tumor is benign, so there's no need to worry too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頸度有個瘤，成日都覺得痛，已經約咗去檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng2 dou6 jau5 go3 lau4, sing4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 tung3, ji5 ging1 joek3 zo2 heoi3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脖子上有个瘤，总是觉得痛，已经约了去检查。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lump on his neck that often hurts; he has already scheduled a check-up.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦（shòu）：體型瘦、缺少脂肪或肌肉，或指減輕體重。
english_meaning: thin; slim; skinny; to lose weight
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 動詞（指變瘦）
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述人的體型或動物、物件外觀較瘦，脂肪或肉少；也可表示因病、節食或運動而減重。
explanation_english: Describes a person, animal, or object as having little fat or flesh (thin or slim); can also mean to lose weight due to illness, diet, or exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好瘦，睇落冇乜肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sou3, tai2 lok6 mou5 mat1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很瘦，看起來沒什麼肉。
examples.english_sentence: He is very thin; he doesn't seem to have much flesh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為病而瘦咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 beng6 ji4 sou3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為生病而瘦了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of weight because of illness.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦削（shòu xuē）：形容人或動物非常消瘦、骨感，缺乏脂肉。
english_meaning: thin; gaunt; lanky — describes someone very thin, emaciated, or with a bony appearance.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容身形消瘦、骨感，常帶有體弱或病後瘦弱的意味，可描述外表看起來乾瘦、臉部或四肢缺乏肉感。
explanation_english: Used to describe a body that is very thin and bony, often implying weakness or weight loss from illness; conveys a gaunt or emaciated appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾個月，依家成個人好瘦削。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, ji4 gaa1 seng4 go3 jan4 hou2 sau3 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了幾個月，現在整個人很瘦削。
examples.english_sentence: He has been sick for several months and now looks very thin and gaunt.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦弱／骨瘦如柴
english_meaning: (slang) very skinny; scrawny; skin-and-bones
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，用來形容人非常瘦弱或皮包骨，帶有口語或略帶貶義的語感，多見於香港粵語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang adjective used to describe someone who is very thin or scrawny (skin-and-bones). Informal and can be mildly derogatory; commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家瘦叉咗，好似冇食嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 sau3 caa1 zo2, hou2 ci5 mou5 sik6 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在瘦得不行，好像沒吃東西似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's gotten really skinny, like he hasn't been eating.

mandarin_meaning: 變瘦；減肥；變苗條
english_meaning: to slim down; to lose weight; to get thinner
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示身體變瘦或通過飲食、運動等方式減輕體重，可與「瘦身／減肥」同義。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to slim down or lose weight — to become thinner through dieting, exercise, etc. Comparable to 'slim down' or 'lose weight' in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近想瘦底，要開始節食同做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 soeng2 sau3 dai2, jiu3 hoi1 ci2 zit3 sik6 tung4 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近想變瘦，要開始節食和做運動。
examples.english_sentence: I've been wanting to slim down recently; I need to start dieting and exercising.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦削的身材但胸部很大
english_meaning: slim-bodied but large-busted (skinny body with big breasts)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來形容人身形瘦但胸部豐滿，通常對外貌的描述，帶口語和非正式語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase describing someone who has a slim body but large breasts. Informal and used to comment on physical appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個女仔真係瘦底大波，著條裙好好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 zan1 hai6 sau3 dai2 daai6 bo1, zoek3 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个女孩真是身材瘦但胸部很大，穿裙子很好看。
examples.english_sentence: That girl is really slim with a big bust; she looks great in a dress.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦巴巴／非常消瘦
english_meaning: very thin; scrawny; emaciated
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語表達，用來形容人或動物非常瘦弱、消瘦。常見於香港粵語口語中，帶有些許同情或描述性語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe a person or animal that is very thin or emaciated. Common in Hong Kong Cantonese, often conveys a sympathetic or descriptive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個已經瘦擘擘，成日都俾人叫佢食多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 sau3 bok3 bok3, sing4 jat6 dou1 bei2 jan4 giu3 keoi5 sik6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候就瘦巴巴的，常常被人叫他多吃點。
examples.english_sentence: He was scrawny when he was young; people often told him to eat more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫著落去唔啱，個人仲顯得瘦擘擘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zoek3 lok6 heoi3 m4 aam1, go3 jan4 zung6 hin2 dak1 sau3 bok3 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服穿上去不合適，反而讓人顯得更瘦巴巴。
examples.english_sentence: This outfit doesn't fit; it makes the person look even scrawnier.

mandarin_meaning: 非常瘦 / 瘦得很
english_meaning: very skinny; extremely thin; scrawny
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來誇張或強調某人/某物非常瘦，語氣可帶幽默或輕微批評。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to emphasize that someone or something is very thin; the tone can be humorous or mildly critical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇佢，真係瘦猛猛喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 keoi5, zan1 hai6 sau3 maang5-maang5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他，真的很瘦。
examples.english_sentence: Look at him — he's really skinny.

cantonese: 瘦田冇人耕，耕開有人爭
jyutping: sau3 tin4 mou5 jan4 geng1, geng1 hoi1 jau5 jan4 zaang1
mandarin_meaning: 荒地沒人耕種，一旦被開墾就會引起大家爭搶
english_meaning: If a field is barren nobody farms it; once it's cultivated people start fighting over it. Figuratively: something ignored when worthless will attract competition once it has value.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某事物或資源在沒人重視或未開發時都沒人理會，但一旦有了利用價值或被開發，就會引來爭奪。常用於批評趁勢而起、見利忘義的現象。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something neglected or undeveloped receives no attention, but once it is developed or becomes valuable people rush to compete for it. Often used to criticize opportunistic behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅地以前瘦田冇人耕，耕開有人爭，而家一開發就有好多投資者嚟爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 dei6 ji5 cin4 sau3 tin4 mou5 jan4 geng1, geng1 hoi1 jau5 jan4 zaang1, ji4 gaa1 jat1 hoi1 faat3 zau6 jau5 hou2 do1 tau4 zi1 ze2 lai4 zaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊地以前沒人管，瘦田沒人耕，耕起來有人爭，現在一開發就有很多投資者來爭搶。
examples.english_sentence: That plot of land used to be neglected—nobody farmed it. Once it's cultivated people fight over it. Now that it's being developed, many investors are competing to get it.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦肉（脂肪含量較少的肉，常指豬、牛、雞等的瘦部分；普通話：shòuròu）
english_meaning: lean meat (meat with relatively low fat content)
explanation_mandarin: 指脂肪含量較少的肉，常用於湯、炒菜或做餡料。可以指豬、牛、雞等動物的瘦肉部分。
explanation_english: Refers to meat with relatively low fat content, commonly used in soups, stir-fries, or fillings. Can refer to lean parts of pork, beef, chicken, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買啲瘦肉返嚟煮湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 di1 sau3 juk6 faan1 lai4 zyu2 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚買些瘦肉回來煮湯。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some lean meat tonight to make soup.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦弱、非常瘦（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: very thin; scrawny (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 口語或俚語用法，用來形容人（或動物）非常瘦、瘦弱，語氣可帶戲謔或關心。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term describing someone (or an animal) who is very thin or scrawny; can carry a teasing or concerned tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁瘦蜢蜢，食啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 sau3 maang5 maang5, sik6 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么瘦瘦的，吃点东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're so skinny — eat something.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦身；减肥
english_meaning: to slim down; weight loss; to lose weight
explanation_mandarin: 指通过运动、控制饮食或其他方法减少体重或使身形变得更苗条，既可作动词（瘦身），也可作名词（瘦身计划）。
explanation_english: Refers to losing weight or making the body slimmer through exercise, dieting, or other methods. Can be used as a verb (to slim down) or as a noun (a slimming regimen).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想瘦身，所以開始做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sau3 san1, so2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想瘦身，所以开始做运动。
examples.english_sentence: I want to slim down, so I started exercising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近一直瘦身，食得好少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 jat1 zik6 sau3 san1, sik6 dak1 hou2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近一直在瘦身，吃得很少。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has been trying to slim down recently and eats very little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去健身室做運動有助瘦身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 gin6 san1 sat1 zou6 wan6 dung6 jau5 zo6 sau3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去健身房做运动有助于瘦身。
examples.english_sentence: Going to the gym and exercising helps with slimming down.

mandarin_meaning: 形容人非常瘦，骨瘦嶙峋（類似「瘦骨嶙峋」、「骨瘦如柴」）
english_meaning: an extremely thin or emaciated person; 'skin-and-bones'
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容某人瘦得只剩下骨頭，通常包含同情或輕微貶義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who is extremely thin or emaciated. Depending on context it can convey sympathy or mild disparagement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日病嚟病去，依家瘦到變咗瘦骨仙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 beng6 lai4 beng6 heoi3, ji1 gaa1 sau3 dou3 bin3 zo2 sau3 gwat1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是病來病去，現在瘦得像瘦骨仙一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He's constantly getting sick and has become so thin he looks like a skin-and-bones person.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦骨如柴（shòu gǔ rú chái）：形容非常消瘦，骨瘦如柴。
english_meaning: skin and bones; emaciated; extremely thin and gaunt.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或動物極度消瘦，骨頭明顯，顯得憔悴虛弱。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone (or an animal) who is extremely thin or emaciated, with prominent bones and a gaunt appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，依家瘦骨如柴，令人好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji4 gaa1 sou3-gwat1-jyu4-caai4, ling6-jan4 hou2 daam1-sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，現在瘦骨如柴，讓人很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: He has been ill for a long time; now he's skin and bones, which makes people very worried.

jyutping: sau3 gwat1 jyu4 coi4 bou1 luk6 zuk1
mandarin_meaning: 瘦骨如柴，瘦得像竹竿一樣（口語、誇張說法）
english_meaning: extremely thin; skin and bones (colloquial/humorous expression)
explanation_mandarin: 口語化的廣東話說法，把「瘦骨如柴」與形象化的「煲碌竹」結合，用來誇張或幽默地形容人非常消瘦。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression combining 'skin and bones' with a bamboo-image punchline; used humorously or emphatically to describe someone extremely emaciated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾個月，依家瘦到瘦骨如柴煲碌竹，連衫都鬆晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, ji1 gaa1 sou3 dou3 sau3 gwat1 jyu4 coi4 bou1 luk6 zuk1, lin4 saam1 dou1 sung1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了幾個月，現在瘦得瘦骨如柴、像竹竿一樣，連衣服都鬆了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a few months and is now so thin — skin and bones, like a bamboo pole — even his clothes are loose.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦得皮包骨頭，骨瘦如柴，形容非常消瘦憔悴
english_meaning: extremely thin or emaciated; skin and bones; gaunt, with bones protruding
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或動物極度消瘦，骨骼突出，看起來憔悴無力。
explanation_english: Describes a person or animal that is extremely thin or emaciated, with bones showing and a haggard appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾個月，依家瘦骨嶙峋，睇落好憔悴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, ji1 gaa1 sau3 gwat1 lan4 seon4, tai2 lok6 hou2 ciu4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了幾個月，現在瘦骨嶙峋，看起來很憔悴。
examples.english_sentence: He has been ill for several months and is now skin and bones; he looks very haggard.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）非常瘦，骨瘦如柴
english_meaning: extremely thin; emaciated; skin and bones
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容人或動物非常消瘦，骨骼突出，像柴火一樣瘦。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone or an animal who is extremely thin and emaciated, literally 'bones as thin as firewood.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近病咗，瘦到真係瘦骨拉柴，見到好心痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 beng6 zo2, sau3 dou3 zan1 hai6 sau3 gwat1 laai1 caai4, gin3 dou2 hou2 sam1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近生病了，瘦到真的是瘦骨如柴，看到他很心疼。
examples.english_sentence: He has been ill recently and is so thin he's skin and bones; it's heartbreaking to see.

mandarin_meaning: 非常瘦，骨瘦如柴
english_meaning: extremely thin; emaciated; skin and bones
explanation_mandarin: 口語/俗語用法，用來形容人非常消瘦，幾乎只剩下皮包骨頭，外表憔悴。
explanation_english: An informal/idiomatic Cantonese expression describing someone who is extremely thin or emaciated, almost skin and bones; conveys a haggard appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為生病，佢而家瘦骨瀨柴，睇落好憔悴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 saang1 beng6, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 sau3 gwat1 laai6 caai4, tai2 lok6 hou2 ciu4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為生病，他現在瘦得像皮包骨頭，看起來很憔悴。
examples.english_sentence: Because of illness, he's now skin and bones and looks very haggard.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦骨嶙峋；極度消瘦
english_meaning: extremely thin; emaciated; skin and bones
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或動物非常瘦，骨頭突出、乾癟，通常帶有憐憫或描述病弱的語氣。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or animal that is extremely thin and emaciated, with protruding bones; often conveys pity or indicates sickness/weakness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗兩個月，依家瘦骨癩柴，好似冇晒力氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 loeng5 go3 jyut6, ji1 gaa1 sou3 gwat1 laai6 caai4, hou2 ci5 mou5 saai3 lik6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了兩個月，現在瘦骨嶙峋，好像沒力氣。
examples.english_sentence: He has been ill for two months; now he's emaciated and seems to have no strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓仔餓咗好耐，瘦骨癩柴，見到人就搵嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 zai2 ngo6 zo2 hou2 noi6, sou3 gwat1 laai6 caai4, gin3 dou2 jan4 zau6 wan2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻小貓餓了很久，瘦骨嶙峋，看到人就找東西吃。
examples.english_sentence: The kitten had been hungry for a long time; it's emaciated and looks for food whenever it sees people.

mandarin_meaning: 瘧（疟）／瘧疾，指由瘧原蟲引起的一種間歇性熱症，俗稱瘧疾病（疟疾）
english_meaning: malaria; intermittent fever caused by Plasmodium parasites
explanation_mandarin: 「瘧」原指由瘧原蟲（Plasmodium）引起的一種有發冷、發熱、盜汗等間歇性症狀的熱性疾病，現代常見詞為「瘧疾／疟疾」。
explanation_english: Refers to malaria, an intermittent febrile disease caused by Plasmodium parasites, characterized by chills, fever, and sweating; commonly referred to as malaria.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去非洲旅行，返嚟之後確診係瘧疾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 fei1 zau1 leoi5 hang4, faan1 lai4 zi1 hau6 kok3 zan3 hai6 joek6 zat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去非洲旅行，回來之後被確診為瘧疾。
examples.english_sentence: He traveled to Africa and was diagnosed with malaria after returning.

mandarin_meaning: 疟疾（瘧疾）
english_meaning: malaria
explanation_mandarin: 指由瘧原蟲（Plasmodium）引起的傳染病，主要透過受感染的蚊子叮咬傳播，症狀包括發燒、寒戰、頭痛和貧血等，嚴重者可致命。
explanation_english: An infectious disease caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by bites of infected mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, chills, headache, and anemia, and it can be fatal if severe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺非洲感染咗瘧疾，要入院治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fei1 zau1 gam2 jim6 zo2 joek6 zat6, jiu3 jap6 jyun2 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在非洲感染了疟疾，需要住院治疗。
examples.english_sentence: He contracted malaria in Africa and needs to be hospitalized for treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 傳播瘧疾的蚊子；指會傳播瘧疾的蚊類（即按蚊等）
english_meaning: malaria mosquito; anopheline mosquito (a mosquito that transmits malaria)
explanation_mandarin: 「瘧蚊」字面為傳播瘧疾的蚊子，常指按蚊等會傳播瘧疾的蚊類。在醫學和防疫語境中使用，也可用來強調某些蚊子特別危險或致病。
explanation_english: Literally 'malaria mosquito' — a mosquito that transmits malaria (typically Anopheles species). Used in medical/public health contexts to refer to mosquitoes that spread malaria; can also emphasize a particularly dangerous or disease-carrying mosquito.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排有人講有瘧蚊出現，政府已經派人滅蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 jau5 jan4 gong2 jau5 joek6 man1 ceot1 jin6, zing3 fu2 ji5 ging1 paai3 jan4 mit6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有人說出現了瘧蚊，政府已派人滅蚊。
examples.english_sentence: Recently people said malaria mosquitoes have appeared; the government has sent teams to exterminate mosquitoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瘧蚊主要係啲按蚊，會傳播瘧疾，要做好防疫措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 man1 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 di1 on3 man1, wui5 cyun4 bo3 joek6 zat6, jiu3 zou6 hou2 fong4 jik6 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 瘧蚊主要是按蚊，會傳播瘧疾，要做好防疫措施。
examples.english_sentence: Malaria mosquitoes are mainly Anopheles; they can transmit malaria, so take proper preventive measures.

mandarin_meaning: 疙瘩；小包；小瘤；（口語）痘痘、突起或心結
english_meaning: lump; bump; pimple; small swelling; (figurative) a lingering issue
explanation_mandarin: 「瘩」常用來指皮膚上的小包、痘痘或小瘤，亦可引申指人際間或心裡的結、麻煩事。
explanation_english: Used to refer to a small lump, bump, or pimple on the skin; can also be used figuratively for a lingering issue or emotional knot between people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我面上有幾粒瘩，唔知係咪痘痘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 min6 seong6 jau5 gei2 lap1 daat6, m4 zi1 hai6 mai6 dau6 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我脸上有几颗疙瘩，不知道是不是痘痘。
examples.english_sentence: I have a few bumps on my face; I don't know if they're pimples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋之間仲有啲瘩未解開，要唔要傾下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 zung6 jau5 di1 daat6 mei6 gaai2 hoi1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 king1 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们之间还有些疙瘩没化解，要不要谈谈？
examples.english_sentence: There are still some issues between you that haven't been resolved — do you want to talk it over?

mandarin_meaning: （多見於複合詞「瘰疬」）指瘰疬，結核性淋巴結炎
english_meaning: Scrofula (tuberculous cervical lymphadenitis); tuberculous swelling of lymph nodes, especially in the neck
explanation_mandarin: 「瘰」常見於醫學詞語「瘰疬」，指一種由結核菌引起的頸部淋巴結炎，俗稱頸部淋巴結腫大或頸瘤，屬舊稱或專業術語。
explanation_english: Often seen in the medical term "瘰疬" (scrofula). It denotes a tuberculous infection of lymph nodes, typically in the neck (tuberculous cervical lymphadenitis). An archaic/medical term for swollen lymph nodes caused by tuberculosis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢頸有瘰疬，要做抗結核治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 geng2 jau5 lok3 lik6, jiu3 zou6 kong3 git3 hok6 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他颈部有瘰疬，要做抗结核治疗。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has scrofula in his neck and needs anti-tuberculosis treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 蠑螈 / 蝾螈（róngyuán）——兩棲動物，俗稱蝾螈（salamander/newt），此詞為罕見或異體字用法
english_meaning: A rare/archaic variant writing referring to the salamander/newt (salamander, an amphibian)
explanation_mandarin: 「瘰螈」為罕見或異體字，常見寫法為「蠑螈」或「蝾螈」，指一類兩棲動物（蝾螈、蠑螈），在文獻或舊書中可見，屬於較少使用的字形。
explanation_english: This form is a rare or variant writing of 蠑螈/蝾螈 (róngyuán), meaning salamander or newt. It is chiefly seen in older texts or as an alternate character and is not common in modern usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本舊書用咗「瘰螈」個字，實際係指蠑螈，即係蝾螈（一種兩棲動物）。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 gau6 syu1 jung6 zo2 "lo2 jyun4" go3 zi6, sat6 zai3 hai6 zi2 jung4 jyun4, zik1 hai6 jung4 jyun4 (jat1 zung2 loeng5 cai1 dung6 mat6).
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本旧书用了“瘰螈”这个字，实际上是指蠑螈，即蝾螈（一种两栖动物）。
examples.english_sentence: This old book uses the character "瘰螈", which actually refers to 蠑螈 (the salamander), a type of amphibian.

mandarin_meaning: 瘴（zhàng）：瘴氣、疫氣；指引起疾病的有害氣體或瘧疾等瘟疫
english_meaning: miasma; pestilential vapor; pestilence (archaic/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 瘴多指瘴氣或疫氣，古代認為某些地方會產生瘴氣，會導致人畜生病，亦可泛指瘧疾、瘟疫等傳染性疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to miasma or pestilential vapor believed to cause disease; historically used to describe malarial or epidemic conditions and poisonous airs in certain locales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時有人話呢度有瘴氣，去咗好多人病倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 jau5 jan4 waa6 ni1 dou6 jau5 zoeng6 hei3, heoi3 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 beng6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代有人說這裡有瘴氣，去過的人很多都病倒了。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times people said this place had miasma; many who went there fell ill.

mandarin_meaning: 跛；一只脚或腿有问题，走路一拐一拐
english_meaning: to limp; lame (walking with difficulty because of an injured or weak leg/foot)
explanation_mandarin: 表示因腿或腳受傷、疾病或畸形，走路時一拐一拐或行動不便。
explanation_english: Describes walking with difficulty because one leg or foot is injured, weak, or deformed; to walk with a limp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻腳受傷而家瘸咗，行路好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 goek3 sau6 soeng1 ji4 gaa1 ke4 zo2, haang4 lou6 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他腳受傷現在一瘸一拐，走路很慢。
examples.english_sentence: His foot is injured; he's limping now and walks slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位老伯行得有啲瘸，要靠拐杖先行得穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai2 lou5 baak3 haang4 dak1 jau5 di1 ke4, jiu3 kaau3 gwaai2 zoeng6 sin1 haang4 dak1 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位老先生走路有點跛，需要靠拐杖才能走得穩。
examples.english_sentence: That elderly man limps a little and needs a cane to walk steadily.

mandarin_meaning: 瘘（瘻）——指器官間或器官與皮膚之間的異常通道（瘘管）
english_meaning: fistula — an abnormal tract connecting organs or an organ to the skin (fistulous tract)
explanation_mandarin: “瘺”常指瘘管，即病理性通道，可能連接兩個器官或器官與體表，常需醫療處理。此條目中的“□”為缺字或佚字標記，實際常見詞形如“瘘管”、“瘻孔”。
explanation_english: “瘺” (fistula) refers to a pathological tract that connects two organs or an organ to the skin and usually requires medical treatment. The □ indicates a missing or unreadable character; common real-word forms include “瘘管” or “瘻孔.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有瘺管，要開刀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 lau6 gun2, jiu3 hoi1 dou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他有瘘管，需要开刀。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has a fistula and needs surgery.

jyutping: lou6 bou1 (非標準／不確定讀音)
mandarin_meaning: 非標準詞彙，可能是打錯字或網絡俚語。單字「瘻」（瘘）在漢語中為醫學用語，指瘻管、瘘道（fistula）；後綴「bou」未能確定對應漢字或含義。
english_meaning: Not a standard Cantonese term — possibly a typo or online slang. The character 瘻 (瘘) is a medical term meaning 'fistula' or 'abnormal channel'; the 'bou' part is unclear and does not correspond to a recognized word on its own here.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 非標準詞 / 可能為片語或俚語
explanation_mandarin: 「瘻bou」不是常見或正式的廣東話詞彙。若單看「瘻」（瘘），是醫學名詞，指體內形成的異常通道（瘻管）。網絡或口語出現的「瘻bou」可能是打字錯誤、拼寫混合（漢字＋拉丁字母）或地區性俚語，具體意思需依上下文或原作者解釋。
explanation_english: “瘻bou” is not a recognized standard Cantonese word. The character 瘻 (瘘) alone is a medical noun meaning 'fistula' or an abnormal channel. The appended 'bou' (Latin letters) is unclear — it may be a typo, a mixed-script internet slang, or a local in-group term. Its meaning cannot be determined without context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話嗰樣嘢係「瘻bou」？我聽唔明，係乜嘢意思？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 go2 joeng6 je5 hai6 「lou6 bou1」? ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4, hai6 mat1 je5 ji3 si1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說那個東西是「瘻bou」？我聽不懂，這是什麼意思？
examples.english_sentence: You said that thing is '瘻bou'? I don't understand — what does that mean?

mandarin_meaning: 治疗；医治；疗法
english_meaning: to cure; to heal; treatment; therapy
explanation_mandarin: 表示對疾病或創傷進行治療或使身心復原，常用於合成詞如「治療」「療程」「療癒」。
explanation_english: Denotes healing or treatment of illness or wounds, or restoring physical/emotional well‑being; commonly appears in compounds such as 'treatment' (治療), 'course of treatment' (療程), and 'to heal/therapeutic' (療癒).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要繼續治療先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 gai3 zuk6 zi6 liu4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要继续治疗才行。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you need to continue treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲療程要做幾多次？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 liu4 cing4 jiu3 zou6 gei2 do1 ci3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些疗程要做多少次？
examples.english_sentence: How many sessions of this treatment are needed?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽音樂對佢好有療癒作用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jam1 ngok6 deoi3 keoi5 hou2 jau5 liu4 jyu6 zok3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听音乐对他/她很有疗愈作用。
examples.english_sentence: Listening to music is very therapeutic for him/her.

mandarin_meaning: 療傷 / 疗伤：治療身體或心靈的創傷，恢復傷口或情感上的痛楚。
english_meaning: to heal wounds (physical or emotional); to recover from emotional hurt
explanation_mandarin: 「療傷」可以指醫療或處理身體上的傷口，也常用來比喻透過各種方式（如旅行、休息、傾訴）修復心靈上的創傷或恢復情緒。
explanation_english: “療傷” can mean treating physical wounds or, metaphorically, healing emotional pain — recovering from hurt through rest, travel, talking, or other means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想去旅行療傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 liu4 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想透過旅行療傷。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to heal his wounds by traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失戀之後佢要一段時間先可以療傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 jiu3 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan1 sin1 ho2 ji5 liu4 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失戀後他需要一段時間才能療傷。
examples.english_sentence: After the breakup, he needs some time to heal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 護士幫佢療傷同止血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 si6 bong1 keoi5 liu4 soeng1 tung4 zi2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 護士幫他療傷並止血。
examples.english_sentence: The nurse treated his wound and stopped the bleeding.

mandarin_meaning: 疗效，治疗效果
english_meaning: therapeutic effect; efficacy; effectiveness of a treatment or medicine
explanation_mandarin: 指藥物或治療方法對疾病的治療成效或效果，常用於醫學、藥物評估與臨床研究中。
explanation_english: Refers to the effect or effectiveness of a medicine or treatment in curing or improving a disease; commonly used in medical, pharmacological, and clinical research contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種藥嘅療效幾好，病人情況改善咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 joek6 ge3 liu4 haau6 gei2 hou2, beng6 jan4 cing4 fong3 goi2 sin6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種藥的療效很好，病人的情況改善了。
examples.english_sentence: The therapeutic effect of this medicine is good; the patient's condition has improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臨床試驗未證明呢個療法有冇持久嘅療效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 cong4 si3 jim6 mei6 zing3 ming4 ni1 go3 liu4 faat3 jau5 mou5 ci4 gau2 ge3 liu4 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 臨床試驗尚未證明這種療法是否有持久的療效。
examples.english_sentence: Clinical trials have not yet proven whether this therapy has lasting efficacy.

mandarin_meaning: 疗法 (指用于治疗疾病或症状的方法)
english_meaning: therapy; treatment method
explanation_mandarin: 指用来治疗疾病或症状的方法或手段，常用于医学或康复场景，例如物理疗法、药物疗法等。
explanation_english: Refers to a method or technique used to treat an illness or medical condition; commonly used in medical or rehabilitation contexts (e.g., physical therapy, drug therapy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個療法已經幫咗佢好大忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 liu4faat3 ji5ging1 bong1 zo2 keoi5 hou2 daai6 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个疗法已经帮了他很多忙。
examples.english_sentence: This therapy has already helped him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想試下物理療法定係藥物療法？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 si3 haa5 mat6 lei5 liu4faat3 ding6 hai6 joek6mat6 liu4faat3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想尝试物理疗法还是药物疗法？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to try physical therapy or medication-based therapy?

mandarin_meaning: 疗程（指一段醫療或治療的過程或一系列療法，通常以次數或周期計算）
english_meaning: treatment course; course of therapy; regimen (a series of medical treatments or therapy sessions, often defined by number of sessions or duration)
explanation_mandarin: 指為治療某種疾病或症狀而進行的一段連續醫療程序或一系列療法，常以多少個療程或週期來計算。
explanation_english: Refers to a continuous sequence of medical procedures or a series of therapy sessions intended to treat an illness or condition; typically measured by number of sessions or duration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我要做三個療程嘅化療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 zou6 saam1 go3 liu4 cing4 ge3 faa3 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我要做三个疗程的化疗。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I have to undergo three courses of chemotherapy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完整個療程，你可以慢慢恢復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 zing2 go3 liu4 cing4, nei5 ho2 ji5 maan6 maan6 wui1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完整个疗程，你可以慢慢恢复。
examples.english_sentence: After completing the treatment course, you can gradually recover.

mandarin_meaning: 疗养；休养、调理身体以恢复健康
english_meaning: to recuperate; to convalesce; to undergo rest and medical care to recover health
explanation_mandarin: 指为了恢复健康而接受治疗或休息，常到疗养院或安静处调理身体以恢复体力和健康。
explanation_english: Refers to resting and receiving medical care or treatment to recover health; often involves staying in a sanatorium or a quiet place to recuperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗之後要去山上療養幾個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6 jiu3 heoi3 saan1 soeng5 liu4 joeng5 gei2 go3 jyut6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了之后要去山上疗养几个月。
examples.english_sentence: After his illness, he needs to go to the mountains to recuperate for a few months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議佢出院後到療養院療養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 keoi5 ceot1 jyun2 hau6 dou3 liu4 joeng5 jyun2 liu4 joeng5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议她出院后到疗养院疗养。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor advised her to go to a convalescent home after discharge.

mandarin_meaning: 療養院（供病後康復或長期休養的機構）
english_meaning: sanatorium; convalescent home; a facility for long-term recovery and care
explanation_mandarin: 指提供康復、休養或長期照護的機構，常用於病後恢復或慢性病、老人需要長期照護的情況。
explanation_english: An institution that provides recovery, rest, or long-term care; commonly used for convalescence after illness or for chronic patients and the elderly who need extended care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為中風，要去療養院康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zung1 fung1, jiu3 heoi3 liu4 joeng5 jyun2 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為中風，要去療養院康復。
examples.english_sentence: He needs to go to a sanatorium to recover after a stroke.

mandarin_meaning: （旧称）痨、肺痨，指肺结核等消耗性传染病
english_meaning: tuberculosis; pulmonary tuberculosis; consumption (old term for wasting infectious disease)
explanation_mandarin: 「癆」多用於舊時醫學術語，常指肺癆或痨病，即肺結核等以消耗為特徵的傳染性疾病。有時亦泛指消耗性疾病。
explanation_english: The character 癆 is an old medical term referring to consumption, especially pulmonary tuberculosis. It can denote TB or other wasting infectious diseases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有肺癆，要定期去醫院覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 fei6 lou4, jiu3 ding6 kei4 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 fuk1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得了肺痨，需要定期去医院复诊。
examples.english_sentence: He has pulmonary tuberculosis and needs to visit the hospital regularly for follow-ups.

mandarin_meaning: 癫痫；抽搐（亦可指俗稱的發脾氣、鬧脾氣）
english_meaning: epilepsy; convulsion; fit (also colloquially: tantrum)
explanation_mandarin: 「癇」常見於醫學詞彙如「癲癇」，指腦神經系統的反覆性發作（抽搐、意識改變等）；在口語中也見於「癇癪」等，表示發脾氣或耍性子。
explanation_english: The character "癇" appears in medical terms such as "癲癇" (epilepsy), referring to recurrent neurological seizures (convulsions, altered consciousness). Colloquially it appears in compounds like "癇癪" to mean throwing a tantrum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有癲癇，醫生教佢點樣控制發作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 din1 hin4, ji1 sang1 gaau3 keoi5 dim2 joeng6 hung3 zai3 faat3 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有癫痫，医生教他怎样控制发作。
examples.english_sentence: He has epilepsy; the doctor taught him how to control the seizures.

mandarin_meaning: 膿腫；古書中指皮膚的腫瘡（亦有記載為罵怒、怨恨之意，今用較罕見）
english_meaning: abscess; festering sore (rare/archaic; historically also used for resentment/anger)
explanation_mandarin: “癊”為一個較罕見的漢字，傳統語境多指皮膚上的膿瘡或腫塊；文獻中亦有作為怨恨、憤怒的記載。現代漢語中少用，見於醫古文或詞典註釋中。
explanation_english: “癊” is a rare/archaic character that traditionally refers to an abscess or a festering skin sore; literary sources sometimes record meanings related to resentment or anger. It is seldom used in modern speech and appears mainly in historical medical texts or dictionaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手起咗個癊，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 hei2 zo2 go3 jan2, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手上长了一个癊，需要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He has developed an abscess on his hand and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 癌（常用於「癌症」指惡性腫瘤）
english_meaning: cancer (malignant tumor; often used in compounds like 'cancer' as a disease)
explanation_mandarin: 「癌」指身體細胞異常、失控生長形成的惡性腫瘤，常見用法為「癌症」。
explanation_english: Refers to malignant growths where cells proliferate uncontrollably; commonly used in compounds like 'cancer' (as a disease).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被診斷出有癌症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 zan2 dyun6 ceot1 jau5 ngaam4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被诊断出有癌症。
examples.english_sentence: He was diagnosed with cancer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗化療之後，佢嘅癌細胞有啲減少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 faa3 liu4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 ngaam4 sai3 baau1 jau5 di1 gaam2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了化疗之后，他的癌细胞有所减少。
examples.english_sentence: After chemotherapy, his cancer cells were somewhat reduced.

mandarin_meaning: 癌症（恶性肿瘤）
english_meaning: cancer (malignant tumor)
explanation_mandarin: 由細胞異常增生形成的一類惡性疾病，會在不同器官形成腫瘤並可能擴散（轉移）。
explanation_english: A group of malignant diseases caused by abnormal and uncontrolled cell growth that form tumors and may spread (metastasize) to other parts of the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為癌症要接受化療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 ngaam4 zing3 jiu3 zip3 sau6 faa3 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為癌症要接受化療。
examples.english_sentence: He has to undergo chemotherapy because of cancer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早期發現可以提高癌症存活率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 kei4 faat3 jin6 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 ngaam4 zing3 cyun4 wut6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早期发现可以提高癌症存活率。
examples.english_sentence: Early detection can improve cancer survival rates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢冇癌症，係良性腫瘤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 mou5 ngaam4 zing3, hai6 loeng4 sing3 zung2 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他没有癌症，是良性肿瘤。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he doesn't have cancer; it's a benign tumor.

mandarin_meaning: 癫痫（癎/癇）：一種神經系統的發作性疾病，常表現為癲癇發作
english_meaning: Epilepsy; seizure (medical condition)
explanation_mandarin: 「癎」為「癇/癲癇」相關用字，指癲癇或發作性抽搐等神經系統疾病，常用於醫學或日常描述發作情況。
explanation_english: The character refers to epilepsy (seizure disorder) or related seizure conditions. Used in medical contexts or everyday speech to describe seizure episodes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有癎，發作嘅時候要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 haan6, faat3 zok3 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有癫痫，发作的时候要小心。
examples.english_sentence: He has epilepsy — be careful when he has a seizure.

mandarin_meaning: 病；生病（罕用字）
english_meaning: illness; to be sick (rare/archaic character)
explanation_mandarin: 「癐」為罕用字，帶有病、患病之意，多見於古籍或人名用字，現代粵語中很少使用。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character conveying the idea of illness or being sick. It is seldom used in modern Cantonese and mainly appears in classical texts or as part of names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日覺得身體唔舒服，好似有癐，應該去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 san1 tai2 m4 syu1 fuk6, hou2 ci5 jau5 gok3, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常覺得身體不舒服，好像有病，應該去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He often feels unwell, as if he has an illness; he should see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 又髒又破、邋遢、破爛不堪
english_meaning: scruffy; filthy; ragged; shabby
explanation_mandarin: 粤語俗語或口語用法，形容衣物、地方或人的樣子又舊又髒、整齊度差，看起來破爛或邋遢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe clothing, places, or people that look old, dirty, shabby, or unkempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫癐癩癩，已經好耐冇洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 au3 laai6 laai6, ji5 ging1 hou2 noi6 mou5 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服又舊又髒，已經很久沒洗了。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are scruffy and dirty; they haven't been washed for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條街癐癩癩，垃圾堆得好亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gaai1 au3 laai6 laai6, laap6 saap3 deoi1 dak1 hou2 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條街又髒又亂，垃圾堆得很亂。
examples.english_sentence: That street is filthy and messy; the garbage is piled up chaotically.

mandarin_meaning: 愈／癒（治癒、痊愈）
english_meaning: to heal; to recover (from illness or wound)
explanation_mandarin: 表示傷口或疾病恢復、痊癒。多用於複合詞，如「痊癒」「癒合」。
explanation_english: Indicates healing or recovery from illness or injury. Commonly appears in compounds such as "痊癒" and "癒合".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傷口已經癒合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 hau2 ji5 ging1 jyu6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伤口已经愈合了。
examples.english_sentence: The wound has already healed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾次治療，佢終於痊癒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 ci3 zi6 liu4, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 cyun4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几次治疗，他终于痊愈了。
examples.english_sentence: After several treatments, he finally recovered.

mandarin_meaning: （傷口、組織或骨骼）愈合、復原
english_meaning: to heal; healing; union (of a wound, tissue, or bone)
explanation_mandarin: 指傷口、組織或骨骼等恢復連接、癒合成為完整結構，常用於醫學或書面語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the process by which a wound, tissue, or bone restores continuity and becomes healed or united; commonly used in medical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傷口已經癒合，唔使縫針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 hau2 ji5 ging1 jyu6 hap6, m4 sai2 fung4 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伤口已经愈合，不需要缝针。
examples.english_sentence: The wound has already healed; no stitches are needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 骨折之後，骨頭已經癒合，醫生話可以開始復健。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwat1 zit3 zi1 hau6, gwat1 tau4 ji5 ging1 jyu6 hap6, ji1 sang1 waa6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 fuk6 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骨折之后，骨头已经愈合，医生说可以开始复健。
examples.english_sentence: After the fracture, the bone has united; the doctor says rehabilitation can begin.

mandarin_meaning: 癖（pǐ）：癖好、嗜好，指個人特殊而固定的習慣或癖性。
english_meaning: a peculiarity or habit; a penchant, obsession, or odd liking
explanation_mandarin: 指個人奇怪或特殊的嗜好或習慣，常帶有固定且難改的特性，例如怪癖或嗜好。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's peculiar or habitual liking or obsession, often fixed and difficult to change (e.g., a quirk or fetish).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有個怪癖，好鍾意半夜食朱古力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 go3 gwaai3 pik3, hou2 zung1 ji3 bun3 je6 sik6 zyu1 gu2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有個怪癖，很喜歡半夜吃巧克力。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strange habit — he loves eating chocolate late at night.

mandarin_meaning: 癖好（pǐhào）：個人癖性、嗜好或特殊的習慣
english_meaning: a personal habit, peculiarity, or hobby; an eccentric preference or penchant
explanation_mandarin: 指個人特有的喜好或習慣，常帶有一定的奇癖或嗜性，可指正面（興趣、愛好）或負面（怪癖）。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's particular liking, habit, or eccentric preference. It can denote a harmless hobby or a quirky/odd habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有啲奇怪嘅癖好，鍾意收集舊火車模型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 di1 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 pik1 hou3, zung1 ji3 sau1 zaap6 gau6 fo2 ce1 mou4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有些奇怪的癖好，喜欢收集旧火车模型。
examples.english_sentence: He has some strange quirks — he likes collecting old train models.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦小、凹陷；（口語、貶義）沒出息、可憐的人（如“癟三”）
english_meaning: sunken/deflated; shrunken or scrawny; colloquially: a pathetic/loser (as in slang '癟三')
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / verb (also slang noun in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體凹陷或變扁、變瘦；在口語或俚語中可用來形容人可憐、沒出息（如“癟三”）。也可指輪胎等沒氣而塌下。
explanation_english: Denotes something that is sunken, deflated or shrunken. In colloquial/slang use it can describe a pitiable or unsuccessful person (e.g., '癟三'). Also used for deflated tires or objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架單車個車胎癟咗，要打氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 daan1 ce1 go3 ce1 taai1 bit3 zo2, jiu3 daa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 腳踏車的輪胎沒氣了，要打氣。
examples.english_sentence: The bicycle tire is flat and needs air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，做嘢又唔靠得住，真係個癟三。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, zou6 je5 jau6 m4 kaau3 dak1 zyu6, zan1 hai6 go3 bit3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說謊，做事又不可靠，真是個癟三（沒出息的人）。
examples.english_sentence: He always lies and is unreliable—what a loser.

mandarin_meaning: 痴（愚蠢、癡迷、執著）
english_meaning: foolish; crazy; infatuated/obsessed
explanation_mandarin: 表示愚蠢、瘋狂或過度執著、癡迷。在粵語口語中常與其他字組成俗語或詞語（如「癡線」、「癡情」），也可用來描述對人或事物的痴迷。
explanation_english: Indicates foolishness, craziness, or excessive infatuation/obsession. In Cantonese it commonly appears in colloquial expressions and compounds (e.g., '癡線' meaning 'crazy', '癡情' meaning 'infatuated'), and can describe someone being overly attached or obsessed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁癡線啦，冷靜啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 ci1 sin3 laa1, laang5 zing6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別這麼瘋狂，冷靜一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so crazy, calm down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對嗰位女仔好癡，成日望住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 go2 wai2 neoi5 zai2 hou2 ci1, seng4 jat6 mong6 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對那個女生很癡情，整天盯著她。
examples.english_sentence: He's infatuated with that girl, always staring at her.

mandarin_meaning: 痴呆；（尤指老年）失智症；愚笨
english_meaning: dementia; senile dementia; dull/stupid (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 指大腦認知功能下降，常用於醫學上表示失智症；在口語中也可用來形容人愚笨或反應遲鈍。
explanation_english: Refers to decline in cognitive function, often used medically to mean dementia (especially senile dementia); colloquially can describe someone as dull or slow to respond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿婆有老年癡呆，需要人照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 po4 jau5 lou5 nin4 ci1 doi6, seoi1 jiu3 jan4 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他奶奶有老年痴呆，需要人照顾。
examples.english_sentence: His grandmother has senile dementia and needs someone to look after her.

mandarin_meaning: 痴心；對某人或某事過分執著或痴迷，常帶有傻氣或不切實際的感覺
english_meaning: infatuated; blindly devoted or hopelessly in love; foolishly attached
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can also be used as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對某人或某事抱有深切而不切實際的執著或迷戀，有時含有傻氣或盲目的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a deep, often unrealistic or foolish attachment or infatuation toward someone or something; can imply blind devotion or naivety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅舊愛仲癡心，放唔低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 gau6 oi3 zung6 ci1 sam1, fong3 m4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對他的舊愛還很癡心，放不下。
examples.english_sentence: He's still infatuated with his ex and can't let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好癡心妄想佢會改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ci1 sam1 mong6 soeng2 keoi5 wui5 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別癡心妄想他會改變。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fool yourself into thinking he'll change.

mandarin_meaning: 痴心妄想（抱有不切實際的幻想）
english_meaning: to indulge in vain or unrealistic fantasies; wishful thinking
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作動詞或形容詞）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (can function as verb or adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 表示抱有不切實際的希望或幻想，常帶貶義，用於勸阻或批評別人的不現實想法。
explanation_english: Expresses holding unrealistic hopes or delusions; usually pejorative and used to discourage or criticize someone's unrealistic thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲以為佢會返嚟？唔好癡心妄想啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 ji5wai6 keoi5 wui5 faan1 lai4? m4 hou2 ci1 sam1 mong6 soeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你還以為他會回來？別痴心妄想了。
examples.english_sentence: You still think he'll come back? Don't be delusional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為可以贏，真係癡心妄想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5wai6 ho2 ji5 jing4 dou3, zan1 hai6 ci1 sam1 mong6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以為可以贏，真是痴心妄想。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he could win — that's truly wishful thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 形容過於矯情、煽情或做作的浪漫言行（帶戲謔或諷刺意味）
english_meaning: A playful/sarcastic term for overly sentimental, melodramatic, or affected romantic behaviour or lines; literally "lovesick long sword."
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語 / 名詞或形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 網絡或口語俗語，帶有戲謔或諷刺意味，用來形容過於矯情、煽情或做作的浪漫言行。字面上把「情」擬人化並用武俠誇張的「長劍」意象，常用於調侃，屬非正式或新興用法。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression (often used online) to tease or mock behaviour or lines that are overly sentimental, melodramatic, or affected. The literal image — a 'lovesick long sword' — evokes wuxia-style exaggeration, so it's mainly a humorous or sarcastic, informal term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺講台上念嗰段情詩，簡直係癡心情長劍，台下笑咗成場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gong2 toi4 soeng6 nim6 go2 dyun6 cing4 si1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ci1 sam1 cing4 coeng4 gim3, toi4 haa6 siu3 zo2 seng4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在講台上念那段情詩，簡直就是癡心情長劍，台下全場都笑了。
examples.english_sentence: When he recited that love poem on stage, it was pure '癡心情長劍' — the whole audience laughed.

mandarin_meaning: 痴心錯付（把真心、愛情付錯人/付給不值得的人）
english_meaning: To give one's wholehearted love or devotion to the wrong person; misplaced affection or devotion.
explanation_mandarin: 表示把自己的真心或愛情傻傻地付給不值得或錯誤的人，常帶有遺憾、後悔和失望的情緒。
explanation_english: A phrase describing the act of giving sincere love or devotion to someone undeserving or the wrong person; often conveys regret, disappointment, or unrequited feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發覺自己癡心錯付咗，原來佢根本唔鍾意我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 gok3 zi6 gei2 ci1 sam1 co3 fu6 zo2, jyun4 loi4 keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 zung1 ji3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我發覺自己痴心錯付了，原來他根本不喜歡我。
examples.english_sentence: I realized I'd misplaced my devotion — it turns out he doesn't like me at all.

mandarin_meaning: 痴情 (chīqíng)：對感情執著、深情或容易為愛情著迷
english_meaning: infatuated; lovesick; deeply devoted in love
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人對愛情非常投入或執著，常帶有痴迷或難以放手的意味，既可表讚賞的深情，也可含貶義表示盲目。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is deeply infatuated or emotionally devoted—often lovesick or obsessively attached. Can be used positively (deeply loving) or negatively (blindly infatuated).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁癡情，就算俾人傷害都唔肯放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 ci1 cing4, zau6 syun3 bei2 jan4 soeng1 hoi6 dou1 m4 hang2 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那麼痴情，就算被人傷害也不肯放手。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lovesick/devoted that even when he's hurt he won't let go.

mandarin_meaning: 猥褻犯；色狼（尤指在公共場合，尤其是交通工具上對他人進行摸索或性騷擾的男子）
english_meaning: pervert; sexual molester—especially a man who gropes people (often on public transport)
explanation_mandarin: 「癡漢」用來形容做出猥褻、摸索行為的男子，常指在擁擠的車廂或公共場所趁機對他人進行性騷擾的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who behaves like a sexual molester or pervert, often groping others in crowded public places such as trains or buses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果見到有人喺車廂入面摸人，應該報警，唔好畀癡漢得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 hai2 ce1 soeng1 jap6 min6 mo1 jan4, jing1 goi1 bou3 ging2, m4 hou2 bei2 ci1 hon3 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果看到有人在車廂裡猥褻他人，應該報警，不要讓癡漢得逞。
examples.english_sentence: If you see someone groping others on the train, you should call the police—don't let the pervert get away with it.

jyutping: ci1 ci1 daai1 daai1, co5 maai4 jat1 toi4
mandarin_meaning: 傻傻地坐在一起（通常形容戀愛中的兩人或心不在焉）
english_meaning: to sit together in a dazed/silly way — often used to describe lovers who are lovestruck and oblivious to their surroundings
explanation_mandarin: 「癡癡呆呆，坐埋一枱」是廣東話口語，形容兩個人傻傻、入神或戀愛中，緊貼或坐在同一張桌子上，顯得對周圍事物漠不關心。
explanation_english: This Cantonese colloquial phrase describes two people sitting together in a dazed or lovestruck way, often implying they are infatuated or inattentive to their surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日癡癡呆呆，坐埋一枱，好似世界只得佢哋兩個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 ci1 ci1 daai1 daai1, co5 maai4 jat1 toi4, hou2 ci5 sai3 gaai3 zi2 dak1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們經常傻傻地坐在一起，好像世界只有他們兩個。
examples.english_sentence: They often sit together dazedly, as if the world only contains the two of them.

mandarin_meaning: 傻傻地 / 呆呆地
english_meaning: foolishly; blankly; absent-mindedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種傻傻地、發呆或神情恍惚的狀態，常用於口語，帶有輕微的感情色彩（有時可帶同情或揶揄）。
explanation_english: An adverb describing a foolish, blank, or absent-minded manner. Commonly used colloquially, sometimes conveying sympathy or mild teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢癡癡哋望住窗外，乜都唔講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci1 ci1 dei6 mong6 zyu6 coeng1 ngoi6, mat1 dou1 m4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他傻傻地望著窗外，什麼也不說。
examples.english_sentence: He stared blankly out the window, saying nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好癡癡哋等佢，佢可能唔會返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ci1 ci1 dei6 dang2 keoi5, keoi5 ho2 nang4 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別傻傻地等他，他可能不會回來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wait for him foolishly; he might not come back.

mandarin_meaning: 傻傻地；呆呆地
english_meaning: sillyly; dazedly; absentmindedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示傻乎乎、呆呆地的样子，多用来形容人沉醉、迟钝或走神的状态。常用作副词。
explanation_english: Describes a silly, dazed, or absentminded manner; often used to depict someone who is daydreaming, infatuated, or not fully aware. Used as an adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢癡癡地望住你，唔知發生乜嘢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci1 ci1 dei6 mong6 zyu6 nei5, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 mat1 je5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他呆呆地望着你，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He is staring at you absentmindedly, not knowing what's happening.

mandarin_meaning: 瘋了／發瘋／說荒唐的話
english_meaning: crazy / insane / ridiculous / nonsense (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來形容某人行為或說話很瘋狂、不合理，或作為責問別人是否『瘋了』的感嘆語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone or something as crazy, insane, or ridiculous; also used as an exclamation to ask if someone is out of their mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你癡線呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ci1 sin3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你瘋了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you crazy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要喺颱風吹到入嚟都唔走，真係癡線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 hai6 toi4 fung1 ceoi1 dou3 jap6 lai4 dou1 m4 zau2, zan1 hai6 ci1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說就算颱風來了也不走，真是瘋了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd stay even if the typhoon came; that's really crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰啲嘢真係癡線，冇道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 zan1 hai6 ci1 sin3, mou5 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那些話真是荒唐，沒有道理。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is insane; it doesn't make any sense.

mandarin_meaning: 纠缠；缠住不放
english_meaning: to pester/clamor; to cling or be obsessively entangled
explanation_mandarin: 表示反复纠缠、不肯放手。既可指某人对別人的纠缠（如不停打扰、缠着不放），也可指对事情或感情的执迷不放。
explanation_english: Indicates repeatedly pestering or refusing to let go. Can refer to someone persistently bothering or clinging to another person, or being obsessively hung up on something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日癡纏唔放，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci1 cin4 m4 fong3, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天纠缠不放，真是很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps pestering and won't let go; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對前度癡纏，唔肯放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 cin4 dou6 ci1 cin4, m4 hang2 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她对前任纠缠不休，不肯放手。
examples.english_sentence: She clings to her ex and won't let go.

mandarin_meaning: （口語／俚語）形容人或動物圓潤、胖嘟嘟，常帶調侃或愛稱意味。
english_meaning: Slang for chubby/plump (often affectionate or teasing).
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話俗語，用來形容人或動物有點胖、圓潤，語氣可愛或帶玩笑、輕微貶義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang adjective describing someone or an animal as chubby/round. It can be affectionate or teasing, and may be mildly derogatory depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻小貓好癡肥，好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 siu2 maau1 hou2 ci1 fei4, hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻小貓胖嘟嘟的，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: That kitten is chubby and very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好叫人癡肥，佢可能會唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 giu3 jan4 ci1 fei4, keoi5 ho2 nang4 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別用「癡肥」叫別人，可能會讓人不高興。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call someone 'chi fei' — they might get upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仔愈食愈癡肥，成日笑到冇停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zai2 jyu6 sik6 jyu6 ci1 fei4, seng4 jat6 siu3 dou3 mou5 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他孩子越吃越胖嘟嘟，整天笑個不停。
examples.english_sentence: His kid is getting chubbier the more he eats, always laughing nonstop.

mandarin_meaning: （對…）痴迷、著迷、沉溺
english_meaning: obsessed; infatuated; fascinated
explanation_mandarin: 形容對某人或某事非常著迷、無法自拔，可作形容詞或動詞使用。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely fascinated or obsessed with someone or something, unable to pull oneself away; can function as an adjective or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對足球癡迷到冇得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zuk1 kau4 ci1 mai4 dou3 mou5 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對足球痴迷到沒救。
examples.english_sentence: He's so obsessed with football there's no saving him.

mandarin_meaning: 痒（形容词/名词）
english_meaning: itchy; itch
explanation_mandarin: 表示皮膚或身體某處有想搔抓的感覺，也可指比喻性想做某事（如「手癢」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the sensation of wanting to scratch a part of the skin; can also be used figuratively (e.g., "itchy hands" to mean an urge to act).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成身好癢，要搔一搔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 san1 hou2 joeng5, jiu3 sou1 jat1 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我全身很癢，要抓一抓。
examples.english_sentence: My whole body is very itchy; I need to scratch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我畀蚊咬咗，嗰度好癢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei6 man1 ngaau5 zo2, go2 dou6 hou2 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被蚊子咬了，那裡很癢。
examples.english_sentence: I got bitten by a mosquito; that spot is very itchy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到啲新電子用品就手癢，成日買嚟買去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 di1 san1 din6 zi2 jung6 ban2 zau6 sau2 joeng5, sing4 jat6 maai5 loi4 maai5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到新的電子用品就手癢，總是買來買去。
examples.english_sentence: He gets "itchy hands" when he sees new gadgets — always buying them.

mandarin_meaning: （1）症，指疾病或症狀（讀作 zhèng）；（2）癥結，指問題的要害或癥結所在（讀作 zhēng）。
english_meaning: 1) (medical) disease / syndrome / symptom; 2) (figurative, in 癥結) the crux or sticking point of a problem.
explanation_mandarin: 「癥」在醫學語境多作「症」（如抑鬱症、心臟病等），表示疾病或症狀；在書面或成語中常見於「癥結」，表示問題的關鍵或要害。
explanation_english: In medical contexts, 癥 corresponds to '症' meaning a disease, syndrome, or symptom. In written/idiomatic use (as in 癥結) it means the crux or core issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 問題嘅癥結喺於溝通唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man6 tai4 ge3 zing1 git3 hai2 jyu1 gau1 tung1 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 问题的癥结在于沟通不足。
examples.english_sentence: The crux of the problem lies in insufficient communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有抑鬱癥，建議佢去睇精神科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 jik1 wat1 zing3, gin3 ji3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 zing1 san4 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他患有抑郁症，建议他去看精神科。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has depression and recommended he see a psychiatrist.

mandarin_meaning: 症结（问题的关键或根源）
english_meaning: crux; the crux of the matter; the root or key point of a problem
explanation_mandarin: 指問題的關鍵或癥結所在，原指醫學上的病理結節，現多用於比喻事物的關鍵或症結。
explanation_english: Refers to the pivotal point or root cause of a problem. Originally a medical term for a pathological knot, now commonly used figuratively to denote the key issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅癥結唔係錢，而係信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 zing1git3 m4 hai6 cin2, ji4 hai6 seon3jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的症结不是钱，而是信任。
examples.english_sentence: The crux of this matter isn't money; it's trust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵出問題嘅癥結先至可以對症下藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 ceot1 man6tai4 ge3 zing1git3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 deoi3 zing3 haa6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找出问题的症结才能对症下药。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find the root of the problem before we can apply the right remedy.

mandarin_meaning: 癤、疖（皮膚的膿腫、瘡）
english_meaning: boil; skin abscess; pustule
explanation_mandarin: 「癦」為較少見的漢字，常用來指皮膚上的膿腫或癤（俗稱瘡、膿包），屬於皮膚科的病變描述。現代口語也常以「瘡」、「疖」等字代替。
explanation_english: A rare/less-common character used to refer to a skin abscess or boil (a localized pus-filled swelling). In modern speech speakers often use words like "boil," "abscess," or "pustule."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手起咗一個癦，好痛，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 hei2 zo2 jat1 go3 git3, hou2 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手上長了個癤（膿腫），很痛，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has a boil on his hand. It's painful and he needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 癩（lài），一种皮肤病，常指疥疮或癞病，表现为皮肤瘙痒、结痂或溃烂，亦为古字或方言用字。
english_meaning: Scabies / a crusted skin disease (an old/dialectal term for skin disorders like scabies or leprosy).
explanation_mandarin: “癧”為古字或方言中用來指稱某些皮膚病（如癩、疥癬等）的詞，通常描述會造成皮膚搔癢、結痂或潰爛的病變。在廣東話中可見於口語或舊文獻中。
explanation_english: “癧” is an older/literary or dialectal character used to refer to certain skin diseases (such as scabies or crusted lesions). It describes conditions that cause itching, crusting, or ulceration of the skin and appears in Cantonese usage and historical texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有癧，要去睇大夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 laai6, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 daai6 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有癩，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He has scabies (a skin disease) and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 麻风病；（粤语口语中）作贬义或咒骂用字
english_meaning: leprosy; (in Cantonese slang) a derogatory/insulting term
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词；口语中可作贬义用
explanation_mandarin: 原为医学用语，指麻风病；在粤语俗语或口头语中也常用作骂人的词或语气加强词，带贬义，非正式场合使用需谨慎。
explanation_english: Originally a medical term meaning leprosy. In Cantonese colloquial speech it is also used as a derogatory term or an expletive to insult or intensify, and is informal/offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個病人被診斷出有癩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 beng6 jan4 bei6 zan2 dyun6 ceot1 jau5 laai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病人被诊断出患有麻风病。
examples.english_sentence: The patient was diagnosed with leprosy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，真係癩佬一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 laai6 lou2 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說謊，真是一個混蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He lies all the time; he's such a jerk.

mandarin_meaning: 癞渣（贬义）：指无耻、卑劣、可鄙的人，常用作辱骂用语
english_meaning: scumbag; despicable person; low-life (pejorative, slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「癩渣」是香港粵語俗語或罵人用語，字面上由「癩」（古指癩病）和「渣」（渣滓）組成，用來形容人卑劣、可恥或無恥，語氣粗俗且帶強烈貶義，應避免在正式場合使用。
explanation_english: “癩渣” is a Cantonese slang insult used in Hong Kong. Literally combining characters meaning 'leprosy' and 'dregs', it labels someone as despicable, shameless, or a scoundrel. It is vulgar and strongly pejorative, so avoid in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個癩渣成日借錢唔還，真係冇良心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 laai6 zaa1 sing4 jat6 ze3 cin2 m4 wun6, zan1 hai6 mou5 loeng4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个癞渣总是借钱不还，真是没有良心。
examples.english_sentence: That scumbag always borrows money and doesn't pay it back; really heartless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好無恥，根本就係個癩渣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 mou4 ci2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 go3 laai6 zaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很无耻，根本就是个癞渣。
examples.english_sentence: He's shameless in what he does; basically a scumbag.

mandarin_meaning: 原指皮膚病或痢疾；粵語口語中作貶稱，指卑鄙、可惡的人或事物
english_meaning: Literally refers to a skin disease or dysentery; in Cantonese slang a derogatory term for a despicable or filthy person/thing
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語口語裡常用作粗俗的貶稱，形容人卑鄙、下流或某事物令人厭惡。字面上與疾病相關，但作為罵人用法較常見。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, this is commonly used as a coarse derogatory term to describe someone despicable, low, or something disgusting. The literal characters relate to disease, but the insulting slang sense is far more common in speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個癩痢鬼，成日呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 laai6 lei6 gwai2, sing4 jat6 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個癩痢鬼，整天騙人。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a lowlife, always tricking people.
