explanation_english: In Cantonese, "白事" refers to funerals or affairs related to a death, including the funeral service and associated arrangements. Equivalent to Mandarin "喪事/喪禮" (funeral).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚八點要去參加佢叔叔嘅白事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 baat3 dim2 jiu3 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 keoi5 suk1 suk1 ge3 baak6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚八點要去參加他叔叔的喪事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go to his uncle's funeral tonight at 8.

mandarin_meaning: 白人 (báirén)
english_meaning: white person; Caucasian
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚較白的人，通常用來指歐洲或歐裔人士，也可泛指白種人。
explanation_english: Refers to people with lighter skin tones, typically used to denote Europeans or people of European descent (white people).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上見到好多白人遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 baak6 jan4 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在街上看到很多白人游客。
examples.english_sentence: I saw many white tourists on the street.

mandarin_meaning: 白俄罗斯 (Bái'éluósī)
english_meaning: Belarus
explanation_mandarin: 白俄罗斯是位于东欧的国家，首都是明斯克，曾为苏联加盟共和国之一，官方语言包括白俄罗斯语和俄语。
explanation_english: Belarus is a country in Eastern Europe whose capital is Minsk. It was a former Soviet republic; official languages include Belarusian and Russian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去白俄羅斯旅行，想睇明斯克嘅舊城區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 baak6 ngo4 lo4 si1 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 tai2 ming4 si1 hak1 ge3 gau6 sing4 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去白俄罗斯旅行，想看看明斯克的旧城区。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to Belarus to see Minsk's old town.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白俄羅斯係一個位於東歐嘅國家，首都係明斯克。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 ngo4 lo4 si1 hai6 jat1 go3 wai6 jyu1 dung1 au1 ge3 gwok3 gaa1, sau2 dou1 hai6 ming4 si1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白俄罗斯是一个位于东欧的国家，首都是明斯克。
examples.english_sentence: Belarus is a country in Eastern Europe; its capital is Minsk.

mandarin_meaning: 白費、徒勞；白白做事（也可指無酬地做事）
english_meaning: to do something in vain; to do work for nothing (wasted effort or unpaid work)
explanation_mandarin: 「白做」是廣東話的口語說法，表示所做的事情沒有收穫或沒有回報（徒勞無功），在某些語境下也可指無償地做事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that what one did was for nothing (no result or no reward). Depending on context it can also mean doing work without pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咁耐都冇回報，唔好再白做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 gam2 noi6 dou1 mou5 wui4 bou3, m4 hou2 zoi3 baak6 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做了那麼久都沒有回報，不要再白做了。
examples.english_sentence: You've been working so long without any returns; don't keep doing it for nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱做完，結果全部都白做咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 zou6 jyun4, git3 gwo2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 baak6 zou6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛做完，結果全部都白做了。
examples.english_sentence: I just finished, but it was all for nothing.

mandarin_meaning: 白兔（動物）；亦可指「白兔奶糖」這一知名糖果品牌
english_meaning: white rabbit (the animal); can also refer to the White Rabbit candy brand
explanation_mandarin: 「白兔」字面意思是白色的兔子，屬於動物名稱。在日常語境中，單說「白兔」也常用來指代中國著名的糖果品牌「白兔奶糖」。
explanation_english: Literally a white rabbit (the animal). In everyday use, "白兔" can also refer to the famous Chinese candy brand "White Rabbit" (White Rabbit Creamy Candy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺公園見到一隻白兔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 baak6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在公园看到一只白兔。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a white rabbit in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇試過白兔奶糖？好好食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 baak6 tou3 naai5 tong4? hou2 hou2 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有吃过白兔奶糖？很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: Have you tried White Rabbit candy? It's really tasty!

mandarin_meaning: 白兔糖（大白兔奶糖）
english_meaning: White Rabbit candy (a popular Chinese milk candy)
explanation_mandarin: 一种著名的中国奶味软糖品牌（通常称“大白兔奶糖”），产自上海，糖外常包有可食用的米纸。因其奶香及怀旧感在华人社区广受欢迎。
explanation_english: A well-known Chinese milk-flavored chewy candy brand (commonly called "Big White Rabbit"). Originating from Shanghai, the candy is often wrapped in an edible rice paper. It is popular across Chinese-speaking communities and evokes nostalgia for many.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個我成日食白兔糖，依家聞到奶香就好懷念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ngo5 sing4 jat6 sik6 baak6 tou3 tong4, ji1 gaa1 man4 dou3 naai5 hoeng1 zau6 hou2 waai4 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常吃白兔糖，现在闻到奶香就很怀念。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid I used to eat White Rabbit candy all the time; now the smell of milk makes me nostalgic.

mandarin_meaning: 白內障（báinèizhàng）
english_meaning: cataract (an eye condition causing clouding of the lens)
explanation_mandarin: 白內障是一種眼睛晶狀體混濁的疾病，會導致視力模糊或下降，常見於老年人，嚴重時通常需要手術治療並置換人工晶體。
explanation_english: A cataract is a condition where the eye's lens becomes cloudy, causing blurred or reduced vision. It is common in older adults and is often treated surgically by replacing the lens with an artificial one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽檢查出有白內障，醫生話要做手術改善視力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 gim2 caa4 ceot1 yau5 baak6 noi6 zoeng3，ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6 goi2 sin6 si6 lik6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈检查出有白内障，医生说需要做手术来改善视力。
examples.english_sentence: My mother was diagnosed with a cataract; the doctor said she needs surgery to improve her vision.

mandarin_meaning: （烹飪方式）白切（如白切雞）——把肉類用水煮熟、切塊，味道較清淡以保留原味
english_meaning: white-cut (a Cantonese cooking method, e.g. white-cut chicken) — poaching/boiling meat and serving it plain to preserve its original flavor
explanation_mandarin: 「白切」是廣東菜常見的烹調方式或菜名用法，通常指將雞或其他肉類以滾水或熱水煮熟後切件上桌，調味較淡，重視原汁原味。常見菜式如「白切雞」。
explanation_english: “白切” refers to a Cantonese cooking method and dish name, typically poaching chicken or other meats in hot water, cutting into pieces and serving with light seasoning or dipping sauce, emphasizing the meat's natural flavor. A common example is white-cut chicken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食白切雞啦，啲雞肉好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 baak6 cit3 gai1 laa1, di1 gai1 juk6 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃白切鸡，鸡肉很滑。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have white-cut chicken tonight; the chicken is very tender.

mandarin_meaning: 白切鸡 (báiqiē jī)
english_meaning: white-cut chicken; plain poached chicken served with dipping sauce
explanation_mandarin: 广东传统菜式，把鸡用温水或慢火煮熟后切块，保持鸡肉嫩滑，通常冷食并配姜葱油或其他蘸酱。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dish of poached chicken that is cooked gently, chopped, and served (often cold) to preserve tender meat, typically accompanied by ginger-scallion oil or other dipping sauces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間飯店嘅白切雞好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 faan6 dim3 ge3 baak6 cit3 gai1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家饭店的白切鸡很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's white-cut chicken is very famous.

mandarin_meaning: 白切鸡 (báiqiē jī)
english_meaning: white-cut chicken; poached (plain) chicken served chopped, a Cantonese dish
explanation_mandarin: 粤菜中的一道传统菜式，将整只鸡以熱水或鹽水輕滾至熟，保留雞肉的原汁原味，切件上桌，常配薑蔥油、豉油或蒜蓉醬食用，肉質嫩滑。
explanation_english: A traditional Cantonese dish consisting of a whole chicken gently poached (in hot or salted water), then chopped and served to preserve the natural flavor and tender texture. Commonly eaten with ginger-scallion oil, soy dipping sauce, or garlic sauce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食白切雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 baak6 cit3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃白切鸡。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat white-cut chicken tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白切雞好好味，肉好嫩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 cit3 gai1 hou2 hou2 mei6, juk6 hou2 non6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白切鸡很好吃，肉很嫩。
examples.english_sentence: The white-cut chicken is delicious; the meat is very tender.

mandarin_meaning: 白化病（白化症）
english_meaning: albinism
explanation_mandarin: 遺傳性疾病，因為黑色素生成不足或缺乏，導致皮膚、頭髮、眼睛等色素減少，常伴有視力問題。主要為醫學術語；在少數口語或網絡用法中，有時被比喻性地用來形容變白或失去顏色，但此用法較少且可能敏感。
explanation_english: A hereditary condition (albinism) caused by reduced or absent melanin production, resulting in very light skin, hair, and eyes and often associated with visual problems. Primarily a medical term; occasionally used metaphorically in casual or online contexts to describe whitening or loss of color, though such usage is uncommon and can be insensitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個患有白化病，皮膚同頭髮好淺，視力亦有問題，要定期檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 waan6 jau5 baak6faa3beng6, pei4fu1 tung4 tau4 faat3 hou2 cin2, si6lik6 jik6 jau5 man6tai4, jiu3 ding6kei4 gim2caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候患有白化病，皮膚和頭髮顏色很淺，視力也有問題，需要定期檢查。
examples.english_sentence: He had albinism as a child; his skin and hair are very light, and his vision also has problems, so he needs regular check-ups.

mandarin_meaning: 無訊號區；死角；盲區
english_meaning: dead zone (no signal coverage); blind spot
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有手機、無線或網絡訊號覆蓋的區域，也可比喻某範圍內資訊不足或不了解的盲點。
explanation_english: Refers to an area with no mobile/wireless/network signal coverage (a dead zone); can also be used figuratively for a blind spot where information is lacking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係白區，冇手機訊號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 baak6 keoi1, mou5 sau2 gei1 seon3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡是白區，沒有手機訊號。
examples.english_sentence: This place is a dead zone; there's no cell signal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條隧道成日係白區，打唔通電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 sing4 jat6 hai6 baak6 keoi1, daa2 m4 tung1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條隧道經常是白區，打不通電話。
examples.english_sentence: That tunnel is often a dead zone; calls won't go through.

mandarin_meaning: 白色的卡片；泛指空白或未填写、未注明用途的卡片。在某些语境（如香港口语）亦可用作指某些临时证件或凭证的俗称，具体含义视语境而定。
english_meaning: a white card; a blank or unfilled card. Colloquially (especially in Hong Kong) it can also refer to certain temporary cards or passes, depending on context.
explanation_mandarin: 「白卡」字面意思是白色的卡片，可指沒有書寫或標記的空白卡；在不同語境下可能引申為臨時證件、免費憑證或俗稱的某類卡片，需根據上下文判斷。
explanation_english: Literally a white card — meaning a blank or unmarked card. Depending on context it may be extended to mean a temporary ID, voucher, or a colloquial name for certain types of cards in Hong Kong; the exact sense depends on usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我拎住張白卡寫低啲電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ling1 zyu6 zoeng1 baak6 kaa1 se2 dai1 di1 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拿着一张白卡把一些电话号码记下来。
examples.english_sentence: I took a white card and jotted down some phone numbers.

mandarin_meaning: 白吃 / 白拿（免费吃东西）；有时指白费、徒劳
english_meaning: to eat for free; to freeload; (informally) to be wasted/for nothing
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指吃免費的東西或不付出代價而享受食物（搭便車、白拿）。2) 在某些語境中可引申為努力或付出最終沒得到回報（白費、徒勞）。
explanation_english: 1) To eat without paying or to get food for free (mooching). 2) In some contexts it can be extended to mean that effort or work ends up wasted/no result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟我屋企白吃白飲，唔幫手洗碗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4jat6 lei4 ngo5 uk1kei2 baak6 hek3 baak6 jam2 , m4 bong1 sau2 sai2 wun2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常到我家白吃白喝，從不幫忙洗碗。
examples.english_sentence: He often comes to my place to mooch food and drinks and never helps wash the dishes.

mandarin_meaning: （口語、貶義）愚蠢、像白痴一樣
english_meaning: (colloquial, pejorative) stupid; an idiot; being foolish
explanation_mandarin: 「白咋」為粵語口語俗語，用來罵人或形容某人行為愚蠢、笨拙，相當於「白痴／傻瓜」。屬於非正式、帶貶義的用法，主要在香港粵語口語中出現（區域用法可能較少見）。
explanation_english: '白咋' is a colloquial Cantonese slang term used pejoratively to call someone stupid or foolish (similar to 'idiot' or 'moron'). It is informal and regionally used in Cantonese-speaking contexts (chiefly Hong Kong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做真係白咋，根本唔會有用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zan1 hai6 baak6 zaa3, gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 jau5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做真是很蠢，根本沒用。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this is really stupid; it won't work at all.

mandarin_meaning: 白卡；空白卡片（用于书写或记录资料的未印字卡片）
english_meaning: white card; blank card (a plain card without printing used for writing or recording information)
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有印刷文字或圖案的卡片，常用於讓人填寫聯絡資料、留言或作臨時記錄。在香港書寫“card”常用「咭」字，故稱「白咭」。
explanation_english: Refers to a card that has no printing or design—used for writing contact details, messages, or temporary notes. In Hong Kong Cantonese the character 咭 is commonly used for 'card', hence 'white card'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司仲有好多白咭，可以俾客人寫聯絡資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 baak6 kaat1, ho2 ji5 bei2 haak3 jan4 se2 lyun4 lok3 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司还有很多白卡，可以给客人写联络资料。
examples.english_sentence: Our company still has many blank cards that we can give customers to write their contact information.

mandarin_meaning: 空地；沒有建築或覆蓋物的土地
english_meaning: vacant lot; bare ground
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有建築物或覆蓋物的空曠土地，常用於描述待開發或供臨時用途的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to land without buildings or coverings — a vacant lot or bare ground, often describing land awaiting development or used temporarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰塊白地準備起高層住宅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 faai3 baak6 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hei2 gou1 cang4 zyu6 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊空地準備興建高層住宅。
examples.english_sentence: That vacant lot is going to be developed into high-rise residential buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有一塊白地，好啱擺臨時停車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 jat1 faai3 baak6 dei6, hou2 aam1 baai2 lam4 si4 ting4 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡有一塊空地，很適合臨時停車。
examples.english_sentence: There's a vacant lot here, suitable for temporary parking.

mandarin_meaning: 白天 (báitiān)，白昼，日间
english_meaning: daytime; during the day
explanation_mandarin: 指从天亮到天黑的时间段，也可表示“在白天（而非晚上）”的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to the period of daylight between sunrise and sunset; can also mean 'during the day' as opposed to at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白天好熱，夜晚先舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 tin1 hou2 jit6, je6 maan5 sin1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白天很热，晚上才舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot during the day; it's only more comfortable at night.

mandarin_meaning: 白天鹅
english_meaning: white swan
explanation_mandarin: 指一種白色的水禽，羽毛潔白、頸長，常在湖泊或河面游動；也可比喻舉止優雅、美麗的人或姿態。
explanation_english: Refers to a white swan, a waterbird with white plumage and a long neck commonly seen on lakes; can also be used metaphorically for someone or something graceful and elegant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園嗰啲白天鵝好靚，我成日帶小朋友去睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 go2 di1 baak6 tin1 ngo4 hou2 leng3, ngo5 sing4 jat6 daai3 siu2 pang4 jau5 heoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园那些白天鹅很漂亮，我常常带小朋友去看。
examples.english_sentence: The white swans in the park are beautiful; I often take the kids to see them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上好似一隻白天鵝，動作好優雅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 seong6 hou2 ci5 jat1 zek3 baak6 tin1 ngo4, dung6 zok3 hou2 jau1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上像一只白天鹅，动作很优雅。
examples.english_sentence: On stage he resembles a white swan, moving very gracefully.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有正式登記或缺乏法律效力的合約（俗語）
english_meaning: an informal/unregistered agreement or 'contract' that lacks legal force (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「白契」為香港粵語俗語，通常指未經正式登記、手續未辦妥或缺乏法律效力的合約或書面承諾，可用來形容口頭協議或未辦理過戶、印花稅等手續的買賣約定。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "白契" refers to an informal or unregistered agreement/document that lacks legal validity. It is often used to describe verbal agreements or transactions where required legal procedures (registration, stamping, transfers) have not been completed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份合約係白契，冇法律效力，唔好簽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 hap6 joek3 hai6 baak6 kek3, mou5 faat3 leot6 haau6 lik6, m4 hou2 cim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份合約是白契，沒有法律效力，不要簽。
examples.english_sentence: That contract is a "white contract" (informal/unregistered) and has no legal force; don't sign it.

mandarin_meaning: 错字；读错或写错的汉字
english_meaning: a wrong/miswritten character; a character read or written incorrectly
explanation_mandarin: 指寫錯或讀錯的漢字。口語中常用來表示文本或朗讀時出現的錯誤字形或誤讀。
explanation_english: Refers to a Chinese character that is written or read incorrectly. Commonly used to denote mistakes in characters found in text or made when reading aloud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句入邊有個白字，要改返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 jap6 bin1 jau5 go3 baak6 zi6, jiu3 goi2 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句话里有个错字，要先改正。
examples.english_sentence: There's a wrong character in this sentence; you need to correct it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識嗰個字，讀成白字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 go2 go3 zi6, duk6 sing4 baak6 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不认识那个字，读错了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't recognize that character and misread it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 校對嗰本書嗰陣發現咗好多白字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 deoi3 go2 bun2 syu1 go2 zan6 faat3 jin6 zo2 hou2 do1 baak6 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 校对那本书时发现了很多错字。
examples.english_sentence: When proofreading that book, I found many wrong characters.

mandarin_meaning: 念錯字／念錯台詞的演出片段（出糗、鬧笑話）
english_meaning: a part of a performance where lines/characters are misread or flubbed; a gaffe/flubbed-line moment (sometimes used for comedic effect)
explanation_mandarin: 「白字戲」指演員在粵劇、舞台劇或電視戲等表演中念錯字、念錯台詞或出現口誤，導致場面出糗或成為笑料的片段。有時亦可指演員故意用錯字詞以製造喜劇效果。
explanation_english: "Baak zi hei" refers to moments in performances (Cantonese opera, stage plays, TV dramas, etc.) where actors misread characters, flub lines, or make verbal gaffes, causing an awkward or laughable scene. It can also refer to intentionally wrong wording used for comedic effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噚晚個舞台劇出咗幾段白字戲，觀眾笑到停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan5 go3 mou5 toi4 kek6 ceot1 zo2 gei2 dyun6 baak6 zi6 hei3, gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚那場舞台劇出現好幾段白字戲，觀眾笑得停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: Last night's stage play had several instances of flubbed lines, and the audience couldn't stop laughing.

mandarin_meaning: 白宫（美国总统的官邸和办公地点）
english_meaning: The White House (official residence and workplace of the U.S. President)
explanation_mandarin: 指美國總統的官邸白宮及其辦公場所。也常用作轉喻，表示美國行政部門或總統辦公室。
explanation_english: Refers to the White House, the official residence and workplace of the U.S. president. Often used metonymically to mean the U.S. executive branch or the president's administration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國總統住喺白宮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 zung2 tung2 zyu6 hai2 baak6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国总统住在白宫。
examples.english_sentence: The U.S. president lives in the White House.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去白宮參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 baak6 gung1 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去白宫参观。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to visit the White House.

mandarin_meaning: 白小姐（用于称呼姓白的女性）
english_meaning: Miss Bai (a form of address for a woman with the surname Bai)
explanation_mandarin: 用于称呼或指代姓白的女性，直译为“白小姐”。在粤语语境中可作正式或非正式称呼，视语境而定。
explanation_english: A form of address meaning "Miss Bai," used to refer to or address a woman whose surname is Bai. It functions as a proper noun/title; the level of formality depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識白小姐？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 baak6 siu2 ze2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你认识白小姐吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know Miss Bai?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要同白小姐食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 tung4 baak6 siu2 ze2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要和白小姐吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to have dinner with Miss Bai tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 戏称某人写诗、写词拙劣或自封为诗人但水平低落（源自对唐代诗人“白居易”名字的戏谑）
english_meaning: A joking/pejorative label for someone who writes poor poetry/lyrics or pretends to be a poet (a pun on the poet Bai Juyi)
explanation_mandarin: “白居二”是香港粵語網絡俚語，取自唐代詩人白居易的名字，把“易”換成“二”以譏諷。用來形容某人自認或嘗試當詩人、寫詩寫詞，但作品拙劣或令人覺得滑稽。
explanation_english: “白居二” is a Hong Kong Cantonese internet slang term that puns on the Tang poet Bai Juyi's name by replacing 易 with 二. It mockingly refers to someone who writes poetry/lyrics poorly or styles themselves as a poet despite weak work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲歌詞寫得咁差，真係白居二。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 go1ci4 se2 dak1 gam2 caa1, zan1 hai6 baak6 geoi1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌词写得这么差，真是白居二。
examples.english_sentence: His lyrics are so bad — he's a total 'bai ju er' (bad poet).

mandarin_meaning: 白色的房屋；白色外牆的建築物
english_meaning: a house or building that is white; a white-painted house
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思，指顏色為白色的房屋或被刷成白色的建築物。粵語中通常按字面使用，並非指美國總統官邸（白宮）。
explanation_english: Literal meaning: a house/building that is white or painted white. In Cantonese it is generally used literally and does not refer to the U.S. White House (白宮).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幢係白屋，喺街角好顯眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zong6 hai6 baak6 uk1, hai2 gaai1 gok3 hou2 hin2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幢是白色的房子，位於街角，很顯眼。
examples.english_sentence: That building is a white house; it's on the corner and very eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 白布鞋
english_meaning: white cloth shoes; simple/plain cotton shoes
explanation_mandarin: 一种以白色布料製成的鞋，款式簡單、輕便，常作日常或傳統穿着；有时也用來形容樸素、簡約的鞋子。
explanation_english: A shoe made of white cloth, simple and lightweight, commonly worn as everyday or traditional footwear; can also refer to plain or modest shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住對白布鞋去街市買菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 deoi3 baak6 bou3 haai4 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着一双白布鞋去菜市场买菜。
examples.english_sentence: He/She wore a pair of white cloth shoes to the wet market to buy vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白布鞋耐著又透氣，夏天好啱著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 bou3 haai4 noi6 zoek3 jau6 tou3 hei3, haa6 tin1 hou2 aam1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白布鞋耐穿又透气，夏天很适合穿。
examples.english_sentence: White cloth shoes are durable and breathable, suitable for wearing in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 白平衡 (摄影用语，调整颜色偏移以使白色看起来自然)
english_meaning: white balance (camera/photography setting that adjusts color temperature so whites appear neutral)
explanation_mandarin: 在攝影與影像處理中，用來調整相機或影像的色溫，使白色看起來為中性白，從而修正整體偏色的設定。
explanation_english: In photography and imaging, a setting that adjusts the camera or image color temperature so that whites appear neutral, correcting overall color casts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相啲白平衡唔啱，睇落有啲偏黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 di1 baak6 ping4 hang4 m4 aam1, tai2 lok6 jau5 di1 pin1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片的白平衡不對，看起來有點偏黃。
examples.english_sentence: The photo's white balance is off; it looks a bit yellow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用相機嘅白平衡去調返啲色，或者揀自動白平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 soeng1 gei1 ge3 baak6 ping4 hang4 heoi3 tiu4 faan1 di1 sik1, waak6 ze2 gaan2 zi6 dung6 baak6 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用相機的白平衡來調整顏色，或者選擇自動白平衡。
examples.english_sentence: You can use the camera's white balance to correct the colors, or choose auto white balance.

mandarin_meaning: 徒手；白手起家（從無到有，沒有資本或資源）
english_meaning: bare-handed; to start from scratch (without capital or resources)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞/形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「白手」可指用赤手、徒手（沒有工具或武器）去做事；亦常出現在片語「白手起家」，表示沒有資本或背景從零開始創業或發展。
explanation_english: “白手” can mean doing something with bare hands (without tools) and also appears in the phrase “白手起家”, meaning to start from scratch without capital or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用白手拎起嗰塊石頭，真係勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 baak3 sau2 ling1 hei2 go2 faai3 sek6 tau4, zan1 hai6 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他徒手把那塊石頭拿起來，真厲害。
examples.english_sentence: He lifted that rock with his bare hands — really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢白手起家，幾年之內將公司做到好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baak3 sau2 hei2 gaa1, gei2 nin4 zi1 noi6 zoeng1 gung1 si1 zou6 dou3 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他白手起家，幾年之內把公司做得很成功。
examples.english_sentence: He started from nothing and made the company very successful within a few years.

mandarin_meaning: 白色手套；俚語：替他人掩護或代為處理不法、骯髒交易的中間人或傀儡（即「門面人物」或代持人）
english_meaning: White gloves; slang: a person or entity that acts as a front/intermediary to conceal the real party and handle illegal or dirty transactions (a puppet or nominee)
explanation_mandarin: 可指實際的白色手套；在俚語或新聞語境中常指為他人掩護、代持或處理不法資產與交易的中間人或傀儡，常用於貪污、洗錢等情況。
explanation_english: Can mean literal white gloves; in slang or news contexts it refers to a middleman or puppet who conceals the true party and handles illegal assets or transactions, commonly used in contexts of corruption or money laundering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被揭發係某位官員嘅白手套，專門幫手洗黑錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 git3faat3 hai6 mou5 wai6 gung1jyun4 ge3 baak6 sau2 tou3, zyun1mun4 bong1sau2 sai2 hak1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被揭發是某位官員的白手套，專門幫忙洗黑錢。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed as an official's white glove, specializing in laundering dirty money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宴會嘅侍應都戴住白手套，保持儀態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin3wui2 ge3 si6jing3 dou1 daai3 zyu6 baak6 sau2 tou3, bou2ci4 ji4taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宴會的服務生都戴著白手套，以保持儀態。
examples.english_sentence: The banquet servers all wear white gloves to maintain decorum.

mandarin_meaning: 白手起家（從零開始創業或建立家業）
english_meaning: to start a business or build a family/fortune from nothing; self-made
explanation_mandarin: 指靠自己的努力，沒有外來資助或基礎，從零開始創業或建立家業、事業。
explanation_english: Refers to building a business, family, or fortune from nothing through one's own effort, without external help; being self-made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢白手興家，靠努力將公司做大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1, kaau3 nou5 lik6 zoeng1 gung1 si1 zou6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他白手起家，把公司從無到有做大。
examples.english_sentence: He started the business from scratch and grew the company into something big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺白手興家，靠自己打拼，供晒我哋讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1, kaau3 zi6 gei2 daa2 ping3, gung1 saai3 ngo5 dei6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷白手起家，靠自己打拼，供我们读书。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather built the family from nothing through his own hard work and supported our education.

mandarin_meaning: 白拿 / 占便宜；不勞而獲
english_meaning: to get something for nothing; to freeload; to take advantage without contributing
explanation_mandarin: 指不付出代價或努力，白白取得好處或佔別人便宜，常用於廣東話口語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to obtain benefits without effort or payment — to freeload or take advantage of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟我屋企食飯，淨係嚟白撈嘢，真係唔好意思再請佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6, zing6 hai6 lai4 baak6 lou1 je5, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 zoi3 ceng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是來我家吃飯，就是來白拿東西，真不好意思再請他。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps coming to my place for meals just to freeload — I really feel awkward inviting him again.

mandarin_meaning: 徒勞；白費力氣；無謂去嘗試或打擾別人
english_meaning: to try in vain; to make a futile attempt; to bother someone pointlessly
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指徒勞地去做某事或無謂地去打擾、碰撞別人，通常表示做了也不會有結果或沒有必要去做。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to do something in vain or to bother/approach someone pointlessly — an action with little or no chance of success or that wastes effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再白撞佢啦，佢根本唔會理你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 baak6 zong6 keoi5 laa3, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 lei5 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再白撞他了，他根本不會理你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep bothering him for nothing; he simply won't pay attention to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰日我去面試，覺得係白撞，根本冇機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 jat6 ngo5 heoi3 min6 si3, gok3 dak1 hai6 baak6 zong6, gan1 bun2 mou5 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那天我去面試，覺得是白撞，根本沒有機會。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the interview that day but it felt like a wasted effort; there was no chance at all.

mandarin_meaning: 突如其來、使計劃落空的短暫陣雨（俗語）
english_meaning: a sudden, brief shower that spoils plans (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「白撞雨」為廣東話俗語，指那種突然來臨、持續時間短但足以打亂行程或活動的雨。通常含有「白費力氣／白走一趟」的無奈意味。
explanation_english: “白撞雨” is Cantonese slang for a sudden, short-lived shower that is enough to disrupt plans or activities. It often carries a sense of frustration that the outing or effort was wasted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日約咗去沙灘，點知中途落咗白撞雨，只好收隊返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 joek3 zo2 heoi3 saa1 taan1, dim2 zi1 zung1 tou6 lok6 zo2 baak6 zong6 jyu5, zi2 hou2 sau1 deoi6 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天约好去海滩，没想到中途下了白撞雨，只好收队回家。
examples.english_sentence: We planned to go to the beach today, but halfway through a sudden shower came and we had to pack up and go home.

mandarin_meaning: 白切鸡 (báiqiē jī)
english_meaning: white-cut chicken; poached chicken
explanation_mandarin: 一道廣東菜，把整隻雞用滾水或熱水煮熟後冰鎮切件，通常佐以薑蔥油或豉油食用，屬冷盤或家常菜。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dish of poached chicken served chilled and chopped; the whole chicken is poached, chilled, and served with ginger-scallion oil or soy-based sauces. Common as a cold dish or home-style entrée.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食白斬雞，幾好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 baak6 zaam2 gai1, gei2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃白切鸡，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: We're having white-cut chicken tonight; it's really tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 白斩鸡（粤菜，一种水煮后切块的鸡肉）
english_meaning: white-cut chicken (poached chicken, Cantonese dish)
explanation_mandarin: 白斩鸡是一道粤菜，通常将整只鸡用清水或高汤煮熟后立即冷却定型，再切块上桌，常配姜葱油、酱油等蘸料，肉质鲜嫩，风味清淡。
explanation_english: White-cut chicken is a Cantonese dish where a whole chicken is poached in water or broth, cooled to set the skin, then chopped and served—often with ginger-scallion oil or soy-based sauces. The meat is tender and the flavor is clean and simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食白斬雞，隻雞好嫩，姜蔥油好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Gam1 maan5 sik6 baak6 zaam2 gai1, zek3 gai1 hou2 nan6, goeng1 cung1 jau4 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃白斩鸡，那只鸡很嫩，姜葱油很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: We're having white-cut chicken tonight; the chicken is very tender and the ginger-scallion oil is delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 白天；日间
english_meaning: daytime; daylight; broad daylight
explanation_mandarin: 指太陽升起、有日光的時間，也可在口語或成語中出現（如「白日做夢」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the time of day when the sun is up (daytime/daylight). Commonly used in everyday speech and appears in idioms (e.g. "白日做夢").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺白日出街都唔戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baak6 jat6 ceot1 gaai1 dou1 m4 daai3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在白天出門都不戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: He goes out during the day without wearing a mask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白日做夢係冇用，要付諸行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 jat6 zou6 mung6 hai6 mou5 jung6, jiu3 fu6 zyu1 haang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白日做梦是没用的，要付诸行动。
examples.english_sentence: Daydreaming is useless; you need to take action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報話今日白日會好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 gam1 jat6 baak6 jat6 wui5 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气预报说今天白天会很热。
examples.english_sentence: The weather forecast says it will be very hot during the day today.

mandarin_meaning: 白日梦 (báirìmèng) — 做白日梦、幻想
english_meaning: daydream; a fanciful or wishful thought while awake
explanation_mandarin: 指人在清醒時幻想、不切實際的想法或夢想，也可用作形容常常空想的人或行為。
explanation_english: Refers to fantasizing or having unrealistic thoughts while awake; can describe the act of daydreaming or someone who frequently indulges in such fantasies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日發白日夢，唔好淨係喺度空想啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 faat3 baak6 jat6 mung6, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 hung1 soeng2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是做白日梦，别只是空想了。
examples.english_sentence: You always daydream; stop just fantasizing.

mandarin_meaning: 潔白 / 雪白
english_meaning: very white; bright white; spotless
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，用來形容某物顏色非常白、看上去很乾淨或明亮。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe something that is extremely white, bright, or spotless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫白晒晒，睇落好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 baak6 saai3 saai3, tai2 lok6 hou2 gon1 zeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的衣服白白的，看起來很乾淨。
examples.english_sentence: His/her clothes are bright white; they look very clean.

mandarin_meaning: 白天；晝間
english_meaning: daytime; daytime hours
explanation_mandarin: 指從天亮到天黑、有日光的時間，即白天。
explanation_english: Refers to the period from dawn to dusk when it is light outside; daytime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街白晝好熱鬧，夜晚就冷清晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 baak6 zau3 hou2 jit6 naau6, je6 maan5 zau6 laang5 cing1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街白天很热闹，晚上就冷清了。
examples.english_sentence: This street is bustling during the daytime, but becomes quiet at night.

mandarin_meaning: 白杖 / 盲杖（視障者用的白色手杖）
english_meaning: white cane (a mobility cane used by visually impaired people)
explanation_mandarin: 指視障人士用來探路或提示他人自己視力受限的白色手杖，常見於視障者的輔助工具與識別物件。
explanation_english: A white cane used by people with visual impairments to detect obstacles, navigate, and signal to others that the user has vision loss. It is both a mobility aid and an identification tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係視障人士，平時出門會拄住白杖行路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 si6 zoeng3 jan4 si6, ping4 si4 ceot1 mun4 wui5 zyu2 zyu6 baak6 zoeng6 haang4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是视障人士，平时出门会拄着白杖行路。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is visually impaired and usually uses a white cane when going out.

mandarin_meaning: 白板；空白（比喻未填寫或沒有內容）
english_meaning: whiteboard; blank (figurative: empty or with no content)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 一種用於教學或會議上可以用白板筆書寫、再擦掉的板子。2) 比喻某處沒有任何內容或紀錄，處於空白狀態。
explanation_english: 1) A board (usually white) used in classrooms or meetings for writing with erasable markers. 2) Figuratively, something that is blank or contains no information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺教室用白板寫字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 gaau3 sat1 jung6 baak6 baan2 se2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師在教室用白板寫字。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is writing on the whiteboard in the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份履歷表嗰欄係白板，咁老闆唔會鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 leoi5 lik6 biu2 go2 laam4 hai6 baak6 baan2, gam2 lou5 baan2 m4 wui5 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她的履歷表那一欄是空白，老闆不會喜歡這樣。
examples.english_sentence: That section of his resume is blank; the boss won't like that.

mandarin_meaning: 菜鳥；新手；沒有經驗的人
english_meaning: newbie; inexperienced person; greenhorn (literally 'whiteboard kid')
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，常用於香港，字面為「白板仔」(白板 = 空白)，比喻像白紙一樣缺乏經驗或知識，用來戲稱或指責新人或缺乏經驗的人，語氣可輕微帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term commonly used in Hong Kong. Literally 'whiteboard kid,' it refers to someone who is inexperienced or a novice (a blank slate). Often used teasingly or mildly derogatorily to describe newcomers or people who don't know much about a topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嚟公司嗰個係白板仔，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lei4 gung1 si1 go2 go3 hai6 baak6 baan2 zai2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新來公司的那個是個白板仔，什麼都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: The new person at the company is a newbie; he doesn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢係白板仔，佢學嘢好快㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 hai6 baak6 baan2 zai2, keoi5 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別看他是個白板仔，他學東西很快。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him as a newbie; he learns things very quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 白板笔 / 乾擦筆
english_meaning: whiteboard marker (dry-erase marker)
explanation_mandarin: 用于在白板上書寫且可用擦拭清除的筆，常見於教室或會議室。
explanation_english: A marker used to write on whiteboards that can be wiped off; commonly used in classrooms and meeting rooms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇白板筆借我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 baak6 baan2 bat1 ze3 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有白板筆可以借我？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a whiteboard marker I can borrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白板筆用晒喇，要換新的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 baan2 bat1 jung6 saai3 laa3, jiu3 wun6 san1 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白板笔用完了，要换新的。
examples.english_sentence: The whiteboard marker is used up; we need to replace it.

mandarin_meaning: 平板车；平板货车
english_meaning: flatbed truck; flatbed lorry
explanation_mandarin: 指具有平坦貨斗或貨台的貨車，常用於運送大型物品或搬家，平台通常沒有封閉車廂。
explanation_english: A truck with a flat open bed or platform used to transport large items or for moving; the cargo area is typically an unclosed flatbed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要租部白板車去搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou1 bou6 baak6 baan2 ce1 heoi3 baan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要租一辆平板车去搬家。
examples.english_sentence: We need to rent a flatbed truck to move house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白板車好適合運大件嘅傢俬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 baan2 ce1 hou2 sik1 hap6 wan6 daai6 gin6 ge3 gaa1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 平板车很适合运送大件家具。
examples.english_sentence: Flatbed trucks are well suited for transporting large pieces of furniture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 司機話唔可以載客，白板車係貨車唔係客車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 gei1 waa6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 haak3, baak6 baan2 ce1 hai6 fo3 ce1 m4 hai6 haak3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 司机说不可以载客，白板车是货车不是客车。
examples.english_sentence: The driver said passengers can't be carried; a flatbed truck is a goods vehicle, not a passenger vehicle.

mandarin_meaning: 白果（銀杏果）
english_meaning: ginkgo nut; ginkgo seed
explanation_mandarin: 白果指銀杏樹的種子，常用於廣東菜、糖水與中藥。生食或未經妥善處理的白果含有毒性（如銀杏毒素），食用前需去殼並徹底煮熟或按傳統方法處理。
explanation_english: The ginkgo nut — the seed of the ginkgo tree. Commonly used in Cantonese cuisine, sweet soups, and traditional Chinese medicine. Raw or improperly prepared ginkgo nuts contain toxins, so they must be properly shelled and cooked before consumption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食糖水入面嘅白果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 tong4 seoi2 jap6 min6 ge3 baak6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃糖水裡的白果。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat ginkgo nuts in sweet soup.

mandarin_meaning: 白桃（白肉桃，一種果實）
english_meaning: white peach (a peach with white flesh)
explanation_mandarin: 白桃指果肉呈白色的桃子，常見於生鮮水果、罐頭或飲品口味（如白桃茶、白桃罐頭等）。
explanation_english: White peach refers to a peach with white flesh. It is a fruit and also a common flavor in beverages, desserts, and canned fruit (e.g., white peach tea).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食白桃，夏天最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 baak6 tou4, haa6 tin1 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃白桃，夏天最好。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating white peaches; they're best in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯白桃茶幾好味，可以試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 baak6 tou4 caa4 gei2 hou2 mei6, ho2 ji5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯白桃茶很好喝，可以试试。
examples.english_sentence: This white peach tea is quite tasty — you should try it.

mandarin_meaning: 白色橄欖（白橄欖）；可指淺色的橄欖果或罐裝/醃製的白橄欖
english_meaning: white olive (a pale-colored olive); can refer to jarred/preserved white olives or products made from them
explanation_mandarin: 「白欖」字面上指顏色較淺的橄欖果，亦常用來指罐裝或醃製的白橄欖，以及以白橄欖為原料的食品（例如橄欖油等）。
explanation_english: Literally 'white olive' — a pale-colored olive. It can refer to the fruit itself, jarred or preserved white olives, or food products derived from them (e.g., olive oil).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺超市見到罐白欖，買唔買？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ciu1 si5 gin3 dou2 gun3 baak6 laam5, maai5 m4 maai5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在超市看到一罐白橄欖，要不要買？
examples.english_sentence: I saw a jar of white olives at the supermarket. Should I buy it?

mandarin_meaning: 白武士（指在企業遭遇惡意收購或困境時出手救援的公司或投資者；亦可指在社交場合替他人出面辯護的“救援者”）
english_meaning: white knight (a company or investor that rescues a firm from a hostile takeover or a person who rushes to defend/rescue someone)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容在公司面臨惡意收購或財務困境時，出面收購或提供援助以拯救該公司的企業或投資者；在口語中也可指在爭論或衝突中出面幫忙、替人辯護的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a company or investor that intervenes to rescue a firm from a hostile takeover or financial trouble by providing a friendly acquisition or support; colloquially, it can also mean someone who rushes in to defend or help another person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有間公司俾人惡意收購，最後由另一間做咗白武士出手救返間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 gaan1 gung1si1 bei2 jan4 ok3 ji3 sau1gou3, zeoi6hau6 jau4 ling6 jat1 gaan1 zou6 zo2 baak6 mou5 si6 ceot1sau2 gau3 faan1 gaan1 gung1si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有家公司被恶意收购，最后由另一家公司扮演白武士出手救回了公司。
examples.english_sentence: A company was facing a hostile takeover; in the end another company acted as a white knight and rescued it.

mandarin_meaning: 白汁（烹飪用語，指以牛奶、奶油與麵粉等製成的白色醬汁，如法式béchamel）；（俚語）指精液（粗俗用法）
english_meaning: white sauce (béchamel) used in cooking; (slang) semen (vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 在烹飪中「白汁」指以牛奶或奶油為基底，加入麵粉或其他材料製成的白色醬汁，常用於焗菜、意粉或燴菜。另在口語俚語中，有時被粗俗地用來指代男性的精液，屬不雅用法。
explanation_english: In cooking, "white sauce" refers to a creamy white sauce (e.g., béchamel) made from milk or cream and thickened with flour, commonly used in baked dishes, pasta, or stews. Colloquially, it can be used as a vulgar slang term for semen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我煮白汁意粉，你想唔想食？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zyu2 baak6 zap1 ji3 fan2, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 sik6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我做白醬意大利麵，你想不想吃？
examples.english_sentence: I'm making pasta with white sauce tonight. Do you want some?

mandarin_meaning: 凡士林（白色石油凝胶，用于保湿、护唇和处理轻微擦伤）
english_meaning: petroleum jelly (Vaseline) — a white petroleum-based ointment used for moisturizing, protecting skin and treating minor cuts)
explanation_mandarin: 「白油」在廣東話通常指凡士林或類似的白色石油膏，常用於潤膚、護唇、保護皮膚或處理輕微擦傷與乾裂。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "白油" usually refers to petroleum jelly (Vaseline) or a similar white petroleum ointment, commonly used to moisturize skin, protect lips, and treat minor abrasions and dryness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我皮膚好乾，夜晚訓覺之前會搽白油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pei4 fu1 hou2 gon1, je6 maan5 fan3 gaau3 zi1 cin4 wui5 caat3 baak6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我皮肤很干，晚上睡觉前会擦白油。
examples.english_sentence: My skin is very dry; I apply petroleum jelly before going to bed.

mandarin_meaning: 白净；皮肤白皙
english_meaning: fair-skinned; having a pale, clean-looking complexion
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人的膚色白皙、看起來乾淨細緻，常用於描述面色或膚質。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose skin is fair or pale and looks clean or delicate; commonly used to describe complexion or skin quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個皮膚好白淨，望落好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 pei4 fu1 hou2 baak6 zeng6, mong6 lok6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的皮肤很白净，看起来很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Her skin is very fair and looks beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要保濕先可以保持皮膚白淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 bou2 sat1 sin1 ho2 ji5 bou2 ci4 pei4 fu1 baak6 zeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要保湿才能保持皮肤白净。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you need to moisturize to keep your skin fair.

mandarin_meaning: 白汤（清汤、简单的汤底）
english_meaning: plain broth; clear soup (simple soup base)
explanation_mandarin: 指用水或以骨、肉等簡單熬製、未加重調味的清湯，也可指作為湯底的單純湯品。
explanation_english: Refers to a plain broth or clear soup made by simmering bones or ingredients with little or no seasoning; also used for a simple soup base.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳嗰碗白湯好清甜，適合細路飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 go2 wun2 baak6 tong1 hou2 cing1 tim4, sik1 hap6 sai3 lou6 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅那碗白汤很清甜，适合小孩喝。
examples.english_sentence: That bowl of plain broth at the restaurant is very mild and slightly sweet; it's suitable for children to drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意咁鹹，淨係想飲白湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 gam2 haam4, zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 baak6 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢这么咸，只想喝白汤。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like it so salty; I just want to drink plain broth.

mandarin_meaning: 白皙光滑（皮膚）
english_meaning: fair and smooth (usually describing skin)
explanation_mandarin: 常用來形容皮膚色澤白淨且觸感光滑，也可用於描述表面平滑、潔白。
explanation_english: Usually describes skin that is fair and smooth to the touch; can also describe a surface that is smooth and white.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個面膜用完之後，皮膚變得好白滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 min6 mok6 jung6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, pei4 fu1 bin3 dak1 hou2 baak6 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个面膜用完之后，皮肤变得很白皙光滑。
examples.english_sentence: After using this facial mask, the skin becomes very fair and smooth.

mandarin_meaning: 白开水（开水）
english_meaning: plain boiled water (water boiled for drinking)
explanation_mandarin: 指把水煮沸後供飲用的清水，沒有加入茶或其他調味，常用於日常生活或醫療照護。
explanation_english: Refers to water that has been boiled for drinking without adding tea or other flavorings; commonly used in daily life and for health/care purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲白滾水，唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 baak6 gwan2 seoi2, m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝白开水，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: I'd like a cup of plain boiled water, please.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友驚凍，俾佢飲返杯白滾水先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 geng1 dung3, bei2 keoi5 jam2 faan1 bui1 baak6 gwan2 seoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子怕冷，先給他喝杯白开水。
examples.english_sentence: The child is feeling cold — give them a cup of plain boiled water first.

mandarin_meaning: 白茫茫；霧蒙蒙
english_meaning: white and hazy; covered in a whitish haze (fog, frost, snow); indistinct
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容被一層白色或霧氣籠罩，視野模糊、不清楚的景象。常用於形容霧、霜、雪或白色覆蓋的場景。
explanation_english: Used to describe a scene covered by a whitish haze or fog, appearing blurred or indistinct. Commonly applied to fog, frost, snow, or any landscape with a light white covering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝個天白濛濛，遠處啲山睇唔真切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 go3 tin1 baak6 mung4 mung4, jyun5 cyu3 di1 saan1 tai2 m4 zan1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上天色白茫茫，远处的山看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the sky was all white and hazy; I couldn't see the distant mountains clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 白灼（bái zhuó）——用沸水短时间烫熟食材的烹调方法，常见于粤菜
english_meaning: to blanch; a Cantonese cooking method of briefly boiling food (often seafood) and serving with a dipping sauce
explanation_mandarin: 白灼是一种粤式烹饪方法，把食材（如虾、青菜、贝类）放入沸水中迅速烫熟，捞起后通常配以姜葱油、豉油或其它蘸料，以保持食材原味、口感爽嫩。
explanation_english: Baak zoek (white-blanching) is a Cantonese cooking technique where ingredients (e.g. shrimp, greens, shellfish) are briefly cooked in boiling water, then removed and served with sauces like ginger-scallion oil or soy dip to preserve the natural flavor and texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚打算食白灼蝦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 daa2 syun3 sik6 baak6 zoek3 haa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚打算吃白灼虾。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to eat blanched (white-boiled) shrimp tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 清煮 / 白灼（簡單用水或輕微調味煮熟食材）
english_meaning: plain-boil; to poach/blanch/boil food simply with minimal seasoning
explanation_mandarin: 指用清水或很少調味料短暫煮熟食材，保留食材原味，常見於粵菜（如白烚蝦、白烚菜）。在口語中亦可指烹調方法比較清淡。
explanation_english: Refers to cooking food simply by boiling or blanching in plain water (or with minimal seasoning), preserving the natural flavor of the ingredient. Common in Cantonese cuisine (e.g., plain‑boiled shrimp or vegetables).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食白烚菜，唔好落太多調味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 baak6 buk6 coi3，m4 hou2 lok6 taai3 do1 diu6 mei6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚吃清煮的菜，不要放太多調味料。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have plain‑boiled vegetables tonight — don't add too much seasoning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅白烚蝦好新鮮，配蒜蓉好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 baak6 buk6 haa1 hou2 san1 sin1，pui3 syun3 jung4 hou2 zeng3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餐廳的白灼蝦很新鮮，配蒜蓉非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's plain‑boiled shrimp are very fresh and go great with garlic sauce.

mandarin_meaning: 白无常
english_meaning: White Wuchang (one of the two underworld messengers)
explanation_mandarin: 中國民間傳說中的冥界鬼差之一，通常與黑無常成對出現，負責捉拿或引領亡魂；也可比喻帶來噩耗或令人害怕的東西或人。
explanation_english: A figure in Chinese folk belief — one of the two underworld messengers (paired with the Black Wuchang) who escort or capture souls; can also be used figuratively for a bringer of bad news or something frightening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講昨晚有人喺廟附近見到白無常，大家好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 zok6 maan5 jau5 jan4 hai2 miu6 fu6 gan6 gin3 dou2 baak6 mou4 soeng4, daai6 gaa1 hou2 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说昨晚有人在庙附近看到白无常，大家很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: I heard someone saw the White Wuchang near the temple last night, and everyone was scared.

mandarin_meaning: （局勢、爭論、比賽等）變得非常激烈、緊張
english_meaning: to become heated/intensified (e.g. a debate, competition); to escalate into a very intense or fierce state
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容爭論、競爭或局勢等變得極為激烈、緊張，常見於新聞或正式語境，例如「選戰白熱化」。
explanation_english: Describes a situation—such as a debate, competition, or conflict—that has become highly intense or heated; commonly used in news and formal contexts (e.g., "the race has heated up").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉嘅競爭愈嚟愈激烈，已經白熱化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 ge3 ging6 zang1 jyu6 lai4 jyu6 gik1 lit6, ji5 ging1 baak6 jit6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 選舉的競爭越來越激烈，已經白熱化。
examples.english_sentence: The competition in the election is getting more and more intense; it has already heated up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 討論會上嘅辯論越嚟越白熱化，場面好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou2 leon6 wui2 soeng6 ge3 bin6 leon6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 baak6 jit6 faa3, coeng4 min6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 討論會上的辯論越來越白熱化，場面很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: The debate at the forum is becoming increasingly heated; the atmosphere is very tense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽下半場完全白熱化，雙方都放手一搏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 haa6 bun3 coeng4 jyun4 cyun4 baak6 jit6 faa3, soeng1 fong1 dou1 fong3 sau2 jat1 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場比賽下半場完全白熱化，雙方都放手一搏。
examples.english_sentence: This match completely heated up in the second half; both sides are going all out.

mandarin_meaning: 白牌烟（指走私、假冒或未經正規渠道、未繳稅的香烟）
english_meaning: Illicit/bootleg cigarettes; unbranded or smuggled cigarettes sold outside official channels
explanation_mandarin: 「白牌煙」是香港粵語俗稱，指不通過正規渠道、可能是走私、假冒或未繳稅的香煙，通常價格較便宜且品質與安全性無法保障。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, '白牌煙' refers to cigarettes sold outside official channels—often smuggled, counterfeit, untaxed or unbranded. They are usually cheaper but unregulated and potentially unsafe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲白牌煙雖然平，但係可能係走私或者假煙，唔好買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 baak6 paai4 jin1 seoi1 jin4 peng4, daan6 hai6 ho2 nang4 hai6 zau2 si1 waak6 ze2 gaa2 jin1, m4 hou2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些白牌烟虽然便宜，但可能是走私或假烟，别买。
examples.english_sentence: These white-brand cigarettes are cheap, but they might be smuggled or counterfeit—don't buy them.

mandarin_meaning: 指未經許可或無牌照以收費載客的私人車輛（俗稱「黑車」、無牌車），屬非法營運。
english_meaning: An unlicensed/illegal private car used to carry passengers for hire (often called an 'illegal taxi' or 'black car').
explanation_mandarin: 在香港口語中，白牌車指沒有合法營運牌照但以收費載客的私人車輛，通常屬非法營運，存在安全與法規風險。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong colloquial usage, '白牌車' refers to privately owned vehicles operating without authorization as paid passenger transport. They are illegal and pose safety and legal risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好搭白牌車，唔安全而且冇保障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 daap3 baak6 paai4 ce1, m4 on1 cyun4 ji4 ce2 mou5 bou2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不要坐白牌车，不安全而且没有保障。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't take a 'white-plate' car — it's unsafe and offers no protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方最近加強巡邏，打擊白牌車非法營運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zeoi3 gan6 gaa1 koeng4 ceon4 lo4, daa2 gik1 baak6 paai4 ce1 fei1 faat3 jing4 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方最近加强巡逻，打击白牌车非法营运。
examples.english_sentence: The police have stepped up patrols recently to crack down on illegal 'white-plate' cars.

mandarin_meaning: 白牛 (bái niú)：白色的牛，字面意思
english_meaning: white cow; literally a cow that is white
explanation_mandarin: 指顏色為白色的牛，主要為字面上的動物描述。這個詞在廣東話中多為直述，不是常見的成語或俚語，但在特定語境下可用作比喻。
explanation_english: Refers to a cow that is white in color — a literal animal description. It is primarily used literally in Cantonese rather than as a common idiom or slang, though it can be used metaphorically in specific contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有一頭白牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 tau4 baak6 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场里面有一头白牛。
examples.english_sentence: There is a white cow on the farm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋養咗一隻白牛做莊園嘅吉祥物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 joeng5 zo2 jat1 zek3 baak6 ngau4 zou6 zong1 jyun4 ge3 gat1 coeng4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们养了一头白牛作为庄园的吉祥物。
examples.english_sentence: They raised a white cow as the estate's mascot.

mandarin_meaning: 1) 字面：白色的瓜（某些瓜類）；2) 口語（較少見）：戲稱或輕鬆稱呼傻瓜、笨蛋
english_meaning: 1) Literal: white gourd/melon (a type of gourd); 2) Colloquial (less common): a joking or mild way to call someone a fool or silly person
explanation_mandarin: 「白瓜」本義指白色或品種名稱的瓜類（可作蔬果食用）。在部分口語情境中，也有人以輕鬆或戲謔的方式把「白瓜」當作「傻瓜」的同義稱呼，但此用法並不普遍且較口語化。
explanation_english: Literally, "白瓜" denotes a white gourd or melon (a kind of edible gourd). In some spoken contexts it is occasionally used jokingly to mean "fool" or "silly person," but that slang usage is informal and less common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有白瓜賣，好大個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 baak6 gwaa1 maai6, hou2 daai6 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜市場有白瓜賣，好大個。
examples.english_sentence: There are white gourds for sale at the market — they're huge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做白瓜，快啲答佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 baak6 gwaa1, faai3 di1 daap3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別裝傻了，快點回覆他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a fool — reply to him quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 白瓜子（去殼的瓜子／葵花籽仁）
english_meaning: shelled sunflower seeds (peeled melon/sunflower seed kernels), a snack
explanation_mandarin: 指去掉外殼的瓜子或葵花籽仁，常作小吃或零食。
explanation_english: Refers to shelled melon/sunflower seeds (seed kernels) commonly eaten as a snack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影開始之前，我買咗包白瓜子，一邊食一邊睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 hoi1 ci2 zi1 cin4, ngo5 maai5 zo2 baau1 baak6 gwaa1 zi2, jat1 bin1 sik6 jat1 bin1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影开始之前，我买了一包白瓜子，一边吃一边看。
examples.english_sentence: Before the movie started, I bought a bag of shelled sunflower seeds and munched on them while watching.

mandarin_meaning: 白痴 (báichī) — 笨蛋、愚蠢的人；舊時亦為醫學術語指智力障礙
english_meaning: idiot; moron; (offensive) a stupid person — historically also a medical term for intellectual disability
explanation_mandarin: 口語中常用作辱罵，指愚蠢或智力低下的人；在醫學上為舊有術語，現多被視為冒犯性用語，不建議用於正式場合。
explanation_english: Commonly used colloquially as an insult meaning an idiot or a very stupid person. Historically a medical term for intellectual disability. Considered offensive in many contexts and inappropriate for formal use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩咁白痴？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 gam2 baak6 ci1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么白痴？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so stupid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係白痴，唔好同佢計較。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 baak6 ci1, m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gai3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个白痴，别跟他计较。
examples.english_sentence: He's really an idiot; don't bother arguing with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺學校叫人白痴，會傷害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 hok6 haau6 giu3 jan4 baak6 ci1, wui5 soeng1 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在学校叫人白痴，会伤害别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people idiots at school; it can hurt them.

mandarin_meaning: 白痴／傻瓜（罵人的話）
english_meaning: idiot; fool (insult)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用作罵人或貶低他人，意指『白痴、笨蛋』，帶有不禮貌與冒犯性。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese insult meaning 'idiot' or 'fool'. Used to insult or belittle someone; impolite and offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做白痴仔，快啲收工返屋企啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 baak6 ci1 zai2, faai3 di1 sau1 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要當白痴了，快點下班回家吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like an idiot; hurry up and go home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日做咗件白痴仔嘅事，大家都好嬲佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zou6 zo2 gin6 baak6 ci1 zai2 ge3 si6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 nau1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天做了件很蠢的事，大家都很生他的氣。
examples.english_sentence: He did something really stupid today; everyone is angry at him.

mandarin_meaning: 白痴（指愚蠢的人，帶有侮辱意味）
english_meaning: idiot; moron (derogatory term for someone considered very stupid)
explanation_mandarin: 「白癡」是粵語及國語中常見的罵人用語，表示某人愚蠢或做事很蠢。語氣通常帶有侮辱性，但在熟人間有時也可戲謔使用。屬口語、粗俗用語，使用時需注意場合與對象。
explanation_english: “白癡” is a colloquial derogatory term meaning someone is very stupid or acts foolishly. It’s commonly used in spoken Cantonese (and Mandarin) and can be insulting; among friends it may be used jokingly. It’s informal and should be used with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做白癡啦，我已經講過好多次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 baak6 ci1 laa1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 gong2 gwo3 hou2 do1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做白痴了，我已經說過很多次。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be an idiot — I've already told you many times.

mandarin_meaning: 白痴；笨蛋；傻瓜
english_meaning: idiot; fool (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「白癡仔」是廣東話口語，用來罵人愚蠢或做事很笨。帶有冒犯性，朋友之間有時會以開玩笑的語氣使用；後綴「仔」使語氣更口語化或帶輕蔑/親暱色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning "idiot" or "fool." It's derogatory and offensive in many contexts, though friends may use it jokingly. The suffix "仔" gives a colloquial or diminutive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係白癡仔，點解會咁做？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 baak6 ci1 zai2, dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 zou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是白痴，為什麼會這樣做？
examples.english_sentence: You're such an idiot — why would you do that?

mandarin_meaning: 白白；白費；(口語)免費
english_meaning: for nothing; in vain; (colloquial) free of charge
explanation_mandarin: 粵語常用口語詞，根據語境可表示“徒然、白費（白白浪費）”或“免費、不用付費”。
explanation_english: A common colloquial Cantonese term meaning either 'for nothing / in vain' (wasted) or 'free of charge' depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做只係白白浪費時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zi2 hai6 baak6 baak6 long6 fai3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做只是白白浪費時間。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that is just wasting time for nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次免費，白白㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 min5 fei3, baak6 baak6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次是免費的，白白的。
examples.english_sentence: This time it's free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咗佢努力咗咁耐，最後發現全部白白晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 zo2 keoi5 nou5 lik6 zo2 gam2 noi6, zeoi3 hau6 faat3 jin6 cyun4 bou6 baak6 baak6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我為了他努力了那麼久，最後發現全都白費了。
examples.english_sentence: I worked so hard for him, but in the end it was all for nothing.

mandarin_meaning: 傻乎乎、呆呆的（有時含容易受騙或天真的意思）
english_meaning: silly; dazed; foolish; gullible (idiomatic, colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人顯得呆滯、傻乎乎或容易輕信別人，語氣可帶同情或責備。
explanation_english: Describes someone who appears dazed, silly, or easily fooled; can be used sympathetically or reproachfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好白白痴痴咁信晒佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 baak6 baak6 ci1 ci1 gam2 seon3 saai3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別這麼傻乎乎地全信他了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so gullible and believe him completely.

mandarin_meaning: 白皙（皮膚白淨、細膩）
english_meaning: fair (complexion); pale and smooth skin
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容皮膚白淨、細膩、有光澤的膚色或外觀，常用於描述人的面容或皮膚狀態。
explanation_english: Used to describe skin that is fair, pale, and smooth in appearance; commonly used to refer to someone's complexion or skin condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有白皙嘅皮膚，經常搽護膚品保養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 baak6 sik1 ge3 pei4 fu1, ging1 soeng4 caat3 wu6 fu1 ban2 bou2 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她有白皙的皮膚，經常使用護膚品保養。
examples.english_sentence: She has fair skin and often uses skincare products to maintain it.

mandarin_meaning: 白皮書 (báipíshū)，正式的政策或研究報告
english_meaning: white paper — an official report or authoritative guide that explains policy, proposals, or research findings
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或機構為闡明政策、立場或調查結果而發表的正式書面報告，通常用來提出建議或說明未來方向。
explanation_english: A formal written report issued by a government or organization to explain policies, positions, or research findings. White papers are often used to present proposals or outline future directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府將會喺下星期發表一份有關房屋政策嘅白皮書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zoeng1 wui5 hai2 haa6 sing1 kei4 faat3 biu2 jat1 fan6 jau5 gwaan1 fong4 uk1 zing3 caak3 ge3 baak6 pei4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府將於下星期發表一份有關房屋政策的白皮書。
examples.english_sentence: The government will publish a white paper on housing policy next week.

mandarin_meaning: （口語、貶義）白皮猪；用來罵人愚蠢、容易受騙或行為粗鄙
english_meaning: (slang, derogatory) literally "white-skin pig"; an insult for someone seen as stupid, gullible, or vulgar
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗俗的貶義稱呼，字面為「白皮豬」，常用來形容一個人愚蠢、容易被騙、或行為粗魯/自以為高貴等。帶有侮辱性，非正式場合使用。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese derogatory term literally meaning "white-skin pig." It is used to insult someone as stupid, gullible, or behaving arrogantly/uncouthly. Offensive slang and inappropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做白皮豬啦，咁容易畀人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 baak6 pei4 zyu1 laa1, gam2 jung6 ji6 bei2 jan4 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做白皮猪了，這麼容易被人騙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a "white-skin pig" — don't be so easily fooled.

mandarin_meaning: 白眼；轻蔑的眼神；冷落或看不起
english_meaning: a scornful or contemptuous look; to give someone the cold shoulder or to snub
explanation_mandarin: 指用轻蔑或不屑的眼神看别人，也可作动词表示冷落或看不起某人。
explanation_english: Refers to a contemptuous or scornful look; can be used as a noun (a cold look) or as a verb (to snub or give someone the cold shoulder).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對我擺白眼，我都唔知做錯咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 ngo5 baai2 baak6 ngaan5, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 zou6 co3 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常对我白眼，我都不知道做错了什么。
examples.english_sentence: He often gives me the cold shoulder; I don't know what I did wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日擺白眼啦，有咩事就講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 baai2 baak6 ngaan5 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 zau6 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是白眼，有什么事就说明白。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep giving (people) the cold shoulder; if there's something, just say it clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 空白選票（投票時未填寫有效候選人以表達棄權或不滿）；口語亦可指免費贈票、免費入場券
english_meaning: blank ballot (a ballot with no valid choice, used to express abstention or protest); colloquially, a complimentary/free ticket
explanation_mandarin: 「白票」在選舉語境中指投出空白選票，用以表示棄權或抗議；在日常口語中，有時也用來稱呼免費得到的票券（如贈票、免費入場券）。
explanation_english: In elections, "白票" refers to a blank ballot cast to indicate abstention or protest. Informally, it can also mean a complimentary or free ticket (e.g., a free-entry pass).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對候選人都唔滿意，可以投白票表達不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 hau6 syun2 jan4 dou1 m4 mun5 ji3, ho2 ji5 tau4 baak6 piu3 biu2 daat6 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果對候選人都不滿意，可以投白票表達不滿。
examples.english_sentence: If you're unhappy with all the candidates, you can cast a blank vote to show your dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朋友攞到兩張白票，今晚可以免費入場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pang4 jau5 lo2 dou3 loeng5 zoeng1 baak6 piu3, gam1 maan5 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 jap6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 朋友拿到兩張白票，今晚可以免費入場。
examples.english_sentence: My friend got two complimentary tickets, so we can get in for free tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 白种人
english_meaning: white person; Caucasian
explanation_mandarin: 指皮膚較白的外國人或屬於白人種的人。常用於口語描述，語氣可中性，但在某些語境下可能帶有冒犯或刻板印象的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to people of the white/Caucasian racial group—foreigners with light/white skin. Commonly used colloquially; can be neutral but may carry offensive or stereotypical connotations depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺尖沙咀成日見到好多白種人旅客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zim1 saa1 zeoi2 sing4 jat6 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 baak6 zung2 jan4 leoi5 haak3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在尖沙咀经常看到很多白种人旅客。
examples.english_sentence: You often see many white tourists in Tsim Sha Tsui.

mandarin_meaning: 白白地站著；無所作為地站着（口語）
english_meaning: to stand idly / to stand there doing nothing; to be left standing in vain (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語詞，指無所事事地站着或白白地站在一旁，沒有幫忙或沒有實際作用。常用於催促或責備他人不要只是站着不做事。用法非正式，較常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to stand around idly or to stand there doing nothing. Often used to urge or scold someone for not helping or taking action. Informal and commonly heard in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺度白立，幫手搞掂下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 baak6 lap6, bong1 sau2 gaau2 dim6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要總是站在那裡不做事，幫忙處理一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always just stand there doing nothing; help sort it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢約埋我去幫手，但我到場發現大家都白立，最後只好自己做晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joek3 maai4 ngo5 heoi3 bong1 sau2, daan6 ngo5 dou3 coeng4 faat3 jin6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 baak6 lap6, zeoi3 hau6 zi2 hou2 zi6 gei2 zou6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他約我去幫忙，但我到場發現大家都只是在那裡白站著，最後只好自己全部做完。
examples.english_sentence: He asked me to help, but when I arrived everyone was just standing there doing nothing, so I ended up doing it all myself.

mandarin_meaning: 白米（精制或未煮的米）
english_meaning: white rice (polished rice; uncooked rice)
explanation_mandarin: 指精制的稻米，常作为主食，亦可指未煮的米。烹饪前通常需要淘洗。
explanation_english: Refers to polished rice commonly used as a staple food; can mean uncooked rice. It is usually washed before cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢袋白米係咪新買㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 doi2 baak6 mai5 hai6 mai6 san1 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这袋白米是不是新买的？
examples.english_sentence: Is this bag of white rice newly bought?

mandarin_meaning: 白色粉末狀的毒品（俗稱），通常指海洛因，有時泛指其他白色粉末類毒品
english_meaning: A slang term for white powdered illegal drugs; in Cantonese it commonly refers to heroin (sometimes used generically for white powdered narcotics)
explanation_mandarin: 「白粉」為粵語俚語，指白色粉末狀的非法藥物，日常語境中多指海洛因，也可泛指其他白色粉末毒品或吸毒行為相關事物。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang word referring to white powdered illegal drugs. In everyday use it most often denotes heroin, but can also be used more generally for other white powdered narcotics or matters related to drug use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺屋企搜到啲白粉，嫌疑人已經被拘捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geng2 fong1 hai2 uk1 kei2 sau1 dou3 di1 baak6 fan2, haam4 ji4 jan4 ji5 ging1 bei6 kau1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在他家搜出一些白粉，嫌疑人已被拘捕。
examples.english_sentence: The police found some white powder at his home; the suspect has been arrested.

mandarin_meaning: 吸食白色粉末類毒品的吸毒者（通常指海洛因或可卡因等），帶有貶義
english_meaning: a junkie; a person who uses white powdered drugs (e.g. heroin or cocaine) — derogatory slang
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俗稱，指經常吸食白色粉末類毒品的人。用法帶有貶義或侮辱性，屬俚語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used in Hong Kong for someone who regularly uses white powdered drugs (commonly heroin or cocaine). It is colloquial and derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個白粉佬成日出入嗰間大廈，鄰居都好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 baak6 fan2 lou2 sing4 jat6 ceot1 jap6 go2 gaan1 daai6 haa6, leon4 geoi1 dou1 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个白粉佬经常出入那幢大厦，邻居们都很担心。
examples.english_sentence: That junkie often goes in and out of that building; the neighbors are very worried.

mandarin_meaning: 吸食白色粉狀毒品的人（俗稱，多指海洛因使用者）
english_meaning: a drug user of white powder drugs (slang); typically refers to a heroin addict in Hong Kong
explanation_mandarin: 「白粉友」為香港俗稱，用來指吸食白色粉狀毒品的人，通常指海洛因等鴉片類或白色粉劑的使用者，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong slang term referring to a person who uses white powder drugs; commonly denotes a heroin user. The term is colloquial and derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係白粉友，依家戒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5cin4 hai6 baak6 fan2 jau5, ji1gaa1 git3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是白粉友，現在已經戒掉了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a heroin addict; he's quit now.

mandarin_meaning: 白粥（báizhōu），用白米煮成的清淡粥品
english_meaning: plain congee / plain rice porridge
explanation_mandarin: 白粥指用白米加大量水煮成的稀粥，口味清淡，常作早餐或病人、嬰幼兒容易消化時食用。
explanation_english: Plain congee made from rice and water; mild in flavor and easy to digest, commonly eaten for breakfast or given to the sick and young children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食白粥，唔想食太重口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 baak6-zuk1, m4 soeng2 sik6 taai3 zung6 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃白粥，不想吃太重口味。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat plain congee tonight; I don't want anything too strongly flavored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔肚痛，媽媽煲咗白粥畀佢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 tou5 tung3, maa4 maa1 bou1 zo2 baak6-zuk1 bei2 keoi5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩肚子痛，媽媽煮了白粥給他吃。
examples.english_sentence: The child had a stomachache, and mom cooked plain congee for him.

mandarin_meaning: 白糖（白砂糖），精制蔗糖或甜菜糖，常用于烘焙和调味
english_meaning: white sugar (granulated sugar), refined sucrose used in baking and sweetening
explanation_mandarin: 白糖指顆粒狀的精製糖，通常由甘蔗或甜菜提煉，常用於烹飪、烘焙與飲品調味。
explanation_english: White sugar refers to granulated refined sugar, usually derived from sugarcane or sugar beet, commonly used in cooking, baking, and sweetening drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一包白糖，想整蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 baak6 tong4, soeng2 zing2 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一包白糖，想做蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bag of white sugar and want to make a cake.

mandarin_meaning: 白糖糕（白糖发糕/白糖蒸糕）
english_meaning: white sugar sponge cake (Cantonese steamed sugar cake)
explanation_mandarin: 白糖糕是廣東傳統點心之一，通常用粘米粉或米粉和白糖發酵後蒸製，質地鬆軟、有些微發酵的香氣，常見於茶樓或點心店作為甜品或點心。
explanation_english: A traditional Cantonese steamed sugar sponge cake made from rice flour (or glutinous rice flour) and white sugar, often lightly fermented. It has a spongy, airy texture with a mildly sweet and slightly tangy aroma, commonly served as dim sum or a sweet snack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 茶樓嘅白糖糕好鬆軟，好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 lau4 ge3 baak6 tong4 gou1 hou2 sung1 jyun5, hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 茶樓的白糖糕很松軟，很香。
examples.english_sentence: The white sugar sponge cakes at the teahouse are very fluffy and fragrant.

mandarin_meaning: 白纸
english_meaning: blank paper; blank sheet (literal); can be used metaphorically as 'blank slate' or to symbolize censorship/absence of content
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指未有書寫的白紙。口語中可指「白紙一張」即一張空白的狀態，或比喻為對某事物毫無認識（blank slate）。在近年社會語境中，白紙亦曾成為表達對審查或言論受限的象徵。
explanation_english: Literally a sheet of paper with nothing written on it. Colloquially it can mean a 'blank slate' (no knowledge on a topic) or be used symbolically (e.g., as a protest symbol against censorship).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請畀我一張白紙，我要寫低啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 bei2 ngo5 jat1 zoeng1 baak6 zi2, ngo5 jiu3 se2 dai1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我一张白纸，我要写下东西。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a blank sheet of paper; I need to write something down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個話題好似白紙咁，乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 waa6 tai4 hou2 ci5 baak6 zi2 gam2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这个话题像白纸一样，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He is like a blank slate on this topic — he doesn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 信上有白紙黑字，你唔可以否認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seon3 soeng6 jau5 baak6 zi2 hak1 zi6, nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 fau2 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 信上有白纸黑字，你不可以否认。
examples.english_sentence: The letter is written in black and white; you can't deny it.

mandarin_meaning: 一张白纸；比喻对某事完全不懂或从零开始
english_meaning: a blank sheet of paper; figuratively, completely ignorant or starting from scratch
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指一張白紙，常用作比喻，表示對某個領域或事情完全不懂，或形容從零開始、沒有基礎。
explanation_english: Literally 'a blank sheet of paper.' Used figuratively to describe someone who knows nothing about a subject, is inexperienced, or is starting from scratch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個題目係白紙一張，唔識答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 tai4 muk6 hai6 baak6 zi2 jat1 zoeng1, m4 sik1 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个题目是一张白纸，不会回答。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a blank slate on this topic; I can't answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢份工之前，我真係白紙一張，要由頭學起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 zi1 cin4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 baak6 zi2 jat1 zoeng1, jiu3 jau4 tau4 hok6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这份工作之前，我真的是一张白纸，要从头学起。
examples.english_sentence: Before doing this job, I was completely inexperienced and had to learn from scratch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺審訊入面，佢裝作白紙一張，話乜嘢都唔記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sam2 seon3 jap6 min6, keoi5 zong1 zok3 baak6 zi2 jat1 zoeng1, waa6 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在审讯中，他装作一张白纸，说什么都不记得。
examples.english_sentence: During the interrogation, he pretended to be completely ignorant, saying he didn't remember anything.

mandarin_meaning: 白纸扇（字面：用白紙做的扇子）
english_meaning: white paper fan (a fan made of plain white paper)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是用白紙製成的扇子，常見於廉價的一次性手扇或作為宣傳贈品、戲劇道具等。在口語中較少見，比喻用法不多，但偶爾可用來形容表面簡單或容易被利用的物件或人（非普遍用法）。
explanation_english: Literally a fan made of plain white paper. Commonly refers to inexpensive disposable hand fans or promotional giveaways and can be used as a prop in performances. Figurative usage is uncommon, though it may occasionally be used to suggest something or someone appears simple or easily used (not a widespread sense).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天有啲檔口會免費派白紙扇俾顧客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 jau5 di1 dong3 hau2 wui5 min5 fai3 paai3 baak6 zi2 sin3 bei2 gu3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天有些攤位會免費派白紙扇給顧客。
examples.english_sentence: In summer some stalls give away white paper fans to customers.

mandarin_meaning: 空白的草案；沒有實質內容或具體細節的初稿
english_meaning: a draft that is blank or lacks substantive content; a placeholder or conceptual draft
explanation_mandarin: 指一份沒有具體內容或實質建議的草案，通常只是佔位或示意性的初稿，未包含詳細方案。
explanation_english: Refers to a draft that contains little or no concrete content or proposals; typically a placeholder or conceptual initial draft without detailed plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份白紙草案睇落好空，冇乜實質內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 baak6 zi2 cou2 on3 tai2 lok6 hou2 hung1, mou5 mat1 sat6 zik1 noi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份白紙草案看起來很空，沒什麼實質內容。
examples.english_sentence: That draft looks empty; it doesn't contain much substantive content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再遞交白紙草案，大家需要更清楚嘅方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 dai6 gaau1 baak6 zi2 cou2 on3, daai6 gaa1 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 cing1 co2 ge3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再提交空白草案，大家需要更清楚的方案。
examples.english_sentence: Don't submit blank drafts again; we need clearer, more concrete proposals.

mandarin_meaning: 白紙黑字
english_meaning: in black and white; written down; written proof
explanation_mandarin: 指以書面文字記載、能作為憑證的內容，強調有書面證據且明確不可爭辯。
explanation_english: Refers to something documented in writing (literally 'white paper, black characters'), emphasizing written proof or clear documentary evidence that is hard to dispute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約係白紙黑字，你無得反悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 hai6 baak6 zi2 hak1 zi6, nei5 mou5 dak1 faan2 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同是白纸黑字，你不能反悔。
examples.english_sentence: This contract is in black and white; you can't back out.

mandarin_meaning: 白俄罗斯（國名）
english_meaning: Belarus (country)
explanation_mandarin: 「白羅斯」是白俄羅斯（Belarus）的音譯，用於指稱位於東歐的一個國家。
explanation_english: "白羅斯" is the Cantonese transliteration of Belarus, a country in Eastern Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想去白羅斯旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 baak6 lo4 si1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想去白俄罗斯旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to travel to Belarus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白羅斯嘅首都係明斯克。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 lo4 si1 ge3 sau2 dou1 hai6 ming4 si1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白俄罗斯的首都是明斯克。
examples.english_sentence: Belarus's capital is Minsk.

mandarin_meaning: 白羊座（Báiyángzuò），黃道十二宮之一，對應白羊座星座。
english_meaning: Aries (the zodiac sign represented by the ram).
explanation_mandarin: 白羊座是黃道十二星座之一，象徵公羊，出生日期大致為每年3月21日至4月19日。在占星學中，白羊座通常被認為具有衝動、積極和勇敢的特質。
explanation_english: One of the twelve zodiac signs, Aries is symbolized by the ram and generally covers birthdays from about March 21 to April 19. In astrology, Aries is often associated with impulsiveness, energy, and assertiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係白羊座，通常都幾衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 baak6 joeng4 zo6, tung1 soeng4 dou1 gei2 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是白羊座，通常比较冲动。
examples.english_sentence: I'm an Aries; I'm usually quite impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 白羊座通常係三月二十一號到四月十九號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak6 joeng4 zo6 tung1 soeng4 hai6 saam1 jyut6 ji6 sap6 jat1 hou6 dou3 sei3 jyut6 sap6 gau2 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 白羊座通常是3月21号到4月19号。
examples.english_sentence: Aries usually runs from March 21 to April 19.

mandarin_meaning: 白色的翅膀；（引申）白色翅膀或潔白翼狀物
english_meaning: white wing; white‑winged (literal); can be used metaphorically (e.g., angelic wings)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「白翼」在廣東話中並非常見的成語或固定詞彙，主要是字面用法，指白色的翅膀，用於描述鳥類、昆蟲等的翅膀，或在文學中作為比喻（如潔白、純潔、天使的翅膀等）。也可作為名稱或描述性的短語。
explanation_english: “白翼” is not a common fixed Cantonese idiom; it is mainly a literal phrase meaning 'white wings'. It describes the white wings of birds, insects, etc., and can be used metaphorically in literature (e.g., purity or angelic wings). It may also appear as a name or descriptive phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻雀有白翼，好易認得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 zoek3 jau5 baak6 jik6, hou2 ji6 jing6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只鳥有白色的翅膀，很容易認出來。
examples.english_sentence: That bird has white wings, easy to recognize.

mandarin_meaning: 白老鼠（指實驗用的老鼠；比喻被用作實驗或試驗的人或對象）
english_meaning: literally 'white mouse'; a lab mouse or, figuratively, a guinea pig — someone used as a test subject
explanation_mandarin: 本詞可指實驗室中用作科學試驗的白色老鼠；引申為比喻用語，指被用來做嘗試、試驗或測試的人或對象，常含有被動或不情願的語氣。
explanation_english: Refers to a laboratory mouse used in experiments; figuratively used to describe a person or subject used for trials or tests (a 'guinea pig'), often implying passivity or unwillingness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想畀佢哋當白老鼠做實驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 dong3 baak6 lou5 syu2 zou6 sat6 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想被他们当白老鼠做实验。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be used as a guinea pig for their experiments.

mandarin_meaning: 白肉
english_meaning: white meat (pale-colored meat such as poultry, some pork cuts, or fish)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指顏色較淺的動物肉類（如家禽、魚以及某些豬肉部位），與紅肉（如牛、羊）相對；在粵菜語境下，有時也用來指以清蒸或白切方式處理的肉類。
explanation_english: Refers to pale-colored animal meat (e.g., poultry, certain pork cuts, fish), contrasted with red meat (beef, lamb). In Cantonese culinary context it can also refer to meats prepared plainly (e.g., 'white-cut' chicken or pork).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意食白肉定紅肉？
