examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jan4 coi4 baak3 zung1 mou4 jat1, hou2 naan4 wan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种人才百中无一，很难找到。
examples.english_sentence: People like this are one in a hundred; very hard to find.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種機會百中無一，唔可以錯過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 gei1 wui6 baak3 zung1 mou4 jat1, m4 ho2 ji5 co3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种机会百中无一，不能错过。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of opportunity is one in a hundred; you can't miss it.

mandarin_meaning: （1）很多事情、各種事務、諸事；（2）百事可樂（Pepsi）的簡稱
english_meaning: (1) many matters; everything/various affairs; (2) short for Pepsi (the cola brand)
explanation_mandarin: 「百事」可用作書面或口語，表示各種事情、諸事不一（例如「百事皆休」）；在現代粵語口語中常作「百事可樂」的簡稱，指飲料品牌Pepsi。
explanation_english: “百事” can mean (1) many matters or all sorts of affairs (used in literary or colloquial contexts), or (2) colloquially in Cantonese as a short form of “Pepsi” (the cola brand).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗支百事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 baak3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一瓶百事（可樂）。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bottle of Pepsi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我百事唔順，諗咩都唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 baak3 si6 m4 seon6, lam2 me1 dou1 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我諸事不順，想什麼都不對。
examples.english_sentence: Lately everything's been going wrong for me; nothing I try works.

mandarin_meaning: 百事可乐（Pepsi）
english_meaning: Pepsi (the cola soft drink/brand)
explanation_mandarin: 百事可乐是碳酸饮料品牌Pepsi在中文的名称，用来指该品牌或其产品（可乐饮料）。
explanation_english: The Chinese name for the Pepsi soft drink brand; used to refer to the cola beverage or the Pepsi brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲百事可樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 baak3 si6 ho2 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝百事可乐。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a Pepsi.

mandarin_meaning: 百佳（香港大型連鎖超市品牌）
english_meaning: ParknShop (a major Hong Kong supermarket chain)
explanation_mandarin: 「百佳」是香港常見的大型連鎖超級市場品牌名稱，也可按字面理解為「百般美好/百種優質」。在口語中常用來指該超市或在該店購物的情況。
explanation_english: “百佳” is the Chinese name for ParknShop, a major supermarket chain in Hong Kong. Literally it suggests ‘hundred good (things)’. It is used as the brand name and commonly refers to the store or shopping there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去百佳買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 baak3 gaa1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去百佳買東西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to ParknShop to buy some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 百佳而家有特價，買二送一，好抵！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 gaa1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 dak6 gaa3, maai5 ji6 sung3 jat1, hou2 dai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 百佳現在有特價，買二送一，很划算！
examples.english_sentence: ParknShop has a sale now — buy two get one free; it's a great deal!

mandarin_meaning: 裸体宴会 / 裸体派对
english_meaning: nude party; naked party; clothing-optional party
explanation_mandarin: 俗称，指参与者多数赤裸或完全裸体的宴会或聚会，通常为成人场合，有时带有挑逗或娱乐性质。在不同语境可能带俚语或贬义色彩。
explanation_english: Colloquial term for a gathering or party where most participants are naked; typically an adult event, sometimes erotic or playful in nature. Usage can be slangy or carry negative connotations depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋喺酒店搞咗個百倮宴，全部人都赤裸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 hai6 zau2 dim3 gaau2 zo2 go3 baak3 lo2 jin3, cyun4 bou6 jan4 dou1 cek3 lo2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们在酒店办了一个裸体派对，所有人都全裸了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard they held a nude party at a hotel; everyone was completely naked.

mandarin_meaning: 完全沒有；絕對沒有
english_meaning: completely none; absolutely not
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，用以強調「沒有、一點也沒有」，常見於香港日常對話，用來加強否定語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used to emphasize absence or negation ('have none at all', 'absolutely not'). Common in Hong Kong speech to intensify a negative statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個提議百冇興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 baak3 mou5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對這個提議完全沒有興趣。
examples.english_sentence: He has absolutely no interest in this proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班人百冇紀律，成日遲到又唔守規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 jan4 baak3 mou5 gei2 leot6, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 jau6 m4 sau2 gwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這班人完全沒有紀律，整天遲到又不守規矩。
examples.english_sentence: This group has absolutely no discipline; they're always late and don't follow rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告啲數據百冇可信性，唔好用嚟做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 di1 sou3 geoi3 baak3 mou5 ho2 seon3 sing3, m4 hou2 jung6 lai4 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告的數據完全沒有可信度，不要用來做決定。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report are completely unreliable; don't use them to make decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 百分之 (bǎi fēn zhī)
english_meaning: percent; per cent (marker indicating a proportion out of 100)
explanation_mandarin: 用来表示某事物占整体的比例，相当于英语的“percent”，通常放在数词前，例如“百分之五十”表示50%。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a proportion out of one hundred (percent). It functions as a percent marker that typically precedes the numeral (e.g., 百分之五十 = 50%).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試我嘅合格率係百分之八十。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 ge3 hap6 gok3 leot6 hai6 baak3 fan6 zi1 baat3 sap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我的合格率是百分之八十。
examples.english_sentence: My pass rate for this exam is 80%.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事成功嘅機會只有百分之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 sing4 gung1 ge3 gei1 wui6 zi2 jau5 baak3 fan6 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事成功的机会只有百分之一。
examples.english_sentence: The chance of this succeeding is only 1%.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你表現好，可能會有百分之十嘅加薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 biu2 jin2 hou2, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 baak3 fan6 zi1 sap6 ge3 gaa1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你表现好，可能会有百分之十的加薪。
examples.english_sentence: If you perform well, you might get a 10% raise.

mandarin_meaning: 百分数（表示以每一百為基準的比率）
english_meaning: percent; percentage (a value expressed as parts per hundred)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以百分比表示的數值，指每一百份中的多少，常用來表示比例、比率或成績等。
explanation_english: A numerical value expressed as parts per hundred; used to represent proportions, rates, scores, or changes in percentage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅百分數係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 baak3 fan1 sou3 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的百分数是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What is your percentage?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近失業率嘅百分數上升咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 sat1 jip6 leot6 ge3 baak3 fan1 sou3 soeng5 sing1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近失业率的百分数上升了。
examples.english_sentence: The unemployment percentage has risen recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以將呢個分數轉做百分數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 ni1 go3 fan1 sou3 zyun2 zou6 baak3 fan1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把这个分数转换成百分数。
examples.english_sentence: You can convert this fraction into a percentage.

mandarin_meaning: 百分比 (bǎi fēn bǐ)
english_meaning: percentage; percent
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一數值在整體中所佔的比例，通常以百分比（%）來表示。
explanation_english: Indicates the proportion of a value relative to the whole, usually expressed as a percentage (%).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成功嘅百分比有幾高？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 gung1 ge3 baak3 fan1 bei2 jau5 gei2 gou1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的成功百分比有多高？
examples.english_sentence: What's your percentage chance of success?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司合格產品嘅百分比上升咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hap6 gok3 caan2 ban2 ge3 baak3 fan1 bei2 soeng5 sing1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的合格產品的百分比上升了。
examples.english_sentence: The percentage of qualified products at the company has increased.

mandarin_meaning: 百分率（bǎifēnlǜ），表示每一百份中的比率
english_meaning: percentage; percent rate (the proportion per hundred)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某一數值佔整體的比例，通常以百分比（%）表示。
explanation_english: Used to indicate how much a value represents of a whole, usually expressed as a percent (%).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅成功百分率只有30%。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 gung1 baak3 fan1 leot6 zi2 jau5 30%.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的成功百分率只有30%。
examples.english_sentence: The success percentage of this project is only 30%.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果出席百分率唔夠高，會議就開唔成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ceot1 zik1 baak3 fan1 leot6 m4 gau3 gou1, wui6 ji5 zau6 hoi1 m4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果出席百分率不够高，会议就开不成。
examples.english_sentence: If the attendance percentage isn't high enough, the meeting can't go ahead.

mandarin_meaning: 百分之百；完全、絕對
english_meaning: 100%; completely; absolutely; definitely
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示程度達到一百百分比，意即完全或絕對，常用來強調肯定、保證或效果。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a full 100% degree — completely or absolutely. Often used to emphasize certainty, assurance, or effectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我百分百肯定佢冇做呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baak3 fan6 baak3 hang2 ding6 keoi5 mou5 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我百分之百肯定他/她沒有做這件事。
examples.english_sentence: I'm 100% sure he/she didn't do this.

mandarin_meaning: 百分点（表示百分比之间的差距或变动的单位）
english_meaning: percentage point (the unit measuring the arithmetic difference between percentages)
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩個百分比之間的絕對差距或變動的單位。例如從10%到12%是增加了2個百分點；這與按百分比計算的相對變動不同。
explanation_english: A unit that denotes the absolute difference between two percentages. For example, an increase from 10% to 12% is an increase of 2 percentage points; this is different from relative percent change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 根據報告，失業率跌咗兩個百分點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 geoi3 bou3 gou3, sat1 jip6 leot6 dit3 zo2 loeng5 go3 baak3 fan6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 根據報告，失業率下降了兩個百分點。
examples.english_sentence: According to the report, the unemployment rate fell by two percentage points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投票結果顯示，支持率上升咗五個百分點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 piu3 git3 gwo2 hin2 si6, zi1 ci4 leot6 soeng5 sing1 zo2 ng5 go3 baak3 fan6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投票结果显示，支持率上升了五个百分点。
examples.english_sentence: The poll results show that support rose by five percentage points.

mandarin_meaning: （音譯）百利士（罕見或作品牌/專有名詞用）
english_meaning: Bailishi (transliteration; a rare/obscure proper name or brand; no common lexical meaning in Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「百利士」在粵語中不是一個常見的詞彙，通常作為外來語或品牌／專有名詞的音譯出現，沒有廣泛固定的詞義。具體意指需視上下文或該名稱所指的實體而定。
explanation_english: “百利士” is not a common Cantonese lexical item; it typically appears as a transliteration of a foreign name/brand and does not have a widely established meaning in Cantonese. Its exact referent depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔太清楚百利士係乜嘢，可能係個外國品牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 taai3 cing1 co2 baak3 lei6 si6 hai6 mat1 je5, ho2 nang4 hai6 go3 ngoi6 gwok3 ban1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太清楚“百利士”是什么，可能是个外国品牌。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not too sure what "百利士" is; it might be a foreign brand.

mandarin_meaning: （不常见）可能是人名或外來名／品牌的音譯；有時被誤寫或誤稱為「百加得」（Bacardi）
english_meaning: Rare/uncertain usage — likely a proper name or a transliteration of an external name/brand; sometimes mistaken for 'Bacardi'.
explanation_mandarin: 「百加利」在粵語中並非常見詞彙，沒有固定的通行義項。常見情況是作為人名、地名或外來品牌的音譯；亦有可能是把「百加得」（Bacardi）等外來名稱誤寫或誤讀的變體。使用時應根據語境判斷其具體指涉。
explanation_english: “百加利” is not a common Cantonese lexical item and does not have a standard established meaning. It is most likely used as a proper name (person/place) or as a transliteration of an external brand/name. It can also appear as a mistaken variant of “百加得” (Bacardi). Context is needed to determine the exact reference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽人講「百加利」，但我未聽過，究竟係乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 jan4 gong2 "baak3 gaa1 lei6", daan6 ngo5 mei6 teng1 gwo3, gau3 ging2 hai6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听人说「百加利」，但我没听过，究竟是什么？
examples.english_sentence: I heard people say '百加利', but I've never heard of it — what exactly is it?

mandarin_meaning: 非常討厭／惹人厭煩
english_meaning: very annoying; irritating; obnoxious
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，形容人或行為令人生厭、惹人煩或很煩躁。常用於香港日常對話，語氣可輕鬆或帶不滿。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term used to describe a person or behaviour that is extremely annoying or irritating. Common in Hong Kong speech; can be used jokingly or with displeasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好百厭，成日笑我哋唔識嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 baak3 jim3, sing4 jat6 siu3 ngo5 dei6 m4 sik1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很討厭，經常嘲笑我們不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He's really annoying, constantly mocking us for being ignorant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個同事好百厭，成日遲到又推卸責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 tung4 si6 hou2 baak3 jim3, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 jau6 teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個同事很惹人厭，經常遲到還推卸責任。
examples.english_sentence: That colleague is really irritating; he’s always late and shirks responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友到咗下午就變得好百厭，唔肯聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 dou3 zo2 haa6 ng5 zau6 bin3 dak1 hou2 baak3 jim3, m4 hang2 teng1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子到下午會變得很煩，不肯聽話。
examples.english_sentence: The kids get really annoying in the afternoon and won't listen.

mandarin_meaning: 討厭鬼；令人很討厭或愛惹事的人
english_meaning: an annoying person; a nuisance or pest (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容非常惹人厭煩、愛惹事或令人生氣的人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who is extremely annoying, habitually causes trouble, or is a nuisance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司鬧人同搞事，真係個百厭星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 nau6 jan4 tung4 gaau2 si6, zan1 hai6 go3 baak3 jim3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在公司挑事、罵人，真是個討厭鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He is always causing trouble and yelling at people in the office — such an annoying person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好理佢啦，佢淨係想惹人注意，係個百厭星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 laa3, keoi5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 je5 jan4 zyu3 ji3, hai6 go3 baak3 jim3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理他，他只是想惹人注意，是個討厭鬼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay attention to him — he just wants attention; he's an annoying pest.

mandarin_meaning: 十足的討厭鬼、搗蛋鬼（口語，形容非常討人厭或愛惹事的人）
english_meaning: an extremely annoying person / pesky little rascal (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「百厭精」是廣東話口語，常用來形容某人非常討厭、煩人或愛惹事、愛鬧的人，語氣可以是半開玩笑或帶不滿。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who is extremely annoying, a pesky troublemaker or little rascal. It can be used jokingly or with mild irritation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞嘢，簡直係個百厭精。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 je5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 go3 baak3 jim3 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天搗亂，簡直就是個討厭鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble — he's a real little rascal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢，佢就係個百厭精，成日扮嘢想激你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 zau6 hai6 go3 baak3 jim3 zing1, seng4 jat6 baan6 je5 soeng2 gik1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理他，他就是個討厭鬼，老是在逗你生氣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay him any attention — he's such a nuisance, always trying to rile you up.

mandarin_meaning: 很惹人厭煩的人（討厭的人）
english_meaning: an annoying person; a pest; someone who is very irritating
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來形容令人覺得很煩、很討厭的人。語氣可輕鬆帶玩笑，也可用來責備對方。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who is very annoying or irritating. Can be used jokingly or as a mild rebuke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，又唔打招呼，真係百厭鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, jau6 m4 daa2 ziu1 fu1, zan1 hai6 baak3 jim3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常遲到，也不打招呼，真是個令人討厭的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late and doesn't even say hello — such an annoying person.

mandarin_meaning: 百口莫辩（无法辩解、无可辩驳）
english_meaning: Unable to defend oneself; cannot offer any plausible explanation or refutation
explanation_mandarin: 指無論怎樣解釋、說多少話也無法辯白或自證清白，常用來形容面對明確證據或指控時無法辯駁。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning one cannot give any convincing explanation or defense; used when someone is unable to refute accusations or evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 證據擺喺眼前，佢百口莫辯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 geoi3 baai2 hai2 ngaan5 cin4, keoi5 baak3 hau2 mok6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 证据摆在眼前，他百口莫辩。
examples.english_sentence: With the evidence laid out before him, he couldn't defend himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 即使佢不停解釋，大家都覺得佢百口莫辯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 si2 keoi5 bat1 ting4 gaai2 sik1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 baak3 hau2 mok6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使他不停解释，大家也觉得他百口莫辩。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he kept explaining, everyone felt he couldn't justify himself.

mandarin_meaning: 百合（bǎihé）：1) 百合科植物及其花朵；2)（网络/次文化用法）指描写女性之间恋爱关系的题材（即“百合”或yuri）。
english_meaning: Lily: 1) the lily plant and its flower; 2) (internet/anime context) a genre depicting romantic relationships between women (yuri).
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指一種常見的園藝植物，花朵美麗並常作觀賞或入藥、入饌；2) 在二次元或網絡語境中，簡稱『百合』，指以女性之間戀愛為題材的作品或取向。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to the lily plant, often grown for its attractive flowers and used in cuisine or traditional medicine; 2) In internet/anime contexts, '百合' (yuri) denotes works or themes focusing on romantic relationships between women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度種咗好多百合，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 baak3 hap6, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里种了很多百合，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: There are many lilies planted here; they're very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意睇百合題材嘅漫畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 tai2 baak3 hap6 tai4 coi4 ge3 maan6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她喜欢看百合题材的漫画。
examples.english_sentence: She likes reading manga with yuri themes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中藥入面，百合可以滋陰潤肺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 joek3 jap6 min6, baak3 hap6 ho2 ji5 zi1 jam1 jeon6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在中药中，百合可以滋阴润肺。
examples.english_sentence: In traditional Chinese medicine, lily can nourish yin and moisten the lungs.

mandarin_meaning: 百合勺（用來舀百合或糖水百合的小勺子）
english_meaning: lily spoon (a small spoon used to scoop lily bulbs or lily sweet soup)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指用來舀百合（如糖水或甜品裡的百合）的專用小勺子。在日常廣東話中以字面用法為主，並非常見的慣用語或俚語。
explanation_english: Literally a spoon for lily bulbs (used to scoop lily in sweet soups or desserts). This is primarily a literal, kitchen-related term in Cantonese rather than a common idiom or slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻百合匙係用嚟拎糖水入面嘅百合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 baak3 hap6 ci4 hai6 jung6 lai4 ling1 tong4 seoi2 jap6 min6 ge3 baak3 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把百合勺是用来取糖水里百合的。
examples.english_sentence: This lily spoon is used to scoop the lily bulbs in the sweet soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚具舖有賣唔同款式嘅百合匙，好適合煲甜品用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 geoi6 pou3 jau5 maai6 m4 tung4 fun2 sik1 ge3 baak3 hap6 ci4, hou2 sik1 hap6 bou1 tim4 ban2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨具店有卖不同款式的百合勺，很适合煲甜品用。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchenware shop sells different styles of lily spoons, great for making desserts.

mandarin_meaning: 百合花（百合屬的花），常見的花卉，象徵純潔與幸福
english_meaning: lily (the flower); commonly used flower symbolizing purity and happiness
explanation_mandarin: 百合花是一種常見的花卉，常用於婚禮或作為祝福時的花束，象徵純潔、無瑕與幸福。
explanation_english: The lily is a common flower often used in weddings and bouquets; it symbolizes purity, innocence, and happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗一束白色嘅百合花畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 jat1 suk1 baak6 sik1 ge3 baak3 hap6 faa1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了一束白色的百合花給我。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a bouquet of white lilies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 百合花喺婚禮上好常見，代表純潔同幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 hap6 faa1 hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6 hou2 coeng4 gin3, doi6 biu2 seon4 git6 tung4 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 百合花在婚禮上很常見，代表純潔和幸福。
examples.english_sentence: Lilies are common at weddings and represent purity and happiness.

mandarin_meaning: 當然啦；肯定（口語強調）
english_meaning: of course; definitely (colloquial emphatic)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 語氣詞 / 感嘆詞（口語）
explanation_mandarin: 「百囉」是香港廣東話的口語用法，作為語氣詞或感嘆詞，用來強調某事很明顯或表示肯定、理所當然，語氣較隨意，常見於非正式對話。
explanation_english: “百囉” is a colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese particle used as an emphatic interjection to indicate certainty or that something is obvious. It’s informal and commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你信唔信佢會遲到？百囉，佢成日都咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon3 m4 seon3 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3? baak3 lo1, keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你相信他會遲到嗎？當然會，他常常這樣。
examples.english_sentence: Do you think he'll be late? Of course — he always is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為我會放棄？百囉，除非有非常合理的理由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai6 ngo5 wui5 fong3 hei3? baak3 lo1, ceoi4 fei1 jau5 fei1 soeng4 hap6 lei5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為我會放棄？當然不會，除非有非常合理的理由。
examples.english_sentence: You think I'll give up? Of course not — unless there's a very good reason.

mandarin_meaning: 百夫长（古罗马军官，指挥约一百名士兵）
english_meaning: centurion (an officer in ancient Roman armies commanding about a hundred soldiers)
explanation_mandarin: 指古罗马军队中负责指挥大约一百名士兵的军官。该词常见于历史、文学、影视及游戏等语境中。
explanation_english: An officer in ancient Roman armies responsible for commanding roughly one hundred soldiers. The term appears in historical texts, literature, films, and games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺羅馬軍隊入面，百夫長負責指揮一百個士兵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 lo4 maa5 gwan1 deoi2 jap6 min6, baak3 fu1 zoeng2 fu6 zaak3 zi2 fai1 jat1 baak3 go3 si6 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在罗马军队里，百夫长负责指挥一百名士兵。
examples.english_sentence: In Roman armies, a centurion was responsible for commanding about a hundred soldiers.

mandarin_meaning: 百姓（bǎi xìng）
english_meaning: the common people; the populace; civilians; the masses
explanation_mandarin: 指普通的人民、平民，常用來泛指廣大民眾或社會大眾。
explanation_english: Refers to ordinary people or commoners; used collectively for the general populace or the masses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該重視百姓嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 zung6 si6 baak3 sing3 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該重視百姓的需要。
examples.english_sentence: The government should pay attention to the needs of the people.

mandarin_meaning: 百子柜（中药铺或家庭用于存放中药材或小物件的多格抽屉柜）
english_meaning: apothecary chest / multi-drawer cabinet used to store herbs or small items
explanation_mandarin: 百子櫃指傳統中藥舖常見的那種有很多小抽屜的木櫃，用來分門別類存放各種藥材或小物件，也可作為古董或家具收藏。
explanation_english: A 百子櫃 is a traditional wooden cabinet with many small drawers, commonly used in Chinese medicine shops to store and organize herbs and small items. It can also be found as vintage furniture in homes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時中藥舖成日用百子櫃分類啲藥材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 zung1 joek6 pou3 sing4 jat6 jung6 baak3 zi2 gwai6 fan1 leot6 di1 joek6 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前中药店常用百子柜把药材分类。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, Chinese medicine shops often used apothecary cabinets to sort herbs.

mandarin_meaning: 《百家姓》（一本列出常見姓氏的古代書籍）
english_meaning: The Hundred Family Surnames (a classic Chinese text listing common family names)
explanation_mandarin: 《百家姓》成書於北宋，是一本列出各家姓氏的書，原為兒童識字與姓氏教學用書，最初收錄五百零四姓，後來有增補，常與《三字經》《千字文》並稱為傳統啟蒙讀物之一。
explanation_english: The Hundred Family Surnames is a Song-dynasty text that lists Chinese family names. Originally compiled as a primer for children (to teach characters and surnames), it initially contained 504 surnames and was later expanded. It is traditionally grouped with the Three Character Classic and the Thousand Character Classic as elementary educational texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路喺學校學《百家姓》，識咗好多常見嘅姓氏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 hai2 hok6 haau6 hok6 'baak3 gaa1 seng3', sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 soeng4 gin3 ge3 seng3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子在学校学《百家姓》，认识了很多常见的姓氏。
examples.english_sentence: Children learn The Hundred Family Surnames at school and learned many common surnames.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺中國文化入面，《百家姓》係了解姓氏來源嘅重要資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung1 gwok3 man4 faa3 jap6 min6, 'baak3 gaa1 seng3' hai6 liu5 gaai2 seng3 si6 loi4 jyun4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在中国文化中，《百家姓》是了解姓氏来源的重要资料。
examples.english_sentence: In Chinese culture, The Hundred Family Surnames is important material for understanding the origins of family names.

mandarin_meaning: 一种廉价、质地较粗糙的棉布（类似于calico/粗布），传统上为百姓常用的布料；也可泛指粗糙或劣质的布料。
english_meaning: A cheap, coarse cotton cloth (similar to calico); traditionally used by common people; can also figuratively mean coarse or inferior fabric.
explanation_mandarin: “百家布”原指价格便宜、质地粗糙的棉布，过去常见于民间衣物或家用布料。现在仍可用于描述一种具体的布料，或比喻为粗糙、廉价的东西。
explanation_english: “Baak gaa bou” originally refers to an inexpensive, coarse cotton cloth commonly used by ordinary people. It can describe a specific type of fabric or be used figuratively to mean something coarse or cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係用百家布做嘅，穿落去唔夠舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 jung6 baak3 gaa1 bou3 zou6 ge3, coen1 lok6 heoi3 m4 gau3 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是用百家布做的，穿起来不太舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This garment is made from calico/coarse cloth; it's not very comfortable to wear.

mandarin_meaning: 百家乐
english_meaning: baccarat (casino card game)
explanation_mandarin: 百家乐是一种在赌场常见的扑克牌赌博游戏，源自欧洲，英文为 baccarat。玩法包括押注「閒家」或「莊家」等，澳门和其他博彩场所非常流行。
explanation_english: A casino card game known as baccarat. Players bet on outcomes such as the 'player' or the 'banker'. Popular in casinos, especially in Macau and other gambling hubs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去澳門試下打百家樂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ou3 mun4 si3 haa5 daa2 baak3 gaa1 lok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去澳门试着打百家乐吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Macau and try playing baccarat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 百家樂係好受香港人歡迎嘅賭戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baak3 gaa1 lok6 hai6 hou2 sau6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 fun1 jing4 ge3 dou2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 百家乐是很受香港人欢迎的赌博游戏。
examples.english_sentence: Baccarat is a gambling game that is very popular with Hong Kong people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺百家樂贏咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baak3 gaa1 lok6 jing4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在百家乐赢了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He won a lot of money playing baccarat.

mandarin_meaning: 百家争鸣 (bǎi jiā zhēng míng) — 各種學說或意見並存並相互辯論，學術或思想領域呈現多元繁榮的局面（源自戰國時期諸子百家）
english_meaning: Literally 'a hundred schools contend' — a situation in which many different schools of thought or opinions coexist and debate; a flourishing of diverse ideas and open intellectual exchange
explanation_mandarin: 「百家爭鳴」出自中國古代，原指戰國時期諸子百家並起，互相辯論。現用來形容學術、思想或意見多元並熱烈討論的局面。
explanation_english: Originally from ancient China describing the Warring States period when many schools of thought debated. Now used to describe an environment with diverse viewpoints and active intellectual discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家互聯網資訊多，學術討論開放，真係一個百家爭鳴嘅時代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 wu6 lyun4 mong5 zi1 seon3 do1, hok6 seot6 tou2 leon6 hoi1 fong3, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 baak3 gaa1 zang1 ming4 ge3 si4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在互聯網資訊多，學術討論開放，真是一個百家爭鳴的時代。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays with abundant online information and open academic debate, it's truly an era of flourishing diverse opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 百密一疏
english_meaning: One oversight spoils a hundred precautions; a single slip can ruin everything
explanation_mandarin: 形容即使做得再周密，也可能會出現一處疏漏，導致遺憾或不良後果。
explanation_english: Describes that no matter how thorough the preparations are, there may still be one oversight that causes regret or negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢籌備婚禮籌得好周詳，點知百密一疏，竟然忘記咗預訂婚車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cau4 bei6 fan1 lai5 cau4 dak1 hou2 zau1 coeng4, dim2 zi1 baak3-mat6-jat1-so1, ging2 jin4 mong4 gei3 zo2 jyu6 deng6 fan1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他筹备婚礼筹得很周详，谁知百密一疏，竟然忘记了预订婚车。
examples.english_sentence: He planned the wedding very thoroughly, but despite that one oversight occurred — he forgot to reserve the wedding car.

mandarin_meaning: 百宝箱；装有许多宝物或各种有用物品的箱子；引申为资源或工具的汇集
english_meaning: treasure chest; a box containing many treasures or a collection/repository of useful items or resources
explanation_mandarin: 原指裝有珍貴財物的箱子；引申為用來收納各種有用物品或資源的容器或匯集，也可比喻為資訊或工具的寶庫。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a chest holding valuable treasures; by extension, it denotes a container or collection that holds many useful items or resources. It can also be used figuratively for a repository of information or tools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個旅行袋就好似一個百寶箱，乜都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 leoi5 hang4 doi2 zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 baak3 bou2 soeng1, mat1 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个旅行包就像一个百宝箱，什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: The travel bag is like a treasure chest — it has everything.

jyutping: baak3 cek3 gon1 tau4, gang3 zeon3 jat1 bou6
mandarin_meaning: 百尺竿頭，更進一步（在已達到很高境界時仍要繼續進步）
english_meaning: To make further progress even when at the pinnacle; to continue improving despite already having achieved a high level
explanation_mandarin: 此成語原指登高已到極點，仍要再向前邁進，現用來比喻即使已取得成就，仍應不斷進取、追求更高目標。
explanation_english: This idiom originally implies that even after reaching a great height one should advance further; it now means that even after achieving success one should keep striving for improvement and higher goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司已經好成功，但都要百尺竿頭，更進一步，繼續創新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 hou2 sing4 gung1, daan6 dou1 jiu3 baak3 cek3 gon1 tau4, gang3 zeon3 jat1 bou6, gai3 zuk6 cong3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司已经很成功，但仍要百尺竿头、更进一步，继续创新。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is already successful, but we must still strive to make further progress and continue innovating.

mandarin_meaning: 靠性關係/走後門才成才（粗俗俚語）
english_meaning: Vulgar slang meaning to become successful by sleeping with people, using backdoor connections, or by undeserved means
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話粗俗俚語，字面為「百次屌才成才」。常用作諷刺或貶義地形容某人靠性關係、走後門或不光彩的方式才得以出人頭地，也可作誇張的幽默說法，帶侮辱意味。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang phrase literally 'become talented after a hundred fucks.' Used sarcastically or pejoratively to describe someone who achieved success by sleeping with people, using backdoor connections, or other undeserved/unscrupulous means. It can also be used hyperbolically as a crude joke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠走後門先有今日，真係百屌成才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zou2 hau6 mun4 sin1 jau5 gam1 jat6, zan1 hai6 baak3 diu2 sing4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠走后门才有今天，真是靠性关系/不正當手段才出人頭地。
examples.english_sentence: He only got where he is by using connections/backdoor deals — it's like he got ahead by sleeping around.

mandarin_meaning: （粗口俚語）戲謔地把「百煉成材」改寫，意指經過很多挫折、被人罵或折磨（或被「屌」）後才成才／變得有用。
english_meaning: Vulgar slang parodying '百煉成材' — jokingly says someone became capable or useful only after many hardships, insults, or rough experiences ('being fucked' used figuratively).
explanation_mandarin: 這是一個粵語粗口俚語，從「百煉成材」改編而來，帶有諷刺與幽默意味，常用來形容一個人經歷多次失敗或磨練後才變得能幹或成熟。
explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar slang phrase derived from '百煉成材'. It is used tongue-in-cheek to describe someone who only became competent or resilient after many setbacks or harsh experiences. It carries profanity and humorous/sardonic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經過咁多失敗，依家先算係百屌成材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1gwo3 gam2 do1 sat1baai6, ji4gaa1 sin1 syun3 hai6 baak3 diu2 sing4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經歷這麼多失敗，現在才算是（粗口說法）百屌成材。
examples.english_sentence: He went through so many failures; now you could say he's 'baak diu sing coi' (crude slang for becoming capable after hardships).

mandarin_meaning: 百年好合
english_meaning: May the couple enjoy a long and harmonious marriage; a wedding blessing wishing lasting marital happiness
explanation_mandarin: 常用於婚禮或祝福新人，祝願夫妻長久和睦、幸福美滿。
explanation_english: A traditional blessing used at weddings to wish the newlyweds a long, harmonious, and happy marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係你哋嘅大日子，祝你哋百年好合！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 nei5 dei6 ge3 daai6 jat6 zi2, zuk1 nei5 dei6 baak3 nin4 hou2 hap6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是你们的大日子，祝你们百年好合！
examples.english_sentence: Today is your big day — wishing you a long and happy marriage!

mandarin_meaning: 百年归老 / 寿终正寝 / 终老
english_meaning: to die after a long life; to live to old age and pass away peacefully
explanation_mandarin: 表示人活到很老，安然去世，常用以形容自然死亡或享尽天年。
explanation_english: Indicates living to an advanced age and dying naturally; used to describe passing away peacefully after a long life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於百年歸老，親友都嚟送佢最後一程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 baak3 nin4 gwai1 lou5, can1 jau5 dou1 lei4 sung3 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於百年歸老，親友都來送他最後一程。
examples.english_sentence: He finally passed away at an old age; relatives and friends all came to see him off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望我同你可以百年歸老，一齊度過幸福嘅晚年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ngo5 tung4 nei5 ho2 ji5 baak3 nin4 gwai1 lou5, jat1 cai4 dou6 gwo3 hang6 fuk1 ge3 maan5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望我和你可以百年歸老，一起度過幸福的晚年。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you and I can grow old together and spend our later years happily.

mandarin_meaning: 被大量攻擊或抨擊的對象（網絡俚語）
english_meaning: a person who attracts a barrage of attacks or heavy criticism (internet slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「百彈齋主」為粵語網絡俚語，字面可理解為被「百發子彈」射擊的對象，用來形容在討論區或社交媒體上因言行或立場而成為眾多攻擊、抨擊或討伐目標的人。
explanation_english: “百彈齋主” is Cantonese internet slang. Literally suggesting someone who would be hit by a hundred bullets, it describes a person who becomes the target of widespread attacks, heavy criticism, or online pile-ons because of their remarks or stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於佢啲言論好爭議，佢而家已經成咗社交網上嘅百彈齋主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 keoi5 di1 jin4 leon6 hou2 zang1 ji6, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 sing4 zo2 se5 gaau1 mong5 soeng6 ge3 baak3 daan6 zaai1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為他的言論很有爭議，他現在已經成了社交網絡上的百彈齋主。
examples.english_sentence: Because his remarks were controversial, he has become the target of heavy criticism online.

mandarin_meaning: （常見於「百忙之中」）非常忙碌
english_meaning: very busy; extremely occupied (often used in the phrase 'in the midst of a busy schedule')
explanation_mandarin: 「百忙」多用於「百忙之中」，表示某人非常忙碌，但仍在繁忙中抽空處理或應對某事。
explanation_english: ‘百忙’ (baak3mong4) is often used in the expression '百忙之中' to indicate someone is extremely busy; it conveys doing something or making time despite a very busy schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你喺百忙之中幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 hai2 baak3 mong4 zi1 zung1 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你在百忙之中帮我。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me despite your busy schedule.

jyutping: baak3 si1 bat1 dak1 kei4 gaai2
mandarin_meaning: 百思不得其解（无论如何思考也无法理解）
english_meaning: cannot make head or tail of it; no matter how much one thinks, one cannot understand
explanation_mandarin: 形容對某件事反覆思考也想不明白、無法理解原因或道理。
explanation_english: Describes being unable to understand something no matter how much one ponders it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於呢件事我百思不得其解，完全唔明白點解會咁樣發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 baak3 si1 bat1 dak1 kei4 gaai2, jyun4 cyun4 m4 ming4 baak6 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 joeng6 faat3 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于这件事，我百思不得其解，完全不明白为什么会这样发生。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this matter, I can't make head or tail of it; I totally don't understand why this happened.

mandarin_meaning: （成语）心中有许多复杂的情感同时涌现，感慨万千
english_meaning: to be filled with a mixture of emotions; to have mixed/complex feelings
explanation_mandarin: 表示内心同时涌现出多种不同的情感，通常带有复杂、感慨或矛盾的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates that many different emotions arise at the same time, usually conveying a sense of complexity, nostalgia, or conflicting feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅畢業典禮，聽住校長講嘢，我真係百感交集。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 bat1 jip6 din2 lai5, teng1 zyu6 haau6 zoeng2 gong2 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 baak3 gam2 gaau1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的毕业典礼，听着校长讲话，我真是百感交集。
examples.english_sentence: At today's graduation ceremony, listening to the principal speak, I truly felt a mixture of emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 返到舊區，見到好多變化，我心裏百感交集。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan1 dou3 gau6 keoi1, gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 bin3 faa3, ngo5 sam1 leoi5 baak3 gam2 gaau1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 回到旧区，看到很多变化，我心里百感交集。
examples.english_sentence: Returning to my old neighborhood and seeing many changes, I was filled with mixed feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到大家送嘅紀念冊，睇到以前嘅相，覺得百感交集。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou3 daai6 gaa1 sung3 ge3 gei2 nim6 caat3, tai2 dou2 ji5 cin4 ge3 soeng2, gok3 dak1 baak3 gam2 gaau1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到大家送的纪念册，看到以前的照片，觉得百感交集。
examples.english_sentence: He received the commemorative album everyone gave; seeing the old photos made him feel a flood of mixed emotions.

mandarin_meaning: 百折不挠（遇到很多挫折也不屈服、不放棄）
english_meaning: Unyielding; indomitable — not giving up despite numerous setbacks
explanation_mandarin: 形容在遭遇多次挫折或困難時仍不屈服、堅持奮鬥、不放棄。
explanation_english: Describes someone who remains resolute and perseveres in the face of repeated setbacks or difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然遇到好多困難，但一直百折不撓，最後終於成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 jyu6 dou3 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4, daan6 jat1 zik6 baak3 zit3 bat1 naau4, zeoi3 hau6 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雖然遇到很多困難，但一直百折不挠，最後終於成功。
examples.english_sentence: Although he faced many difficulties, he persevered and eventually succeeded.

mandarin_meaning: 百搭；易于搭配，适合多种风格或场合
english_meaning: versatile; can be paired with many styles; goes well with everything
explanation_mandarin: 用于形容衣服、配件或其他物品容易與多種風格或顏色搭配，適合不同場合。多見於口語或時尚語境。
explanation_english: Describes clothing, accessories, or items that are easy to pair with many styles or colors and are suitable for various occasions. Commonly used in colloquial and fashion contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件外套好百搭，唔使諗就可以配晒啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 hou2 baak3 daap3, m4 sai2 lam2 zau6 ho2 ji5 pui3 saai3 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件外套很百搭，不用想就能搭配所有的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: This coat is very versatile; you can pair it with any clothes without thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋好百搭，著去街定返工都啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 baak3 daap3, zoek3 heoi3 gaai1 ding6 faan1 gung1 dou1 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋很百搭，出门或上班都合适。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are very versatile; they're suitable for going out or for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個濾鏡好百搭，影唔同風格都好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 leoi6 geng3 hou2 baak3 daap3, jing2 m4 tung4 fung1 gaak3 dou1 hou2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个滤镜很百搭，拍不同风格都好用。
examples.english_sentence: This filter is very versatile; it works well for different photo styles.

mandarin_meaning: 非常肯定、十拿九穩（字面：一百斤再加一斤，形容超過一百％）
english_meaning: absolutely certain; more than 100% sure (literal: ‘a hundred catties plus one’, used figuratively to mean certainty or overwhelming advantage)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞（口語/俚語，表示程度）
explanation_mandarin: 「百斤加一」是香港粵語的口語俚語，字面意思為「一百斤再加一斤」，用來表示比完全確定（100%）還要多、非常肯定或十拿九穩。常用於強調某事幾乎肯定會發生或某事沒有問題。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase literally meaning “a hundred catties plus one.” It’s used figuratively to indicate certainty beyond 100% — absolutely sure, rock-solid, or overwhelmingly likely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單買賣成交嘅機會係百斤加一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 maai5-maai6 sing4-gaau1 ge3 gei1-wui6 hai6 baak3 gan1 gaa1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆買賣成交的機會是非常大的／十拿九穩。
examples.english_sentence: The chance of this deal going through is more than 100% — absolutely certain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，我已經檢查過，呢啲資料冇問題，係百斤加一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 gim2 caa4 gwo3, ni1 di1 zi1 liu2 mou5 man6 tai4, hai6 baak3 gan1 gaa1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心，我已經檢查過，這些資料沒問題，肯定沒問題。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry — I've already checked these documents; they're fine, absolutely certain.

mandarin_meaning: 百日咳（bǎi rì ké）
english_meaning: whooping cough (pertussis)
explanation_mandarin: 由百日咳桿菌（Bordetella pertussis）引起的傳染性呼吸道疾病，主要症狀為陣發性劇烈咳嗽，嬰幼兒常伴有吸氣時的高音“whoop”聲，嚴重者可導致併發症。
explanation_english: An infectious respiratory disease caused by Bordetella pertussis (pertussis). It is characterized by severe, paroxysmal coughing fits often followed by a high-pitched 'whoop' on inspiration; can be serious in infants and may cause complications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路有時會患上百日咳，應該盡早打疫苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 jau5 si4 wui5 waan6 soeng5 baak3 jat6 hot3, jing1 goi1 zeon6 zou2 daa2 jik6 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子有時會得百日咳，應該盡早接種疫苗。
examples.english_sentence: Children sometimes get whooping cough; they should be vaccinated as early as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 百日宴（為慶祝嬰兒滿一百日而舉辦的宴會）
english_meaning: hundred-day banquet (a celebration held when a baby reaches 100 days old)
explanation_mandarin: 指為慶祝嬰兒出生後滿一百日而舉辦的宴會或聚會，常由親友出席並送上祝賀與禮物。在粵語文化圈中此活動較常見於香港、廣東一帶，有時也稱為「百日酒」。
explanation_english: A banquet or gathering held to celebrate a baby's 100th day after birth. It is a traditional celebration in Cantonese-speaking communities (commonly in Hong Kong and Guangdong), where relatives and friends attend, offer congratulations and gifts. Sometimes called "baak yat jau" or "hundred-day feast."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋預咗下個禮拜六去參加朋友個女仔嘅百日宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 zo2 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 luk6 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 pang4 jau5 go3 neoi5 zai2 ge3 baak3 jat6 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們預定下星期六去參加朋友女兒的百日宴。
examples.english_sentence: We have planned to go to our friend's baby's 100-day banquet next Saturday.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）非常可能；很有把握（常見於「百有八九」等表達）
english_meaning: very likely; almost certain (colloquial, often in expressions like "百有八九")
explanation_mandarin: 「百有」為香港粵語口語或網語用法，用來表示極高的可能性或肯定性，常見於「百有八九」等表達，語氣比「十有八九」更強或用來強調保證性。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used to indicate a very high probability or near certainty. Often appears in phrases like "百有八九" and is informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇嚟，百有八九係塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 lai4, baak3 jau5 baat3 gau2 hai6 sai1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒來，十之八九是塞車。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come; it's very likely due to a traffic jam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢唔知？我諗百有可能佢唔想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 m4 zi1? ngo5 lam2 baak3 jau5 ho2 nang4 keoi5 m4 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說他不知道？我想很可能是他不想說。
examples.english_sentence: You say he doesn't know? I think it's very possible he just doesn't want to say.

mandarin_meaning: 百步穿杨（bǎi bù chuān yáng）——形容射擊非常準確，能在很遠距離命中靶心。
english_meaning: To be an extremely accurate marksman; lit. 'to pierce a willow/poplar at a hundred paces' (i.e., to hit the target from a long distance).
explanation_mandarin: 出自古代射箭的誇張說法，用來形容射擊或比喻某人技術非常精準，命中率極高。
explanation_english: An idiom originally describing exceptional archery skill; used to say someone is extraordinarily accurate (literally: can shoot through a willow/poplar from a hundred paces).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢射箭嘅準頭真係百步穿楊，次次都中靶心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se6 zin3 ge3 zeon2 tau4 zan1 hai6 baak3 bou6 cyun1 joeng4, ci3 ci3 dou1 zung3 baat6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的射箭準確得像百步穿楊，每次都射中靶心。
examples.english_sentence: His archery is incredibly accurate — truly '百步穿杨'; he hits the bull's-eye every time.

mandarin_meaning: 对各种毒害不受侵害；比喻身体强健或不受坏影响
english_meaning: Impervious to all poisons; figuratively very healthy or unaffected by harm or negative influence
explanation_mandarin: 原指对各种毒物毫无侵害，常用来形容人體強健、不易生病，或比喻對外界負面影響不受動搖。
explanation_english: Originally refers to being unaffected by all kinds of poisons; commonly used to describe someone very healthy and rarely sick, or metaphorically someone unaffected by negative influences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身體好似百毒不侵，成日都冇病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 tai2 hou2 ci5 baak3 duk6 bat1 cam1, seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身体像百毒不侵，经常不生病。
examples.english_sentence: His body seems immune to all illnesses; he rarely gets sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上有好多負評，但佢百毒不侵，照樣做自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 seong6 jau5 hou2 do1 fu6 ping4, daan6 keoi5 baak3 duk6 bat1 cam1, ziu3 joeng6 zou6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上有很多负评，但他百毒不侵，依然做自己。
examples.english_sentence: There are many negative reviews online, but he's unaffected and continues being himself.

mandarin_meaning: 百洁布（清洁用布/擦拭用海绵或抹布）
english_meaning: scouring pad / cleaning cloth / scrub sponge
explanation_mandarin: 指用來擦拭或清潔表面的布或海綿類清潔用品，常見於廚房和家居清潔。香港日常用語中“百潔布”可指不同材質的抹布或擦洗墊，有時與「菜瓜布」互換使用，但材質和磨損程度或有差異。
explanation_english: Refers to a cloth, sponge, or pad used for wiping and cleaning surfaces, commonly found in kitchens and households. In Hong Kong usage, "百潔布" can denote various materials (microfiber cloths, sponge scourers, etc.); it is sometimes used interchangeably with "scrub pad" though materials and abrasiveness may differ.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房嗰塊百潔布已經好污糟，要換啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 go2 faai3 baak3 git3 bou3 ji5 ging1 hou2 wu1 zou1, jiu3 wun6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房那塊百潔布已經很髒，要換了。
examples.english_sentence: The scouring pad in the kitchen is already very dirty; it needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用百潔布擦枱面就快好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jung6 baak3 git3 bou3 caat3 toi4 min6 zau6 faai3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們用百潔布擦桌面就快很多。
examples.english_sentence: We use a scouring pad to wipe the tabletop; it's much faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住唔好用百潔布擦易刮花嘅表面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 m4 hou2 jung6 baak3 git3 bou3 caat3 ji6 gwaat3 faa1 ge3 biu2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記住不要用百潔布擦容易刮花的表面。
examples.english_sentence: Remember not to use a scouring pad on surfaces that scratch easily.

mandarin_meaning: 非常無聊、沒有事情可做、心情沉悶
english_meaning: extremely bored; having nothing to do; feeling listless
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人非常無聊或沒有事情做，心情沉悶、無精打采的狀態。屬於成語/慣用語。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is extremely bored or has nothing to do, feeling listless or dispirited. It is an idiomatic phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假冇嘢做，我真係覺得百無聊賴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 mou5 je5 zou6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 baak3 mou4 liu4 laai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假沒事做，我覺得百無聊賴。
examples.english_sentence: With nothing to do during the holiday, I really feel utterly bored.

mandarin_meaning: 百物騰貴（物價普遍上漲，許多東西變得昂貴）
english_meaning: Many goods' prices are soaring; a general rise in prices—everything is getting more expensive.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 慣用語／成語（描述物價狀況）
explanation_mandarin: 表示各種物品價格普遍上漲、變得昂貴，常用於形容通貨膨脹或生活成本上升的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that prices of many items are generally rising and becoming expensive; commonly used to describe inflation or a general increase in the cost of living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排百物騰貴，連菜同雞蛋都貴咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 baak3 mat6 tang4 gwai3, lin4 coi3 tung4 gai1 daan2 dou1 gwai3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近百物騰貴，連菜和雞蛋都貴了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Lately everything has gotten expensive; even vegetables and eggs have gone up a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 百病；各種疾病，常指多病或長期有病
english_meaning: many ailments; many kinds of illnesses; being frequently ill
explanation_mandarin: 表示各種疾病或長期多病，常用來形容身體虛弱、經常生病的狀況，亦可用於成語如「百病纏身」。
explanation_english: Refers to a multitude of illnesses or being frequently ill; often used to describe a weak person who is constantly suffering from various ailments. Also appears in idioms like "百病纏身."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家成日話自己百病纏身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 baak3 beng6 cin4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人家经常说自己百病缠身。
examples.english_sentence: Elderly people often say they are plagued by many ailments.

mandarin_meaning: 百病缠身 (bǎibìng chánshēn)：身體患有多種疾病，或受到多種病痛困擾。
english_meaning: Plagued by numerous illnesses; afflicted with many ailments (often used to describe someone in very poor health).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人長期或同時受到多種疾病困擾，身體狀況很差；有時也可引申指遭受多種麻煩或困擾。
explanation_english: Describes someone suffering from many illnesses at the same time or over a long period, indicating very poor health. It can also be used figuratively to mean being beset by many problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸依家真係百病纏身，要多人照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 ji1 gaa1 zan1 hai6 baak3 beng6 cin4 san1, jiu3 do1 jan4 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸現在真是百病缠身，需要很多人照顧。
examples.english_sentence: Dad is really plagued by many illnesses now and needs a lot of care.

mandarin_meaning: 百发百中（指每次都能命中或成功）
english_meaning: always on target; unfailingly accurate (literally 'a hundred shots, a hundred hits')
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容射擊、投擲或做事非常準確或成功，幾乎每次都能命中或達到目的。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is consistently accurate or successful; used for hitting targets or accomplishing tasks reliably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打籃球嘅時候，投籃真係百發百中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 laam4 kau4 ge3 si4 hau6, tau4 laam4 zan1 hai6 baak3 faat3 baak3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打篮球的时候，投篮真是百发百中。
examples.english_sentence: When he plays basketball, his shots are always on target.

mandarin_meaning: 百看不厌（无论看多少次都不会厌倦）
english_meaning: never get tired of looking at (something); never tire of viewing
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论看多少次都不会觉得厌烦，常用来形容景色、画作、照片或人物等。
explanation_english: Indicates that one never grows tired of looking at something; commonly used to describe scenery, artworks, photos, people, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫真係百看不厭，每次睇都有新發現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 zan1 hai6 baak3 hon3 bat1 jim3, mui5 ci3 tai2 dou1 jau5 san1 faat3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画真是百看不厌，每次看都有新发现。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is truly never tiring to look at; every time I look there's something new to discover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每次睇呢本相簿都百看不厭，裡面滿載回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 ci3 tai2 ni1 bun2 soeng2 bou2 dou1 baak3 hon3 bat1 jim3, leoi5 min6 mun5 zoi6 wui4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每次看这本相册都百看不厌，里面满载回忆。
examples.english_sentence: I never get tired of looking through this photo album; it's filled with memories.

mandarin_meaning: 百科全書（指收錄各種知識的參考書或線上資料庫）
english_meaning: encyclopedia (a reference work compiling knowledge on many subjects, including online/digital versions)
explanation_mandarin: 指系統性收錄各類知識並按分類或字母編排的參考書籍，也可指線上或數位形式的百科資料庫。
explanation_english: A reference work that systematically compiles information on a wide range of subjects, typically organized by category or alphabetically; can also denote online or digital knowledge databases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企有一本好舊嘅百科全書，成日拎出嚟睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 jau5 jat1 bun2 hou2 gau6 ge3 baak3 fo1 cyun4 syu1, seng4 jat6 ling1 ceot1 lai4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家裡有一本很舊的百科全書，經常拿出來看。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very old encyclopedia at home that he often takes out to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家 Google 就好似一本線上嘅百科全書，乜嘢資料都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 Google zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 bun2 sin3 soeng6 ge3 baak3 fo1 cyun4 syu1, mat1 je5 zi1 liu2 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在 Google 就像一本線上的百科全書，什麼資料都有。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays Google is like an online encyclopedia; it has information on everything.

jyutping: baak3 man4 bat1 jyu4 jat1 gin3
mandarin_meaning: 百闻不如一见
english_meaning: Hearing something many times is not as good as seeing it once; 'Seeing is believing.'
explanation_mandarin: 意指聽再多也不如親眼所見，強調親身經驗或實際觀察的可靠性與重要性。
explanation_english: Indicates that no amount of hearsay compares to seeing something with one's own eyes; emphasizes the reliability and importance of personal experience and direct observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以聽我講，但百聞不如一見，你自己去睇吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 teng1 ngo5 gong2, daan6 baak3 man4 bat1 jyu4 jat1 gin3, nei5 zi6 gei2 heoi3 tai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以听我说，但百闻不如一见，你自己去看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: You can listen to me, but seeing is believing — go see it for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相睇落好靚，但百聞不如一見，真係要親眼睇先知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 tai2 lok6 hou2 leng3, daan6 baak3 man4 bat1 jyu4 jat1 gin3, zan1 hai6 jiu3 can1 ngaan5 tai2 sin1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张照片看起来很漂亮，但百闻不如一见，真的要亲眼看才能知道。
examples.english_sentence: This photo looks great, but seeing is believing — you really have to see it in person to know.

mandarin_meaning: 各种各样；尽一切办法（表示方式或努力多样）
english_meaning: in every possible way; by all sorts of means; all kinds of
explanation_mandarin: “百般”用于表示以各种各样的方式或尽一切办法，常置于动词前构成“百般 + 动词”的结构，强调方式多或尽力而为。
explanation_english: Used to indicate many different ways or doing everything possible; often appears in the pattern '百般 + verb', emphasizing multiple approaches or great effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我百般照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 baak3 baan1 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我百般照顾。
examples.english_sentence: He/she took care of me in every possible way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗說服佢，我百般解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 syut3 fuk6 keoi5, ngo5 baak3 baan1 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了说服他，我百般解释。
examples.english_sentence: To persuade him, I explained it in every possible way.

mandarin_meaning: 百花齐放（比喻多种思想、流派或文化并存并繁荣发展）
english_meaning: Let a hundred flowers bloom — a metaphor for diversity, where many ideas, styles, or schools flourish simultaneously.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不同的意见、流派或文化等并存并繁荣发展，常用于鼓励多样性与创新。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning that different opinions, schools, or cultural forms coexist and prosper. Often used to encourage diversity and innovation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該鼓勵文化多樣化，令百花齊放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 gu2 lai6 man4 faa3 do1 joeng6 faa3, ling6 baak3 faa1 cai4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该鼓励文化多样化，让百花齐放。
examples.english_sentence: The government should encourage cultural diversity so that various forms can flourish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司鼓勵創新，令各種諗法百花齊放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gu2 lai6 cong3 san1, ling6 gok3 zung2 nam2 faat3 baak3 faa1 cai4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司鼓励创新，让各种想法百花齐放。
examples.english_sentence: The company promotes innovation so that all kinds of ideas can flourish.

mandarin_meaning: 百万（1,000,000）；也可指大量或巨額（尤指金錢）。
english_meaning: One million (1,000,000); can also mean a very large number or a huge sum (especially of money).
explanation_mandarin: 「百萬」表示數量上的一百萬（1,000,000），在口語中也常用來形容極大量或巨額的金錢。可作為名詞或數詞使用。
explanation_english: “百萬” denotes the quantity one million (1,000,000). It is also commonly used colloquially to describe a very large number or a huge sum of money. Used as a numeral/noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，獎金有一百萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, zoeng2 gam1 jau5 jat1 baak3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了六合彩，獎金有一百萬。
examples.english_sentence: He won the Mark Six lottery and the prize was one million.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢盤買賣可以賺到百萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pun2 maai5 maai6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou3 baak3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆買賣可以賺到百萬。
examples.english_sentence: This deal could earn a million.

mandarin_meaning: 百万富翁 (bǎi wàn fù wēng)
english_meaning: millionaire
explanation_mandarin: 指拥有至少一百万（通常指货币单位）的资产或财富的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has at least one million (typically in a given currency) in assets or wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意多年，終於成為百萬富翁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 do1 nin4, zung1 jyu1 sing4 wai4 baak3 maan6 fu3 jung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意多年，终于成为百万富翁。
examples.english_sentence: He ran his business for many years and finally became a millionaire.

mandarin_meaning: 能賺到百萬的行業（口語）
english_meaning: a very lucrative industry/trade (literally 'million-dollar line')
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指收入很高、可以賺到百萬（通常指港幣）的行業或工作，也可泛指暴利或高薪的行業。常在香港口語中使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for industries or occupations that pay very high incomes (on the order of a million HKD or similarly lucrative). Often used informally in Hong Kong to describe high‑paying or high‑profit trades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家金融、地產啲人，多數係百萬行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gam1 jung4, dei6 caan2 di1 jan4, do1 sou3 hai6 baak3 maan6 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在金融、地產的人，多數屬於高薪行業（俗稱「百萬行」）。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays people in finance and real estate are mostly in 'million‑dollar' industries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想搵快錢，就唔好諗住入百萬行，風險好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 wan2 faai3 cin2, zau6 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 jap6 baak3 maan6 hong4, fung1 him2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想快速賺錢，就別想着進入所謂的百萬行，風險很大。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to make quick money, don't think about entering so‑called 'million‑dollar' trades — the risks are high.

mandarin_meaning: 百叶（可指豆制品的百叶/腐皮，也可指牛的一个胃室，见于“牛百叶”；另见复合词如百叶窗）
english_meaning: yuba/tofu skin; (also) omasum (beef tripe); appears in compounds like 'venetian blind' (louvre)
explanation_mandarin: 「百葉」在粤语中有几种常见用法：一是指黄豆制品的百叶、腐皮（素菜、卷类用料）；二是指动物胃的一部分（如“牛百葉”，常用于火锅）；另一个常见用法为复合词如“百葉窗”（百叶窗、百叶式窗帘/百叶窗）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '百葉' has several common senses: (1) the soybean product yuba/tofu skin (used in vegetarian dishes and rolls); (2) a part of an animal stomach (e.g. '牛百葉' = beef omasum, used in hot pot); (3) appears in compounds like '百葉窗' meaning louvered/venetian blinds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲百葉返嚟整素菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 baak3 jip6 faan1 lai4 zing2 sou3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了些百叶回去做素菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some yuba (tofu skin) to make vegetarian dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火鍋入面有牛百葉，口感好脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 wo1 jap6 min6 jau5 ngau4 baak3 jip6, hau2 gam2 hou2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火锅里有牛百叶，口感很脆。
examples.english_sentence: There is beef omasum (beef tripe) in the hot pot; its texture is very crunchy.

mandarin_meaning: 百叶窗（百葉窗）/ 可調節光線和通風的百葉簾或百葉窗扇
english_meaning: venetian blind; louvered window/shutter (adjustable slatted blinds)
explanation_mandarin: 由多片可調角度的葉片組成，用來遮擋或調節光線和通風的窗簾或窗扇，常見於窗戶或室內隔斷。
explanation_english: A window covering or shutter made of horizontal slats whose angle can be adjusted to control light and airflow (venetian blinds or louvered shutters). Commonly used on windows or as interior partitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企換咗一套百葉窗，咁就可以調較入面嘅光線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 wun6 zo2 jat1 tou3 baak3 jip6 coeng1, gam2 zau6 ho2 ji5 tiu4 gaau3 jap6 min6 ge3 gwong1 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家換了一套百葉窗，這樣可以調節室內的光線。
examples.english_sentence: We replaced the blinds at home, so we can adjust the indoor lighting.

mandarin_meaning: 百叶窗 / 百叶窗帘
english_meaning: venetian blind; venetian blinds (window covering with adjustable horizontal slats)
explanation_mandarin: 一種由水平葉片組成、可以調節角度以控制光線和隱私的窗簾，常見材質有金屬、木材或塑料。
explanation_english: A type of window covering made of horizontal slats (usually metal, wood, or plastic) whose angle can be adjusted to control light and privacy; also called venetian blinds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋客廳裝咗新嘅百葉簾，陽光可以好好調節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haak3 teng1 zong1 zo2 san1 ge3 baak3 jip6 lim4, joeng4 gwong1 ho2 ji5 hou2 hou2 tiu4 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們客廳裝了新的百葉簾，陽光可以很好地調節。
examples.english_sentence: We installed new venetian blinds in the living room; the sunlight can be adjusted well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天嘅時候，將百葉簾拉低可以擋熱同保持私隱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ge3 si4 hau6, zoeng1 baak3 jip6 lim4 laai1 dai1 ho2 ji5 dong2 jit6 tung4 bou2 ci4 si1 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天的時候，將百葉簾拉下來可以擋熱並保持隱私。
examples.english_sentence: In summer, pulling down the venetian blinds helps block heat and maintain privacy.

mandarin_meaning: 百褶裙（指帶有多重褶皺的裙子）
english_meaning: pleated skirt (a skirt with many pleats)
explanation_mandarin: 指裙子上有多道褶皺的款式，常見於校服、休閒或正式場合的裙裝款式。
explanation_english: A skirt style characterized by many pleats; commonly seen in school uniforms, casual wear, or more formal outfits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗一條百褶裙，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 tiu4 baak3 zip3 kwan4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一条百褶裙，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a pleated skirt; it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港中學嘅女校服通常都係百褶裙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zung1 hok6 ge3 neoi5 haau6 fuk6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 baak3 zip3 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港中学的女校服通常是百褶裙。
examples.english_sentence: Girls' school uniforms in Hong Kong schools are usually pleated skirts.

mandarin_meaning: 百貨（bǎihuò），指百貨公司或百貨店，販售各類日用品、服裝、化妝品等
english_meaning: department store; general merchandise (store)
explanation_mandarin: 「百貨」通常指售賣多種商品的大型零售商店，常見說法為「百貨公司」。
explanation_english: “百貨” refers to a department store or large retail shop that sells a wide range of goods (clothing, cosmetics, daily necessities, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去百貨公司買衫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 maai5 saam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去百貨公司買衣服吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the department store tonight to buy clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間百貨公司而家有減價，好多嘢都平咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 gam2 gaa3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 peng4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家百貨公司現在在減價，很多東西都便宜了。
examples.english_sentence: This department store is having a sale right now; many items are cheaper.

mandarin_meaning: 百貨公司（大型零售商店）
english_meaning: department store
explanation_mandarin: 指販售各類商品的大型零售商店，通常分樓層並設有不同品牌或類別的專櫃。
explanation_english: A large retail store that sells a wide range of goods, usually organized in departments and often spanning multiple floors with different brand counters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去百貨公司買新衫，點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 maai5 san1 saam1 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天去百貨公司買新衣服，怎麼樣？
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the department store tomorrow to buy new clothes — how about it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕節百貨公司成日好多人，要排長龍先入到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 zit3 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 hou2 do1 jan4, jiu3 paai4 coeng4 lung4 sin1 jap6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聖誕節百貨公司常常很多人，要排很長的隊才能進去。
examples.english_sentence: Department stores are usually very crowded at Christmas; you often have to wait in a long line to get in.

mandarin_meaning: 百货商场 / 百货公司 / 购物中心（大型出售多种商品的商业场所）
english_meaning: department store; shopping mall; shopping centre (a large retail place selling a variety of goods)
explanation_mandarin: 指大型的零售商业场所，通常有多层、多个专柜或店铺，出售服饰、化妆品、家居用品等多种商品，常见促销活动和服务设施。
explanation_english: Refers to a large retail venue, often multi-level with multiple counters or shops, selling clothing, cosmetics, household goods and other items; commonly offers promotions and customer services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六去百貨商場買新衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 baak3 fo3 soeng1 coeng4 maai5 san1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期六去百货商场买新衣服。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the department store on Saturday to buy new clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家去百貨商場要排長龍，尤其係週末嗰陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 heoi3 baak3 fo3 soeng1 coeng4 jiu3 paai4 coeng4 lung4, jau1 kei4 hai6 zau1 mut6 go2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在去百货商场要排长队，尤其是在周末的时候。
examples.english_sentence: You have to queue to get into the department store now, especially on weekends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間百貨商場今個月搞緊大減價，好多品牌都有折扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 baak3 fo3 soeng1 coeng4 gam1 go3 jyut6 gaau2 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3, hou2 do1 ban1 paai4 dou1 jau5 zit3 hau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家百货商场这个月正在搞大减价，很多品牌都有折扣。
examples.english_sentence: That department store is having a big sale this month; many brands are offering discounts.

mandarin_meaning: 貨品多樣，能滿足各種顧客的需求（類似「應有盡有」）
english_meaning: There is something for everyone; goods arranged to satisfy a diverse range of customers
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容商店或場所提供種類繁多的商品或服務，可以滿足不同顧客的喜好與需要。
explanation_english: Used to describe a shop or place that offers a wide variety of goods or services, able to meet the tastes and needs of many different customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間商場貨品繁多，真係百貨應百客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 soeng1 coeng4 fo3 ban2 faan4 do1, zan1 hai6 baak3 fo3 jing3 baak3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間商場貨品繁多，真是百貨應百客。
examples.english_sentence: This mall carries a wide variety of goods — truly there's something for everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 百越（Bǎi Yuè），泛指古代居住在長江以南及華南、越南等地的多個族群的總稱
english_meaning: The Hundred Yue — a collective term for various ancient peoples who lived in southern China and northern Vietnam
explanation_mandarin: 百越是中國古代文獻中對長江以南及華南、東南亞部分地區若干土著民族的總稱，主要出現在先秦至漢代的歷史記載中，涵蓋多個不同族群與文化。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of indigenous peoples in ancient times who lived south of the Yangtze River and in parts of Southeast Asia; a historical term appearing in pre-Qin to Han sources that covers multiple ethnic groups and cultures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代百越族主要生活喺長江以南同南方沿海一帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 baak3 jyut6 zuk6 zyu2 jiu3 sang1 wut6 hai2 coeng4 gong1 ji5 naam4 tung4 naam4 fong1 jin4 hoi2 jat1 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的百越族主要生活在长江以南和南方沿海一带。
examples.english_sentence: The ancient Hundred Yue peoples mainly lived in regions south of the Yangtze River and along the southern coasts.

mandarin_meaning: 蜈蚣；百足蟲；亦用於成語中（如「百足之蟲，死而不僵」）
english_meaning: centipede (literally 'hundred-legged'); used in idiom to mean something resilient or hard to eliminate
explanation_mandarin: 「百足」字面指有很多足的昆蟲（如蜈蚣）。在成語「百足之蟲，死而不僵」中，用來比喻即使遭受打擊仍有殘存力量、頑強難除的事物或人。
explanation_english: Literally 'hundred legs', referring to many‑legged insects such as a centipede. Also appears in the idiom '百足之蟲，死而不僵', used metaphorically for something or someone resilient and hard to eradicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓下見到一條百足，嚇死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 haa6 gin3 dou2 jat1 tiu4 baak3 zuk1, haak3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在楼下看到一只蜈蚣，吓死我。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a centipede downstairs — it scared me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司差啲要倒閉，但員工好努力，真係百足之蟲，死而不僵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 caa1 di1 jiu3 dou2 bei3, daan6 jyun4 gung1 hou2 nou5 lik6, zan1 hai6 baak3 zuk1 zi1 cung4, sei2 ji4 bat1 goeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司差点要倒闭，但员工很努力，真是百足之虫，死而不僵。
examples.english_sentence: The company almost went under, but the staff kept going — they're like a centipede that won't die; extremely resilient.

mandarin_meaning: 人多手雜／牽涉很多人（事情複雜、難以統一）
english_meaning: Literally 'like a centipede with many claws' — describes a situation involving many people/parties (many hands), often implying complexity or difficulty coordinating
explanation_mandarin: 比喻牽涉很多人或很多部門，事情變得複雜或難以統一協調；有時也可中性地表示人多手多。
explanation_english: A metaphor likening a situation to a centipede with many legs; used to indicate many people or parties are involved — making matters complex or hard to coordinate. Can sometimes be used neutrally to mean 'many hands'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司呢個計劃涉及咁多部門，真係百足咁多爪，好難協調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sik1 gap3 gam2 do1 bou6 mun4, zan1 hai6 baak3 zuk1 gam2 do1 zaau2, hou2 naan4 hip3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司這個計劃牽涉這麼多部門，真是百足這麼多爪，很難協調。
examples.english_sentence: This company project involves so many departments — like a centipede with many claws — it's really hard to coordinate.

mandarin_meaning: 百辞莫辩 / 无论如何辩解也无济于事
english_meaning: Unable to defend or explain oneself; no amount of words can vindicate or refute
explanation_mandarin: 表示無論說多少話也不能辯解、無法為自己辯白，常用於形容面對明顯事實或指控時無言以對。
explanation_english: Indicates that no amount of words can defend or explain; often used when someone cannot refute an obvious fact or accusation and is left speechless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多證據，佢百辭莫辯，連解釋都講唔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 zing3 geoi3, keoi5 baak3 ci4 mok6 bin6, lin4 gaai2 sik1 dou1 gong2 m4 ceot1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多证据，他百辞莫辩，连解释都说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with so much evidence, he had no words to defend himself and couldn't even explain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講再多理由都冇用，佢嘅錯實在明顯，百辭莫辯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zoi3 do1 lei5 jau4 dou1 mou5 jung6, keoi5 ge3 co3 sat6 zoi6 ming4 hin2, baak3 ci4 mok6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再多辩解也没用，他的错误实在明显，百辞莫辩。
examples.english_sentence: No amount of explanation would help; his mistake was obvious and there was nothing to argue.

mandarin_meaning: 百里香（香草），即 thyme（唇形科植物，常用作料理和藥用）
english_meaning: Thyme (an aromatic herb used in cooking and sometimes medicinally)
explanation_mandarin: 百里香是一種常見的香草，學名屬於 Thymus，具有香氣，常用於烹飪調味及部分傳統藥用。
explanation_english: Thyme is a common aromatic herb (genus Thymus) with a strong fragrance, widely used for culinary seasoning and sometimes for traditional medicinal purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲百里香嚟煮湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 baak3 lei5 hoeng1 lai4 zyu2 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了些百里香来煮汤。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some thyme to cook into the soup.

mandarin_meaning: 百鸟归巢（众鸟回巢，大家回家或返回原处）
english_meaning: All the birds return to the nest; people returning home or to their original places, especially after an event or at the end of the day/season
explanation_mandarin: 「百鳥歸巢」原指許多鳥兒回到巢中，常用作比喻人群在活動結束或節日時紛紛回家或回到各自的地方，亦可形容場面冷清、眾人散去。
explanation_english: Literally describes many birds returning to their nests. Figuratively used to describe people returning home or to their original places (e.g., after an event or for a festival), or to depict a scene becoming quiet as people disperse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚會完咗，大家都百鳥歸巢，各自返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 wui2 jyun4 zo2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 baak3 niu5 gwai1 caau4, gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚会结束了，大家都百鸟归巢，各自回家。
examples.english_sentence: The party ended; everyone returned home, each going their own way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年嚟到，城市入面百鳥歸巢，大家都返鄉下過年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 lai4 dou3, sing4 si5 jap6 min6 baak3 niu5 gwai1 caau4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 gwo3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历新年到了，城里出现百鸟归巢的景象，人们都回乡过年。
examples.english_sentence: Lunar New Year arrives, the city looks deserted as people return to their hometowns to celebrate.

mandarin_meaning: 肥皂、香皂（用於清潔的皂）
english_meaning: soap (e.g., bar of soap, scented soap)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用來清潔皮膚或衣物的肥皂，常見於『香皂』『肥皂』等詞。古漢語中亦有『黑色』的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to soap used for cleaning the skin or clothes, often seen in compounds like '香皂' (scented soap) or '肥皂' (soap). In classical Chinese it can also have the meaning 'black'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企冇晒洗手用嘅皂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 mou5 saai3 sai2 sau2 jung6 ge3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家已經沒有洗手用的肥皂了。
examples.english_sentence: We have run out of soap for washing hands at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗塊香皂嚟用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 faai3 hoeng1 zou6 lai4 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一塊香皂來用。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a bar of scented soap to use.

mandarin_meaning: 容貌；樣子（書面語）
english_meaning: appearance; looks; expression (literary)
explanation_mandarin: 表示人的外表、樣子或神情，常見於書面語，與「容貌」「面貌」意義相近。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's appearance, looks, or facial expression. It is chiefly literary and synonymous with 'appearance' or 'countenance'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅皃好溫柔，令人好想接近佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mou6 hou2 wan1 jau4, ling6 jan4 hou2 soeng2 zip3 gan6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的容貌很溫柔，讓人很想接近他。
examples.english_sentence: His appearance is gentle, making people want to get close to him.

mandarin_meaning: （结构助词/的）表示所有、修饰或判断
english_meaning: structural particle (possessive/attributive marker 'de', 'of')
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「的」在廣東話中多用作書面或受普通話影響的結構助詞，表示所有、修飾或作為名詞化標記；口語廣東話常用「嘅」代替。
explanation_english: The character 的 (dik1) functions as a structural/possessive particle in Cantonese (especially in writing or under Mandarin influence), marking possession or attribution. In colloquial Cantonese 嘅 (ge3) is more commonly used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本係我買的書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 hai6 ngo5 maai5 dik1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本是我买的书。
examples.english_sentence: This is the book I bought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋坐的士去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co5 dik1 si2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐出租车去机场。
examples.english_sentence: We took a taxi to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件好笑的事令到我笑咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 hou2 siu3 dik1 si6 ling6 dou3 ngo5 siu3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件好笑的事让我笑了。
examples.english_sentence: This funny thing made me laugh.

mandarin_meaning: 只有那麼多；就那麼多
english_meaning: only that much; that's all; nothing more
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 短語（表示數量有限／限定）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用來表示數量或程度有限、就只有那樣多。書寫時常見得/的兩種字形，讀音為 dak1，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning 'only that much' or 'that's it', used to limit quantity or indicate there is nothing more. Often pronounced dak1 and appears in informal HK Cantonese speech (sometimes written 得 or 的).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲錢就的咁多，買唔到嗰部新電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 cin2 zau6 dik1 gam2 do1, maai5 m4 dou2 go2 bou6 san1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的錢就只有那麼多，買不到那部新電話。
examples.english_sentence: I only have this much money; I can't buy that new phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你緊張做咩？考試就的咁多啫，唔使咁驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gan2 zoeng1 zou6 me1? haau2 si3 zau6 dik1 gam2 do1 ze1, m4 sai2 gam2 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你緊張做什麼？考試就只有那麼多而已，不用那麼緊張。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so nervous? There's only that much on the exam, no need to be so anxious.

mandarin_meaning: 出租车
english_meaning: taxi; cab
explanation_mandarin: 粵語（香港）常用詞，指計程車／出租車，來自英文“taxi”的音譯，屬口語常用詞。
explanation_english: Common Cantonese (Hong Kong) term for a taxi/cab, a loanword from English 'taxi', commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭的士去機場啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dik1 si2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐出租车去机场吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a taxi to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搭的士返屋企，因為夜咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2, jan1 wai6 je6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐出租车回家，因为太晚了。
examples.english_sentence: He took a taxi home because it was late.

mandarin_meaning: 出租车司机（口语）
english_meaning: taxi driver (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指的士（出租車）的司機，常用於香港，語氣非正式或帶有熟悉感。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a taxi driver, commonly used in Hong Kong; informal and can convey a familiar or casual tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個的士佬開車好快，大家要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 dik1 si2 lou2 hoi1 ce1 hou2 faai3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個出租车司机開車很快，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: That taxi driver drives very fast; everyone should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 的士佬喺度等客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik1 si2 lou2 hai2 dou6 dang2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出租车司机在這裡等客。
examples.english_sentence: The taxi driver is waiting for passengers here.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）達到可作為的士或成為的士司機標準
english_meaning: colloquial: to meet the standards to be a taxi / to qualify as a taxi driver
explanation_mandarin: 「的士夠格」是粵語口語說法，字面意思是某輛車或某人達到可以做的士（出租車）或當的士司機的標準，也可用作比喻表示具備某項職務或角色的資格。
explanation_english: “的士夠格” is a Cantonese colloquial phrase. Literally it means a vehicle or person meets the standards to be a taxi or to work as a taxi driver. It can also be used figuratively to say someone is qualified for a particular role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車又乾淨又舒服，的士夠格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 jau6 gon1 zeng6 jau6 syu1 fuk6, dik1 si2 gau3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车又干净又舒服，够格当出租车。
examples.english_sentence: This car is clean and comfortable — qualifies as a taxi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸車好穩陣，識路又有禮貌，的士夠格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 ce1 hou2 wan2 zan6, sik1 lou6 jau5 lai5 maau6, dik1 si2 gau3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开车很稳当，识路又有礼貌，够格当的士司机。
examples.english_sentence: He drives steadily, knows the routes and is polite — qualified to be a taxi driver.

mandarin_meaning: 的士牌照；出租车营运许可证（俗称）
english_meaning: taxi license / taxi medallion / taxi registration plate
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中，『的士牌』通常指出租車的營運牌照或車牌，持有者有權以該車從事載客營運。有時也泛指取得可做的士司機的資格（俗稱取得的士牌）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '的士牌' usually refers to a taxi's operating licence/medallion or its registration plate authorizing commercial taxi service. It can also colloquially mean obtaining the qualification to work as a taxi driver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到咗的士牌，終於可以做司機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 zo2 dik1 si6 paai4, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 zou6 si1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考到了的士牌，終於可以做司機。
examples.english_sentence: He got his taxi license, and can finally work as a driver.

mandarin_meaning: （带贬义）的士司机 / 出租车司机（指态度差、拒载、宰客或不守规矩的司机）
english_meaning: Taxi driver (derogatory slang implying a rude, unscrupulous, or greedy driver)
explanation_mandarin: 「的士狗」是香港粤语俚语，用来贬称的士司机，通常指那些态度恶劣、拒载短途乘客、哄抬价格或开车粗鲁的司机。
explanation_english: A Cantonese derogatory slang term for taxi drivers, typically used to describe those who are rude, refuse short fares, overcharge, or behave unscrupulously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班的士狗成日唔肯載短程客，仲會喊價，真係氣死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 dik1 si6 gau2 sing4 jat6 m4 hang2 zoi3 dyun2 cing4 haak3, zung6 wui5 haam3 gaa3, zan1 hai6 hei3 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些無良的士司機經常不願載短程乘客，還會哄抬價格，真讓人生氣。
examples.english_sentence: Those taxi drivers often refuse to take short fares and even overcharge — it's really infuriating.

mandarin_meaning: 的士停靠處；出租车站
english_meaning: taxi stand; taxi rank
explanation_mandarin: 指乘客上落或候車的的士（出租车）集中停靠的地點，常見於街道一角、商場門口或交通樞紐附近。
explanation_english: A place where taxis queue or wait for passengers; commonly found at street corners, outside malls, or near transportation hubs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺的士站等緊的士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dik1 si2 zaam6 dang2 gan2 dik1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在的士站等出租车。
examples.english_sentence: I'm waiting for a taxi at the taxi stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨，我哋去最近嘅的士站搭的士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zeoi3 gan6 ge3 dik1 si2 zaam6 daap3 dik1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，我們去最近的的士站搭車。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining, let's go to the nearest taxi stand to take a taxi.

mandarin_meaning: 出租車費 / 計程車費
english_meaning: taxi fare; the money paid for a taxi ride
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話的常用說法，指搭的士（計程車）時需要支付的車資或現金。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning the money required for a taxi ride; the taxi fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對唔住，我冇帶夠的士錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 m4 zyu6, ngo5 mou5 daai3 gau3 dik1 si2 cin2.
