explanation_english: Means to do everything one can; to make every possible effort and then leave the outcome to forces beyond one's control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次面試我已經盡人事，結果就等公司通知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 min6 si3 ngo5 ji5 ging1 zeon3 jan4 si6, git3 gwo2 zau6 dang2 gung1 si1 tung1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次面试我已经尽人事，结果就等公司通知了。
examples.english_sentence: I did everything I could for this interview; now it's just waiting for the company to notify me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經準備好晒所有資料，盡人事，剩返就交俾天命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 saai3 so2 jau5 zi1 liu2, zeon3 jan4 si6, zing6 faan1 zau6 gaau1 bei2 tin1 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经准备好所有资料，尽人事，其余的就交给天命吧。
examples.english_sentence: I've prepared all the materials and done everything I can; the rest I'll leave to fate.

mandarin_meaning: 尽力 (jǐn lì)：盡最大努力
english_meaning: to do one's best; to try one's utmost
explanation_mandarin: 表示用盡自己的力量或努力去完成某事，常用於承諾會努力幫忙或做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates making the greatest possible effort to accomplish something; often used to promise to try hard or help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡力幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會盡力幫你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll do my best to help you.

mandarin_meaning: 尽最大努力去做（某事）
english_meaning: to do one's best; to try one's utmost
explanation_mandarin: 表示盡最大努力去完成某件事，即使結果未必能完全掌控，也盡力而為。
explanation_english: An expression meaning to make one's best effort to accomplish something, even if the outcome is not entirely controllable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使太擔心，盡力而為就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1, zeon6 lik6 ji4 wai4 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用太担心，尽力而为就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much; just do your best.

mandarin_meaning: 尽力而为（jǐn lì ér wéi）：尽最大努力去做某事。
english_meaning: to do one's best; to try one's hardest
explanation_mandarin: 表示盡最大努力去完成某件事，即使結果未必完美，也要盡力而為，不遺憾。
explanation_english: Expresses making the greatest possible effort to accomplish something; even if the result may not be perfect, one does what one can.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡力而為，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 ji4 wai4, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽力而为，不必担心。
examples.english_sentence: I'll do my best, don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢份報告我盡力而為，但時間真係唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 zeon6 lik6 ji4 wai4, daan6 si4 gaan3 zan1 hai6 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这份报告我尽力而为，但时间真的不够。
examples.english_sentence: I did my best on this report, but there really wasn't enough time.

mandarin_meaning: 尽善尽美（达到最完美的状态；沒有缺憾）
english_meaning: Perfect; flawless; as good as possible
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物达到了最完美、没有瑕疵或遗憾的状态，常用来形容結果或作品非常完美。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has reached the most perfect state, without blemish or shortcomings; often used to describe results or works that are exceptionally flawless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘅報告寫得盡善盡美，冇得彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ge3 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 zeon6 sin6 zeon6 mei5, mou5 dak1 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的报告写得尽善尽美，没有可挑剔的地方。
examples.english_sentence: His report was perfect; there was nothing to criticize.

mandarin_meaning: 一切尽在不言中；无需多言，意思已很明显
english_meaning: Everything is implied without words; it goes without saying
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某件事或某人的態度、表情等已把意思完全表露出來，不需用語言解釋。
explanation_english: Used to say that something is completely expressed or understood without verbal explanation; the meaning is clear from context or expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表情已經盡在不言中，無需我哋多問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 cing4 ji5 ging1 zeon6 zoi6 bat1 jin4 zung1, mou4 seoi1 ngo5 dei6 do1 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表情已经尽在不言中，不需要我们多问。
examples.english_sentence: His expression says it all; we don't need to ask more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要睇住佢同客人嘅互動，就知道事情盡在不言中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 tai2 zyu6 keoi5 tung4 haak3 jan4 ge3 wu6 dung6, zau6 zi1 dou3 si6 cing4 zeon6 zoi6 bat1 jin4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要看他和客人的互动，就知道事情尽在不言中。
examples.english_sentence: Just watch his interaction with the client — everything is clear without words.

mandarin_meaning: 全力以赴；放手一搏
english_meaning: go all out; give it your all; go for broke
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，表示用盡全力、一口氣把事情做到極致或放手去做，不保留、盡情投入。相當於「全力以赴／放手一搏」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to give everything or go all out—doing something with full effort or taking an all-or-nothing approach, without holding back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋要盡地一煲，唔好留力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 dei6 jat1 bou1, m4 hou2 lau4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们要全力以赴，不要保留实力。
examples.english_sentence: In this match we must go all out; don't hold back.

mandarin_meaning: 豁出去／孤注一擲（在一次行動或賭注中把全部押上，全力一搏）
english_meaning: to go all out / to go all in (to stake everything or make one big, wholehearted effort)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，表示在某一回合或行動中把所有的資源或努力一次性投入、不留退路，類似「豁出去」或「孤注一擲」。常見於口語或賭博語境，也可引申為生活或工作中的全力一搏。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang phrase meaning to put everything into one round or action — to stake all or make a single wholehearted effort with no reserves left. Often used in gambling contexts or figuratively for taking a big risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我就盡地一鋪，唔好留手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zau6 zeon6 dei6 jat1 pou1, m4 hou2 lau4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我就豁出去一把，別留手。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I'll go all out — no holding back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺賭場佢盡地一鋪，結果輸晒老本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dou2 coeng4 keoi5 zeon6 dei6 jat1 pou1, git3 gwo2 syu1 saai3 lou5 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在賭場他把所有都押上一把，結果輸光了本錢。
examples.english_sentence: At the casino he went all in and ended up losing his capital.

mandarin_meaning: 尽地主之谊（表示作为主人应尽的招待之礼）
english_meaning: to do the honours as a host; to offer hospitality as a matter of courtesy
explanation_mandarin: 表示主人對來訪者應該盡的禮遇或款待，常用於主人招待客人時表達自己要周到招待的意思。
explanation_english: An expression used when a host wants to indicate they will fulfill their duty by offering hospitality or treats to guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋嚟咗我屋企做客，我都要盡地主之誼，整啲嘢畀你哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 lei4 zo2 ngo5 uk1 kei2 zou6 haak3, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zeon6 dei6 zyu2 zi1 ji4, zing2 di1 je5 bei2 nei5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們來到我家做客，我也要盡地主之誼，準備一些東西招待你們。
examples.english_sentence: Since you've come to my home, I should do the honours as host and prepare something to serve you.

mandarin_meaning: 盡如人意（完全符合人的期望，令人滿意）
english_meaning: to be exactly as one wishes; entirely satisfactory; meet expectations
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情或結果完全符合人的意願或期望，令人滿意。可用於肯定句，也常見於否定形式「不盡如人意」表示未達預期。
explanation_english: Indicates that something turns out exactly as one hopes or meets expectations; wholly satisfactory. Often used positively or in the negated form (e.g., 'not quite up to expectations').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽結果並不盡如人意，我哋要再努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2 bing6 bat1 zeon6 jyu4 jan4 ji3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoi3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次的比賽結果並不盡如人意，我們要再努力。
examples.english_sentence: The result of this competition was not entirely satisfactory; we need to try harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 活動安排順利，全部都盡如人意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wut6 dung6 on1 paai4 seon6 lei6, cyun4 bou6 dou1 zeon6 jyu4 jan4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 活動安排順利，全部都盡如人意。
examples.english_sentence: The event arrangements went smoothly; everything was exactly as desired.

mandarin_meaning: 尽心尽力（尽最大努力）
english_meaning: to do one's utmost; to spare no effort; to put one's heart and strength into something
explanation_mandarin: 表示用全部的心力和力量去做某件事，盡最大的努力去完成或幫助。
explanation_english: Indicates putting one's whole heart and strength into doing something; to make the greatest possible effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你已經盡心盡力幫佢，唔使再自責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 ging1 zeon6 sam1 zeon6 lik6 bong1 keoi5, m4 sai2 zoi3 zi6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已經盡心盡力幫助他，不用再自責了。
examples.english_sentence: You've already done your best to help him; you don't need to blame yourself anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為呢個項目，公司上下都盡心盡力，希望可以按時完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, gung1 si1 soeng6 haa6 dou1 zeon6 sam1 zeon6 lik6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 on3 si4 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了這個項目，公司上下都盡心盡力，希望能按時完成。
examples.english_sentence: For this project, the whole company has been doing their best, hoping to complete it on time.

mandarin_meaning: 尽忠报国：以最大的忠诚和努力为国家效力，报答国家（成语）。
english_meaning: To devote oneself loyally to serve one's country; to show utmost loyalty and dedicate efforts to the nation.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对国家尽最大忠诚并为国家效力，常用于形容愿意为国奉献、甚至牺牲个人利益或生命的精神。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to show the greatest loyalty to one's country and serve it; often used to describe willingness to dedicate oneself or even sacrifice personal interests for the nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人話，古時啲將士以盡忠報國為榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 waa6, gu2 si4 di1 zoeng3 si6 ji5 zeon6 zung1 bou3 gwok3 wai4 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人說，古時的將士以盡忠報國為榮。
examples.english_sentence: The elder said that in ancient times soldiers considered it an honor to devote themselves loyally to the country.

mandarin_meaning: 尽忠职守（尽职尽责、忠诚履行岗位职责）
english_meaning: to perform one's duties loyally and conscientiously; to faithfully fulfill one's post
explanation_mandarin: 表示在自己的崗位上忠誠盡責，認真履行職務。
explanation_english: Expresses being loyal and dutiful in one's position, conscientiously carrying out one's responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺部隊入面一直盡忠職守，得到長官嘅讚賞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou6 deoi2 jap6 min6 jat1 zik6 zeon6 zung1 zik1 sau2, dak1 dou3 coeng4 gwan1 ge3 zaan3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在部隊裡一直盡忠職守，得到了長官的讚賞。
examples.english_sentence: He has always performed his duties loyally in the unit and earned praise from his superiors.

mandarin_meaning: 尽快 (jǐnkuài)
english_meaning: as soon as possible; as quickly as possible; ASAP
explanation_mandarin: 表示儘量快、不要拖延，盡早完成某事或作出回應。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something as quickly as possible without delay; to complete or respond at the earliest opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你盡快回覆我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 zeon6 faai3 wui4 fuk1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你尽快回复我。
examples.english_sentence: Please reply to me as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡快處理呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 faai3 cyu2 lei5 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽快处理这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I'll handle this matter as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要盡快完成個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 jyun4 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尽快完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to finish this project as soon as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 尽情
english_meaning: to one's heart's content; freely; without restraint
explanation_mandarin: 表示盡情地做某事，毫無保留或拘束，通常用作副詞，表示在程度上充分或放開來做。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something fully or without restraint; used adverbially to mean enjoying or doing something to the fullest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假期間，我想盡情休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 kei4 gaan1, ngo5 soeng2 zeon6 cing4 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假期间，我想尽情休息。
examples.english_sentence: During the holiday, I want to rest to my heart's content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去派對，大家盡情玩啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 paai3 deoi3, daai6 gaa1 zeon6 cing4 waan2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去派对，大家尽情玩吧！
examples.english_sentence: Going to a party tonight — everyone, enjoy yourselves!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議上歡迎大家盡情發表意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 soeng6 fun1 jing4 daai6 gaa1 zeon6 cing4 fat3 biu2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议上欢迎大家尽情发表意见。
examples.english_sentence: At the meeting everyone is welcome to freely express their opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 尽收眼底（全部映入眼帘，一目了然）
english_meaning: to take everything in at a glance; to have the whole scene within view
explanation_mandarin: 形容把全部景物或情况都看得一清二楚，尽在眼前。
explanation_english: Describes seeing an entire scene or situation clearly at once; everything is visible within one's sight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山頂嘅景色盡收眼底，令人心曠神怡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 ding2 ge3 ging2 sik1 zeon6 sau1 ngaan5 dai2, ling6 jan4 sam1 kong3 san4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山顶的景色尽收眼底，让人心旷神怡。
examples.english_sentence: The view from the summit is spread out before you, making you feel relaxed and delighted.

mandarin_meaning: 尽数（全部、全都）
english_meaning: all; entirely; without exception
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部、全數、毫無例外地；可作副詞使用，也可在某些語境下作動詞短語（如「盡數沒收」）
explanation_english: Indicates that something is all or without exception. Commonly used as an adverb meaning 'entirely' or 'all of them'; in some contexts used in verb phrases (e.g. 'seized in full').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢我已經盡數交咗畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 ngo5 ji5 ging1 zeon3 sou3 gaau1 zo2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些錢我已經全部交給你了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already handed all the money to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參加嘅人盡數到齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 gaa1 ge3 jan4 zeon3 sou3 dou3 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 參加的人全部到齊了。
examples.english_sentence: All the participants are present.

mandarin_meaning: 尽早
english_meaning: as soon as possible; at the earliest
explanation_mandarin: 表示在越早的時間做某事，通常指盡可能早地完成或處理某事。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something at the earliest possible time; used adverbially to mean as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你盡早嚟啦，遲咗就冇位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeon6 zou2 lai4 laa1, ci4 zo2 zau6 mou5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你尽早来吧，迟了就没有位子。
examples.english_sentence: Come as early as you can; if you're late there won't be any seats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話你要盡早檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 nei5 jiu3 zeon6 zou2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说你要尽早检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you should have the check-up as soon as possible.

mandarin_meaning: 完全顯現；充分展現
english_meaning: to be fully revealed; to be fully displayed; to manifest completely
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某種能力、特質或狀態被完全顯示出來，常用於描述在特定情境下充分表現或露出真實面貌。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that an ability, quality, or state is fully shown or revealed, often describing thorough display or manifestation in a particular context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面實力盡現，贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 sat6 lik6 zeon6 jin6, jing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比賽中實力盡現，贏了。
examples.english_sentence: He fully displayed his ability in the competition and won.

mandarin_meaning: 尽兴；玩得尽兴
english_meaning: to enjoy oneself thoroughly; to have a great time
explanation_mandarin: 表示玩得很高兴、享受到了极点，常用于形容聚会、活动等大家玩得很开心。
explanation_english: Indicates having enjoyed oneself to the fullest; commonly used to describe parties or events where people had a great time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家今晚玩得盡興，唔想走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 gam1 maan5 waan2 dak1 zeon6 hing1, m4 soeng2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家今晚玩得很尽兴，不想走。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone had a great time tonight and didn't want to leave.

mandarin_meaning: 尽责 (jìn zé)：负责，尽职
english_meaning: be responsible; conscientious; to fulfill one's duties
explanation_mandarin: 表示對自己的職責或任務認真負責、盡力完成。
explanation_english: Indicates being responsible and dutiful toward one's tasks or duties, taking care to complete them conscientiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好盡責，成日加班都唔怨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zeon6 zaak3, sing4 jat6 gaa1 baan1 dou1 m4 jyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很尽责，经常加班也不抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: He is very responsible; he often works overtime without complaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要盡責，準時交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zeon6 zaak3, zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要尽责，准时交功课。
examples.english_sentence: You should be responsible and hand in your homework on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求每個員工盡責履行崗位職責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 mui5 go3 jyun4 gung1 zeon6 zaak3 leoi5 hang4 gong3 wai6 zik1 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求每个员工尽责履行岗位职责。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires every employee to responsibly fulfill their job duties.

mandarin_meaning: 尽量 (jǐnliàng) — 尽可能，在能力范围内做到最大程度
english_meaning: as much as possible; to the greatest extent; try one's best
explanation_mandarin: 表示在能力或條件允許下，把事情做到最大程度或盡可能去做，常用於請求、建議或承諾中。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something to the greatest extent possible within one's ability or conditions; commonly used in requests, suggestions, or promises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會盡量喺今晚之前交報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 zeon6 loeng6 hai2 gam1 maan5 zi1 cin4 gaau1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽量在今晚之前交报告。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try to submit the report before tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你盡量食多啲青菜，對身體好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeon6 loeng6 sik6 do1 di1 cing1 coi3, deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你尽量多吃点青菜，对身体好。
examples.english_sentence: Try to eat more vegetables as much as possible; it's good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有問題就盡量問，唔好怕麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 man6 tai4 zau6 zeon6 loeng6 man6, m4 hou2 paa3 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有问题就尽量问，不要怕麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: If you have questions, ask as much as possible; don't be afraid of causing trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 尽头 (jìntóu) — 结束的地方、末端
english_meaning: end; extremity; the point where something finishes
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或道路等到達結束或末端的位置，可用於字面或比喻意義。
explanation_english: Refers to the end or extremity of something (e.g., a road, a process); can be used literally or figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路已經行到盡頭，冇路行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 ji5 ging1 haang4 dou3 zeon6 tau4, mou5 lou6 haang4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路已经走到尽头了，没路可以走了。
examples.english_sentence: This road has come to an end; there's no more road to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃終於嚟到盡頭，我哋要諗下一步喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 zung1 jyu1 lai4 dou3 zeon6 tau4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nam2 haa6 jat1 bou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划终于到了尽头，我们要想下一步了。
examples.english_sentence: The project has finally come to an end; we need to think about the next step.

mandarin_meaning: 監督；監視；（在複合詞中）監獄
english_meaning: to supervise/oversee/monitor; (in compounds) prison
explanation_mandarin: 字義包括監督、監視、管理。在日常用法中常見於複合詞，如「監督」「監察」，或表示入獄的「入監」。
explanation_english: The character means to supervise, oversee, or monitor. It commonly appears in compounds like '監督' (supervise) or '監獄' (prison); in some contexts it can denote being imprisoned (e.g., '入監').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要加強監察污染排放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 gaam1 caat3 wu1 jim5 paai4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要加強對污染排放的監察。
examples.english_sentence: The government must strengthen monitoring of pollution emissions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為偷嘢被判入監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 tau1 je5 bei6 pun3 jap6 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為偷竊被判入獄。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to prison for stealing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師會監督學生做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 wui5 gaam1 duk1 hok6 saang1 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師會監督學生做功課。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher will supervise the students doing their homework.

mandarin_meaning: （古文）對別人事務進行事後監督／事後監視
english_meaning: to supervise or monitor someone afterwards; to oversee someone after the fact (archaic/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 「監人乃後」屬較罕見或古典用法，字面可解作「在事後對人進行監督或監視」。多見於古文或文言式表述，現代口語中較少使用。
explanation_english: This is a rare/archaic literary phrase meaning literally to supervise or watch people afterwards. It appears in classical or literary contexts and is uncommon in everyday Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺一本古書度見到「監人乃後」，估唔到會有咁嘅古語用法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jat1 bun2 gu2 syu1 dou6 gin3 dou2 "gaam3 jan4 naai5 hau6", gu2 m4 dou2 wui5 jau5 gam2 ge3 gu2 jyu5 jung6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在一本古書上看到「監人乃後」，沒想到會有這樣的古語用法。
examples.english_sentence: I saw '監人乃後' in an old book — I didn't expect to encounter such an archaic usage.

mandarin_meaning: 仗勢欺人、厚顏無恥（利用權勢或地位欺負別人）
english_meaning: to bully or intimidate others and act shamelessly; to abuse authority and be impudent
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語表達，指仗勢或有恃無恐地欺壓、刁難他人，並且厚顏無恥、不知廉恥。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing behaviour of bullying or exploiting others, often by abusing one's authority or status, and being shameless about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個經理成日監人賴厚，啲同事都唔敢反抗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 ging1 lei5 sing4 jat6 gaam3 jan4 laai6 hau5, di1 tung4 si6 dou1 m4 gan2 faan2 hong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個經理經常仗勢欺人、厚顏無恥，同事都不敢反抗。
examples.english_sentence: That manager is always bullying people and shamelessly abusing his authority; the colleagues dare not resist.

mandarin_meaning: 監倉／牢房（監獄內關押犯人的房間或設施）
english_meaning: prison cell; jail cell (a room or facility inside a prison used to hold inmates)
explanation_mandarin: 指監獄或看守所內用來關押囚犯的房間或設施，也可泛指被關押的場所。
explanation_english: Refers to a room or facility inside a prison or detention center used to hold inmates; can also be used more generally for a place of confinement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺監倉入面，等住下星期開庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 gaam1 cong1 jap6 min6, dang2 zyu6 haa6 sing1 kei4 hoi1 teng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在監倉裡，等著下星期開庭。
examples.english_sentence: He is now in a prison cell, waiting for his court hearing next week.

mandarin_meaning: 代行国政；摄政
english_meaning: to act as regent; to govern on behalf of the monarch
explanation_mandarin: 指在君主無法親自處理國務（例如君主年幼、昏迷或出巡等）時，代為處理國家大事或代行統治權力的行為或職務。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or duty of governing the state on behalf of the sovereign when the monarch cannot personally handle affairs (for example due to being underage, incapacitated, absent, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太子年幼，由親王暫時監國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 zi2 nin4 jiu3, jau4 can1 wong4 zaam6 si4 gaam1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太子年幼，由亲王暂时代行国政。
examples.english_sentence: The crown prince was too young, so a prince temporarily acted as regent.

mandarin_meaning: 監守自盜（jiān shǒu zì dào）：被委以看守或管理的人自己偷竊或挪用公物、資金，指失職並利用職權貪汙。
english_meaning: To steal while guarding; to embezzle or pilfer funds/property by someone entrusted with their care — a breach of trust by a custodian or official.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容被委以看守、管理的人反而利用職務之便盜取公物或挪用資金，含有失職與貪腐的意思。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a person entrusted to guard or manage something exploits that position to steal or embezzle — implies dereliction of duty and corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司個經理竟然監守自盜，挪用公司公款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 go3 ging1 lei5 ging2 jin4 gaam1 sau2 zi6 dou6, no4 jung6 gung1 si1 gung1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的經理竟然監守自盜，挪用公司公款。
examples.english_sentence: The company's manager actually embezzled company funds while entrusted with oversight.

mandarin_meaning: 监察；监督
english_meaning: to supervise; to inspect; to monitor; oversight/inspection
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人員、機構或事務進行監督、視察或審查，也可指監督或審查的機構或行為。
explanation_english: Refers to supervising, inspecting, or monitoring people, organizations, or activities; can also denote the act of oversight or an oversight body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府成立咗一個監察委員會，負責監察公營機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 sing4 laap6 zo2 jat1 go3 gaam1 caat3 wai2 jyun4 wui2, fu6 zaak3 gaam1 caat3 gung1 jing4 gei1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府成立了一个监察委员会，负责监察公营机构。
examples.english_sentence: The government set up an oversight committee responsible for monitoring public institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 護士要細心監察病人嘅病情，隨時向醫生匯報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 si6 jiu3 sai3 sam1 gaam1 caat3 beng6 jan4 ge3 beng6 cing4, ceoi4 si4 hoeng3 ji1 sang1 wai6 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 护士要细心监察病人的病情，随时向医生汇报。
examples.english_sentence: Nurses must carefully monitor patients' conditions and report to doctors as needed.

mandarin_meaning: 监工；监督施工
english_meaning: to supervise/inspect work (especially on a construction site); (noun) a supervisor/inspector on-site
explanation_mandarin: 指在工地或工程項目上負責監督、檢查工人和施工進度的行為或職務，可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to supervising or inspecting workers and the progress of work on a construction site or project. Can be used as a verb (to supervise) or a noun (a supervisor/inspector).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日要去工地監工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gung1dei6 gaam1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天要去工地监工。
examples.english_sentence: He's going to the construction site to supervise the work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 監工喺度睇住工程進度，唔容有差錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam1 gung1 hai2 dou6 tai2 zyu6 gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6, m4 jung4 jau5 caa1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 监工在这里看着工程进度，不能有差错。
examples.english_sentence: The supervisor is here monitoring the project's progress; there can't be any mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細親自嚟監工，大家都緊張咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 can1 zi6 lai4 gaam1 gung1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gan2 zoeng1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板亲自来监工，大家都紧张了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss came personally to supervise, and everyone got nervous.

mandarin_meaning: 總是貶低、看不起（某人或某物）
english_meaning: to repeatedly belittle, demean, or look down on someone/something
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語說法，形容反覆用言語或態度貶低、辱罵或看不起別人，帶有輕視意味，常見於香港粵語日常對話中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese informal expression describing the repeated belittling, insulting, or looking-down-on of someone. Used in everyday spoken Cantonese, often in Hong Kong, and carries a dismissive or contemptuous tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日監平監賤我，講嘢好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gaam1 ping4 gaam1 zin6 ngo5, gong2 je5 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是貶低我，說話很傷人。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps belittling me; his words are really hurtful.

mandarin_meaning: 监房
english_meaning: prison cell; jail cell
explanation_mandarin: 指監獄或拘留場所中關押犯人的房間或牢房。
explanation_english: Refers to a prison cell — the room in a jail or detention facility where inmates are held.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 犯人被關喺監房度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan6 jan4 bei6 gwaan1 hai2 gaam1 fong4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 犯人被关在监房里。
examples.english_sentence: The prisoner is locked in the cell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 監房入面冇私人空間，生活受到好大限制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam1 fong4 jap6 min6 mou5 si1 jan4 hung1 gaan1, saang1 wut6 sau6 dou6 hou2 daai6 haan6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 监房里面没有私人空间，生活受到很大限制。
examples.english_sentence: There is no privacy in the cell; daily life is severely restricted.

mandarin_meaning: 监控（监视、监测并控制）
english_meaning: monitor; surveillance; to monitor or control
explanation_mandarin: 指通过设备或系统对人、场所或活动进行监视、记录和（有时）控制的行为或机制。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or system of observing, recording, and sometimes controlling people, places, or activities using devices or systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會監控員工嘅電郵同網絡使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 gaam1 hung3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 din6 jau4 tung4 mong5 lok3 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司会监控员工的电邮和网络使用。
examples.english_sentence: The company monitors employees' emails and internet usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得街上嘅監控太多，唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 gaai1 seong6 ge3 gaam1 hung3 taai3 do1, m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得街上的监控太多，不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He feels there are too many surveillance cameras on the streets and feels uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 监测（对环境、设备或健康状况等进行持续观察与测量）
english_meaning: to monitor; to observe and measure continuously (e.g., environment, equipment, health)
explanation_mandarin: 指對某些指標、狀況或變化進行持續觀察、測量和記錄，以便評估或預警。
explanation_english: Refers to the continuous observation, measurement, and recording of indicators or conditions to assess status or provide warnings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院會監測病人嘅情況，確保治療適當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 wui5 gaam1 cak1 beng6 jan4 ge3 cing4 fong3, kok3 bou2 zi6 liu4 sik1 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院会监测病人的情况，确保治疗适当。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital will monitor the patient's condition to ensure appropriate treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 监牢；监狱（关押罪犯的地方）
english_meaning: prison; jail; place where prisoners are detained
explanation_mandarin: 指關押或囚禁犯人的場所，與「監獄」意思相近，較正式或古典用詞。
explanation_english: Refers to a place where prisoners are held or detained; similar in meaning to 'prison' or 'jail', somewhat formal or classical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為偷嘢而入咗監牢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 tau1 je5 ji4 jap6 zo2 gaam1 laau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為偷東西而進了監牢。
examples.english_sentence: He went to jail for stealing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被判監兩年，要喺監牢度服刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 pun3 gaam1 loeng5 nin4, jiu3 hai2 gaam1 laau4 dou6 fuk6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被判監禁兩年，要在監牢服刑。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to two years in prison and has to serve the sentence in jail.

mandarin_meaning: 囚犯；被監禁或羈押的人（罪犯）
english_meaning: prisoner; inmate; convict (a person held in custody or imprisoned)
explanation_mandarin: 指被羈押、監禁或關押在監獄中的人，常用於法律或司法語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is held in custody or imprisoned; commonly used in legal or judicial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰名監犯今朝逃走，警方緊急搜捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ming4 gaam1 faan6 gam1 ziu1 tou4 zau2, ging2 fong1 gan2 gap1 sau1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那名囚犯今天早上逃走，警方正在緊急搜捕。
examples.english_sentence: That prisoner escaped this morning; the police are conducting an urgent search.

mandarin_meaning: 监狱 (jiānyù)
english_meaning: prison; jail
explanation_mandarin: 關押罪犯或被判刑者的場所，用於監禁和改造犯人。
explanation_english: A place for detaining criminals or those sentenced by law; used for confinement and rehabilitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為偷嘢而被送入監獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 tau1 je5 ji4 bei6 sung3 jap6 gaam1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为偷东西而被送进监狱。
examples.english_sentence: He was sent to prison for stealing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間監獄嘅管理好嚴格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gaam1 juk6 ge3 gun2 lei5 hou2 jim4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家监狱的管理很严格。
examples.english_sentence: The management of this prison is very strict.

mandarin_meaning: 監生（jiānshēng）：古代國子監或科舉制度中受官方登記或具特定身分的學生，常指在國子監就讀或受朝廷資助的官學學生。
english_meaning: Jiansheng: a historical title for students registered at the Imperial Academy (Guozijian) or a rank within the imperial examination system — government-recognized students in imperial China.
explanation_mandarin: 「監生」為古代科舉與官學體系中的稱謂，通常指在國子監就讀或由朝廷承認、享有一定待遇的學生。現多用於史料或古文語境中。
explanation_english: A historical term used in the imperial examination and official education system, referring to students of the Guozijian (Imperial Academy) or those officially recognized by the court. Mostly found in historical texts and contexts today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係清朝嘅監生，喺國子監讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 cing1 ciu4 ge3 gaam1 saang1, hai6 gwok3 zi2 gaam1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是清朝的監生，在國子監讀書。
examples.english_sentence: He was a jiansheng in the Qing dynasty, studying at the Guozijian (Imperial Academy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時考中秀才之後，有機會成為監生，接受朝廷的待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 haau2 zung1 sau3 coi4 zi1 hau6, jau5 gei1 wui6 sing4 wai4 gaam1 saang1, zip3 sau6 ciu4 ting4 dik1 doi6 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古時考中秀才之後，有機會成為監生，接受朝廷的待遇。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, after passing the xiucai exam, one could become a jiansheng and receive benefits from the court.

mandarin_meaning: 监督 (jiān dū)
english_meaning: to supervise; to oversee; supervisor
explanation_mandarin: 表示監察、督促或管理某項事務的行為；也可指擔任監督職務的人。
explanation_english: To supervise or oversee an activity, ensuring rules and standards are followed; can also refer to a person who performs supervision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排咗一位經理嚟監督呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 zo2 jat1 wai2 ging1 lei5 lai4 gaam1 duk1 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司安排了一位經理來監督這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company assigned a manager to oversee this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府成立咗一個監督小組，負責監督公共工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 sing3 laap6 zo2 jat1 go3 gaam1 duk1 siu2 zou2, fu6 zaak3 gaam1 duk1 gung1 gung6 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府成立了一個監督小組，負責監督公共工程。
examples.english_sentence: The government set up a supervisory panel responsible for overseeing public works.

mandarin_meaning: 偏偏；執拗地堅持（做某事）
english_meaning: stubbornly; deliberately insist on doing something
explanation_mandarin: 「監硬」為廣東話口語用詞，通常表示偏偏、故意或執拗地堅持做某事，不聽勸阻。主要在香港粵語口語中使用，語氣較口語化。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to stubbornly or deliberately insist on doing something (often despite advice or objections). Common in Hong Kong Cantonese and used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢監硬唔肯聽人勸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaam1 ngaang6 m4 hang2 teng1 jan4 hyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偏偏不肯聽勸。
examples.english_sentence: He stubbornly refuses to take advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你監硬咁做，最後會後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaam1 ngaang6 gam2 zou6, zeoi3 hau6 wui5 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你偏偏這樣做，最後會後悔。
examples.english_sentence: If you insist on doing that, you'll regret it in the end.

mandarin_meaning: 監票（監督投票或計票的行為）
english_meaning: to monitor/supervise voting or the counting of ballots; to act as a polling observer
explanation_mandarin: 指在投票或計票過程中監督、查核以確保公平與公正，常見於選舉或投票場所的工作或義務。
explanation_english: Refers to overseeing or observing the voting or vote-counting process to ensure fairness and integrity; commonly used for duties at polling stations or as election observers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉我報名做監票，想確保投票過程公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 ngo5 bou3 ming4 zou6 gaam1 piu3, soeng2 kok3 bou2 tau4 piu3 gwo3 cing4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次選舉我報名做監票，希望確保投票過程公平。
examples.english_sentence: I signed up to monitor the voting in this election to help ensure the process is fair.

mandarin_meaning: 监禁；剥夺人身自由并关押
english_meaning: to imprison; to confine; imprisonment
explanation_mandarin: 指依法或非法剝奪他人行動自由，將其關押在監獄或其他場所；在法律語境中亦指判處徒刑並使其服刑。
explanation_english: Refers to depriving a person of their liberty and confining them in prison or another place; in legal contexts it can mean sentencing someone to imprisonment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀法官判監禁十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 faat3 gun1 pun3 gaam1 gam3 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被判监禁十年。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to ten years' imprisonment.

mandarin_meaning: 监管（对机构、行业或活动进行监督和管理）
english_meaning: to supervise, oversee, or regulate; supervision/regulation
explanation_mandarin: 指對某一事物、機構或行業進行監督、管理和控制，以確保其遵守規範或達到標準。
explanation_english: To supervise, manage, or control an entity, industry, or activity to ensure compliance with rules or standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該加強對金融市場嘅監管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 gaa1 koeng4 deoi3 gam1 jung4 si5 coeng4 ge3 gaam1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該加強對金融市場的監管。
examples.english_sentence: The government should strengthen regulation of the financial market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司係由一個獨立機構監管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 jau4 jat1 go3 duk6 lap6 gei1 kau3 gaam1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司由一个独立机构监管。
examples.english_sentence: This company is regulated by an independent agency.

mandarin_meaning: 當工頭／監工（口語）
english_meaning: to boss people around / act as a foreman (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指在做粗活或工地上監督、指揮或愛指手畫腳地管人，語氣常帶有批評或不滿的意味。
explanation_english: Colloquial term meaning to supervise or boss manual workers (act as a foreman), often with a sense of meddling or bossiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意監粗，啲工人都頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 gaam1 cou1, di1 gung1 jan4 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是喜歡當工頭監督工人，工人都受不了。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to boss people around; the workers can't stand it.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）監工／工頭來了（提醒有人權威／上司要來巡視）
english_meaning: Informal warning that the supervisor/foreman is coming (used to tell people to behave, tidy up, or stop slacking)
explanation_mandarin: 「監粗嚟呀」是廣東話口語、俗語用法，常在工地或勞動場所用來提醒同伴：監工／工頭（或上司）快到，要收心、收拾或唔好偷懶。也可戲謔地用在其他情境表示有人有權威來臨。此語有時為「監工嚟呀」的口語變體。
explanation_english: “監粗嚟呀” is Cantonese slang used mainly on worksites or among coworkers to warn that the supervisor/foreman (or someone in authority) is coming. It signals others to behave, clean up, or stop slacking. It is informal and can be used jokingly in other contexts. Often a colloquial variant of “監工嚟呀.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲收拾，你哋！監粗嚟呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 sau1 sap1, nei5 dei6! gaam1 cou1 lai4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点收拾，你们！监工／工头来了！
examples.english_sentence: Hurry up and tidy up, you guys! The foreman is coming!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺度偷懶，突然有人叫：『監粗嚟呀』。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 tau1 laan5, fat1 jin4 jau5 jan4 giu3: 'gaam1 cou1 lai4 aa3'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在这儿偷懒，突然有人喊：‘监工来了’。
examples.english_sentence: We were slacking off here when someone suddenly shouted, 'The supervisor's coming.'

mandarin_meaning: 监考，负责监督考试进行
english_meaning: to invigilate/proctor an exam; to supervise an examination
explanation_mandarin: 指在考場中負責監督、維持秩序、確保考試公平、不作弊的行為或職務。
explanation_english: To supervise an examination; the act or duty of overseeing an exam, maintaining order, and preventing cheating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師今日要去監考，唔會返嚟上堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gaam1 haau2, m4 wui5 faan1 lai4 soeng5 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師今天要去監考，不能回來上課。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher has to proctor an exam today and won't be able to come to class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試期間，監考員要確保考生唔抄襲，亦要維持考場秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 kei4 gaan1, gaam1 haau2 jyun4 jiu3 kok3 bou2 haau2 saang1 m4 caau1 zaap6, jik6 jiu3 wai4 ci4 haau2 coeng4 zat1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试期间，监考人员要确保考生不抄袭，也要维持考场秩序。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, invigilators must ensure students do not cheat and must maintain order in the exam hall.

mandarin_meaning: 监制（电影或电视作品的出品或监制人，负责筹资与统筹制作）
english_meaning: producer; supervising producer (person who oversees financing and overall production of a film/TV project)
explanation_mandarin: 指在電影、電視等影視製作中，負責籌措資金、統籌製作流程並代表出品方的職務。有時側重財務與製作管理，也可稱為製片人或監製，具体職責視項目而定。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in film or television production responsible for securing funding, coordinating the production process, and representing the production company. Duties often include financial oversight and production management; role can overlap with 'producer' or 'executive producer' depending on the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅監製係邊個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 gaam1 zai3 hai6 bin1 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的监制是谁？
examples.english_sentence: Who is the producer of this film?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 監製通常負責籌款同統籌製作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam1 zai3 tung1 soeng4 fu6 zaak3 cau4 fun2 tung4 tung2 cau4 zai3 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 监制通常负责筹款和统筹制作。
examples.english_sentence: A producer typically handles fundraising and oversees production.

mandarin_meaning: 监视（監視）；监控、监督、注视
english_meaning: to monitor; to keep under surveillance; to watch closely
explanation_mandarin: 指對某人或某事進行密切或持續的觀察與監控，常用於警方、保安或監控系統對對象進行監督的情況。
explanation_english: To observe or keep watch over someone or something closely and continuously; often used for police, security, or monitoring systems conducting surveillance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方一直監視住嗰個嫌疑犯，等佢一有可疑嘅行為就拘捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 jat1 zik6 gaam1 si6 zyu6 go2 go3 jim4 ji4 faan6, dang2 keoi5 jat1 jau5 ho2 ji4 ge3 hang4 wai6 zau6 ku1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方一直監視那名嫌疑犯，一有可疑行為就拘捕他。
examples.english_sentence: The police have been monitoring the suspect and will arrest him as soon as he behaves suspiciously.

mandarin_meaning: 监督宣誓；在宣誓时担任见证并监督
english_meaning: to supervise or witness an oath; to administer an oath
explanation_mandarin: 指在宣誓或誓词仪式上担任见证并监督宣誓程序或行为，也可指由特定人士（如法官或宣誓人）实施宣誓的动作。
explanation_english: Refers to acting as the witness or supervisor during an oath-taking ceremony — overseeing or administering the oath (e.g., by a judge or designated official).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官負責監誓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 fu6 zaak3 gaam1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官负责监督宣誓。
examples.english_sentence: The judge is responsible for supervising the oath.

mandarin_meaning: 監護（监护）——對未成年人或無行為能力者負責照顧、保護，或指法院所授予的監護權／監護關係。
english_meaning: Guardianship / custody — the act or legal status of being responsible for someone's care and protection; can also mean to supervise or look after.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指法律或實務上對未成年人、無行為能力者等負責照顧與保護的行為或權利，也可泛指監視、照管。
explanation_english: Generally refers to the legal or practical responsibility to care for and protect minors or persons incapable of self-care; can also be used more generally to mean supervising or looking after.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭會決定孩子嘅監護權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 wui5 kyut3 ding6 haai4 zi2 ge3 gaam1 wu6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院會決定孩子的監護權。
examples.english_sentence: The court will decide the child's guardianship/custody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舅父申請成為我阿妹嘅監護人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 fu6 san1 cing2 sing4 wai4 ngo5 aa3 mui6 ge3 gaam1 wu6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舅父申請成為我妹妹的監護人。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle applied to become my younger sister's guardian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母有責任監護未成年子女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gaam1 wu6 mei6 sing4 nin4 zi2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母有責任監護未成年子女。
examples.english_sentence: Parents have the responsibility to provide guardianship for minor children.

mandarin_meaning: 监护人 (法定或指定負責照顧未成年人或無行為能力者的人)
english_meaning: guardian (a person legally responsible for the care of a minor or someone incapacitated)
explanation_mandarin: 指在法律或實際上負有照顧、保護未成年人或無行為能力者的人，通常有簽署文件、決定醫療或教育事務等權責。
explanation_english: A person who is legally or practically responsible for caring for and protecting a minor or someone unable to care for themselves; typically has authority to sign documents and make decisions about medical care, education, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅監護人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gaam1 wu6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她是我的监护人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my guardian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 未成年人要由監護人簽署文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei6 sing4 nin4 jan4 jiu3 jau4 gaam1 wu6 jan4 cim1 syu2 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 未成年人要由监护人签署文件。
examples.english_sentence: Minors need documents signed by their guardian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院要求監護人同意做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jiu3 kau4 gaam1 wu6 jan4 tung4 ji3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院要求监护人同意手术。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital requires the guardian's consent for the surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 囚犯／在監服刑的人
english_meaning: inmate; prisoner (person serving a prison sentence)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用詞，指在監獄中服刑的人，即囚犯或犯人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to a person serving time in prison — an inmate or prisoner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個監躉喺監倉入面搞事，最後被轉到高戒備嘅監獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gaam1 deon3 hai2 gaam1 cong1 jap6 min6 gaau2 si6, zeoi3 hau6 bei6 zyun2 dou3 gou1 gaai3 bei6 ge3 gaam1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個囚犯在監倉裡鬧事，最後被轉到戒備較高的監獄。
examples.english_sentence: That inmate caused trouble in the cell block and was eventually transferred to a higher-security prison.

mandarin_meaning: 工头；负责监督施工、管理工人的负责人（口语）
english_meaning: foreman; site supervisor — an informal term for the person who manages and supervises workers, especially on construction/renovation sites
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粤语中的口语用法，指在施工或装修现场负责指挥、安排和管理工人的人。有时可带负面含义，例如偷工减料或不守规矩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for the person who directs, organizes, and manages workers on a construction or renovation site. It is informal and can carry negative connotations (e.g., cutting corners or being unreliable).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個監頭唔可信，佢經常遲到又偷工減料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaam1 tau4 m4 ho2 seon3, keoi5 ging1 soeng4 ci4 dou3 jau6 tau1 gung1 gaam2 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工头不可靠，他经常迟到又偷工减料。
examples.english_sentence: This foreman is unreliable; he often arrives late and cuts corners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵個好嘅監頭嚟監工，先至可以放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 go3 hou2 ge3 gaam1 tau4 lai4 gaam1 gung1, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找个好的工头来监工，这样才可以放心。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a good foreman to supervise the work so we can feel assured.

mandarin_meaning: 工頭/監工用來記錄出勤、工時或工人名冊的簿冊（即監工簿、工頭簿、出勤簿）
english_meaning: foreman's register; supervisor's ledger used to record attendance, workers' names, hours, and job details
explanation_mandarin: 在工地或勞動現場由工頭或監工保管的簿子，用來記錄工人出勤、工作時數、分配工作或其他施工相關紀錄。
explanation_english: A book kept by a foreman or supervisor at a worksite to record workers' attendance, hours, job assignments, and other job-related notes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師父，監頭簿擺喺邊？我要寫今日到咗幾點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu6, gaam1 tau4 bou6 baai2 hai2 bin1? ngo5 jiu3 se2 gam1 jat6 dou3 zo2 gei2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师父，监头簿放在哪里？我要写今天到了几点。
examples.english_sentence: Boss/foreman, where's the foreman's register? I need to note what time I arrived today.

mandarin_meaning: 被列入黑名單或被監控、封鎖
english_meaning: to be blacklisted, monitored or blocked (by authorities or a platform)
explanation_mandarin: 「監黑」是香港網絡／口語俚語，通常指被平台、當局或相關方監控、限制或列入黑名單，導致被封鎖、禁言或無法使用某些服務。
explanation_english: “監黑” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang meaning to be monitored and/or put on a blacklist by a platform, authority, or other party, resulting in being blocked, muted, or barred from services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個帳號畀平台監黑咗，登入唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng3 hou6 bei2 ping4 toi4 gaam1 hak1 zo2, dang1 jap6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个账号被平台列入黑名单，无法登录。
examples.english_sentence: This account was blacklisted by the platform and can't log in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交平台講啲敏感嘢，驚會畀人監黑，所以收返啲帖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 ping4 toi4 gong2 di1 man5 gam2 je5, geng1 wui5 bei2 jan4 gaam1 hak1, so2 ji5 sau1 faan1 di1 tip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常在社交平台發表敏感言論，擔心會被人監控並列入黑名單，因此收回了帖子。
examples.english_sentence: He often posts sensitive content on social media and fears being monitored and blacklisted, so he deleted the posts.

mandarin_meaning: 盘（pán）：盘子、托盘；盘绕、盘起；见于盘问、盘算等词。
english_meaning: plate, dish, tray; (verb) to coil/wind/pin up; appears in compounds like 'interrogate' (盤問).
explanation_mandarin: “盤”可作名词，指器皿如盘子或一盘食物；可作动词，表示盘绕或把东西盘起来；也常见于复合词如“盘问”（讯问）或“盘算”（考虑、打算）。
explanation_english: As a noun, '盤' refers to a plate, dish, or a serving of food. As a verb, it can mean to coil, wind, or pin up (e.g., hair). It also appears in compound words such as '盤問' (to interrogate) and '盤算' (to plan/consider).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢盤炒飯好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pun4 caau2 faan6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘炒饭很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of fried rice is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將頭髮盤起嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 tau4 faat3 pun4 hei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把头发盘起来。
examples.english_sentence: He pinned up his hair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察盤問目擊者有冇見到乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 pun4 man6 muk6 gik1 ze2 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察盘问目击者有没有看到什么。
examples.english_sentence: The police interrogated the eyewitness to see if they saw anything.

mandarin_meaning: 盤前盤後（盤前交易與盤後交易）
english_meaning: pre-market and after-hours (trading)
explanation_mandarin: 指在證券或其他市場正常交易時間之前（盤前）與之後（盤後）進行的交易時段或交易行為；通常流動性較低、價格波動較大，風險與交易條件與正常交易時段不同。
explanation_english: Refers to trading that takes place before the regular market opens (pre-market) and after it closes (after-hours). These sessions usually have lower liquidity and higher volatility; trading conditions and risks can differ from regular market hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資者要注意盤前盤後嘅流動性較低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 ze2 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 pun4 cin4 pun4 hau6 ge3 lau4 dung6 sing3 gaau3 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投資者要注意盤前盤後的流動性較低。
examples.english_sentence: Investors should note that liquidity in pre-market and after-hours is relatively low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 盤前盤後嘅價格未必反映開市時嘅真實成交價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pun4 cin4 pun4 hau6 ge3 gaa3 gaak3 mei6 bat1 faan2 jing6 hoi1 si5 si4 ge3 zan1 sat6 sing4 gaau1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盤前盤後的價格未必反映開市時的真實成交價。
examples.english_sentence: Prices in pre-market and after-hours may not reflect the true transaction price when the market opens.

mandarin_meaning: 盘口；（博彩）开出的赔率或让分
english_meaning: betting odds/line; the handicap or market set by a bookmaker
explanation_mandarin: 「盤口」常用於博彩語境，指莊家或博彩公司開出的賠率、讓分或投注盤口；在日常語境亦可引申為看形勢、判斷勝算的依據。
explanation_english: In gambling contexts, "盤口" refers to the odds, handicap, or betting line set by a bookmaker. It can also be used figuratively to mean assessing the odds or market position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 盤口改咗，賠率依家高咗，唔好落注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pun4 hau2 goi2 zo2, pui4 leot6 ji1 gaa1 gou1 zo2, m4 hou2 lok6 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盘口改了，现在赔率高了，不要下注。
examples.english_sentence: The odds have changed; the odds are higher now — don't place a bet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 莊家開咗盤口，畀主隊讓兩球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 gaa1 hoi1 zo2 pun4 hau2, bei2 zyu2 deoi6 joeng6 loeng5 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庄家开了盘口，让主队让两球。
examples.english_sentence: The bookmaker opened a line, giving the home team a two-goal handicap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺生意上，佢好識睇盤口，知道幾時出手最有利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 saang1 ji3 soeng6, keoi5 hou2 sik1 tai2 pun4 hau2, zi1 dou3 gei2 si4 ceot1 sau2 zeoi3 jau5 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在生意上，他很会看盘口，知道什么时候出手最有利。
examples.english_sentence: In business, he's good at reading the market/odds; he knows when to make a move for the best advantage.

mandarin_meaning: 盤古開天闢地；自天地初成、從古至今
english_meaning: Refers to the time of Pangu creating the world; since the very beginning/primordial times
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 時間副詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 典出中國神話盤古開天闢地，『盤古初開』指天地剛形成的時候，常用來形容年代久遠或自古以來的狀況，屬書面或文言色彩較重的表達。
explanation_english: From the Chinese myth of Pangu separating heaven and earth. '盤古初開' denotes the moment the world was created and is used to mean 'since the very beginning' or 'from ancient times'. It is literary/formal in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅壁畫講述盤古初開，描繪天地分開嘅情景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 bik1 waa6 gong2 syut3 pun4 gu2 co1 hoi1, miu4 seot6 tin1 dei6 fan1 hoi1 ge3 cing4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅壁畫講述盤古初開，描繪天地分開的景象。
examples.english_sentence: This mural depicts Pangu opening the primordial chaos, portraying the scene of heaven and earth separating.

mandarin_meaning: 盘问 (pánwèn)
english_meaning: to interrogate; to question closely/intensely
explanation_mandarin: 对某人进行详细或强烈的询问或审问，常见于警方或司法场合，用以获取口供或证据。
explanation_english: To question or interrogate someone thoroughly or intensively, often used in contexts like police or judicial questioning to obtain testimony or evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察盤問咗疑犯幾個鐘，但仲未搵到證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 pun4 man6 zo2 ji4 faan6 gei2 go3 zung1, daan6 zung6 mei6 wan2 dou3 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察盘问了嫌疑人好几个小时，但仍未找到证据。
examples.english_sentence: The police interrogated the suspect for several hours, but still haven't found any evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 盘腿坐；盘坐（双腿交叠盘起坐着，常用于打坐或冥想）
english_meaning: to sit cross-legged; to sit with legs folded (often for meditation or yoga)
explanation_mandarin: 指把雙腿交疊盤起而坐，常用於打坐、冥想、瑜伽等情況，也可指一般盤腿而坐的姿勢。
explanation_english: Refers to sitting with the legs crossed and folded (sitting cross-legged). Commonly used for meditation, yoga, or simply sitting on the floor with legs crossed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢盤坐喺蒲團上打坐，專心冥想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paan4 zo6 hai2 pou4 tyun4 soeng6 daa2 zo6, zyun1 sam1 ming4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他盤腿坐在蒲團上打坐，專心冥想。
examples.english_sentence: He sat cross-legged on the meditation cushion, concentrating on his meditation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日盤坐喺地上食飯，依家膝蓋開始痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 paan4 zo6 hai2 dei6 soeng6 sik6 faan6, ji4 gaa1 sat1 goi3 hoi1 ci2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候常常盤腿坐在地上吃飯，現在膝蓋開始疼了。
examples.english_sentence: When he was a child he often sat cross-legged on the floor to eat; now his knees are starting to hurt.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）容易被利用或受騙的人；（字面）盤子、餐盤
english_meaning: (slang) a person who is easily fooled or taken advantage of; (literal) plate
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語口語中，「盤子」作貶義俚語，指容易被人利用、欺騙或當成出氣筒的人；也有字面意思指餐盤。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '盤子' refers derogatorily to someone who gets easily duped or taken advantage of. It also has the literal meaning 'plate'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁好心，成日畀人當盤子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 hou2 sam1, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 dong3 pun4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼好心，經常被人當成盤子（被利用／受騙）。
examples.english_sentence: You're so kind; people often take advantage of you (treat you as a sucker).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做盤子，簽合約之前要細讀條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 pun4 zi2, cim1 hap6 joek3 zi1 cin4 jiu3 sai3 duk6 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做盤子，簽合同前要仔細閱讀條款。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a sucker; read the terms carefully before signing the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫朋友墊錢，結果畀人呃走，真係個盤子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 pang4 jau5 din6 cin2, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 ngok3 zau2, zan1 hai6 go3 pun4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他幫朋友墊錢，結果被人騙走，真是個盤子。
examples.english_sentence: He lent money to a friend and ended up being cheated — such a sucker.

mandarin_meaning: 盘尼西林（青霉素），一种抗生素
english_meaning: Penicillin (an antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections)
explanation_mandarin: 盤尼西林是對多種細菌有效的抗生素，用於治療細菌感染。在粵語中這是英文藥名的音譯。
explanation_english: Penicillin is an antibiotic effective against many bacteria and used to treat bacterial infections. In Cantonese this is a transliteration of the English drug name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我要打盤尼西林，因為我有細菌感染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 daa2 pun4 nei4 sai1 lam4, jan1 wai6 ngo5 jau5 sai3 kwan4 gam2 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我要打盘尼西林，因为我有细菌感染。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need a penicillin injection because I have a bacterial infection.

mandarin_meaning: 盘据；占据、控制某地或某方面的位置或势力
english_meaning: to occupy; to be entrenched in or to control a place, position, or sphere of influence
explanation_mandarin: 表示占据某处或某种位置，常用于军事、政治或势力范围，强调长期或稳固地控制。
explanation_english: Indicates occupying or holding control of a place or position; often used in military, political, or metaphorical contexts to stress entrenched or sustained control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 武裝分子盤據喺山區，政府好難驅逐佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 zong1 fan1 zi2 pun4 geoi3 hai2 saan1 keoi1, zing3 fu2 hou2 naan4 keoi1 zuk6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 武装分子盘据在山区，政府难以驱逐他们。
examples.english_sentence: Militants are entrenched in the mountain area; the government finds it difficult to drive them out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班人盤據喺公司高層，好多決策都唔易改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 jan4 pun4 geoi3 hai2 gung1 si1 gou1 cang4, hou2 do1 kyut3 caak3 dou1 m4 ji6 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群人盘据在公司高层，很多决策都不容易改变。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are entrenched in the company's senior management, and many decisions are hard to change.

mandarin_meaning: 盘旋（在空中或周圍繞行、徘徊）
english_meaning: to circle; to hover; to linger (around)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在空中或某個範圍內繞來繞去、停留不去或反覆出現（例如直升機在空中盤旋，或思緒在腦海中盤旋）。
explanation_english: Describes circling or hovering in the air or lingering/loitering around a place or in thought (e.g., a helicopter circling overhead or thoughts that keep recurring).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 直升機喺山頭上盤旋，未能降落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 sing1 gei1 hai2 saan1 tau4 soeng6 pun4 syun4, mei6 nang4 gong3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 直升机在山头上盘旋，未能降落。
examples.english_sentence: The helicopter was circling over the hill and couldn't land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅思緒喺腦海入面盤旋，搞到佢訓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si1 seoi3 hai2 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6 pun4 syun4, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的思绪在脑海里盘旋，搞得他睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: His thoughts kept circling in his mind, making him unable to sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 盘查（对人员或物品进行检查、询问）
english_meaning: to check/inspect/interrogate (often by police or security)
explanation_mandarin: 指对人员、行李或情况进行检查或询问，常用于警方或保安在公共场所对可疑人员或物品进行身份或物品检查。
explanation_english: Refers to checking, inspecting, or questioning people, belongings, or situations; commonly used for police/security conducting identity or baggage checks in public places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺巴士站盤查可疑人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 baa1 si2 zaam6 pun4 caa4 ho2 ji4 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在巴士站盘查可疑人员。
examples.english_sentence: The police were checking suspicious persons at the bus stop.

mandarin_meaning: 盘根错节（形容关系或情况错综复杂、纠缠难理）
english_meaning: An intricate, tangled situation or relationship that is hard to untangle or resolve
explanation_mandarin: “盘根错节”原指树根盘错交错，现多用来比喻事情、关系或问题纠葛复杂，难以理清或解决。
explanation_english: Originally describing intertwined tree roots, the idiom is used to describe matters, relationships, or problems that are tangled and complex, making them difficult to sort out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事盤根錯節，要搵律師慢慢查先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 pun4 gan1 co3 zit3, jiu3 wan2 leot6 si1 maan6 maan6 caa4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事盘根错节，要找律师慢慢调查才能处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is deeply tangled; we need to get a lawyer to investigate slowly before it can be handled.

mandarin_meaning: 盘子里的水；放在盘子或淺碟中的水
english_meaning: water placed in a tray or shallow dish; a tray/saucer of water
explanation_mandarin: 指擺放於盤子或淺碟內的水，常用於供奉、保濕植物或清潔等用途。在日常廣東話中多為實物名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to water placed in a tray or shallow dish, often used for offerings, humidifying plants, or cleaning. In Cantonese it's used as a concrete noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺窗台放咗一盤水，幫啲植物加濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 coeng1toi4 fong3 zo2 jat1 pun4 seoi2, bong1 di1 zik6mat6 gaa1 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在窗台放了一盘水，帮助植物增加湿度。
examples.english_sentence: I put a tray of water on the windowsill to help humidify the plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜神嗰陣，屋企人會喺神台擺一盤水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 san4 go2 zan6, uk1 kei5 jan4 wui5 hai2 san4 toi4 baai2 jat1 pun4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜神的时候，家里人会在神台摆一盘水。
examples.english_sentence: When worshipping, family members will place a saucer of water on the altar.

mandarin_meaning: 盘满钵满（形容財物充足、富有或生意興隆）
english_meaning: To have abundant wealth or prosperity; to be very successful or prosperous
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容財物豐盛、富足或生意興隆，常用作祝賀或形容成功、富裕的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a state of plentiful wealth or prosperity, often used to congratulate someone on a thriving business or to describe success and affluence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你生意興隆，盤滿缽滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 saang1 ji3 hing1 lung4, pun4 mun5 but3 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你生意興隆，盘满钵满。
examples.english_sentence: I hope your business prospers and you become very wealthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年的打拼，公司終於盤滿缽滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 daa2 ping3, gung1 si1 zung1 jyu1 pun4 mun5 but3 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年的打拼，公司终于盘满钵满。
examples.english_sentence: After years of hard work, the company finally flourished and became very prosperous.

mandarin_meaning: 盘球（盘过、控球、带球过人）
english_meaning: to dribble/juggle the ball; to skilfully control or manoeuvre the ball past opponents
explanation_mandarin: 在足球、籃球等球類運動中，指運用技巧控球、盤過對手或在小範圍內熟練地處理球的動作。
explanation_english: In sports like football or basketball, it refers to controlling the ball skillfully — dribbling, juggling, or maneuvering the ball past opponents within a confined area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢盤球好熟練，喺禁區度可以盤過幾個防守球員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pun4 kau4 hou2 suk6 lin6, hai2 gam3 keoi1 dou6 ho2 ji5 pun4 gwo3 gei2 go3 fong4 sau2 kau4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他盘球技术很熟练，在禁区里可以盘过好几个防守队员。
examples.english_sentence: His ball control is very skilled; in the penalty area he can dribble past several defenders.

mandarin_meaning: 盘算（pánsuan）：打算、計劃或計較利弊，有時含有算計、謀劃的意思。
english_meaning: to calculate; to plan; to scheme (to think over or weigh options, sometimes with a connotation of scheming)
explanation_mandarin: 表示思考、計算或謀劃某事，常指打算或衡量利弊；在某些語境下可能帶有算計或策劃的含義。
explanation_english: Indicates thinking over, calculating, or plotting about something. Often means planning or weighing pros and cons; in some contexts it can imply scheming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日盤算點樣升職同加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 pun4 syun3 dim2 joeng6 sing1 zik1 tung4 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在盤算如何升職和加薪。
examples.english_sentence: He is always calculating how to get promoted and get a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺背後盤算點樣陷害我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bui3 hau6 pun4 syun3 dim2 joeng6 haam6 hoi6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在背後盤算要怎樣陷害我。
examples.english_sentence: He is scheming behind my back to frame me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好淨係盤算利弊，應該直接行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 pun4 syun3 lei6 bai6, jing1 goi1 zik6 zip3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們不要只顧著盤算利弊，應該直接行動。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not just weigh pros and cons; we should take action.

mandarin_meaning: 盘腿（坐）
english_meaning: sit cross-legged; sit with legs folded
explanation_mandarin: 指坐姿時雙腿交叉或屈起並重疊在一起，常見於打坐、休息或隨意坐姿。
explanation_english: To sit with legs crossed or folded over each other; a common sitting posture used for meditation, resting, or casual seating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺地上盤腿打坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 dei6 soeng6 pun4 teoi2 daa2 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡盤腿坐在地上打坐。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to sit cross-legged on the floor to meditate.

mandarin_meaning: 盘腿而坐；双腿交叉或屈起坐着（如打坐、瑜伽的坐姿）
english_meaning: to sit cross-legged; to sit with legs folded (e.g., in lotus or meditation posture)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以雙腿交叉或屈起的姿勢坐下，常用於打坐、冥想或瑜伽等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to sitting with the legs crossed or folded, commonly used for meditation, yoga, or contemplative sitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公園盤膝而坐，專心打坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 pun4 sat1 ji4 zok6, zyun1 sam1 daa2 zok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公園盤膝而坐，專心打坐。
examples.english_sentence: He sat cross-legged in the park, meditating.

mandarin_meaning: 曼谷（泰國首都）
english_meaning: Bangkok (capital city of Thailand)
explanation_mandarin: 「盤谷」是對泰國首都曼谷的粵語稱呼之一，屬地名的舊式或書面譯法；現時口語常以「曼谷」稱呼。
explanation_english: “盤谷” is a Cantonese name for Bangkok, the capital of Thailand. It is an older/alternative rendering for the place name; in spoken Cantonese people often say “曼谷”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去盤谷旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 pun4 guk1 leoi5 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個月要去曼谷旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Bangkok next month.

mandarin_meaning: 盘踞（pánjù）——长期占据、盘据（某地或某一位置）
english_meaning: to occupy; to be entrenched; to hold a position (often stubbornly or in a hostile way)
explanation_mandarin: 表示長期或牢固地占據某地或某個位置，常帶有負面或敵對的意味，既可指實際佔據地形，也可用於比喻勢力、影響力的存在。
explanation_english: Used to describe occupying or being firmly entrenched in a place or position for an extended period. It often carries a negative or hostile connotation and can be used literally (terrain, stronghold) or figuratively (entrenched forces or influence).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲匪徒盤踞喺山頭，唔畀人上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fai2 tou4 pun4 geoi6 hai2 saan1 tau4, m4 bei2 jan4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些匪徒盤踞在山頭，不讓人上去。
examples.english_sentence: The bandits are entrenched on the hill, preventing people from going up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面有啲官僚勢力盤踞，改革好難推行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 gun1 liu4 sai3 lik6 pun4 geoi6, goi2 gaak3 hou2 naan4 teoi1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司內部有些官僚勢力盤踞，改革很難推行。
examples.english_sentence: Some bureaucratic forces are entrenched within the company, making reforms difficult to implement.

mandarin_meaning: 盘点（对库存物品进行清点、点算；也可指总结、回顾）
english_meaning: to take inventory; to count/verify stock; to take stock (review or summarize)
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: 指對庫存或物品進行清點、核對和記錄；在比喻用法上，表示對事情、成績或狀況進行總結、回顧和檢視。
explanation_english: Refers to counting, checking and recording inventory or items; figuratively, it means reviewing or summarizing situations, results, or work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每年都要盤點庫存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 nin4 dou1 jiu3 pun4 dim2 fu3 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每年都要盘点库存。
examples.english_sentence: The company has to take inventory of its stock every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年終時我哋會盤點一下今年嘅工作成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 zung1 si4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 pun4 dim2 jat1 haa5 gam1 nin4 ge3 gung1 zok3 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年终时我们会盘点一下今年的工作成绩。
examples.english_sentence: At year-end we will take stock of this year's work achievements.

mandarin_meaning: （罕用字）读作 ān；常见用法为姓氏或古文字形，亦可作“盎”的异体，表示容器、盛器或充满、兴盛等含义。
english_meaning: A rare/archaic character (ān); used as a surname or in classical texts; sometimes a variant of 盎 meaning a vessel or the idea of being full/abundant.
explanation_mandarin: 盦為罕用漢字，多見於人名、古籍或字形異體中。有時作為“盎”的異體，含有盛器或充滿、興盛的意涵。
explanation_english: A rare Chinese character chiefly seen in personal names or classical writings. It can be a variant of 盎 and carry senses of a vessel or of fullness/abundance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「盦」好少見，通常用喺人名或者古書入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'am1' hou2 siu2 gin3, tung1 soeng4 jung6 hai2 jan4 ming4 waak6 ze2 gu2 syu1 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“盦”很少见，通常用在人名或者古书里面。
examples.english_sentence: The character '盦' is rare; it is usually used in personal names or classical texts.

mandarin_meaning: 姓氏（盧，拼音：Lú）
english_meaning: Chinese surname Lu
explanation_mandarin: 盧是常见汉字，多用作姓氏，普通話讀音為Lú，粤語讀音為lou4。亦可看到其简体字为“卢”。
explanation_english: The character 盧 is commonly used as a Chinese surname (pinyin: Lú). In Cantonese it is pronounced lou4. The simplified form is 卢.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓盧，係我隔離嘅鄰居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 lou4, hai6 ngo5 gaak3 lei4 ge3 leon4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓盧，是我隔壁的鄰居。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Lu; he's my neighbor next door.

mandarin_meaning: 卢布（俄罗斯的货币）
english_meaning: ruble (the currency of Russia)
explanation_mandarin: 指俄羅斯使用的法定貨幣，常用於表示金額或匯率。
explanation_english: Refers to the official currency of Russia, used to denote amounts of money or exchange rates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺俄羅斯用盧布買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ngo4 lo4 si1 jung6 lou4 bou3 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在俄罗斯用卢布买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I used rubles to buy things in Russia.

mandarin_meaning: 卢旺达（國名）
english_meaning: Rwanda (country)
explanation_mandarin: 盧旺達是位於非洲東部的一個國家，1994年曾發生過嚴重的種族屠殺事件。
explanation_english: Rwanda is a country in East/Central Africa. It is known internationally for the 1994 Rwandan genocide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去盧旺達旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 lou4 wong6 daat6 leoi5 jau4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去卢旺达旅游。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Rwanda next month.

mandarin_meaning: 卢森堡（国家名）
english_meaning: Luxembourg (country)
explanation_mandarin: 盧森堡是位於西歐的一個內陸小國，正式國名為盧森堡大公國。
explanation_english: Luxembourg is a small landlocked country in Western Europe, officially the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去盧森堡旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 lou4 san1 bou2 leoi5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去卢森堡旅游。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Luxembourg for a trip next month.

mandarin_meaning: 卢比（印度等国家的货币单位）
english_meaning: rupee (currency used in India and some other countries)
explanation_mandarin: 指印度、尼泊爾等國家使用的貨幣單位，常見縮寫為 INR（印度盧比）。
explanation_english: Refers to the rupee, the monetary unit used in countries such as India and Nepal (commonly abbreviated INR for Indian rupee).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月去印度，要換啲盧比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 jan3 dou6, jiu3 wun6 di1 lou4 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去印度，要换些卢比。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to India next month and need to exchange some rupees.

mandarin_meaning: 荡 / 盪 (dàng) — 摆动、摇荡、荡漾
english_meaning: to swing; to sway; to ripple
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体来回摆动、摇荡或水面等产生荡漾；常用于组成词语，如“盪鞦韆”“盪漾”。
explanation_english: Indicates a back-and-forth motion (to swing or sway) or rippling on a surface; commonly appears in compounds like '盪鞦韆' (swing) and '盪漾' (ripple).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鍾意去公園盪鞦韆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 dong6 cau1 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜欢去公园荡秋千。
examples.english_sentence: Children like to go to the park and swing on the swings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風一吹，湖面就盪起漣漪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 jat1 ceoi1, wu4 min6 zau6 dong6 hei2 lin4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风一吹，湖面就荡起涟漪。
examples.english_sentence: When the wind blows, ripples appear on the surface of the lake.

mandarin_meaning: 迷路；迷失方向；不知所措（口語）
english_meaning: to lose one's way; to be at a loss; to go off track (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「盪失路」是粵語口語，用來形容字面上的迷路或比喻精神、思路走失、不知所措或離題。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to lose one’s way (literally) or to be confused/at a loss (figuratively), i.e. to go off track.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行到半路就盪失路，唔知去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dou3 bun3 lou6 zau6 dong6 sat1 lou6, m4 zi1 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走到半路就迷路了，不知道去哪裡。
examples.english_sentence: He got lost halfway and didn't know where to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有時腦袋會盪失路，記唔起啲細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau6 si4 nou5 doi6 wui5 dong6 sat1 lou6, gei3 m4 hei2 di1 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有時腦子會迷失，想不起一些細節。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes my mind goes blank and I can't remember the details.

mandarin_meaning: 荡漾 (dàng yàng)：波动、起伏，微波或情感被触动、泛起涟漪。
english_meaning: to ripple; to undulate; (of feelings) to be stirred or to ripple through someone
explanation_mandarin: 常用来描述水面微波起伏，也可比喻内心情感被触动、泛起涟漪的状态。
explanation_english: Often used to describe small waves or ripples on a surface of water; metaphorically used for emotions being gently stirred or rippling within someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 湖面喺微風中盪漾，倒映住晚霞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu4 min6 hai2 mei4 fung1 zung1 dong6 joeng6, dou3 jing6 zyu6 maan5 haa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 湖面在微风中荡漾，倒映着晚霞。
examples.english_sentence: The lake rippled in the breeze, reflecting the sunset glow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到嗰句話，我心頭盪漾起一陣暖意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 go2 geoi3 waa6, ngo5 sam1 tau4 dong6 joeng6 hei2 jat1 zan6 nyun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到那句话，我心头荡漾起一阵暖意。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that line, a wave of warmth rippled through my heart.

mandarin_meaning: 目（mù）：1) 眼睛；2) 條目、項目；3) 目的、目標（多在複合詞中出現）
english_meaning: muk6: 1) eye; 2) an item/entry (on a list); 3) purpose/goal (often in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「目」在粤語中作名詞使用。可指身體的「眼」或用於構詞表示條目（如目錄、項目）或表示目的、目標（通常見於複合詞，如目的、目標）。在口語中常以複合詞出現，單字用作“眼睛”較文雅或書面。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 「目」 (muk6) is a noun. It can mean the eye (body part), an item or entry (as in table of contents or list), or purpose/goal (usually as part of compounds). As a standalone word for 'eye' it is more literary; in everyday speech compounds are more common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生檢查咗佢嘅目，話冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4 zo2 keoi5 ge3 muk6, waa6 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生检查了他的眼睛，说没问题。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor examined his eyes and said there was no problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請翻到目錄，搵下呢一章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 faan1 dou3 muk6 luk6, wan2 haa5 ni1 jat1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请翻到目录，找一下这一章。
examples.english_sentence: Please turn to the table of contents and find this chapter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做呢件事嘅目的係咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做这件事的目的是什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What is the purpose of doing this?

mandarin_meaning: 目不暇給（形容眼前景象繁多，來不及一一看盡）
english_meaning: an idiom meaning there is so much to see that one cannot take it all in at a glance; dazzled/overwhelmed by many sights
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容眼前的事物繁多、精彩，來不及一一觀看，常表示驚訝或讚嘆。
explanation_english: Describes a scene with so many things happening or so many attractive sights that one cannot view them all at once; often expresses amazement or admiration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旅遊景點有好多手信同埋美食，真係目不暇給。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 jau4 ging2 dim2 jau5 hou2 do1 sau2 seon3 tung4 maai4 mei5 sik6, zan1 hai6 muk6 bat1 haa4 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旅遊景點有很多伴手禮和美食，真是目不暇給。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many souvenirs and foods at the tourist spots — it's hard to take it all in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜市燈光閃爍，攤檔好多，睇到我都目不暇給。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 si5 dang1 gwong1 sim2 seok3, taan1 dong2 hou2 do1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 muk6 bat1 haa4 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夜市燈光閃爍，攤位很多，讓我看得目不暇給。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's night market sparkled with lights and so many stalls — I was dazzled and couldn't take it all in.

mandarin_meaning: 不識字；文盲
english_meaning: illiterate; unable to read
explanation_mandarin: 表示完全不會認字、沒有讀寫能力，常用來形容文化程度很低或沒有受過教育的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who cannot read any characters (illiterate); often used to indicate very low formal education or inability to read and write.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿公係目不識丁，一世都唔識字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 gung1 hai6 muk6 bat1 sik1 ding1, jat1 sai3 dou1 m4 sik1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爺爺是目不識丁，一輩子都不識字。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather is illiterate; he never learned to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好笑佢目不識丁，始終有啲人冇機會讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 siu3 keoi5 muk6 bat1 sik1 ding1, ci2 zung1 jau5 di1 jan4 mou5 gei1 wui6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要嘲笑他目不識丁，畢竟有些人沒有機會讀書。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at him for being illiterate — after all, some people never had the chance to go to school.

mandarin_meaning: 目不转睛 / 凝视、专注地注视
english_meaning: to stare fixedly; to gaze intently; to be riveted
explanation_mandarin: 形容目光紧盯着某物或某人，看得非常专注，眼睛不移开。
explanation_english: Describes staring intently at something or someone without looking away; being completely absorbed or riveted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友目不轉睛咁睇住電視卡通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 muk6 bat1 zyun2 zing1 gam2 tai2 zyu6 din6 si6 kaa1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友目不转睛地看着电视卡通。
examples.english_sentence: The child stared at the cartoon on TV without taking his eyes off it.

mandarin_meaning: 目中无人（形容人傲慢，自以为是，看不起别人）
english_meaning: arrogant; to consider oneself superior and look down on others
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人自以為高人一等，不把別人放在眼內，態度傲慢、不尊重他人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who behaves arrogantly and dismissively toward others, acting as if they are superior and not respecting others' views.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日目中無人，唔聽人意見，大家都唔鍾意同佢合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 muk6 zung1 mou4 jan4, m4 teng1 jan4 ji3 gin3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是目中无人，不听别人的意见，大家都不喜欢和他合作。
examples.english_sentence: He's always arrogant and dismissive of others; he doesn't listen to people's opinions, so nobody likes working with him.

mandarin_meaning: 目光（mùguāng）：注视、视线；也可引申为注意力或看法
english_meaning: gaze; line of sight; glance; attention; viewpoint
explanation_mandarin: 指人的視線或眼神（如看人的目光、投去的目光），在某些語境下也可指注意力或看法（例如把目光放在某事上）。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's gaze or line of sight (the look someone gives). Can also be used figuratively to mean attention or viewpoint (e.g., focusing attention on something).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用溫暖嘅目光望住細路仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 wan1 nyun5 ge3 muk6 gwong1 mong6 zyu6 sai3 lou6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用温暖的目光看着小孩。
examples.english_sentence: He looked at the child with a warm gaze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀佢嘅目光動搖你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 ge3 muk6 gwong1 dung6 jiu4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他的目光动摇你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let his gaze unsettle you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅目光都集中喺呢個新項目上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 muk6 gwong1 dou1 zaap6 zung1 hai2 ni1 go3 san1 hong6 muk6 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的目光都集中在這個新項目上。
examples.english_sentence: The company's attention is focused on this new project.

mandarin_meaning: 目光炯炯如火炬，形容眼神明亮有力，比喻目光敏銳或注視時很專注、嚴肅
english_meaning: Literally 'eyes like torches' — describes a bright, piercing gaze; metaphorically indicates keen, sharp, or intense attention/scrutiny
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人眼神炯炯有神或盯得很緊，常用於比喻注視時的專注與銳利。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone whose eyes are bright and piercing or who is watching intently; often metaphorical for focused, sharp attention or scrutiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者會上，台下嘅記者目光如炬，追問每一個細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 wui6 soeng6, toi4 haa6 ge3 gei3 ze2 muk6 gwong1 jyu4 geoi6, zeoi1 man6 mui5 jat1 go3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在记者会上，台下的记者目光如炬，追问每一个细节。
examples.english_sentence: At the press conference, the reporters in the audience watched keenly, pressing for every detail.

mandarin_meaning: 目光短浅（形容缺乏远见、见识浅薄）
english_meaning: short-sighted; lacking foresight; having a narrow outlook
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人只看到眼前利益或眼前的事物，缺乏長遠眼光或深刻見識。
explanation_english: Describes a person who only focuses on immediate gains or short-term matters, lacking long-term vision or broad understanding.
