examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 zou6 ngaan5 sin3, aam3 zung1 tai4 gung1 noi6 bou6 siu1 sik1 bei2 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方懷疑有人在公司內部當眼線，暗中向對手提供內部消息。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone inside the company is acting as an informant, secretly providing internal information to rivals.

mandarin_meaning: 眼缘；对外貌或气质的第一印象产生的好感
english_meaning: visual affinity; instant attraction/chemistry upon first sight; feeling that someone is pleasing to the eye
explanation_mandarin: 指對某人（或事物）在外貌、氣質等方面的第一印象產生的好感，常用來形容初次見面時覺得順眼或有親切感。
explanation_english: Refers to the immediate liking or attraction toward someone (or something) based on appearance or presence; often used for the pleasant first impression or instant chemistry when meeting someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢有眼緣，第一次見面已經覺得佢好順眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 jau5 ngaan5 jyun4, dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 ji5 ging1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 seon6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他有眼缘，第一次见面就觉得他很顺眼。
examples.english_sentence: I felt an instant attraction to him; I found him easy on the eyes from the first time we met.

mandarin_meaning: 眼罩（遮盖眼睛的物品）
english_meaning: eye mask; blindfold; protective cover for the eyes
explanation_mandarin: 用來覆蓋眼睛的物件，可作睡眠眼罩、護目罩，或在遊戲/處罰時作為蒙眼布。
explanation_english: An item that covers the eyes; can be used as a sleep mask, protective eye cover, or as a blindfold in games or punishments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搭飛機成日戴眼罩，瞓得好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daap3 fei1 gei1 sing4 jat6 daai3 ngaan5 zaau3, fan3 dak1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坐飛機的時候經常戴眼罩，睡得比較好。
examples.english_sentence: I often wear an eye mask on planes and sleep better.

mandarin_meaning: 眼皮跳 / 眼睛抽搐
english_meaning: eye twitch (eyelid twitch/spasm); to have one's eyelid twitch
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指眼皮跳或眼睛抽搐，通常因疲倦、壓力或神經緊張引起，也可用來描述眼部不適的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression referring to an eye/eyelid twitch or spasm, usually caused by fatigue, stress, or nervousness; used to describe that the eye is twitching or feels unsettled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我成日眼翕毛，可能訓唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 ngaan5 hap1 mou4, ho2 nang4 fan3 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我经常眼皮跳，可能沒睡好。
examples.english_sentence: I've been getting frequent eye twitches lately; maybe I'm not sleeping well.

mandarin_meaning: 眼、耳、口、鼻（指人的面部器官或感官的一部分）
english_meaning: eyes, ears, mouth, and nose (the facial features / parts of the senses)
explanation_mandarin: 通常用來指人的面部器官或感官，既可作字面意思，也可泛指五官或感覺相關部位。
explanation_english: Refers to the eyes, ears, mouth and nose — literal facial features or, more generally, parts of the senses. Can be used literally or collectively to refer to one's facial features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生檢查咗佢嘅眼耳口鼻，話冇嚴重受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4 zo2 keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 ji5 hau2 bei6, waa6 mou5 jim4 zung6 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生检查了他的眼睛、耳朵、嘴和鼻子，说没有严重受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor examined his eyes, ears, mouth, and nose and said there were no serious injuries.

mandarin_meaning: 耐性；容忍力
english_meaning: patience; tolerance (capacity to tolerate or endure)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面為「眼的肚子」，用來表示一個人能夠忍受、包容或有耐性的程度，常用於日常口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term literally 'eye belly' used to indicate a person's patience or tolerance—how much they can put up with or endure. Common in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇眼肚再聽佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 ngaan5 tou5 zoi3 teng1 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒有耐心再听他/她说话了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have the patience to listen to him/her anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要有啲眼肚，唔好咁衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 jau5 di1 ngaan5 tou5, m4 hou2 gam2 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要有點耐心，不要這麼衝動。
examples.english_sentence: You should have some patience; don't be so impulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有眼肚，成日都會包容其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 ngaan5 tou5, sing4 jat6 dou1 wui5 baau1 jung4 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有耐心，經常包容別人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very patient and often tolerant of others.

mandarin_meaning: （1）眼神、表情；（2）示意、暗示（如「看眼色」「給眼色」）
english_meaning: (1) look, expression in the eyes; (2) a nonverbal signal or hint given with one's eyes
explanation_mandarin: 「眼色」可指眼神或眼部表情，也常用作動詞短語，表示用眼神或神情示意或察言觀色，藉此判斷對方態度或暗中傳達意思。
explanation_english: “眼色” can mean the expression or look in someone's eyes. It is also used to indicate giving or reading a nonverbal signal with the eyes—gauging someone's mood or hinting something without words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下老細啲眼色，唔好亂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 lou5 sai3 di1 ngaan5 sik1, m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看老板的眼色，别乱说话。
examples.english_sentence: Watch the boss's expression; don't speak carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗個眼色，大家都懂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 go3 ngaan5 sik1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 dung2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他示意了一下，大家都明白了。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a look as a signal; everyone understood.

mandarin_meaning: 眼花 (看不清楚、被耀眼或被大量事物弄得迷亂)
english_meaning: eyes feeling blurred; dazzled or overwhelmed (by bright lights or too many things)
explanation_mandarin: 指眼睛感到看不清楚，或被刺眼的光線或大量事物弄得頭暈、迷亂；可作形容詞或動詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to eyes feeling blurry, or being dazzled/overwhelmed by bright lights or a large number of things; can be used as an adjective or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日眼花，睇唔清楚啲字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ngaan5 faa1, tai2 m4 cing1 co2 di1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天眼花，看不清楚字。
examples.english_sentence: My eyes are blurry today; I can't see the characters clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場啲燈太閃，真係睇到眼花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 di1 dang1 taai3 sim2, zan1 hai6 tai2 dou3 ngaan5 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场的灯太闪，真的让我看得眼花。
examples.english_sentence: The mall's lights are too dazzling; they really make my eyes spin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多款式令我眼花，揀唔到要買邊一款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 do1 fun2 sik1 ling6 ngo5 ngaan5 faa1, gaan2 m4 dou2 jiu3 maai5 bin1 jat1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么多款式让我眼花，选不出要买哪一款。
examples.english_sentence: So many styles make me dizzy; I can't decide which one to buy.

mandarin_meaning: 眼花缭乱（形容看到的东西太多或太绚烂，使人目眩、眼睛应接不暇）
english_meaning: dazzled; visually overwhelmed — describes being dazzled or bewildered by many or flashy sights
explanation_mandarin: 形容所見之事物繁多或光彩奪目，讓人目眩、看不清楚或應接不暇。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being visually overwhelmed or dazzled by many or spectacular things, causing confusion or inability to take everything in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場新年大減價，貨品又多又靚，睇到我眼花繚亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 san1 nin4 daai6 gaam2 gaa3, fo3 ban2 jau6 do1 jau6 leng3, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商場新年大減價，商品又多又漂亮，看得我眼花缭乱。
examples.english_sentence: The mall's big New Year sale had so many attractive items that I was dazzled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會燈光同舞台效果好震撼，整晚我都眼花繚亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui6 dang1 gwong1 tung4 mou5 toi4 haau6 gwo2 hou2 zan3 ham6, zing2 maan5 ngo5 dou1 ngaan5 faa1 liu4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱會的燈光和舞台效果很震撼，整晚我都眼花缭乱。
examples.english_sentence: The concert's lighting and stage effects were so spectacular that I was dazzled all night.

mandarin_meaning: （口语）眼花；视力模糊或被繁复、绚烂的事物弄得目眩
english_meaning: colloquial: dazzled or visually overwhelmed; eyes feel blurred or dazzled by bright/flashy things
explanation_mandarin: 「眼花花」是廣東話口語，常用來形容因強光、疲勞或東西太多、太花哨而看不清或感到目眩、眼睛發花，也可引申為被繁多選擇或誘惑弄得眼花。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing being visually dazzled or having blurred vision from bright light, fatigue, or too many flashy things; can also mean being overwhelmed by choices or temptations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚行街嗰啲霓虹燈太閃，差啲令我眼花花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 haang4 gaai1 go2 di1 nei4 hung4 dang1 taai3 sim2, caa1 di1 ling6 ngo5 ngaan5 faa1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上逛街那些霓虹灯太刺眼，差点让我眼花。
examples.english_sentence: The neon lights while walking around at night were so flashy they almost dazzled me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭陳列嘅鞋款太多太花，睇到我眼花花唔知買邊對好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 can4 lit6 ge3 haai4 fun2 taai3 do1 taai3 faa1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 faa1 faa1 m4 zi1 maai5 bin1 deoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店陈列的鞋款太多太花，让我看得眼花，不知道买哪一双好。
examples.english_sentence: This store has so many flashy shoe styles that I'm overwhelmed and don't know which pair to buy.

mandarin_meaning: 眼药水 (用于滋润或治疗眼睛的滴眼液)
english_meaning: eye drops (liquid medicine for the eyes)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來滋潤、清洗或治療眼部問題的液體藥品，通常以滴劑形式使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a liquid medicine used to lubricate, cleanse, or treat eye conditions, usually applied as drops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻眼好痕，要滴啲眼葯水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 hou2 han4, jiu3 dik1 di1 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的眼睛很痒，要滴些眼药水。
examples.english_sentence: My eye is very itchy; I need to put in some eye drops.

mandarin_meaning: 眼皮；眼睑
english_meaning: eyelid
explanation_mandarin: 指覆盖和保护眼球的皮肤或薄膜（即眼皮、眼睑）。口语中也常用来形容因疲倦而下垂、想睡的眼皮。
explanation_english: Refers to the fold of skin that covers and protects the eyeball (the eyelid). In colloquial use it can also describe drooping eyelids from tiredness or sleepiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞓唔夠，眼蓋成日垂低，好想訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan3 m4 gau3, ngaan5 goi3 sing4 jat6 seoi4 dai1, hou2 soeng2 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我睡眠不足，眼皮总是下垂，很想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not getting enough sleep; my eyelids keep drooping and I really want to sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 眼藥水；（比喻）甜言蜜語
english_meaning: eye drops; (figurative) sweet talk, flattery
explanation_mandarin: 原指用於眼睛的藥水（滴眼液），口語中也可作比喻，指討好或哄騙別人的甜言蜜語。
explanation_english: Literally medicinal liquid for the eyes (eye drops). Colloquially used figuratively to mean flattering or coaxing words intended to charm or deceive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻眼好痕，要買啲眼藥水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 hou2 han4, jiu3 maai5 di1 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的眼睛很癢，要買一些眼藥水。
examples.english_sentence: My eye is very itchy; I need to buy some eye drops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對女仔講眼藥水，唔好全信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 neoi5 zai2 gong2 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2, m4 hou2 cyun4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對女生說甜言蜜語，不要全信他。
examples.english_sentence: He often sweet-talks the girls; don't believe him entirely.

mandarin_meaning: 用貪慕、覬覦或色迷的眼神偷偷看（別人或物品）
english_meaning: to ogle; to give flirtatious, covetous or sly looks
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容用帶有貪慕、色心或覬覦的眼神偷偷看別人或物件，有時帶玩笑或貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase describing the act of giving someone/ something a covetous, flirtatious, or sly look (i.e., ogling). It’s informal and can be teasing or mildly pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日對住其他女仔眼蛇蛇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 kei4 taa1 neoi5 zai2 ngaan5 se4 se4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要總是對其他女生偷偷瞄來瞄去。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep ogling other girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到新款包包就眼蛇蛇，睇到都羨慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 san1 fun2 baau1 baau1 zau6 ngaan5 se4 se4, tai2 dou3 dou1 sin6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到新款包包就眼紅、看得很羨慕。
examples.english_sentence: He ogles new bags whenever he sees them; he looks really envious.

mandarin_meaning: 眼袋 (yǎn dài)
english_meaning: eye bags; puffiness under the eyes
explanation_mandarin: 指眼睛下方因脂肪堆積、皮膚鬆弛或水腫而形成的袋狀突起，常與疲倦或衰老有關。
explanation_english: Refers to the sagging or puffiness under the eyes caused by fat accumulation, loose skin, or fluid retention; often associated with tiredness or aging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近熬夜多，成日有眼袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngou4 je6 do1, sing4 jat6 jau5 ngaan5 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近熬夜多，老是有眼袋。
examples.english_sentence: I've been staying up late a lot recently and always have eye bags.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗眼袋手術，樣子精神好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 ngaan5 doi2 sau2 seot6, joeng6 zi2 zing1 san4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了眼袋手術，精神好多了。
examples.english_sentence: He had surgery for his eye bags and looks much more refreshed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化妝可以遮掩眼袋，但要用啱嘅遮瑕產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 zong1 ho2 ji5 ze1 jim2 ngaan5 doi2, daan6 jiu3 jung6 aam1 ge3 ze1 haa4 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化妝可以遮掩眼袋，但要用合適的遮瑕產品。
examples.english_sentence: Makeup can conceal eye bags, but you need to use the right concealer products.

mandarin_meaning: 眼见 (yǎnjiàn)：用眼睛看到；亲眼所见，也可引申为“眼见为实”（看到才相信）。
english_meaning: to see (with one's own eyes); seeing is believing; based on direct observation.
explanation_mandarin: 表示用眼睛看見某事或根據親眼所見來判斷；在口語中常用作動詞或副詞，亦可出現在成語如「眼見為實」中。
explanation_english: Indicates perceiving something with one's eyes or judging based on direct observation; commonly used as a verb or adverb in Cantonese. Also appears in the idiom 'seeing is believing.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我眼見佢好唔開心，就過去問佢有冇事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaan5_gin3 keoi5 hou2 m4 hoi1_sam1, zau6 gwo3_heoi3 man6 keoi5 jau5 mou5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我眼見他很不高兴，就过去问他有没有事。
examples.english_sentence: I saw that he was very unhappy, so I went over to ask if he was okay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眼見烏雲密布，出門記得帶把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan5_gin3 wu1_wan4 mat6_bou3, ceot1_mun4 gei3_dak1 daai3 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看見烏雲密布，出門記得帶把傘。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the dark clouds, remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲嘢眼見為實，唔好淨係聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 je5 ngaan5_gin3 wai4_sat6, m4 hou2 zing6_hai6 teng1 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些事情眼见为实，不要只听别人说。
examples.english_sentence: Some things are best seen with your own eyes; don't just rely on what others say.

mandarin_meaning: 眼光；观察事物并判断价值或优劣的能力
english_meaning: a good eye; the knack/skill of judging quality or value by sight
explanation_mandarin: 指凭视觉观察来判断事物好坏、价值或潮流的本领，常用来形容某人很会分辨、挑选或有眼光。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability to judge quality, value, or taste by sight — having a good eye or knack for spotting the right things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有眼見工夫，買嘢成日都識揀啱又抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 ngaan5 gin3 gung1 fu1, maai5 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sik1 gaan2 aap3 jau6 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有眼光，买东西总是会挑到合适又划算的。
examples.english_sentence: He has a good eye — he always picks the right and cost-effective things when shopping.

mandarin_meaning: 看到就起了私心、打歪主意（見到別人的好處或財物就產生貪念和計較）
english_meaning: To see something desirable and immediately start scheming or coveting it; to be tempted into plotting when one sees others' possessions or advantages.
explanation_mandarin: 常用於粵語口語，指看到別人的好東西或利益便起了私心、打歪主意，帶有貶義，形容人容易被眼前事物誘惑而動歪念。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that upon seeing something desirable, a person becomes covetous and begins to scheme; often pejorative and used to describe someone tempted into wrongful thoughts or plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好眼見心謀，見到啲好嘢就想佔為己有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ngaan5 gin3 sam1 mau4, gin3 dou3 di1 hou2 je5 zau6 soeng2 zim3 wai4 gei2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要眼見心謀，看到好東西就想佔為己有。
examples.english_sentence: Don't start scheming when you see something good; don't immediately think of taking it for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 眼角 (yǎn jiǎo)：眼睛的角落（內眼角或外眼角）
english_meaning: corner of the eye (inner or outer); the area where tears may gather or that helps describe eye expressions
explanation_mandarin: 指眼睛的角落位置，可以指內眼角或外眼角，常用來描述淚水、表情或眼部的狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to the corner of the eye (inner or outer). Commonly used to describe where tears collect or to indicate aspects of eye expression or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢眼角濕咗一滴淚，但係佢無講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan5 gok3 sap1 zo2 jat1 dik1 leoi6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 mou5 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眼角湿了一滴泪，但他没有说什么。
examples.english_sentence: There was a tear at the corner of his eye, but he didn't say anything.

mandarin_meaning: 角膜（眼球前部的透明組織）
english_meaning: cornea (the transparent front part of the eye)
explanation_mandarin: 眼角膜是眼球前表面的透明組織，負責折射光線並保護眼內結構。
explanation_english: The cornea is the transparent tissue at the front of the eye that helps refract light and protects internal eye structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我嘅眼角膜有輕微損傷，要注意休息同點眼藥水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 ngaan5 gok3 mok6 jau5 hing1 mei4 syun2 soeng1, jiu3 zyu3 ji3 jau1 sik1 tung4 dim2 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的眼角膜有轻微损伤，要注意休息并点眼药水。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my cornea has a minor injury; I should rest and use the eye drops.

mandarin_meaning: 高傲、看不起別人；有居高自大的態度
english_meaning: to be arrogant or haughty; to act superior and look down on others
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，用來形容一個人態度驕傲、自視高人一等，對別人不以為然或瞧不起。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who behaves arrogantly or haughtily, giving the impression they look down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嗰陣成日眼角高，似乎睇唔起我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 ngaan5 gok3 gou1, ci5 fu4 tai2 m4 hei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話的時候總是一副高高在上的樣子，好像看不起我們。
examples.english_sentence: When he speaks he always acts superior, as if he's looking down on us.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）眼紅、嫉妒
english_meaning: jealous; envious (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「眼赤」是廣東話的口語說法，字面是「眼睛發紅」，用來形容對別人的東西或成功感到嫉妒、眼紅。有時也可泛指羨慕但帶負面情緒的感覺。
explanation_english: “眼赤” (ngaan5 cek3) is Cantonese slang literally meaning “eyes red.” It is used colloquially to describe feeling jealous or envious of someone’s possessions, success, or advantages—usually with a negative tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我有新手機，成個人眼赤晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 jau5 san1 sau2 gei1, seng4 go3 jan4 ngaan5 cek3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我有新手機，整個人眼紅了。
examples.english_sentence: He saw I had a new phone and got totally jealous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁眼赤，大家都有份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 ngaan5 cek3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別這麼眼紅，大家都有份。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so jealous — everyone gets a share.

mandarin_meaning: 眼睛發亮（表示渴望、羨慕或貪婪）
english_meaning: eyes light up; to look at something with eager/greedy longing
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词（口语）/ 动词短语
explanation_mandarin: 俗語的廣東話表達，形容看到某樣心儀或誘人的東西時，眼睛發亮、流露出渴望或貪婪的神色。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing when someone's eyes light up or show eager/greedy longing upon seeing something desirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路見到糖果就眼超超。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 gin3 dou2 tong4 gwo2 zau6 ngaan5 ciu1 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子看到糖果就眼睛發亮。
examples.english_sentence: The kid's eyes lit up when he saw the candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到新款波鞋，佢即刻眼超超咁望住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 san1 fun2 bo1 haai4, keoi5 zik1 haak1 ngaan5 ciu1 ciu1 gam2 mong6 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到新款球鞋，他立刻眼睛發亮地盯著看。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the new sneakers, he immediately stared at them with eyes that lit up.

mandarin_meaning: （眼睛）瞪大/凸出來（表示驚訝或震驚）
english_meaning: eyes popping out; to be stunned/astonished (eyes bulging)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，形容因為驚訝、震驚或吃驚而眼睛突出或瞪大。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing eyes bulging or popping out from surprise, shock, or amazement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰個消息，眼都凸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 go3 siu1 sik1, ngaan5 dou1 dat6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那個消息，眼睛都瞪大了。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard the news, his eyes popped out.

mandarin_meaning: （眼睛）凸出／瞪大（表示驚訝、貪婪或注視）
english_meaning: eyes bulging / eyes popped out (expressing surprise, greed, or intense staring)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，字面意思是眼睛突出來，用來形容因為驚訝、吃驚、貪心或盯著看而把眼睛瞪大。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'eyes protrude.' It describes having one's eyes bulge or pop out due to surprise, astonishment, greed, or staring intently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢贏咗個獎，我眼都突晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 jing4 zo2 go3 zoeng2, ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 dat6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他得了獎，我驚訝得眼睛都瞪出來了。
examples.english_sentence: When I saw that they won the award, my eyes practically popped out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一見到免費自助餐，眼都突晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gin3 dou2 min5 fai3 zi6 zo6 caan1, ngaan5 dou1 dat6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到免費自助餐就眼睛都凸出來了（貪心／盯著看）。
examples.english_sentence: He practically had his eyes pop out when he saw the free buffet (staring greedily).

mandarin_meaning: 眼睛发亮；看见喜欢或贪心的东西时眼神闪亮
english_meaning: eyes light up; to have sparkling eyes when seeing something desirable (often with excitement or greed)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容一個人看到喜歡、想要或覺得有利可圖的東西時，眼睛閃亮、露出興奮或貪慾的神情。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone whose eyes sparkle or light up upon seeing something they like, want, or find profitable — often implying excitement or greed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一見到新出的手袋就眼金金，成日諗住要買返個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gin3 dou3 san1 ceot1 dik1 sau2 doi2 zau6 ngaan5 gam1 gam1, sing4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 jiu3 maai5 faan1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到新出的手袋就眼睛发亮，整天想着要買一個。
examples.english_sentence: His/her eyes light up whenever they sees the new handbag; he's/she's always thinking of buying one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到有分紅，大家都眼金金，開始搶著問詳情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 jau5 fan1 hung4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ngaan5 gam1 gam1, hoi1 ci2 coeng2 zoek3 man6 coeng4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一說到有分紅，大家都眼睛發亮，開始搶著問詳情。
examples.english_sentence: When bonuses are mentioned, everyone's eyes light up and they start asking for details eagerly.

mandarin_meaning: 眼镜
english_meaning: glasses; spectacles
explanation_mandarin: 用來矯正視力或保護眼睛的光學器具，由鏡片和鏡架組成，日常生活中常用於看遠或看近。
explanation_english: An optical device consisting of lenses and a frame worn on the face to correct vision or protect the eyes; commonly used for distance or reading correction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗我副眼鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 ngo5 fuk1 ngaan5 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不見了我的眼鏡。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my glasses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試下戴呢副眼鏡，啱唔啱你？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 daai3 ni1 fuk1 ngaan5 geng2, aam1 m4 aam1 nei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你試戴一下這副眼鏡，合不合適？
examples.english_sentence: Try on these glasses; do they suit you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我需要配眼鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 pui3 ngaan5 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說我需要配眼鏡。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor says I need to get glasses.

mandarin_meaning: 眼镜店；眼镜行
english_meaning: optical shop; eyeglass store
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指出售、配制或維修眼鏡的店鋪，等同於「眼鏡店／眼鏡行」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a shop that sells, fits, or repairs eyeglasses — equivalent to an optical shop or eyeglass store.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去眼鏡房換副新眼鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ngaan5 geng3 fong4 wun6 fu6 san1 ngaan5 geng3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去眼镜店换一副新眼镜。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the optical shop today to get a new pair of glasses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間眼鏡房啲款式好新，好多人排隊試眼鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ngaan5 geng3 fong4 di1 fun2 sik1 hou2 san1, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi6 si3 ngaan5 geng3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家眼镜店的款式很新，很多人在排队试戴。
examples.english_sentence: This optical shop has very new styles; many people are lining up to try them on.

mandarin_meaning: 眼镜糖（怀旧的一种糖果，外形像一副眼镜）
english_meaning: spectacle candy; a nostalgic candy shaped like a pair of eyeglasses
explanation_mandarin: 一種懷舊零食，通常為硬糖或壓製糖，兩粒圓形糖由一條糖橋連在一起，外形像一副小眼鏡，兒童常把它當作玩具戴着玩或吃掉。
explanation_english: A nostalgic confection shaped like a pair of eyeglasses—usually hard candy consisting of two round pieces joined by a sugar bridge. Children in Hong Kong often wore them as toy 'glasses' and then ate them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日買眼鏡糖，戴住當眼鏡玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 sing4 jat6 maai5 ngaan5 geng2 tong4, daai3 zyu6 dong3 ngaan5 geng2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我经常买眼镜糖，戴着当眼镜玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid I often bought spectacle candy and wore them as pretend glasses.

mandarin_meaning: 眼镜蛇 (yǎnjìngshé)
english_meaning: cobra (a venomous snake)
explanation_mandarin: 指一類有毒的蛇，屬眼鏡蛇科，因頸部能展開形成像「眼鏡」或有類似斑紋而得名，遇威脅時會豎起頸側的兜帽以示威嚇。
explanation_english: A venomous snake of the cobra family, named for the hood or 'spectacle' pattern on its neck; it can spread its neck hood when threatened as a defensive display.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺郊外見到一條眼鏡蛇，驚到唔敢郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gou1ngoi6 gin3 dou3 jat1 tiu4 ngaan5 geng3 se4, geng1 dou3 m4 gam2 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在郊外看到一條眼鏡蛇，嚇得不敢動。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a cobra in the countryside and was too scared to move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物館嘅導賞團今次講解咗眼鏡蛇嘅習性同埋毒性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6mat6gun2 ge3 dou6soeng2 tyun4 gam1 ci3 gong2 gaai2 zo2 ngaan5 geng3 se4 ge3 zaap6 sing3 tung4 maai4 duk6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 動物館的導賞團這次講解了眼鏡蛇的習性和毒性。
examples.english_sentence: The zoo's guided tour this time explained the habits and venom of cobras.

mandarin_meaning: 眼镜腿
english_meaning: temple / arm of eyeglasses
explanation_mandarin: 指眼鏡框兩側延伸至耳朵後面的部分，即鏡腿／鏡腳；常用來描述眼鏡配件的位置或損壞情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the side pieces of eyeglasses that extend over the ears (the temples or arms). Used when describing parts of glasses or when they are loose/broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條眼鏡髀斷咗，戴唔到眼鏡出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 ngaan5 geng2 bei2 dyun6 zo2, daai3 m4 dou2 ngaan5 geng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的眼镜腿断了，戴不了眼镜出门。
examples.english_sentence: The arm of my glasses broke, I can't wear my glasses to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢副眼鏡嘅眼鏡髀好鬆，要去舖頭整吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fu3 ngaan5 geng2 ge3 ngaan5 geng2 bei2 hou2 sung1, jiu3 heoi3 pou3 tau4 zing2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这副眼镜的镜腿很松，需要去店里修一下。
examples.english_sentence: The temples of these glasses are loose; I need to get them fixed at the shop.

mandarin_meaning: 小氣 / 吝嗇 / 心胸狹窄
english_meaning: Stingy; petty; small-minded
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人小氣或心胸狹窄，不願意付出或寬容。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stingy or petty—narrow-hearted and unwilling to give or be generous/forgiving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表面好大方，但實際好眼闊肚窄，連請杯咖啡都唔肯出錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 min6 hou2 daai6 fong1, daan6 sat6 zai3 hou2 ngaan5 fut3 tou5 zaak3, lin4 cing2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 dou1 m4 hang2 ceot1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表面上很大方，但實際上很小氣，連請杯咖啡都不肯花錢。
examples.english_sentence: He seems generous on the surface, but is actually stingy — he won't even pay for a cup of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同事做錯事，我哋原諒咗，但佢好眼闊肚窄，成日記住舊帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 si6 zou6 co3 si6, ngo5 dei6 jyun4 loeng6 zo2, daan6 keoi5 hou2 ngaan5 fut3 tou5 zaak3, seng4 jat6 gei3 zyu6 gau6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 同事犯錯，我們原諒了，但他很小氣，總是記恨舊事。
examples.english_sentence: A colleague made a mistake and we forgave him, but he's very petty and always holds grudges about past issues.

mandarin_meaning: 眼高手低 (yǎn gāo shǒu dī)
english_meaning: Having high standards or ambitions but lacking the practical ability to achieve them; big ideas but poor execution.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人眼光或要求很高，但實際能力或技巧不足，做事達不到預期。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose expectations or standards are high but whose practical skills or ability are insufficient to meet them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗到啲好大嘅計劃，但做嘢又眼高手低，成日做唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 nam2 dou3 di1 hou2 daai6 ge3 gai3 waak6, daan6 zou6 je5 jau6 ngaan5 gou1 sau2 dai1, sing4 jat6 zou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是想出很大的計劃，但做事眼高手低，總是做不好。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes up with big plans, but his skills don't match his ambitions and he always fails to do them well.

mandarin_meaning: 瞪大眼睛/怒目而視
english_meaning: to stare (often angrily or with wide eyes); to glare
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，形容把眼睛睜大並盯著看，常帶有驚訝、憤怒或警覺的意味，相當於普通話的「瞪眼/怒目而視」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing eyes being opened wide and staring/looking fixedly, often implying surprise, anger, or alertness. Equivalent to Mandarin '瞪眼' or '怒目而视'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到嗰件事，眼𡲬𡲬咁望住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 go2 gin6 si6, ngaan5 dang6 dang6 gam2 mong6 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到那件事，瞪大眼睛地盯著我。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw that, he stared at me with wide eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔做錯嘢，阿媽就用𡲬𡲬嘅眼神教訓佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zou6 co3 je5, aa3 maa1 zau6 jung6 dang6 dang6 ge3 ngaan5 san4 gaau3 fan3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩做錯了事，媽媽就用瞪大的眼神教訓他。
examples.english_sentence: When the child did something wrong, the mother scolded him with a stern, glaring look.

mandarin_meaning: 眼汪汪；眼眶含淚
english_meaning: eyes brimming with tears; teary-eyed
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容眼睛裡含著淚水或看起來溼潤、快要哭的樣子。
explanation_english: Used to describe eyes that are filled with tears or look wet/teary — as if about to cry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到壞消息，眼𥇣𥇣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 waai6 siu1 sik1, ngaan5 wong1 wong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到壞消息，眼眶含淚。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the bad news and his eyes filled with tears.

mandarin_meaning: 眯着眼；眼睛微眯（表示笑意、困倦或眯眼看東西）
english_meaning: eyes squinting; eyes half‑closed (showing a smile, sleepiness, or squinting to look)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述眼睛半閉或微眯的樣子，常表示帶笑、困倦或因陽光/視力而眯眼看東西。
explanation_english: Describes the appearance of eyes being half‑closed or squinting; often indicates a smile, sleepiness, or squinting because of bright light or to focus on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係眼𧢝𧢝噉笑，睇落好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 ngaan5 mai1 mai1 gam2 siu3, tai2 lok6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是眯着眼笑，看起來很開心。
examples.english_sentence: He always smiles with squinted eyes; he looks very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 眾 / 众 (zhòng)：群眾；許多人、大量
english_meaning: the masses; crowd; many; numerous
explanation_mandarin: 指很多人或事物的集合，如大眾、群眾；也用於表示數量多（如眾多）。
explanation_english: Refers to a large number of people or things as a group (the masses, the public); can also indicate a large quantity (numerous).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眾人都齊聲反對嗰個提議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 jan4 dou1 cai4 sing1 faan2 deoi3 go2 go3 tai4 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 众人齐声反对那个提议。
examples.english_sentence: The crowd unanimously opposed the proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢唔代表大眾嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 m4 doi6 biu2 daai6 zung3 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不代表大众的意见。
examples.english_sentence: What he says doesn't represent public opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場上有眾多選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 soeng6 jau5 zung3 do1 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市场上有众多选择。
examples.english_sentence: There are numerous choices in the market.

mandarin_meaning: 众人；大家；众多的人
english_meaning: the people; everyone; the crowd; the public
explanation_mandarin: 指許多人的集合、一般人或大家，常用來表示群體或公眾。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people—the public or everyone; used to denote a collective of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眾人都支持佢嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 jan4 dou1 zi1 ci4 keoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 众人都支持他的决定。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone supports his decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眾人拾柴火焰高，大家一齊做就快啲完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 jan4 sap6 caai4 fo2 jim6 gou1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 zou6 zau6 faai3 di1 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 众人拾柴火焰高，大家一起做就能快点完成。
examples.english_sentence: Many hands make light work; if we all do it together, it will get finished faster.

jyutping: zung3 jan4 gaai1 zeoi3 ngo5 duk6 sing2
mandarin_meaning: 眾人皆醉，我獨醒（比喻在大多數人被迷惑或盲從時，只有自己保持清醒或提出異議）
english_meaning: Everyone else is drunk, only I am sober — metaphor for being the lone clear-sighted person while others are deluded or following the crowd; can imply contrarianism or a sense of superiority.
explanation_mandarin: 此成語用來比喻在大多數人被錯誤觀念或情緒所影響時，只有自己保持清醒、提出不同看法。有時帶有自認高人一等或與眾不同的語氣。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where most people are misled or carried away, and only one person remains clear-headed or voices a dissenting opinion. It can carry tones of contrarianism or self-perceived superiority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 討論到呢個問題時，大家都好贊成呢個方案，佢卻眾人皆醉我獨醒，提出反對意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou2 leon6 dou3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 si4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3, keoi5 koek3 zung3 jan4 gaai1 zeoi3 ngo5 duk6 sing2, tai2 ceot1 faan2 deui3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 討論到這個問題時，大家都很贊成這個方案，他卻眾人皆醉我獨醒，提出了反對意見。
examples.english_sentence: When the issue was discussed, everyone supported the proposal, but he—acting as if 'everyone else is drunk and I'm the only sober one'—raised objections.

mandarin_meaning: 众叛亲离（被大众和亲属都背弃、孤立无援）
english_meaning: to be universally condemned and abandoned by both the public and one's family; to be left without supporters
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作動詞或形容詞）
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人或集體因為失德或失敗而被大眾和親屬拋棄，處於孤立無援的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a person or group who, because of wrongdoing or failure, is forsaken by the public and relatives and left isolated without support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢貪污被揭發之後，眾叛親離，連屋企人都唔理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taam1 wu1 bei6 gik1 faat3 zi1 hau6, zung3 pun3 can1 lei4, lin4 uk1 kei5 jan4 dou1 m4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他貪污被揭發之後，眾叛親離，連家人都不管他。
examples.english_sentence: After his corruption was exposed, he was abandoned by everyone; even his family turned their backs on him.

mandarin_meaning: 众口铄金（zhòng kǒu shuó jīn）——比喻舆论的力量极大，众人的议论可以扭曲事实或损害名誉。
english_meaning: The voices of many can melt gold — an idiom meaning public opinion is powerful; mass opinion can distort the truth or destroy someone's reputation.
explanation_mandarin: 出自古籍，原指众口（众人的议论）能像火一样把金属熔化。現多用來形容輿論力量大，或指眾人的言論會影響事實或名譽。
explanation_english: A classical idiom originally describing how many mouths can 'melt gold'. It is used to highlight the strong influence of public opinion, and how widespread talk can affect facts or damage reputations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲媒體亂咁報，眾口鑠金，佢嘅名聲一落千丈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mui4 tai2 lyun6 gam2 bou3, zung3 hau2 seok6 gam1, keoi5 ge3 ming4 sing1 jat1 lok6 cin1 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒體胡亂報道，眾口鑠金，他的名聲一落千丈。
examples.english_sentence: The media reported recklessly; public opinion ruined his reputation and his standing plummeted.

mandarin_meaning: 众多 (zhòngduō)
english_meaning: numerous; many; a large number
explanation_mandarin: 表示數量很多，用來修飾名詞或作表語，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Indicates a large quantity or number; an adjective used to describe nouns or act as a predicate; relatively formal in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個活動有眾多觀眾支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 jau5 zung3 do1 gun1 zung3 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个活动有众多观众支持。
examples.english_sentence: This event has many audience members supporting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眾多原因之中，最主要係時間唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 do1 jyun4 jan1 zi1 zung1, zeoi3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 si4 gaan3 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在众多原因中，最主要的是时间不够。
examples.english_sentence: Among the many reasons, the main one is lack of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有眾多職位空缺，歡迎應徵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 zung3 do1 zik1 wai6 hung1 kyut3, fun1 jing4 jing3 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有众多职位空缺，欢迎应聘。
examples.english_sentence: The company has many job vacancies; applications are welcome.

mandarin_meaning: 众志成城
english_meaning: To unite as one; united we stand (literally: the people's will becomes a fortress)
explanation_mandarin: 形容大家团结一致，凝聚起强大的力量，能够共同战胜困难或抵御外敌。
explanation_english: Describes people coming together with united determination, forming a strong force able to overcome difficulties or repel threats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺今次疫情期間，我哋要眾志成城，齊心抗疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam1 ci3 jik6 cing4 kei4 gaan1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zung3 zi3 sing4 sing4, cai4 sam1 kong3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这次疫情期间，我们要众志成城，齐心抗疫。
examples.english_sentence: During this outbreak, we must unite as one and fight the epidemic together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風之後，社區職員同居民眾志成城，一齊清理街道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 zi1 hau6, se5 keoi1 zik1 jyun4 tung4 geoi1 man4 zung3 zi3 sing4 sing4, jat1 cai4 cing1 lei5 gaai1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风过后，社区工作人员和居民众志成城，一起清理街道。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, community workers and residents united to clear the streets together.

mandarin_meaning: 众所周知
english_meaning: as is well known; it is well known that
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事是大家都知道的事實，常用於句首或句中，引出普遍認知的內容。
explanation_english: Used to state that something is widely known or obvious; often used to introduce a commonly accepted fact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眾所周知，香港嘅樓價一向都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 so2 zau1 zi1, hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lau4 gaa3 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 众所周知，香港的房价一直很高。
examples.english_sentence: As is well known, Hong Kong's housing prices have always been very high.

mandarin_meaning: 众所周知（表示大家普遍知道的事）
english_meaning: As everyone knows; it is well known (that...)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某件事是普遍為人所知的，常用於引出已知的事實或作為背景說明。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is widely known by people; often used to introduce a well-known fact or provide background information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 眾所週知，香港的房價一直很高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 so2 zau1 zi1, hoeng1 gong2 dik1 fong4 gaa3 jat1 zik6 han2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 众所周知，香港的房价一直很高。
examples.english_sentence: As everyone knows, housing prices in Hong Kong have been very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事眾所週知，無須再重複解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zung3 so2 zau1 zi1, mou4 seoi1 zoi3 cung4 fuk1 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事众所周知，不必再重复解释。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is well known; there's no need to explain it again.

mandarin_meaning: 众数（统计学中出现次数最多的数值）；亦可指多数、大家的观点
english_meaning: Mode (the value that appears most frequently in a data set); can also mean the majority or what most people think
explanation_mandarin: 在统计学中，眾數指一组数据中出现次数最多的数值。日常使用时，也可用来表示多数或大多数人的意见。
explanation_english: In statistics, the mode is the value that occurs most frequently in a dataset. In everyday usage it can also refer to the majority or the view held by most people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢組數據入面，眾數係五。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 zou2 sou3 geoi3 jap6 min6, zung3 sou3 hai6 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这组数据中，众数是5。
examples.english_sentence: In this data set, the mode is 5.

mandarin_meaning: 众星拱照（zhòng xīng gǒng zhào）：原指众多星辰环绕照耀，后比喻众人簇拥、围绕或普遍赞誉某人，使其成为焦点或受人敬仰。
english_meaning: Literally 'the stars surround and illuminate' — figuratively, to be the center of attention, surrounded by admirers or praised by many.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某事受到眾人的簇擁、圍繞或高度讚譽，成為眾人矚目的焦點。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is surrounded by admirers or prominent figures and becomes the focus of attention and praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開幕禮嗰陣，主角真係眾星拱照，成日畀媒體追住問問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 muk6 lai5 go2 zan6, zyu2 gok3 zan1 hai6 zung3 sing1 gung2 ziu3, seng4 jat6 bei2 mui4 tai2 zeoi1 zyu6 man6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开幕礼上主角真是众星拱照，整天被媒体追着问问题。
examples.english_sentence: At the opening ceremony the protagonist was truly the center of attention, constantly chased by the media with questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新任CEO一上任就成為眾星拱照嘅焦點，好多業界大佬都嚟祝賀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jam6 CEO jat1 soeng5 jam6 zau6 sing4 wai4 zung3 sing1 gung2 ziu3 ge3 ziu1 dim2, hou2 do1 jip6 gaai3 daai6 lou2 dou1 lai4 zuk1 ho6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新任首席执行官一上任就成為众星拱照的焦點，很多業界大佬都來祝賀。
examples.english_sentence: When the new CEO took office, he immediately became the center of attention, with many industry bigwigs coming to offer congratulations.

mandarin_meaning: 眾望所歸 (zhòng wàng suǒ guī)：受到廣大民眾期待和支持的人或結果
english_meaning: to be the people's choice; to enjoy the unanimous expectations and support of the public
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事獲得大多數人期待與支持，大家一致盼望其成為結果或擔任某職務。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or outcome that commands widespread public expectation and support — the one everyone hopes will succeed or assume a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺今次選舉，佢幾乎係眾望所歸，大家都支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2, keoi5 gei2 fu1 hai6 zung3 mong6 so2 gwai1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 ci4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這次選舉中，他幾乎是眾望所歸，大家都支持他。
examples.english_sentence: In this election, he was almost the people's choice; everyone supported him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新董事長一上任，內部嘅反對聲就消失晒，佢真係眾望所歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 dong2 si6 zoeng2 jat1 soeng5 jam6, nei6 bou6 ge3 faan2 deoi3 seng1 zau6 siu1 sat1 saai3, keoi5 zan1 hai6 zung3 mong6 so2 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新任董事長一上任，內部的反對聲就消失了，他真是眾望所歸。
examples.english_sentence: When the new chairman took office, internal opposition disappeared; he truly was the people's choice.

mandarin_meaning: 众生（指一切有情生命，尤用于佛教语境，意为所有能感受的生命或众人）
english_meaning: sentient beings; all living creatures (often used in Buddhist context to mean all beings capable of feeling)
explanation_mandarin: “眾生”常用于佛教或宗教语境，指一切有情的生命，包括人類及其他有感受的動物；也可泛指眾人。
explanation_english: “眾生” refers to all sentient beings — living creatures capable of feeling. Commonly used in Buddhist or religious contexts to denote all living beings or people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話海洋污染會令好多眾生受害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hoi2 joeng4 wu1 jim5 wui5 ling6 hou2 do1 zung3 saang1 sau6 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说海洋污染会让许多众生受害。
examples.english_sentence: He said ocean pollution will harm many living creatures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛陀教導我哋要救度眾生，行慈悲心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 to4 gaau3 dou6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gau3 dou6 zung3 saang1, hang4 ci4 bei1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛陀教导我们要救度众生，行慈悲心。
examples.english_sentence: The Buddha taught us to save sentient beings and practice compassion.

mandarin_meaning: 眾生相（指眾生各種面貌、行為與世態人情）
english_meaning: The various appearances/behaviours of people; the many faces of humanity; human foibles and worldly conditions.
explanation_mandarin: 「眾生相」用來形容世間各種人物的表現、面貌或生活狀態，常帶有對人情冷暖或世態百態的觀察與評論意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe the many appearances or behaviours of people in society; often implies observing and commenting on human nature, social conditions, or the variety of worldly phenomena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行街見到咁多人嘅反應，真係眾生相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 gaai1 gin3 dou2 gam2 do1 jan4 ge3 faan2 jing3, zan1 hai6 zung3 sang1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在街上看到那麼多人的反應，真是眾生相。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing so many people's reactions on the street really shows the many faces of humanity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套紀錄片揭示咗社會上嘅各種眾生相，好值得反思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin3 kit3 si6 zo2 se5 wui6 soeng6 ge3 gok3 zung2 zung3 sang1 soeng2, hou2 zik1 dak1 faan2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部紀錄片揭示了社會上的各種眾生相，很值得反思。
examples.english_sentence: This documentary reveals various aspects of society and is well worth reflecting on.

mandarin_meaning: 众目睽睽（在众人注视下；大家都看得到的情形）
english_meaning: In full view of everyone; under the eyes/gaze of all; openly in public
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（作状语/副词性短语）
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事发生或某人处在众人的注视之下，强调公开、明显、大家都能看到或注意到的情形。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens or someone is placed under the watchful eyes of many people; emphasizes that it is public, obvious, and seen by everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺眾目睽睽之下偷嘢，真係好蠢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zung3 muk6 kwai4 kwai4 zi1 haa6 tau1 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 ceon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在众目睽睽之下偷东西，真的很愚蠢。
examples.english_sentence: He stole something in full view of everyone; it was really stupid.

mandarin_meaning: 众矢之的（被众人指责或攻击的对象）
english_meaning: the target of public criticism or attack; the focus of everyone's blame/hostility
explanation_mandarin: 成語，原指眾人的箭矢所射的目標，現用來形容某人成為眾人公然指責或攻擊的對象。
explanation_english: An idiom originally meaning the object at which everyone's arrows are aimed. Now used to describe a person or thing that becomes the object of public blame or attack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為上次的失誤，佢而家成咗眾矢之的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 soeng6 ci3 dik1 sat1 ng6, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 sing4 zo2 zung3 si2 zi1 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為上次的失誤，他現在成了眾矢之的。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the last mistake, he has become the target of public criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一提出新政策，就即刻成咗眾矢之的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 tai4 ceot1 san1 zing3 caak3, zau6 zik1 hak1 sing4 zo2 zung3 si2 zi1 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一提出新政策，立刻就成了眾矢之的。
examples.english_sentence: When he proposed the new policy, he immediately became the focus of everyone's attacks.

mandarin_meaning: 众筹（通过网络或平台由大量公众小额出资筹集资金）
english_meaning: Crowdfunding (raising small amounts of money from many people, usually via online platforms)
explanation_mandarin: 指透过互联网或专门平台，由众多个人出资以小额集合成较大资金，用于支持项目、产品开发、活动等的行为或机制。
explanation_english: The practice or mechanism of raising funds by collecting small contributions from a large number of people, typically through online platforms, to support a project, product development, event, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目打算喺網上眾籌，籌集資金做原型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 daa2 syun3 hai2 mong5 soeng6 zung3 cau4, cau4 zaap6 zi1 gam1 zou6 jyun4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目打算在网上众筹，筹集资金做原型。
examples.english_sentence: This project plans to crowdfund online to raise money to build a prototype.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度搞一個眾籌，希望可以印多啲書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 gaau2 jat1 go3 zung3 cau4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jan3 do1 di1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在做一个众筹，希望可以多印些书。
examples.english_sentence: They're running a crowdfunding campaign, hoping to print more copies of the book.

mandarin_meaning: 众说纷纭（zhòng shuō fēn yún）：许多人对同一件事发表不同意见，看法不一。
english_meaning: There are many differing opinions; views are divided; opinions vary widely.
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (can function as a noun or adverbial phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 表示多人對某事有各種不同或相互矛盾的看法，難以達成一致。
explanation_english: Indicates that many people have various or conflicting opinions on a matter, making consensus difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於新政策，市民嘅意見眾說紛紜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 san1 zing3 caak3, si5 man4 ge3 ji3 gin3 zung3 syut3 fan1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于新政策，市民的意见众说纷纭。
examples.english_sentence: Public opinion about the new policy is divided.

mandarin_meaning: 众说纷纭（众人各有不同看法或意见）
english_meaning: Many people hold differing opinions; opinions are divided
explanation_mandarin: 形容對某事看法不一致，各人說法很多且互相不同。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where many people have different and often conflicting opinions about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於呢件事，眾說紛紜，未有定案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6, zung3 syut3 fan1 wan4, mei6 jau5 ding6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 關於這件事，眾說紛紜，尚未達成定論。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this matter, opinions are divided and no conclusion has been reached.

mandarin_meaning: 众说纷纭 (zhòng shuō fēn yún)：对同一件事有许多不同甚至相互矛盾的意见或说法
english_meaning: Opinions are divided; there are many and often conflicting views or statements
explanation_mandarin: 形容就同一件事出現多種不同、往往互相矛盾的意見，難以達成共識或確定答案。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where many different and often conflicting opinions exist about the same matter, making consensus or a definitive conclusion difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於呢件事，大家眾説紛紜，暫時未有定案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6, daai6 gaa1 zung3 syut3 fan1 wan4, zaam6 si4 mei6 jau5 ding6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于这件事，众说纷纭，暂时没有定案。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this matter, opinions are divided and there is no decision yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於新政策，社會眾説紛紜，記者會上唔少人提出批評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 san1 zing3 caak3, se5 wui6 zung3 syut3 fan1 wan4, gei3 ze2 wui2 soeng6 m4 siu2 jan4 tai4 ceot1 pai1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于新政策，社会众说纷纭，记者会上不少人提出批评。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding the new policy, society is full of differing opinions and many people raised criticisms at the press conference.

mandarin_meaning: 穿；（表示持续或状态）着；着火
english_meaning: to wear/to put on; (particle) indicating a state/continuation; to catch fire
explanation_mandarin: 汉字「着」在粤语有多种读音与用法：讀作zoek3时常作动词，表示穿戴或穿上；讀作zoek6时多用作表示持续状态或结果（相当于汉语普通话的“着/着着”或表示“着火”）；根据语境选择读音与用法。
explanation_english: The character 着 in Cantonese has multiple readings and uses: pronounced 'zoek3' when used as a verb meaning to wear/put on; pronounced 'zoek6' when used as a particle indicating a continued/state result or in verbs like 'catch fire'. The correct reading depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住件毛衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 mou4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着那件毛衣。
examples.english_sentence: He is wearing that sweater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 燈著住喇，唔使開返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 zoek6 zyu6 laa3, m4 sai2 hoi1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯开着，不用再开了。
examples.english_sentence: The light is on, no need to turn it on again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房著咗火！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 zoek6 zo2 fo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房着火了！
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen caught fire!

mandarin_meaning: 着力 (zhuólì) — 努力、用力，着重投入精力或资源在某事上
english_meaning: to exert effort; to put effort into; to focus/ concentrate resources on something
explanation_mandarin: 表示把精力或力量投入到某件事情上，强调努力或重点投入。
explanation_english: Indicates putting energy or force into something; emphasizes making an effort or concentrating resources/attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好着力準備考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zoek3 lik6 zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力准备考试。
examples.english_sentence: He is putting a lot of effort into preparing for the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府着力改善交通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zoek3 lik6 goi2 sin6 gaau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府着力改善交通。
examples.english_sentence: The government is making efforts to improve transportation.

mandarin_meaning: （被）牵连/连累在同一件事上；被卷入同一责任或麻烦
english_meaning: to be implicated together; to be dragged into the same mess or share the same responsibility/fate
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，字面意義是「穿同一條褲」，引申為被牽連、一起承擔責任或同受連累。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "wear the same pair of trousers," used to say someone is implicated together, dragged into the same trouble, or shares responsibility/fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將我着埋一條褲，呢件事係你搞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 ngo5 zoek3 maai4 jat1 tiu4 fu3, ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 nei5 gaau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把我牽扯進來，這件事是你惹的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drag me into this; this was your doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都唔想着埋一條褲，最好查清楚邊個負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 soeng2 zoek3 maai4 jat1 tiu4 fu3, zeoi3 hou2 caa4 cing1 co2 bin1 go3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們都不想被連累，最好查清楚誰負責。
examples.english_sentence: We don't want to be implicated; it's best to find out who is responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司嗰啲領導有問題，你個部門好可能會着埋一條褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 go2 di1 ling5 dou6 jau5 man6 tai4, nei5 go3 bou6 mun4 hou2 ho2 nang4 wui5 zoek3 maai4 jat1 tiu4 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司那些領導有問題，你的部門很可能會被連累。
examples.english_sentence: If those leaders at the company have problems, your department could very well be implicated.

mandarin_meaning: 穿孝；守孝
english_meaning: to wear mourning clothes; to be in mourning
explanation_mandarin: 表示穿戴孝服、守孝，通常在親人去世後用來表達哀悼和服喪的習俗，屬於傳統禮節。
explanation_english: Refers to wearing mourning attire or observing mourning after a relative's death; a traditional practice expressing grief and filial respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爹過咗身，佢要着孝一段時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 daa1 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 jiu3 zoek3 haau3 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他父親去世了，他要穿孝一段時間。
examples.english_sentence: His father passed away; he has to wear mourning clothes for a period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿媽着孝，所以冇去參加朋友嘅婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 maa1 zoek3 haau3, so2 ji5 mou5 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 pang4 jau5 ge3 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他媽媽在守孝，所以沒去參加朋友的婚禮。
examples.english_sentence: His mother was in mourning, so she didn't attend a friend's wedding.

mandarin_meaning: 确实
english_meaning: indeed; truly; really; solidly
explanation_mandarin: 表示确实、的确，用来强调程度或肯定某事；也可表示扎实、可靠。
explanation_english: Used to indicate certainty or strong emphasis ('indeed', 'truly'); can also describe something as solid or reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着實幫到我好多忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 sat6 bong1 dou3 ngo5 hou2 do1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他确实帮了我很多忙。
examples.english_sentence: He truly helped me a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢着實準備得好充足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 zoek3 sat6 zeon2 bei6 dak1 hou2 cung1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他确实准备得很充分。
examples.english_sentence: He really prepared thoroughly for this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰份報告寫得着實，有好多數據做支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 zoek3 sat6, jau5 hou2 do1 sou3 geoi3 zou6 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份报告写得很扎实，有很多数据作为支持。
examples.english_sentence: That report is written solidly, with a lot of data supporting it.

mandarin_meaning: 着急 (zháojí)
english_meaning: anxious; worried; impatient; in a hurry
explanation_mandarin: 表示急於等待、擔心或心情焦急的狀態，可作形容詞或動詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates a state of being anxious, worried, or impatient; can be used as an adjective or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好着急，慢慢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 gap1, maan6 maan6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别着急，慢慢做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be anxious, take your time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個學生成日為考試着急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hok6 saang1 sing4 jat6 wai6 haau2 si3 zoek3 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个学生总是为考试着急。
examples.english_sentence: That student is always anxious about exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話快啲交報告，大家都有啲着急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 faai3 di1 gaau1 bou3 gou3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 di1 zoek3 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要快点交报告，大家都有点着急。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said to hand in the report quickly; everyone is a bit anxious.

mandarin_meaning: 为别人着想；考虑他人
english_meaning: to consider (others); to think of others; to take into consideration
explanation_mandarin: 表示替别人考虑、关心别人的需要或感受，常用于“为别人着想”等结构。
explanation_english: To think about or take into account the needs and feelings of others; commonly used in phrases like 'to think of others'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要學下為人着想，唔好淨係諗住自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 hok6 haa5 wai6 jan4 zoek3 soeng2, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 lam2 zyu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要学会为别人着想，不要只想着自己。
examples.english_sentence: You should learn to think of others; don't only think about yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢乜都唔會為同事着想，大家都唔鍾意同佢合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 mat1 dou1 m4 wui5 wai6 tung4 si6 zoek3 soeng2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事从不为同事着想，大家都不喜欢和他合作。
examples.english_sentence: He never considers his colleagues when working; nobody likes to collaborate with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當安排旅行時，應該替大家着想啲，例如考慮下長者同小朋友嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 ngon1 paai4 leoi5 hang4 si4, jing1 goi1 tai3 daai6 gaa1 zoek3 soeng2 di1, lai6 jyu4 haau2 leoi6 haa5 coeng4 ze2 tung4 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 安排旅行时应该替大家着想，例如考虑一下长者和小朋友的需要。
examples.english_sentence: When planning the trip, you should consider everyone, for example by thinking about the needs of the elderly and children.

mandarin_meaning: 着意 / 特意注意、用心
english_meaning: to pay special attention to; to take care to; deliberately
explanation_mandarin: 表示特意注意或用心去做某事，常用來表示刻意、用心處理或關注某事。
explanation_english: Indicates deliberately paying attention or making a special effort; used to mean taking care to, being attentive to, or intentionally doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使太着意佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 taai3 zoek3 ji3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用太着意他說的話。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to pay too much attention to what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師着意解釋每一個重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 zoek3 ji3 gaai2 sik1 mui5 jat1 go3 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師特意解釋每一個重點。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher deliberately explains each key point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我着意睇返合同嘅細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoek3 ji3 tai2 faan1 hap6 tung4 ge3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我特意查看合同的細節。
examples.english_sentence: I took care to check the details of the contract.

mandarin_meaning: 着手 / 著手 (zhuóshǒu) — 开始着手做某事，着手处理。
english_meaning: to start; to set about; to begin handling a task or matter
explanation_mandarin: 表示开始着手做某件事或开始处理某个问题，常用于正式或书面语。
explanation_english: Indicates beginning to carry out or deal with something; commonly used to mean starting work on a task or handling an issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家開始着手做份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 zoek3 sau2 zou6 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在开始着手做一份报告。
examples.english_sentence: I'm starting to work on a report now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經着手安排下星期嘅培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 zoek3 sau2 ngon1 paai4 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经着手安排下星期的培训。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already begun arranging next week's training.

mandarin_meaning: 划算；占便宜；有利
english_meaning: advantageous; a good deal; to get a bargain
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，表示某件事或交易很划算、有利或者能佔到便宜。可作名詞或形容詞使用，常見於香港用語。
explanation_english: Informal Cantonese slang meaning that something is advantageous, a good deal, or that someone gets a bargain. Can be used as a noun or adjective; commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間超市而家有折，真係好着數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 si5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 zit3, zan1 hai6 hou2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家超市现在在打折，真的很划算。
examples.english_sentence: This supermarket has discounts now; it's really a good deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買呢個套票比較着數，平多咗二百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ni1 go3 tou3 piu3 bei2 gok3 zoek3 sou3, peng4 do1 zo2 ji6 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买这个套票比较划算，便宜了两百块。
examples.english_sentence: Buying this package is cheaper; it's HK$200 cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆今日送咗免費飲品畀我，着數喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 sung3 zo2 min5 fai3 jam2 ban2 bei2 ngo5, zoek3 sou3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天送了我免费饮料，真是占便宜啊。
examples.english_sentence: The boss gave me a free drink today — that's a bargain.

mandarin_meaning: 適時；及時；恰當
english_meaning: timely; at the right time; opportune
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來表示在合適或恰當的時間點，或做事很及時、適當。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning happening at the right or appropriate time; timely or opportune. Can function adjectivally or adverbially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你着時嚟，好彩未開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 si4 lai4, hou2 coi2 mei6 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你來得正好，幸好還沒開始。
examples.english_sentence: You arrived at the right time — luckily it hasn't started yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅建議好着時，幫到我哋解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 gin3 ji5 hou2 zoek3 si4, bong1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出的建議很適時，幫助我們解決了問題。
examples.english_sentence: His suggestion was very timely and helped us solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要着時出手，先有機會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zoek3 si4 ceot1 sau2, sin1 jau5 gei1 wui6 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要適時出手，才有機會成功。
examples.english_sentence: You need to act at the right time to have a chance of success.

mandarin_meaning: 着凉 / 受寒
english_meaning: to catch a cold; to get chilled
explanation_mandarin: 因受寒冷而出現頭痛、流鼻涕、打噴嚏等症狀；即「著涼、受寒」。
explanation_english: To become ill or develop symptoms (runny nose, sneezing, sore throat) as a result of being chilled; to catch a cold from exposure to cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚出面凍，你小心啲，唔好着涼呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ceot1 min6 dung3, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 zoek3 loeng4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上外面很冷，小心別着凉。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold outside at night; be careful not to catch a cold.

mandarin_meaning: 着火／起火
english_meaning: to catch fire; to be on fire
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体开始燃烧（起火）。在口语中有时也可作比喻，表示情绪或事态突然激烈。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has begun to burn (caught fire). Can also be used metaphorically to describe someone or something becoming highly active or intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓下間舖着火，快啲打999叫消防喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 haa6 gaan1 pou3 zoek3 fo2, faai3 di1 daa2 gau2 gau2 gau2 giu3 siu1 fong4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼下的店着火了，快打999叫消防队！
examples.english_sentence: The shop downstairs is on fire — quickly call 999 for the fire brigade!

mandarin_meaning: 开灯 / 点灯
english_meaning: turn on the light; light up
explanation_mandarin: 表示把燈打開或點亮（常用於口語）。相當於普通話的「开灯」。
explanation_english: Means to switch on or light a lamp/light; commonly used in spoken Cantonese as the equivalent of 'turn on the light.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企黑晒，快啲着燈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 hak1 saai3, faai3 di1 zoek6 dang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里黑了，快点开灯吧。
examples.english_sentence: The house is dark, turn on the light quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺戲院入面唔可以着燈，會影響其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hei3 jyun2 jap6 min6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoek6 dang1, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 kei4 ta1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在电影院里面不可以开灯，会影响其他人。
examples.english_sentence: You can't turn on lights inside the cinema; it would disturb others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕節嗰陣成座大廈都着晒燈，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 zit3 go2 zan6 seng4 zo6 daai6 haa6 dou1 zoek6 saai3 dang1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞节的时候整座大厦都亮着灯，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: At Christmas the whole building lights up and looks beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 倒霉、遭殃（俚語，廣東話）
english_meaning: to get into trouble / to be doomed / to have very bad luck (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「着瓦靴」是香港粵語的俚語，表示遭遇不幸、出事或落得很窮困、倒霉的境況。語氣口語化，多用來警告或形容會有壞結果。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression used chiefly in Hong Kong to say someone will be unlucky, get into trouble, or meet a bad end. Informal and colloquial; often used as a warning or to describe a bad outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做會着瓦靴㗎，唔好衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 wui5 zoek3 ngaa4 hyut3 gaa3 m4 hou2 cung1 dung6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做会倒霉的，别冲动。
examples.english_sentence: If you do that you'll get into trouble — don't act on impulse.

mandarin_meaning: 着眼 / 著眼（注重、关注某一方面）
english_meaning: to focus on; to take into consideration; to pay attention to a particular aspect
explanation_mandarin: 表示把注意力或考虑点放在某个方面或目标上，常用于强调长远、关键或需要特别关注的点（可与“于/於”连用）。
explanation_english: A verb phrase meaning to direct attention or consideration to a particular aspect or objective; often emphasizes long-term or key points and can be followed by a preposition equivalent to 'on' or 'to'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做計劃嘅時候要着眼長遠利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 gai3 waak6 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 zoek3 ngaan5 coeng4 jyun5 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做计划的时候要着眼长远利益。
examples.english_sentence: When we make plans, we should focus on long-term benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府着眼於改善基層民生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zoek3 ngaan5 jyu1 goi2 sin6 gei1 cang4 man4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府着眼于改善基层民生。
examples.english_sentence: The government is focused on improving grassroots livelihoods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢總係着眼細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 zung2 hai6 zoek3 ngaan5 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是着眼于细节。
examples.english_sentence: He always pays attention to details.

mandarin_meaning: 着眼点（关注的重点、出发点）
english_meaning: focal point; point of focus; emphasis
explanation_mandarin: 表示關注或評估時所著重的重點或出發視角，常用於討論策略、分析或評估時指出關注的方向。
explanation_english: Refers to the point or perspective that one focuses on when evaluating or discussing something; commonly used when talking about strategy, analysis, or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺做策劃嘅時候，要先確定着眼點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zou6 caak3 waak6 ge3 si4hau6, jiu3 sin1 kok3ding6 zoek3 ngaan5 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在做策划的时候，要先确定着眼点。
examples.english_sentence: When planning, you should first determine the focal point.

mandarin_meaning: 不停地糾纏、煩人或嘮叨
english_meaning: to keep pestering/bugging someone; to nag or make a fuss repeatedly
explanation_mandarin: 「着着聲」是廣東話口語，用來形容某人不斷地糾纏、煩擾別人或反覆嘮叨，帶有抱怨或煩人的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who repeatedly pesters, nags, or fusses — continuously bothering others with requests, complaints, or attention-seeking behaviour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日着着聲，畀人休息啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zoek3 zoek3 seng1, bei2 jan4 jau1 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是糾纏別人，讓人休息吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop pestering all the time; give people a break.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着着聲要我幫手，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 zoek3 seng1 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 sau2, zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是纏著我要幫忙，真讓人受不了。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps nagging me to help him; it's really unbearable.

mandarin_meaning: 穿紅鞋；（俚語）當情婦/小三（在某些語境下）
english_meaning: to wear red shoes; (slang/colloquial) to be a mistress / to become someone's kept woman (in some contexts)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞片語（也可作俚語用）
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是穿紅色的鞋子。口語中在部分廣東話語境（尤其是非正式或俚語情況）有時用來暗指女性成為別人的情婦或當小三，但此用法並非正式或普遍語法，理解時要看語境。
explanation_english: Literally 'to wear red shoes'. In everyday Cantonese it can simply mean putting on red shoes. Colloquially in some contexts it is used as slang to imply a woman has become a mistress/the other woman, but this figurative use is informal and context-dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新娘今日着紅鞋，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 noeng4 gam1 jat6 zoek3 hung4 haai4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新娘今天穿紅鞋，看起來很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The bride is wearing red shoes today; she looks beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢而家著緊紅鞋，可能已經做咗人哋嘅小三。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zoek3 gan2 hung4 haai4, ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 zou6 zo2 jan4 dei6 ge3 siu2 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說她現在當了別人的小三，可能已經成了情婦。
examples.english_sentence: I've heard she's become someone's mistress; she may already be the other woman.

mandarin_meaning: 正在穿着（衣物）
english_meaning: wearing; in the process of putting on (clothes or accessories)
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或狀態正在進行，指正在穿著衣服或配件（持續性的「穿著」或正在穿上的過程）。
explanation_english: Indicates an ongoing action or state of wearing clothing or accessories — to be wearing something or in the process of putting it on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家着緊件衫，等一陣先出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zoek3 gan2 gin6 saam1, dang2 jat1 zan6 sin1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在正在穿衣服，等一下再出門。
examples.english_sentence: I'm putting on clothes right now; wait a moment before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你着緊鞋未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 gan2 haai4 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你穿著鞋了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you wearing shoes yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日成日着緊外套，可能覺得凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 zoek3 gan2 ngoi6 tou3, ho2 nang4 gok3 dak1 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天一直穿著外套，可能覺得冷。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has been wearing a coat all day today, probably feels cold.

mandarin_meaning: 逃跑；溜走
english_meaning: to run away; to flee; to bail out (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，表示突然離開、逃走或溜走，常用於非正式情境，帶有潛逃或躲避責任的含義。
explanation_english: Colloquial/slang expression meaning to run away, flee, or bail out—often used informally and can imply escaping responsibility or avoiding trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到警察，佢即刻着草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 ging2 caat3, keoi5 zik1 hak1 zoek3 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到警察，他立刻逃走。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the police, he ran off immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成班人一見到問題就着草，唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 baan1 jan4 jat1 gin3 dou3 man6 tai4 zau6 zoek3 cou2, m4 fu6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一群人一遇到問題就溜走，不負責任。
examples.english_sentence: The whole group bails whenever there's a problem—it's irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司搞唔掂，老闆已經着草走咗，冇人接手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gaau2 m4 dim6, lou5 baan2 ji5 ging1 zoek3 cou2 zau2 zo2, mou5 jan4 zip3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司處理不好，老闆已經逃走了，沒人接手。
examples.english_sentence: The company couldn't handle it; the boss already took off and there's no one to take over.

mandarin_meaning: 逃走；跑路；溜走
english_meaning: to run away; to take off; to flee
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语俚语，字面是“穿上草鞋”，引申为迅速离开或逃跑。常用于形容人在遇到麻烦、危险或想脱身时匆忙离开。起源于穿草鞋赶路、匆忙离开的形象。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning "to put on straw sandals." It figuratively means to flee or take off quickly, used when someone hurriedly leaves to escape trouble or avoid responsibility. Originates from the image of putting on simple footwear and running away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到警察，佢即刻着草鞋走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 ging2 caat3, keoi5 zik1 hak1 zoek3 cou2 haai4 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到警察，他立刻跑掉了。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the police, he ran off immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生意唔好，老闆夜晚就着草鞋走人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, lou5 baan2 je6 maan5 zau6 zoek3 cou2 haai4 zau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生意不好，老板晚上就跑路了。
examples.english_sentence: Business was bad, the boss took off at night.

mandarin_meaning: 事情的下落、去向、安排或結果（口語用法）
english_meaning: The outcome, whereabouts, progress, or arrangement of something; whether something is settled or has a lead
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词（视语境而定，口语）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，表示某件事的去向、下落、安排或是否有著落、進展，常用於詢問事情是否已經落實或有進展。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to the outcome, whereabouts, arrangement, or progress of something; commonly used to ask whether something has been sorted or has any developments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事有冇着落？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 mou5 zoek3 lok6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事有没有着落？
examples.english_sentence: Has there been any progress on this matter?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵個着落，先至可以放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 go3 zoek3 lok6, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找个着落，才能放心。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a solution/place to settle this before we can relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢朋友介紹咗份工俾佢，終於有着落啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pang4 jau5 gaai3 siu6 zo2 fan6 gung1 bei2 keoi5, zung1 jyu1 jau5 zoek3 lok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他朋友给他介绍了一份工作，终于有着落了。
examples.english_sentence: His friend recommended a job to him, so he's finally got something sorted.

mandarin_meaning: 穿衣服
english_meaning: to put on clothes; to wear clothes
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語常用表達，表示穿上衣服或穿著衣物的動作或狀態。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning to put on or be wearing clothes; used to describe the action or state of dressing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲未着衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 mei6 zoek3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還沒穿衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not dressed yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前記得着件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 dak1 zoek3 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門前記得穿件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put on a piece of clothing before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友試下自己着衫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 si3 haa5 zi6 gei2 zoek3 saam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 讓小朋友試著自己穿衣服吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let the child try putting on clothes by himself.

jyutping: zoek3 hei2 lung4 pou4 m4 ci5 taai3 zi2
mandarin_meaning: 穿上龙袍却不像太子（形容外表啦哄但不配或沒有氣度、實力）
english_meaning: Dressed grandly but doesn't look or behave like a prince (all show and no substance; ostentatious but unfit or lacking bearing/ability).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻外表或裝扮很華麗，卻沒有相應的身份、氣度或實力，徒有其表。
explanation_english: An idiomatic expression describing someone who dresses or displays themselves grandly but lacks the corresponding status, bearing, or competence — all show, no substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着起龍袍唔似太子，成日裝到好威但做嘢冇實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 hei2 lung4 pou4 m4 ci5 taai3 zi2, seng4 jat6 zong1 dou3 hou2 wai1 daan6 zou6 je5 mou5 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着龙袍却不像太子，整天装得很威风但做事没有实力。
examples.english_sentence: He dresses grandly but doesn't look like a prince — always putting on a show but lacking real ability.

mandarin_meaning: （对某事物）着迷、沉迷、入迷
english_meaning: to be fascinated by / to be obsessed with; to be hooked on
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事物非常感興趣或沉溺，以至於難以自拔。
explanation_english: Indicates being extremely interested in or captivated by someone or something, often to the point of obsession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢套劇着迷咗，日日都要追劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 tou3 guk6 zoek3 mai4 zo2, jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zeoi1 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这部剧着迷了，每天都要追剧。
examples.english_sentence: He's hooked on this show; he watches it every day.

mandarin_meaning: 强调；重视
english_meaning: to emphasize; to stress; to attach importance to
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事物或某方面给予特别的注意或重视，常用于说明强调某个要点或价值。
explanation_english: To give special attention or importance to something; used to indicate that a point or aspect is being emphasized or prioritized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺報告入面好着重數據嘅準確性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 hou2 zoek3 zung6 sou3 geoi3 ge3 zeon2 kok3 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在报告里面很注重数据的准确性。
examples.english_sentence: We place great emphasis on the accuracy of the data in the report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師着重培養學生嘅實踐能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 zoek3 zung6 pui4 joeng5 hok6 saang1 ge3 sat6 zin3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师重视培养学生的实践能力。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher emphasizes developing students' practical skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着重外表，多過內在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zung6 ngoi6 biu2, do1 gwo3 noi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她重视外表多于内在。
examples.english_sentence: He/She cares more about appearance than inner qualities.

mandarin_meaning: 着陆 (zhuólù) / 降落
english_meaning: to land; (of an aircraft or vehicle) to touch down; (figuratively) to enter a place or market
explanation_mandarin: 指飛機或其他載具從空中降落到地面；也可引申為進入某地或進入市場（落地）。
explanation_english: Refers to an aircraft or other vehicle descending from the air to the ground (to land); can also be used figuratively to mean entering a place or market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班機已經着陸，請乘客唔好離開座位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 gei1 ji5 ging1 zoek3 luk6, ceng2 sing4 haak3 m4 hou2 lei4 hoi1 zo6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 航班已经着陆，请乘客不要离开座位。
examples.english_sentence: The flight has landed; passengers please do not leave your seats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機仲未着陸，請繫好安全帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zung6 mei6 zoek3 luk6, ceng2 gai3 hou2 on1 cyun4 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机还未着陆，请系好安全带。
examples.english_sentence: The plane hasn't landed yet; please fasten your seatbelt.

mandarin_meaning: 瞥一眼；斜視、看一眼
english_meaning: to glance; to take a quick look; to look sideways
explanation_mandarin: 表示迅速或匆匆地看一眼，常含斜眼或不經意的意思。屬於較文言或書面、口語中也可見的動詞。
explanation_english: Means to give a quick or sideways glance, often implying a brief, casual, or furtive look. Used both in written and spoken contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向我睄咗一眼就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 ngo5 siu3 zo2 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他朝我瞥了一眼就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He glanced at me and walked away.

mandarin_meaning: 看；观看；看病；查看
english_meaning: to look; to watch; to see; to visit (a doctor); to check
explanation_mandarin: 「睇」是粤语常用动词，基本意思为看、观看，也可用于看病（拜访医生）、查看或考虑。具体含义依语境而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "睇" is a common verb meaning to look, watch, or see. It can also mean to visit a doctor (to see a doctor), to check, or to consider depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I want to watch a movie tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下呢個有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 go3 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看这个有没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: Take a look at this to see if there are any problems.

jyutping: tai2 ... tau4 (常見用法：有睇頭 / 冇睇頭 -> tai2 tau4)
mandarin_meaning: （口語）有看頭；值得一看；有希望、有前景
english_meaning: worth watching/interesting/promising (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「睇頭」常用於粵語口語，通常與「有/冇」等詞連用（如「有睇頭」「冇睇頭」），表示某事物值得看、有趣或有發展前景。也可泛指某件事有看頭、有值得注意的地方。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression often used with particles like "有/冇" (e.g. "有睇頭", "冇睇頭"). It means something is worth seeing, interesting, or promising — that it has appeal or potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲幾有睇頭，唔好錯過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 gei2 jau5 tai2 tau4, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这出戏挺有看头，不要错过。
examples.english_sentence: This play/movie is quite worth watching — don't miss it.

mandarin_meaning: （有/沒有）前途、看頭、值得看或期待的意思
english_meaning: whether something has prospects/interest/worth seeing; a sense of hope or point
explanation_mandarin: 「睇頭」是粵語口語用語，表示某事物是否有看頭、前途或值得關注。常見用法有「有睇頭」（有希望、有可看之處）和「冇睇頭」（沒希望、沒意思）。也可用於「睇唔到頭」表示暫時看不到結果或出路。
