explanation_english: “睇頭” is a Cantonese colloquial expression indicating whether something has prospect, interest, or is worth paying attention to. Common uses include “有睇頭” (promising/interesting) and “冇睇頭” (no prospect/not worth it). It can also appear as “睇唔到頭” meaning one cannot see the outcome yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工冇乜睇頭，唔好做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 mou5 mat1 tai2 tau4, m4 hou2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作没什么前途，别做。
examples.english_sentence: This job doesn't have much prospect; don't take it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲好有睇頭，大家可以去睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 hou2 jau5 tai2 tau4, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很有看头，大家可以去看看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie looks promising; everyone can go watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事暫時睇唔到頭，先加把勁做下再睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zaam6 si4 tai2 m4 dou2 tau4, sin1 gaa1 baa2 ging6 zou6 haa5 zoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事暂时看不到头，先加把劲做一做再看。
examples.english_sentence: We can't see how this will turn out yet; let's put in more effort and see later.

mandarin_meaning: 看上眼 / 看上
english_meaning: to take a liking to; to fancy; to be impressed by (someone or something, often by appearance)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示對某人或某物在外表或某方面產生好感或喜歡，常用於日常會話。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to take a liking to someone or something (often based on appearance); used informally to say you fancy or are impressed by someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我第一眼就睇上眼佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 soeng5 ngaan5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我第一眼就看上他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I liked him/her at first sight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好睇上眼嗰間餐廳，環境太嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 tai2 soeng5 ngaan5 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1, waan4 ging2 taai3 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太看得上那家餐厅，环境太吵。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not really impressed with that restaurant; it's too noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係睇上眼嗰件衫，打算買返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 soeng5 ngaan5 go2 gin6 saam1, daa2 syun3 maai5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的看上了那件衣服，打算买下来。
examples.english_sentence: I really liked that piece of clothing and plan to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 看中 / 看上（觉得合适或喜欢并决定选择）
english_meaning: to take a fancy to; to favor; to pick out; to have one's eye on
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某物感興趣、看重或決定選擇，常用於口語。例如看中一件物品、看中一個人選。
explanation_english: Indicates being interested in or favoring someone or something, often meaning to choose or set one's sights on. Commonly used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經睇中嗰件衫，今晚去買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 zung1 go2 gin6 saam1, gam1 maan5 heoi3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經看中那件衣服，今晚去買。
examples.english_sentence: I've already taken a liking to that shirt; I'll go buy it tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有好多候選人，但老闆已經睇中佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 hau6 syun2 jan4, daan6 lou5 baan2 ji5 ging1 tai2 zung1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有很多候選人，但老板已經看中了他/她。
examples.english_sentence: There are many candidates, but the boss has already picked him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對個女同事睇中咗，但唔敢表白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 go3 neoi5 tung4 si6 tai2 zung1 zo2, daan6 m4 gam2 biu2 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看上了那位女同事，但不敢表白。
examples.english_sentence: He has his eye on the female colleague, but doesn't dare confess.

mandarin_meaning: 看不起 / 轻视 / 小看
english_meaning: to look down on; to despise; to underestimate
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事評價低，認為其不夠好、不重要或能力不足。
explanation_english: Expresses having a low opinion of someone or something — to regard them as inferior, unimportant, or to underestimate them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇低佢，佢其實好有能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 dai1 keoi5, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要看低他，他其實很有能力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on him; he's actually very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇低自己，試吓就知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 dai1 zi6 gei2, si3 haa5 zau6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看自己，試一試就知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate yourself; try and you'll see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔好咁睇低年輕人，佢哋都有新嘅想法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 hou2 gam2 tai2 dai1 nin4 hing1 jan4, keoi5 dei6 dou1 jau5 san1 ge3 soeng2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不要這樣看低年輕人，他們也有新的想法。
examples.english_sentence: The company shouldn't look down on young people; they also have new ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 看着 / 照看 / 盯住 / 关注
english_meaning: to watch; to keep an eye on; to look after; to monitor; (colloquially) wait and see
explanation_mandarin: 表示密切注视、看管或照看某人或某物；在某些语境也可表示“等着看/看我的做法”。
explanation_english: Expresses closely watching, supervising, or looking after someone/something; in some contexts can mean "wait and see" or "watch how I do it."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我睇住個小朋友，我去買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5, ngo5 heoi3 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我照看一下小朋友，我去买东西。
examples.english_sentence: Please look after the child for me, I'll go buy something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好郁，睇住我點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 juk1, tai2 zyu6 ngo5 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要动，看看我怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't move — watch how I do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇住市場變化先至決定投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 zyu6 si5 coeng4 bin3 faa3 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要关注市场变化，才决定投资。
examples.english_sentence: We need to monitor market changes before deciding to invest.

mandarin_meaning: 等着瞧（口语/威胁或示意留意）
english_meaning: Just you wait; watch and see (used as a warning) or 'keep an eye on this' (instructional)
explanation_mandarin: 「睇住嚟」是廣東話的口語用法，常用作警告或威脅，意思接近「等着瞧」。在某些語境下也可用作讓人盯緊或看管某件事的指示。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase often used as a warning/threat meaning 'just you wait' or 'watch and see'. It can also mean 'keep an eye on this' when asking someone to watch or monitor something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再遲到，我就唔客氣，睇住嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 ci4 dou3, ngo5 zau6 m4 haak3 hei3, tai2 zyu6 lei4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再迟到，我就不客气，等着瞧！
examples.english_sentence: If you're late again, I won't be nice — just you wait!

mandarin_meaning: 看形勢／看情況（視情況而定）
english_meaning: to assess the situation; to wait and see; to play it by ear
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示先觀察形勢或情況，再根據發展作決定或採取行動，類似「視情況而定」「等看看」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to observe or gauge the situation first and decide later; similar to 'wait and see' or 'play it by ear.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好急住落手，等我哋睇個勢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gap1 zyu6 lok6 sau2, dang2 ngo5 dei6 tai2 go3 sai3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別急著出手，讓我們先觀察一下情況。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush to act; let's observe the situation first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家情況太多變，要睇個勢先囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 cing4 fong3 taai3 do1 bin3, jiu3 tai2 go3 sai3 sin1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在情況變化太多，要先看看形勢。
examples.english_sentence: The situation is changing too much right now; we need to see how it develops first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好急住決定，先睇個勢，等佢哋行咗一步先再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gap1 zyu6 kyut3 ding6, sin1 tai2 go3 sai3, dang2 keoi5 dei6 haang4 zo2 jat1 bou6 sin1 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別急著做決定，先觀望一下，等他們先走一步再說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hurry to make a decision; let's wait and see — let them make a move first, then we'll talk.

mandarin_meaning: 看全貌 / 看全局 / 看大局
english_meaning: to see the whole picture; to look at the bigger picture
explanation_mandarin: 指把整體情況或全局都考慮清楚，不只看局部或眼前一點利益，常用於建議別人要有長遠或全面的觀察。
explanation_english: Means to consider the entire situation or view the big picture rather than focusing on parts or immediate gains; often used to advise someone to take a broader, more comprehensive perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要睇全相，唔好淨係睇眼前利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tai2 cyun4 soeng2, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 ngaan5 cin4 lei6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要看全局，不要只看眼前的利益。
examples.english_sentence: You should look at the whole picture; don't just focus on immediate gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做決定之前，睇全相先啦，咁先唔會出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4, tai2 cyun4 soeng2 sin1 laa1, gam2 sin1 m4 wui5 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在做決定之前先看清全貌，這樣才不會出錯。
examples.english_sentence: Before making a decision, look at the full picture first so you won't make a mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 看出；察覺
english_meaning: to be able to see/notice/figure out; to discern
explanation_mandarin: 表示能從外表、表情、言語或行為中察覺或判斷出某種情況或想法，常用作動詞或動詞短語。
explanation_english: Indicates perceiving or discerning something from appearance, expression, words, or behavior; used as a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一睇就睇出佢唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 tai2 zau6 tai2 ceot1 keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一看就看出他不高興。
examples.english_sentence: I could tell right away that he wasn't happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你由佢啲表情睇唔出佢緊張？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau4 keoi5 di1 biu2 cing4 tai2 m4 ceot1 keoi5 gan2 zoeng1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你從他的表情看不出他緊張嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can't you tell from his expression that he's nervous?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生喺X光入面睇唔出骨折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 hai2 X gwong1 jap6 min6 tai2 m4 ceot1 gwat1 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生在X光片中看不出骨折。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor couldn't see the fracture on the X-ray.

mandarin_meaning: 看得到；能看到
english_meaning: to be able to see; to see; to notice
explanation_mandarin: “睇到”是粤语的动词短语，表示能够看到或已经看到某人或某物，也可用来表示注意到或察觉到。
explanation_english: “睇到” is a Cantonese verb phrase meaning to be able to see or to have seen someone or something; it can also mean to notice or perceive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇到佢喺街度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 dou3 keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到他在街上。
examples.english_sentence: I saw him on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇到未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 dou3 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看到了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you seen it yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遠遠就睇到佢喺門口等緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jyun5 jyun5 zau6 tai2 dou3 keoi5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我远远就看到他在门口等着。
examples.english_sentence: I could see him waiting at the door from far away.

mandarin_meaning: 看呆／看得入神
english_meaning: to be mesmerized, stunned, or entranced (by what one sees)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示因為某人的外表、表現或某事物而看得入神或驚訝，類似「看呆／看傻」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to say someone is mesmerized, stunned, or entranced when looking at a person or thing—often because of attractiveness or a surprising appearance/behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢新髮型真係睇化晒我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 faat3 jing4 zan1 hai6 tai2 faa3 saai3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新髮型真的把我看呆了。
examples.english_sentence: His new hairstyle really stunned me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出場嗰一刻，所有人都睇化咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 coeng4 go2 jat1 hak1, so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 tai2 faa3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一出場，所有人都看呆了。
examples.english_sentence: When he walked on stage, everyone was stunned.

mandarin_meaning: 看不顺眼；看不惯
english_meaning: to find someone/something displeasing to look at; to dislike or disapprove of (someone/something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某事看不顺眼、感到不喜欢或反感，常用于口语或粤语表达。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese expression meaning one finds someone or something unpleasant or disagreeable to look at; used to express dislike or disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲衫太花，我真係睇唔入眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 saam1 taai3 faa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 jap6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的衣服太花，我真看不顺眼。
examples.english_sentence: His/her clothes are too flashy; I really can't stand the sight of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰個人講嘢好跩，老闆睇唔入眼，冇請佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 go2 go3 jan4 gong2 je5 hou2 ziu2, lou5 baan2 tai2 m4 jap6 ngaan5, mou5 ceng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试那个人说话很傲慢，老板看不顺眼，所以没有录用他。
examples.english_sentence: The person at the interview spoke arrogantly; the boss disliked him and didn't hire him.

mandarin_meaning: 看不出 / 看不出来
english_meaning: cannot tell / cannot make out (from appearance or evidence)
explanation_mandarin: 表示從外表、情況或有限的信息中無法判斷或分辨出某事或某人的特徵。
explanation_english: Expresses inability to tell or discern something (a fact, age, identity, etc.) from appearance or available information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣咁年輕，我真係睇唔出佢幾多歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng6 gam2 nin4 cing1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 ceot1 keoi5 gei2 do1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他長得這麼年輕，我真看不出他幾歲。
examples.english_sentence: He looks so young — I really can't tell how old he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇唔出佢係唔係香港人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 m4 ceot1 keoi5 hai6 m4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看不出他是不是香港人嗎？
examples.english_sentence: You can't tell if he's from Hong Kong, can you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話啲化驗結果正常，我睇唔出有乜問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 di1 faa3 jim6 git3 gwo2 zing3 soeng4, ngo5 tai2 m4 ceot1 jau5 mat1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說檢查結果正常，我看不出有什麼問題。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the test results are normal; I can't see any problem.

mandarin_meaning: 看不起
english_meaning: to look down on; to despise; to think little of
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話動詞短語，表示輕視或鄙視某人或某事，意為認為某人/某事不如自己、地位低或不值得尊重。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb phrase meaning to regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect; to despise or look down on. Often used transitively (A 睇唔起 B).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想畀人睇唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 tai2 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想讓別人看不起我。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want others to look down on me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日睇唔起啲工人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tai2 m4 hei2 di1 gung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常看不起工人。
examples.english_sentence: He often looks down on workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇唔起細路仔，佢哋學嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 m4 hei2 sai3 lou6 zai2, keoi5 dei6 hok6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要看不起小孩子，他們學東西很快。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on kids; they learn quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 看不下去 / 看不顺眼 / 不能容忍
english_meaning: cannot stand / cannot tolerate (to see something); be displeased with
explanation_mandarin: 粵語片語，用來表示對某人或某事感到看不下去、無法容忍，通常帶有不滿、厭惡或強烈反感的情緒，有時會暗示會去干預或糾正。
explanation_english: A Cantonese phrase meaning one cannot bear or tolerate seeing someone/something—expressing displeasure, disgust, or strong disapproval; it can imply a desire to intervene or correct the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係睇唔過眼佢咁樣對人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 gwo3 ngaan5 keoi5 gam2 joeng6 deoi3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的看不惯他这样对人。
examples.english_sentence: I really can't stand how he treats people like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，我真係睇唔過眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 gwo3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是迟到，我真看不下去。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late; I really can't put up with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到人哋欺負細路，我就睇唔過眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 hei1 fu6 sai3 lou6, ngo5 zau6 tai2 m4 gwo3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到别人欺负小孩，我就看不下去。
examples.english_sentence: When I see people bullying children, I just can't stand it.

mandarin_meaning: 看不开 / 放不下
english_meaning: unable to let go; unable to accept; can't get over (something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示无法接受某事或放不下，心里难以释怀。常用来形容对感情、怨恨或失去机会等耿耿于怀。
explanation_english: Indicates an inability to accept or let go of something; emotionally unable to move on. Often used for relationships, grievances, or missed opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢分手之後一直睇唔開，成日喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6 jat1 zik6 tai2 m4 hoi1, seng4 jat6 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他分手之後一直看不开，总是哭。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been able to get over the breakup and keeps crying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁睇唔開，生活仲有好多可能性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 tai2 m4 hoi1, saang1 wut6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ho2 nang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要這麼看不开，生活還有很多可能性。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unable to let go — life still has many possibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為畀人誤會而辭職，依家仲睇唔開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 bei2 jan4 ng6 wui6 ji4 ci4 zik1, ji1 gaa1 zung6 tai2 m4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為被人誤會而辭職，現在還放不下。
examples.english_sentence: He quit because he was misunderstood and still can't let it go.

mandarin_meaning: 覺得合適；看上；看得順眼
english_meaning: to think something or someone is suitable/appealing; to like/approve at a glance
explanation_mandarin: 「睇啱」是廣東話口語，表示看了之後覺得合適、順眼或中意。可用於物件（如衣服、款式）或人（覺得某人合適擔任某職位或作為伴侶）。
explanation_english: “睇啱” is Cantonese slang meaning to find something/someone suitable or pleasing at first sight. It’s used for objects (e.g., clothes, styles) or people (e.g., suitable for a role or personally attractive).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫我睇啱，顏色同款式都啱我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngo5 tai2 ngam1, ngaan4 sik1 tung4 fun2 sik1 dou1 ngam1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服我看上了，顏色和款式都很合我意。
examples.english_sentence: I like this piece of clothing — the color and style suit me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇啱邊個做項目經理？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 ngam1 bin1 go3 zou6 hong6 muk6 ging1 lei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你覺得誰做項目經理比較合適？
examples.english_sentence: Who do you think is suitable to be the project manager?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好睇啱佢，覺得佢做事有啲散漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 tai2 ngam1 keoi5, gok3 dak1 keoi5 zou6 si6 jau5 di1 saan3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太看得上他，覺得他做事有點散漫。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not really impressed with him; I think he's a bit lax in his work.

mandarin_meaning: 看来 / 看起來
english_meaning: it seems; apparently
explanation_mandarin: 表示根據目前情況或跡象做出的推測，相當於「看来」或「看起來」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate an inference or conclusion based on current evidence or appearance; equivalent to "it seems" or "apparently."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟佢唔會嚟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来他不会来了。
examples.english_sentence: It seems he won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟今次考試冇咁難喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 mou5 gam2 naan4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来这次考试没有那么难。
examples.english_sentence: It seems this exam isn't that difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟我哋要改變計劃喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 bin3 gai3 waak6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来我们要改变计划了。
examples.english_sentence: It looks like we'll have to change our plan.

mandarin_meaning: 看來要湊合/湊數（口語）
english_meaning: seems like (we need to) make do / fill in the numbers (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「睇嚟」表示「看起來、似乎」，「湊」常指湊合、湊數或臨時湊足人手/數目。合起來多用於口語，表示看起來需要湊合或只是用來湊數、湊合過去。
explanation_english: Combines "睇嚟" (looks like/seems) with "湊" (to make up/patch together or to fill the numbers). A colloquial phrase meaning it appears something will be patched together or is just to fill the headcount or make do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟湊唔夠人，要再搵人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 cau3 m4 gau3 jan4, jiu3 zoi3 wan2 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看來人數湊不夠，要再找人幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: Looks like we don't have enough people; we need to find more help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批貨睇嚟係湊數貨，質素唔係太好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pat1 fo3 tai2 lai4 hai6 cau3 sou3 fo3, zat1 sou3 m4 hai6 taai3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這批貨看起來是湊數貨，品質不是太好。
examples.english_sentence: This batch of goods looks like filler stock — the quality isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係嚟湊數，你真係要幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 lai4 cau3 sou3, nei5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是來湊數，你真的要幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just come to fill the headcount — you actually need to help.

mandarin_meaning: 看在...的份上（为表示对某人或某事的考虑或情分而采取宽容或优惠的态度）
english_meaning: out of consideration/for the sake of (someone or something); in view of (this), showing leniency or favor
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为对某人或某事有顾及、情分或考虑，所以采取宽容、让步或优待的态度。常用于“看在...的份上”的句式。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that an action is taken out of consideration, sentiment, or respect for someone/something, often resulting in leniency or a special favor. Commonly appears in the pattern 'in view of.../for the sake of...'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗都係睇在你幫過我嘅份上，先幫你一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 dou1 hai6 tai2 zoi6 nei5 bong1 gwo3 ngo5 ge3 fan6 soeng6, sin1 bong1 nei5 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想还是看在你帮过我的份上，才帮你这一次。
examples.english_sentence: I guess I'll help you this time for the sake of the help you've given me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司睇在佢做咗咁多年嘅份上，畀佢多個機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tai2 zoi6 keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam2 do1 nin4 ge3 fan6 soeng6, bei2 keoi5 do1 go3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司看在他做了那么多年的份上，给他多一个机会。
examples.english_sentence: The company, in view of his many years of service, gave him another chance.

mandarin_meaning: 觀課；（有時）代課／上課
english_meaning: to observe a class; (sometimes) to cover/teach a class or to attend class (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語。通常指到課堂旁聽或觀摩教學（觀課），有時也用來指代替老師上課（代課），在香港常見用法。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb. Usually means to observe or sit in on a lesson (observe a class); sometimes used to mean to cover or substitute-teach a class. Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日唔去睇堂，因為病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 heoi3 tai2 tong4, jan1 wai6 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不去上課，因為生病了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not going to class today because I'm sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校會請實習老師嚟睇堂，學習教學方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 wui5 cing2 sat6 zaap6 lou5 si1 lai4 tai2 tong4, hok6 zaap6 gaau3 hok6 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校會請實習老師來觀課，學習教學方法。
examples.english_sentence: The school will invite a student teacher to observe lessons to learn teaching methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝校長叫我幫手睇堂，代替缺席嘅老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 haau6 zoeng2 giu3 ngo5 bong1 sau2 tai2 tong4, doi6 tai3 kyut3 zik1 ge3 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上校長叫我代課，代替缺席的老師。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the principal asked me to cover a class for an absent teacher.

mandarin_meaning: 看店；看守場所；當保安／值班（口語）
english_meaning: to mind/watch a shop or venue; to be on duty looking after a place (colloquial); sometimes to work as security/bouncer
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指在店舖或場所負責看守、值班或暫時替人看店，有時也指在酒吧等地方當保安／睇場。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to look after or watch a shop/place (be on duty or cover a shift). It can also refer to working as security or a bouncer at a venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我喺舖頭度睇場，唔使驚舖頭冇人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 hai2 pou3 tau4 dou6 tai2 coeng4, m4 sai2 geng1 pou3 tau4 mou5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我在店裡看店，不用擔心店裡沒人。
examples.english_sentence: I'm minding the shop tonight, so you don't have to worry about it being unattended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢星期六喺酒吧睇場，做保安收入都幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 kei4 luk6 hai2 zau2 baa1 tai2 coeng4, zou6 bou2 on1 sau1 jap6 dou1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他星期六在酒吧當保安，收入也不錯。
examples.english_sentence: He works as security at the bar on Saturdays; the pay is fairly good.

mandarin_meaning: 值夜 / 值夜班 / 守夜
english_meaning: to do the night shift; to stay up at night to look after someone; to keep watch overnight
explanation_mandarin: 指在夜間值班、看守或照顧（例如病人或嬰兒），常用於香港粵語口語中。
explanation_english: Refers to working the night shift, staying up to keep watch, or looking after someone overnight. Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我要睇夜，唔好嚟煩我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 jiu3 tai2 je6, m4 hou2 lei4 faan4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要值夜，不要來煩我。
examples.english_sentence: I'm on the night shift tonight; don't bother me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽病咗，我成晚要幫手睇夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 beng6 zo2, ngo5 seng4 maan5 jiu3 bong1 sau2 tai2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽生病了，我整晚要幫忙值夜。
examples.english_sentence: My mother is ill; I have to help watch over her all night.

mandarin_meaning: 看好 / 看好（某人或某事）
english_meaning: to be optimistic about; to favor; to back (someone/something) as likely to succeed; (colloquially) to look after/watch over
explanation_mandarin: 「睇好」常用於粤语，表示對某人或某事持樂觀態度、看好、看好會成功或勝出。口語中亦可用作「照看、看管」的意思（視語境而定）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "睇好" commonly means to be optimistic about someone/something, to favor or expect success. Colloquially it can also mean to look after or watch over, depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇好佢，覺得佢有機會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 hou2 keoi5, gok3 dak1 keoi5 jau5 gei1 wui6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看好他，覺得他有機會贏。
examples.english_sentence: I favor him; I think he has a chance to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司內部好多人都睇好呢個新項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 tai2 hou2 ni1 go3 san1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司內部很多人都看好這個新項目。
examples.english_sentence: Many people inside the company are optimistic about this new project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前媽媽叫我幫手睇好細佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 maa4 maa1 giu3 ngo5 bong1 sau2 tai2 hou2 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門前媽媽叫我幫忙照看弟弟。
examples.english_sentence: Before going out, Mom asked me to help look after my younger brother.

mandarin_meaning: 盯着/看好；預先保留
english_meaning: to watch closely / keep an eye on; to reserve or hold something for someone; to make sure (something is taken care of)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，有兩個常見含義：1）盯住、看管、留意某件事或某樣東西；2）替人預先保留、留着某個位置或物品。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb with two common senses: 1) to watch or keep an eye on something; 2) to reserve or hold something for someone (e.g., a seat or item).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你睇定張位，等你返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 tai2 ding6 zoeng1 wai6, dang2 nei5 faan1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我幫你保留位子，等你回來。
examples.english_sentence: I'll hold the seat for you until you come back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意要睇定啲，唔好大意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3 jiu3 tai2 ding6 di1, m4 hou2 daai6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆生意要多加留意，不要大意。
examples.english_sentence: We need to keep a close eye on this deal; don't be careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你出門前要睇定啲證件，唔好冇帶護照。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceot1 mun4 cin4 jiu3 tai2 ding6 di1 zing3 gin6, m4 hou2 mou5 daai3 wu6 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你出門前要把證件看好，別忘了帶護照。
examples.english_sentence: Before you go out, make sure to check your documents; don't forget your passport.

mandarin_meaning: 看紧；盯紧；注意
english_meaning: to watch closely; to keep an eye on; to guard; to make sure
explanation_mandarin: 口语化的粤语动词，表示密切注视、盯住或看管某人或某物；有时也引申为确保或注意某事。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to watch closely, keep an eye on, guard or look after someone/something; it can also mean to make sure or pay close attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要睇實個袋，唔好畀人偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tai2 sat6 go3 doi6, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要看紧那个包，不要让人偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: You need to keep an eye on the bag; don't let anyone steal from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細會睇實你嘅工作表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 wui5 tai2 sat6 nei5 ge3 gung1 zok3 biu2 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板会盯紧你的工作表现。
examples.english_sentence: The boss will be watching your work performance closely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要睇實個細路，佢成日郁嚟郁去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tai2 sat6 go3 sai3 lou6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 juk6 lai4 juk6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要看紧小孩，他老是到处乱动。
examples.english_sentence: You need to watch the child closely; he keeps moving around.

mandarin_meaning: 小看；看不起；轻视
english_meaning: to look down on; to belittle; to underestimate
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示對某人或某事物不重視、輕視或低估。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to belittle, look down on, or underestimate someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇小佢喇，佢其實好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5 laa3, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 lak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看他／她了，他其實很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him; he's actually very capable.

mandarin_meaning: 小看；看不起；轻视；低估
english_meaning: to look down on; to belittle; to underestimate
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示對某人或某事抱有輕視、不重視或低估的態度。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to look down on, belittle, or underestimate someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇少佢，佢好有實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 jau5 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看他，他很有實力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him; he's very capable.

mandarin_meaning: 小看／看不起
english_meaning: to underestimate; to look down on
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示對某人或某事評價低於實際能力或重要性，即小看或看不起。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to underestimate or look down on someone/something, treating them as inferior or less capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇差一皮佢，佢做得比你想像中好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 caa1 jat1 pei4 keoi5, keoi5 zou6 dak1 bei2 nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他，他做得比你想像的好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him; he does better than you expect.

mandarin_meaning: 看得出
english_meaning: to be able to tell; to be able to see/notice
explanation_mandarin: 表示能從外在表現或情況看出某種狀態或情緒，常用於判斷或推測。
explanation_english: Indicates that one can infer or perceive a state or emotion from outward signs or circumstances; often used for judging or guessing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇得出佢唔開心嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看得出他不高兴吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you tell he's unhappy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 從佢個反應，我都睇得出佢好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cung4 keoi5 go3 faan2 jing3, ngo5 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从他的反应，我也看得出他很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: From his reaction, I can tell he's really scared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢冇講，但你睇得出佢已經準備好咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 mou5 gong2, daan6 nei5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他没说，但你看得出他已经准备好了。
examples.english_sentence: Although he didn't say it, you can tell he's already ready.

mandarin_meaning: 看得過去／看起來還可以／好看
english_meaning: easy on the eyes; presentable; acceptable-looking
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，表示外表或某物看起來還可以、令人覺得順眼或可接受，不一定很出色但不難看。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone or something is pleasant or acceptable to look at — not necessarily outstanding, but not unattractive; presentable or easy on the eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嚟嗰位同事睇得化，大家都幾鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lai4 go2 wai6 tung4 si6 tai2 dak1 faa3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gei2 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新來的那位同事看得過去，大家都蠻喜歡他的。
examples.english_sentence: The new colleague is easy on the eyes; everyone quite likes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫睇得化，你著落好精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 tai2 dak1 faa3, nei5 zoek3 lok6 hou2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服看起來不錯，你穿上去很有精神。
examples.english_sentence: That outfit looks good — it suits you and makes you look lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然唔係好靚仔，但睇得化，唔會嚇親人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 hou2 leng3 zai2, daan6 tai2 dak1 faa3, m4 wui5 haak3 can1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雖然不是很帥，但看起來還可以，不會嚇到別人。
examples.english_sentence: He isn't very handsome, but he's presentable — he won't frighten people.

mandarin_meaning: 看得起；重視、尊重
english_meaning: to think highly of; to respect; to hold in esteem
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事抱有尊重或高評價。常用於口語，負面形式為「唔睇得起」，表示看不起或輕視。
explanation_english: Expresses holding someone or something in high regard or esteem. Common in colloquial Cantonese. The negative form '唔睇得起' means to look down on or despise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好睇得起佢嘅才華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 tai2 dak1 hei2 keoi5 ge3 coi4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很看重他的才華。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire / think highly of his talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好勁，唔睇得起其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai6 zi6 gei2 hou2 ging6, m4 tai2 dak1 hei2 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以為自己很了不起，看不起其他人。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he's great and looks down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆好睇得起佢，畀咗升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 hou2 tai2 dak1 hei2 keoi5, bei2 zo2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆很賞識他，給了他晉升。
examples.english_sentence: The boss thinks highly of him and gave him a promotion.

mandarin_meaning: 看得開
english_meaning: to be able to let go; open-minded; not take things to heart
explanation_mandarin: 表示對不順利或失落的事情能夠釋懷、不放在心上、態度較為豁達。
explanation_english: Expresses the ability to let go of setbacks or disappointments, not dwelling on them; being broad-minded and accepting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後好快就睇得開，唔會成日諗起嗰個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 hou2 faai3 zau6 tai2 dak1 hoi1, m4 wui5 sing4 jat6 nam2 hei2 go2 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失戀後很快就看得開，不再整天想起那個人。
examples.english_sentence: He moved on quickly after the breakup and no longer thinks about that person all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到困難唔好太掛住，要學識睇得開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan4 m4 hou2 taai3 gwaa3 zyu6, jiu3 hok6 sik1 tai2 dak1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到困難不要太掛念，要學會看得開。
examples.english_sentence: When facing difficulties, don't cling too much; learn to let go.

mandarin_meaning: 恐怕 / 擔心（可能發生或不發生某事）
english_meaning: to be afraid that; to fear; (informal) to think something is likely/unlikely
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用來表示擔心或估計某事可能會或不會發生，類似普通話的「恐怕」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to express worry or a supposition that something is likely (or unlikely) to happen; similar to Mandarin "恐怕" or English "I'm afraid that / I fear that / probably."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇怕佢唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 paa3 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我恐怕他/她不會來。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid he/she won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好遲到，睇怕老闆會唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3, tai2 paa3 lou5 baan2 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別遲到，恐怕老板會不高興。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be late; I'm afraid the boss will be unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 看慣
english_meaning: to be used to seeing; accustomed to seeing; no longer surprised by seeing something
explanation_mandarin: 表示習慣於看到某事物，經常接觸後不再覺得奇怪或感到麻木。
explanation_english: Indicates being accustomed to seeing something; after repeated exposure one is no longer surprised or sensitive to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經睇慣佢哋爭吵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 gwaan3 keoi5 dei6 zang1 caau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經看慣他們吵架。
examples.english_sentence: I'm already used to seeing them argue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲廣告我睇慣晒，已經唔會理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gwong2 gou3 ngo5 tai2 gwaan3 saai3, ji5 ging1 m4 wui5 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些廣告我看慣了，已經不會理會它們。
examples.english_sentence: I'm used to these ads; I don't pay attention to them anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你會唔會對呢啲暴力場面睇慣咗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 deoi3 ni1 di1 bou6 lik6 coeng4 min6 tai2 gwaan3 zo2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你會不會對這些暴力場面看慣了？
examples.english_sentence: Have you become desensitized to these violent scenes?

mandarin_meaning: 看電影/看戲
english_meaning: to watch a movie or a play; to go to the cinema
explanation_mandarin: 粵語的口語說法，表示觀看電影或戲劇，通常指去戲院看電影，也可泛指看表演或戲劇。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to watch a movie or a play—usually referring to going to the cinema, but can also mean watching a performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去睇戲，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去看电影，好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go watch a movie tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我依家喺戲院等緊，電影快開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji1 gaa1 hai2 hei3 jyun6 dang2 gan2, din6 jing2 faai3 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在在电影院等，电影快开始。
examples.english_sentence: I'm at the cinema waiting; the movie is about to start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套新戲好多人去睇，票都賣晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 san1 hei3 hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 tai2, piu3 dou1 maai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部新片很多人去看，票都卖光了。
examples.english_sentence: That new movie has a lot of viewers; the tickets are sold out.

mandarin_meaning: 色眯眯地看、盯著看（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to ogle; to stare at someone lustfully (informal/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「睇扒」是香港粵語口語或俚語，表示用帶有性暗示或不禮貌的目光盯著別人看、色眯眯地看。常帶貶義或不禮貌的語氣。
explanation_english: “睇扒” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang meaning to ogle or stare at someone in a lecherous or impolite way. It is informal and often carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺街度咁樣睇扒人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 gaai1 dou6 gam2 joeng6 tai2 paa4 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在街上那樣色眯眯地看人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ogle people like that on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧度睇扒其他女仔，真係好無禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 zau2 baa1 dou6 tai2 paa4 kei4 taa1 neoi5 zai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou4 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在酒吧那裡盯著其他女孩看，真的很沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps ogling other girls at the bar — really rude.

mandarin_meaning: 看手相 / 看掌
english_meaning: to read someone's palm; palmistry
explanation_mandarin: 指觀察手掌的紋路、形狀等來占卜吉凶、推測運勢或性格等。
explanation_english: To examine the lines and features of a person's palm to predict fortune, luck, or aspects of their character (palmistry).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日去搵人睇掌，話想知下自己嘅運程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 heoi3 wan2 jan4 tai2 zoeng2, waa6 soeng2 zi1 haa5 zi6 gei2 ge3 wan6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈经常去找人看手相，说想知道自己的运程。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often goes to have her palm read; she says she wants to know her fortune.

mandarin_meaning: 核对数目；对账、清算账目
english_meaning: to check/verify numbers; to reconcile or settle accounts
explanation_mandarin: “睇數”在粤语中常用作动词，表示檢查或核對數目，對帳或結算帳目，用於核對收支、確認數字是否正確或清算債務。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '睇數' is a verb meaning to check or verify numbers — to reconcile accounts or settle figures. It's commonly used when checking finances, tallies, or bookkeeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇數，計清今個月嘅收入同支出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2-sou3, gai3 cing1 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 sau1 jap6 tung4 zi1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要对账，算清这个月的收入和支出。
examples.english_sentence: We need to check the accounts and figure out this month's income and expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我去幫手睇數，確認數目無錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 heoi3 bong1 sau2 tai2-sou3, kok3 jing6 sou3 muk6 mou4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我去帮忙对账，确认数字没错。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked me to help check the accounts to make sure the figures are correct.

mandarin_meaning: 值夜；當夜更（在夜間看守或巡邏）
english_meaning: to do the night watch; to work as a night watchman or guard at night
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，指夜間看守、巡邏或當更的工作。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to perform night-watch duties—guarding or patrolling at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我要去公司睇更，唔好煩我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 gung1 si1 tai2 gang1, m4 hou2 faan4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要去公司值夜，別打擾我。
examples.english_sentence: I have to do the night watch at the office tonight, don't bother me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前村入面有個阿伯專職睇更，保護村民夜晚安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 cyun1 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 aa3 baak3 zyun1 zik1 tai2 gang1, bou2 wu6 cyun1 man4 je6 maan5 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前村裡有位伯伯專職當更，保護村民夜間安全。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be an old man in the village who worked as a night watchman, protecting villagers' safety at night.

mandarin_meaning: 看書；讀書
english_meaning: to read a book; to study
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中表示閱讀書本或用功學習，常用於口語。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, means to read books or study; commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要喺圖書館睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要在图书馆看书。
examples.english_sentence: I need to read/study at the library today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試快到，我日日都要睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 faai3 dou3, ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试快到了，我每天都要看书。
examples.english_sentence: Exams are coming; I have to study every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬成日唔肯睇書，成績愈嚟愈差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 seng4 jat6 m4 hang2 tai2 syu1, sing4 zik1 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟總是不願意看書，成績越來越差。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother never wants to study; his grades are getting worse and worse.

mandarin_meaning: 看房／看樓（參觀房屋或單位以考慮購買或租賃）
english_meaning: to view properties (to visit flats/houses/units for sale or rent)
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話常用詞，指到房屋或單位實地參觀，通常是為了購買或租賃作出考察。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term commonly used in Hong Kong meaning to visit and inspect a property or unit, usually when considering buying or renting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要去睇樓，諗住搵間近地鐵嘅兩房單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 lau4, lam2 zyu6 wan2 gaan1 gan6 dei6 tit3 ge3 loeng5 fong2 daan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要去看房，打算找一間靠近地鐵的兩房單位。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to view properties tonight; planning to find a two-bedroom unit near the MTR.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上星期已經去睇咗好幾間樓，仲未決定買唔買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 sing1 kei4 ji5 ging1 heoi3 tai2 zo2 hou2 gei2 gaan1 lau4, zung6 mei6 kyut3 ding6 maai5 m4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上星期已經看了好幾處房子，還沒決定要不要買。
examples.english_sentence: He already viewed several properties last week and still hasn't decided whether to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想租屋，可以約地產代理帶你去睇樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 zou1 uk1, ho2 ji5 joek3 dei6 caan2 doi6 lei5 daai3 nei5 heoi3 tai2 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想租房，可以約房地產中介帶你去看房。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to rent, you can arrange for an agent to show you properties.

mandarin_meaning: 看店；看攤（代人看守、頂班）
english_meaning: to mind the shop/stall; to cover someone's shift or look after a stall
explanation_mandarin: 「睇檔」是香港廣東話口語，指在店舖或街市檔口幫忙看守、代人看店或頂班，通常是暫時性或輪班性的工作。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "睇檔" is a colloquial verb meaning to look after or mind a shop/stall—often to cover someone’s shift or temporarily manage a stall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我聽日去街市幫佢睇檔半日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 bong1 keoi5 tai2 dong3 bun3 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽叫我明天去街市幫她看攤半天。
examples.english_sentence: Mom asked me to go to the market tomorrow to mind her stall for half a day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日唔使返工，我會幫你睇檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1, ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5 tai2 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天不用上班，我會幫你看店。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to work today; I'll cover/mind the stall for you.

mandarin_meaning: 看衰／看扁；认为某人或某事没有希望、注定失败（粤语口语）
english_meaning: to write someone/something off; to regard as doomed or hopeless (Cantonese colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「睇死」是廣東話口語，字面為「看作已死」，引申為看衰、看扁或放棄某人或某事，認為沒有希望或必敗；有時帶有幸災樂禍或冷漠不幫助的意味，常見用法如「睇死佢」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "look as dead." Figuratively it means to write someone or something off, to expect them to fail or be hopeless. It can carry tones of schadenfreude or refusal to help. Commonly used as "tai2 sei2 keoi5" (write him off).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快就睇死佢啦，佢其實仲有機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 faai3 zau6 tai2 sei2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 kei4 sat1 zung6 jau5 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么快就看扁他，他其實還有機會。
examples.english_sentence: Don't write him off so quickly; he actually still has a chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係睇死其他人，冇人想幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 tai2 sei2 kei4 taa1 jan4, mou5 jan4 soeng2 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是看不起別人，所以沒有人想幫他。
examples.english_sentence: He always writes people off, so nobody wants to help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都睇死佢，但佢最後贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai2 sei2 keoi5, daan6 keoi5 zeoi6 hau6 jing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都看扁他，但他最後贏了。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone wrote him off, but he eventually won.

mandarin_meaning: 觀望；試探情況
english_meaning: to wait and see; to test the waters
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，字面為「看水」，引申為暫時觀望或試探情況，以便決定下一步行動。有時也與「試水溫」同義。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase literally 'look at the water.' It means to wait and see or to test the waters — observe how a situation develops before taking action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市咁波動，我哋宜家唯有睇水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 gam2 bo1 dung6, ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 wai4 jau5 tai2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市這麼波動，我們現在只能觀望。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market is so volatile; for now we can only wait and see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家先睇水，唔想即刻做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 sin1 tai2 seoi2, m4 soeng2 zik1 hak1 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在只是觀望，不想立刻做決定。
examples.english_sentence: He's just waiting and seeing for now; he doesn't want to make an immediate decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以先試下，睇吓水先，唔使急住投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 sin1 si3 haa5, tai2 haa5 seoi2 sin1, m4 sai2 gap1 zyu6 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們可以先試探一下，看看情況，沒必要急著投資。
examples.english_sentence: We can test the waters first and see the situation; there's no need to rush into investing.

mandarin_meaning: 看法
english_meaning: view; opinion; way of looking at something
explanation_mandarin: 指對某件事或問題的看法或意見，表示個人如何理解、評價或處理該事。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's opinion or way of viewing something; indicates how someone perceives, evaluates, or approaches an issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對呢件事嘅睇法係點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 hai6 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你對這件事的看法是什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What's your opinion on this matter?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅睇法好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 tai2 faat3 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的看法很不一樣。
examples.english_sentence: Their views are very different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完專家嘅講解，我改變咗對呢個問題嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jyun4 zyun1 gaa1 ge3 gong2 gaai2, ngo5 goi2 bin3 zo2 deoi3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽完專家的講解後，我改變了對這個問題的看法。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to the expert's explanation, I changed my view on this issue.

mandarin_meaning: 看球（尤指看足球或其他球類比賽）
english_meaning: to watch (a) football/soccer match; to watch a ball game or sports match
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，通常指觀看足球或其他球類比賽，可以是在現場、酒吧或電視前觀看，亦可泛指看體育賽事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to watch football (soccer) or other ball/sports matches, either live, at a bar, or on TV. It is commonly used in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚一齊去旺角睇波啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 Wong6 gok3 tai2 bo1 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚一起去旺角看球嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to Mong Kok to watch the match tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同我講星期日要去酒吧睇波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tung4 ngo5 gong2 sing1 kei4 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 zau2 baa1 tai2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常跟我說星期日要去酒吧看球。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he'll go to the pub to watch the game on Sundays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽好緊張，大家都喺電視機前睇波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 din6 si6 gei1 cin4 tai2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場比賽很緊張，大家都在電視機前看球。
examples.english_sentence: This match is intense; everyone is watching it in front of the TV.

mandarin_meaning: 看淡；不太在意
english_meaning: to take (something) lightly; not attach much importance to
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事不放在心上、看得比較淡、不過分執著或擔心。
explanation_english: Indicates not caring much about something, viewing it as less important, or not becoming overly attached or worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對啲批評睇淡，繼續做自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 di1 pai1 ping4 tai2 daam6, gai3 zuk6 zou6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對那些批評看得很淡，繼續做自己。
examples.english_sentence: He takes the criticism lightly and keeps being himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你學識睇淡失敗，生活會輕鬆啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hok6 sik1 tai2 daam6 sat1 baai6, sang1 wut6 wui5 hing1 sung1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你学会看淡失败，生活會轻松一些。
examples.english_sentence: If you learn to take failures lightly, life will be a bit easier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對金錢睇淡，唔太貪心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gam1 cin2 tai2 daam6, m4 taai3 taam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對金錢看得比較淡，不太貪心。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't care much about money; he's not very greedy.

mandarin_meaning: 看準就動手 / 看準機會就行動
english_meaning: Seize the opportunity; take action decisively once you're sure (literally 'once you've aimed, pick up the chopsticks')
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，字面是「看準就拿起筷子」，引申為一旦看準時機或把握到機會就立即行動。可指實際開動吃飯，也常用作比喻，表示果斷出手或把握良機，有時帶有機敏或投機的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase literally meaning 'once you've taken aim, pick up the chopsticks.' It means to act immediately when the right moment or opportunity appears. It can be used literally (to start eating) or figuratively to indicate decisive action or seizing a chance; sometimes carries a sense of opportunism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋睇準起筷，趁機推出新產品，結果好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tai2 zeon2 hei2 faai3, can3 gei1 teoi1 ceot1 san1 caan2 ban2, git3 gwo2 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們看準時機，趁機推出新產品，結果很受歡迎。
examples.english_sentence: We seized the right moment and launched the new product, which turned out to be very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飯一上枱，大家就睇準起筷，無人客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan6 jat1 soeng5 toi2, daai6 gaa1 zau6 tai2 zeon2 hei2 faai3, mou4 jan4 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飯一上桌，大家就看準起筷，沒人客氣。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the food was put on the table, everyone immediately dug in; no one held back.

mandarin_meaning: 看漏、沒看見、忽略
english_meaning: to miss seeing something; to overlook; to fail to notice
explanation_mandarin: 「睇漏」是廣東話的口語用法，表示未看到、看漏或忽略了某事或某細節。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to miss seeing something or to overlook/neglect to notice something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇漏咗條訊息，遲咗回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 lau6 zo2 tiu4 seon3 sik1, ci4 zo2 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看漏了那條訊息，所以回覆晚了。
examples.english_sentence: I missed that message, so I replied late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裁判睇漏咗佢哋犯規，球隊好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi4 pun3 tai2 lau6 zo2 keoi5 dei6 faan6 gwai1, kau4 deoi6 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裁判沒看到他們犯規，球隊很生氣。
examples.english_sentence: The referee missed their foul, and the team is very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再睇漏任何細節，搵多個人幫手檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 tai2 lau6 jam6 ho4 sai3 zit3, wan2 do1 go3 jan4 bong1 sau2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再看漏任何細節，找多人幫忙檢查。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to miss any more details; I'll get more people to help check.

mandarin_meaning: 看走眼；漏看；没看清楚
english_meaning: to miss seeing something; to overlook; to make a mistaken judgment
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有看到或注意到某事物，或对人/事物的判断错误（看走眼、漏看）。常用来形容自己或别人没察觉到重要细节或看错了人。
explanation_english: Indicates failing to notice or see something, or making an incorrect judgment about someone or something. Often used to admit or criticize having overlooked an important detail or misjudged someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係睇漏眼，竟然唔記得佢係我大學同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 lau6 ngaan5, ging2 jin4 m4 gei3 dak1 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 daai6 hok6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真是看走眼，竟然忘记他是我大学同学。
examples.english_sentence: I really missed that — I actually forgot he was my college classmate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆睇漏眼，俾咗加薪畀個唔叻嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 tai2 lau6 ngaan5, bei2 zo2 gaa1 san1 bei2 go3 m4 lek1 ge3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板看走眼，把加薪给了一个不称职的员工。
examples.english_sentence: The boss made a poor judgment and gave a raise to an incompetent employee.

mandarin_meaning: 看热闹；（字面）看着火炉/看火
english_meaning: to watch a commotion; be a bystander; (literal) to tend/watch the fire or stove
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法上常指旁觀、看熱鬧、不參與或不出手干預的行為；字面上也可指看著火爐／看火以防失火或烹煮時照看火候。
explanation_english: Colloquially it often means to stand by and watch a commotion or incident (to gawk, be a bystander); literally it can mean to tend or watch the fire/stove (e.g., when cooking or guarding against fire).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日淨係去睇火，幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 heoi3 tai2 fo2, bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是去看热闹，帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always just watch the commotion — help out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲路人淨係嚟睇火，冇人肯出手救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lou6 jan4 zing6 hai6 lai4 tai2 fo2, mou5 jan4 hang2 ceot1 sau2 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路人只是来看热闹，没有人肯出手救人。
examples.english_sentence: Bystanders only came to gawk; nobody is willing to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煮嘢食嗰陣要有人睇火，咪亂離開廚房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 je5 sik6 go2 zan6 jiu3 jan4 tai2 fo2, mai6 lyun6 lei4 hoi1 ceoi4 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煮东西的时候要有人看着火，不要随便离开厨房。
examples.english_sentence: When cooking someone needs to watch the stove — don't leave the kitchen carelessly.

mandarin_meaning: 看不起；瞧不起
english_meaning: to look down on; to disdain or snub someone
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，表示輕視或看不起某人，常用於「畀人睇爬」（被人看不起）等表達中，語氣偏口語和帶有貶義。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang meaning to treat someone with contempt or look down on them. Common in colloquial speech and often appears in phrases like "畀人睇爬" (to be looked down on).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀人睇爬你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 tai2 paa4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別讓別人看不起你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let others look down on you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擺架，對人態度好差，成日睇爬人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baai2 gaa3, deoi3 jan4 taai3 dou6 hou2 caa1, seng4 jat6 tai2 paa4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是擺架子，對人態度很差，總是看不起人。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on airs, treats people poorly, and constantly looks down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意畀人咁樣睇爬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 bei2 jan4 gam2 joeng6 tai2 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜歡被人這樣看不起。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like being looked down on like that.

mandarin_meaning: 看牛 / 照料牛隻
english_meaning: to look after or inspect cattle; to tend cows
explanation_mandarin: 指在農牧或鄉村語境中看顧、放牧或觀察牛隻（如餵食、檢查健康或巡視牛群）。在日常口語中多用於描述照料牛隻的工作或行為。
explanation_english: Refers to looking after, tending, or inspecting cattle in a farming or rural context (e.g., feeding, checking health, or herding). Commonly used to describe the tasks of caring for cows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸每日去山上睇牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 mui5 jat6 heoi3 saan1 soeng5 tai2 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸每天到山上看牛。
examples.english_sentence: Dad goes up the hill every day to tend the cows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放牛唔係咁易，要識得點樣照顧牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 ngau4 m4 hai6 gam2 ji6, jiu3 sik1 dak1 dim2 joeng6 ziu3 gu3 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放牛不是那麼容易，要懂得如何照顧牛。
examples.english_sentence: Tending cattle isn't that easy; you need to know how to take care of them.

mandarin_meaning: 观望；看情况（有时含有衡量利弊或看看有没有利可图的意味）
english_meaning: to wait and see; to observe the situation before acting (sometimes implies checking for potential benefit/profit)
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，表示先觀察局勢或等候時機再作決定，有時特別指評估是否有利可圖才採取行動。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to observe the situation or wait for the right moment before taking action; sometimes specifically refers to assessing whether something is profitable before acting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家市道唔穩，我哋先睇田水，唔好急住做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 si5 dou6 m4 wan2, ngo5 dei6 sin1 tai2 tin4 seoi2, m4 hou2 gap1 zyu6 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在市场不稳，我们先观望一下，不要急着做决定。
examples.english_sentence: The market is unstable right now; we'll wait and see and not rush into a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 看病
english_meaning: to see a doctor; to go to the doctor; to seek medical treatment
explanation_mandarin: 表示去看医生或向医疗人员就诊，寻求治疗或诊断。
explanation_english: To visit a doctor or consult medical personnel for diagnosis or treatment when ill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要去睇病，唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 beng6, m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要去看病，不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to see the doctor tonight; I don't feel well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去睇病嗰陣，醫生話佢唔需要打針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 tai2 beng6 go2 zan6, ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 m4 seoi1 jiu3 daa2 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去看病的时候，医生说他不需要打针。
examples.english_sentence: When he went to see the doctor, the doctor said he didn't need an injection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友有發燒就要快啲去睇病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 faat3 siu1 zau6 jiu3 faai3 di1 heoi3 tai2 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友发烧就要尽快去看病。
examples.english_sentence: If a child has a fever, you should take them to see a doctor quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 看病；看医生
english_meaning: to see a doctor; to consult a doctor; to seek medical treatment
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语用法，字面為「看（病）症狀」，實際意思是去看病或找醫生診治。常用於香港日常對話，既可指去普通科或專科，也可指急症就診。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'look at symptoms' but used to mean 'to see a doctor' or 'to seek medical care'. Commonly used in Hong Kong for visiting clinics, specialists, or emergency services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔舒服，聽日要去睇症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6, ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不舒服，明天要去看病。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not feeling well; I need to see a doctor tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日頭痛，已經去過好多次睇症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tau4 tung4, ji5 ging1 heoi3 gwo3 hou2 do1 ci3 tai2 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常头痛，已经去看过很多次病了。
examples.english_sentence: He often has headaches and has seen doctors many times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想去公立醫院定係去私家醫生睇症？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 heoi3 gung1 lap6 ji1 jyun2 ding6 hai6 heoi3 si1 gaa1 ji1 sang1 tai2 zing3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想去公立医院还是去私家医生看病？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to see a doctor at a public hospital or a private physician?

mandarin_meaning: 看不起 / 輕視
english_meaning: to look down on; to treat with contempt; give a disdainful or cold look
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語或俚語，表示對人不尊重或輕視，常用於以輕蔑、冷淡的目光或態度看待別人（相當於「白眼」、「看不起」）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to look down on someone or show contempt—often by giving a disdainful or cold look, similar to 'giving someone the cold shoulder' or 'looking down on someone.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁睇白佢，佢都係盡力做喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 tai2 baak6 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 hai6 zeon6 lik6 zou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那樣看不起他，他也在盡力做了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on him like that; he's doing his best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲同事成日睇白佢，搞到佢好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tung4 si6 sing4 jat6 tai2 baak6 keoi5, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的同事總是看不起他，弄得他很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: His colleagues always look down on him, which makes him very unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 看相；算命（粤语中也可指看照片）
english_meaning: To have one's fortune told / to read someone's face for fortune-telling; colloquially also 'to look at photos'
explanation_mandarin: “睇相”在粤语里主要指找算命师或相士通过看面相、手相等来推算命运或运势；在口语中，也可以指“看照片”。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '睇相' primarily means to visit a fortune-teller or physiognomist to have one's fortune read by examining the face, palm, etc. Colloquially it can also mean 'to look at photos'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我打算去搵一個算命師睇相，睇下新一年嘅運勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 wan2 jat1 go3 syun3 ming6 si1 tai2 soeng2, tai2 haa5 san1 jat6 nin4 ge3 wan6 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我打算去找一個算命師看相，看看新一年的運勢。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to see a fortune-teller tomorrow to have my fortune read and check my luck for the coming year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啱啱影嗰啲相，我哋等陣可以一齊睇相嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 aam1 aam1 jing2 go2 di1 soeng2, ngo5 dei6 dang2 zan6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 tai2 soeng2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你剛剛拍的那些照片，我們等一下可以一起看照片嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can we look at the photos you just took in a bit?

jyutping: tai2 soeng2 lou2 ngok6 nei5 sap6 nin4 baat3 nin4
mandarin_meaning: 算命的（或看相的人）騙你很多年／一再欺騙你
english_meaning: The fortune-teller has been ripping you off for years; (used to warn that fortune-tellers or similar scammers have been deceiving you repeatedly)
explanation_mandarin: 「睇相佬呃你十年八年」是粵語俗語用法，字面上指算命師或看相的人長期欺騙你，常用來提醒別人不要輕信算命、神棍或類似騙子。
explanation_english: This Cantonese colloquial phrase literally says "fortune-tellers have cheated you for ten, eight years" and is used to mean that fortune-tellers (or similar charlatans) have been conning someone for a long time; often used to warn people not to trust such scammers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話睇相佬呃你十年八年，你仲去搵佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 tai2 soeng2 lou2 ngok6 nei5 sap6 nin4 baat3 nin4, nei5 zung6 heoi3 wan2 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說算命的騙你很多年，你還去找他？
examples.english_sentence: People say the fortune-tellers have been ripping you off for years — you're still going to see him?

mandarin_meaning: 看认真一点 / 仔细看看
english_meaning: look more closely; pay closer attention; be more serious
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，通常用作提醒或命令，叫對方更仔細地看或更認真對待某事。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to tell someone to look more carefully or to take something more seriously; often used as a prompt or admonition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇眞啲，呢份報告有好多錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 zan1 di1, ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 hou2 do1 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看认真一点，这份报告有很多错误。
examples.english_sentence: Look more closely — this report has a lot of mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 看清／仔細看；當真、重視
english_meaning: look closely; take seriously; pay attention
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，意思是仔細看或對某事當真、重視。常與「啲」連用（如「睇真啲」表示更仔細看），或用於否定句（如「唔好睇真」表示不要當真）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to look carefully or to take something seriously. Often used as '睇真啲' (look more closely) or in negation '唔好睇真' (don't take it seriously).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇真啲！個價錢係二百蚊唔係二十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 zan1 di1! go3 gaa3 cin2 hai6 ji6 baak3 man1 m4 hai6 ji6 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你仔細看！這個價格是兩百塊不是二十塊。
examples.english_sentence: Look closely! The price is $200, not $20.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係講笑，唔好太睇真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gong2 siu3, m4 hou2 taai3 tai2 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是開玩笑，不要太當真。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just joking—don't take it too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要睇真啲X光片先可以診斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 tai2 zan1 di1 X gwong1 pin2 sin1 ho2 ji5 zan2 dyun6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說要仔細看X光片才能診斷。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs to examine the X-ray closely before making a diagnosis.

mandarin_meaning: 看仔细一点 / 看清楚一点
english_meaning: look more closely; take a closer look; pay closer attention
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，用来提醒別人仔細看或更注意某件事或細節。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to tell someone to look more carefully or pay closer attention to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再睇真啲，呢度有個錯字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 tai2 zan1 di1, ni1 dou6 jau5 go3 co3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再看仔细点，这里有一个错字。
examples.english_sentence: Look again more carefully; there's a typo here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買衫要睇真啲，呢件有污漬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 saam1 jiu3 tai2 zan1 di1, ni1 gin6 jau5 wu1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买衣服要看清楚点，这件有污渍。
examples.english_sentence: When buying clothes, look more closely — this one has a stain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要你睇真啲份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 nei5 tai2 zan1 di1 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要你仔细看那份报告。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you should look at that report more carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 看電影／看影碟
english_meaning: to watch a movie/video (literally 'watch a disc'); can refer to watching DVDs or films
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示去看電影或在家看 DVD / 影碟。視語境，有時亦可特指觀看成人影片。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to watch a movie or video (literally 'to look at a disc'). It can mean going to the cinema or watching DVDs/videos at home. In some contexts it may specifically refer to watching pornographic films.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜六我哋一齊去睇碟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 luk6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 dip6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期六我們一起去看電影吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go watch a movie together on Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話喺屋企夜晚自己睇咗碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hai2 uk1 kei2 je6 maan5 zi6 gei2 tai2 zo2 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說在家裡晚上自己看了碟（看了電影／影片）。
examples.english_sentence: He said he watched a movie/video by himself at home last night.

mandarin_meaning: 看穿；看透（某人的伪装或企图）
english_meaning: to see through (someone's lies, pretence, or motives); to perceive the truth
explanation_mandarin: 表示看透別人的假裝、把戲或真正意圖，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Expresses perceiving someone's true intentions or seeing past their pretence; commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經睇穿佢嘅把戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 cyun1 keoi5 ge3 baa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經看穿他的把戲。
examples.english_sentence: I've already seen through his tricks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講啲理由我一啲都唔信，我全部都睇穿晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 di1 lei5 jau4 ngo5 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 seon3, ngo5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 tai2 cyun1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那些理由我一點也不信，我全都看穿了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't believe any of those reasons you gave — I've seen right through all of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇穿佢嗰啲藉口，佢根本唔想幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 cyun1 keoi5 go2 di1 ze3 hau2, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 soeng2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看穿了他的那些藉口，他根本不想幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: I see through his excuses — he simply doesn't want to help.

mandarin_meaning: 怕老婆；听老婆的话；受妻子支配
english_meaning: to be henpecked; to be dominated or bossed around by one's wife; to obey one's wife
explanation_mandarin: 口语，形容一个男人受妻子支配或很听妻子的话，相当于“怕老婆”或“被老婆管”。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase describing a man who is dominated by, or obedient to, his wife — i.e., 'henpecked'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好睇老婆，出街買嘢都要問老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tai2 lou5 po4, ceot1 gaai1 maai5 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 lou5 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很怕老婆，出门买东西都要问老婆。
examples.english_sentence: He's henpecked — he even asks his wife before going out to buy things.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）看熱鬧；色眯眯地看別人的身體/衣著
english_meaning: slang for ogling (looking at someone's body) or more generally gawking at a spectacle
explanation_mandarin: 「睇肉」是香港廣東話的俚語，字面為「看肉」，常用來形容：1）帶有色眼光地看別人的身體或外表（盯人看）；2）引申為看熱鬧、旁觀別人的事情以取樂。屬於口語化用法，視語境可偏向調侃或貶義。
explanation_english: "Tai juk" (睇肉) is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression literally meaning "look at meat." It commonly refers to: 1) ogling someone (looking at their body or appearance with sexual/admiring intent); 2) more broadly, gawking at a spectacle or watching for amusement. It is informal and context-dependent (can be teasing or pejorative).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係喺度睇肉，幫下手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 tai2 juk6, bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別只是站在那裡看熱鬧，幫忙一下吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand there gawking—help out a bit!

mandarin_meaning: 把脈；看脈（中醫辨證用）；引申為觀察或判斷某人或某事的情況
english_meaning: to take/check someone's pulse (in TCM); figuratively, to size someone up or assess a situation
explanation_mandarin: 「睇脈」原指中醫師用手診察病人的脈象以診斷病情。引申用法可指觀察、判斷某人或某事的狀況或實力（例如先觀察對方反應或態度以決定下一步行動）。
explanation_english: Literally, 'to take/check the pulse'—used in traditional Chinese medicine to diagnose a patient. Figuratively, it means to observe or assess someone/something (for example, sizing someone up or gauging a situation before acting).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽去中醫舖畀醫生睇脈，醫生話要食藥同休息幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 heoi3 zung1 ji1 pou3 bei2 ji1 sang1 tai2 mak6, ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 sik6 joek6 tung4 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽去中醫診所讓醫生把脈，醫生說要吃藥並休息幾天。
examples.english_sentence: My mother went to the TCM clinic to have the doctor take her pulse; the doctor said she needs to take medicine and rest for a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣，老闆會先睇吓你嘅脈，睇下你啱唔啱件工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 go2 zan6, lou5 baan2 wui5 sin1 tai2 haa5 nei5 ge3 mak6, tai2 haa5 nei5 aam1 m4 aam1 gin6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試時，老闆會先觀察一下你的情況（'看脈'），看看你是否適合這份工作。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview, the boss will first size you up to see whether you're suitable for the job.

mandarin_meaning: 看起来；看上去
english_meaning: to look; to seem; to appear
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示從外觀或第一印象判斷某事或某人給人的感覺或樣子，相當於「看起來／看上去」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate how something appears or seems based on appearance or first impression. Equivalent to 'look', 'seem', or 'appear'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇落今日天氣會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lok6 gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看起来今天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: It looks like it will rain today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇落好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 lok6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来很開心。
examples.english_sentence: He looks very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰道菜睇落好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 coi3 tai2 lok6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那道菜看起来很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: That dish looks delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 看不起；對某事／某人持悲觀、看衰的態度
english_meaning: to look down on; to think poorly of someone; to be pessimistic about something or expect it to fail
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語表達。可以指看不起、瞧不起某人；也可以指對事情持悲觀看法，認為會失敗或結果不好。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb. It can mean to look down on or despise someone, or to be pessimistic about something—i.e., to write something off or expect it to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁睇衰佢，佢其實好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 tai2 seoi1 keoi5, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這樣看不起他，他其實很努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on him like that; he's actually working hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想咁快就睇衰呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gam2 faai3 zau6 tai2 seoi1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想這麼快就看衰這個計劃。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be so quick to write off this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日睇衰自己，結果失去咗好多機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tai2 seoi1 zi6 gei2, git3 gwo2 sat1 heoi3 zo2 hou2 do1 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是看不起自己，結果失去了很多機會。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts himself down and as a result missed many opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 看见/看到
english_meaning: to see; to catch sight of
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过视线看到某人或某物，常用于粤语口语，相当于普通话的“看见/看到”。
explanation_english: Indicates perceiving someone or something with one's eyes; commonly used in spoken Cantonese. Equivalent to Mandarin '看见/看到' and English 'see'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺街市睇見佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 gaai1 si5 tai2 gin3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚在街市看见他/她。
examples.english_sentence: I just saw him/her at the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇睇見我把鎖匙放喺邊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 gin3 ngo5 baa2 so2 si4 fong3 hai2 bin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有看见我把钥匙放在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Did you see where I put my keys?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺樓下睇見有隻貓，佢好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 lau4 haa6 tai2 gin3 jau5 zek3 maau1, keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在楼下看到有只猫，它很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a cat downstairs; it was very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 看得起；看重；尊重
english_meaning: to look up to; to esteem; to hold in high regard
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事懷有好感或尊重，認為對方值得重視或欽佩。
explanation_english: Expresses holding someone or something in esteem; to think highly of or respect someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好睇起佢，佢做事好負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 tai2 hei2 keoi5, keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很看得起他，他做事很負責。
examples.english_sentence: I think highly of him; he is very responsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢冇讀好書，但我好睇起佢嘅誠懇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 mou5 duk6 hou2 syu1, daan6 ngo5 hou2 tai2 hei2 keoi5 ge3 sing4 han2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他沒讀好書，但我很看重他的誠懇。
examples.english_sentence: Although he didn't study much, I admire his sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆好睇起張員工，成日俾機會佢做重要項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 hou2 tai2 hei2 zoeng1 jyun4 gung1, sing4 jat6 bei2 gei1 wui6 keoi5 zou6 zung6 jiu3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆很看重那名員工，常常給他機會做重要項目。
examples.english_sentence: The boss holds that employee in high regard and often gives him chances for important projects.

mandarin_meaning: 看起來；顯得
english_meaning: to look; to seem; to appear
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某人或某事在外觀或情況上給人的印象，相當於「看起來」、「顯得」。通常用於描述外表、狀態或整體感覺。
explanation_english: Used to indicate the impression someone or something gives based on appearance or situation; equivalent to 'looks' or 'seems'. Commonly used to describe appearance, condition, or general impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇起上嚟幾精神，應該瞓得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 hei2 soeng5 lai4 gei2 zing1 san4, jing1 goi1 fan3 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起來很有精神，應該睡得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He looks energetic; he probably slept well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫睇起上嚟好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 tai2 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服看起來很貴。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing looks expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇起上嚟好攰，係咪瞓唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 gui6, hai6 mai6 fan3 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看起來很累，是不是沒睡好？
examples.english_sentence: You look tired — did you not sleep well?

mandarin_meaning: 看路；注意路况/周围环境；小心
english_meaning: watch the road; mind your step; watch out
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來提醒別人注意路面或周圍環境，意思是「看路」或「小心」。語氣可中性（提醒）或較強（催促、責備），視語境和語調而定。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to tell someone to pay attention to the road or their surroundings—i.e., "watch the road" or "watch out." Tone can be neutral (a reminder) or sharper (an admonition) depending on context and intonation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇路呀！有車嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lou6 aa3! jau5 ce1 lai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看路！有车来了！
examples.english_sentence: Watch out! A car is coming!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路要睇路，唔好望住手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 lou6 jiu3 tai2 lou6, m4 hou2 mong6 zyu6 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路要看路，不要看着手机。
examples.english_sentence: When walking, watch where you're going; don't stare at your phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 司機揸車要睇路，小心行人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 gei1 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 tai2 lou6, siu2 sam1 hang4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 司机开车要看路，小心行人。
examples.english_sentence: Drivers should watch the road; be careful of pedestrians.

mandarin_meaning: 處理；照顧（某事或替人辦理）
english_meaning: to take care of; to handle; to deal with (something on someone's behalf)
explanation_mandarin: （口語）表示替人或自己處理、辦理某件事或照顧相關事務的動作。
explanation_english: A colloquial verb meaning to handle, take care of, or deal with a matter (often on behalf of someone).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事你唔洗擔心，我會幫你睇辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5 tai2 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事你不用担心，我会帮你处理。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about this matter; I'll take care of it for you.

mandarin_meaning: 看透 / 看穿
english_meaning: to see through; to perceive the true nature or motives; to be disillusioned
explanation_mandarin: 表示看清事物或人的本質或真相，亦可指對某人或某事失望、看淡。
explanation_english: Indicates seeing the true nature or motives of a person or situation; can also mean becoming disillusioned or seeing something as not surprising anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經睇透佢嘅真正用心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 tau3 keoi5 ge3 zan1 zing3 jung6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經看透他的真正用心。
examples.english_sentence: I've already seen through his true intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘅嘢我早就睇透晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 ngo5 zou2 zau6 tai2 tau3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事我早就看透了。
examples.english_sentence: I've long since seen through what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多嘢，我對佢哋嘅信任已經睇透咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam2 do1 je5 ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 seon3 jam6 ji5 ging1 tai2 tau3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過這麼多事，我對他們的信任已經看透了。
examples.english_sentence: After all that, I've seen through my trust in them.

mandarin_meaning: 看通；看開（看清事情的本質或放下執著）
