explanation_english: Indicates someone has fallen asleep or is in the state of being asleep; a common Cantonese expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經瞓着喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 fan3 zoek6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她已經睡著了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has already fallen asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔瞓着咗，唔好吵佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 fan3 zoek6 zo2, m4 hou2 caau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩已經睡著了，別吵他/她。
examples.english_sentence: The child has fallen asleep; don't wake him/her.

mandarin_meaning: （睡）睡著；入睡
english_meaning: to fall asleep; to be asleep
explanation_mandarin: 「瞓著」是廣東話口語，表示已經入睡或睡著，常用作狀態或結果。</br>可用於描述人或小孩已經睡著，或表示剛剛睡着（有時加咗作完成）。
explanation_english: “瞓著” is colloquial Cantonese meaning to fall asleep or to be asleep. It indicates the state or result of sleeping and is commonly used to describe someone (often a child) who is already asleep. A particle like 咗 may be added to mark completion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經瞓著喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 fan3 zoek6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她已經睡著了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has already fallen asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞓著咗，錯過咗巴士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan3 zoek6 zo2, co3 gwo3 zo2 baa1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我睡著了，錯過了公車。
examples.english_sentence: I fell asleep and missed the bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓著嘅樣好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 zoek6 ge3 joeng6 hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡著的樣子很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: He looks so cute when he's asleep.

mandarin_meaning: 在街上睡覺／露宿街頭（常指無家可歸或醉酒後在街上昏睡）
english_meaning: to sleep on the street / sleep rough (often implying homelessness or passing out on the street, e.g., from drunkenness)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，字面意思是「在街上睡覺」。常用來形容無家可歸者在街頭露宿，或因醉酒、暈倒等原因在街上睡著或昏睡。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning literally 'sleep on the street.' It commonly describes sleeping rough (being homeless) or passing out/asleep on the street (often due to drunkenness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗咁多酒，最後瞓街喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zo2 gam2 do1 zau2, zeoi3 hau6 fan3 gaai1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝了那麼多酒，最後在街上睡着／昏睡了。
examples.english_sentence: He drank so much that he ended up sleeping/passed out on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間好多工人無左工，要瞓街，好心痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 kei4 gaan1 hou2 do1 gung1 jan4 mou4 zo2 gung1, jiu3 fan3 gaai1, hou2 sam1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期間很多工人失去工作，不得不在街上露宿，令人心痛。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic many workers lost their jobs and had to sleep on the street; it's heartbreaking.

mandarin_meaning: 睡覺
english_meaning: to sleep; to go to bed
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，表示入睡或睡覺，常用於日常會話中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to sleep or go to bed, commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家好攰，想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 gui6, soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在很累，想睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really tired right now and want to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬瞓咗覺，唔好吵佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 fan3 zo2 gaau3, m4 hou2 cau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟已經睡著了，別吵他。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother is already asleep; don't disturb him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚幾點瞓覺？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gei2 dim2 fan3 gaau3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚幾點睡覺？
examples.english_sentence: What time are you going to sleep tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 豁出去 / 拼命（为某事或某人愿意冒险、牺牲自己）
english_meaning: to risk oneself; to go all out; to put oneself on the line; to throw oneself into (something), even at personal risk
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，表示願意為某事或某人冒險、犧牲自己或拼命付出，既可指實際冒生命危險，也可指在工作或情感上全力以赴。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to be willing to risk oneself or make a personal sacrifice for something or someone. It can be literal (risking life) or figurative (going all out, putting oneself on the line).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗保護妹妹，瞓身衝入火場救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 mui6 mui6, fan3 san1 cung1 jap6 fo2 coeng4 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了保護妹妹，豁出性命衝進火場救人。
examples.english_sentence: He risked his life to rush into the fire to save his sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班同事真係肯瞓身，唔會計較加班幾時返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 tung4 si6 zan1 hai6 hang2 fan3 san1, m4 wui5 gai3 gaau3 gaa1 baan1 gei2 si4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些同事真的肯拼命，不會計較加班到幾點回公司。
examples.english_sentence: These colleagues are really willing to go all out and don't mind working overtime.

mandarin_meaning: 睡過頭
english_meaning: to oversleep; to sleep in and miss or be late for something
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面上是「睡過籠」，意思是睡得太久或睡過頭，導致錯過事情或遲到。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang/idiom meaning to oversleep or sleep in so long that you miss something or are late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝瞓過籠，遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 fan3 gwo3 lung4, ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上睡過頭，遲到了。
examples.english_sentence: I overslept this morning and was late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好彩佢冇瞓過籠，否則就會錯過飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 coi2 keoi5 mou5 fan3 gwo3 lung4, fau2 zak1 zau6 wui5 cok3 gwo3 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好他沒有睡過頭，否則會錯過飛機。
examples.english_sentence: Fortunately he didn't oversleep; otherwise he would have missed the flight.

mandarin_meaning: 睡過頭 / 睡懶覺
english_meaning: to oversleep; to sleep in
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，表示睡過頭、睡得太久而錯過預定起床時間或行程。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to oversleep or sleep in — i.e., to sleep past the intended time and possibly miss appointments or plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我瞓過龍，上班遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 fan3 gwo3 lung4, soeng5 baan1 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上我睡過頭，上班遲到了。
examples.english_sentence: I overslept this morning and was late for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旅行嗰日佢瞓過龍，結果錯過咗第一班船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 hang4 go2 jat6 keoi5 fan3 gwo3 lung4, git3 gwo2 co3 gwo3 zo2 dai6 jat1 baan1 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旅行那天他睡過頭，結果錯過了第一班船。
examples.english_sentence: On the day of the trip he overslept and ended up missing the first ferry.

mandarin_meaning: 睡醒 / 醒來
english_meaning: to wake up (from sleep)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，表示從睡眠狀態醒過來，等同普通話的「睡醒」或「醒來」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to wake up from sleep; equivalent to 'wake up' or 'wake (up)'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝瞓醒先發覺手機冇電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 fan3 seng2 sin1 faat3 gok3 sau2 gei1 mou5 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上睡醒才發現手機沒電。
examples.english_sentence: I only realized my phone had no battery after I woke up this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一瞓醒就要食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 fan3 seng2 zau6 jiu3 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一醒來就要吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to eat as soon as he wakes up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔瞓醒成日心情唔穩定，記得耐心照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 fan3 seng2 sing4 jat6 sam1 cing4 m4 wan2 ding6, gei3 dak1 noi6 sam1 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子睡醒後常常情緒不穩定，記得耐心照顧。
examples.english_sentence: Children often feel unsettled after waking up, so remember to be patient when looking after them.

mandarin_meaning: 躺着也能赢 / 無論在哪裡睡都能贏
english_meaning: win effortlessly / win no matter what (even while sleeping)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人非常幸運或實力強，無論在任何情況或多麼不費力的情況下都能獲勝，帶有誇張或戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese slang phrase used to describe someone so lucky or dominant that they win effortlessly in any situation — often said humorously or hyperbolically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波勁好，真係瞓響度都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 ging6 hou2, zan1 hai6 fan3 hoeng2 dou6 dou1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球很厲害，簡直躺着也能贏。
examples.english_sentence: He's so good at playing that he could win even while sleeping.

mandarin_meaning: 睡飽；睡得夠
english_meaning: to have slept enough; to be well-rested
explanation_mandarin: 「瞓飽」是廣東話口語，表示已經睡夠了，因此身體或精神狀態較好。常用於打招呼或詢問對方是否休息充足。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning one has slept enough and feels rested. Often used when asking or commenting about someone's rest or energy level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你瞓飽未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan3 baau2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你睡飽了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you slept enough?

mandarin_meaning: 瞒 (mán) — 隐瞒、不把真相告诉别人
english_meaning: to conceal; to hide the truth; to withhold information (to deceive by omission)
explanation_mandarin: 表示故意隱藏事實或不把真相告訴別人，常用於“瞞住/瞞着”某人或“瞞報”等表達。
explanation_english: Means to deliberately hide facts or not tell someone the truth. Often used in forms like "瞞住/瞞着" (hide from someone) or "瞞報" (cover up reporting).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再瞞住我，我已經知道晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 maan4 zyu6 ngo5, ngo5 ji5 ging1 zi1 dou6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再瞒着我，我已经知道了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hide things from me anymore — I already know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日瞞住屋企人做啲咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 maan4 zyu6 uk1 kei5 jan4 zou6 di1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是瞒着家人做些什么？
examples.english_sentence: He always hides what he does from his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司瞞報咗嗰次事故，之後畀人揭發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 maan4 bou3 zo2 go2 ci3 si6 gu3, zi1 hau6 bei2 jan4 gaai1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司隐瞒了那次事故，后来被人揭发。
examples.english_sentence: The company covered up that accident and was later exposed.

mandarin_meaning: 瞒天过海（mántiān guòhǎi）：用欺骗或掩饰的方法瞒过众人以达到目的。
english_meaning: To deceive everyone with a ruse; literally 'to hide the sky and cross the sea' — to accomplish something by trickery or concealment.
explanation_mandarin: 出自《三十六計》之一，指用迷惑或隱瞞的手段瞞過眾人以完成計劃，比喻用詭計欺騙或掩飾真相。
explanation_english: From the Thirty-Six Stratagems; literally 'to deceive the heavens and cross the sea.' It means using deception or concealment to mislead others and achieve one's goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用瞞天過海嘅手段，將資金偷偷轉去離岸戶口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung6 maan4 tin1 gwo3 hoi2 ge3 sau2 dyun6, jeung1 zi1 gam1 tau1 tau1 zyun2 heoi3 lei4 ngon6 wu6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用瞒天过海的手段，把资金偷偷转到离岸账户。
examples.english_sentence: They used a ruse to secretly transfer the funds to an offshore account.

mandarin_meaning: 瞒税；逃税
english_meaning: to evade taxes; tax evasion
explanation_mandarin: 指故意隱瞞收入或虛報支出，以減少應繳納的稅款，屬於逃稅行為，可能觸犯稅法並被罰款或追繳稅款。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately concealing income or falsely reporting expenses to reduce taxes owed. It is a form of tax evasion that may violate tax laws and result in fines or back taxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲公司會透過開假發票嚟瞞稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gung1si1 wui5 tau3 gwo3 hoi1 gaa2 faat3 piu3 lai4 maan4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些公司會透過開假發票來瞞稅。
examples.english_sentence: Some companies hide taxes by issuing fake invoices.

mandarin_meaning: 瞒税；隐瞒或少报应缴税款（即偷税、逃税）
english_meaning: to evade taxes; tax evasion (concealing or underreporting taxable income to avoid paying taxes)
explanation_mandarin: 指隱瞞或少報應繳的稅款，以逃避繳稅責任，屬違法行為。
explanation_english: Refers to concealing or underreporting taxes owed in order to avoid paying them; an illegal act of tax evasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司瞞稅，結果畀罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 maan4 seoi3, git3 gwo2 bei2 faat3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司瞒税，结果被罚款。
examples.english_sentence: The company evaded taxes and ended up being fined.

mandarin_meaning: 欺瞞；欺騙
english_meaning: to deceive; to cheat; to conceal and trick someone
explanation_mandarin: 指用隱瞞或虛假手段使他人上當或受騙。
explanation_english: To hide the truth or use false information to make someone be deceived or cheated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好瞞騙我，直接講真話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 maan4pin3 ngo5, zik6zip3 gong2 zan1waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要欺騙我，直接說實話。
examples.english_sentence: Don't deceive me; just tell the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用假資料瞞騙投資者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gaa2 zi1 liu6 maan4pin3 tau4 zi1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用假資料欺騙投資者。
examples.english_sentence: He used fake documents to deceive investors.

mandarin_meaning: 瞟（瞥一眼；偷看）
english_meaning: to glance; to take a quick or furtive look
explanation_mandarin: 表示迅速或暗中看一眼，通常是短暫、匆匆或帶有偷看的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a quick or furtive look, usually brief or cursory, sometimes implying sneaking a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞟咗我一眼，就繼續講電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 piu3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 ngaan5, zau6 gai3 zuk6 gong2 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他瞟了我一眼，就继续打电话。
examples.english_sentence: He glanced at me once and continued talking on the phone.

mandarin_meaning: 瞠（常見於「瞠目」「瞠目結舌」），表示睜大眼睛，因驚訝或愕然而目瞪口呆
english_meaning: to stare wide-eyed; to be dumbfounded or astonished (as in the idiom "瞠目結舌")
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因驚訝、愕然或震驚而睜大眼睛、說不出話的狀態，常見於成語「瞠目結舌」。
explanation_english: Describes the act/state of staring with wide eyes due to surprise or astonishment, often used in the idiom "瞠目結舌" to mean being speechless or dumbfounded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰個消息，瞠目結舌，唔知點答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 go3 siu1 sik1, cing4 muk6 git3 sit3, m4 zi1 dim2 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那個消息，瞠目結舌，不知道怎麼回答。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the news and was dumbfounded, not knowing how to respond.

mandarin_meaning: 目瞪口呆、驚訝得說不出話（成語）
english_meaning: dumbfounded; stunned; speechless from shock or astonishment
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或動詞性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 形容因為驚訝、震驚或尷尬而目瞪口呆、說不出話來的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being stunned or astonished to the point of being speechless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息，瞠目結舌，唔知點回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1si3, cing1 muk6 git3 sit3, m4 zi1 dim2 wui4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到這個消息，目瞪口呆，不知道怎麼回應。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the news and was dumbfounded, not knowing how to respond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試成績公布後，全班都瞠目結舌，氣氛好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 gung1 bou3 hau6, cyun4 baan1 dou1 cing1 muk6 git3 sit3, hei3 fan1 hou2 gaan1 goi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試成績公布後，全班都目瞪口呆，氣氛很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam results were announced, the whole class was stunned and the atmosphere was awkward.

mandarin_meaning: 迅速地看一眼；瞥见
english_meaning: to glance; to glimpse; a quick or fleeting look
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暫、迅速地看一眼，或偶然瞥見某人或某物。
explanation_english: Denotes looking briefly or quickly at someone or something; to catch a fleeting glimpse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係瞥咗我一眼就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 pit3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 zou2 zo2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是瞥了我一眼就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He only glanced at me and then left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞥見佢喺街角同人傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pit3 gin3 keoi5 hai6 gaai1 gok3 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我瞥见他在街角和人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: I glimpsed him chatting with someone at the street corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫值得一瞥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 zik1 dak1 jat1 pit3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画值得一瞥。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is worth a glance.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）瞥一眼、冷落、瞧不起地看一眼
english_meaning: slang: to give a quick dismissive glance; to snub someone
explanation_mandarin: 「瞥伯」是香港粵語俚語，用來形容對人或事不屑地瞥一眼、敷衍或冷落對方，帶有輕視或敷衍的語氣。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang verb meaning to cast a quick, dismissive glance at someone — essentially snubbing or showing disdain with a brief look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我淨係瞥伯我一眼就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 zing6 hai6 pit3 baak3 ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我只是瞥了我一眼就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He only gave me a dismissive glance and then left.

mandarin_meaning: 瞥见；瞥到（短暫地看見）
english_meaning: to catch a glimpse of; to glimpse briefly
explanation_mandarin: 表示短暫、匆匆地看到某人或某物，通常是一瞬間的瞥見。
explanation_english: Indicates briefly catching sight of someone or something; a quick, fleeting glance or glimpse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱瞥見佢喺街角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 pit3 gin3 keoi5 hai2 gaai1 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚瞥见他在街角。
examples.english_sentence: I just caught a glimpse of him at the street corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞥見我嘅時候，笑咗一笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pit3 gin3 ngo5 ge3 si4 hau6, siu3 zo2 jat1 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他瞥见我的时候，笑了一笑。
examples.english_sentence: When he caught sight of me, he gave a little smile.

mandarin_meaning: 看、瞧、瞥一眼
english_meaning: to look at; to glance; to peer
explanation_mandarin: 表示看、瞥一眼或注視的動作，可用於口語或書面顯示觀察或瞥視的行為。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of looking, glancing, or peering; used to express observing or casting a quick look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你瞧乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ciu4 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What are you looking at?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日瞧住部電話，唔理人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ciu4 zyu6 bou6 din6 waa2, m4 lei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是盯着手機，不理人。
examples.english_sentence: He always stares at his phone and ignores people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞧咗個陌生人一眼就走開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ciu4 zo2 go3 mak6 saang1 jan4 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 zau2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她瞥了那個陌生人一眼就走開了。
examples.english_sentence: She cast a quick glance at the stranger and then walked away.

mandarin_meaning: 瞪 (dèng)：怒目注視、瞪視
english_meaning: to stare/glare (with wide-open eyes); to glower
explanation_mandarin: 表示用睜大的眼睛帶有不悅或驚訝地盯著看，常帶有責備或不滿的意思。
explanation_english: To look at someone with wide-open eyes, often angrily or in surprise; a glaring or fixed stare that can express disapproval or astonishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁瞪住我，講吓你想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 dang3 zyu6 ngo5, gong2 haa5 nei5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這樣瞪著我，說說你想怎麼樣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't glare at me like that — tell me what you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到啲壞消息，就瞪大眼望住個電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 di1 waai6 siu1 sik1, zau6 dang3 daai6 ngaan5 mong6 zyu6 go3 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一聽到壞消息，就瞪大眼睛看著電視。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard the bad news, he widened his eyes and stared at the TV.

mandarin_meaning: 瞬（瞬间）：极短的时间，片刻
english_meaning: instant; moment; a very short period of time
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 副词（用于表示短暂时间，常见于合成词如“瞬间”）
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常短暂的时间、片刻，常用於“瞬间”“一瞬间”等词语，强调时间短促。
explanation_english: Indicates an extremely short period of time or a brief moment. Commonly used in compounds like "瞬间" (in an instant) to emphasize brevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一瞬間已經消失咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 seon3 gaan1 ji5 ging1 siu1 sat1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一瞬间就消失了。
examples.english_sentence: He disappeared in an instant.

mandarin_meaning: 瞬息萬變（shùn xī wàn biàn）：變化極快，短時間內產生很多變化
english_meaning: changing rapidly; ever-changing; subject to sudden and frequent changes
explanation_mandarin: 指事物、局勢或環境在極短時間內發生劇烈或頻繁的變化，強調變化迅速且難以預測。
explanation_english: Describes a situation, environment, or thing that changes extremely quickly and often unpredictably; emphasizes rapid and frequent change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅社會環境瞬息萬變，企業要不斷適應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Hoeng1 gong2 ge3 se5 wui6 waan4 ging2 syun3 sik1 maan6 bin3, kei5 jip6 jiu3 bat1 dyun6 sik1 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的社會環境瞬息萬變，企業要不斷適應。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's social environment changes rapidly; companies must constantly adapt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資要小心，市場瞬息萬變，隨時有風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Tau4 zi1 jiu3 siu2 sam1, si5 coeng4 syun3 sik1 maan6 bin3, ceoi4 si4 jau5 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投資要小心，市場瞬息萬變，隨時有風險。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when investing—the market changes in an instant and risks can arise at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣瞬息萬變，落雨前記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Tin1 hei3 syun3 sik1 maan6 bin3, lok6 jyu5 cin4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣瞬息萬變，出門前記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: The weather changes rapidly; remember to bring an umbrella before heading out.

mandarin_meaning: 瞬间（很短的时间，一剎那）
english_meaning: an instant; a moment; in an instant
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常短暫的時間，常用來指事情在很短的時間內發生或改變。
explanation_english: Refers to a very brief period of time; used to indicate that something happens or changes in an extremely short time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情況瞬間改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 fong3 seon3 gaan3 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情况瞬间改变。
examples.english_sentence: The situation changed in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞬間消失喺我眼前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 gaan3 siu1 sat1 hai2 ngo5 ngaan5 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他瞬间消失在我眼前。
examples.english_sentence: He disappeared before my eyes in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞬間明白咗佢嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon3 gaan3 ming4 baak6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我瞬间明白了他的意思。
examples.english_sentence: I understood what he meant in a flash.

mandarin_meaning: 瞬间移动（把人或物從一處瞬間轉移到另一處）
english_meaning: teleportation; to teleport — instantaneously move someone or something from one place to another
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述在極短時間內從一地瞬間移動到另一地的現象或能力，常見於科幻、遊戲或口語比喻用法。
explanation_english: Describes the phenomenon or ability to instantly move from one location to another; commonly used in science fiction, games, or figuratively in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似有瞬間移動嘅能力，一眨眼就唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 seon3 gaan1 ji4 dung6 ge3 nang4 lik6, jat1 zaap6 ngaan5 zau6 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像有瞬间移动的能力，一眨眼就不见了。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have the ability to teleport — in the blink of an eye he's gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢款遊戲入面，角色可以用技能瞬間移動到其他位置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 fun2 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6, gok3 sik1 ho2 ji5 jung6 gei6 nang4 seon3 gaan1 ji4 dung6 dou3 kei4 taa1 wai6 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這款遊戲裡，角色可以用技能瞬間移動到其他位置。
examples.english_sentence: In this game, characters can use a skill to instantly teleport to another position.

mandarin_meaning: （常見於「瞭解」、「明瞭」）表示明白、了解
english_meaning: to understand; clear/clear up
explanation_mandarin: 「瞭」多用於詞語如「瞭解」、「明瞭」，表示對事物清楚或已理解。在粵語中通常讀作 liu5，用於表示明白或了解。
explanation_english: Used mainly in compounds such as 瞭解 (to understand) and 明瞭 (clear). In Cantonese it is usually read as 'liu5' and means to understand or be clear about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞭，你唔使再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 liu5, nei5 m4 sai2 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明白了，你不用再說了。
examples.english_sentence: I got it; you don't need to say more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔瞭解件事嘅全部情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 liu5 gaai2 gin6 si6 ge3 cyun4 bou6 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不瞭解這件事的全部情況。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't understand the full situation of this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 了如指掌
english_meaning: to know something thoroughly; to know like the back of one's hand
explanation_mandarin: 形容對某事物非常了解，像看自己的手掌一樣清楚。
explanation_english: Describes knowing something very thoroughly; to understand something as clearly as one knows the lines of one's hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對香港嘅地理瞭如指掌，可以做導遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 dei6 lei5 liu5 jyu4 zi2 zoeng2, ho2 ji5 zou6 dou6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對香港的地理了如指掌，可以當導遊。
examples.english_sentence: He knows Hong Kong's geography like the back of his hand; he could be a tour guide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗幾十年嘅廚師，佢對食材嘅特性瞭如指掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 ge3 ceoi4 si1, keoi5 deoi3 sik6 coi4 ge3 dak6 sing3 liu5 jyu4 zi2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了幾十年的廚師，他對食材的特性了如指掌。
examples.english_sentence: Having worked as a chef for decades, he knows the properties of ingredients like the back of his hand.

mandarin_meaning: 瞭望 (liàowàng)：眺望、觀察遠方；也指瞭望的崗位或動作
english_meaning: to look out; to observe from a vantage point; a lookout (post or act of watching)
explanation_mandarin: 從較高或有利的位置觀察遠處的情況，或指負責觀察的崗位／動作。
explanation_english: To observe distant areas from a vantage point or to keep watch; can also refer to the lookout position or the act of watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺塔頂瞭望，可以望到成個海港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taap3 deng2 liu6 mong6, ho2 ji5 mong6 dou3 seng4 go3 hoi2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在塔頂瞭望，可以看到整個海港。
examples.english_sentence: From the top of the tower, looking out, you can see the entire harbor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞭望哨負責觀察海面有冇可疑船隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: liu6 mong6 siu3 fu6 zaak3 gun1 caat3 hoi2 min6 jau5 mou5 ho2 ji4 syun4 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 瞭望哨負責觀察海面有沒有可疑船隻。
examples.english_sentence: The lookout post is responsible for watching the sea for any suspicious vessels.

mandarin_meaning: 了解 / 瞭解 (liǎojiě)
english_meaning: to understand; to comprehend; to know about
explanation_mandarin: 表示理解或掌握某事的情況、原因或內容，常用於詢問或陳述對事情的理解程度。
explanation_english: Indicates understanding or grasping the situation, reason, or content of something; commonly used to ask or state one's level of understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我瞭解你嘅處境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 liu5 gaai2 nei5 ge3 cyu3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我了解你的處境。
examples.english_sentence: I understand your situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你瞭解呢個問題嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 liu5 gaai2 ze5 go3 man6 tai4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你了解这个问题吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you understand this problem?

mandarin_meaning: 俯视；从高处向下看，概观
english_meaning: to look down from above; to overlook; to survey (often literary)
explanation_mandarin: 表示从高处向下看、俯视或概观，多用于书面语，如“俯瞰”。
explanation_english: Expresses looking down from a high place, overlooking or surveying; often used in written/literary contexts (e.g. in the compound 俯瞰).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺山頂俯瞰成個城市，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 deng2 fu2 hon3 sing4 go3 sing4 si5, ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以从山顶俯瞰整个城市，景色很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: We can overlook the whole city from the mountaintop; the view is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 瞳（瞳孔、瞳仁）——眼睛中央的圓形開口，控制進入眼內的光量
english_meaning: pupil (of the eye); the circular opening in the iris that controls the amount of light entering the eye
explanation_mandarin: 「瞳」常用於「瞳孔」或「瞳仁」，指眼睛虹膜中央的開口，其大小會隨光線變化以調節入眼光量，常在醫學檢查中被提及。
explanation_english: Often used in compounds like 瞳孔 or 瞳仁, 瞳 refers to the pupil—the opening in the center of the iris. Its size changes with light and is commonly referenced in medical examinations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生檢查咗我嘅瞳孔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4 zo2 ngo5 ge3 tung4 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生检查了我的瞳孔。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor examined my pupils.

mandarin_meaning: 瞳孔（tóng kǒng）：眼睛虹膜中間的圓形孔，控制進入眼睛的光量。
english_meaning: Pupil (of the eye): the circular opening in the center of the iris that regulates the amount of light entering the eye.
explanation_mandarin: 眼睛中央的圓孔，由虹膜肌肉控制，會根據光線明暗而收縮或擴大以調節進入眼內的光量與視覺清晰度。
explanation_english: The circular opening in the center of the iris of the eye; it changes size (constricts or dilates) in response to light and other stimuli to regulate how much light enters the eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生檢查佢嘅瞳孔反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4 keoi5 ge3 tung4 hung2 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生檢查他的瞳孔反應。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor checked his pupil reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺黑暗嘅環境，瞳孔會擴大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hak1 aam3 ge3 waan4 ging2, tung4 hung2 wui5 kwok3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在黑暗的環境中，瞳孔會擴大。
examples.english_sentence: In dark environments, the pupils dilate.

mandarin_meaning: 眯眼、瞥一眼（方言、口語）
english_meaning: to squint; to give a quick glance (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「瞸」為粵語方言中較少見的字，用來表示眯眼或瞥一眼的動作，口語用法，多用於描述看東西時眯起眼或快速看一眼的情況。
explanation_english: A less common Cantonese character used colloquially to mean squinting or taking a quick glance. It describes the action of narrowing the eyes or glancing briefly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日瞸住眼，好似睇唔清楚噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 saam2 zyu6 ngaan5, hou2 ci3 tai2 m4 cing1 co2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常眯著眼，好像看不清楚一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He often squints his eyes, as if he can't see clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 閉上眼睛；裝作沒看到／視而不見
english_meaning: to close one's eyes (literally, to squint/close eyes); figuratively, to turn a blind eye / pretend not to see
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，原指把眼睛瞇起或閉上，也可引申為對問題或錯誤裝作沒看見、不加處理（視而不見）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to close or squint one's eyes. Figuratively it can mean to ignore a problem or pretend not to notice (to turn a blind eye).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞸埋眼，唔好再諗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai1 maai4 ngaan5, m4 hou2 zoi3 lam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 閉上眼睛，不要再想了。
examples.english_sentence: Close your eyes; don't think about it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司知道有問題，但管理層瞸埋眼唔處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zi1 dou6 jau5 man6 tai4, daan6 gun2 lei5 cang4 mai1 maai4 ngaan5 m4 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司知道有问题，但管理层视而不见不处理。
examples.english_sentence: The company knew about the problem, but management turned a blind eye and didn't deal with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞸埋眼望住遠處，諗住要點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mai1 maai4 ngaan5 mong6 zyu6 jyun5 cyu3, lam2 zyu6 jiu3 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眯起眼看着遠處，想着要怎麼做。
examples.english_sentence: He squinted at the distance, thinking about what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 眺望、注視、仰視（zhān）
english_meaning: to look at; to gaze; to face; often used in literary contexts
explanation_mandarin: 表示仰視、注視或觀望，常見於書面語或成語（如「瞻仰」「瞻前顧後」）。
explanation_english: Indicates to gaze at, look up to, or face; typically used in literary language and idioms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋前往烈士陵園瞻仰先烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cin4 wong5 lit6 si6 ling4 jyun4 zim1 ngong5 sin1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们前往烈士陵园瞻仰先烈。
examples.english_sentence: They went to the martyrs' cemetery to pay respects to the martyrs.

mandarin_meaning: 瞻仰（表示恭敬地觀看或向某人、某事物表示敬意）
english_meaning: to look upon with reverence; to pay homage or pay one's respects
explanation_mandarin: 表示恭敬地觀看或向某人、某事物表示敬意，常用於拜訪先人墳墓、紀念場所或瞻仰偉人事跡。
explanation_english: A formal verb meaning to view or regard something with respect or veneration; often used for visiting ancestors' graves, memorials, or venerating distinguished figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個清明節去瞻仰先人嘅墳墓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 cing1 ming4 zit3 heoi3 zim1 ngong5 sin1 jan4 ge3 fan4 mou6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們清明節去瞻仰先人的墳墓。
examples.english_sentence: We go to pay our respects at our ancestors' graves on Tomb-Sweeping Day.

mandarin_meaning: 瞻前顾后（zhānqián gùhòu）— 形容做事过于谨慎，顾虑太多，犹豫不决。
english_meaning: To be overly cautious and hesitant; to look before and after (worry about consequences), causing hesitation or indecision.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事過於謹慎、顧慮太多，因而猶豫不決或錯失良機。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is overly cautious and preoccupied with possible consequences, leading to hesitation, indecision, or missed opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日瞻前顧後，所以錯過咗好多機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zim1 cin4 gu3 hau6, so2 ji5 co3 gwo3 zo2 hou2 do1 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是瞻前顾后，所以错过了很多机会。
examples.english_sentence: He's always overcautious and hesitant, so he missed many opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 眼睑 / 眼皮 (yǎnjiǎn / yǎnpí)
english_meaning: eyelid
explanation_mandarin: 指覆蓋眼睛並保護眼球的皮膚摺皺，俗稱眼皮。
explanation_english: The fold of skin that covers and protects the eye; commonly called the eyelid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日覺得眼瞼好沉，可能係瞓得唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 ngaan5 gim2 hou2 cam4, ho2 nang4 hai6 fan3 dak1 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我經常覺得眼皮很沉，可能是睡眠不足。
examples.english_sentence: I often feel my eyelids are heavy; maybe I haven't slept enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家眼瞼跳，聽講係因為太攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ngaan5 gim2 tiu3, teng1 gong2 hai6 jan1 wai6 taai3 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在眼皮跳，聽說是因為太累。
examples.english_sentence: His eyelid is twitching right now; I heard it's because he's too tired.

mandarin_meaning: 盲、失明（文言）
english_meaning: blind (archaic/literary)
explanation_mandarin: “瞽”为古汉字，意为盲或失明，多见于文言或书面用语，如“瞽者”指盲人。
explanation_english: “瞽” is an archaic/literary Chinese character meaning 'blind' or 'visually impaired', mainly found in classical texts and compounds such as '瞽者' (blind person).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代文獻用「瞽者」指盲人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 man4 hin3 jung6 'gu2 ze2' zi2 mong4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代文献用「瞽者」指盲人。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient texts use '瞽者' to refer to blind people.

mandarin_meaning: 蒙；模糊、不清楚；（口語）裝作不懂、糊塗
english_meaning: to be blind/obscured; to be confused or unaware; (colloquial) to play dumb or feign ignorance
explanation_mandarin: 「矇」常用於廣東話，表示視線被遮蔽或頭腦糊塗、不清楚，也可用作口語表達裝作不懂或迷糊。與漢字「蒙」意義相近。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 矇 is used to indicate obscured vision or being confused/unclear in one's mind; colloquially it can also mean to play dumb or feign ignorance. It is closely related in meaning to the character 蒙.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日矇查查，唔知自己做緊啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mung4 caa4 caa4, m4 zi1 zi6 gei2 zou6 gan2 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是矇矇懂懂，不知道自己在做什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always clueless, not knowing what he's doing.

mandarin_meaning: 迷糊、模糊、不清楚或茫然
english_meaning: dazed, fuzzy, confused; unable to see or understand clearly
explanation_mandarin: 表示視覺或思維狀態不清楚、模糊或感到茫然，常用於廣東話口語表達。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being blurry, fuzzy, or confused (visually or mentally). A colloquial Cantonese expression for not seeing or understanding clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到呢件事之後，整個人矇查查，乜都唔記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6 zi1 hau6, zing2 go3 jan4 mung4 caa1 caa1, mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到這件事之後，整個人茫然，什麼都記不得了。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing about it, he was completely dazed and couldn't remember anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相拍得矇查查，睇唔清楚個人樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 paak3 dak1 mung4 caa1 caa1, tai2 m4 cing1 co2 go3 jan4 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張照片拍得模糊，看不清楚人的樣子。
examples.english_sentence: This photo turned out blurry; you can't see the person clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 蒙混
english_meaning: to deceive or muddle through; to cover up and get by by tricking or evasive means
explanation_mandarin: 用欺騙、藉口或敷衍的方式，把事情蒙混過去，不讓人發現真相或承擔責任。常用於「矇混過去」。
explanation_english: To deceive or mislead someone, or to cover up and get by through trickery or evasive tactics. Commonly used in the pattern "矇混過去" (to muddle through/cover up).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想矇混過去，唔肯承認自己嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 mung4 wan6 gwo3 heoi3, m4 hang2 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想蒙混過去，不肯承認自己的錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to cover it up and refused to admit his mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 容易上當/不明事理的人
english_meaning: a gullible or naive person; someone who is clueless
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，通常用來形容容易被騙、頭腦不靈光或對情況不了解的人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to describe someone who is naive, easily deceived, or clueless about a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個矇眼仔，成日俾人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 mung4 ngaan5 zai2, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 aak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個容易上當的人，總是被人騙。
examples.english_sentence: He's a gullible guy; he's always getting cheated.

mandarin_meaning: 昏暗的微光；朦朧的光線
english_meaning: a dim, faint, or hazy light; a soft/blurred glow
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來形容光線微弱或朦朧，常用於描述傍晚、清晨或有霧時的光景。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing weak, faint, or hazy light—often used for dawn, dusk, or foggy/poorly lit conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚街上淨係得矇矇光，行路都有啲危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 gaai1 soeng6 zing6 hai6 dak1 mung4 mung4 gwong1, haang4 lou6 dou1 jau5 di1 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上街上只有昏暗的微光，走路有點危險。
examples.english_sentence: At night the streets only have a dim glow, so walking can be a bit dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 昏昏沉沉；迷迷糊糊，形容困倦或精神不清楚
english_meaning: drowsy; groggy; half-awake and unfocused
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人還沒完全清醒、頭腦不清楚或昏昏欲睡的狀態，屬於口語表達。
explanation_english: Describes being not fully awake or mentally clear — sleepy, groggy, or in a dazed state. Commonly used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早未夠鐘，仲矇矇忪忪，行路都慢慢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 mei6 gau3 zung1, zung6 mung4 mung4 sung1 sung1, haang4 lou6 dou1 maan6 maan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上還沒完全清醒，仍然迷迷糊糊，走路都慢慢的。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't fully woken up this morning; I'm still groggy and walking slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 朦胧；模糊不清
english_meaning: hazy; dim; blurred; vague
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容視覺上不清楚、光線或輪廓朦朧，也可引申為概念或記憶模糊不明。
explanation_english: Describes something visually indistinct or dim (e.g., foggy, blurred); can also be used figuratively for vague or unclear ideas or memories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早起身，外面好矇矓，好似有霧咁，望唔清楚樓下嘅街景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1zou2 hei2san1, ngoi6min6 hou2 mung4 lung4, hou2ci5 jau5 mou6 gam2, mong6 m4 cing1co2 lau4haa6 ge3 gaai1ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一大早起來，外面很朦朧，好像有霧，看不清樓下的街景。
examples.english_sentence: I got up early and outside is very hazy, as if there's fog — I can't clearly see the street below.

mandarin_meaning: 裝作看不見；佯裝不知情；視而不見
english_meaning: to pretend not to notice; to feign ignorance; to turn a blind eye
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，字面是「矇住豬的眼」，用來形容故意裝作看不見或不理會某事或某人，佯裝不知情。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning 'covering the pig's eyes'. Used to describe deliberately pretending not to see or ignoring something/someone—feigning ignorance or turning a blind eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好矇豬眼，講清楚係發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 mung4 zyu1 ngaan5, gong2 cing1 co2 hai6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要裝傻，說清楚發生了什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dumb — explain clearly what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次有人偷嘢，老闆好似矇豬眼冇理會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 ci3 jau5 jan4 tau1 je5, lou5 baan2 hou2 ci5 mung4 zyu1 ngaan5 mou5 lei5 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次有人偷東西，老闆好像視而不見，沒有理會。
examples.english_sentence: Last time someone stole something, the boss seemed to turn a blind eye and didn't do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 罕用漢字，現代漢語中無固定或常見的詞義（多見於古籍或人名、地名的字形），在廣東話中亦無普遍接受的讀音或用法。
english_meaning: A rare/obscure Chinese character with no established modern meaning or common Cantonese reading; typically seen only in classical texts, personal names, or place names.
explanation_mandarin: 「矋」為生僻字，現代字典與口語中極少列出具體讀音或詞義。因此在粵語中一般視為罕見字，無固定用法。
explanation_english: The character "矋" is an uncommon/archaic character. It has no standard modern pronunciation or meaning in Cantonese and is rarely used except in specialised or historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「矋」好罕見，一般唔會用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 "矋" hou2 hon2 gin3, jat1 bun1 m4 wui5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字「矋」很罕见，一般不会使用。
examples.english_sentence: The character "矋" is very rare and generally not used.

mandarin_meaning: （眼睛或頭腦）模糊、朦朧、迷糊
english_meaning: blurred, dim, dazed; feeling fuzzy or indistinct (vision or mind)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述視覺或精神狀態不清楚、朦朧或恍惚的情況；可指眼睛看不清、頭腦迷糊或精神恍惚。
explanation_english: Describes a state of blurred or dim vision or a dazed, fuzzy mental state; can refer to unclear sight, grogginess, or mental haze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱瞓醒，頭腦有啲矓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 fan3 sing2, tau4 nou5 jau5 di1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛睡醒，頭腦有點矇矇的/迷糊。
examples.english_sentence: I just woke up and my head feels a bit fuzzy.

mandarin_meaning: 罕用字，常作「眯」的異體，意為半閉眼睛或瞇眼看東西（多為口語描述動作）
english_meaning: Rare/archaic character, often a variant of '眯' meaning to squint or half-close one's eyes
explanation_mandarin: 「矖」為罕見字，古今文獻中有時用作「眯」的異體，用來描述半閉眼或瞇眼看東西的動作。在現代粵語口語中通常使用「眯」或「瞇」，「矖」很少單獨出現。
explanation_english: The character '矖' is rare and sometimes used as a variant of '眯', describing the action of squinting or half-closing the eyes. In modern Cantonese the common forms are '眯' or '瞇'; '矖' is seldom used alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢矖住眼望住遠處，似乎睇唔清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mai1 zyu6 ngaan5 mong6 zyu6 jyun5 cyu3, ci5 fu1 tai2 m4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眯著眼望著遠處，似乎看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He squinted his eyes and looked into the distance, as if he couldn't see clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 高耸、屹立（常见于“矗立”）
english_meaning: towering; to tower; standing tall (often in the compound '矗立')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 动词（主要作形容词或与“立”合用作动词，如“矗立”）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / verb (mainly adjective; often used in verb compound 'to tower')
explanation_mandarin: 「矗」表示高而直地屹立，常与「立」合成動詞「矗立」，用來形容建築物、山峰等高聳於周圍景物之上。
explanation_english: The character denotes standing tall or towering. It is commonly used in the verb compound '矗立' to describe buildings, peaks, or structures that rise prominently above their surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 高樓矗立喺街邊，成個景觀好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gou1 lau4 cuk1 lap6 hai2 gaai1 bin1, sing4 go3 ging2 gun1 hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 高楼矗立在街边，整个景观很壮观。
examples.english_sentence: Tall buildings tower along the street; the whole view is spectacular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古老嘅城牆矗立咗幾百年，見證住一段歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 lou5 ge3 sing4 coeng4 cuk1 lap6 zo2 gei2 baak3 nin4, gin3 zing3 zyu6 jat1 dyun6 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古老的城墙矗立了几百年，见证着一段历史。
examples.english_sentence: The ancient city wall has stood for centuries, witnessing a stretch of history.

mandarin_meaning: 矗立（高聳地直立）
english_meaning: to stand tall; to tower; to rise prominently
explanation_mandarin: 表示高高地直立、聳立，常用於描述建築物、山峰等在環境中顯眼地豎立。
explanation_english: Indicates standing upright and prominently; commonly used to describe buildings, peaks, or structures that tower above their surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 高樓矗立喺海邊，睇落好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gou1 lau4 cuk1 laap6 hai2 hoi2 bin1, tai2 lok6 hou2 zong3 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 高楼矗立在海边，看起来很壮观。
examples.english_sentence: Tall buildings stand along the seafront, looking very spectacular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新大廈矗立喺市中心，成為地標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 daai6 haa6 cuk1 laap6 hai2 si5 zung1 sam1, sing4 wai4 dei6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新大厦矗立在市中心，成为地标。
examples.english_sentence: The new tower stands in the city center, becoming a landmark.

mandarin_meaning: 注目；瞩望；關注
english_meaning: to gaze at; to attract or focus attention; to watch or expect
explanation_mandarin: 表示注視、關注或期待，常見於「矚目」「矚望」等詞，指成為眾人注視的焦點或對某事抱有期待。
explanation_english: Indicates looking at, paying attention to, or expecting something. Commonly appears in compounds like '矚目' and '矚望', meaning to be the focus of attention or to be looked forward to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅新作品成為社會嘅矚目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 zok3 ban2 sing4 wai4 se5 wui6 ge3 zyu2 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新作品成为社会的瞩目。
examples.english_sentence: His new work has become the focus of society's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 矚目（注目、關注）
english_meaning: to attract attention; to be the focus of attention
explanation_mandarin: 表示吸引別人注意、成為眾人注目的對象，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: To draw or attract people's attention; to become the focus of public attention. Often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新科技產品一推出就吸引到全世界嘅矚目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 fo1 gei6 caan2 ban2 jat1 teoi1 ceot1 zau6 kap1 jan5 dou3 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 ge3 zyu3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個新科技產品一推出就吸引了全世界的矚目。
examples.english_sentence: This new tech product attracted the attention of the whole world as soon as it was launched.

mandarin_meaning: 矛（長柄的刺擊兵器）
english_meaning: spear; lance
explanation_mandarin: 指一種有尖端的長柄刺擊武器，古代常用；亦常出現在成語或比喻中（如“矛盾”中的“矛”）。
explanation_english: A long-handled pointed weapon used for thrusting (a spear or lance), commonly used in ancient warfare; also appears in idioms/metaphors (e.g., the 'spear' in 'contradiction').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代士兵用矛做武器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 si6 bing1 jung6 maau4 zou6 mou5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代士兵用矛作為武器。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient soldiers used spears as weapons.

mandarin_meaning: 矛盾 (máodùn)：指相互對立、互相衝突或不一致的情況。
english_meaning: Contradiction; conflict; inconsistency between statements, ideas, or facts.
explanation_mandarin: 源自古代“矛與盾”的寓言，比喻彼此對立或互相抵觸，表示兩種說法或情況不能同時成立。
explanation_english: Derived from the ancient fable of the spear and the shield; used to describe a contradiction or mutual conflict where two statements or situations cannot both be true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅說法互相矛盾，我哋要再查證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 syut3 faat3 wu6 soeng1 maau4 deon6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoi3 caa4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的說法互相矛盾，我們要再查證。
examples.english_sentence: Their statements contradict each other; we need to verify again.

mandarin_meaning: 矛头；比喻攻击或指责的方向或对象
english_meaning: spearhead; the focus or direction of an attack or criticism
explanation_mandarin: “矛頭”原指武器的尖端，常用作比喻，表示冲突、批评或攻势指向的对象或方向。
explanation_english: Originally the tip of a spear, '矛頭' is used figuratively to indicate the object or direction of an attack, criticism, or offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家矛頭指向政府，市民好關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 maau4 tau4 zi2 hoeng3 zing3 fu2, si5 man4 hou2 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在矛头指向政府，市民很关注。
examples.english_sentence: The criticism is now aimed at the government; citizens are very concerned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰鬥中士兵舉起矛頭衝向敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 dau3 zung1 si6 bing1 geoi2 hei2 maau4 tau4 cung1 hoeng3 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战斗中士兵举起矛头冲向敌人。
examples.english_sentence: In the battle, the soldiers raised their spearheads and charged toward the enemy.

mandarin_meaning: （文言）憐憫、同情；（現代常見於合成詞）矜持、拘謹、有點驕傲
english_meaning: to pity/compassion (literary); reserved, proud/pretentious (in modern compounds or colloquial use)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「矜」在文言文中可作動詞，意為憐憫或同情（如「矜恤」）。在現代漢語多見於合成詞或口語，表示拘謹、害羞或帶有些微驕傲的態度（如「矜持」或口語的「矜」用法）。
explanation_english: In classical/literary usage, 矜 means to pity or show compassion (e.g., 矜恤). In modern usage it appears in compounds or colloquially to mean reserved, restrained, or somewhat proud/pretentious (e.g., 矜持 or colloquial 矜).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對陌生人好矜持，唔太容易開聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 mak6 saang1 jan4 hou2 gan1 ci4, m4 taai3 jung4 ji6 hoi1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對陌生人很矜持，不太容易開口。
examples.english_sentence: He is very reserved with strangers and doesn't speak up easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁矜啦，大家只係朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 gan1 laa1, daai6 gaa1 zi2 hai6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別那麼矜持，我們只是朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pretentious; we're just friends.

mandarin_meaning: 拘謹、含蓄、內斂（拼音：jīnchí）
english_meaning: reserved; restrained; modest; not openly expressive
explanation_mandarin: 形容人言行比較謹慎、克制或不輕易表露情感或誇耀自己。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is cautious, restrained, modest, and not prone to openly showing emotions or boasting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公眾場合一直好矜持，唔太會主動講笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1zung3 coeng4hap6 jat1zik6 hou2 gan1 ci4, m4 taai3 wui5 zyu2dung6 gong2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公共場合一直很矜持，不太會主動開玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: They are very reserved in public and don't often initiate joking around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到讚美佢通常好矜持，會禮貌咁回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1dou3 zaan3mei5 keoi5 tung1soeng4 hou2 gan1 ci4, wui5 lai5maau6 gam2 wui4jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 受到讚美時他通常很矜持，會有禮貌地回應。
examples.english_sentence: When receiving compliments, they are usually reserved and respond politely.

mandarin_meaning: 矜贵（jīn guì）
english_meaning: snobbish; pretentiously high-class; (of an object) precious/high-end
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人擺出高貴、矜持或自命不凡的態度，也可用於形容物品珍貴或昂貴。語氣上常帶有批評或帶輕蔑意味。
explanation_english: Describes a person who puts on an air of superiority or snobbishness; can also describe an item as precious or high-end. Often carries a mildly critical or dismissive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮矜貴，唔肯同人傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 baan6 gan1 gwai3, m4 hang2 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是擺出一副矜貴的樣子，不肯和別人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on an air of snobbishness and won't talk to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件古董好矜貴，要好小心保存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 gu2 dung2 hou2 gan1 gwai3, jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1 bou2 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件古董很珍貴，要好好保存。
examples.english_sentence: This antique is very precious and must be kept carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 矢（shǐ）：本義為箭；亦有誓言、發誓之意，常見於書面語或成語（如矢志、矢口）
english_meaning: 矢: originally 'arrow'; also used in literary contexts to mean 'to vow' or 'to swear' (appears in compounds like 矢志, 矢口)
explanation_mandarin: 「矢」本義為箭，延伸有發誓、立誓的意思，現多見於複合詞或書面語，例如「矢志」（立志）、「矢口否認」（堅決否認）。在口語中單字「矢」不常單獨使用。
explanation_english: Originally meaning 'arrow', 矢 is also used in literary compounds to mean 'to vow' or 'to swear'. Common in written expressions such as 矢志 (to be determined) and 矢口否認 (to vehemently deny). It is seldom used alone in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢矢口否認有參與嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si2 hau2 fau2 jing6 jau5 caam1 jyu5 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他矢口否認有參與那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He vehemently denied participating in that matter.

mandarin_meaning: 断然否认；坚决否认（指对指控或事实坚决不承认）
english_meaning: to flatly deny; to categorically refuse to admit (an accusation or fact)
explanation_mandarin: 堅決否認某項指控或事情的真實性，表示絕不承認。
explanation_english: To emphatically deny an accusation or fact, refusing to admit it under any circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對記者提問，佢矢口否認有份涉案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gei3 ze2 tai4 man6, keoi5 si2 hau2 fau2 jing6 jau5 fan6 sip6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對記者提問，他矢口否認有份涉案。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with reporters' questions, he flatly denied involvement in the case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 即使有證據，佢都矢口否認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 si2 jau5 zing3 geoi3, keoi5 dou1 si2 hau2 fau2 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使有證據，他也矢口否認。
examples.english_sentence: Even with evidence, he still denied it categorically.

mandarin_meaning: 矢志（下定决心）
english_meaning: to vow; to be determined; to resolve
explanation_mandarin: 表示下定決心要做某事，常用於書面或正式語境，帶有堅定意志的語氣。
explanation_english: Indicates a firm determination or vow to do something. Often used in written or formal contexts and conveys resolute intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢矢志要喺三年內攞到博士學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si2 zi3 jiu3 hai2 saam1 nin4 noi6 lo2 dou3 bok3 si6 hok6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他矢志要在三年內取得博士學位。
examples.english_sentence: He is determined to obtain his PhD within three years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋矢志推動可持續發展嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 si2 zi3 teoi1 dung6 ho2 ci4 zuk6 faat3 zin2 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們矢志推動可持續發展的政策。
examples.english_sentence: We are determined to promote policies for sustainable development.

mandarin_meaning: 立志坚定，永不改变；表示意志坚定不动摇
english_meaning: steadfast and unwavering in one's commitment; resolute and unchanging in purpose
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人意志非常堅定，決心不會改變或動搖。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose determination or resolve is firm and will not change or waver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對教學事業矢志不渝，教咗三十年都冇轉行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gaau3 hok6 si6 jip6 si2 zi3 bat1 jyu4, gaau3 zo2 saam1 sap6 nin4 dou1 mou5 zyun2 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對教學事業矢志不渝，教了三十年都沒轉行。
examples.english_sentence: He is unwavering in his commitment to teaching; he has taught for thirty years without changing careers.

mandarin_meaning: 矢志不移（shǐ zhì bù yí）：立志堅定，不會改變或動搖
english_meaning: steadfast; unwavering in one's determination; resolute
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人意志堅定，決心不會改變或被動搖。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose determination is firm and will not change or be shaken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢矢志不移，決心要成為一個好老師，無論遇到幾多困難都唔會放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si2 zi3 bat1 ji4, kyut3 sam1 jiu3 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 hou2 lou5 si1, mou4 leon6 jyu6 dou3 gei2 do1 kwan3 naan4 dou1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他矢志不移，決心要成為一個好老師，無論遇到多少困難都不會放棄。
examples.english_sentence: He is steadfast in his resolve to become a good teacher; no matter how many difficulties he faces, he will not give up.

mandarin_meaning: （文言）表完成、變化或感歎的語助詞，相當於現代漢語的“了”或用於書面語的語氣詞
english_meaning: A classical/literary final particle indicating completion, change of state, or exclamation — similar to the modern Chinese particle 'le' in function (used in literary/styleful contexts).
explanation_mandarin: “矣”是文言文和書面語中常見的句末虛詞，用來表示動作或狀態的完成、變化或強調感歎。在口語粵語中較少用，常見於書面或模仿文言的表達中。
explanation_english: “矣” is a literary final particle used to mark completion, a change of state, or to add an exclamatory tone. It is mostly found in classical or written contexts; in spoken Cantonese it is uncommon and sounds literary or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 事已矣，無謂後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 ji5 ji5, mou4 wai6 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情已經結束了，沒必要後悔。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is already done; there's no need to regret it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做得好矣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 dak1 hou2 ji5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做得很好了！
examples.english_sentence: You've done very well!

mandarin_meaning: 知道；了解；懂
english_meaning: to know; to be aware of; to understand
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物有認識、了解或察覺。
explanation_english: Indicates having knowledge, awareness, or understanding of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知而家幾點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道現在幾點嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know what time it is now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢去咗邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他/她去了哪裡。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know where he/she went.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知點做呢份工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 dim2 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道怎麼做這份工作嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to do this job?

jyutping: zi1 jan4 hau2 min6 bat1 zi1 sam1
mandarin_meaning: 只知道別人的表面（言行/表情），不知道他們的內心想法或動機。
english_meaning: To know a person's outward appearance or words but not their true heart — you can't judge someone's inner thoughts or intentions from appearances.
explanation_mandarin: 形容只看見別人的表面、言行或態度，卻無法看透其真實心思或動機，因此不要僅憑表面判斷一個人。
explanation_english: Describes seeing someone's outward demeanor or words but being unable to perceive their true thoughts or motives; a warning not to judge people solely by appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快信佢，知人口面不知心，佢笑得好親切，但可能有啲企圖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 faai3 seon3 keoi5, zi1 jan4 hau2 min6 bat1 zi1 sam1, keoi5 siu3 dak1 hou2 can1 cit3, daan6 ho2 nang4 jau5 di1 kei5 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那麼快相信他，只看表面看不透人心，他笑得很親切，但可能有些企圖。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him so quickly — you can see his outward smile but not his heart. He seems warm, but he may have ulterior motives.

mandarin_meaning: 能夠正確識別人才並妥善任用
english_meaning: Able to recognize people's strengths and appoint or assign them appropriately; good at selecting and employing the right people
explanation_mandarin: 形容領導者或管理者能夠辨別各人的才能與特長，並把合適的人放在合適的位置上，充分發揮其所長。
explanation_english: Describes a leader or manager who can accurately identify people's talents and place them in suitable roles so they can fully utilize their strengths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司老闆好知人善任，大家都可以發揮所長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lou5 baan2 hou2 zi1 jan4 sin6 jam6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ho2 ji5 faat3 fai1 so2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司老闆很知人善任，大家都能發揮所長。
examples.english_sentence: The company boss is good at recognizing and using people, so everyone can make the most of their strengths.

jyutping: zi1 kei4 jin4, bat1 zi1 kei4 so2 ji5 jin4
mandarin_meaning: 只知道事情的表面現象，卻不知道其原因或道理
english_meaning: To know that something is so but not understand why; to know the facts but not the reasons
explanation_mandarin: 表示只了解事情表面或結果，卻不了解其背後的原因、原則或道理。
explanation_english: Means being aware of the outcome or how to do something superficially, but not understanding the underlying reason, principle, or cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識做嗰啲步驟，知其然，不知其所以然，遇到新問題就束手無策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 zou6 go2 di1 bou6 zau6, zi1 kei4 jin4, bat1 zi1 kei4 so2 ji5 jin4, jyu6 dou3 san1 man6 tai4 zau6 suk1 sau2 mou4 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他會按步驟做，知其然，不知其所以然，遇到新問題就無從應付。
examples.english_sentence: He can follow the steps and knows how things are done, but doesn't understand why, so when a new problem appears he's at a loss.

mandarin_meaning: 知道；得知；知曉（廣東話口語用法，等同「知道」）
english_meaning: to know; to be aware of; to find out (colloquial Cantonese equivalent of '知道')
explanation_mandarin: 「知到」是廣東話口語用語，意思與普通話的「知道/得知」相同，用於表示已經了解或得悉某事。書寫上有時與「知道」互換使用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression equivalent to '知道' (to know). It indicates awareness, understanding, or having found something out. It is commonly used in everyday speech in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知到未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 dou6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱先知到佢已經走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 sin1 zi1 dou6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛才知道他已經走了。
examples.english_sentence: I just found out he had already left.

mandarin_meaning: 知名；著名
english_meaning: well-known; famous
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事物具有一定的知名度或名声，為大眾所熟知。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something has a certain level of recognition or reputation and is widely known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳喺香港好知名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai6 Hoeng1 gong2 hou2 zi1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅在香港很知名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very well-known in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 知名人士 / 知名人物
english_meaning: well-known person; public figure; celebrity
explanation_mandarin: 指在社會上有一定知名度或影響力的人，通常指名人、名流或公眾人物。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is well-known or influential in society, typically a celebrity, public figure, or prominent individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次活動會有好多知名人士出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 wui5 jau5 hou2 do1 zi1 ming4 jan4 si6 ceot1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动会有很多知名人士出席。
examples.english_sentence: There will be many well-known figures attending this event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家係一位國際知名人士，經常出席各種論壇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 jat1 wai2 gwok3 zai3 zi1 ming4 jan4 si6, ging1 seong4 ceot1 zik6 gok3 zung2 leon6 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她现在是一位国际知名人士，经常出席各种论坛。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is now an internationally renowned figure and often attends various forums.

mandarin_meaning: 知名度 (zhīmíngdù)：被大眾知道或認可的程度
english_meaning: degree of fame; how well-known or recognizable something or someone is
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人、品牌或事物被公眾認識或熟悉的程度，常用來衡量人氣或影響力。
explanation_english: Indicates how well-known a person, brand, or thing is; commonly used to measure popularity or public recognition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間新開嘅咖啡店要提升知名度，可以喺社交媒體做宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 san1 hoi1 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dim3 jiu3 tai1 sing1 zi1 ming4 dou6, ho2 ji5 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 zou6 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間新開的咖啡店要提升知名度，可以在社交媒體做宣傳。
examples.english_sentence: This newly opened cafe needs to raise its visibility; it can promote itself on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拍電影嘅時候，演員嘅知名度會影響票房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paak3 din6 jing2 ge3 si4 hau6, jin2 jyun4 ge3 zi1 ming4 dou6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 piu3 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍電影的時候，演員的知名度會影響票房。
examples.english_sentence: When making a movie, an actor's fame can affect box office performance.

mandarin_meaning: 知道味道；（俚語）讓某人嘗到後果、給某人一個教訓
english_meaning: to know the taste; (slang/idiomatic) to give someone a taste of something / teach someone a lesson
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中可指字面意思「知道（某物）的味道」，也常用作俚語，表示讓某人嘗到後果或被教訓，以讓對方知道厲害或收斂。
explanation_english: In Cantonese it can mean literally 'to know the taste' of something. Idiomatically/slang-wise it means to make someone experience the consequences or to teach someone a lesson so they know what's what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係聽人講，自己試吓先會知味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 teng1 jan4 gong2, zi6 gei2 si3 haa5 sin1 wui5 zi1 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只听别人说，自己试一试才会知道味道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just listen to others; try it yourself and you'll know the taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日欺負細路，今次畀人知味道，唔敢再出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hei1 fu6 sai3 lou6, gam1 ci3 bei2 jan4 zi1 mei6 dou6, m4 gam2 zoi6 ceot1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是欺负小孩，这次被人教训了，不敢再出声。
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies the kids; this time he was taught a lesson by someone and didn't dare speak up again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想教訓佢？唔使咁激，慢慢叫佢知味道就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 gaau3 fan3 keoi5? m4 sai2 gam2 gik1, maan6 maan6 giu3 keoi5 zi1 mei6 dou6 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想教训他？不用那么激动，让他慢慢尝到教训就行。
examples.english_sentence: You want to teach him a lesson? No need to be so extreme — just let him gradually learn his lesson.

jyutping: zi1 m4 zi1 go3 sei2 zi6 dim2 se2
mandarin_meaning: 你知道「死」字怎麼寫嗎？（俗用作罵人或叫人去死）
english_meaning: Literally: "Do you know how to write the character '死' (death)?" Colloquially: an insulting/rhetorical phrase meaning "Do you know how to die?" or "Go die."
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語質問/感歎（罵人用語）
explanation_mandarin: 表面上是詢問如何寫「死」字，但常作粗俗罵人用語，意指叫人去死或表示極度不滿。語氣粗魯，不適合正式或禮貌場合，亦可在熟人間開玩笑時使用，需看語境。
explanation_english: Literally asks how to write the character "death," but is typically used as a vulgar insult meaning "go die" or "do you know how to die?" It's rude and offensive — used to tell someone off. Tone and acceptability depend on context (angry or joking among close friends).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日呃我錢，真係想對佢講：知唔知個死字點寫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ngok6 ngo5 cin2, zan1 hai6 soeng2 deoi3 keoi5 gong2: zi1 m4 zi1 go3 sei2 zi6 dim2 se2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是騙我的錢，我真想對他說：你知道「死」字怎麼寫嗎？（此處為罵人、叫人去死的用法）
examples.english_sentence: He keeps scamming me out of money; I really want to tell him: "Do you know how to write the character '死'?" (Here used as an insult meaning "go die")

jyutping: zi1 m4 zi1 go3 cau2 zi6 dim2 se2
mandarin_meaning: 你知道「醜」这个字怎么写吗？
english_meaning: Do you know how to write the character '醜' (ugly)?
explanation_mandarin: 口语用法，用来询问对方是否知道汉字“醜”的写法。既可以是字面上的提问（询问笔画或写法），有时也可作为开玩笑或讽刺对方长相的表达。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese question asking whether someone knows how to write the Chinese character '醜' (meaning 'ugly'). It can be used literally to ask about the character's writing, or jokingly/teasingly to comment on someone's appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知個醜字點寫啊？我想抄低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 go3 cau2 zi6 dim2 se2 aa3? ngo5 soeng2 caau1 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道“醜”这个字怎么写吗？我想抄下来。
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to write the character '醜'? I want to copy it down.

mandarin_meaning: 你應該懂得/要有點自知之明（用來責備或質問對方是否有常識）
english_meaning: You should know better / Have some sense (used to scold or question someone's awareness or common sense)
explanation_mandarin: 口語化的責備或質問用語，用來表示對方應該有常識、察覺或懂得分寸，意即「你應該知道／要有點自知之明」。
explanation_english: A colloquial reproach or rhetorical question used to indicate someone should be aware or have common sense; essentially means 'you should know better' or 'have some sense'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講，知啲唔知啲呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gong2, zi1 di1 m4 zi1 di1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說，有沒有點常識？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any sense saying that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢太過份，應該知啲唔知啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 taai3 gwo3 fan6, jing1 goi1 zi1 di1 m4 zi1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事太過分，應該要懂得分寸。
examples.english_sentence: He's gone too far; he should know better.

mandarin_meaning: 知道了 / 知道
english_meaning: to know; got it; to be aware
explanation_mandarin: 香港粤语口语用词，表示已經知道或明白，語氣常帶有不耐煩或敷衍的意味，類似「我知道了」、「知道吧」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning 'to know' or 'got it'. It indicates awareness or understanding and can carry a tone of impatience or dismissiveness, similar to 'I know' or 'I get it'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知埞，唔洗再講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 doi6, m4 sai2 zoi3 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道了，不用再說了。
examples.english_sentence: I know already, no need to say more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知埞未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 doi6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know yet?

mandarin_meaning: 没有人比父亲更了解孩子
english_meaning: No one knows a child better than (his) father
explanation_mandarin: 這句成語強調父親對子女的了解通常最深，常用來指出父母在教育或判斷孩子時有特殊的了解與權威。
explanation_english: This proverb emphasizes that a father knows his child best; it's used to state that parents (especially fathers) have the deepest understanding and judgement about their children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿公成日話：知子莫若父，父親最了解仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 gung1 sing4 jat6 waa6: zi1 zi2 mok6 joek6 fu6, fu6 can1 zeoi3 liu5 gaai2 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爺爺常說：沒有誰比父親更了解孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa often says: no one knows a child better than his father.

mandarin_meaning: 接待員；負責迎接客人的人（在寺廟中可指掌管接待的僧人）
english_meaning: a person who receives or attends to guests; an usher/host (in temples, a guestmaster monk)
explanation_mandarin: 指負責迎接、招呼來賓或顧客的人。古代或宗教場所（如寺廟）中，知客也可指專門掌管接待事務的僧人或職務。
explanation_english: Refers to someone responsible for receiving and attending to guests or customers. Historically and in religious settings (e.g., temples), it can denote a monk or officer in charge of guest reception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳門口有個知客幫我哋安排座位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 mun4 hau2 jau5 go3 zi1 haak3 bong1 ngo5 dei6 on1 paai4 zo6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐廳門口有個接待員幫我們安排座位。
examples.english_sentence: There was a host at the restaurant entrance who helped us arrange a table.

mandarin_meaning: 知己（指非常了解並且親近的朋友）
english_meaning: bosom friend; close confidant; soulmate
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常了解你、關係親密的朋友；可以傾訴心事、互相理解的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a very close friend who understands you deeply; a confidant or soulmate with whom one can share intimate thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅知己，乜嘢事都可以同佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi1 gei2, mat1 je5 si6 dou1 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的知己，什麼事都可以跟他說。
examples.english_sentence: He is my close friend; I can tell him anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵到一個知己好難，要好珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 dou3 jat1 go3 zi1 gei2 hou2 naan4, jiu3 hou2 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找到一個知己很難，要好好珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to find a true friend; you should cherish them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋雖然係朋友，但佢唔係我嘅知己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jin4 hai6 pang4 jau5, daan6 keoi5 m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi1 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們雖然是朋友，但他不是我的知己。
examples.english_sentence: Although we're friends, he is not my confidant.

mandarin_meaning: 了解自己和對方（或敵人）；出自《孫子兵法》“知彼知己，百戰不殆”。
english_meaning: Know yourself and know your opponent; if you understand both sides, you can succeed in competition or conflict.
explanation_mandarin: 「知己知彼」是指既要了解自己，也要了解對方（尤其是對手）的情況、優劣勢，以便在競爭或對抗中取得優勢。常用作戰略或策劃上的建議。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning one should understand both oneself and the opponent (strengths and weaknesses). It is strategic advice—knowing both sides increases the chance of success. Originates from Sun Tzu's Art of War.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意要知己知彼，了解自己優勢同對手弱點先至有機會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 sang1 ji3 jiu3 zi1 gei2 zi1 bei2, liu5 gaai2 zi6 gei2 jau1 sai3 tung4 deoi3 sau2 joek6 dim2 sin1 zi3 jau5 gei1 wui6 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意要知己知彼，了解自己的優勢和對手的弱點，才有機會成功。
examples.english_sentence: When doing business you must know yourself and your opponent; understanding your advantages and the opponent's weaknesses increases your chance of success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺比賽前，我哋要知己知彼，做好準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 bei2 coi3 cin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zi1 gei2 zi1 bei2, zou6 hou2 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在比賽前，我們要知己知彼，做好準備。
examples.english_sentence: Before the competition, we should know ourselves and our opponents, and prepare well.

mandarin_meaning: 察覺細微之處；注意微小的變化或細節
english_meaning: to perceive subtle details; to be aware of minute changes or nuances
explanation_mandarin: 「知微」常用於書面或文言語境，指能夠察覺或注意到微小、細微的事物或變化，強調敏銳的觀察力與對細節的留意。
explanation_english: A literary/idiomatic expression meaning to perceive or notice subtle, minute things or changes. It emphasizes keen observation and attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個編輯，你要知微，留意每一個字嘅細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wai4 jat1 go3 bin1 zap1, nei5 jiu3 zi1 mei4, lau4 ji3 mui5 jat1 go3 zi6 ge3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為一名編輯，你要能察覺細微，注意每一個字的細節。
examples.english_sentence: As an editor, you need to notice subtle details and pay attention to the nuances of every character.

mandarin_meaning: 反應快且注意細節
english_meaning: quick and attentive to small details; nimble and observant
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人反應靈敏、留意細節且做事麻利，不容易出錯。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is quick to react, pays attention to small details, and works nimbly — unlikely to make mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事知微麻利，老闆好放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 zi1 mei4 maa4 lei6, lou5 baan2 hou2 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事反應快又細心，老闆很放心。
examples.english_sentence: He handles tasks quickly and with attention to detail, so the boss feels reassured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個已經好知微麻利，做事唔會漏位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 hou2 zi1 mei4 maa4 lei6, zou6 si6 m4 wui5 lau6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從小就很機敏又細心，做事不會出錯。
examples.english_sentence: He was attentive and quick from a young age; he doesn't make mistakes when working.

mandarin_meaning: 知心（理解、投契；也指知心朋友）
english_meaning: understanding; intimate; a confidant
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容彼此心意相通、容易互相理解、投契；也可作名詞，指可以傾訴心事、相互理解的朋友或知己。
explanation_english: Describes a close, understanding relationship where people are emotionally in tune; can also be a noun meaning a confidant — someone you can share your feelings with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅知心朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi1 sam1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的知心朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my close friend and confidant.

mandarin_meaning: 知耻 / 有羞耻心（意识到自己的行为有不光彩之处并感到羞愧）
english_meaning: to have a sense of shame; to feel ashamed; to know shame
explanation_mandarin: 表示有羞耻心，意识到自己言行不当而感到羞愧或应当感到羞愧，常用于道德评价或劝诫。
explanation_english: Indicates having a sense of shame—recognizing that one's actions are improper or disgraceful and feeling ashamed. Often used as a moral judgement or admonition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要知恥，先可以改過自新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 zi1 ci2, sin1 ho2 ji5 goi2 gwo3 zi6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要知耻，才能改过自新。
examples.english_sentence: A person should have a sense of shame so they can reform and start anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，仲唔覺得知恥，真係過份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, zung6 m4 gok3 dak1 zi1 ci2, zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是撒谎，还不觉得羞耻，真过分。
examples.english_sentence: He lies all the time and isn't even ashamed—it's really excessive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔知恥咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zi1 ci2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你难道不知耻吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't you feel ashamed?

mandarin_meaning: 知耻近乎勇
english_meaning: To know shame is akin to courage; awareness of shame can motivate brave corrective action.
explanation_mandarin: 出自中國古籍（常見於《孟子》語錄引文），意思是：懂得羞恥的人，其行為接近勇敢。強調有羞恥心可以促使人改正錯誤、表現出道德勇氣。
explanation_english: A classical saying (often attributed in context to Mencius): being aware of shame is close to being brave. It emphasizes that a sense of shame can prompt people to correct mistakes and act with moral courage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺比賽失誤後，佢覺得知恥近乎勇，主動向隊友道歉並加倍練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 bei2 coi3 sat1 ng6 hau6, keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi1 ci2 gan6 fu1 jung5, zyu2 dung6 hoeng3 deoi6 jau5 dou6 hip3 bing6 gaa1 bui3 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在比賽失誤後，他覺得知耻近乎勇，主動向隊友道歉並加倍練習。
examples.english_sentence: After making a mistake in the match, he felt that to know shame is close to courage, so he proactively apologized to his teammates and doubled his practice.

synonyms: 知耻近乎勇 (普通話書寫)

mandarin_meaning: 知恩图报（感激別人的恩惠並設法報答）
english_meaning: to be grateful for a kindness and seek to repay it; to remember favors and return them
explanation_mandarin: 表示對別人的恩惠心存感激，並努力報答對方。屬於四字成語，常用來形容知恩並有回報之意。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to feel grateful for someone's kindness and to try to repay it. It describes the attitude of remembering favors and returning them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當年救過我一命，我會永遠知恩圖報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1nin4 gau3 gwo3 ngo5 jat1 ming6, ngo5 wui5 wing5jyun5 zi1 jan1 tou4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當年救過我一命，我會永遠知恩圖報。
examples.english_sentence: He saved my life back then; I will always be grateful and repay his kindness.

mandarin_meaning: 知道別人的恩惠並懷有感激之情，願意報答或銘記
english_meaning: to recognize and be grateful for someone's kindness; to feel indebted and appreciative
explanation_mandarin: 表示懂得別人的恩惠並懷有感激之情，常含有願意報答或長久銘記的意思，屬較正式或書面語用法。
explanation_english: Indicates recognizing and feeling grateful for someone's kindness, often implying a willingness to repay or remember it; a relatively formal or literary expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知恩感戴，時刻銘記師父嘅教誨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 jan1 gam2 daai3, si4 hak1 ming4 gei3 si1 fu6 ge3 gaau3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知恩感戴，時刻銘記師父的教誨。
examples.english_sentence: He is grateful and always remembers his teacher's teachings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要知恩感戴，唔好忘記別人對我哋嘅幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zi1 jan1 gam2 daai3, m4 hou2 mong4 gei3 bit6 jan4 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要知恩感戴，不要忘記別人對我們的幫助。
examples.english_sentence: We should be grateful and not forget the help others have given us.

mandarin_meaning: 知悉（知道、獲悉）
english_meaning: to be informed of; to acknowledge receipt; to know
explanation_mandarin: 表示知道或獲悉某事，常用於正式或書面語，用來表明已收到信息或了解情況。
explanation_english: Indicates being aware of or having been informed of something. Commonly used in formal or written contexts to acknowledge receipt of information or understanding of a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅通知，我已知悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 tung1 zi1, ngo5 ji5 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你的通知，我已經知悉。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for the notice — I've noted it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到電郵後，請回覆話你已知悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 din6 jau4 hau6, ceng2 wui4 fuk1 waa6 nei5 ji5 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到郵件後，請回覆說你已知悉。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the email, please reply saying that you have acknowledged it.

mandarin_meaning: 知情；了解內情；被告知情況
english_meaning: to be informed; to know the situation; to be aware of the facts
explanation_mandarin: 表示知道事情的情況或被告知內情；可用作動詞或描述狀態的形容詞，指對某事有了解或知悉內幕。
explanation_english: Indicates being informed or aware of the circumstances; can be used as a verb or a stative adjective meaning to know the facts or be 'in the know'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我已經知情喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 zi1 cing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我已经知情了。
examples.english_sentence: I already know about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個知情人士，應該知道內幕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 zi1 cing4 jan4 si6, jing1 goi1 zi1 dou3 noi6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个知情人士，应该知道内幕。
examples.english_sentence: He's someone in the know and should know the inside story.

mandarin_meaning: 知情不报
english_meaning: to know about something but not report it / to withhold information
explanation_mandarin: 表示明明知道事情或情況，卻不向有關方面或當局報告，通常帶有責備或負面含義（暗示隱瞞或包庇）。
explanation_english: Indicates being aware of a fact or situation but failing to inform the relevant parties or authorities; often carries a negative or blaming connotation (implying concealment or shielding).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知件事，但係知情不報，結果害咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi1 gin6 si6, daan6 hai6 zi1 cing4 bat1 bou3, git3 gwo2 hoi6 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道这件事，但知情不报，结果害了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knew about the matter but didn't report it, and as a result harmed many people.

mandarin_meaning: 知情权；獲得與自身或公眾相關資訊的權利
english_meaning: the right to information / the right to know
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或公眾獲取與事件、政策或影響其權益相關資訊的權利，常見於新聞自由、政府透明度與資訊公開等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the right of individuals or the public to obtain information related to events, policies, or matters affecting their interests; commonly used in contexts of press freedom, government transparency, and information disclosure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民有知情權，政府應該公開相關資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 jau5 zi1 cing4 kyun4, zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 gung1 hoi1 soeng1 gwaan1 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民有知情权，政府应该公开相关资料。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens have the right to information; the government should disclose the relevant data.

mandarin_meaning: 懂得節約、節儉
english_meaning: knowing how to be thrifty and economical; frugal
explanation_mandarin: 形容人懂得節約、節儉，不浪費金錢或資源。
explanation_english: Describes a person who knows how to save and be economical, not wasteful with money or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽從細教佢要知慳識儉，唔好亂花錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 cung4 sai3 gaau3 keoi5 jiu3 zi1 haan1 sik1 gim2, m4 hou2 lyun6 faa1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽從小教他要懂得節約，不要亂花錢。
