examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to build my own PC — not only to save money, but also to choose the components I like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司IT部今朝幫我砌機，同埋安裝好所有驅動程式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 IT bou6 gam1 ziu1 bong1 ngo5 cai3 gei1, tung4 maai4 on1 zong1 hou2 so2 jau5 keoi1 dung6 cing4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的IT部今天早上幫我組裝了電腦，並安裝好了所有驅動程式。
examples.english_sentence: The company's IT department assembled the computer for me this morning and installed all the drivers.

mandarin_meaning: 陷害、設局栽贓（某人）
english_meaning: to set someone up; to frame someone by arranging false evidence or a compromising situation
explanation_mandarin: 「砌生豬肉」是香港廣東話俚語，指有人設計、捏造情況或證據，讓別人受牽連或被指控；即陷害或栽贓。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase meaning to arrange or fabricate a situation or evidence to make someone look guilty or get them into trouble — in short, to frame or set someone up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己冇做嘢，點知竟然俾人砌生豬肉畀老細，結果畀炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 je5, dim2 zi1 ging2 jin4 bei2 jan4 cai3 saang1 zyu1 juk6 bei2 lou5 sai3, git3 gwo2 bei2 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己沒做，但竟然被人陷害交給老闆，結果被炒了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he didn't do it, but someone set him up in front of the boss and he ended up getting fired.

mandarin_meaning: 砌砖 (qì zhuān)；比喻逐步搭建、做繁重或重複的工作
english_meaning: to lay bricks; (figurative) to build something brick by brick; to do tedious/repetitive/manual work
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是砌磚、從事砌磚的建築工作；引申可指逐步建立（如「一步一步砌磚」）或形容枯燥、重複的體力或例行工作。
explanation_english: Literally 'to lay bricks' (bricklaying). Figuratively it can mean to build something step by step (brick by brick) or to do tedious, repetitive, manual work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺工地度砌磚，做緊好辛苦嘅體力活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 dei6 dou6 cai3 zyun1, zou6 gan2 hou2 san1 fu2 ge3 tai2 lik6 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在工地砌砖，正在做很辛苦的体力活。
examples.english_sentence: He's laying bricks at the construction site, doing very hard manual work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業初期，我哋一步一步砌磚，慢慢建立起公司嘅基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 co1 kei4, ngo5 dei6 jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 cai3 zyun1, maan6 maan6 gin3 laap6 hei2 gung1 si1 ge3 gei1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创业初期，我们一步一步砌砖，慢慢建立公司的基础。
examples.english_sentence: In the early stage of the startup, we're building the company's foundation brick by brick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意做啲砌磚式嘅工作，就係日日重複同一樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 zou6 di1 cai3 zyun1 sik1 ge3 gung1 zok3, zau6 hai6 jat6 jat6 cung4 fuk1 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢做那种“砌砖式”的工作，就是每天重复同样的事。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like doing those 'bricklaying-style' jobs — doing the same thing over and over every day.

mandarin_meaning: （玩）搭积木／玩积木
english_meaning: to play with building blocks; to assemble toy blocks (e.g. Lego)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把積木組合起來，常指兒童玩耍時搭建玩具積木，也可用於口語中描述組裝類似的小物件。
explanation_english: Literally 'assemble building blocks.' Commonly refers to children playing with toy blocks (such as Lego). In colloquial use it can also describe assembling small parts or putting pieces together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友鍾意砌積木，成日可以砌幾個鐘頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 ji3 cai3 zik1 muk6, sing4 jat6 ho2 ji5 cai3 gei2 go3 zung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友喜欢玩积木，经常可以玩好几个小时。
examples.english_sentence: Children like to play with building blocks; they can often play for hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人周末會一齊砌積木。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zau1 mut6 wui5 jat1 cai4 cai3 zik1 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人周末会一起搭积木。
examples.english_sentence: Their family will build with blocks together on the weekend.

mandarin_meaning: 编造借口/敷衍的话语
english_meaning: to make up excuses; to fabricate explanations or talk one's way out of something
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“砌辭”指拼凑或编造话语（通常是借口或托词），用来搪塞、推脱责任或应付他人。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '砌辭' means to cobble together words—usually fabricating excuses or evasive statements—to fend off responsibility or to talk one's way out of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日砌辭，唔肯承認錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 cai3 ci4, m4 hang2 sing4 jing6 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是编造理由，不肯承认错误。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes up excuses and refuses to admit his mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣佢試咗砌辭，想掩飾自己冇經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6 keoi5 si3 zo2 cai3 ci4, soeng2 jim2 sik1 zi6 gei2 mou5 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试时他试图编造话术，想掩盖自己没有经验。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview he tried to fabricate his answers to hide his lack of experience.

mandarin_meaning: 砍 (kǎn)：劈、砍、切；也指砍價（討價還價）或比喻性地裁減（如砍人、砍預算）。
english_meaning: to chop or cut (with a blade/axe); to haggle (in compounds like '砍價'); metaphorically, to cut/reduce (e.g., staff, budgets).
explanation_mandarin: 表示用刀、斧等工具把物件劈開或削減；口語中常見於「砍價」（討價還價），也可比喻為裁減人手或削減預算。
explanation_english: Denotes cutting or chopping with a tool (knife/axe); commonly appears in colloquial compounds like '砍價' (to haggle) and can be used metaphorically to mean cutting/reducing (staff, budgets).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用斧頭砍開咗塊木頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 fu2 tau4 ham2 hoi1 zo2 faai3 muk6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用斧头把那块木头砍开了。
examples.english_sentence: He chopped that piece of wood open with an axe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺街市佢同鋪頭砍價，最後平咗三十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gaai1 si5 keoi5 tung4 pou3 tau4 ham2 gaa3, zeoi3 hau6 ping4 zo2 saam1 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在街市他跟店主砍价，最后便宜了三十块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He bargained with the shopkeeper at the market and saved thirty dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗減成本，最近要砍走啲人手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 gam2 sing4 bun2, zeoi3 gan6 jiu3 ham2 zau2 di1 jan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司为了削减成本，最近要裁减一部分人手。
examples.english_sentence: The company, to cut costs, is going to cut some staff.

mandarin_meaning: 砍伐（kǎnfá）：砍倒或砍去樹木，指伐木或砍掉植物的行為。
english_meaning: to fell; to cut down (trees); to chop or fell vegetation; logging.
explanation_mandarin: 指用工具或機械將樹木砍倒或削減，常見於描述伐木、林業或環境破壞等情境，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Refers to cutting down or felling trees or chopping vegetation, often used in contexts of logging, forestry, or environmental impact; a more formal term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府禁止喺保護區內砍伐樹木。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gam2 zi2 hai2 bou2 wu6 keoi1 noi6 ham2 faat3 syu6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府禁止在保護區內砍伐樹木。
examples.english_sentence: The government prohibits cutting down trees in the protected area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人偷偷入咗森林砍伐樹木，結果被發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 tau1 jap6 zo2 sam1 lam4 ham2 faat3 syu6 muk6, git3 gwo2 bei6 faat3 jin4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人偷偷闖入森林砍伐樹木，結果被發現了。
examples.english_sentence: Some people secretly entered the forest to cut down trees and were discovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋靠砍伐樹木維生，但咁樣會破壞生態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kaau3 ham2 faat3 syu6 muk6 wai4 saang1, daan6 gam2 joeng6 wui5 po3 waai6 sang1 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們靠砍伐樹木維生，但這樣會破壞生態。
examples.english_sentence: They rely on cutting down trees to make a living, but this will damage the ecosystem.

mandarin_meaning: 把已做的部分全部刪掉，重新開始；徹底重做
english_meaning: to scrap and start over; to abandon the previous work and redo it from scratch
explanation_mandarin: 口語化的說法，表示把現有的作品、計劃或程式等全部砍掉，從頭徹底重新做起。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression meaning to remove what has been done and redo something completely from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計唔掂，砍掉重練啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 m4 dim6, ham2 diu6 cung4 lin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個設計不行，砍掉重練吧。
examples.english_sentence: This design doesn't work — scrap it and start over.

mandarin_meaning: （罕用字）指小石块、石片或石器的一部分，亦见于古文、人名或地名中
english_meaning: A rare character referring to a small piece of stone or a fragment/part of a stone tool; occasionally appears in historical texts, names or inscriptions
explanation_mandarin: 砐為罕見漢字，常見於古籍、墓誌或人名地名的用字，通常表示石頭的小碎片或石器的零件。
explanation_english: A rare Chinese character mainly seen in historical records or names. It typically denotes a small stone fragment or part of a stone implement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺古墓入面見到一塊刻有「砐」字嘅石片，好罕見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gu2 mou6 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 jat1 faai3 hak1 jau5 「ngok6」zi6 ge3 sek6 pin3, hou2 hon2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在古墓里看到一块刻有「砐」字的石片，很罕见。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a shard of stone in the tomb carved with the character '砐' — very rare.

mandarin_meaning: 砒：表示砷或含砷的物质（常见于化学名词，如砒霜）。
english_meaning: Arsenic; denotes arsenic or arsenic-containing substances (commonly used in chemical compounds like 'arsenic trioxide').
explanation_mandarin: “砒”通常用于化学术语中，表示与砷有关的元素或化合物，常见于词语如“砒霜”（砷的氧化物/三氧化二砷）。單獨使用較少，更多出現在複合詞中。
explanation_english: The character refers to arsenic or arsenic-containing substances and is mainly used in chemical terms. It appears most often in compounds (e.g., '砒霜' — arsenic trioxide) and is rarely used alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化驗報告話樣本入面搵到砒，懷疑係砒霜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 jim6 bou3 gou3 waa6 joeng6 bun2 jap6 min6 wan2 dou3 pei1, waai4 ji4 hai6 pei1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化验报告说在样本中检出砒，怀疑是砒霜。
examples.english_sentence: The lab report says arsenic was detected in the sample; it is suspected to be arsenic trioxide (arsenous oxide).

mandarin_meaning: 砒霜（即三氧化二砷），一种剧毒化合物
english_meaning: Arsenic trioxide (a highly toxic compound); figuratively, something deadly or ruinous
explanation_mandarin: 砒霜（化学名三氧化二砷）为白色结晶性剧毒物质，能致命，历史上曾用于农药或医药但因毒性大已受限制；在比喻用法中指会造成严重伤害或毁灭性的事物。
explanation_english: Arsenic trioxide (chemical name: arsenic trioxide) is a white crystalline, highly poisonous substance capable of causing death; historically used in pesticides or medicines but now restricted due to toxicity. Figuratively, it describes something that is destructive or ruinous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺案發現場搵到少量砒霜，正喺調查來源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2fong1 hai2 ngon6faat3 jin6coeng4 wan2 dou3 siu2 loeng6 pei1 soeng1, zing3 hai2 diu6caat3 loeng4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在案发现场发现少量砒霜，正在调查来源。
examples.english_sentence: Police found a small amount of arsenic trioxide at the crime scene and are investigating its source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲流言對佢嘅事業就好似砒霜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lau4 jin4 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 zau6 hou2 ci5 pei1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些流言对他的事业就像砒霜。
examples.english_sentence: These rumors are like arsenic to his career.

mandarin_meaning: 研（yán）：研磨；研究、钻研
english_meaning: to grind; to research; to study; to investigate
explanation_mandarin: 表示磨碎、研磨的动作，或引申為探索、研究、钻研。在合成词（如“研究”、“研發”）中常读作yán。
explanation_english: Denotes the action of grinding or milling, and by extension to research, study, or investigate. In compounds like "研究" and "研發" it commonly has the pronunciation /yán/ in Mandarin and corresponds to Cantonese readings ngaan4 or jin4 depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要研究呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4 gau3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要研究这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to research/investigate this issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥要研成粉先用得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 jiu3 ngaan4 sing4 fan2 sin1 jung6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些药要研成粉才能使用。
examples.english_sentence: These medicines need to be ground into powder before use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家喺研發新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 hai2 jin4 faat3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司现在在研发新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently researching/developing a new product.

mandarin_meaning: 研发 (yánfā) — 研究与开发
english_meaning: research and development (R&D); to research and develop
explanation_mandarin: 「研發」是「研究與開發」的簡稱，指從事技術、產品或工藝的研究與開發工作，常用於企業或科研單位。
explanation_english: "研發" is the abbreviation of "research and development"; it refers to activities of researching and developing technologies, products, or processes, commonly used in companies and research institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司主要做電子產品嘅研發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 zyu2ji3 zou6 din6zi2 caan2ban2 ge3 jin4faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司主要做電子產品的研發。
examples.english_sentence: This company mainly does R&D for electronic products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司喺研發部做緊一個新項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1si1 hai6 jin4faat3 bou6 zou6 gan2 jat1 go3 san1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司在研發部做一個新項目。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is working on a new project in the R&D department.

mandarin_meaning: 研究 (yánjiū)：作动词或名词，表示对某一课题进行系统性的调查、分析与探索。
english_meaning: research; to research; to study — systematic investigation or study of a topic.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某个问题或领域进行深入调查、分析或实验，以获得新知或解决问题。可用作动词（研究某事）或名词（做研究）。
explanation_english: Refers to the systematic investigation, analysis, or study of a topic or problem to gain knowledge or solve issues. Can be used as a verb (to research) or as a noun (research).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要研究呢個問題嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4gau3 ni1 go3 man6tai4 ge3 jyun4jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要研究这个问题的原因。
examples.english_sentence: We need to research/study the cause of this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學做研究，專門研究人工智能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6hok6 zou6 jin4gau3, zyun1mun4 jin4gau3 jan4gung1 zi6nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学做研究，专门研究人工智能。
examples.english_sentence: He does research at university, specializing in artificial intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報告係我哋研究嘅成果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3gou3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 jin4gau3 ge3 sing4gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报告是我们研究的成果。
examples.english_sentence: This report is the result of our research.

mandarin_meaning: 研究所（從事科學、學術或技術研究的機構；在台灣也指大學的研究生院或研究所）
english_meaning: research institute; (in Taiwan) a graduate institute/graduate school program
explanation_mandarin: 指專門從事科學、學術或技術研究的單位或機構。在台灣語境中，研究所亦常指大學裡的研究生班或研究生院（碩士、博士階段）。
explanation_english: An institution that conducts scientific, academic, or technical research. In Taiwanese usage, it can also refer to a university graduate institute (program for master's or doctoral studies).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺研究所做研究助理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jin4 gau3 so2 zou6 jin4 gau3 zo6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在研究所當研究助理。
examples.english_sentence: I'm working as a research assistant at a research institute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間研究所專門研究人工智能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jin4 gau3 so2 zyun1 mun4 jin4 gau3 jan4 gung1 zi6 neng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間研究所專門研究人工智慧。
examples.english_sentence: This research institute specializes in artificial intelligence research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考咗入研究所，計劃繼續讀碩士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 zo2 jap6 jin4 gau3 so2, gai3 waak6 gai3 zuk6 duk6 sok3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了研究所，計劃繼續讀碩士。
examples.english_sentence: He got into a graduate institute and plans to continue for a master's degree.

mandarin_meaning: 研究生
english_meaning: graduate student; postgraduate student (master's or doctoral student)
explanation_mandarin: 指在大學或研究機構攻讀碩士或博士學位的學生。
explanation_english: A student pursuing graduate-level studies (master's or doctoral degree) after completing undergraduate education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係研究生，喺大學讀緊碩士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 jin4 gau3 saang1, hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 gan2 suk3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是研究生，在大學讀碩士。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently a graduate student, studying for a master's at university.

mandarin_meaning: 研究院 (yán jiū yuàn)，从事学术或技术研究的机构
english_meaning: research institute; academy
explanation_mandarin: 指從事學術、技術或應用研究的機構，通常下設多個研究小組或實驗室，專注某些專業領域的研究與開發。
explanation_english: An institution dedicated to academic, technical, or applied research, typically housing multiple research teams or laboratories focused on specific fields of study or development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司打算同一間研究院合作一個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 tung4 jat1 gaan1 jin4-gau3-jyun6 hap6-zok3 jat1 go3 hong6-muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司打算與一家研究院合作一個項目。
examples.english_sentence: Our company plans to collaborate with a research institute on a project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺研究院做博士後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jin4-gau3-jyun6 zou6 bok3-si6-hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在研究院做博士後研究員。
examples.english_sentence: He is a postdoctoral researcher at a research institute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有幾間著名嘅研究院專注人工智能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1-gong2 jau5 gei2 gaan1 zoek3-ming4 ge3 jin4-gau3-jyun6 zyun1-zyu3 jan4-gung1 zi6-nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有幾所著名的研究院專注於人工智能。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has several well-known research institutes that focus on artificial intelligence.

mandarin_meaning: 研習（研究、學習）
english_meaning: to study; to research and learn; to study intensively
explanation_mandarin: 表示研究或學習某個領域或內容，強調鑽研或系統性地學習，常見於書面語或正式場合。
explanation_english: Indicates researching or studying a subject or material, often implying in-depth or systematic learning; commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期要研習新嘅教學方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 jin4 zaap6 san1 ge3 gaau3 hok6 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下星期要研習新的教學方法。
examples.english_sentence: We will study/research new teaching methods next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對歷史好有興趣，經常研習古代文獻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 lik6 si2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, ging1 soeng4 jin4 zaap6 gu2 doi6 man4 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對歷史很有興趣，經常研習古代文獻。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in history and often studies ancient documents.

mandarin_meaning: 研究船（用於科學研究或海洋考察的船艇）
english_meaning: research vessel (a ship used for scientific research or marine expeditions)
explanation_mandarin: 「研船」為「研究船」的縮略說法，指用於海洋、氣象、地質等科學考察或研究用途的專門船隻，配備相關儀器與設備。
explanation_english: “研船” is an abbreviated form of “research vessel,” referring to a ship equipped for scientific research or marine expeditions (e.g., oceanography, meteorology, geology) with specialized instruments and equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條研船今日出海做科學考察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 jin4 syun4 gam1 jat6 ceot1 hoi2 zou6 fo1 hok6 haau2 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那艘研究船今天出海進行科學考察。
examples.english_sentence: That research vessel went out to sea today to conduct scientific research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係做海洋科學嘅，經常要上研船工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zou6 hoi2 joeng4 fo1 hok6 ge3, ging1 soeng4 jiu3 soeng5 jin4 syun4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從事海洋科學，經常需要上研究船工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works in marine science and often needs to go on research vessels for work.

mandarin_meaning: 研制（研究并制造、开发）
english_meaning: to research and develop; to design and manufacture
explanation_mandarin: 指對新產品、設備或技術進行研究並進一步製造或開發。
explanation_english: To conduct research and then manufacture or develop new products, equipment, or technologies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司研製咗一款新型電池。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jin4 zai3 zo2 jat1 fun2 san1 jing4 din6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司研制了一款新型电池。
examples.english_sentence: This company developed a new type of battery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 研製新產品需要大量測試同改良。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin4 zai3 san1 caan2 ban2 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 loeng6 cak1 si3 tung4 goi2 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 研制新产品需要大量测试和改良。
examples.english_sentence: Developing new products requires extensive testing and refinement.

mandarin_meaning: 研讨（研究並討論）
english_meaning: to study and discuss; to discuss; (noun) seminar/discussion
explanation_mandarin: 指對某個議題或問題進行研究並交換意見、討論；亦可指以討論為主的會議（如研討會）。
explanation_english: To investigate and discuss a topic or issue; also used for discussion-based meetings or seminars (e.g., '研討會').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期會舉行一個研討會，討論新政策嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 geoi2 hang4 jat1 go3 jin4 tou2 wui2, tou2 leon6 san1 zing3 caak3 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下星期會舉行一個研討會，討論新政策的影響。
examples.english_sentence: We will hold a seminar next week to discuss the impact of the new policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師希望學生能夠積極參與課堂研討。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hei1 mong6 hok6 saang1 nang4 gau3 zik1 gik6 caam1 jyu5 fo3 tong4 jin4 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師希望學生能夠積極參與課堂研討。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher hopes students will actively participate in class discussions.

mandarin_meaning: 研讨会（学术或专业性的会议）
english_meaning: seminar; symposium; conference (a meeting for discussion and exchange on a specific topic)
explanation_mandarin: 指專家、學者或相關人員就某一主題進行報告、演講與討論的會議或聚會，通常以交流研究成果或意見為目的。
explanation_english: A meeting or conference where experts, scholars, or professionals present, discuss, and exchange ideas on a specific topic; typically involves presentations and discussion sessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜有個研討會，要準備簡報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 go3 jin4 tou2 wui6, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 gaan2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個禮拜有一個研討會，要準備簡報。
examples.english_sentence: I have a seminar next week and need to prepare a presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個研討會主要討論人工智能嘅應用同挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jin4 tou2 wui6 zyu2 jiu3 tou2 leon6 jan4 gung1 zi6 nang4 ge3 jing3 jung6 tung4 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個研討會主要討論人工智能的應用和挑戰。
examples.english_sentence: This seminar mainly discusses applications and challenges of artificial intelligence.

mandarin_meaning: fá（多見於「砝碼」，指用於天平或秤上的配重物）
english_meaning: weight (a small calibrated mass used on a balance or scale; part of the compound 砝码)
explanation_mandarin: 「砝」本字少見，常見於合成詞「砝碼」，指用於天平或秤上作校準或配重的小塊重量。
explanation_english: The character 砝 is uncommon on its own and typically appears in the compound 砝碼, referring to small calibrated weights used to balance or calibrate scales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲砝碼唔夠，我哋要加多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faa3 maa5 m4 gau3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些砝码不够，我们要加多一些。
examples.english_sentence: These weights aren't enough; we need to add more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 技師用砝碼去校秤，確保量度準確。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei6 si1 jung6 faa3 maa5 heoi3 gaau3 cang4, kok3 bou2 loeng6 dou6 zeon2 kok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 技师用砝码去校秤，确保测量准确。
examples.english_sentence: The technician used weights to calibrate the scale to ensure accurate measurements.

mandarin_meaning: 砝码：放在天平或称上用于称重或校准的标准重量；也可指用作配重的砝码。
english_meaning: weight (for scales); calibration weight; counterweight used to measure or balance scales.
explanation_mandarin: 指放在天平或稱上用作稱重或校準的標準重量。常見材質有鋼或銅，標示克、毫克等規格；有時也泛指用作配重的物件。
explanation_english: Refers to standardized weights placed on a balance or scale for measuring mass or calibrating the instrument. Commonly made of metal (steel, brass) and marked in grams/milligrams; can also mean a counterweight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺化驗室度要用精密嘅砝碼去校秤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 faa3jim6sat1 dou6 jiu3 jung6 zing1mat6 ge3 faa3maa5 heoi3 haau6 cang3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在化驗室裡需要用精密的砝碼來校準天平。
examples.english_sentence: In the laboratory, precise weights are needed to calibrate the balance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲砝碼有一克、五克、十克等幾種，可以用嚟秤細嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faa3maa5 jau5 jat1 hak1, ng5 hak1, sap6 hak1 dang2 gei2 zung2, ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 cang3 sai3 je5
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些砝碼有一克、五克、十克等幾種，可以用來稱量小件物品。
examples.english_sentence: These weights come in 1g, 5g, 10g, etc., and can be used to weigh small items.

mandarin_meaning: 塊狀的重物；用作配重或稱重的錘塊（如鐵砣、鉛砣）
english_meaning: a lump or block used as a weight or sinker (e.g., iron lump, lead sinker); a chunk or mass
explanation_mandarin: 指塊狀的重物，常用作配重、稱重或墜物，例如釣魚用的鉛砣或工用的鐵砣。有時也泛指一塊塊的東西。
explanation_english: Refers to a lump or block of heavy material commonly used as a weight, sinker, or counterweight (e.g., fishing sinker, iron lump). It can also generically mean a chunk or mass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊鐵砣好重，搬唔動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 tit3 to4 hou2 zung6, baan1 m4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊鐵砣很重，搬不動。
examples.english_sentence: This iron lump is very heavy; I can't move it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 釣魚要帶幾個砣做配重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: diu3 jyu4 jiu3 daai3 gei2 go3 to4 zou6 pui3 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 釣魚要帶幾個砣作配重。
examples.english_sentence: When fishing, you need to bring a few sinkers to act as weights.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語口語、俗語）用作強調語氣，表示「非常／極度」，有時帶粗俗或輕蔑色彩，屬地區性用法。
english_meaning: A colloquial Cantonese intensifier meaning 'very/extremely'; sometimes coarse or derogatory and regionally used.
explanation_mandarin: 砣地為粵語俗語，常置於形容詞或動詞之後以加強語氣，表示程度很高或帶強烈情緒色彩。此詞屬口語且帶地區性與非正式性，書面語少用。
explanation_english: 砣地 is a Cantonese colloquial/vernacular term used after adjectives or verbs to intensify meaning, indicating a very high degree or strong emotion. It is informal, regionally used, and can carry coarse or derogatory nuance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件牛仔褲貴到砣地，我唔會買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 ngau4 zai2 fu3 gwai3 dou3 tou4 dei6, ngo5 m4 wui5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條牛仔褲貴得要命，我不會買。
examples.english_sentence: Those jeans are ridiculously expensive — I won't buy them.

mandarin_meaning: 字面意思為「沉重或笨拙的手錶」。此詞罕見，可能為口語或誤寫/俗用，並非標準書面詞彙。
english_meaning: Literally "lump/watch" — refers to a heavy or clunky watch. Rare/obscure usage, possibly a colloquial or nonstandard term.
explanation_mandarin: 「砣」本意為塊狀的重物，「錶」指手錶。合在一起多以字面理解指沉重、笨拙的手錶。此詞在粵語中較罕見，可能是口語慣用或誤寫，並非通用成語或固定搭配。
explanation_english: The character 砣 means a lump or weight and 錶 means watch. Together it is typically understood literally as a heavy or clunky watch. The term is uncommon in Cantonese and may reflect colloquial, regional, or nonstandard usage rather than a fixed idiom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗰隻砣錶真係好重，戴唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go2 zek3 to4 biu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 zung6, daai3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那只砣錶真的很重，戴不住。
examples.english_sentence: That watch of yours is really heavy; it's uncomfortable to wear.

mandarin_meaning: 砥（dǐ）：磨刀石；磨礪、磨練；（常見於成語如“砥柱中流”）
english_meaning: dǐ: whetstone; to hone or sharpen; to encourage or serve as a steadfast pillar (as in idiom "砥柱中流")
explanation_mandarin: “砥”原指用來磨刀的石頭（砥石），引申為磨練、激勵或比喻堅定的支柱（如“砥柱中流”）。常見於書面語或成語中。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a whetstone used to sharpen blades; extended meanings include to hone or discipline oneself and a metaphor for a steadfast pillar (as in the idiom "砥柱中流"). Often appears in written or idiomatic expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋嘅砥柱中流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zi2 zyu6 zung1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们的砥柱中流。
examples.english_sentence: He is our pillar of strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅用砥石砥刀，令刀刃變得好鋒利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu6 jung6 zi2 sek6 zi2 dou1, ling6 dou1 jam5 bin3 dak1 hou2 fung1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅用砥石磨刀，使刀刃变得很锋利。
examples.english_sentence: The master used a whetstone to sharpen the knife, making the blade very sharp.

mandarin_meaning: 砥礪（dǐ lì）：磨練、勉勵；比喻自我砥礪或互相勉勵，使品質或才能得到鍛鍊與提升。
english_meaning: To sharpen and encourage; to temper or improve oneself (or one another) through hardship and effort; to strive and make progress.
explanation_mandarin: 原指用砥石、礪石磨利，比喻經過磨鍊或互相鼓勵而使品行或能力增進。常見於書面語或成語，如「砥礪前行」。
explanation_english: Originally refers to sharpening with whetstones; figuratively means to improve or temper oneself (or encourage each other) through practice and hardship. Commonly used in literary or idiomatic contexts (e.g., "砥礪前行").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢段日子，我哋要互相砥礪，繼續向前行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 dyun6 jat6 zi2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 di2 lai6, gai3 zuk6 hoeng3 cin4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這段日子，我們要互相砥礪，繼續向前行。
examples.english_sentence: During this period, we should encourage and spur one another on and continue moving forward.

mandarin_meaning: 寨；小型防禦工事或有圍牆的聚落
english_meaning: stockade; small fort; fortified settlement
explanation_mandarin: 指用來防禦的小型防禦工事或被圍護起來的聚落，常見於古代或軍事用途。可與「寨」「堡」等詞互換視情況而定。
explanation_english: Refers to a small defensive structure or an enclosed settlement used for protection—essentially a stockade or small fort—commonly seen in historical or military contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座古老嘅砦已經變成旅遊景點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 gu2 lou5 ge3 zaai6 ji5 ging1 bin3 sing4 leoi5 jau4 ging2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座古老的寨子已經變成旅遊景點。
examples.english_sentence: That old fort has already become a tourist attraction.

mandarin_meaning: 砧（如砧板、鐵砧）
english_meaning: anvil; chopping block; cutting board (as in compounds like 'cutting board')
explanation_mandarin: 「砧」指用來敲打或切割時所用的砧臺、砧板或鐵砧等器物，常見於廚房或金屬加工的語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to a block or base used for pounding, chopping, or hammering—such as a cutting board in the kitchen or an anvil in metalwork. Often appears in compounds like '砧板' (cutting board).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊砧板已經好殘舊，要換一塊新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 zam1 baan2 ji5 ging1 hou2 caan4 gau6, jiu3 wun6 jat1 faai3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊砧板已經很破舊，要換一塊新的。
examples.english_sentence: This cutting board is already very worn; it needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 砧板（切菜、切肉用的木板或塑料板）
english_meaning: chopping board; cutting board
explanation_mandarin: 砧板是廚房常用的平板，用來切菜、切肉或處理其他食材，材質可為木、塑料或竹等。
explanation_english: A flat board commonly used in the kitchen for cutting vegetables, meat, and other ingredients; typically made of wood, plastic, or bamboo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有兩塊砧板，一塊切生肉，一塊切蔬菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 loeng5 faai3 zam1 baan2, jat1 faai3 cit3 saang1 juk6, jat1 faai3 cit3 so1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里面有两块砧板，一块切生肉，一块切蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: There are two cutting boards in the kitchen: one for cutting raw meat and one for cutting vegetables.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：砧板上的蚂蚁；引申：被人欺负、任人摆布、像“任人宰割”的弱者或爛好人
english_meaning: Literally “chopping-board ant”; figuratively a person who is bullied or treated like a doormat/a pushover
explanation_mandarin: 口語俗稱，原意為砧板上的小蟻，常用來比喻那些在關係或處境中毫無反抗、容易被欺負或利用的人。
explanation_english: A colloquial slang term. Literally an ant on a chopping board, used metaphorically for someone who is powerless, easily bullied, or treated like a doormat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日畀人欺負，好似砧板蟻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 hei1 fu6, hou2 ci5 zam1 baan2 ngai5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常被人欺負，好像砧板上的蚂蚁一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He's constantly being bullied — like an ant on a chopping board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做砧板蟻，要學識為自己發聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 zam1 baan2 ngai5, jiu3 hok6 sik1 wai4 zi6 gei2 faat3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做任人欺負的人，要學會為自己發聲。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a doormat — learn to stand up for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 用尖銳器物刺或以砭石等治療（砭石、砭療等），亦可指古代的一種療法
english_meaning: to prick or treat with a sharp instrument; bian stone therapy (ancient form of needling/scraping therapy)
explanation_mandarin: 「砭」字本義為用尖利器具刺、刮或以砭石治病，常見於中醫術語如「砭石」、「砭療」，指一類古代的針刺、刮治療方法。
explanation_english: The character '砭' originally means to prick or treat using a sharp object or bian stones. It appears in traditional Chinese medicine terms such as 'bian stone' and refers to an ancient therapy involving needling/scraping with stones or similar tools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫用砭石做療法，話可以舒緩肌肉痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 jung6 bin1 sek6 zou6 liu4 faat3, waa6 ho2 ji5 syu1 wun6 gei1 juk6 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医用砭石做疗法，说可以缓解肌肉疼痛。
examples.english_sentence: Traditional Chinese medicine uses bian stone therapy, which is said to help relieve muscle pain.

mandarin_meaning: 砰（拟声词），表示猛然的撞击声、爆裂声或关门等的巨响
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic sound meaning bang, boom, or a sudden loud striking noise (e.g., a slam, impact, or explosion)
explanation_mandarin: “砰”是汉语中的拟声词，用来描述突然的、响亮的撞击或爆裂声，例如门窗砰的一声关上、东西砰地落地等。也可用作描写动作的瞬间声响。
explanation_english: “砰” is an onomatopoeic word used to represent a sudden loud impact or explosive sound, such as a door slamming or an object hitting the ground. It can be used to convey the instantaneous sound of an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 門俾風一陣吹，砰一聲關埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mun4 bei2 fung1 jat1 zan6 ceoi1, paang1 jat1 seng1 gwaan1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 门被风一阵吹，砰的一声关上了。
examples.english_sentence: The door was blown by the wind and slammed shut with a bang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢砰一聲將杯摔落地，杯打爛咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paang1 jat1 seng1 zoeng1 bui1 seoi1 lok6 dei6, bui1 daa2 laan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他砰的一声把杯子摔在地上，杯子摔碎了。
examples.english_sentence: He threw the cup to the ground with a bang; it broke.

mandarin_meaning: 被重擊打昏；被打得失去知覺或驚呆（廣東話俚語）
english_meaning: to be knocked out / stunned (Cantonese slang for being hit hard or left dazed)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，形容被打得很厲害、昏迷或被嚇得呆住，也可比喻受到極大衝擊而短時間失去反應。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term describing being beaten so badly one is knocked senseless or, figuratively, being so shocked/stunned that one is momentarily unresponsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人砰拎棒冷，成個人冇晒知覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 paang1 ling1 bong6 laang5, seng4 go3 jan4 mou5 saai3 zi1 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人打得砰拎棒冷，整個人沒了知覺。
examples.english_sentence: He got beaten so badly he was knocked senseless.

mandarin_meaning: 砰砰声（拟声词），表示连续的敲击、撞击或爆裂声。
english_meaning: an onomatopoeic term for repeated bangs/thuds/booms; the sound of pounding or banging.
explanation_mandarin: 「砰砰聲」多用來描述持續或重複的撞擊、敲打或爆裂聲，可指門被敲、物件相撞、心跳（口語化）等。
explanation_english: Used to describe repeated or heavy banging, thudding, or booming noises (e.g., knocking on a door, objects colliding, or colloquially a pounding heartbeat).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 突然門外傳來砰砰聲，我以為有人敲門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dat6 jin4 mun4 ngoi6 cyun4 loi4 paang1 paang1 seng1, ngo5 ji5 wai6 jau5 jan4 haau1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 突然从门外传来砰砰声，我以为有人敲门。
examples.english_sentence: Suddenly a banging sound came from outside the door; I thought someone was knocking.

mandarin_meaning: 猛地关门；砰地关上门
english_meaning: to slam (a door) shut; to bang the door
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，形容用力或生氣地關門、把門砰地一聲關上。常見於香港粵語口語中。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to slam a door shut forcefully (often out of anger or frustration). Common in Hong Kong Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到一腳踢開門，砰門走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau6 dou3 jat1 goek3 tek3 hoi1 mun4, paang1 mun4 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得一脚踢开门，把门砰地一声关上走了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry he kicked the door open, slammed it, and left.

mandarin_meaning: 炮（大炮）；俚語：「打炮」，指发生性关系
english_meaning: cannon; (slang) to have sex (casually)
explanation_mandarin: 「砲」原指炮、火炮等武器。廣東話中常見於合成詞如「大砲」、「開砲」。另外在口語俚語裡，常見用法「打砲」，指發生性關係（較粗俗）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a cannon or artillery. In Cantonese it appears in compounds like "大砲" or "開砲". In colloquial/slang usage, "打砲" means to have sex (vulgar).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古城門外擺咗一門大砲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 sing4 mun4 ngoi6 baai2 zo2 jat1 mun4 daai6 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古城门外摆着一门大炮。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big cannon displayed outside the old city gate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋昨晚喺酒店打砲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zok6 maan5 hai2 zau2 dim3 daa2 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们昨晚在酒店打炮。
examples.english_sentence: They had sex at the hotel last night.

mandarin_meaning: 炮台
english_meaning: artillery battery; gun emplacement; fortification mounting cannons
explanation_mandarin: 砲台是安放火炮的防禦工事或設施，通常設於海岸、要塞或戰場，用於發射火炮以防守或攻擊。
explanation_english: A fortification or emplacement where artillery (cannons or guns) are mounted; typically placed on coasts, fortresses, or battlefields for defensive or offensive fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座砲台已經變咗旅遊景點，成日有人嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 paau3 toi4 ji5 ging1 bin3 zo2 leoi5 jau4 ging2 dim2, seng4 jat6 jau5 jan4 lai4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座砲台已經變成旅遊景點，常常有人來拍照。
examples.english_sentence: That battery has become a tourist attraction; people often come to take photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 二次大戰期間，軍隊喺海邊嘅砲台駐守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji6 ci3 daai6 zin3 kei4 gaan1, gwan1 deoi2 hai2 hoi2 bin1 ge3 paau3 toi4 zyu6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 二次大戰期間，軍隊在海邊的砲台駐守。
examples.english_sentence: During World War II, troops were stationed at coastal batteries.

mandarin_meaning: 炮弹 (pàodàn)
english_meaning: artillery shell; explosive projectile fired from a cannon or artillery
explanation_mandarin: 炮弹是由火炮发射的弹药，通常内装炸药，用来攻击或摧毁目标。
explanation_english: An explosive projectile fired from a cannon or artillery piece, used as ammunition to attack or destroy targets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度散落咗幾枚砲彈，唔好亂摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 saan3 lok6 zo2 gei2 mui4 pou3 daan6, m4 hou2 lyun6 mo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里散落着几枚炮弹，不要乱摸。
examples.english_sentence: There are several shells scattered there; don't touch them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰場上響起砲彈嘅爆炸聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 coeng4 soeng6 hoeng2 hei2 pou3 daan6 ge3 baau3 zaa3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战场上响起炮弹的爆炸声。
examples.english_sentence: The battlefield was filled with the sounds of artillery shells exploding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰架車畀砲彈打爛咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaa3 ce1 bei6 pou3 daan6 daa2 laan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆车被炮弹打烂了。
examples.english_sentence: The car was destroyed by a shell.

mandarin_meaning: 炮火；砲擊的火力；也可比喻猛烈的攻勢或批評
english_meaning: artillery fire; heavy gunfire; figuratively a barrage of attacks or criticism
explanation_mandarin: 指武器（尤其是大砲、榴彈砲等）的射擊火力；在比喻用法中，常用來形容猛烈的攻勢或針對性的批評攻勢。
explanation_english: Refers to the firing power of weapons (especially artillery); figuratively used to describe an intense offensive or a barrage of criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰場上充滿砲火，士兵要小心掩護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 coeng4 soeng6 cung1 mun5 paau3 fo2, si6 bing1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 jim2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战场上充满炮火，士兵要小心掩护。
examples.english_sentence: The battlefield was filled with artillery fire; the soldiers had to take cover.

mandarin_meaning: 猛烈抨击；痛批（舆论或言语攻击）
english_meaning: to heavily criticize or verbally attack; to lambaste
explanation_mandarin: “砲轟”通常用來形容媒體或公眾對某人或某事進行強烈抨擊或批評，有時帶有群體性或言語攻勢的意思。
explanation_english: “砲轟” describes a forceful verbal attack or heavy criticism, often by the media or public; implies an aggressive, concentrated barrage of criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者會上啲記者不停咁砲轟佢，佢答唔到好幾個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 wui6 soeng6 di1 gei3 ze2 bat1 ting4 gam2 paau3 hung1 keoi5, keoi5 daap3 m4 dou3 hou2 gei2 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在记者会上，记者们不停地炮轰他，他回应不上好几个问题。
examples.english_sentence: At the press conference, the reporters kept lambasting him; he couldn't answer several questions.

mandarin_meaning: 破、破裂、损坏；也用于构成词（如破产、突破）
english_meaning: to break; broken; to damage; to split; used in compounds (e.g., bankrupt, break through)
explanation_mandarin: “破”常表示物品破裂或损坏，可作动词或形容词；也常用于构成词语（如“破产”“突破”）表示失败或打破局面等含义。
explanation_english: “破” commonly indicates something is broken or damaged and can function as a verb or adjective. It also appears in compounds (e.g., 'bankrupt', 'break through') with extended meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫破咗，唔好再著啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 po3 zo2 , m4 hou2 zoi3 zoek3 laa3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服破了，别再穿了。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is torn; don't wear it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打破咗個杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 po3 zo2 go3 bui1 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打破了杯子。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the cup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司破產嗰陣，好多人失業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 po3 caan2 go2 zan6 , hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 jip6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司破产的时候，很多人失业。
examples.english_sentence: When the company went bankrupt, many people lost their jobs.

mandarin_meaning: 破例（打破常例，作出例外）
english_meaning: to make an exception; to break the usual rule or practice
explanation_mandarin: 指打破通常的規定或慣例，對某情況作出例外處理。
explanation_english: To depart from the normal rule or practice and treat a case as an exception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我哋破例放你一馬，唔會再提呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 po3 lai6 fong3 nei5 jat1 maa5, m4 wui5 zoi6 tai4 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我们破例放过你，不会再提这件事。
examples.english_sentence: This time we'll make an exception and let you off; we won't bring this up again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師破例畀佢提早走，因為佢有急事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 po3 lai6 bei2 keoi5 tai4 ziu2 zau2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 jau5 gap1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师破例让他提前离开，因为他有急事。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher made an exception and let him leave early because he had an urgent matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司通常唔畀員工喺屋企做嘢，但係上次破例批咗佢喺屋企做嘢嘅申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tung1 soeng4 m4 bei2 jyun4 gung1 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 je5, daan6 hai6 soeng6 ci3 po3 lai6 pai1 zo2 keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 je5 ge3 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司通常不允许员工在家工作，但上次破例批准了他的在家工作申请。
examples.english_sentence: The company usually doesn't allow employees to work from home, but last time they made an exception and approved his work-from-home request.

mandarin_meaning: 破伤风（pòshāngfēng），由破伤风梭菌（Clostridium tetani）感染引起的急性疾病，常表现为颌部痉挛（俗称“锁jaw/镣牙”）和全身肌肉强直。
english_meaning: tetanus (lockjaw), an acute infectious disease caused by Clostridium tetani, characterized by muscle spasms and rigidity.
explanation_mandarin: 破伤风是由破伤风梭菌通过伤口进入人体后产生毒素引起的疾病。常见诱因包括被生锈的钉子扎伤或深层伤口。预防措施为接种破伤风疫苗并对伤口进行及时处理。
explanation_english: Tetanus is caused by toxins produced by Clostridium tetani entering the body through a wound. Common triggers are puncture wounds such as from rusty nails. Prevention includes tetanus vaccination and prompt wound care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果俾生鏽嘅釘扎親，應該即刻去打破傷風針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 bei2 saang1 sau3 ge3 deng1 zaak6 can1, jing1 goi1 zik1 hak1 heoi3 daa2 po3 soeng1 fung1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果被生锈的钉子扎到，应该立刻去打破伤风针。
examples.english_sentence: If you get punctured by a rusty nail, you should get a tetanus shot immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 破冰（消除尷尬或隔閡，建立起交流或信任）
english_meaning: to break the ice; to relieve initial awkwardness and open up interaction
explanation_mandarin: 指消除尴尬或隔阂，使人彼此熟络或建立联系，常用于社交场合、會議或團隊活動的開場。
explanation_english: Refers to removing awkwardness or barriers between people so they become more comfortable interacting; commonly used for social situations, meetings, or team activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先大家都好尷尬，我講咗個笑話嚟破冰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gon1 ngaai3, ngo5 gong2 zo2 go3 siu3 waa6 lai4 po3 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛才大家都很尷尬，我講了一個笑話來破冰。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone was awkward earlier, so I told a joke to break the ice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今日安排咗一個聯誼活動，目的是破冰同建立信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 jat6 on1 paai4 zo2 jat1 go3 lyun4 ji4 wut6 dung6, muk6 dik1 si6 po3 bing1 tung4 gin3 laap6 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今天安排了一個聯誼活動，目的是破冰並建立信任。
examples.english_sentence: The company organized a social event today to break the ice and build trust.

mandarin_meaning: 破口大骂；大声辱骂、恶言相向
english_meaning: to angrily berate or curse someone aloud; to hurl abusive language
explanation_mandarin: 表示因憤怒而大聲辱罵或用粗暴、侮辱性的語言責罵某人，通常形容說話激烈且帶有攻擊性。
explanation_english: Indicates angrily shouting abusive or insulting words at someone; describes an intense, verbally aggressive scolding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到條消息之後，氣到破口大罵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 tiu4 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, hei3 dou3 po3 hau2 daai6 maa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到这个消息后，气得破口大骂。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the news and angrily cursed (someone) out.

mandarin_meaning: 破口大罵（用粗言穢語大聲責罵）
english_meaning: to loudly berate or curse someone; to swear violently at someone
explanation_mandarin: 形容用激烈或粗俗的話大聲斥責、辱罵別人，通常帶有強烈情緒宣洩的意味。
explanation_english: Describes loudly berating or cursing someone, often using harsh or coarse language; typically an emotional outburst.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚老闆亂咁鬧人，阿強忍唔住對老闆破口大駡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo2 maan5 lou5 baan2 lyun6 gam2 nou6 jan4, aa3 koeng4 jan2 m4 zyu6 deoi3 lou5 baan2 po3 hau2 daai6 maa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚老闆亂罵人，阿強忍不住對老闆破口大罵。
examples.english_sentence: Last night the boss was ranting at people; Ah Keung couldn't hold back and loudly berated the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到鄰居整晚開派對，阿嫻嬲到對佢哋破口大駡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 leon4 geoi1 zing2 maan5 hoi1 paai3 deoi6, aa3 haan4 nau5 dou3 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 po3 hau2 daai6 maa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到鄰居整晚開派對，阿嫻氣到對他們破口大罵。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the neighbors partying all night, Ah Haan got so angry that she cursed them out.

mandarin_meaning: 破坏气氛/拆台，公开拆某人的台面或导致关系/计划受损
english_meaning: to embarrass or undermine someone publicly; to spoil the atmosphere or ruin a relationship/plan
explanation_mandarin: 「破台」是廣東話口語，通常指當眾拆台、揭短或做出使氣氛、關係或計劃破裂的行為，令局面尷尬或無法繼續。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to upstage, embarrass, or undermine someone publicly, thereby spoiling the atmosphere or causing a relationship/plan to break down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度破台啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 po3 toi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在這裡拆台／破壞氣氛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a scene here / don't undermine someone in front of everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上破台，搞到成個計劃都冇得繼續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 po3 toi4, gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 mou5 dak1 gai3 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在會議上破壞了局面，導致整個計劃無法繼續。
examples.english_sentence: He ruined things at the meeting, causing the whole plan to be unable to continue.

mandarin_meaning: 该死的；可恶的（口语咒骂用语）
english_meaning: damn; damned; damn it (colloquial curse used to express annoyance or to insult someone/something)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗口用語，常用作感嘆詞或放在名詞前作形容，表示強烈不滿或詛咒，語氣粗魯。主要在香港口語中出現。
explanation_english: A Cantonese swear phrase used as an interjection or as an adjective before nouns to express strong annoyance or contempt. Informal and coarse; common in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 破地獄！條車又爆胎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po3 dei6 ngok6! tiu4 ce1 jau6 baau3 taai1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 该死！车又爆胎了。
examples.english_sentence: Damn it! The car got a flat again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部破地獄電話成日死機，唔好買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 po3 dei6 ngok6 din6 waa2 sing4 jat6 sei2 gei1, m4 hou2 maai5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部该死的手机老是死机，别买了。
examples.english_sentence: This damn phone keeps freezing; don't buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 破坏 (pòhuài)
english_meaning: to destroy; to damage; to sabotage; to undermine
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某物或系統遭到損壞或毀壞，也可指破壞關係、秩序或計劃的正常運作。
explanation_english: To cause physical or functional damage to something; can also mean to undermine relationships, order, plans, or systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢故意破壞公司嘅電腦系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu3 ji3 po3 waai6 gung1 si1 ge3 din6 nou5 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意破坏公司的电脑系统。
examples.english_sentence: He intentionally sabotaged the company's computer system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴風雨破壞咗沿岸嘅好多建築。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 fung1 jyu5 po3 waai6 zo2 jin4 ngon2 ge3 hou2 do1 gin3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴风雨破坏了沿岸的很多建筑。
examples.english_sentence: The storm destroyed many coastal buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅爭吵破壞咗朋友之間嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zang1 cau3 po3 waai6 zo2 pang4 jau5 zi1 gaan1 ge3 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的争吵破坏了朋友之间的信任。
examples.english_sentence: Their arguments undermined the trust between friends.

mandarin_meaning: 破天荒（表達史無前例、前所未有或久未發生的事情首次發生）
english_meaning: unprecedented; happening for the first time; breaking precedent
explanation_mandarin: 「破天荒」原本含有荒涼之意，後來引申為從未有過或非常罕見的情況，用來形容某事是史無前例或首次發生。
explanation_english: Originally referring to desolation, '破天荒' now means unprecedented or something happening for the first time; used to describe an event that breaks with past precedent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢破天荒遲到，大家都好驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 po3 tin1 wong4 ci4 dou3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次他破天荒遲到，大家都很驚訝。
examples.english_sentence: This time he was late for the first time ever; everyone was surprised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司破天荒決定加薪，員工都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 po3 tin1 wong4 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 san1, jyun4 gung1 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司破天荒決定加薪，員工都很開心。
examples.english_sentence: The company, unprecedentedly, decided to give raises and the employees were very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 破局 (pòjú)，指打破僵局或使局面改變；也可指談判、安排等終止或告吹。
english_meaning: to break a stalemate; to cause a situation to change; to collapse/end (a negotiation or arrangement).
explanation_mandarin: “破局”常用來表示打破僵持的局面，使事情出現轉機；在談判或協議場景，也可表示談判或安排告吹、終止。
explanation_english: “破局” is used to indicate breaking a deadlock or causing a change in the situation; in contexts like negotiations it can also mean the talks or arrangement have collapsed or ended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府同反對派嘅談判已經破局，局勢越嚟越緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tung4 faan2 deoi3 paai3 ge3 taam4 pun3 ji5 ging1 po3 guk6, guk6 si3 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府和反對派的談判已經破局，局勢越來越緊張。
examples.english_sentence: The negotiations between the government and the opposition have broken down, and the situation is becoming increasingly tense.

mandarin_meaning: 破戒 / 犯戒（違反宗教戒律或打破自己立下的戒律）
english_meaning: to break a religious precept or vow; to break one's resolution
explanation_mandarin: 指違反宗教戒律（例如出家人吃肉、喝酒），也可廣義指打破自己立的戒律或決心（如戒菸、戒酒等）。
explanation_english: Refers to violating a religious precept (e.g., a monastic eating meat or drinking alcohol); more broadly, it means breaking one's own vow or resolution (e.g., giving in while trying to quit smoking/drinking).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本來戒咗唔食肉，但今日破戒食咗一碟叉燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 loi4 gaai3 zo2 m4 sik6 juk6, daan6 gam1 jat6 po3 gaai3 sik6 zo2 jat1 dip6 caa1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本來不吃肉，但今天破戒吃了一盤叉燒。
examples.english_sentence: He had stopped eating meat, but today he broke his vow and ate a plate of char siu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試咗一個月唔飲酒，可惜今晚喺朋友聚會破戒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 zo2 jat1 go3 jyut6 m4 jam2 zau2, ho2 sik1 gam1 maan5 hai2 pang4 jau5 zeoi6 wui6 po3 gaai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我試了一个月不喝酒，可惜今晚在朋友聚會破戒了。
examples.english_sentence: I tried not drinking for a month, but unfortunately I broke it tonight at a friends' gathering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出家人如果破戒，會有唔少批評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaa1 jan4 jyu4 gwo2 po3 gaai3, wui5 jau5 m4 siu2 pei1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出家人如果破戒，會有不少批評。
examples.english_sentence: If monastics break their precepts, they'll face considerable criticism.

mandarin_meaning: 破折号（標點符號，用於表示停頓、插入語、語句中斷或強調）
english_meaning: dash (a punctuation mark used to indicate a break in thought, a parenthetical insertion, an abrupt interruption, or emphasis)
explanation_mandarin: 破折號是一種標點符號，常用來標示句子中的突兀停頓、插入語、話語中斷或用於強調某部分內容。中文與外語寫作中用法略有差異（如長破折號、短破折號的使用）。
explanation_english: A dash is a punctuation mark used to mark breaks in thought, parenthetical insertions, abrupt interruptions, or to add emphasis. Usage varies between languages (e.g., em dash vs en dash).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺英文寫作入面，破折號用嚟表示突兀嘅停頓或者插入語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jing1 man4 se2 zok3 jap6 min6, po3 zit3 hou6 jung6 lai4 biu2 si6 dat6 ngat6 ge3 ting4 tyun4 waak6 ze2 caap3 jap6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在英語寫作中，破折號用來表示突兀的停頓或插入語。
examples.english_sentence: In English writing, the dash is used to indicate an abrupt pause or a parenthetical insertion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺中文入面有時會用破折號嚟標示講話中斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung1 man4 jap6 min6 jau5 si4 wui5 jung6 po3 zit3 hou6 lai4 biu1 si6 gong2 waa6 zung1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中文裡面有時會用破折號來表示說話中斷。
examples.english_sentence: In Chinese, dashes are sometimes used to indicate an interrupted speech.

mandarin_meaning: 該死的／混蛋（粗口）
english_meaning: a vulgar Cantonese expletive meaning 'damn' or 'bastard'
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語的粗口用語，用來表達憤怒、不滿或直接罵人，類似「該死的」「混蛋」。通常可作感嘆或作為對人的侮辱，屬粗俗詞彙。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese swear/expletive used to express anger or annoyance or to insult someone; roughly equivalent to 'damn' or 'bastard'. It is vulgar and offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 破日！今日又落雨，郁都郁唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po3 jat6! gam1 jat6 jau6 lok6 jyu5, juk6 dou1 juk6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 該死！今天又下雨，動都動不了。
examples.english_sentence: Damn! It's raining again — can't move at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個破日，唔好再煩我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 po3 jat6, m4 hou2 zoi3 faan4 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個混蛋，不要再煩我了！
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, stop bothering me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲破日嘅人成日借錢唔還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 po3 jat6 ge3 jan4 sing4 jat6 ze3 cin2 m4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些該死的人老是借錢不還。
examples.english_sentence: Those damn people always borrow money and never pay it back.

mandarin_meaning: 破曉 (pòxiǎo)；拂曉、黎明
english_meaning: dawn; daybreak
explanation_mandarin: 指天色剛亮、日出之前的時刻，即黎明、拂曉。此詞較偏書面或文雅用法。
explanation_english: Refers to the time when night turns into morning, just before or at sunrise — dawn or daybreak. The term is often literary or slightly formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺海邊等到破曉，見到日頭慢慢升起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hoi2 bin1 dang2 dou3 po3 hiu2, gin3 dou3 jat6 tau4 maan6 maan6 sing1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在海邊等到破曉，看到太陽慢慢升起。
examples.english_sentence: We waited at the seashore until dawn and watched the sun slowly rise.

mandarin_meaning: 破碎的柴火；（口語）比喻破爛、沒用的東西或人
english_meaning: broken firewood; (colloquial) junk/useless thing or person
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；口語時可作貶義形容詞
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指破裂或劈開的柴火。口語中可用作比喻，形容物件破舊、沒用，或對人作輕蔑的稱呼（視語境及地區而定）。
explanation_english: Literally refers to broken or split firewood. Colloquially it can be used metaphorically to describe something rundown or useless, and occasionally used disparagingly of a person (usage is regional/colloquial).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲破柴放喺院入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 po3 caai4 fong3 hai2 jyun2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些破柴放在院子裡。
examples.english_sentence: The broken firewood is placed in the yard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部舊電話真係破柴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa6 zan1 hai6 po3 caai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部舊電話真是破爛。
examples.english_sentence: This old phone is really junk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當我係破柴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong3 ngo5 hai6 po3 caai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把我當成破爛或沒用的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat me like junk/a useless person.

mandarin_meaning: 破格 (破例、打破常規；也可指超出一般標準、非常優秀)
english_meaning: to break the rules/precedent; to make an exception; exceptional/outstanding (beyond the usual standard)
explanation_mandarin: 表示打破常規或破例對待某人或某事，也可用來形容某人或某事超出一般規格、非常出色。
explanation_english: Indicates breaking precedent or making an exception for someone/something; can also describe someone/something as beyond the usual standard or exceptionally good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗表揚佢嘅表現，破格加薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 biu2 joeng4 keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6, po3 gaak3 gaa1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司為了表揚他的表現，破格加薪。
examples.english_sentence: The company broke precedent and gave him a raise to recognize his performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選拔，教練破格起用咗嗰位新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 baat3, gaau3 lin6 po3 gaak3 hei2 jung6 zo2 go2 wai6 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次選拔，教練破格起用了那位新人。
examples.english_sentence: In this selection, the coach unusually selected that newcomer.

mandarin_meaning: 破案 (pò àn)：侦破案件，查明真相并抓获嫌疑人。
english_meaning: to solve/crack a (criminal) case; to uncover the truth of a case and apprehend the suspect(s).
explanation_mandarin: 指警方或偵探經調查、蒐證後，查明案件真相並將涉案人員繩之以法。
explanation_english: Refers to the police or detectives investigating and gathering evidence to determine the facts of a case and bring the perpetrators to justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方終於破咗案，捉住個小偷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 po3 zo2 on3, zuk1 zyu6 go3 siu2 tau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方終於破了案，抓住了小偷。
examples.english_sentence: The police finally solved the case and caught the thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單案好複雜，可能要花幾個月先破案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 on3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, ho2 nang4 jiu3 faa1 gei2 go3 jyut6 sin1 po3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這宗案很複雜，可能要花幾個月才破案。
examples.english_sentence: This case is complicated; it may take several months to solve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 偵探靠住一條線索終於破咗案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing1 taam3 kaau3 zyu6 jat1 tiu4 sin3 sok3 zung1 jyu1 po3 zo2 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 偵探靠著一條線索終於破了案。
examples.english_sentence: The detective finally cracked the case based on a single clue.

mandarin_meaning: 氣餒、洩氣；使人掃興或失去士氣
english_meaning: to be disheartened/demoralized; to dampen someone's spirits or spoil the mood
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，表示失去士氣或感到沮喪；也可指某些言行使他人掃興、士氣受挫。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to lose morale or feel discouraged; can also mean to dampen or spoil others' spirits/mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考試唔及格，真係好破氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 si3 m4 gap3 gaak3, zan1 hai6 hou2 po3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考試沒及格，真的很氣餒。
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam; I'm really disheartened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨搞到成個計劃唔可以做，大家都覺得好破氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 ho2 ji5 zou6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 po3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨弄得整個計畫做不了，大家都覺得很灰心。
examples.english_sentence: The rain ruined the whole plan; everyone feels very discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁講，咁講法會破氣大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 gong2, gam2 gong2 faat3 wui5 po3 hei3 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那樣說，這種說法會打擊大家的士氣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that; saying it like that will dampen everyone's morale.

mandarin_meaning: 破水 / 羊膜囊破裂
english_meaning: water breaking (rupture of the amniotic sac)
explanation_mandarin: 指孕婦的羊膜囊破裂（俗稱「破水」），通常表示臨產開始，需要儘快就醫處理。
explanation_english: Refers to the rupture of the amniotic sac (commonly called 'water breaking'), usually indicating the onset of labor and requiring prompt medical attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老婆今晚突然破水囊，要即刻送佢去醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 po4 gam1 maan5 dat6 jin4 po3 seoi2 nong4, jiu3 zik1 hak1 sung3 keoi5 heoi3 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太太今晚突然破水，要立刻送她去醫院。
examples.english_sentence: His wife's water broke suddenly tonight; we need to rush her to the hospital immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 破涕为笑（pò tì wéi xiào）：由哭轉為笑，悲傷轉為歡喜。
english_meaning: To turn tears into laughter; to stop crying and begin to laugh — to change from sorrow to joy.
explanation_mandarin: 形容由哭轉為笑，表示情緒從悲傷變為高興。常用於書面語或成語語境。
explanation_english: Describes a change from crying to laughing — an emotional shift from sorrow to joy. A four-character idiom used as a verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到好消息，終於破涕為笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou3 hou2 siu1 sik1, zung1 jyu1 po3 tai3 wai4 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到好消息，終於破涕為笑。
examples.english_sentence: He received good news and finally stopped crying and began to laugh.

mandarin_meaning: 破涕为笑（pò tì wéi xiào）——停止哭泣，轉而露出笑容，表示由悲轉喜或被安慰後笑出來。
english_meaning: to stop crying and break into a smile; to change from tears to laughter; to be cheered up.
explanation_mandarin: 成語，形容由哭泣轉為笑容，多用於描寫被安慰、聽到好消息或心境轉變時的情形。
explanation_english: An idiom describing the change from crying to smiling; often used when someone is comforted, hears good news, or their mood shifts from sorrow to joy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到醫生話病情冇咁嚴重，終於破涕為笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 ji1 sang1 waa6 beng6 cing4 mou5 gam2 jim4 zung6, zung1 jyu1 po3 tai3 wai4 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到醫生說病情沒那麼嚴重，終於破涕為笑。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the doctor say the condition wasn't that serious, and finally went from tears to laughter.

mandarin_meaning: （希望、計劃、夢想等）被徹底摧毀或終止；破滅
english_meaning: to be shattered or ruined (e.g., hopes, plans, dreams); to come to nothing
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示希望、計劃或幻想等完全被毀掉、無法實現的狀態。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that hopes, plans, or dreams are completely destroyed or cannot be realized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲希望完全破滅咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 hei1 mong6 jyun4 cyun4 po3 mit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的希望完全破灭了。
examples.english_sentence: My hopes were completely shattered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生計劃因為疫情而破滅咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 gai3 waak6 jan1 wai4 jik6 cing4 ji4 po3 mit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生计划因为疫情而破灭了。
examples.english_sentence: His life plans were ruined because of the pandemic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔趕快做，佢哋嘅機會就會破滅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gon2 faai3 zou6, keoi5 dei6 ge3 gei1 wui6 zau6 wui5 po3 mit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不赶快做，他们的机会就会破灭。
examples.english_sentence: If they don't act quickly, their chance will be lost.

mandarin_meaning: 破烂；破旧、损坏的东西或形容物品破败不堪
english_meaning: shabby; tattered; worn-out; (can also mean) junk or worthless items
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词（亦可作名词，指破烂的东西）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can also be used as a noun meaning 'junk')
explanation_mandarin: 表示物品破舊、損壞或破爛不堪，可用來形容衣物、家具、車輛等，亦可指價值低的廢物或垃圾。
explanation_english: Describes something worn-out, damaged, or in tatters. Can be used for clothes, furniture, vehicles, etc., and can also refer to low-value junk or rubbish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫都破爛晒，唔想出去見人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 dou1 po3 laan6 saai3, m4 soeng2 ceot1 heoi3 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服都破烂了，不想出去见人。
examples.english_sentence: My clothes are all tattered; I don't want to go out and see people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架舊車好破爛，成日壞，唔安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 gau6 ce1 hou2 po3 laan6, sing4 jat6 waai6, m4 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆旧车很破烂，经常坏，不安全。
examples.english_sentence: This old car is really beat-up; it breaks down often and isn't safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋賣緊啲破爛傢俬，價錢好平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maai6 gan2 di1 po3 laan6 gaa1 si1, gaa3 cin2 hou2 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在卖一些破烂的家具，价格很便宜。
examples.english_sentence: They're selling some shabby furniture; the prices are very cheap.

mandarin_meaning: 破获：侦破犯罪案件，捣毁犯罪团伙并抓捕嫌疑人。
english_meaning: to crack (a case); to bust; to uncover and arrest criminals or dismantle a criminal ring
explanation_mandarin: 表示偵破犯罪案件或搗毀犯罪團夥，抓獲犯罪嫌疑人並繳獲贓物。
explanation_english: Used to describe law enforcement cracking a criminal case or dismantling a criminal operation, arresting suspects and seizing evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方終於破獲咗個詐騙集團，拘捕咗好幾個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 po3 wok6 zo2 go3 zaa3 pin3 zaap6 tyun4, kau1 bou6 zo2 hou2 gei2 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方终于破获了诈骗集团，拘捕了好几个人。
examples.english_sentence: The police finally cracked the fraud ring and arrested several people.

mandarin_meaning: 破产；倒闭
english_meaning: to go bankrupt; bankruptcy
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或個人無力償還債務，依法或實際上陷入破產狀態。可作動詞（破產）或名詞（破產、破產狀態）。
explanation_english: Refers to a company or individual unable to repay debts and entering a state of bankruptcy. Can be used as a verb ('to go bankrupt') or a noun ('bankruptcy').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司宣佈破產，啲員工好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 syun1 bou3 po3 caan2, di1 jyun4 gung1 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司宣布破产，员工很担心。
examples.english_sentence: The company announced it was bankrupt; the employees are very worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔小心經營，生意可能會破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 siu2 sam1 ging1 jing4, saang1 ji3 ho2 nang4 wui5 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不小心经营，生意可能会破产。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't manage carefully, the business might go bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀法院宣告破產，要清算債務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 faat3 jyun6 syun1 gok3 po3 caan2, jiu3 cing1 syun3 zai3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被法院宣告破产，要清算债务。
examples.english_sentence: He was declared bankrupt by the court and must liquidate his debts.

mandarin_meaning: 面部受傷或容貌受損；（比喻）颜面受损、丢脸
english_meaning: to have one's face injured/disfigured; (figurative) to lose face or be publicly embarrassed
explanation_mandarin: 通常指因外力或事故导致面部受伤、容貌受损；在比喻用法中指名誉或颜面受损、丢脸。
explanation_english: Usually refers to facial injury or disfigurement caused by external force or an accident; figuratively it means a loss of face or public embarrassment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚佢喺街度畀人打到破相，要縫針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan5 keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 bei2 jan4 daa2 dou3 po3 soeng1, jiu3 fung4 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚在街上被人打到破相，得縫針。
examples.english_sentence: He got his face badly injured in a fight last night and needed stitches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，老闆好擔心會破相，對外好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ceot1 si6, lou5baan2 hou2 daam1sam1 wui5 po3 soeng1, deoi3 ngoi6 hou2 gaan1gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出事，老板很担心会破相，对外很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: The company had a scandal; the boss is worried about losing face and it's embarrassing publicly.

mandarin_meaning: 破碎 (pòsuì)
english_meaning: broken; shattered; fragmented
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体被打碎或破坏，也可用于比喻，表示感情、關係或希望等被毁灭或瓦解。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is physically broken or shattered; can also be used figuratively for relationships, feelings, hopes, etc., that have been broken or ruined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個玻璃杯破碎咗，唔好再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 lei4 bui1 po3 seoi3 zo2, m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玻璃杯破碎了，别再用。
examples.english_sentence: The glass cup is shattered; don't use it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係已經破碎，冇得挽回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 ji5 ging1 po3 seoi3, mou5 dak1 waan2 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系已经破碎，无法挽回。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is already broken and cannot be repaired.

mandarin_meaning: 破碎家庭 / 破碎的家庭
english_meaning: broken family (a family whose relationships or structure have been disrupted)
explanation_mandarin: 指由于父母離異、分居、死亡或嚴重的家庭功能失調等原因，導致家庭關係破裂或不完整的家庭。
explanation_english: Refers to a family in which parental divorce, separation, death, or severe dysfunction has broken the family relationships or structure, resulting in an incomplete or disrupted household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一個破碎家庭入面長大，所以性格有啲內向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 go3 po3 seoi3 gaa1 ting4 jap6 min6 coeng4 daai6, so2 ji5 sing3 gaak3 jau5 di1 noi6 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一個破碎家庭中長大，所以性格有點內向。
examples.english_sentence: He grew up in a broken family, so he is somewhat introverted.

mandarin_meaning: 破纪录 / 打破纪录
english_meaning: to break a record; to set a new record
explanation_mandarin: 表示超越先前的最佳或最高紀錄，創下新的紀錄。常用於運動、業績、票房等情況。
explanation_english: To exceed a previous best or highest record and establish a new record. Commonly used in contexts like sports, performance metrics, box office, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺今日嘅比賽打破紀錄，成為最快嘅選手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 jat6 ge3 bei2 coi3 daa2 po3 gei2 luk6, sing4 wai4 zeoi3 faai3 ge3 syun2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在今天的比賽打破了紀錄，成為最快的選手。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the record in today's competition and became the fastest contestant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司連續三個月破紀錄，盈利創新高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 lin4 zuk6 saam1 go3 jyut6 po3 gei2 luk6, jing4 lei6 cong3 san1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司連續三個月破紀錄，盈利創新高。
examples.english_sentence: The company broke records for three consecutive months; profits hit a new high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋上星期嘅票房已經破紀錄，電影大受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng6 sing1 kei4 ge3 piu3 fong4 ji5 ging1 po3 gei2 luk6, din6 jing2 daai6 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們上星期的票房已經破紀錄，電影非常受歡迎。
examples.english_sentence: Our box office last week already broke records; the movie was very popular.

mandarin_meaning: 破绽 (缺点、漏洞、破绽)
english_meaning: a flaw, defect, loophole or inconsistency that reveals weakness
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或說法中的缺陷、漏洞或不合邏輯之處，常用來形容論點、說法或計劃中顯露出來的破綻。
explanation_english: Refers to a defect, loophole, or inconsistency in something (such as an argument, story, or plan) that reveals weakness or undermines credibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個故事有好多破綻，聽落唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 gu3 si6 jau5 hou2 do1 po3 taan3, teng1 lok6 m4 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的故事有很多破绽，听起来不可信。
examples.english_sentence: His story has many flaws and doesn't sound believable.

mandarin_meaning: 破旧 (pòjiù)，年久损坏、破烂或陈旧
english_meaning: worn-out; shabby; dilapidated; old and in poor condition
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容物品、衣物或建築等因年久、損壞或缺乏維護而顯得破爛、陳舊。
explanation_english: Describes objects, clothes, buildings, etc. that appear worn, shabby, dilapidated, or old from age or lack of maintenance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋好破舊，需要整修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hou2 po3 gau6, seoi1 jiu3 zing2 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子很破旧，需要整修。
examples.english_sentence: This house is very dilapidated and needs repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫好破舊，已經唔想著出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 hou2 po3 gau6, ji5 ging1 m4 soeng2 zoek3 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服很破旧，已经不想穿出门。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are very shabby; he no longer wants to wear them out.

mandarin_meaning: 破旧立新
english_meaning: to break with the old and establish the new; to reform or innovate
explanation_mandarin: 意指打破陳舊的事物或做法，建立新的制度或形式，常用於改革或創新情況。
explanation_english: Means discarding old things or practices and establishing new ones; commonly used in contexts of reform or innovation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定破舊立新，換咗班管理層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 po3 gau6 laap6 san1, wun6 zo2 baan1 gun2 lei5 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定破旧立新，换了管理层。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to break with the old and establish the new, replacing the management team.

mandarin_meaning: 破败、落魄、凋敝（形容人或地方衰败、破旧或没落）
english_meaning: shabby; run-down; dilapidated; fallen on hard times (describing a person or place that is in decline or poor condition)
explanation_mandarin: 「破落」在廣東話中常用來形容人或地方衰敗、沒落或破舊。可指經濟上窮困、生活潦倒，也可指房屋、服飾等磨損、殘舊。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "破落" describes a person or place that is in decline, shabby, or impoverished. It can refer to being financially down, living in reduced circumstances, or to worn-out, dilapidated buildings or belongings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家破落咗，唔似以前咁有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4gaa1 po3 lok6 zo2, m4 ci5 ji5cin4 gam2 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在落魄了，不像以前那么有钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's fallen on hard times now; he's not as well-off as he used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋好破落，窗同門都壞晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hou2 po3 lok6, coeng1 tung4 mun4 dou1 waai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间房很破败，窗和门都坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The house is very run-down; the windows and doors are all broken.

mandarin_meaning: 破处（失去处女/童贞）
english_meaning: to lose one's virginity; to deflower (colloquial/vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指失去處女或童貞，語氣較粗俗，常用於口語或俚語語境。
explanation_english: A colloquial/vulgar slang verb meaning to lose one's virginity (often used to say someone has been deflowered). Primarily informal and potentially offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲未破處㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 mei6 po3 cyu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她還沒破處。
examples.english_sentence: She hasn't lost her virginity yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢早幾年已經破處咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zou2 gei2 nin4 ji5 ging1 po3 cyu3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她說幾年前已經破處了。
examples.english_sentence: They said they lost their virginity a few years ago.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）打破蛋；（俚語）壞蛋、混蛋（罵人）
english_meaning: (literal) to break an egg; (slang) bastard/rotten egg (insult)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（字面）；名詞/俚語（罵人用）
explanation_mandarin: 「破蛋」可以指字面意思的把蛋打破，用於料理等場景；在廣東話口語中也常作俚語，罵人時稱對方是壞蛋、混蛋，語氣粗俗或帶侮辱性。
explanation_english: “破蛋” literally means to break an egg (used in cooking). In Cantonese slang it’s used as an insult—calling someone a bastard/rotten egg. The slang sense is coarse and can be offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係破蛋，成日呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 po3 daan6, sing4 jat6 ngok6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个坏蛋，总是欺骗人。
examples.english_sentence: You're really a bastard, always deceiving people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整蛋糕要先破蛋再打散佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 daan6 gou1 jiu3 sin1 po3 daan6 zoi3 daa2 saan3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做蛋糕要先把鸡蛋打破再打散它。
examples.english_sentence: To make a cake, you need to break the eggs first and then whisk them.

mandarin_meaning: 破裂 (pòliè)
english_meaning: to rupture; to burst; to split; a rupture/breakdown (physical or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體裂開、破損或關係、和諧等出現斷裂、破裂的狀態，可用於實物或抽象事物（如關係、信任）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has split, burst, or broken apart; can describe physical objects or abstract things (e.g. relationships, trust) that have ruptured or broken down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個玻璃杯破裂咗，唔好拎住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 lei4 bui1 po3 lit3 zo2, m4 hou2 ling1 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玻璃杯破裂了，別拿着它。
examples.english_sentence: The glass cup has cracked/broken; don't hold it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係因為誤會而破裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 jan1 wai6 ng6 wui6 ji4 po3 lit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系因误会而破裂。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship broke down because of a misunderstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲血管破裂，要即刻入院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 hyut3 gun2 po3 lit3, jiu3 zik1 haak1 jap6 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的血管破裂了，需要立即住院。
examples.english_sentence: His blood vessel ruptured; he needs immediate hospitalization.

mandarin_meaning: 破解
english_meaning: to crack; to decrypt; to solve
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过技术或方法解开、破除加密、密码或解决难题、谜题等，将原本无法访问或理解的内容揭示出来。
explanation_english: To break or decode something (e.g., a password or encrypted data) or to solve a puzzle/problem — to reveal the contents or solution by overcoming protections or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功破解咗嗰個密碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4gung1 po3 gaai2 zo2 go2 go3 mat6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功破解了那个密码。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully cracked that password.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個謎語好難，你破解到未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mai4 jyu5 hou2 naan4, nei5 po3 gaai2 dou3 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个谜语很难，你能破解吗？
examples.english_sentence: This riddle is difficult — can you solve it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗一個程式去破解呢個加密檔案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zo2 jat1 go3 cing4 sik1 heoi3 po3 gaai2 ni1 go3 gaa1 mat6 dong2 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了一個程序去破解這個加密檔案。
examples.english_sentence: He used a program to crack this encrypted file.

mandarin_meaning: 破财（遭受金钱损失；不得已花钱）
english_meaning: to suffer a financial loss; to have to part with money (often unexpectedly)
explanation_mandarin: 指在金錢上遭受損失，或不得已花掉一筆錢。常用於口語描述買東西、賠錢或發生意外支出時。
explanation_english: Refers to experiencing a loss of money or having to spend money unexpectedly. Commonly used colloquially to describe paying out money, losing an investment, or incurring an expense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我投資失手，今個月真係破財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 zi1 sat1 sau2, gam1 go3 jyut6 zan1 hai6 po3 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我投资失败，这个月真的破财了。
examples.english_sentence: My investment failed; I really suffered a financial loss this month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企啲電器壞咗，要買過，真係破財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 di1 din6 hei3 waai6 zo2, jiu3 maai5 gwo3, zan1 hai6 po3 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的電器壞了，需要重新購買，真是破财。
examples.english_sentence: The appliance at home broke and needs to be replaced — what a financial hit.

mandarin_meaning: 破财挡灾 / 破财消灾（用钱免灾）
english_meaning: To spend or lose money to avert or lessen misfortune; 'lose money to ward off disaster.'
explanation_mandarin: 指用花錢或承受小損失來避免或減輕更大的災禍或損失，帶有民間習俗或凡俗說法的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to spending money or taking a small loss to prevent or reduce a larger misfortune; a folk belief/idiomatic idea that losing some money can ward off disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次整車嘅費用係破財擋災，唔使太擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zing2 ce1 ge3 fai3 jung6 hai6 po3 coi4 dong2 zoi1, m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次修車的費用算是破財擋災，不必太擔心。
examples.english_sentence: Consider the car repair cost this time as 'spending money to avert disaster' — don't worry too much.

mandarin_meaning: 破费 / 付出金錢；花錢（常作客套用語：別為我破費）
english_meaning: to incur expense; to spend money; (polite) you've gone to the trouble of spending / you shouldn't have
explanation_mandarin: 表示花費金錢。常用作客套語，當別人為你花錢時可說「唔好破費」（不用破費）。也可指花費很大、耗費金錢。
explanation_english: Indicates spending money. Often used as a polite expression when someone pays for you (e.g. “you shouldn't have”); can also mean that something is costly or involves a lot of expense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你請客，真係唔好破費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 cing2 haak3, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 po3 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你請客，真的不用破費。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for treating me — you really shouldn't have (spent so much).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買咁多禮物，真係破費晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 gam3 do1 lai5 mat6, zan1 hai6 po3 fai3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你買這麼多禮物，真的很破費。
examples.english_sentence: You bought so many gifts — that's really costly.

mandarin_meaning: 破釜沉舟 (pò fǔ chén zhōu)：下定決心、不留退路，表示決一死戰或堅決執行某事的決心。
english_meaning: To burn one's boats; to make a determined decision and eliminate any possibility of retreat — to commit to a course of action with no turning back.
explanation_mandarin: 出自秦末楚漢相爭的典故，傳說項羽率軍攻敵時毀鍋沉舟以斷後路，表示下定決心、斷絕退路，決一死戰或堅決完成任務。
explanation_english: An idiom from a historical episode in which a commander destroyed his cooking pots and sank his boats to remove any option of retreat. It means to resolve firmly to proceed and remove the possibility of turning back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗呢個項目，我哋決定破釜沉舟，唔留退路。
