examples.english_sentence: Don't always call in favors; it's wrong to expect others to help when you don't put in the effort yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 打人情牌／耍人情牌
english_meaning: play the 'favor card' (use personal connections or favors to gain advantage)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指藉由人情、關係或私人關係來獲得好處或便利，通常含有走後門或利用熟人幫忙的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to 'play the favor card' — to use personal relationships or favors to obtain advantages or conveniences, often informally or as a shortcut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次面試唔順，最後碌咗人情咭，靠朋友幫佢搞掂份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 min6 si3 m4 seon6, zeoi3 hau6 luk1 zo2 jan4 cing4 kaa1, kaau3 pang4 jau5 bong1 keoi5 gaau2 dim6 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次面試不順，最後打了人情牌，靠朋友幫他拿到這份工作。
examples.english_sentence: His interview didn't go well, but in the end he played the favor card and got the job with a friend's help.

mandarin_meaning: 刷卡
english_meaning: to swipe/tap a card (pay or validate)
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話口語，指使用信用卡、八達通等在讀卡器上刷或拍卡付款或感應（如在巴士、地鐵、便利店等使用）。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to swipe or tap a card (e.g., credit card, Octopus) on a reader to pay or validate — commonly used for transport or retail payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺便利店碌咗信用卡買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 bin6 lei6 dim3 luk6 zo2 seon3 jung6 kaat1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在便利店刷了信用卡買東西。
examples.english_sentence: I just swiped my credit card at the convenience store to buy something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得上車要碌八達通，唔好走錯閘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 soeng5 ce1 jiu3 luk6 baat3 daat6 tung1, m4 hou2 zau2 co3 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記得上車要刷八達通，別走錯閘。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to tap your Octopus card when boarding so you don't go through the wrong gate.

mandarin_meaning: 倒霉；運氣不好
english_meaning: to be unlucky; to have bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語俚語，表示某人或某事很倒霉、遇到不順或麻煩。有時帶有粗俗或戲謔語氣，視語境可作輕鬆抱怨或沮喪之用。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to say someone is unlucky or has bad luck. It can be colloquial and slightly coarse or jocular depending on context, used for complaints or to describe unfortunate events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係碌吉，坐錯車仲遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 luk1 gat1, co5 co3 ce1 zung6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真倒霉，坐錯車還遲到。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really unlucky today; I took the wrong train and was late.

mandarin_meaning: 刷卡；用信用卡或其他卡片付款
english_meaning: to swipe/charge a card; to pay by card
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語口語中，「碌咭」指用信用卡、借記卡或其他感應卡在機器上刷卡或感應付款（相當於普通話的「刷卡」）。「咭」為「card」的音譯字。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "碌咭" means to swipe or tap a card (credit/debit/contactless) to make a payment. "咭" is a transliteration of the English word "card."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇帶現金，等我碌咭俾錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 daai3 jin6 gam1, dang2 ngo5 luk1 kaat1 bei2 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天沒帶現金，讓我刷卡付錢吧。
examples.english_sentence: I didn’t bring any cash today; let me swipe my card to pay.

mandarin_meaning: 胡鬧；耍弄；糊弄人（口語）
english_meaning: to mess around; to fool/joke with someone; to act up (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示胡鬧、耍花招、捉弄或不認真地搗亂，也可指說謊或糊弄別人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to mess around, act up, fool or trick someone, or generally cause trouble; can also mean to bullshit or not be serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好碌嘢，講真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 luk6 je5, gong2 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別胡鬧，認真點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around; be serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好碌嘢我，我知你講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 luk6 je5 ngo5, ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別耍我，我知道你在撒謊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fool me; I know you're lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔喺街度碌嘢，搞到大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 gaai1 dou6 luk6 je5, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子在街上胡鬧，弄得大家不高興。
examples.english_sentence: The kids were messing around on the street, making everyone unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 摔倒／滚到地上
english_meaning: to fall down; to tumble onto the ground
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，通常指人或物從站立或行走狀態失去平衡而摔到地上，也可作誇張或口語化表達狼狽跌倒的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to fall or tumble onto the ground. Commonly used in everyday speech to describe someone or something losing balance and hitting the ground; can be used in an exaggerated or humorous way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得快，唔小心碌地，膝頭擦破咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang4 dak1 faai3, m4 siu2 sam1 luk6 dei6, sat1 tau4 caat3 po3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走得快，不小心摔倒，膝蓋擦破了。
examples.english_sentence: He was walking fast and accidentally fell, scraping his knee.

mandarin_meaning: 在地上打滚；（口語/俚語）被打倒或在地上翻滾
english_meaning: to roll on the ground; (colloquial/slang) to be knocked down or to tumble/writhe on the ground
explanation_mandarin: 「碌地沙」字面上指在地上滾動、打滾。在廣東話口語中常用來形容被打倒、跌倒後在地上翻滾，或戲謔地形容某人狼狽、慘遭失敗或受挫。
explanation_english: Literally ‘roll on the ground (sand)’. In Cantonese colloquial usage it describes rolling or tumbling on the ground—often after being knocked down or falling—or is used mockingly to describe someone who is embarrassed, defeated, or in a pitiable state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你見到佢畀人一拳之後，已經碌地沙喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin3 dou3 keoi5 bei2 jan4 jat1 kyun4 zi1 hau6, ji5 ging1 luk6 dei6 saa1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看到他被人一拳後，已經在地上打滾了。
examples.english_sentence: You saw him get punched and he was already rolling on the ground.

mandarin_meaning: 輸家；沒出息的人；廢柴
english_meaning: loser; a person who is unsuccessful or useless
explanation_mandarin: 「碌士」是香港粵語俗語，用來貶義地稱呼一個沒出息、常常失敗或無所作為的人，類似「廢柴」或「輸家」。可能源自英語“loser”的音譯或語音借用。
explanation_english: “碌士” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used derogatorily to refer to someone who is unsuccessful, useless, or often fails—similar to “loser.” It is likely a phonetic borrowing of the English word “loser.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做嘢，乜嘢都搞唔掂，真係個碌士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5, mat1 je5 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6, zan1 hai6 go3 luk6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是不做事，什麼都搞不定，真是個廢柴（輸家）。
examples.english_sentence: He never works and can't get anything done—what a loser.

mandarin_meaning: 刷手機 / 玩手機
english_meaning: to scroll through / play on one's smartphone; to be on one's phone
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指在手機上滑動、瀏覽或無目的地看內容，通常含有打發時間或分心的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to scroll, swipe, or browse on a smartphone — often implying killing time or being distracted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日碌手機，做嘢都唔專心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 luk1 sau2 gei1, zou6 je5 dou1 m4 zyun1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你经常玩手机，做事都不专心。
examples.english_sentence: You're always on your phone; you don't concentrate on your work.

mandarin_meaning: 碌架床 / 双层床 / 上下铺
english_meaning: bunk bed (a bed with two stacked sleeping surfaces)
explanation_mandarin: 指上下兩層的床，也常稱為雙層床或上下鋪，通常用於兒童房或宿舍以節省空間。
explanation_english: Refers to a bed with two stacked sleeping surfaces (bunk bed), commonly used in children's rooms or dormitories to save space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗一張碌架床放喺小朋友嘅房間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 jat1 zoeng1 luk6 gaa3 cong4 fong3 hai2 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 fong4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买了一张碌架床放在小朋友的房间里。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a bunk bed and put it in the children's room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大學宿舍通常會有碌架床，咁可以慳位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 hok6 suk1 se3 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 luk6 gaa3 cong4, gam2 ho2 ji5 haan2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大学宿舍通常会有碌架床，这样可以节省空间。
examples.english_sentence: University dorms usually have bunk beds, which saves space.

mandarin_meaning: 在床上翻滾（口語），常含有性行為或親密接觸的意思
english_meaning: to roll around in bed (colloquial); often implies sexual activity or intimate physical contact
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，指在床上翻來覆去或滾動，語境中常用以暗示性行為或親密接觸，可視語境為粗俗或親密用語。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression meaning to roll about in bed. In many contexts it implies sexual activity or intimate contact; it can be coarse or informal depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同女朋友一齊返屋企之後就碌架床。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 neoi5 pong4 jau5 jat1 cai4 faan1 uk1 kei5 zi1 hau6 zau6 luk1 gaa3 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和女朋友回到家後就在床上翻來覆去（滾床）。
examples.english_sentence: He and his girlfriend rolled around in bed after they got home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係諗住同人碌架床，要尊重人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 lam2 zyu6 tung4 jan4 luk1 gaa3 cong4, jiu3 zyun1 zung6 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別只想着和別人上床，要尊重別人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just think about sleeping with someone; respect other people.

mandarin_meaning: （在床上）翻滾、打滾；口語中可指賴床或與人親熱、發生性行為的委婉說法
english_meaning: to roll around in bed; colloquially to laze in bed or to fool around/have sex in bed
explanation_mandarin: 「碌架牀」是廣東話口語說法，字面意思是在床上翻滾。根據語境可指賴床、在床上打滾，或含有與人親熱／發生性行為的隱晦含義。
explanation_english: “碌架牀” is a Cantonese colloquial phrase literally meaning to roll on the bed. Depending on context it can mean lazing or tossing about in bed, or euphemistically refer to fooling around/sex in bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日碌架牀，快啲起身返工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 luk6 gaa3 cong4, faai3 di1 hei2 san1 faan1 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要一直在床上打滾，快點起床去上班啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep lazing in bed; get up and go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋昨晚喺酒店度碌架牀，第二朝唔肯出房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 zok6 maan5 hai2 zau2 dim3 dou6 luk6 gaa3 cong4, dai6 ji6 ziu1 m4 hang2 ceot1 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說他們昨晚在旅館裡滾床，第二天早上不肯出房間。
examples.english_sentence: I heard they were fooling around in the hotel room last night and wouldn't leave the room the next morning.

mandarin_meaning: 去你的 / 他媽的（粗俗的罵人話）
english_meaning: damn it / fuck (vulgar interjection used to express anger or to insult)
explanation_mandarin: 「碌柒」是香港粵語粗俗俚語，常用作發泄不滿或罵人，相當於普通話的「去你的」或「他媽的」。包含冒犯性，屬於粗口用語。
explanation_english: „碌柒‟ is a Hong Kong Cantonese vulgar slang term used as an expletive to express anger, frustration, or to insult someone (similar to Mandarin "去你的/他妈的" or English "damn it/fuck"). It is offensive and considered coarse language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 碌柒，我又遲到，點算好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: luk1 cat1, ngo5 jau6 ci4 dou3, dim2 syun3 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去他的，我又迟到了，怎麼辦？
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, I'm late again — what should I do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲電話唔見咗，碌柒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 din6 waa2 m4 gin3 zo2, luk1 cat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手機不見了，去他X！
examples.english_sentence: My phone's gone — damn it!

mandarin_meaning: （罕用俚語）字面為把柚子滾動；引申指胡鬧、耍弄或無聊地玩耍
english_meaning: Literally 'to roll a pomelo.' A rare Cantonese slang meaning to fool around, mess about, or play small pranks.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語 / 動詞（偶爾作名詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「碌柚」在廣東話中屬於罕見或地區性俚語，字面意思是把柚子碌動。口語上有人用來形容胡鬧、搞怪或無所事事地耍弄，使用範圍有限且較口語化、不屬於標準書面語。
explanation_english: A rare or regionally used Cantonese slang term literally meaning to roll a pomelo. Colloquially it can describe fooling around, acting mischievously, or messing about. Usage is limited and informal—it's not standard written Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日喺度碌柚，唔好浪費時間啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 luk6 jau4, m4 hou2 long6 fai3 si4 gaan3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是在那裡胡鬧，別浪費時間了。
examples.english_sentence: You're always messing around there—don't waste time.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語、粗口）骂人的詞，指可惡、卑鄙或可恨的人，相當於罵對方像老鼠，帶強烈蔑視和憤怒
english_meaning: (slang, expletive) an insulting expression calling someone a 'damn rat' — used to show contempt or anger toward a deceitful/despicable person
explanation_mandarin: 「碌死老鼠」是香港粵語的罵人俚語，語氣粗俗，用來形容或辱罵某人很可惡、卑鄙或可恨，字面意義為「把老鼠碾死」，實為強烈的貶稱。
explanation_english: "碌死老鼠" is Hong Kong Cantonese slang/expletive used to insult someone — expressing strong contempt or anger, likening the person to a rat. Literally "roll/kill the mouse," but used figuratively as a harsh epithet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷嘢畀人揭發，街坊都鬧佢碌死老鼠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 je5 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3, gaai1 fong1 dou1 naau6 keoi5 luk6 sei2 lou5 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷东西被人揭发，街坊都骂他「碌死老鼠」。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught stealing and the neighbours all called him a 'damn rat.'

mandarin_meaning: （口語）打結、糾纏；（事情）變得複雜或卡住
english_meaning: to get tangled/knotted; (of a situation) to become complicated or stuck
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法。可指物件（如線、繩）打結、糾纏，也可比喻事情變得複雜、陷入僵局或難以解決。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression. It can describe physical tangling/knots (e.g. cables, ropes) or figuratively mean a situation becoming complicated, stuck, or hard to resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條耳機線碌結咗，拆唔開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 ji5 gei1 sin3 luk6 git3 zo2, caak3 m4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 耳機線打結了，拆不开。
examples.english_sentence: The headphone cable got tangled and I can't undo it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事碌結咗一輪，大家都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 luk6 git3 zo2 jat1 leon4, daa2 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事變得很複雜，大家都不知道怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has become tangled/complicated and no one knows what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 出差錯；搞砸
english_meaning: to mess up; to make a blunder; to screw up
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，表示犯錯、失誤或把事情搞砸，常用於責備或描述失誤情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to make a mistake, blunder, or mess something up; commonly used to describe errors or failures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我碌葛咗，遲咗交報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 luk6 got3 zo2, ci4 zo2 gaau1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上我犯錯了，晚交了報告。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up this morning and handed in the report late.

mandarin_meaning: 被騙／被人佔便宜
english_meaning: to be cheated, taken advantage of, or made a fool of
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語（俚語），用來表示被別人騙、佔便宜或被愚弄。通常用在口語，常見用法如「畀人碌蔗」，意指被人占便宜或受騙。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to be cheated, taken advantage of, or made a fool of. Commonly used colloquially, often in phrases like "bei2 jan4 luk6 ze3" meaning to be ripped off by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日俾人碌蔗，好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 bei2 jan4 luk6 ze3, hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天被人騙了，真慘。
examples.english_sentence: I got ripped off today — it's awful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 簽合約之前要小心，唔好畀人碌蔗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cim1 hap6 joek3 zi1 cin4 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 luk6 ze3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 簽合約之前要小心，別讓人騙你。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful before signing the contract — don't let anyone take advantage of you.

mandarin_meaning: 溜過；逃過（責任/處罰）；（物體）滾過、滑過
english_meaning: to slip past; to get away with (escape blame or punishment); (literal) to roll/slide past
explanation_mandarin: 「碌過」在廣東話中可作口語用法，既可指實際物體滾過、滑過（如球碌過），亦可作俚語表示逃過責任或處罰、僥倖通過（如某人『碌過』沒被追究）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "碌過" is used both literally and colloquially: literally to describe something rolling or sliding past; colloquially/slangy to mean slipping past consequences or getting away with something (escaping blame or punishment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次又碌過啦，冇人追究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 jau6 luk1 gwo3 laa1, mou5 jan4 zeoi1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次又逃過了，沒有人追究。
examples.english_sentence: He got away again this time; no one is holding him accountable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波碌過我面前，我攞唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 luk1 gwo3 ngo5 min6 cin4, ngo5 lo2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球從我面前滾過，我沒接到。
examples.english_sentence: The ball rolled past me; I couldn't catch it.

mandarin_meaning: 碍（礙）：妨碍、阻挡、造成不便
english_meaning: to obstruct; to hinder; to be a hindrance; to cause inconvenience
explanation_mandarin: 表示阻碍、妨碍或造成不便，可单独使用或构成合成词，如“碍事”“妨碍”。
explanation_english: Indicates obstruction or hindrance, or causing inconvenience. It can be used alone or in compounds (e.g., "碍事", "妨碍").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好碍住路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ngaai6 zyu6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碍着路。
examples.english_sentence: Don't block the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔碍事，你可以繼續做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 ngaai6 si6, nei5 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不碍事，你可以继续做。
examples.english_sentence: This won't be a problem, you can continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊傢俬擺喺門口會碍住出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 gaa1 si1 baai2 hai2 mun4 hau2 wui5 ngaai6 zyu6 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧家具摆在门口会挡住出入。
examples.english_sentence: Old furniture placed at the doorway will obstruct entry and exit.

mandarin_meaning: 碎；破裂；打碎
english_meaning: broken; shattered; to break into pieces
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體成小塊或破裂的狀態，也可作動詞表示把東西打破或弄碎。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is broken into pieces or shattered; can also be used as a verb meaning to break or smash something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 玻璃杯跌到地上，碎咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bo1 lei4 bui1 dit3 dou3 dei6 soeng6, seoi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玻璃杯掉到地上，碎了。
examples.english_sentence: The glass fell on the floor and shattered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個碗碎咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wun2 seoi3 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个碗碎了，要换一个。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl is broken; we need to replace it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲計劃全部都碎晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gai3 waak6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 seoi3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划全部都泡汤了。
examples.english_sentence: His plans have all fallen apart.

mandarin_meaning: 低聲抱怨、嘟囔；小聲地發牢騷
english_meaning: to mutter or whine under one's breath; to grumble softly
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，形容以小聲、斷斷續續的方式抱怨、嘟囔或發牢騷，常帶有不滿或悶悶不樂的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who mumbles, whines, or grumbles softly and intermittently, expressing dissatisfaction or sulkiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日碎吟吟，唔停抱怨份工好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 seoi3 jam4 jam4, m4 ting4 pou5 jyun3 fan6 gung1 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常碎碎念、低聲抱怨，老是說工作很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps muttering and whining, constantly complaining that the job is really hard.

mandarin_meaning: 碎屍／肢解屍體
english_meaning: dismember (a corpse); to cut up a body
explanation_mandarin: 指將屍體肢解或分割成多塊，屬於嚴重的暴力犯罪行為，常用於刑事案件的描述或新聞報導中。
explanation_english: Refers to cutting up or dismembering a corpse into pieces; a severe violent criminal act. Commonly used in descriptions of criminal cases and news reports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方在郊外發現碎屍，案件正調查中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zoi6 gaau1 ngoi6 faat3 jin6 seoi3 si1, on3 gin6 zing3 diu6 caa4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在郊外發現碎屍，案件正在調查中。
examples.english_sentence: Police found dismembered remains in the outskirts; the case is under investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢種事真係好驚，點解會有人去碎屍？
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 ni1 zung2 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 geng1, dim2 gaai2 wui5 jau5 jan4 heoi3 seoi3 si1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到這種事真的很可怕，為什麼會有人去碎屍？
examples.english_sentence: Hearing about this is really scary — why would anyone dismember a body?

mandarin_meaning: 碎尸万段
english_meaning: to dismember into ten thousand pieces; (figuratively) to tear someone limb from limb — used hyperbolically to express extreme anger or a desire for revenge
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把屍體砍碎成萬段，用來形容極端殘忍或表示極端的憤怒與報復心，常為誇張性的威脅或表達不滿。
explanation_english: Literally means to dismember a corpse into ten thousand pieces. Used figuratively to describe extreme cruelty or as a hyperbolic way to express intense anger or a desire for revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得咁過份，我真係想將佢碎屍萬段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 gam2 gwo3 fan6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 zoeng1 keoi5 seoi3 si1 maan6 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說得這麼過分，我真想把他碎尸万段。
examples.english_sentence: He said such offensive things; I really want to tear him limb from limb.

mandarin_meaning: 八卦；碎片資訊/零碎材料
english_meaning: gossip; tidbits; small bits of information; scraps
explanation_mandarin: 「碎料」在粵語俗語中常指零碎的消息或八卦，也可指散碎的材料或雜物。在香港口語裡多用來指小道消息或可供談論的趣聞。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, 碎料 commonly refers to small bits of information or gossip; it can also mean fragmented materials or scraps. In Hong Kong speech it is often used for tidbits or juicy little stories people share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你有冇啲碎料分享下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 jau5 mou5 di1 seoi3 liu6 fan1 hoeng2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你有沒有什麼八卦可以分享？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, do you have any gossip to share?

mandarin_meaning: 短促的小步子；常指跑、跳、舞或格斗時的快速小幅脚步
english_meaning: short, quick steps; rapid small footwork (as in running, dancing, or fighting)
explanation_mandarin: “碎步”指用短而快的步伐移动，常用来描述舞蹈、拳击等需要灵活脚步的动作，或日常行走时的短小步伐。
explanation_english: “Seoi bou” refers to short, rapid steps or footwork. It's used to describe quick small steps in contexts like dance, boxing, or quick cautious walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺拳館入面練碎步，好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kyun4 gun2 jap6 min6 lin6 seoi3 bou6, hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在拳馆里练碎步，很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He practices footwork (quick small steps) in the boxing gym; he's really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上樓時唔好碎步，會易跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 lau4 si4 m4 hou2 seoi3 bou6, wui5 ji6 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上楼时不要碎步，会容易跌倒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take quick short steps when going upstairs; you might fall.

mandarin_meaning: 濕漉漉
english_meaning: soaking wet; damp; soggy
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語詞，形容人或物被水弄濕、濕漉漉的狀態，語氣有時偏可愛或非正式。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adjective describing something or someone that is wet or soggy; informal and sometimes cutesy in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雨，我成個人都碎溼溼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 seoi3 sap1 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雨，我全身都濕漉漉。
examples.english_sentence: It's pouring; I'm soaking wet.

mandarin_meaning: 嘮叨/愛挑剔（口語）
english_meaning: whiny; nitpicky; overly fussy (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，常見形式為「濕濕碎」，用來形容一個人愛碎碎念、嘮叨或對細節斤斤計較，帶有貶義或打趣的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression (often seen as "濕濕碎") describing someone who is whiny, constantly nagging, or overly fussy about trivial details; typically pejorative or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁碎濕濕啦，我哋快啲出發啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 seoi3 sap1 sap1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 ceot1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別這麼嘮叨了，我們快點出發吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nitpicky/whiny, let's hurry up and leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對細節碎濕濕，成件事做得好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 sai3 zit3 seoi3 sap1 sap1, sing4 gin6 si6 zou6 dak1 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她總是對細節斤斤計較，整件事做得很慢。
examples.english_sentence: He/she always nitpicks the details, so the whole job takes a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 碎片；碎裂的小塊或零散的片段（可指實物或抽象事物如記憶、資料、影像等）
english_meaning: fragment; shard; piece (literal broken pieces or metaphorical fragments like memories, data, images)
explanation_mandarin: 指由整體破裂後形成的小塊或零散片段，也常用來比喻不完整的記憶、資料或影像等片段。
explanation_english: Refers to small pieces produced by breaking something apart, or metaphorically to scattered/incomplete bits of memory, data, images, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心打破咗杯，地上到處都係碎片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 po3 zo2 bui1, dei6 soeng6 dou3 cyu3 dou1 hai6 seoi3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心打破了杯子，地上到處都是碎片。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally broke the cup; there are shards all over the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢腦海裏面只剩下一啲記憶碎片，諗唔起完整嘅細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 hoi2 leoi5 min6 zi2 sing4 haa6 jat1 di1 gei3 jik6 seoi3 pin3, lam2 m4 hei2 jyun4 zung2 ge3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他腦海裡只剩下一些記憶碎片，想不起完整的細節。
examples.english_sentence: Only fragments of memories remain in his mind; he can't recall the full details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電腦硬碟壞咗，啲文件散晒做碎片，資料好難搵返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 nou5 ngaang6 dik6 waai6 zo2, di1 man4 gin6 saan3 saai3 zou6 seoi3 pin3, zi1 liu2 hou2 naan4 wan2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電腦硬碟壞了，文件變成很多碎片，資料很難找回。
examples.english_sentence: The computer's hard drive failed and the files fragmented; it's hard to recover the data.

mandarin_meaning: 碎片化 (suìpiànhuà)：指事物或信息被分割为零散、不连贯的小部分的状态或过程
english_meaning: fragmentation; becoming fragmented or piecemeal (e.g., information, time, attention)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词/动词/名词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述資訊、時間、注意力、學習等變得零散、不成系統或被分割成小片段的現象或過程。
explanation_english: Describes the phenomenon or process where information, time, attention, learning, etc. become scattered into small, non-contiguous pieces—losing coherence or systematic structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲資訊好碎片化，學習要有系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 zi1 seon3 hou2 seoi3 pin3 faa3, hok6 zaap6 jiu3 jau5 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在信息非常碎片化，学习需要有系统。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays information is very fragmented; learning requires a systematic approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 智能手機令我哋嘅注意力變得好碎片化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1 ling6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zyu3 ji3 lik6 bin3 dak1 hou2 seoi3 pin3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 智能手机使我们的注意力变得很碎片化。
examples.english_sentence: Smartphones have made our attention highly fragmented.

mandarin_meaning: 撕碎紙張；（比喻）銷毀文件或證據
english_meaning: to shred paper; to tear paper into pieces; (figurative) to destroy documents/evidence
explanation_mandarin: 把紙撕成小片，通常用碎紙機或手撕；在辦公場合也用來表示銷毀敏感文件或證據。
explanation_english: To tear paper into small pieces, usually with a shredder or by hand; in office contexts it also means to destroy sensitive documents or evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲舊文件我已經碎紙咗，唔使擔心會洩漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gau6 man4 gin6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 seoi3 zi2 zo2, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 wui5 sit3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些舊文件我已經碎掉了，不用擔心會洩漏。
examples.english_sentence: I've already shredded those old documents, no need to worry about leaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司叫所有離職同事將敏感資料碎紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 giu3 so2 jau5 lei4 zik1 tung4 si6 zoeng1 man5 gam2 zi1 liu6 seoi3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司叫所有離職同事把敏感資料碎掉。
examples.english_sentence: The company told all departing employees to shred sensitive materials.

mandarin_meaning: 碎纸机 (suì zhǐ jī)
english_meaning: paper shredder
explanation_mandarin: 一种将纸张切成细条或碎片以防止信息泄露的电动或手动设备，常见于办公室用于销毁敏感文件。
explanation_english: A device, electric or manual, used to cut paper into strips or confetti to prevent information leakage; commonly found in offices to destroy sensitive documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司新買咗部碎紙機，用嚟處理舊文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 san1 maai5 zo2 bou6 seoi3 zi2 gei1, jung6 lai4 cyu2 lei5 gau6 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司新买了台碎纸机，用来处理旧文件。
examples.english_sentence: The company bought a new paper shredder to handle old documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將信用卡放入碎紙機！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 fong3 jap6 seoi3 zi2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把信用卡放进碎纸机！
examples.english_sentence: Don't put your credit card into the paper shredder!

mandarin_meaning: 碎裂（suìliè）
english_meaning: to shatter; to break into pieces; to crack
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體破碎、裂開成很多碎片或出現明顯裂縫。
explanation_english: Describes an object breaking apart or cracking into many pieces or developing clear fractures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個玻璃杯跌咗，碎裂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 lei4 bui1 dit3 zo2, seoi3 lit6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玻璃杯摔碎了。
examples.english_sentence: The glass cup fell and shattered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震令好多窗戶碎裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 ling6 hou2 do1 coeng1 wu6 seoi3 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震使很多窗户破裂。
examples.english_sentence: The earthquake caused many windows to crack/shatter.

mandarin_meaning: 零錢；少量的錢
english_meaning: small change; loose change; a small amount of money
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指零散的硬幣或小額的錢，常用於日常生活中表示沒有整鈔或只有少量錢。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for loose coins or small amounts of money; typically used in everyday speech to indicate one only has small change rather than larger bills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇帶紙幣，淨係得啲碎銀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 daai3 zi2 bai6, zing6 hai6 dak1 di1 seoi3 ngan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒帶紙鈔，只有一些零錢。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't bring any banknotes; I only have some loose change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇碎銀俾我搭的士？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 seoi3 ngan4 bei2 ngo5 daap3 dik1 si2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有零錢給我搭計程車？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any change to give me for a taxi?

mandarin_meaning: 碑，石碑；立在地面上刻有文字的纪念或记录的标志
english_meaning: stele; stone tablet or monument bearing inscriptions
explanation_mandarin: 用石头或其他材料刻字，立于地面以纪念、褒扬或记载事迹的标志或碑刻。
explanation_english: A stone or metal tablet (stele) bearing inscriptions, erected as a monument or record to commemorate, honor, or document events or people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有座古碑，記載住嗰度嘅歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zo6 gu2 bei1, gei3 zoi6 zyu6 go2 dou6 ge3 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一座古碑，记载着那里的历史。
examples.english_sentence: There is an old stele in the park that records the history of the place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寺廟外有塊石碑，上面刻咗先人嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 miu6 ngoi6 jau5 faai3 sek6 bei1, seong6 min6 hak1 zo2 sin1 jan4 ge3 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺庙外有一块石碑，上面刻着先人的名字。
examples.english_sentence: There is a stone stele outside the temple with ancestors' names engraved on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗紀念烈士立咗塊紀念碑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 gei3 nim6 lit6 si6 lap6 zo2 faai3 gei3 nim6 bei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了纪念烈士立了一块纪念碑。
examples.english_sentence: They erected a memorial stele to commemorate the martyrs.

mandarin_meaning: 碑帖（碑刻及其拓本或供學習書法的法帖）
english_meaning: rubbings of stone inscriptions; model calligraphy works based on stele inscriptions
explanation_mandarin: 指刻在石碑上的書法作品或從石碑拓下來的拓本，常作為學習書法的範本或收藏研究的資料。
explanation_english: Refers to calligraphic inscriptions carved on stone steles or the rubbings taken from them; used as models for studying calligraphy or collected as historical/artistic materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意收藏古代碑帖，成日翻嚟睇學書法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sou1 cong4 gu2 doi6 bei1 tip3, sing4 jat6 faan1 lai4 tai2 hok6 syu1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡收藏古代碑帖，常常翻來看學書法。
examples.english_sentence: He likes collecting ancient stele rubbings and often studies calligraphy from them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 書法班老師畀咗幾份碑帖，叫我哋臨摹筆劃同結構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 faat3 baan1 lou5 si1 bei2 zo2 gei2 fan6 bei1 tip3, giu3 ngo5 dei6 lam4 mo1 bat1 waak6 tung4 git3 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 書法班老師給了幾份碑帖，叫我們臨摹筆劃和結構。
examples.english_sentence: The calligraphy teacher gave several rubbings and asked us to copy the strokes and composition.

mandarin_meaning: 碑石；石碑、墓碑等用來刻字或紀念的石塊
english_meaning: stele; monumental stone; tombstone — a stone slab or pillar used for inscriptions or memorials
explanation_mandarin: 指用於刻字或紀念的石塊或石碑，常見於墓葬、紀念碑或歷史遺址上，表面可能刻有文字或浮雕。
explanation_english: A stone slab or pillar used for inscriptions or as a memorial; commonly found as tombstones, steles, or monuments at historical sites and often bears carved text or reliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座古墓嘅碑石已經風化，好難睇清上面嘅文字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 gu2 mou6 ge3 bei1 sek6 ji5 ging1 fung1 faa3, hou2 naan4 tai2 cing1 soeng6 min6 ge3 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座古墓的碑石已經風化，很難看清上面的文字。
examples.english_sentence: The stele at that ancient tomb has weathered; it's hard to make out the inscriptions on it.

mandarin_meaning: 碑铭（刻在石碑或墓碑上的文字，用以纪念、讚揚或記述事跡）
english_meaning: inscription on a stele or monument; commemorative inscription
explanation_mandarin: 碑銘：刻在石碑、墓碑、紀念碑等上的文字，通常用來紀念某人或記述重要事跡、有時含頌揚或警示意義。
explanation_english: An inscription carved on a stele, tombstone, or monument, typically used to commemorate a person or record notable deeds; can also serve to praise or admonish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊石碑上面刻住一段碑銘，係用嚟紀念嗰位先人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 sek6 bei1 soeng6 min6 hak1 zyu6 jat1 dyun6 bei1 ming4, hai6 jung6 lai4 gei2 nim6 go2 wai6 sin1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊石碑上刻著一段碑銘，是用來紀念那位先人。
examples.english_sentence: This stele bears an inscription that commemorates that ancestor.

mandarin_meaning: 碗 (wǎn)，盛食物的器皿
english_meaning: bowl (a round, deep dish used for holding food or liquid)
explanation_mandarin: 用來盛載食物或液體的器皿，通常為圓形、有深度，可用於盛飯、湯等。
explanation_english: A vessel used to hold food or liquids, typically round and deep; commonly used for rice, soup, and similar dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個碗好靚，我想買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wun2 hou2 leng3, ngo5 soeng2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个碗很漂亮，我想买。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl is beautiful; I want to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請畀我一碗湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 bei2 ngo5 jat1 wun2 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我一碗汤。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a bowl of soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好打爛個碗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daa2 laan6 go3 wun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要打破这个碗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't break the bowl.

mandarin_meaning: 小碗的（通常為仿製的）魚翅湯（港式小吃）
english_meaning: a small bowl of (usually imitation) shark-fin soup — a popular Hong Kong street food
explanation_mandarin: 碗仔翅是香港常見的小吃，字面上是小碗的魚翅湯，但多數為仿製或用粉絲、蛋等材料製成的廉價湯品，常在街邊小食檔或茶餐廳供應。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong snack: literally 'small-bowl shark's fin.' It usually refers to an affordable, imitation shark-fin soup served in small bowls, made with ingredients like vermicelli, egg and broth, commonly sold at street stalls or casual eateries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋檔口有賣碗仔翅，一碗只係幾蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dong3 hau2 jau5 maai6 wun2 zai2 ci3, jat1 wun2 zi2 hai6 gei2 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的摊位有卖碗仔翅，一碗只要几块钱。
examples.english_sentence: Their stall sells small bowls of won zai chi; one bowl only costs a few dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路鍾意食碗仔翅，因為又熱又唔貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zung1 ji3 sik6 wun2 zai2 ci3, jan1 wai6 jau6 jit6 jau6 m4 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜欢吃碗仔翅，因为又热又不贵。
examples.english_sentence: Kids like to eat won zai chi because it's hot and cheap.

mandarin_meaning: 碗碟 / 家務瑣事；瑣碎的東西
english_meaning: literally 'bowls and plates'; colloquially 'small household items' or 'trivial matters/odds and ends'
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指碗和碟，口語中常用來指零碎的家務用品或瑣碎的小事，不一定只指餐具。
explanation_english: Literally refers to bowls and plates. Colloquially used to mean small household items or trivial matters/odds and ends, not necessarily limited to tableware.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為啲碗碗碟碟嘈交，專注返啲重要嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai6 di1 wan2 wan2 dip6 dip6 cou4 gaau1, zyun1 zyu3 faan1 di1 zung6 jiu3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要為那些碗碗碟碟吵架，專注於重要的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue over those trivial things; focus on what's important.

mandarin_meaning: 碗碟（指碗和碟等餐具）
english_meaning: bowls and plates; crockery; dishes
explanation_mandarin: 指碗和碟等餐具，有時也用來泛指需要清洗的碗盤。
explanation_english: Refers to bowls and plates (tableware); can also be used to mean dishes that need to be washed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去洗碗碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 sai2 wun2 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去洗碗碟。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to wash the dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有好多碗碟，要收埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 wun2 dip6, jiu3 sau1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里面有很多碗碟，要收起来。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of dishes in the kitchen; they need to be put away.

mandarin_meaning: 碗和筷子（餐具）
english_meaning: bowls and chopsticks; tableware/eating utensils
explanation_mandarin: 指吃飯用的碗和筷子，常用來泛指餐具或家中的飯具。
explanation_english: Refers to bowls and chopsticks used for eating; often used to mean tableware or dining utensils in general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯，記得洗埋啲碗筷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6, gei3 dak1 sai2 maai4 di1 wun2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭，记得把碗筷也洗了。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, remember to wash the bowls and chopsticks too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋買咗好多新碗筷搬入新屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 wun2 faai3 bun1 jap6 san1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们买了很多新的碗筷搬进新房子。
examples.english_sentence: They bought a lot of new bowls and chopsticks when moving into the new home.

mandarin_meaning: 碗筷；餐具（亦可借指一日三餐或謀生的飯食）
english_meaning: bowl and chopsticks; tableware (also used metonymically for meals or one's livelihood)
explanation_mandarin: 「碗箸」字面指碗和筷子，即餐具；在口語中也常用作借代，指一日三餐或維持生計的飯食。
explanation_english: Literally 'bowl and chopsticks' referring to tableware; colloquially can be used metonymically to mean meals or the means of earning a living (food/livelihood).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企入咗客，咪拿多啲碗箸出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 jap6 zo2 haak3, mai5 naa4 do1 di1 wun2 zyu6 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡來了客人，拿多一點碗筷出來。
examples.english_sentence: There are guests at home; bring out more bowls and chopsticks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠呢份工先有碗箸食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 ni1 fan6 gung1 sin1 jau5 wun2 zyu6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠這份工作才能有飯吃。
examples.english_sentence: He depends on this job to have food/a livelihood.

mandarin_meaning: 碘（化学元素，符号 I）
english_meaning: iodine (chemical element, symbol I)
explanation_mandarin: 一种化学元素（原子序数53，化学符号 I），常用于消毒剂及作为人体必需的微量元素，缺碘可导致甲状腺肿大（地方性甲状腺肿）。
explanation_english: A chemical element (atomic number 53, symbol I). Used in disinfectants and as an essential trace nutrient for thyroid function; iodine deficiency can cause goiter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我缺碘，要補充碘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 kyut3 din2, jiu3 bou2 cung1 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我缺碘，要补充碘。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I'm iodine-deficient and need to supplement iodine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你屋企有冇碘酒？有一支用嚟消毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 din2 zau2? jau5 jat1 zi1 jung6 lai4 siu1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你家里有没有碘酒？有一瓶可以用来消毒。
examples.english_sentence: Do you have iodine tincture at home? There's a bottle used for disinfecting.

mandarin_meaning: 碘酒
english_meaning: iodine (tincture); iodine solution used as an antiseptic
explanation_mandarin: 碘酒是一種含碘的酒精溶液，作為外用消毒劑，常用於清潔小傷口或皮膚消毒以防感染。
explanation_english: Iodine tincture — an alcohol-based iodine solution used externally as an antiseptic to clean minor wounds or disinfect skin to prevent infection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家中常備一支碘酒，好應付小傷口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zung1 soeng4 bei6 jat1 zi1 din2 zau2, hou2 jing3 fu6 siu2 soeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家中常备一支碘酒，好应付小伤口。
examples.english_sentence: Keep a bottle of iodine at home to deal with small wounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友跌倒割破手，媽媽用碘酒幫佢消毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 daat6 dou2 got3 po3 sau2, maa4 maa1 jung6 din2 zau2 bong1 keoi5 siu1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友跌倒割破手，妈妈用碘酒帮他消毒。
examples.english_sentence: The child fell and cut his hand; the mother used iodine to disinfect it.

mandarin_meaning: 碟；盘子；光盘、唱片（粤语中常作名词，也可作量词，如“一碟菜”）
english_meaning: disk; small plate or saucer; (colloquially) a CD/album; also used as a classifier for small dishes
explanation_mandarin: “碟”在粤语读作 dip6，主要指小盘子或碟子，也可指光盘/唱片。在口语中可用作量词（例如“一碟菜”）、亦出现在一些日常短语如“洗碟”（洗碟子）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese pronounced dip6. It primarily means a small plate or saucer, and can also mean a disc/CD/album. Used as a noun and sometimes as a classifier for small portions (e.g. "one plate/dish"); appears in common expressions like "wash the dishes".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟餅好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 beng2 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘饼很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of cookies is very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有一碟歌想畀你聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 jat1 dip6 go1 soeng2 bei2 nei5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一张唱片想给你听。
examples.english_sentence: I have a CD/album I want you to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完記得洗碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 gei3 dak1 sai2 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完记得洗碟子。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wash the dishes after eating.

mandarin_meaning: 碟仙（通靈遊戲/儀式），利用碟子或盤子作媒介進行問答的靈異遊戲，類似西方的通靈板（Ouija）
english_meaning: a saucer/plate spirit game (a divination séance using a saucer as a medium), similar to the Ouija board
explanation_mandarin: 碟仙是一種民間通靈遊戲，參與者以碟子、杯底或盤子作媒介，輕放手指讓碟子移動以答覆問題。此類活動在華語圈常被視為迷信或可能引發心裡恐慌與安全顧慮。
explanation_english: A folk spirit/divination game where participants use a saucer, plate, or cup base as a medium; fingers are placed lightly and the saucer is said to move to answer questions. Similar to the Ouija board and often regarded as superstition or potentially psychologically/safely problematic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好玩碟仙，真係好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 waan2 dip6 sin1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngai4him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要玩碟仙，真的很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play with the saucer spirit game; it's really dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 碟子；小盤子（有時口語中「碟/碟子」亦可指光碟）
english_meaning: small plate; saucer; dish (occasionally colloquial for a disc/CD depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放食物的小盤子或碟子。在不同語境下，「碟」或「碟子」有時也用來指光碟、唱片等圓盤狀物，但日常主要指餐具。
explanation_english: Refers to a small plate or saucer used to hold food. In some contexts, especially colloquially, '碟' can also mean a disc (e.g., CD/DVD), but commonly it denotes tableware.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房有幾隻碟子要洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 jau5 gei2 zek3 dip6 zi2 jiu3 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房有幾個碟子要洗。
examples.english_sentence: There are several plates in the kitchen that need washing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個碟子好靚，係陶瓷嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dip6 zi2 hou2 leng3, hai6 tou4 ci4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個碟子很漂亮，是陶瓷的。
examples.english_sentence: This plate is very pretty; it's made of ceramic.

mandarin_meaning: （俗稱）DJ，負責在酒吧/夜店/活動播放唱片或混音的人
english_meaning: slang for a DJ — a person who plays records/mixes music at bars, clubs, or events
explanation_mandarin: 「碟頭」是香港粵語的俗稱，用來指在酒吧、夜店或活動上播放唱碟或混音的人（即DJ）。字面上「碟」指唱片或光碟，「頭」用作指人，屬口語用法。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "碟頭" is a colloquial term for a DJ — someone who plays records or mixes music at bars, clubs, or events. Literally "碟" refers to a disc/record and "頭" marks a person; it's informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個酒吧請咗個好叻嘅碟頭，音樂好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 zau2 baa1 ceng2 zo2 go3 hou2 lek1 ge3 dip6 tau4, jam1 ngok6 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚酒吧請了一位很厲害的DJ，音樂很好。
examples.english_sentence: The bar hired a great DJ tonight; the music was awesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做碟頭已經有十年經驗，對舞曲了解好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dip6 tau4 ji5 ging1 jau5 sap6 nin4 ging1 jim6, deoi3 mou5 kuk1 liu5 gaai2 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當碟頭已經有十年經驗，對舞曲瞭解很深。
examples.english_sentence: He has been a DJ for ten years and has a deep knowledge of dance tracks.

mandarin_meaning: 碟头饭；盘装的家常便饭（把菜和饭放在盘子里）；也可口语化指维持生计的谋生方式/饭碗
english_meaning: a plate meal (home-style rice and dishes served on a plate); colloquially can mean one's bread-and-butter or source of livelihood
explanation_mandarin: 指把飯和菜盛在碟上吃的家常飯，多見於小食店或家庭。口語中也可引申為靠某種小生意或工作維持生計的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a simple, home-style meal served on a plate (rice with dishes). Common in small eateries or homes. Informally it can be extended to mean a small business or job that provides one's livelihood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落街食碟頭飯啦，唔使煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 gaai1 sik6 dip6 tau4 faan6 laa1, m4 sai2 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天出去吃碟头饭吧，不用煮饭。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out for a plate meal today; no need to cook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開間小店賣碟頭飯，日日都好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 maai6 dip6 tau4 faan6, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他開小店賣碟头饭，每天都很忙。
examples.english_sentence: He runs a small shop selling plate meals and is busy every day.

mandarin_meaning: 一碟饭 / 一盘饭（口语）
english_meaning: a plate of rice; a plated meal (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语用词，字面指放在碟上的飯或一碟飯菜，常用于香港日常用语，相当于普通话的“一盘饭/一碟饭”。可指一份简单的餐食或外賣裝在碟上的饭菜。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning 'plate of rice' — referring to rice (and often dishes) served on a plate. Common in Hong Kong speech to denote a single plated meal or a portion of rice and accompanying dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗碟飯返去食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 dip6 faan6 faan1 heoi3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚买了一碟饭回去吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a plate of rice to take home and eat tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 碧（bì）：青綠色、翡翠色；常用於修飾顏色或作人名用字
english_meaning: jade-green; bluish-green; emerald (color); used in compounds and names
explanation_mandarin: 「碧」表示帶青綠的顏色，常見於詞語如「碧海」、「碧綠」、「碧藍」，也常作人名或書面用字。
explanation_english: “碧” denotes a bluish-green or jade-like color. It is commonly used to describe color in compounds (e.g., 碧海, 碧綠) and also appears in personal names and literary expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條裙係碧綠色，好襯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 hai6 bik1 luk6 sik1, hou2 can3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子是碧绿色，很适合你。
examples.english_sentence: This dress is jade-green; it suits you well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅海水有時碧藍得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hoi2 seoi2 jau5 si4 bik1 laam4 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的海水有时碧蓝得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's seawater is sometimes jade-blue and very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽叫陳碧玲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 giu3 can4 bik1 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈叫陈碧玲。
examples.english_sentence: My mother's name is Chen Bilin.

mandarin_meaning: 贝克汉姆（David Beckham）
english_meaning: Beckham (David Beckham)
explanation_mandarin: 「碧咸」是粵語對英國足球員大衛·貝克漢姆（David Beckham）名字的音譯。口語中亦可用來稱呼或比喻長相、髮型或氣質像貝克漢姆的人。
explanation_english: “碧咸” is the Cantonese transliteration of the English name David Beckham. In colloquial use it refers to Beckham himself or is used metaphorically for someone who looks or styles themselves like Beckham (e.g., hairstyle or handsome appearance).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 碧咸真係好靚仔，咁多女仔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bik1 haam4 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 zai2, gam2 do1 neoi5 zai2 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碧咸真的很帅，很多女孩喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: Beckham is really handsome; many girls like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢剪咗個新髮型，好似碧咸咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zin2 zo2 go3 san1 faat3 jing4, hou2 ci5 bik1 haam4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剪了個新髮型，像貝克漢姆一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He got a new haircut that looks like Beckham's.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗俚語）相当于“婊子”或“贱人”，用于侮辱性称呼
english_meaning: Derogatory slang equivalent to 'bitch' — an insulting term used to call someone nasty or despicable
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（粗俗俚语，用作骂人）
explanation_mandarin: “碧池”在香港粤语中是粗俗的俚语，源自對英語“bitch”的諧音，用來侮辱或罵人，常帶性別貶義或粗魯語氣，不宜在正式場合使用。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '碧池' is a vulgar slang term, a homophone of the English 'bitch'. It is used as an insulting epithet to attack someone's character (often with sexist connotations). It is coarse and inappropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個碧池，成日講人壞話又唔負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 bik1 ci4, sing4 jat6 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa6 jau6 m4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她真是个婊子，成天说别人坏话又不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: She's really a bitch — always talking badly about people and never taking responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 碧绿的波涛；水面上碧绿色的波纹（诗意用语）
english_meaning: emerald (or azure) waves; greenish-blue ripples on water (poetic)
explanation_mandarin: “碧波”多用於詩詞和文學中，形容水面呈碧綠色的波紋或波浪，有時也作比喻用來描寫清澈、美麗的景象。
explanation_english: A poetic term used to describe greenish-blue ripples or waves on the surface of water; often used in literature to evoke clear, beautiful scenery and sometimes used metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海面上泛起點點碧波，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 min6 soeng6 faan6 hei2 dim2 dim2 bik1 bo1, ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海面上泛起点点碧波，景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: Little emerald ripples spread across the sea; the scenery was beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 碧空（bìkōng）：蔚藍的天空；晴朗無雲的天空
english_meaning: azure sky; a clear, blue sky
explanation_mandarin: 表示晴朗、蔚藍的天空，語氣偏文學或詩意，常用於書面或描寫景色時。
explanation_english: Refers to a clear, deep-blue sky. The term is somewhat literary or poetic and often used in descriptions of scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日碧空如洗，啱晒去海邊曬太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 bik1 hung1 jyu4 sai2, aam1 saai3 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 saai3 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天碧空如洗，很適合去海邊曬太陽。
examples.english_sentence: The sky is crystal clear today — perfect for going to the beach to sunbathe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺山頂望出去，碧空同遠山連成一片，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 saan1 deng2 mong6 ceot1 heoi3, bik1 hung1 tung4 jyun5 saan1 lin4 seng4 jat1 pin3, ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在山頂望出去，碧空與遠山連成一片，景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: From the mountaintop, the blue sky blends with the distant mountains — the view is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 碧绿（bì lǜ），指鮮豔的綠色，偏藍綠或像翡翠的綠色。
english_meaning: emerald green; bright bluish-green
explanation_mandarin: 形容詞，用來描述一種鮮明、清澈且帶藍調的綠色，常用於描寫水色、植物或布料等。
explanation_english: An adjective describing a vivid, clear green—often bluish or emerald-like. Commonly used for water, foliage, fabrics, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條河水碧綠，好似一塊翡翠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 ho4 seoi2 bik1 luk6, hou2 ci5 jat1 faai3 fei3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條河的水碧綠，好像一塊翡翠。
examples.english_sentence: The river's water is emerald green, like a piece of jade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗一件碧綠色嘅衫，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 gin6 bik1 luk6 sik1 ge3 saam1, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她穿了一件碧绿色的衣服，非常醒目。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is wearing an emerald-green shirt; it's very eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 碧螺春（Bìluóchūn），一种产自江苏苏州洞庭山的名优绿茶
english_meaning: Biluochun (a famous Chinese green tea); literally 'Green Snail Spring' tea
explanation_mandarin: 碧螺春是中国传统名茶之一，产自江苏苏州洞庭山。茶叶芽叶细嫩，卷曲如螺，汤色清绿，香气浓郁且带花果香，口感鲜爽甘甜，属于绿茶类。
explanation_english: Biluochun is a well-known traditional Chinese green tea from Dongting Mountain near Suzhou, Jiangsu. The young leaves are tightly rolled like snails, producing a clear green liquor with a strong floral and fruity aroma and a fresh, sweet taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意飲碧螺春，佢香又清新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 bik1 lo4 ceon1, keoi5 hoeng1 jau6 cing1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢喝碧螺春，它香气宜人、清新可口。
examples.english_sentence: I like drinking Biluochun; it's fragrant and refreshing.

mandarin_meaning: 大、偉大；常見於複合詞，如「碩士」（碩士學位）
english_meaning: large; great; eminent; appears in compounds such as 碩士 (master's degree)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（用於複合詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「碩」本義指大、偉大，主要用於複合詞中表示程度大或學位名稱（如碩士）。
explanation_english: The character denotes largeness or greatness and is mainly used in compounds to indicate magnitude or as part of degree titles (e.g., 碩士 for master's degree).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎咗碩士學位，依家做緊研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zo2 suk6 si6 hok6 wai6, ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到碩士學位，現在正在做研究。
examples.english_sentence: He obtained a master's degree and is now doing research.

mandarin_meaning: 硕士（學位／研究生階段）
english_meaning: master's degree; master's (graduate level)
explanation_mandarin: 指大學之後的研究生學位，一般為碩士學位（例如文學碩士、理學碩士等）。也可指取得該學位的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the postgraduate academic degree (master's degree) awarded after undergraduate studies, or to a person who holds such a degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家讀緊碩士課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gan2 suk6 si6 fo3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在讀碩士課程。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently studying a master's program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 取得碩士學位後，佢搵到一份好工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 dak1 suk6 si6 hok6 wai6 hau6, keoi5 wan2 dou3 jat1 fan6 hou2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 取得碩士學位後，他找到了一份好工作。
examples.english_sentence: After obtaining a master's degree, he found a good job.

mandarin_meaning: 碩果僅存（僅剩少數或僅存一個突出或有價值的事物）
english_meaning: only a few remain; the few surviving fruits/achievements; scarcely any left
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作名詞或形容詞性短語）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (used as noun or adjectival phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 原指成熟的大果子只剩下少數，現多用來比喻在經歷衰敗或破壞後，只剩下少量或唯一的珍貴事物或人物。
explanation_english: Originally referring to only a few large fruits remaining, it is now used figuratively to describe that after decline or destruction, only a few (or a single) valuable items or people survive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前好多傳統手藝人，依家就碩果僅存得幾個老藝人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hou2 do1 cyun4 tung2 sau2 ngai6 jan4, ji1 gaa1 zau6 sek6 gwo2 gan2 cyun4 dak1 gei2 go3 lou5 ngai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有很多傳統手藝人，現在僅存的只有幾位老藝人。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be many traditional craftsmen; now only a few elderly artisans remain.

mandarin_meaning: 碰 (pèng)：接触、撞到、遇到；也可指偶然遇见或遭遇
english_meaning: to touch; to bump; to encounter; to meet by chance; to run into
explanation_mandarin: “碰”表示接触或被撞到，也常用于表示偶然遇见或遭遇某情形（如“碰到老朋友”、“碰釘”表示被拒絕/放鸽子）。
explanation_english: “碰” is used to indicate touching, bumping, or encountering someone/something. It can mean meeting by chance (e.g. 'ran into an old friend') and appears in expressions like '碰釘' (to be stood up or rejected).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街度碰到個舊同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 pung3 dou3 go3 gau6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上碰到一個舊同學。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into an old classmate on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心唔好碰到隻狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 pung3 dou3 zek3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心不要碰到那隻狗。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful not to touch/bump into the dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我約佢出街，但俾佢碰釘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joek3 keoi5 ceot1 gaai1, daan6 bei2 keoi5 pung3 ding1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我約他出去，但被他放鴿子/放我鴿子。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him out, but he stood me up.

mandarin_meaning: 碰到；遇到（偶然遇見或遇到問題）
english_meaning: to meet, run into, encounter (someone or something), often unexpectedly; can also mean to run into a problem
explanation_mandarin: 「碰上」表示偶然遇見某人或遇到某事、某個問題，常用來形容意外相遇或突發的困難。
explanation_english: Used to indicate unexpectedly meeting someone or encountering something (including problems). Often describes an accidental meeting or an unexpected difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我昨日喺街度碰上舊同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zok6 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 pung3 soeng5 gau6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上碰到了老同学。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into an old classmate on the street yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺檢查時碰上啲技術問題，搞咗幾個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gim2 caa4 si4 pung3 soeng5 di1 gei6 seot6 man6 tai4, gaau2 zo2 gei2 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在检查时碰到了一些技术问题，耽误了好几个小时。
examples.english_sentence: We ran into some technical problems during the inspection and were delayed for a few hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想再碰上麻煩，所以小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 pung3 soeng5 maa4 faan4, so2 ji5 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想再碰到麻烦，所以小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to run into trouble again, so he handles things carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 碰巧；正好（遇到或發生）
english_meaning: to happen to; to coincide; to meet by chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情恰好發生或正巧遇到某人或某事，常用於口語，與「碰巧」「剛好」意義相近。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb phrase meaning that something happened by chance or exactly coincided; similar in use to 'happen to' or 'by coincidence.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我行街時碰啱阿珍，於是一齊去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hang4 gaai1 si4 pung3 ngaam1 aa3 zan1, jyu1 si6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我逛街時碰巧遇到阿珍，所以一起去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into Ah Jan while shopping, so we went for tea together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到係因為巴士碰啱塞車，無辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 hai6 jan1 wai6 baa1 si2 pung3 ngaam1 sak1 ce1, mou5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他遲到是因為碰巧遇到塞車，沒辦法。
examples.english_sentence: He was late because the bus happened to get stuck in traffic; there was nothing he could do.

mandarin_meaning: （偶然）碰面；（頭部）碰撞
english_meaning: to bump into (someone); to collide (literally 'bump heads'); to meet unexpectedly
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語說法，既可指兩人不期而遇、突然碰面，也可用作形容（頭部）相撞或碰擊，視語境而定。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression that can mean to run into someone unexpectedly (meet by chance) or literally to bump/collide heads; the exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街度行嘅時候，突然同阿明碰埋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 haang4 ge3 si4 hau6, dat6 jin4 tung4 aa3 ming4 pung3 maai4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上走的時候，突然和阿明碰面了。
examples.english_sentence: I was walking on the street when I suddenly ran into Ah Ming.

mandarin_meaning: 碰壁（pèng bì）：遇到阻礙、受挫或被拒絕
english_meaning: to encounter setbacks; to run into obstacles or be stonewalled
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指撞到牆壁；比喻在做事情或提出要求時遇到阻礙、遭到拒絕或無法進展。
explanation_english: Literally 'bump into a wall'; figuratively to meet obstacles, setbacks, rejection, or be unable to make progress when attempting something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試咗好多次申請，但係最後都碰壁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 san1 cing2, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 pung3 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我申请了很多次，但最后都碰壁。
examples.english_sentence: I applied many times, but I kept hitting roadblocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做呢個研究遇到好多困難，一直碰壁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ni1 go3 jin4 gau3 jyu6 dou3 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan6, jat1 zik6 pung3 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做這項研究遇到很多困難，一直碰壁。
examples.english_sentence: He ran into many difficulties in this research and kept encountering setbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我向管理層反映問題，但全部都碰壁，冇人理會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hoeng3 gun2 lei5 cang4 faan2 jing6 man6 tai4, daan6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 pung3 bik1, mou5 jan4 lei5 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我向管理層反映問題，但全部都碰壁，沒人理會。
examples.english_sentence: I raised the issue to management, but I was stonewalled every time—no one paid attention.

mandarin_meaning: 碰巧（偶然、湊巧）
english_meaning: by chance; coincidentally; luckily
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情不是刻意安排，而是偶然發生，帶有湊巧或幸運的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened unexpectedly or by coincidence, often implying a bit of luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日碰巧喺灣仔見到阿明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 pung3 haau2 hai2 waan1 zai2 gin3 dou3 aa3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天在灣仔碰巧遇到阿明。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to see Ah Ming in Wan Chai today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋碰巧喺同一班機上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 pung3 haau2 hai2 tung4 jat1 baan1 gei1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們碰巧在同一班飛機上。
examples.english_sentence: We happened to be on the same flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日遲到，但碰巧老細未到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ci4 dou3, daan6 pung3 haau2 lou5 sai3 mei6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天遲到了，但碰巧老板還沒到。
examples.english_sentence: I was late today, but luckily the boss hadn't arrived yet.

mandarin_meaning: 碰碰運氣；試試運氣（常指買彩票或賭博碰碰運氣）
english_meaning: to try one's luck (especially by buying a lottery ticket or gambling); to get lucky and win a (usually small) prize
explanation_mandarin: 「碰彩」是廣東話口語，指碰碰運氣、嘗試靠運氣中獎或贏錢，常用於買彩票或小賭一把的情況。有時強調只是試運氣而非靠技巧。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to try one's luck, typically by buying a lottery ticket or placing a small bet. It implies relying on chance rather than skill and sometimes denotes a small, casual attempt to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去買張彩票碰碰彩，試下運氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 maai5 zoeng1 coi2 piu3 pung3 coi2, si3 haa5 wan6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去買張彩票碰碰運氣，試試運氣。
examples.english_sentence: I'll buy a lottery ticket tonight and try my luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去賭場碰碰彩，但大部分時間都輸多過贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 coeng4 pung3 coi2, daan6 daai6 bou6 fan6 si4 gaan1 dou1 syu1 do1 gwo3 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常去賭場碰碰運氣，但大多時候輸多於贏。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to casinos to try his luck, but most of the time he loses more than he wins.

mandarin_meaning: 碰撞 (pèngzhuàng)：物體相撞；比喻意見或立場發生衝突
english_meaning: collision; to collide; a clash (physical or figurative conflict)
explanation_mandarin: 指兩個或多個物體互相碰擊產生衝突或撞擊，也可用來比喻意見、立場或文化上的衝突。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more objects physically hitting each other (a collision). It can also be used metaphorically for clashes of opinions, positions, or cultures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩部車喺十字路口發生咗碰撞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 bou6 ce1 hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 faat3 sang1 zo2 pong3 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两辆车在十字路口发生了碰撞。
examples.english_sentence: Two cars collided at the intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個部門喺意見上有碰撞，需時協調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 bou6 mun4 hai2 ji3 gin3 seong6 jau5 pong3 zong6, seoi1 si4 hip3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个部门在意见上有碰撞，需要时间协调。
examples.english_sentence: The two departments clashed in opinion and need time to coordinate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺觀點上發生咗激烈嘅碰撞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 gun1 dim2 soeng6 faat3 sang1 zo2 gik1 lit6 ge3 pong3 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两人在观点上发生了激烈的碰撞。
examples.english_sentence: They had a fierce clash of viewpoints.

mandarin_meaning: 碰杯；舉杯互相輕碰以示祝賀或敬酒
english_meaning: to clink glasses; to toast
explanation_mandarin: 兩人或多人把酒杯輕輕碰撞，表示祝賀、慶祝或互相敬酒的行為。
explanation_english: The action of lightly clinking drinking glasses together among two or more people to express congratulations, celebration, or to make a toast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚大家一齊碰杯，為新年乾杯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 pung3 bui1, wai6 san1 nin4 gon1 bui1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚大家一起碰杯，為新年乾杯！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight let's all clink glasses together and toast to the New Year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺婚宴上，新人同賓客一齊碰杯慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fan1 jin2 soeng6, san1 jan4 tung4 ban1 haak3 jat1 cai4 pung3 bui1 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在婚宴上，新人和賓客一起碰杯慶祝。
examples.english_sentence: At the wedding banquet, the newlyweds and guests clinked glasses to celebrate.

mandarin_meaning: 故意佯装被碰撞或被弄坏物品，以敲诈或骗取赔偿的诈骗行为
english_meaning: to stage an accident or fake being hit/damaged in order to extort money; a staged-accident scam
explanation_mandarin: “碰瓷”指有人故意制造看似被撞或物品被碰坏的情形，通过夸大损失或谎称受伤向对方索要钱财以达到敲诈目的。
explanation_english: “Pèng cí” refers to a scam where someone deliberately stages an apparent collision or damage (often pretending to be hit by a vehicle) to extort compensation or money from the target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，最近有人喺街度碰瓷，成日扮俾車撞嚟呃錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, zeoi3 gan6 jau5 jan4 hai2 gaai1 dou6 pung3 ci4, seng4 jat6 baan6 bei2 ce1 zong6 lei4 aak3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心，最近有人在街上碰瓷，经常装作被车撞来骗钱。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful — recently people have been staging accidents on the street to extort money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方警告市民要小心碰瓷詐騙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ging2 gou3 si5 man4 jiu3 siu2 sam1 pung3 ci4 zaa3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方警告市民要提高警惕，防范碰瓷诈骗。
examples.english_sentence: The police warned the public to be vigilant against碰瓷 scams.

mandarin_meaning: 碰碰车
english_meaning: bumper car; (colloquial) a clash or collision between people/groups
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（口語；亦可作比喻用）
explanation_mandarin: 原指遊樂場的碰碰車遊樂設施；口語中也用來形容人或部門之間頻繁碰撞、摩擦或衝突。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the amusement-park ride 'bumper cars'. Colloquially used to describe frequent collisions or clashes between people, teams, or departments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去遊樂場玩碰碰車啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jau4 lok6 coeng4 waan2 pung3 pung3 ce1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去遊樂場玩碰碰車吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the amusement park to ride the bumper cars tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近成日部門之間碰碰車，令項目拖慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 bou6 mun4 zi1 gaan1 pung3 pung3 ce1, ling6 hong6 muk6 to1 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近經常有部門之間的摩擦，導致項目進度放慢。
examples.english_sentence: The company has been experiencing frequent clashes between departments recently, causing project delays.

mandarin_meaning: 碰见
english_meaning: to meet; to run into; to encounter (usually by chance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在偶然或無預期的情況下遇到某人或某事。
explanation_english: Indicates meeting or encountering someone or something, typically by chance or unexpectedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日喺街市碰見阿華，佢講咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1jat6 hai2 gaai1si5 pung3 gin3 aa3 waa4, keoi5 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天在菜市場碰見了阿華，他說了很多話。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into Ah Wah at the market today; he talked a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇諗過喺工作時會碰見咁嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 lam2 gwo3 hai2 gung1 zok3 si4 wui5 pung3 gin3 gam2 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒想到在工作時會碰到這樣的問題。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect to encounter such problems at work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嘅時候我哋碰見一班義工喺清理山徑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6 ngo5 dei6 pung3 gin3 jat1 baan1 ji6 gung1 hai2 cing1 lei5 saan1 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在爬山的時候碰見了一群志願者在清理山徑。
examples.english_sentence: We encountered a group of volunteers clearing the trail while hiking.

mandarin_meaning: 见面 / 碰面 / 遇见
english_meaning: to meet (someone); to run into someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示与某人见面或碰到，可以指事先约好的会面，也可指偶然遇见。
explanation_english: Indicates meeting someone or running into someone; can refer to a planned meeting or an accidental encounter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期記得碰面傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 gei3 dak1 pung3 min6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下星期记得碰面谈谈。
examples.english_sentence: Remember we'll meet next week to talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街市撞到阿明，結果我哋碰面傾咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 zong6 dou3 aa3 ming4, git3 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 pung3 min6 king1 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在菜市场碰到了阿明，结果我们碰面聊了很久。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into Ah Ming at the market and we ended up chatting for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話今晚要同客戶碰面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 tung4 haak3 wu6 pung3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说今晚要跟客户碰面。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we have to meet with the client tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 碰面；见面（也可指字面碰撞）
english_meaning: to meet up; to have a brief meeting; (literally) to bump into/head-on collision
explanation_mandarin: 表示見面、碰面或短暫會合；也可用於字面上兩物互相碰撞。多用於口語或非正式場合，例如「我們明天碰頭」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate meeting up or having a brief get-together/meeting; can also be literal (things bumping into each other). Commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日碰頭傾下計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 pung3 tau4 king1 haa5 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天碰頭談談。
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet up tomorrow to talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺中環碰頭食午餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zung1 waan4 pung3 tau4 sik6 ng5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在中環碰頭吃午餐。
examples.english_sentence: We met up in Central for lunch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會前大家先碰頭，確定時間表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 cin4 daai6 gaa1 sin1 pung3 tau4, kok3 ding6 si4 gaan1 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會前大家先碰頭，確定時間表。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting, everyone met briefly to finalize the schedule.

mandarin_meaning: 碳（化学元素，符号 C）
english_meaning: carbon (the chemical element, symbol C)
explanation_mandarin: 碳是一种化学元素（符号 C），是有机化合物的基础，存在于二氧化碳、碳纖維、活性碳等多种形式和材料中，并与温室气体和材料科学密切相关。
explanation_english: Carbon is a chemical element (symbol C). It is fundamental to organic compounds and appears in forms such as carbon dioxide, carbon fiber, and activated carbon; it is important in climate science and materials technology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 二氧化碳排放對氣候變化有好大影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji6 joeng5 faa3 taan3 paai4 fong3 deoi3 hei3 hau6 bin3 faa3 jau5 hou2 daai6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 二氧化碳排放对气候变化有很大影响。
examples.english_sentence: Carbon dioxide emissions have a big impact on climate change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個水族箱用活性碳過濾水質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 seoi2 zuk6 soeng1 jung6 wut6 sing3 taan3 gwo3 leot6 seoi2 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个水族箱用活性碳过滤水质。
examples.english_sentence: This fish tank uses activated carbon to filter the water.

mandarin_meaning: 碳排放（指二氧化碳等溫室氣體的排放）
english_meaning: carbon emissions (release of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases)
explanation_mandarin: 指以二氧化碳為主的溫室氣體向大氣釋放的過程或總量，通常由燃燒化石燃料、工業活動、土地使用變化等造成，與氣候變遷有直接關係。
explanation_english: The release of carbon, especially carbon dioxide, into the atmosphere—typically from burning fossil fuels, industry, and land-use changes. It is a key metric related to greenhouse gases and climate change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要制定減少碳排放嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 zai3 ding6 gaam2 siu2 taan3 paai4 fong3 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要制定减少碳排放的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to formulate policies to reduce carbon emissions.

mandarin_meaning: 碳水化合物（简称碳水或醣類）
english_meaning: carbohydrate(s)
explanation_mandarin: 一類由碳、氫、氧構成的有機化合物，主要包括糖類、澱粉和纖維，是人體的重要能量來源。
explanation_english: A class of organic compounds made of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen; includes sugars, starches, and fiber, and serves as a major energy source for the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 減肥期間要注意碳水化合物嘅攝取量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam2 fei4 kei4 gaan1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 taan3 seoi2 faa3 hap6 mat6 ge3 sip3 ceoi2 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 减肥期间要注意碳水化合物的摄取量。
examples.english_sentence: During a diet, pay attention to your carbohydrate intake.

mandarin_meaning: （打印機/影印機用的）碳粉、墨粉；碳的粉末
english_meaning: toner (powder used in laser printers/photocopiers); carbon powder
explanation_mandarin: 指雷射打印機或影印機所使用的粉狀色粉（即碳粉或墨粉），也可泛指碳的粉末。常見於辦公室耗材相關語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the powder used in laser printers or photocopiers (toner); can also refer more generally to carbon powder. Commonly used in office-supply contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打印機嘅碳粉用晒，暫時印唔到，要換碳粉盒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daat6 jan3 gei1 ge3 taan3 fan2 jung6 saai3, zaam6 si4 jan3 m4 dou3, jiu3 wun6 taan3 fan2 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打印機的碳粉用完了，暫時無法列印，需要更換碳粉匣。
examples.english_sentence: The printer's toner is used up and can't print for now; the toner cartridge needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 碳粉盒 (tàn fěn hé) — 激光打印機或影印機使用的碳粉盒/碳粉匣
english_meaning: toner cartridge (the replaceable container of toner for laser printers or copiers)
explanation_mandarin: 指裝有碳粉、供激光打印機或影印機使用的可更換耗材，也常稱為碳粉匣或墨粉盒。
explanation_english: A replaceable consumable that holds toner powder used in laser printers and photocopiers; often called a toner cartridge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打印機啲碳粉盒用晒，要買一個新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 jan3 gei1 di1 taan3 fan2 hap6 jung6 saat3, jiu3 maai5 jat1 go3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打印機的碳粉盒用完了，要買一個新的。
examples.english_sentence: The printer's toner cartridge is empty; we need to buy a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 碳纸
english_meaning: carbon paper
explanation_mandarin: 一种薄纸，表面涂有碳或色素，夹在原稿与空白纸之间，通过书写或打字时的压力把字迹转印到副本上，用来制作抄本或备份。
explanation_english: A thin sheet coated with carbon or pigment placed between an original and a blank sheet so that writing or typing transfers the marks to produce a copy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要多影一份，記住喺張白紙同底稿之間夾張碳紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 do1 jing2 jat1 fan6, gei3 zyu6 hai6 zoeng1 baak6 zi2 tung4 dai2 gou2 zi1 gaan1 gaap3 zoeng1 taan3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要多复印一份，记得在白纸和底稿之间夹一张碳纸。
examples.english_sentence: If you need an extra copy, remember to put a sheet of carbon paper between the blank sheet and the original.

mandarin_meaning: 碳足迹（指個人、組織或產品在生產和消費過程中直接或間接排放的二氧化碳總量）
english_meaning: carbon footprint (the total greenhouse gas emissions, expressed as CO2 equivalent, caused directly and indirectly by an individual, organization, product or event)
explanation_mandarin: 「碳足印」指在日常生活、工業生產或運輸過程中所產生的二氧化碳及等量溫室氣體的排放總量，常用來衡量對環境的影響並作為減排目標的依據。
explanation_english: Refers to the total amount of carbon dioxide and equivalent greenhouse gases emitted directly and indirectly by activities such as daily life, production, transportation, etc. It's used to measure environmental impact and guide emission-reduction efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要減少碳足印，保護地球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaam2 siu2 taan3 zuk1 jan3, bou2 wu6 dei6 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要減少碳足跡，保護地球。
examples.english_sentence: We need to reduce our carbon footprint to protect the planet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買本地產品可以減低碳足印。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 bun2 dei6 caan2 ban2 ho2 ji5 gaam2 dai1 taan3 zuk1 jan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 購買本地產品可以降低碳足跡。
examples.english_sentence: Buying local products can lower your carbon footprint.

mandarin_meaning: 碳酸（指碳酸或含二氧化碳的飲料，常用於「碳酸飲料」表示汽水）
english_meaning: carbonic acid; carbonated (as in carbonated beverages, soda)
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used attributively as adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指由二氧化碳形成的酸（碳酸），在日常語境多指含有氣泡的飲料，如碳酸飲料、汽水。
explanation_english: Refers to carbonic acid formed by dissolved carbon dioxide; in everyday usage it commonly denotes carbonated beverages (soda, fizzy drinks).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意飲碳酸飲料，因為飲落太多氣泡，飲唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 jam2 taan3 syun1 jam2 liu6, jan1 wai6 jam2 lok6 taai3 do1 hei3 paau3, jam2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢喝碳酸饮料，因为喝起来气泡太多，感觉不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like drinking carbonated drinks because they have too many bubbles and feel uncomfortable to drink.

mandarin_meaning: 碎片；（口語）爭吵、糾紛、找碴
english_meaning: a small sharp fragment or splinter; (colloquial) a quarrel/dispute or to pick a fight
explanation_mandarin: 「碴」可指細小尖銳的碎片（如木碴），在香港口語中亦常用作表示爭吵、挑釁或找麻煩（如「搞碴」「揾碴」）。
explanation_english: “碴” can mean a small sharp fragment (e.g. a splinter). In Hong Kong Cantonese it is also used colloquially to refer to quarrels or picking fights (e.g. “搞碴”, “揾碴”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為一啲小事搞碴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 jat1 di1 siu2 si6 gaau2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們因為一些小事吵架。
examples.english_sentence: They quarrelled over some minor things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張木椅有碴，小心會割到手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 muk6 ji2 jau5 caa4, siu2 sam1 wui5 got3 dou3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張木椅有碎片，小心會割到手。
examples.english_sentence: That wooden chair has splinters; be careful you might cut your hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度揾碴，冇必要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 wan2 caa4, mou5 bit1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別在這裡找碴，沒必要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pick a fight here; it's unnecessary.

mandarin_meaning: 確（què）：表示確定、確實或確切，常見於「確實」、「確定」、「確係」等詞語中。
english_meaning: què / sure, certain, indeed; expresses certainty or emphasis (appears in compounds like '確定', '確實', '確係').
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 副詞（表示確定或強調）
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示肯定、確實或強調語氣。可單獨與「係」構成口語「確係」（確實是），或用於複合詞如「確定」「確實」。
explanation_english: Used to express affirmation, certainty, or emphasis. It appears in colloquial Cantonese as '確係' (indeed) and in compounds such as '確定' (to confirm) and '確實' (indeed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢確係唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kok3 hai6 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他確實不來。
examples.english_sentence: He really isn't coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我確定聽日冇得去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kok3 ding6 ting1 jat6 mou5 dak1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我確定明天不能去。
examples.english_sentence: I'm certain I can't go tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 确实 / 确认（用于加强肯定语气）
english_meaning: indeed; really; certainly (used to emphasize affirmation)
explanation_mandarin: 「確係」是廣東話口語，用來加強肯定或確認某事，相當於普通話的「確實」或「真的」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to strengthen affirmation or confirmation of a fact; equivalent to Mandarin 'quèshí' or English 'indeed/really'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢確係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kok3 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他确实很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: He really is very clever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢確係有道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 kok3 hai6 jau5 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的确实有道理。
examples.english_sentence: What you said does make sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我確係唔想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kok3 hai6 m4 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我确实不想去。
examples.english_sentence: I really don't want to go.

mandarin_meaning: 确保 (quèbǎo)，保证
english_meaning: to ensure; to guarantee; to make sure
explanation_mandarin: 表示采取措施或安排以确保某事发生、维持某种状态或不受损害。
explanation_english: To take measures or make arrangements to ensure that something happens, remains true, or is kept safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要確保資料安全，唔好俾人入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 kok3 bou2 zi1 liu6 on1 cyun4, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 jap6 cam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要确保资料安全，不要被人入侵。
examples.english_sentence: The company must ensure data security and prevent intrusions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要確保所有門都鎖好先出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 kok3 bou2 so2 jau5 mun4 dou1 so2 hou2 sin1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要确保所有门都锁好才出门。
examples.english_sentence: Make sure all the doors are locked before you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保呢個項目喺預算內完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hai6 jyu6 syun3 noi6 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保这个项目在预算内完成。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure this project is completed within budget.

mandarin_meaning: 确信 (quèxīn)
english_meaning: to be convinced; to be certain; to firmly believe
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事非常確定或深信不疑，認為某事屬實。
