explanation_mandarin: 「祕技」指隱藏或不公開的技巧、方法或訣竅，常用於遊戲、工具或生活小技巧的語境中。詞尾的「*」通常是網上書寫的標記，用來強調或避免敏感詞過濾，本身並非詞的一部分。
explanation_english: "祕技" means a hidden or secret technique, method, or tip, often used in contexts like gaming, tools, or life hacks. The trailing "*" is an online typographic mark used for emphasis or to avoid automated filters and is not part of the core word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢教咗我一個祕技，打機可以輕鬆過關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 bei3 gei6, daa2 gei1 ho2 ji5 hing1 sung1 gwo3 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他教了我一個秘技，打遊戲可以輕鬆過關。
examples.english_sentence: He taught me a secret trick so I can easily get through levels when playing games.

mandarin_meaning: 暗中私下牟利；私下撈錢
english_meaning: to secretly pocket profits; to skim money or take illicit cuts
explanation_mandarin: 「祕撈」是廣東話俗語，指在背後或私下偷偷牟利，常見於工作或交易中私下抽取佣金或好處，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: "祕撈" is Cantonese slang meaning to secretly obtain profit or benefits—usually by skimming commissions or taking illicit cuts in a workplace or transaction. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司祕撈佣金，結果俾人揭發而畀炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 bei3 lou4 jung4 gam1, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 ji4 bei2 caau2 jau4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司暗中私下牟取佣金，結果被揭發而被解僱。
examples.english_sentence: He secretly skimmed commissions at the company and was exposed and fired.

mandarin_meaning: 秘書（mìshū）——負責文書、聯絡、安排日程等行政事務的人或職位
english_meaning: secretary — a person or job responsible for clerical and administrative tasks
explanation_mandarin: 指負責處理文書、安排會議與日程、接待與聯絡等行政工作的職位或人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or position responsible for handling documents, scheduling meetings, correspondence, and other administrative duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋公司嘅祕書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 bei3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我們公司的秘書。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is our company's secretary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祕書幫手回覆電話同電郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 syu1 bong1 sau2 wui4 fuk1 din6 waa2 tung4 din6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘書幫忙回覆電話和電子郵件。
examples.english_sentence: The secretary helps reply to phone calls and emails.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司請咗一位經驗豐富嘅祕書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 wai2 ging1 jim6 fung1 fu3 ge3 bei3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司聘請了一位經驗豐富的秘書。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired an experienced secretary.

mandarin_meaning: 秘书 (mìshū)
english_meaning: secretary
explanation_mandarin: 指在公司或機構中負責文件處理、行程安排、聯絡協調等事務的職位或人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or position in an organization responsible for handling documents, scheduling, communications, and coordination tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司請咗一個新祕書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 bei3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司请了一个新秘书。
examples.english_sentence: Our company hired a new secretary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祕書幫我安排咗下星期嘅會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 syu1 bong1 ngo5 on1 paai4 zo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘书帮我安排了下星期的会议。
examples.english_sentence: The secretary arranged next week's meeting for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係老闆個人祕書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lou5 baan2 go3 jan4 bei3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是老板的私人秘书。
examples.english_sentence: He is the boss's personal secretary.

mandarin_meaning: 秘书台
english_meaning: secretary's desk / reception desk / secretarial station
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或機構中負責接待、電話轉接及提供行政支援的工作崗位或櫃位。
explanation_english: Refers to a desk or station in a company/organization responsible for reception, call transfers and administrative support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司新設咗祕書台，專門負責接待客人同處理行政工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 san1 cit3 zo2 bei3 syu1 toi4, zyun1 mun4 fu6 zaak3 zip3 doi6 haak3 jan4 tung4 cyu2 lei5 hang4 zing3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司新设了秘书台，专门负责接待客人和处理行政工作。
examples.english_sentence: The company set up a secretary desk to handle visitor reception and administrative tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔想成日自己接電話，可以交畀祕書台轉接。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 soeng2 sing4 jat6 zi6 gei2 zip3 din6 waa2, ho2 ji5 gaau1 bei2 bei3 syu1 toi4 zyun2 zip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不想每天自己接电话，可以交给秘书台转接。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to answer calls all the time, you can have the secretary desk transfer them.

mandarin_meaning: 秘書長 (mìshūzhǎng)
english_meaning: secretary-general
explanation_mandarin: 在組織或機構中負責管理秘書處、協調事務與處理日常行政工作的最高或主要職務，常見於國際組織、工會、政黨等。
explanation_english: The head of a secretariat in an organization; the chief administrative officer responsible for coordinating affairs, managing the secretariat, and overseeing daily administration—commonly used for international organizations, unions, parties, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係我哋工會嘅祕書長，負責統籌日常事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 wui6 ge3 bei3 syu1 zoeng2, fu6 zaak3 tung2 cau4 jat6 soeng4 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是我們工會的秘書長，負責統籌日常事務。
examples.english_sentence: He is now our union's secretary-general, responsible for coordinating daily affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺聯合國，祕書長係最高行政首長，要協調各成員國嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 lyun4 hap6 gwok3, bei3 syu1 zoeng2 hai6 zeoi3 gou1 hang4 zing3 sau2 zoeng2, jiu3 hip3 tiu4 gok3 sing4 jyun4 gwok3 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在聯合國，秘書長是最高行政首長，要協調各成員國的工作。
examples.english_sentence: At the United Nations, the secretary-general is the highest administrative head and must coordinate the work of member states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱當選為學會嘅祕書長，下星期開始就要處理新職務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 dong1 syun2 wai4 hok6 wui6 ge3 bei3 syu1 zoeng2, haa6 sing1 kei4 hoi1 ci2 zau6 jiu3 cyu2 lei5 san1 zik1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛剛當選為學會的秘書長，下星期開始就要處理新職務。
examples.english_sentence: He was just elected as the society's secretary-general and will start handling the new duties next week.

mandarin_meaning: 秘書長（職稱）
english_meaning: secretary-general
explanation_mandarin: 指組織中負責協調、管理或代表性的職務，通常為機構或團體的主要行政負責人（如聯合國秘書長或社團的秘書長）。
explanation_english: Refers to the official in an organization responsible for coordination and administration; typically the chief administrative officer of an institution or association (e.g., the UN Secretary-General).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係我哋社團嘅祕書長，負責安排會議同埋對外聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 se5 tyun4 ge3 bei3 syu1 zoeng2, fu6 zaak3 on1 paai4 wui6 ji5 tung4 maai4 deoi3 ngoi6 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是我們社團的秘書長，負責安排會議和對外聯絡。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently the secretary-general of our association, responsible for arranging meetings and external communications.

mandarin_meaning: 秘笈（秘密的手冊或秘籍）
english_meaning: secret manual; secret handbook; collection of insider tips or techniques
explanation_mandarin: 指記載秘方、獨門技巧或經驗的書或手冊，通常含有秘密、傳承或不公開的操作方法。
explanation_english: A book or handbook that records secret formulas, unique techniques, or insider tips—usually containing knowledge that is passed down or kept private.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本祕笈係我阿爺傳畀我，入面記載咗好多獨門秘技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 bei3 gap1 hai6 ngo5 aa3je4 cyun4 bei2 ngo5, jap6 min6 gei3zoi6 zo2 hou2 do1 duk6 mun4 bei3 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本秘笈是我爺爺傳給我的，裡面記載了很多獨門秘技。
examples.english_sentence: This secret manual was passed down to me by my grandfather; it contains many unique secret techniques.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺網上搵到一啲烹飪祕笈，教你整出餐廳級嘅菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 mong5 soeng6 wan2 dou3 jat1 di1 paang1 jam6 bei3 gap1, gaau3 nei5 zing2 ceot1 caan1 teng1 kap1 ge3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在網上找到了一些烹飪秘笈，教你做出餐廳級的菜。
examples.english_sentence: I found some cooking secret manuals online that teach you how to make restaurant-quality dishes.

mandarin_meaning: 秘笈（mìjí）：記載秘訣或獨門技藝的書冊或手稿，常見於武俠、烹飪或專業技術中。
english_meaning: secret manual; handbook containing special/secret techniques or recipes
explanation_mandarin: 指包含秘訣或特殊技巧的書籍或手稿，常用於武俠或專門技藝中，帶有神秘或傳承的意味。
explanation_english: A book or manuscript that contains secret tips or special techniques; often used in contexts like martial arts, cooking, or specialized trades and carries a sense of mystery or lineage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本祕笈係佢師傅傳落嚟嘅，裡面有好多獨門武功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 bei3 gap1 hai6 keoi5 si1 fu2 cyun4 lok6 lai4 ge3, leoi5 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 duk6 mun4 mou5 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本秘笈是他師傅傳下來的，裡面有很多獨門武功。
examples.english_sentence: This secret manual was passed down by his master; it contains many unique martial arts techniques.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想學到高深技巧，就要細心研究呢啲祕笈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 hok6 dou3 gou1 sam1 gei6 haau6, zau6 jiu3 sai3 sam1 jin4 gau3 ni1 di1 bei3 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想學到高深技巧，就要細心研究這些秘笈。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to learn advanced techniques, you need to study these secret manuals carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆終於公開佢嘅生意祕笈，教大家點樣慳錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zung1 jyu1 gung1 hoi1 keoi5 ge3 saang1 ji3 bei3 gap1, gaau3 daai6 gaa1 dim2 joeng6 haan1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆終於公開了他的生意秘笈，教大家怎樣省錢。
examples.english_sentence: The boss finally revealed his business secret manual, teaching everyone how to save money.

mandarin_meaning: 秘而不宣（保持秘密，不對外宣揚、公布）
english_meaning: to keep something secret; not to announce or publicize
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某件事保密，不對外宣布或宣揚。常用來形容對訊息、計畫或安排保持沉默，不讓外界知道。
explanation_english: Indicates keeping a matter secret and not announcing or publicizing it. Often used to describe staying silent about information, plans, or arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司對於呢件事一直祕而不宣，冇公開講過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 deoi3 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 zik6 bei3 ji4 bat1 syun1, mou5 gung1 hoi1 gong2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司對於這件事一直秘而不宣，沒有公開說過。
examples.english_sentence: The company has kept this matter secret and hasn't said anything about it publicly.

mandarin_meaning: 秘製／秘制（用秘密配方或獨特方法製作）
english_meaning: made with a secret recipe; house special; specially prepared
explanation_mandarin: 表示某樣食物或產品用獨特或保密的配方製作，常用來形容店家的招牌或特別調製的醬料、點心等。
explanation_english: Indicates that something (usually food) is prepared using a secret or special recipe. Often used to describe a shop's signature item, sauce, or specially crafted dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖嘅祕製醬好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 bei3 zai3 zoeng3 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店的秘製醬很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The shop's secret sauce is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款祕製牛油餅只喺店舖先買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 bei3 zai3 ngau4 jau4 beng2 zi2 hai2 dim3 pou3 sin1 maai5 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款秘製牛油餅只有在店鋪才能買到。
examples.english_sentence: This secret butter cookie is only sold in the shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 店長話佢哋有祕製配方，唔會公開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim3 zoeng2 waa6 keoi5 dei6 jau5 bei3 zai3 pui3 fong1, m4 wui5 gung1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店長說他們有秘製配方，不會公開。
examples.english_sentence: The shop owner says they have a secret recipe and won't disclose it.

mandarin_meaning: 秘诀 (mìjué)：达到某个目的的秘密方法或技巧
english_meaning: secret; tip; key trick or technique to achieve a goal
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种能帮助达成目标的特别方法或技巧，通常指经验性的要点或窍门。
explanation_english: A particular method, trick, or technique—often based on experience—that helps achieve a desired result; a tip or secret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學好一樣嘢冇乜祕訣，係要堅持同埋不停練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 hou2 jat1 joeng6 je5 mou5 mat1 bei3 kyut3, hai6 jiu3 gin1 ci4 tung4 maai4 bat1 ting4 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学好一件事没有什么秘诀，要坚持并不断练习。
examples.english_sentence: There's no real secret to mastering something; you need to persist and keep practising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煮意粉嘅祕訣係唔好煮過頭，要保留啲彈牙口感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 ji3 fan2 ge3 bei3 kyut3 hai6 m4 hou2 zyu2 gwo3 tau4, jiu3 bou2 lau4 di1 daan6 ngaa4 hau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煮意大利面的秘诀是不要煮过头，要保留弹牙的口感。
examples.english_sentence: The secret to cooking pasta is not to overcook it; keep it al dente.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺推銷方面有幾個祕訣，成日用啲故事同例子嚟說服客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 teoi1 siu1 fong1 min6 jau5 gei2 go3 bei3 kyut3, sing4 jat6 jung6 di1 gu3 si6 tung4 lai6 zi2 lai4 syut3 fuk6 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在推销方面有几个秘诀，经常用故事和例子来说服顾客。
examples.english_sentence: He has a few sales tricks; he often uses stories and examples to persuade customers.

mandarin_meaning: 祕訣（秘诀）
english_meaning: secret (method); key; tip; trick
explanation_mandarin: 指完成某事或取得成功的秘密方法、要點或技巧。
explanation_english: Refers to a secret method, key point, or tip that helps accomplish something or achieve success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗比賽，大家都想知道佢嘅祕訣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing4 zo2 bei2 coi3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 soeng2 zi1 dou6 keoi5 ge3 bei3 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他贏了比賽，大家都想知道他的祕訣。
examples.english_sentence: He won the competition; everyone wants to know his secret.

mandarin_meaning: 秘道；隱藏的通道或暗道
english_meaning: secret passage; hidden passageway or clandestine route
explanation_mandarin: 指建築物或地形中隱藏、不為人知的通道，常用於逃生、秘密出入或躲藏。
explanation_english: Refers to a concealed passage within a building or landscape, often used for escape, secret access, or hiding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間城堡地下有條祕道，可以通到河邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 sing4 bou2 dei6 haa6 jau5 tiu4 bei3 dou6, ho2 ji5 tung1 dou3 ho4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座城堡地下有一條祕道，可以通到河邊。
examples.english_sentence: There's a secret passage under that castle that leads to the river.

mandarin_meaning: 秘鲁（南美洲的国家）
english_meaning: Peru (country in South America)
explanation_mandarin: 位於南美洲西部的國家，首都是利馬（Lima），以安第斯山脈、亞馬遜雨林、馬丘比丘等自然與歷史遺跡聞名。
explanation_english: A country in western South America, capital Lima. Known for the Andes, the Amazon rainforest, and historical sites such as Machu Picchu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去祕魯旅行，想去馬丘比丘同利馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 bei3 lou5 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 heoi3 maa5 jau1 bei2 jau1 tung4 lei6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去秘鲁旅行，想去马丘比丘和利马。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Peru next month; I want to visit Machu Picchu and Lima.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祕魯出名有安第斯山同馬丘比丘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 lou5 ceot1 ming4 jau5 on1 dai6 si1 saan1 tung4 maa5 jau1 bei2 jau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘鲁以安第斯山和马丘比丘闻名。
examples.english_sentence: Peru is famous for the Andes and Machu Picchu.

mandarin_meaning: 秘鲁（南美洲国家）
english_meaning: Peru (country in South America)
explanation_mandarin: 指南美洲的国家秘鲁（西班牙语：Perú）。詞尾的星號“*”不是詞的一部分，通常是標注或輸入時附加的符號。
explanation_english: Refers to the country Peru in South America (Spanish: Perú). The trailing asterisk '*' is not part of the name and is likely an annotation or input artifact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去祕魯旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 bei3 lou5 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去秘鲁旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Peru next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祕魯菜好有特色，尤其係酸橘汁醃魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 lou5 coi3 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1, jau6 kei4 hai6 syun1 guk1 zap1 jim1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘鲁菜很有特色，尤其是酸橘汁腌鱼（ceviche）。
examples.english_sentence: Peruvian cuisine is very distinctive, especially ceviche (marinated fish in citrus).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祕魯嘅首都係利馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 lou5 ge3 sau2 dou1 hai6 lei6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘鲁的首都是利马。
examples.english_sentence: Peru's capital is Lima.

mandarin_meaning: 祖（zǔ）：祖先、先人；家族的創始者或前輩
english_meaning: ancestor; forefather; progenitor; founder
explanation_mandarin: 「祖」通常指家族的先人或前輩，常見於合成詞如「祖先」「祖父」「祭祖」，也可表示事物的起源或創始者。
explanation_english: The character refers to ancestors or forebears and is commonly used in compounds such as 'ancestor', 'grandfather', or 'to venerate ancestors'. It can also denote an originator or founder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每年都會去燒紙祭祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 siu1 zi2 zai3 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每年都会去烧纸祭祖。
examples.english_sentence: Every year we burn paper offerings to honor our ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祖宗流傳落嚟嘅習俗係好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 zung1 lau4 cyun4 lok6 lai4 ge3 zaap6 zuk6 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祖宗流传下来的习俗很重要。
examples.english_sentence: The customs passed down from our ancestors are important.

mandarin_meaning: 祖传 (zǔchuán)：世代相传的，传下来的
english_meaning: ancestral; handed down through generations; hereditary; a traditional family recipe/skill
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種技能、秘方、習俗或特徵由祖先傳承下來，經家族世代保存或延續。
explanation_english: Indicates something (a skill, recipe, custom, or trait) that has been passed down through a family for generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥水係我哋家族嘅祖傳秘方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 seoi2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 zuk6 ge3 zou2 cyun4 bei3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這瓶藥水是我們家族的祖傳秘方。
examples.english_sentence: This bottle of medicine is a secret ancestral recipe of our family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢有祖傳手藝，整嘅蛋撻真係唔同凡響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 zou2 cyun4 sau2 ngai6, zing2 ge3 daan6 tat1 zan1 hai6 m4 tung4 faan4 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說他有祖傳手藝，做的蛋撻真是不凡。
examples.english_sentence: He says he has an ancestral craft; his egg tarts are truly exceptional.

mandarin_meaning: 祖先 (zǔxiān) — 家族中已故的前輩或祖宗
english_meaning: ancestors; forebears
explanation_mandarin: 指一個家族或民族中早先的世代、已故的祖宗，常在祭祀、紀念或家族傳統中被提及與敬奉。
explanation_english: Refers to the earlier generations or deceased forebears of a family or people, often invoked in rituals, memorials, or family traditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要祭祀祖先，感謝佢哋嘅保佑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zai3 ci2 zou2 sin1, gam2 ze6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 bou2 jau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要祭祀祖先，感謝他們的保佑。
examples.english_sentence: We should perform rites for our ancestors and thank them for their protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋尊敬祖先，保留咗好多家族傳統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun1 ging3 zou2 sin1, bou2 lau4 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 zuk6 cyun4 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們尊敬祖先，保留了很多家族傳統。
examples.english_sentence: They respect their ancestors and have preserved many family traditions.

mandarin_meaning: 祖国（zǔguó）；指自己的國家或出生的國土
english_meaning: motherland; homeland; one's native country
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的祖先所在或出生的國家，泛指自己的國家，常帶有愛國或民族情感。
explanation_english: Refers to one's native country or homeland; often used to express patriotic or national sentiment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好愛祖國，希望可以為佢出一分力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 oi3 zou2 gwok3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 ceot1 jat1 fan6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很愛祖國，希望能為它盡一份力。
examples.english_sentence: I love my motherland and hope to contribute in my own way.

mandarin_meaning: 祖坟
english_meaning: ancestral grave; family tomb
explanation_mandarin: 指祖先的墳墓或家族世系的合葬地，為祭祀和掃墓的場所，常在清明等節日被祭拜。
explanation_english: Refers to the graves or tombs of one's ancestors — the family burial site used for rituals such as tomb-sweeping and ancestral worship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆清明，你哋有冇返去拜祖墳？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 cing1 ming4, nei5 dei6 jau5 mou5 faan1 heoi3 baai3 zou2 fan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历清明，你们有去祭拜祖坟吗？
examples.english_sentence: On the lunar Tomb-Sweeping Day, did you go to pay respects at your ancestral graves?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祖墳位置要揀高啲，唔好太低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 fan4 wai6 zi6 jiu3 gaan2 gou1 di1, m4 hou2 taai3 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祖坟的位置要选高一点，不要太低。
examples.english_sentence: The ancestral grave's location should be chosen a bit higher, not too low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近為老闆修整祖墳，請咗道士嚟做法事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 wai6 lou5 baan2 sau1 zing2 zou2 fan4, cing2 zo2 dou6 si6 lai4 zou6 faat3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近为老板修整祖坟，请了道士来做法事。
examples.english_sentence: The company recently renovated the boss's ancestral tomb and hired a Taoist priest to perform rites.

mandarin_meaning: 祖宗（家族的先人）
english_meaning: ancestors; forefathers
explanation_mandarin: 指家族的祖先、先人。口語中亦可作咒罵或感嘆用語（如「你祖宗十八代」），語氣可強烈，屬粗俗用法。
explanation_english: Refers to a family's ancestors or forebears. In colloquial use it can also appear in curses or exclamations (e.g. "you and your ancestors") and may be coarse or offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重祖宗，唔好忘記家族歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 zou2 zung1, m4 hou2 mong4 gei3 gaa1 zuk6 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重祖宗，不要忘记家族历史。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect our ancestors and not forget our family's history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，我忍唔住鬧佢：「你祖宗十八代！」
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 naau6 keoi5: "nei5 zou2 zung1 sap6 baat3 doi6!"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是说谎，我忍不住骂他：“你祖宗十八代！”
examples.english_sentence: He keeps lying; I couldn't help yelling at him, "Damn you and your ancestors!"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 逢年過節，我哋會去廟裡拜祖宗，燒啲香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung4 nin4 gwo3 zit3, ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 miu6 leoi5 baai3 zou2 zung1, siu1 di1 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 逢年过节，我们会去庙里拜祖宗，烧些香。
examples.english_sentence: During festivals we go to the temple to pay respects to our ancestors and burn incense.

mandarin_meaning: 祖宅；祖籍；祖先的家
english_meaning: ancestral home; family ancestral house; ancestral origin
explanation_mandarin: 指祖先居住的家或家族的老家、祖宅，也可指家族的籍貫或根源地。此詞在粵語口語或方言中常見。
explanation_english: Refers to the house of one's ancestors or the family's ancestral home; can also mean the family's place of origin or ancestral birthplace. Commonly used in Cantonese colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年，大家都會返祖家拜祭祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 wui5 faan1 zou2 gaa1 baai3 zai3 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历新年，大家都回祖家祭拜祖先。
examples.english_sentence: During Lunar New Year, everyone returns to the ancestral home to pay respects to their ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢祖家喺廣東。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zou2 gaa1 hai2 gwong2 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的祖籍在广东。
examples.english_sentence: He says his ancestral home is in Guangdong.

mandarin_meaning: 祖屋；祖宅；祖传房产
english_meaning: ancestral house; ancestral home; family ancestral property
explanation_mandarin: 指由家族祖先留下或世代相傳的房屋或宅第，常帶有情感與血緣繼承的意涵，亦可能涉及產權與族產分配。
explanation_english: Refers to a house or residence passed down by ancestors or kept within a family for generations; carries emotional and familial inheritance connotations and may involve property ownership and clan inheritance issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋家代代都住喺祖屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaa1 doi6 doi6 dou1 zyu6 hai2 zou2 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家世代都住在祖屋里。
examples.english_sentence: My family has lived in the ancestral house for generations.

mandarin_meaning: 祖师；创始人、宗派或技艺的开创者；有时指被供奉的祖师爷（民间或宗教中的始祖神祇）
english_meaning: founder; founding master; patriarch; a venerated founder (sometimes deified)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個宗派、門派、技藝或教派的創始人或始祖；在民間信仰或宗教中，也可指被祭祀、供奉的祖師（如祖師爺）。
explanation_english: Refers to the founder or patriarch of a school, sect, art, or tradition; in folk religion or temple contexts it can also mean a deified founder who is worshipped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋武館嘅祖師，早年創立咗呢一派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 mou5 gun2 ge3 zou2 si1, zou2 nin4 cong3 laap6 zo2 ni1 jat1 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們武館的祖師，早年創立了這一門派。
examples.english_sentence: He is the founding master of our martial arts school; he established this style years ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面供奉住嗰位祖師爺，信眾會嚟參拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 gung1 fung6 zyu6 go2 wai2 zou2 si1 je5, seon3 zung3 wui5 lai4 caam1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡供奉著那位祖師爺，信眾會來參拜。
examples.english_sentence: The temple enshrines that founding deity, and devotees come to pay their respects.

mandarin_meaning: 祖業／祖產，指祖先留下的產業或家族基業
english_meaning: Ancestral estate; family property or legacy (business or assets passed down from ancestors)
explanation_mandarin: 指由祖先留下或由家族世代經營的產業、家業或基業，常用來表示家族財產或事業的延續。
explanation_english: Refers to property, business, or foundation left by one's ancestors—assets or enterprises passed down through the family, emphasizing continuity of family property or enterprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠係佢哋家祖業，已經幾代人經營。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 hai6 keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zou2 jip6, ji5 ging1 gei2 doi6 jan4 ging1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間工廠是他們家的祖業，已經幾代人經營。
examples.english_sentence: This factory is their family's ancestral business; it has been run for several generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想賣晒祖業去開新生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 maai6 saai3 zou2 jip6 heoi3 hoi1 san1 sang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把祖業全賣掉去開新生意。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to sell off the ancestral property to start a new business.

mandarin_meaning: 祖母（指父親的母親，即祖父母中的女性，通常指父系的祖母）
english_meaning: grandmother (paternal grandmother; father's mother)
explanation_mandarin: 指父系的祖母，即父親的母親。此詞較正式書面，口語中常用「嫲嫲」或「阿嫲」。
explanation_english: Refers to the paternal grandmother (the father's mother). The term is relatively formal; in colloquial Cantonese people often say '嫲嫲' or '阿嫲'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期日會去探祖母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat6 wui5 heoi3 taam3 zou2 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期日會去看望祖母。
examples.english_sentence: I'll visit my grandmother on Sunday.

mandarin_meaning: 祖父（父親的父親，等同「爺爺」）
english_meaning: paternal grandfather (father's father)
explanation_mandarin: 指父親的父親，屬於父系長輩。語感偏書面或正式，口語常說「阿爺」或「爺爺」。
explanation_english: Refers to one's father's father (paternal grandfather). The term is somewhat formal or written; in speech people often use colloquial terms like "阿爺" or "爺爺".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個祖父已經九十歲，仲好精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zou2 fu6 ji5 ging1 gau2 sap6 seoi3, zung6 hou2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的祖父已經九十歲，仍然很精神。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is already ninety years old and still very energetic.

mandarin_meaning: 祖祠；供奉祖先的祠堂或牌位所在之處
english_meaning: ancestral shrine; ancestral hall where ancestral tablets/genealogical rites are kept and performed
explanation_mandarin: 指供奉祖先的祠堂或放置祖先牌位的場所，常用於家族祭祀、拜祖或族群聚會。
explanation_english: A place (shrine or hall) dedicated to ancestor worship where ancestral tablets are kept; used for family rites, memorial ceremonies, and clan gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我哋要去祖祠燒香拜祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 zou2 ci4 siu1 hoeng1 baai3 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期日我们要去祖祠烧香祭祖。
examples.english_sentence: On Sunday we will go to the ancestral shrine to burn incense and pay respects to our ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有祖祠，放咗好多祖先嘅牌位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 jau5 zou2 ci4, fong3 zo2 hou2 do1 zou2 sin1 ge3 paai4 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里有祖祠，放了很多祖先的牌位。
examples.english_sentence: There's an ancestral shrine at home with many ancestral tablets.

mandarin_meaning: 祖籍；籍貫
english_meaning: ancestral home; place of family origin
explanation_mandarin: 指家族或祖先的來源地或登記的籍貫，常用於戶籍或介紹背景時。
explanation_english: Refers to the place of origin of a family or ancestors (ancestral hometown), often used in official records or when describing family background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅祖籍係廣東台山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zou2 zik6 hai6 gwong2 dung1 toi4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的祖籍是廣東台山。
examples.english_sentence: His ancestral home is Taishan, Guangdong.

mandarin_meaning: 祖荫；祖先留下的庇护或恩泽，亦指仰仗家族名望或影响力所得到的好处。
english_meaning: Ancestral favor or protection; benefits or advantages derived from one's ancestors or family reputation/influence.
explanation_mandarin: 指由祖先留下的庇護、恩澤或名聲所帶來的好處，常用於形容依靠家族背景而獲得的利益。
explanation_english: Refers to protection, patronage, or benefits conferred by one's ancestors; often used figuratively to describe advantages obtained through family background or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住祖蔭，成日喺政府工程攞到合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 zou2 jam3, sing4 jat6 hai2 zing3 fu2 gung1 cing4 lo2 dou3 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠着祖荫，经常在政府工程中拿到合约。
examples.english_sentence: He relies on ancestral influence and often wins government contracts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祖蔭唔可以永遠代替個人嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 jam3 m4 ho2 ji5 wing5 jyun5 doi6 tai3 go3 jan4 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祖荫不能永远代替个人的努力。
examples.english_sentence: Ancestral favor cannot forever replace a person's own effort.

mandarin_meaning: 祚（zuò）：福祉、天命或祖宗恩澤；常見於“福祚”“國祚”等書面語詞彙。
english_meaning: A literary/classical term meaning blessings, favor, or the fortunes (often from heaven or ancestors); used in compounds like 'fuzuo' (blessings) or 'guozuo' (dynastic fortune).
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語用字，指天命或祖先保佑的福分或國家世系的基業與承續，常在書面語或歷史文獻中出現。
explanation_english: A classical Chinese noun referring to blessings or favor (often divine or ancestral), and by extension the enduring fortune of a family or dynasty; primarily literary or historical in usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺廟入面祈求先祖嘅福祚，希望全家平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 miu6 jap6 min6 kei4 kau4 sin1 zou2 ge3 fuk1 zo6, hei1 mong6 cyun4 gaa1 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在庙里祈求祖先的福祚，希望全家平安。
examples.english_sentence: They prayed in the temple for their ancestors' blessings, hoping the whole family would be safe.

mandarin_meaning: 祝（zhù）：祝愿、祝贺、祝福
english_meaning: to wish; to express good wishes; to congratulate
explanation_mandarin: 表示向他人致以良好祝愿或祝贺，可用于口语和书面语，并常见于复合词如“祝福”、“祝賀”。
explanation_english: Used to express good wishes or congratulations to someone. Functions as a verb and appears in compounds such as '祝福' (to bless) or '祝賀' (to congratulate).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你生日快樂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你生日快乐！
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a happy birthday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你早日康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 zou2 jat6 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你早日康复。
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a speedy recovery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫忙，祝你事事順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 mong4, zuk1 nei5 si6 si6 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮忙，祝你事事顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for your help—I wish you all the best.

mandarin_meaning: 祝寿，向长者祝贺生日、祝愿长寿
english_meaning: to congratulate someone on their birthday (especially an elder); to wish someone longevity; to celebrate a birthday
explanation_mandarin: 表示为寿星（多指长者）庆祝生日、送上祝福与长寿的祝愿，常用于正式或书面语场合，如祝寿宴、致辞等。
explanation_english: To offer birthday congratulations, especially to an elder, and to wish them a long life. Often used in formal or written contexts (e.g., birthday banquets for seniors, speeches).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下星期係阿媽嘅壽宴，我哋要去替佢祝壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 sing1 kei4 hai6 aa3 maa1 ge3 sau6 jin6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 tai3 keoi5 zuk1 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下星期是妈妈的寿宴，我们要去替她祝寿。
examples.english_sentence: Next week is my mother's birthday banquet; we will go to offer birthday congratulations to her.

mandarin_meaning: 祝贺胜利；庆贺捷报或成功
english_meaning: to congratulate on a victory or success; to wish success
explanation_mandarin: 常用于書面或正式場合，表示對方取得勝利或捷報時表示祝賀。
explanation_english: A formal/literary verb used to congratulate someone on a victory, success, or good news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭祝你哋旗開得勝，祝捷！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 zuk1 nei5 dei6 kei4 hoi1 dak1 sing3, zuk1 zit3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭祝你们旗开得胜，祝捷！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a triumphant victory — congratulations!

mandarin_meaning: 祝福 (zhùfú)
english_meaning: blessing; to wish someone well; best wishes
explanation_mandarin: 表示向别人表达美好的愿望或祈求幸福、好运。可作动词（祝福某人）或名词（送上祝福）。
explanation_english: To express good wishes or blessings for someone's happiness or good fortune. Can be used as a verb (to bless / to wish well) or as a noun (a blessing / best wishes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生日快樂！祝福你每日都開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sang1 jat6 faai3 lok6! zuk1 fuk1 nei5 mui5 jat6 dou1 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生日快乐！祝福你每天都开心。
examples.english_sentence: Happy birthday! Wishing you happiness every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我送上最誠摯嘅祝福，祝你前程似錦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sung3 soeng5 zeoi3 sing4 zi3 ge3 zuk1 fuk1, zuk1 nei5 cin4 cing4 ci5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我送上最诚挚的祝福，祝你前程似锦。
examples.english_sentence: I send my sincerest blessings, wishing you a bright future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家一齊替新人送上祝福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 tai3 san1 jan4 sung3 soeng5 zuk1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一起为新人送上祝福。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone together sends blessings to the newlyweds.

mandarin_meaning: 火神；中國古代神話中的火之神
english_meaning: the fire god in Chinese mythology; deity who governs fire
explanation_mandarin: 祝融是中國古代神話中的火神，出現在《山海經》等古籍中，亦常作為文學典故或地名使用。
explanation_english: A deity in ancient Chinese mythology who governs fire. Zhurong appears in classical texts such as the Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shanhaijing) and is used in literature and place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝融係古時中國神話入面掌管火嘅神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 jung4 hai6 gu2 si4 zung1 gwok3 san4 waa6 jap6 min6 zoeng2 gun2 fo2 ge3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝融是古代中國神話中掌管火的神。
examples.english_sentence: Zhurong is the fire god who governs fire in ancient Chinese mythology.

mandarin_meaning: 祝贺 (zhùhè)
english_meaning: to congratulate; congratulations
explanation_mandarin: 表示對別人的喜事或成就表示慶祝或恭賀。
explanation_english: To express congratulations to someone for a happy event or an achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去飲嘢，順便祝賀你升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jam2 je5, seon6 bin6 zuk1 ho6 nei5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去喝一杯，顺便祝贺你升职。
examples.english_sentence: We're going out for drinks tonight; we'll also congratulate you on your promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝賀你新婚快樂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 ho6 nei5 san1 fan1 faai3 lok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝贺你新婚快乐！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on your marriage!

mandarin_meaning: 祝贺语；祝贺的话
english_meaning: congratulatory words/phrases; words of congratulations
explanation_mandarin: 指用來表達祝賀、慶賀的語句或短語，常在節日、婚慶、升職等場合使用。
explanation_english: Words or phrases used to express congratulations, commonly used at festivals, weddings, promotions, and other celebratory occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋會講祝賀語畀親戚同朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 gong2 zuk1 ho6 jyu5 bei2 can1 cik1 tung4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春节的时候，我们会对亲戚和朋友说祝贺语。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we say congratulatory words to relatives and friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺佢哋結婚嘅時候，大家都向佢哋送上祝賀語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ge3 si4 hau6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hoeng3 keoi5 dei6 sung3 soeng5 zuk1 ho6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在他们结婚的时候，大家都向他们送上祝贺语。
examples.english_sentence: At their wedding, everyone offered them words of congratulations.

mandarin_meaning: 祝酒 / 敬酒（提議舉杯祝賀或為他人祝福）
english_meaning: to propose/offer a toast; to drink in someone's honor
explanation_mandarin: 在宴會或聚會上舉杯向他人祝賀、敬意或祝福的行為，常見於婚宴、祝賀場合。
explanation_english: The act of raising a glass to congratulate, honor, or wish someone well at a gathering; commonly done at banquets, weddings, and celebratory events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宴會上大家一齊祝酒，氣氛好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 wui6 soeng6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 zuk1 zau2, hei3 fan1 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在宴会中大家一起祝酒，气氛很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: At the banquet everyone toasted together; the atmosphere was lively.

mandarin_meaning: 祝酒词（在宴会或聚会敬酒时所说的话）
english_meaning: toast (the words or short speech said when proposing a toast)
explanation_mandarin: 指在宴會、婚禮或聚會等場合敬酒時所說的話，用以祝賀、致謝或表達良好祝願，通常較簡短有禮。
explanation_english: Words or a short speech spoken when proposing a toast at a banquet, wedding, or gathering, used to congratulate, thank, or convey good wishes; typically brief and ceremonial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚係老細嘅生日飯，我負責講祝酒詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hai6 lou5 sai3 ge3 saang1 jat6 faan6, ngo5 fu6 zaak3 gong2 zuk1 zau2 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚是老板的生日宴，我负责讲祝酒词。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight is the boss's birthday banquet; I'm in charge of giving the toast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅祝酒詞短短幾句但好真誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zuk1 zau2 ci4 dyun2 dyun2 gei2 geoi3 daan6 hou2 zan1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的祝酒词短短几句，但很真诚。
examples.english_sentence: His toast was only a few short lines but very sincere.

mandarin_meaning: 祝愿（zhùyuàn）：表示祝福或希望
english_meaning: to wish; a wish or blessing
explanation_mandarin: 表示向別人表達美好祝福或希望的語詞，可作動詞（祝願某人）或名詞（某人的祝願）。常見於節日、賀詞或正式書信中。
explanation_english: A word for expressing a wish or blessing for someone; can be used as a verb (to wish) or a noun (a wish). Commonly used in greetings, holidays, or formal messages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，祝願你身體健康，萬事如意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, zuk1 jyun6 nei5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，祝愿你身体健康，万事如意。
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year — I wish you good health and all the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅祝願係成為一位老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zuk1 jyun6 hai6 sing4 wai4 jat1 wai6 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的愿望是成为一名老师。
examples.english_sentence: His wish is to become a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都向佢送上真誠嘅祝願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 hoeng3 keoi5 sung3 soeng5 zan1 sing4 ge3 zuk1 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都向他送上真诚的祝愿。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone sent him their sincere best wishes.

mandarin_meaning: 神（shén）：神、神祇、神靈；也可指超自然或超凡的能力。
english_meaning: god; deity; spirit; the supernatural; (colloquially) amazing or uncanny
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（也可作形容詞或感嘆詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「神」原指神靈或神祇，在日常語境可指宗教信仰中的神；口語中亦可用來形容某人或事物很厲害、超凡或不可思議。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a deity or spirit. In everyday use it denotes gods in religious belief; colloquially it can describe someone or something as extraordinary, uncanny, or amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廟主要係供奉土地神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 miu6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 gung1 fung6 tou2 dei6 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间庙主要是供奉土地神。
examples.english_sentence: This temple mainly worships the Earth God.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢考到滿分，真係神啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 haau2 dou3 mun5 fan1, zan1 hai6 san4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他考到满分，真是神啊！
examples.english_sentence: He got a perfect score on this exam — amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢相信神會保佑佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 seon3 san4 wui5 bou2 jau6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他相信神会保佑他。
examples.english_sentence: He believes that a god will protect him.

mandarin_meaning: 心神不寧、精神恍惚，注意力無法集中
english_meaning: absent-minded; mentally unsettled or distracted; unable to concentrate
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人精神不集中、心神不定，常常走神或沒辦法專心做事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is mentally unsettled or absent-minded—distracted and unable to focus on tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日神不守舍，好似有心事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 san4 bat1 sau2 se3 hou2 ci5 jau5 sam1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近總是心神不寧，好像有心事。
examples.english_sentence: He has been restless lately, as if he has something on his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會時佢神不守舍，講錯咗重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 si4 keoi5 san4 bat1 sau2 se3 gong2 co3 zo2 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會時他心不在焉，把重點說錯了。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting he was absent-minded and got the main points wrong.

jyutping: san4 bat1 zi1 gwai2 bat1 gok3
mandarin_meaning: 没有人知道、完全不被察觉；偷偷地、暗中地
english_meaning: without anyone knowing; completely unnoticed; secretly
explanation_mandarin: 表示做某事非常隱密，沒有被任何人發現或察覺。
explanation_english: Describes doing something so secretly that nobody notices; carried out completely unnoticed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢神不知鬼不覺咁攞走咗公司啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san4 bat1 zi1 gwai2 bat1 gok3 gam2 lo2 zau2 zo2 gung1si1 di1 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他神不知鬼不覺地把公司的文件拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: He took the company's documents without anyone knowing.

mandarin_meaning: 神主牌（祖先或神明的牌位、神位）
english_meaning: spirit tablet; ancestral tablet (a tablet bearing the name of a deceased ancestor or deity for veneration)
explanation_mandarin: 用於祭祀、供奉的牌位，上面刻或寫有祖先或神明的名字，安放於神龕或家中的供奉處，供家人祭拜與紀念。
explanation_english: A tablet used in rituals and veneration that bears the name of an ancestor or deity; placed on an altar or shrine in a home or temple for worship and remembrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祭祀嗰陣，屋企會擺出神主牌，上面寫住祖先嘅名，用嚟供奉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zai3 si6 go2 zan6, uk1 kei5 wui5 baai2 ceot1 san4 zyu2 paai4, soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 zou2 sin1 ge3 ming4, jung6 lai4 gung1 fung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祭祀的时候，家里会摆出神主牌，上面写着祖先的名字，用来供奉。
examples.english_sentence: During ancestral rites, the family places the spirit tablet with the ancestors' names on it for veneration.

jyutping: san4 zyu2 paai4 dou1 wui5 waak6
mandarin_meaning: 連神主牌都會被嚇到（用來形容非常恐怖、震撼或誇張的情況）
english_meaning: So scary/shocking that even the ancestral tablet would be startled (a hyperbolic Cantonese slang expression)
explanation_mandarin: 這句廣東話俚語以誇張的方式形容某事物非常可怕或震撼，意思是連通常不會有反應的神主牌也會被嚇到。常用於形容恐怖電影、驚悚場面或極端驚訝的情況。
explanation_english: This Cantonese slang phrase uses hyperbole to describe something extremely frightening or shocking — literally 'even the ancestral tablet would be startled.' It’s used to emphasize strong fright, shock, or astonishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲特效做得太逼真，神主牌都會喐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dak6 haau6 zou6 dak1 taai3 bik1 zan1, san4 zyu2 paai4 dou1 wui5 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些特效做得太逼真，連神主牌都會被嚇到。
examples.english_sentence: The special effects are so realistic, even the ancestral tablet would be startled.

mandarin_meaning: 出神入化；技艺高超
english_meaning: to have extraordinary/supernatural skill; superbly skilled
explanation_mandarin: 形容技艺达到极高的境界，好像有超凡的本领，令人惊叹。
explanation_english: Describes skill or craftsmanship so exceptional that it seems almost supernatural; used to praise someone’s extraordinary ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅廚藝真係神乎其技，煮出嚟每樣嘢都好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 cyu4 ngai6 zan1 hai6 san4 fu1 kei4 gei6, zyu2 ceot1 lai4 mui5 joeng6 je5 dou1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的厨艺真是出神入化，做出的每样菜都非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: His cooking is truly masterful; everything he makes tastes great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位畫家畫得神乎其技，成日有人嚟睇佢嘅畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 waa6 gaa1 waa6 dak1 san4 fu1 kei4 gei6, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 lai4 tai2 keoi5 ge3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位画家画得出神入化，常有人来看他的画。
examples.english_sentence: This painter paints with astonishing skill; people often come to see his work.

mandarin_meaning: 心靈相通；精神上的交流
english_meaning: spiritual rapport; a deep non-physical connection or mutual understanding
explanation_mandarin: 指心靈或精神上的交流與默契，形容雙方在思想、情感上有深層聯繫，但未必有實際接觸或言語往來。
explanation_english: Refers to a spiritual or emotional connection/rapport—when two people share a deep, non-physical understanding or bond, often without much verbal communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間好似有種神交，唔使講太多都明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 hou2 ci5 jau5 zung2 san4 gaau1, m4 sai2 gong2 taai3 do1 dou1 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间好像有心灵相通，不用说太多也能明白。
examples.english_sentence: They seem to have a spiritual connection; they understand each other without many words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話自己同偶像有神交，其實係一種心理投射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 zi6 gei2 tung4 ngau5 zoeng6 jau5 san4 gaau1, kei4 sat6 hai6 jat1 zung2 sam1 lei5 tau4 seot3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人說自己與偶像有心靈交流，其實是一種心理投射。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say they have a spiritual connection with a celebrity, but it's actually a form of psychological projection.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/網絡）能力出眾或令人驚歎的人；有時帶讚賞或諷刺意味
english_meaning: A colloquial/internet term for a person who is exceptionally skilled or impressive; can be used admiringly or sarcastically
explanation_mandarin: 「神人」常在廣東話口語與網絡用語中出現，用來稱呼某人技術高超、做事速度或能力異於常人，既可作真誠讚賞，也可作半開玩笑或諷刺。
explanation_english: Used in Cantonese speech and online, '神人' labels someone whose skills or speed are extraordinary. It can express genuine admiration, playful praise, or ironic sarcasm depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係神人，十分鐘就整好個故障！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 san4 jan4, sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 zing2 hou2 go3 gu3 zong6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是神人，十分钟就把故障修好了！
examples.english_sentence: You're really amazing — you fixed the fault in ten minutes!

mandarin_meaning: 神仙（不朽的仙人；也可口語用作形容不可思議或高超的人/行為）
english_meaning: immortal/immortal being; deity; (colloquially) someone extraordinary or a miraculous/unbelievable action
explanation_mandarin: 「神仙」原指道教或民間傳說中的不死、有超自然能力的存在。口語中可作褒義用來稱讚某人技藝高超或表現非凡；亦可用作諷刺或感嘆，形容某些荒謬、不可思議或出人意表的行為（如「神仙操作」）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to immortals or deities in Daoist and folk belief. Colloquially it can praise someone as exceptionally skilled or describe something miraculous/unbelievable; it can also be used sarcastically to describe absurd or unexpected actions (e.g. "神仙操作").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代傳說入面，神仙住喺山上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 cyun4 syut3 jap6 min6, san4 sin1 zyu6 hai2 saan1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代传说里，神仙住在山上。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient legends, immortals live on the mountains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你琴晚打波打得咁犀利，真係神仙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kam4 maan5 daa2 bo1 daa2 dak1 gam2 sai1 lei6, zan1 hai6 san4 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你昨天打球打得这么厉害，真是神仙！
examples.english_sentence: You played so well last night — you're unreal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司度嗰個提案真係神仙操作，點解會咁樣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 dou6 go2 go3 tai4 on3 zan1 hai6 san4 sin1 cou1 zok3, dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 joeng6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司那個提案真是神仙操作，為什麼會這樣？
examples.english_sentence: That proposal at the company is a ridiculous 'miracle' move — why did it end up like that?

mandarin_meaning: 指荒謬或難以置信的數字；有時也指迷信或算命中的吉利數字。
english_meaning: An unbelievable or unrealistic number (used to describe a ridiculous price, estimate, or statistic); sometimes refers to a 'magical' or lucky number in superstitious contexts.
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容某個數字非常離譜、不可信或像「天上掉下來」的奇蹟般；在迷信語境下，也可指個人認為有幸運或靈驗的號碼。
explanation_english: Colloquial slang used to describe a number that is absurd, unbelievable, or so unlikely it seems miraculous; in superstitious contexts it can mean a personally lucky or 'magical' number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢報個價真係神仙數，邊有咁平！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou3 go3 gaa3 zan1 hai6 san4 sin1 sou3, bin1 jau5 gam2 peng4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他報的價格真的是神仙數，哪有那麼便宜！
examples.english_sentence: The price he quoted is unbelievable — how could it be that cheap!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵到個中意嘅號碼，話係佢嘅神仙數，日日都用嗰啲號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 dou3 go3 zung1 ji3 ge3 hou6 maa5, waa6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 san4 sin1 sou3, jat6 jat6 dou1 jung6 go2 di1 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找到自己中意的號碼，說那是他的神仙數，每天都用那些號碼。
examples.english_sentence: He found a number he liked and said it's his 'magic' number — he uses those numbers every day.

mandarin_meaning: 吃不胖的肚子；能吃很多但不容易發胖（俚語）
english_meaning: a 'godly' stomach — someone who can eat a lot without gaining weight (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，直譯為「神仙的肚子」，用來形容某人食量大或吃很多東西但不容易長胖，語氣通常帶玩笑或羨慕意味，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang literally meaning 'immortal/god's stomach.' It describes someone who can eat a lot yet hardly gains weight. The term is informal, often used jokingly or admiringly in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有神仙肚，食咁多都唔會肥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 san4 sin1 tou5, sik6 gam2 do1 dou1 m4 wui5 fei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她有「神仙肚」，吃再多也不會變胖。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has a 'godly stomach' — can eat a lot and never gain weight.

mandarin_meaning: 连神仙都救不了；无可救药
english_meaning: Beyond help; hopeless — even immortals/gods couldn't save it
explanation_mandarin: 用于形容事情非常严重或已经无法挽回，连神仙（或神灵）都救不了，表示无可救药或无望。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation so bad or irreversible that even deities/immortals couldn't fix it; indicates hopelessness or beyond help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司已經破產，神仙都難救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 po3 caan2, san4 sin1 dou1 naan4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经破产，连神仙都救不了。
examples.english_sentence: This company has already gone bankrupt; even immortals couldn't save it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到又唔做嘢，老闆話佢神仙都難救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 jau6 m4 zou6 je5, lou5 baan2 waa6 keoi5 san4 sin1 dou1 naan4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到又不做事，老板说他连神仙都救不了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late and doesn't do his work; the boss said he's beyond help.

mandarin_meaning: 神仙鱼（又称天使鱼）——一种常见的观赏鱼，海水或淡水种类都有
english_meaning: angelfish — a common ornamental fish (marine or freshwater species)
explanation_mandarin: 指外形美麗、常作觀賞用途的魚類，既有海洋品種（如海神仙魚），也有淡水品種（如天使魚）
explanation_english: Refers to ornamental fish noted for their attractive appearance; can mean marine angelfish or freshwater angelfish (often kept in aquariums).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺寵物店見到一條好靚嘅神仙魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 cung5 mat6 dim3 gin3 dou3 jat1 tiu4 hou2 leng3 ge3 san4 sin1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在寵物店看到一條很漂亮的神仙魚。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a very beautiful angelfish at the pet shop.

mandarin_meaning: 非常相像；极为相似
english_meaning: to resemble strikingly; to bear an uncanny resemblance
explanation_mandarin: 表示两者在外貌、风格或特征上非常相像，常用来强调相似程度很高。
explanation_english: Indicates that two people or things are very similar in appearance, style, or characteristics; emphasizes a high degree of resemblance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同佢阿爸真係神似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 keoi5 aa3 baa4 zan1 hai6 san4 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和他爸爸真神似。
examples.english_sentence: He really bears a striking resemblance to his father.

mandarin_meaning: 神位（也稱牌位、神牌），用以安放神明或祖先名牌的牌位或神龕位置
english_meaning: spirit tablet; ancestral tablet; the tablet or place on an altar representing a deity or ancestor
explanation_mandarin: 指用來供奉神明或祖先的牌位或牌位所在的位置，常置於神龕或祖先廳，用於祭祀、燒香拜祭等宗教或民俗活動。
explanation_english: Refers to a tablet or the place on an altar used to enshrine deities or ancestors. It is commonly placed on a shrine or ancestral altar and used in rituals such as offerings and incense burning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺嘅神位喺廳入面，我哋會定期替佢掃供。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je5 ge3 san4 wai6 hai2 teng1 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 ding6 kei4 tai3 keoi5 sou3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爺爺的神位在客廳裡面，我們會定期為他掃供。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather's spirit tablet is in the living room; we regularly clean it and make offerings for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明時，全家人會去拜祭掃神位，燒香同擺供品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 si4, cyun4 gaa1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 baai3 zai3 sou3 san4 wai6, siu1 hoeng1 tung4 baai2 gung1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明時，全家人會去祭拜掃神位，燒香並擺供品。
examples.english_sentence: At Qingming, the whole family goes to pay respects and tend the ancestral tablets, burning incense and placing offerings.

mandarin_meaning: （网络/口语）形容某部作品非常出色或堪称杰作
english_meaning: A (slang) term praising a work as outstanding or a 'masterpiece' / 'work of genius'
explanation_mandarin: 网络流行语，常用于称赞电影、小说、音乐、動畫等艺术或娛樂作品，表示该作品非常优秀、令人惊艳。
explanation_english: Internet/slang term used to praise films, books, music, etc., meaning an exceptionally good work or 'masterpiece'. Often hyperbolic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影真係神作，情節同演技都一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 zan1 hai6 san4 zok3, cing4 zit3 tung4 jin2 gei6 dou1 jat1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真是神作，剧情和演技都一流。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is truly a masterpiece — the plot and acting are top-notch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你寫嘅歌真係神作！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 se2 ge3 go1 zan1 hai6 san4 zok3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你写的歌真是神作！
examples.english_sentence: The song you wrote is truly a masterpiece!

mandarin_meaning: 神来之笔（形容出人意表、巧妙的一笔或主意）
english_meaning: a stroke of genius; a brilliant or inspired remark/gesture/detail
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某個構思、細節或處理方法非常巧妙、出人意表，像是靈感突然出現的一筆，通常帶有高度讚賞的語氣。
explanation_english: Used to describe a choice, detail, or solution that is exceptionally clever or unexpectedly inspired — as if a flash of genius produced that single brilliant touch; typically expresses high praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫入面嗰個細節真係神來之筆，將成幅畫提升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 jap6 min6 go2 go3 sai3 zit3 zan1 hai6 san4 loi4 zi1 bat1, zoeng1 seng4 fuk1 waa6 tai4 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画里那个细节真是神来之笔，把整幅画提升了很多。
examples.english_sentence: That detail in this painting is a stroke of genius — it really elevates the whole piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上突然提出個方案嘅改動，真係神來之筆，解決咗我哋嘅難題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 dat6 jin4 tai4 ceot1 go3 fong1 on3 ge3 goi2 dung6, zan1 hai6 san4 loi4 zi1 bat1, gaai2 kyut3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 naan4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上突然提出这个方案的改变，真是神来之笔，解决了我们的难题。
examples.english_sentence: His sudden proposed change at the meeting was a stroke of genius — it solved our problem.

mandarin_meaning: 心靈受創；非常難過、傷心
english_meaning: emotionally hurt; heartbroken; deeply saddened
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中常用的口語詞，表示心靈受到傷害或深感難過、痛心。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe emotional hurt or deep sadness—feeling heartbroken or emotionally wounded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢離開嘅消息，我真係覺得好神傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 lei4 hoi1 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 san4 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他離開的消息，我真的覺得很傷心。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard the news that he left, I really felt heartbroken.

mandarin_meaning: 神像（供奉或陳列的神祇雕像或聖像）
english_meaning: a statue or image of a deity; a religious idol or sacred image
explanation_mandarin: 指供奉或擺放在廟宇、神壇、祭祀場所的神祇雕像、聖像或肖像，也可泛指宗教崇拜的偶像。
explanation_english: Refers to a statue or image of a deity placed in temples, altars, or shrines; can also broadly mean a religious idol or sacred image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面擺住好多神像，信眾嚟燒香拜祭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 baai2 zyu6 hou2 do1 san4 zoeng6, seon3 zung3 lai4 siu1 hoeng1 baai3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庙里摆着很多神像，信众来烧香拜祭。
examples.english_sentence: The temple houses many deity statues; worshippers come to burn incense and pay respects.

mandarin_meaning: 行动诡秘、出没无常
english_meaning: to appear and disappear mysteriously; elusive and unpredictable
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或物行动、出现与消失很不规律、难以捉摸，常用来表示行踪飘忽或难以追踪。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that appears and disappears unpredictably; elusive and hard to track or predict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行蹤神出鬼沒，警察都追唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang4 zung1 san4 ceot1 gwai2 mut6, ging2 caat3 dou1 zeoi1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他行踪神出鬼没，警察都追不到。
examples.english_sentence: His movements are unpredictable; the police can't catch him.

mandarin_meaning: 形容行踪難以捉摸，時常突然出現又迅速消失（shén chū guǐ mò）。
english_meaning: Describes someone or something that appears and disappears unpredictably; elusive; hard to track.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或事物行蹤不定、難以預測，經常忽隱忽現。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing whose movements are unpredictable and hard to pin down, often appearing and vanishing mysteriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人神出鬼没，搞到我哋好難安排會面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 san4 ceot1 gwai2 mut6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 naan4 ngon1 paai4 wui6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個人神出鬼沒，搞得我們很難安排會面。
examples.english_sentence: This person is elusive, making it very difficult for us to arrange a meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 神剧（网络用语）
english_meaning: a 'god-tier' or 'ridiculous' drama (internet slang)
explanation_mandarin: 網絡流行語，用來形容電視劇或網絡劇等的內容非常誇張、精彩或荒誕。依語境可作褒義（極好看、精彩）或貶義（荒謬、離譜）的評價。
explanation_english: Internet slang for a TV/online drama whose plot is extremely spectacular, exaggerated, or absurd. Depending on context it can be complimentary (very entertaining) or derogatory (ridiculously absurd).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嗰套劇真係神劇，笑到我肚痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go2 tou3 kek6 zan1 hai6 san4 kek6, siu3 dou3 ngo5 duk6 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次那部剧真是神剧，笑到我肚子疼。
examples.english_sentence: That drama this time is truly a 'god-tier' show — it made me laugh until my stomach hurt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲收視率好高，大家都話係神劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 sau1 si6 leot6 hou2 gou1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 hai6 san4 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧收视率很高，大家都说是神剧。
examples.english_sentence: This drama has high ratings; everyone says it's a 'god-tier' show.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀或表演奇技花招的把戲；誇張的表現或作秀（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: a flashy stunt or show-off act; performing ostentatious tricks to attract attention (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 指人為了吸引注意或誇耀自己而表演的花招或做作表現，常帶貶義，暗示不真實或過度誇張。
explanation_english: Refers to flashy tricks or theatrical behavior performed to attract attention or show off. Often slang with a negative nuance implying exaggeration or insincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司面前演神功戲，想攞上司注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 min6 cin4 jin2 san4 gung1 hei3, soeng2 lo2 soeng6 si1 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在公司面前表演神功戲，想吸引上司的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on a show at the office to get his boss's attention.

mandarin_meaning: （形容）非常勇敢或表現非常出色；有時帶誇張或諷刺意味，指行為魯莽或過於冒險。
english_meaning: extremely brave or outstandingly bold; can praise someone’s heroic performance or be used sarcastically to mean reckless/brash.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人非常勇猛、表現卓越或奮勇當先；在口語中亦可帶諷刺意味，用以批評行為魯莽、過度冒險。
explanation_english: Describes someone as extraordinarily brave or performing with exceptional boldness; in colloquial use it can be complimentary (heroic, outstanding) or ironic/sarcastic to imply recklessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚打波嗰陣真係神勇，射入咗兩球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 daa2 bo1 go2 zan6 zan1 hai6 san4 jung5, se6 jap6 zo2 loeng5 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚踢球時真是神勇，射入了兩球。
examples.english_sentence: He played outstandingly tonight, scoring two goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做未免太神勇，會惹事㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 mei6 min5 taai3 san4 jung5, wui5 je5 si6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做未免太神勇，會惹麻煩的！
examples.english_sentence: What you did is a bit too reckless — you'll cause trouble!

mandarin_meaning: 把人或事物神格化、神聖化或過度美化，使之像神一樣被崇拜或理想化
english_meaning: to deify or mythicize; to idealize or elevate someone/something to a god-like or flawless status
explanation_mandarin: 指將某人、某事或某種觀念過度理想化或神聖化，忽略其缺點與局限，常見於政治、名人或歷史敘事中。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of idolizing, mythologizing, or sanctifying someone/something—overlooking flaws and elevating them to an almost divine status; common in political, celebrity, or historical narratives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日將領袖神化，忽略咗佢嘅缺點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 zoeng1 ling5 zau2 san4 faa3, fat1 loek6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 kyut3 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們總是把領袖神化，忽視了他的缺點。
examples.english_sentence: They always deify the leader, overlooking his flaws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞媒體唔應該將新明星神化，真相需要客觀報道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 mui4 tai2 m4 jing1 goi1 zoeng1 san1 ming4 sing1 san4 faa3, zan1 soeng6 seoi1 jiu3 haak3 gun1 bou3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞媒體不應該把新明星神化，真相需要客觀報導。
examples.english_sentence: The press shouldn't mythologize a new celebrity; the truth requires objective reporting.

jyutping: san4 jau6 hai6 nei5 gwai2 jau6 hai6 nei5
mandarin_meaning: 凡事都歸你／好事壞事都算在你頭上
english_meaning: You're credited and blamed for everything; everything is attributed to you
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人凡事都被認為有關係或被責備，帶有埋怨或諷刺語氣。
explanation_english: Used to say someone is credited and blamed for everything; often said with resentment or sarcasm to complain that one person is held responsible for all outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為你咁叻？每次有人成功就話係你，一有問題又話係你，真係神又係你鬼又係你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai6 nei5 gam2 lek1? mui5 ci3 jau5 jan4 sing4 gung1 zau6 waa6 hai6 nei5, jat1 jau5 man6 tai4 jau6 waa6 hai6 nei5, zan1 hai6 san4 jau6 hai6 nei5 gwai2 jau6 hai6 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为你很了不起吗？每次有人成功就说是你，一出问题又说是你，真的是好事坏事都归你！
examples.english_sentence: Do you think you're so great? Every time someone succeeds they say it's you, and whenever there's a problem they also blame you — you're credited and blamed for everything!

jyutping: san4 jau6 hai6 keoi5, gwai2 jau6 hai6 keoi5
mandarin_meaning: 神也是他，鬼也是他；用來諷刺或抱怨某人凡事都被歸責或歸功於他
english_meaning: He's the one for everything (both praise and blame); used sarcastically to say someone is credited or blamed for everything
explanation_mandarin: 一句廣東話俚語，帶有諷刺或抱怨意味，表示不論好事壞事都歸到同一個人頭上，或覺得某人凡事都有份
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase, often sarcastic, meaning that the same person is held responsible or given credit for everything — used when someone is blamed or credited for all matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次會議出咗啲問題，經理話全部都係阿文嘅錯，真係神又係佢鬼又係佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 ceot1 zo2 di1 man6 tai4, ging1 lei5 waa6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 aa3 man4 ge3 co3, zan1 hai6 san4 jau6 hai6 keoi5 gwai2 jau6 hai6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次會議出了些問題，經理說全部都是阿文的錯，真是神也是他、鬼也是他。
examples.english_sentence: This meeting had some problems and the manager said it was all Ah Man's fault — it's like he's blamed for (or credited with) everything.

mandarin_meaning: 神龕；供奉神明或祖先的壇位／神位
english_meaning: altar/shrine (the platform or cabinet for enshrining deities or ancestral tablets)
explanation_mandarin: 指供奉神明或祖先的壇位、神龕或放置神位的台座，常見於家庭或廟宇的祭祀空間。
explanation_english: Refers to the altar or shrine platform used to enshrine deities or ancestral tablets; commonly found in homes or temples for worship and offerings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企嘅神台擺咗祖先嘅牌位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 ge3 san4 toi4 baai2 zo2 zou2 sin1 ge3 paai4 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的神台擺放了祖先的牌位。
examples.english_sentence: The household altar holds the ancestral tablets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面個神台好華麗，香火鼎盛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 go3 san4 toi4 hou2 waa4 lai6, hoeng1 fo2 ding2 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡的神台很華麗，香火很旺。
examples.english_sentence: The temple's altar is ornate and has many incense offerings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔好亂拈神台上嘅供品，會唔吉利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 hou2 lyun6 nim1 san4 toi4 soeng6 ge3 gung1 ban2, wui5 m4 gat1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們不要亂動神台上的供品，會不吉利。
examples.english_sentence: They shouldn't touch the offerings on the altar; it's considered unlucky.

mandarin_meaning: 奇怪、無聊或荒謬的言行（口語俚語）
english_meaning: odd, silly, or absurd talk/behavior (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「神台桔」為粵語口語俚語，字面為「神台」和「桔」，實際用來形容某人說話或行為很奇怪、無聊或荒謬。詞源不明，常見於香港日常對話中，語氣偏貶義或戲謔。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term literally composed of "altar" and "tangerine." It is used to describe someone’s speech or behavior as odd, silly, or absurd. The origin is unclear; it is mainly used in Hong Kong and carries a derogatory or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲神台桔，冇人理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 san4 toi4 gat1, mou5 jan4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是說些奇怪無聊的話，沒有人理他。
examples.english_sentence: He always says weird, silly things; nobody pays attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 祭祀神台上擺放的橘子因放久而陰乾（風乾/變乾癟）；也可作比喻，形容事物被忽略以致枯萎或荒廢。
english_meaning: The tangerines/oranges placed on a household altar that have become air‑dried and shriveled; figuratively, something neglected and left to wither or decay.
explanation_mandarin: 「神台橘」指供奉在神台或祖先神桌上的橘子；「陰乾」指在陰涼處自然風乾、變乾癟。合起來可指字面上的陰乾供果，也常用作比喻，描述被遺忘、荒廢或長期不理的狀況。
explanation_english: Literally refers to altar oranges/tangerines that have been left on the altar long enough to air‑dry and shrivel. It can be used literally for dried offering fruit or metaphorically to describe something neglected, left to deteriorate, or abandoned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企個神台橘已經陰乾晒，睇落好似冇人理咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 go3 san4 toi4 gwat1 ji5 ging1 jam1 gon1 saai3, tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 mou5 jan4 lei5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的神台上的橘子已經陰乾了，看起來好像沒人理會。
examples.english_sentence: The oranges on the home altar have already dried up; they look like nobody has been tending to them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個項目擺爛咗好耐，真係好似神台橘咁陰乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hong6 muk6 baai2 laan6 zo2 hou2 noi6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 san4 toi4 gwat1 gam2 jam1 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個項目擺爛了很久，真的像神台橘一樣陰乾。
examples.english_sentence: That project has been left to rot for a long time; it's really like an altar orange that's dried out.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：神台上的貓屎；俚語（粗俗）：形容某事物或某人很差、很糟糕、毫無價值
english_meaning: Literal: 'cat poop on the altar'. Slang/vulgar: used to call something or someone terrible, worthless, or awful.
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語口語中，詞面為「神台上的貓屎」。作為俚語或罵人的用語，用來強烈貶低或批評某物／某人非常爛或令人厭惡。語氣粗俗且帶有誇張成分，屬於非正式用法，較少見於書面語。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese speech, the phrase literally means 'cat poop on the altar'. As slang, it is a vulgar way to strongly belittle or criticize something/someone as very bad or disgusting. It is informal, coarse, and carries exaggerated contempt; not common in formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廣告真係神台貓屎，完全冇心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 zan1 hai6 san4 toi4 maau1 sai2, jyun4 syun4 mou5 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個廣告真是神台貓屎，完全沒有用心。
examples.english_sentence: This ad is really awful — there's clearly no effort at all.

cantonese: 神台貓屎 - 神憎鬼厭
jyutping: san4 toi4 maau1 sai2 —— san4 zang1 gwai2 jim3
mandarin_meaning: 人人厭惡、極其令人生厭（口語/俗語）
english_meaning: Universally despised; extremely detested (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 這是一個廣東話口語表達，將形象化的詞語與成語結合，用來強調某人或某事被眾人厭惡、令人反感。字面上帶有誇張和貶義的色彩，常用於口語或非正式場合。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression that combines a vivid phrase with the idiom '神憎鬼厭' to stress that someone or something is universally disliked. It is figurative, strongly negative, and typically used in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，成班同事都嬲到佢，真係神台貓屎——神憎鬼厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, sing4 baan1 tung4 si6 dou1 naau1 dou3 keoi5, zan1 hai6 san4 toi4 maau1 sai2 —— san4 zang1 gwai2 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事，同事們都氣得很討厭他，真是「神台貓屎——神憎鬼厭」。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up; the colleagues were so angry and disgusted with him — truly universally despised.

mandarin_meaning: 神奇的東西；令人驚訝或不可思議的事物（俚語）
english_meaning: a miraculous/amazing thing; something unbelievable or extraordinary (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「神嘢」為香港粵語俚語，多用來形容某事物或某人很神奇、厲害或令人難以置信，有時也帶有諷刺或驚訝語氣。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, '神嘢' describes something or someone amazing, miraculous, or unbelievable. It can be used admiringly, in surprise, or sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲魔術真係神嘢，點解會做到㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 mo1 seot6 zan1 hai6 san4 je5, dim2 gaai2 wui5 zou6 dou3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的魔術真的很神奇，怎麼可能做到？
examples.english_sentence: His magic tricks are really amazing—how could he do that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲乜嘢神嘢，根本唔可信㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 mat1 je5 san4 je5, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 seon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這是什麼神奇的東西，根本不可信。
examples.english_sentence: What kind of 'miracle' thing is this? It's totally not believable.

mandarin_meaning: 神器（网络/口语），指非常好用或功能强大的工具、装置或软件；原指神圣的器物
english_meaning: A 'miraculous' or 'god-tier' tool/device; colloquially an extremely useful or powerful gadget/app
explanation_mandarin: 原本指具有神力或神聖性的器物，現多用作網絡或口語俚語，用來稱讚某個工具、裝置或軟件非常好用、功能強大或極為實用。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a divine or sacred implement. In modern colloquial/internet use, it praises a tool, device, or app as extremely useful, powerful, or "miraculous."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機真係神器，影相好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 zan1 hai6 san4 hei3, jing2 soeng2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机真是神器，拍照很好看。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is really an amazing gadget; the photos look great.

mandarin_meaning: 神坛（供奉神明或祖先的坛位）
english_meaning: altar; shrine (a platform or place for worshipping deities or ancestors); figuratively, a pedestal for idolizing someone
explanation_mandarin: 指供奉神明或先祖祭拜用的壇、供桌或神位；也可做比喻，用來形容被崇拜或奉為偶像的地位（把某人放上神壇）。
explanation_english: Refers to an altar or shrine used for worshipping deities or ancestors; can also be used figuratively to mean placing someone on a pedestal or treating them as an idol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企起咗個神壇拜祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei5 hei2 zo2 go3 san4taan4 baai3 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家裡立了個神壇祭拜祖先。
examples.english_sentence: He set up an altar at home to worship his ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將佢擺上神壇，佢都係普通人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 keoi5 baai2 soeng6 san4taan4, keoi5 dou1 hai6 pou2tung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把他抬到神壇上崇拜，他也是普通人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put him on a pedestal; he's just an ordinary person.

mandarin_meaning: 神奇（形容事物奇妙、不可思议或像有魔力）
english_meaning: magical; miraculous; wondrous; amazing
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物具有令人驚訝、不可思議或像有神秘力量的特性，常表示極大的驚歎或不可理解。
explanation_english: Describes something as miraculous, magical, or surprisingly wonderful—seeming to defy ordinary explanation; often expresses strong wonder or amazement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事真係好神奇，我根本唔明點解會咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 san4 kei4, ngo5 gan1 bun2 m4 ming4 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真的很神奇，我根本不明白为什么会这样。
examples.english_sentence: This is really amazing; I don't understand at all why it happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺演唱會上嘅聲音好神奇，聽得我好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui6 soeng6 ge3 sing1 jam1 hou2 san4 kei4, teng1 dak1 ngo5 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在演唱会上的声音很神奇，讓我很感动。
examples.english_sentence: His voice at the concert was amazing and moved me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個魔術真係好神奇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mo1 seot6 zan1 hai6 hou2 san4 kei4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个魔术真的很神奇！
examples.english_sentence: This magic trick is really amazing!

mandarin_meaning: 神威 (shénwēi)：神的威力；神聖或令人敬畏的威勢
english_meaning: divine power; awe-inspiring might; imposing authority
explanation_mandarin: 指神聖或超自然的威力，也可用來形容令人敬畏或具有威勢的氣場或力量。
explanation_english: Refers to divine or supernatural power; can also describe an awe-inspiring, imposing presence or authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一出場，真係有種神威，令全場都靜晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 coeng4, zan1 hai6 jau5 zung2 san4 wai1, ling6 cyun4 coeng4 dou1 zing6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一出場，真的有一種神威，讓全場都安靜了。
examples.english_sentence: When he came on stage, there was really a sense of awe that silenced the whole audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座寺廟好有神威，令我覺得好敬畏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 zo6 zi6 miu6 hou2 jau5 san4 wai1, ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 ging3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座寺廟很有神威，讓我感到很敬畏。
examples.english_sentence: This temple feels very awe-inspiring, making me feel reverent.

mandarin_meaning: 通靈或替人算命的女人（口語），可指女巫或靈媒，常帶戲謔或貶義
english_meaning: female fortune-teller or spirit-medium (colloquial); can be used pejoratively as 'witch'
explanation_mandarin: 「神婆」在廣東話中多指替人算命、通靈或主持民間儀式的女性，既可描述職業性的算命師或靈媒，也常作戲稱或帶貶義地稱呼迷信、靠靈異手段謀利的女性。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "神婆" typically refers to a female fortune-teller or spirit-medium who communicates with gods/spirits or performs rituals. It can describe an actual practitioner (fortune-teller/shaman) and is also used colloquially or pejoratively to label someone as superstitious or a 'witch'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嬸成日去搵神婆問運程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sam2 sing4 jat6 heoi3 wan2 san4 po4 man6 wan6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姨经常去找神婆算命問運勢。
examples.english_sentence: My aunt often goes to a spirit-medium to ask about her fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話屋企有嘢，請左個神婆上門化解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 uk1 kei2 jau5 je5, ceng2 zo2 go3 san4 po4 soeng5 mun4 faa3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说家里有事，请了一个神婆上门化解。
examples.english_sentence: He said something was wrong at home and hired a spirit-medium to come and resolve it.

mandarin_meaning: 神学 (shénxué)
english_meaning: theology; the study of God, religious beliefs, and doctrines
explanation_mandarin: 研究神、宗教信仰、教義及相關思想的學科與領域。
explanation_english: An academic field that studies God, religious beliefs, doctrines, and related theological thought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學修讀神學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 sau1 duk6 san4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大學修讀神學。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying theology at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 神學關注宗教嘅教義同信仰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 hok6 gwaan1 zyu3 zung1 gaau3 ge3 gaau3 ji6 tung4 seon3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 神学關注宗教的教義與信仰。
examples.english_sentence: Theology concerns the doctrines and beliefs of religion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想做神父，所以要學神學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 san4 fu6, so2 ji5 jiu3 hok6 san4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想當神父，所以要學神學。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to become a priest, so he needs to study theology.

mandarin_meaning: 神州（shénzhōu），对中国的诗意或文言称呼
english_meaning: Shenzhou; a poetic or literary name for China
explanation_mandarin: “神州”为对中国的古典、诗意称呼，常见于古文、诗歌或较正式、爱国性的语境中，用来指代中华大地或中国大陆。
explanation_english: “Shenzhou” is a literary/poetic name for China, commonly found in classical texts, poetry, or formal/patriotic contexts to refer to the Chinese land or nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去神州出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 san4 zau1 ceot1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去神州出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to China on a business trip next month.

mandarin_meaning: 像受神鬼驅使一樣，指被一種莫名其妙的衝動或力量驅使去做某事。
english_meaning: As if driven by gods and ghosts; acting under a mysterious or inexplicable compulsion.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人似乎受了某種不可理解的力量或衝動影響，做出出人意表的行為。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who seems compelled by some inexplicable force or impulse to do something unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日神差鬼使，竟然去咗佢屋企幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 san4 caai1 gwai2 si2, ging2 jin4 heoi3 zo2 keoi5 uk1 kei2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天神差鬼使，竟然去他家幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: Today, as if driven by some mysterious force, I unexpectedly went to his house to help.

mandarin_meaning: 寺廟中的正殿；供奉神像的殿堂
english_meaning: The main hall of a temple where deities' statues are enshrined and worship takes place
explanation_mandarin: 指寺廟裡供奉神像的主要殿堂，通常是舉行祭祀、上香和祈福等儀式的場所。
explanation_english: Refers to the principal hall in a temple where a deity's statue is housed and where worship, incense offerings, and rituals are performed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個神廳擺放住主神像，成日有人上香拜祭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 san4 teng1 baai2 fong3 zyu6 zyu2 san4 zoeng6, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 soeng6 hoeng1 baai3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 神厅摆放着主神像，经常有人上香祭拜。
examples.english_sentence: The main hall houses the principal deity's statue; people often burn incense and pay their respects.

mandarin_meaning: 神往（被吸引、向往）
english_meaning: to be fascinated or deeply attracted; to yearn for or feel enchanted
explanation_mandarin: 表示被某事物吸引或憧憬、向往，常用於「令人神往」表示令人感到迷戀或向往。
explanation_english: Indicates being attracted to or fascinated by something; to yearn for or feel enchanted. Often appears in the phrase "令人神往" (makes people feel enchanted).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個小鎮好寧靜，令人神往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu2 zan3 hou2 ning4 zing6, ling6 jan4 san4 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小镇很宁静，让人神往。
examples.english_sentence: This small town is very peaceful; it makes people feel enchanted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起旅行嘅經歷，聽到就令人神往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 leoi5 hang4 ge3 ging1 lik6, teng1 dou3 zau6 ling6 jan4 san4 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲起旅行的经历，听了让人神往。
examples.english_sentence: When he talks about his travel experiences, it makes people feel fascinated.

mandarin_meaning: 走運 / 幸運
english_meaning: lucky; fortunate; a stroke of luck
explanation_mandarin: 「神心」是香港廣東話的口語／俚語，用來形容某人或某事非常走運、意外地幸運或剛好命中機會。語氣較口語、帶驚喜或佩服的意味。
explanation_english: “神心” is a colloquial Cantonese/slang expression used to describe being very lucky or having a fortunate stroke of luck. It conveys surprise or admiration at the good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝買到最後一張演唱會飛，真係神心啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 maai5 dou3 zeoi6 hau6 jat1 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui6 fei1, zan1 hai6 san4 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上买到最后一张演唱会票，真是走运啊！
examples.english_sentence: I managed to buy the last concert ticket this morning — really lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中六合彩，神心到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 luk6 ho2 coi2, san4 sam1 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了六合彩，真是幸运到爆。
examples.english_sentence: He won the Mark Six lottery — unbelievably lucky.

mandarin_meaning: （人的）意識、精神狀態；是否清醒或能夠思考、辨別
english_meaning: consciousness; mental state; awareness
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的意識或精神狀態，常用來描述是否清醒或能進行思考與判斷。可用於『失去神志』（失去意識）等表達。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's consciousness or mental state. Used to describe whether someone is awake and able to think or perceive. Often appears in phrases like 'lose consciousness.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出咗車禍之後一度失去神志，依家已經醒返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 zo2 ce1 fo3 zi1 hau6 jat1 dou6 sat1 heoi3 san4 zi3, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 sing2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出车祸后一度失去神志，现在已经醒过来了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost consciousness after the car accident for a while; he's awake now.

mandarin_meaning: 意识、精神不清楚；神志模糊
english_meaning: Having an unclear mental state; confused, delirious, or not fully conscious
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人的神志或意识模糊、混乱或昏迷，常用于医疗场景或描述精神状态异常。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose consciousness or mental state is unclear or disturbed—confused, delirious, or stuporous; often used in medical contexts or to describe abnormal mental states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢比車撞到，仲喺現場神志不清，要即刻送院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 ce1 zong6 dou3, zung6 hai6 jin6 coeng4 san4 zi3 bat1 cing1, jiu3 zik1 hak1 sung3 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被车撞了，现场神志不清，需要立即送医。
examples.english_sentence: He was hit by a car and was mentally confused/unconscious at the scene; he needed to be rushed to the hospital immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老人家瞓着之後跌親，神志不清，需要屋企人照顧。
