explanation_english: As a term, '福士' can be a surname of Japanese origin. It is also used colloquially to refer to Volkswagen cars; Chinese usage more commonly writes the brand as '福斯' or '大眾', but in Hong Kong '福士車' is sometimes seen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一部福士車，成日開嚟載我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 bou6 fuk1 si6 ce1, sing4 jat6 hoi1 lai4 zoi3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一輛福士（福斯／大眾）車，經常開來載我們。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a Volkswagen and often drives it to pick us up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意福士蒼汰嘅戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 fuk1 si6 cong1 taai3 ge3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡福士蒼汰的戲劇。
examples.english_sentence: I really like Fukushi Sota's films.

mandarin_meaning: 福壽膏（中藥外用膏藥或藥膏的商品名），字面為「福壽膏」
english_meaning: Fu Shou Gao (a traditional medicated balm/ointment; literally "fortune and longevity ointment")
explanation_mandarin: 福壽膏通常指傳統中藥製成的外用藥膏或膏狀藥品，常用於舒緩肌肉痛、關節痛或蚊蟲咬傷等，亦可能是某些品牌的商品名。字面含義為「帶來福氣與長壽的膏藥」。
explanation_english: Refers to a traditional topical medicated balm or ointment (and sometimes a brand name). It is commonly used to relieve muscle aches, joint pain, insect bites, etc. The literal meaning is "ointment of fortune and longevity."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企成日有樽福壽膏，痛嘅時候就拎出嚟搽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 sing4 jat6 jau5 zyun1 fuk1 sau6 gou1, tung3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 ling1 ceot1 lei4 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡經常有一瓶福壽膏，痛的時候就拿出來塗。
examples.english_sentence: There's always a jar of Fu Shou Gao at home; when something hurts we take it out and apply it.

mandarin_meaning: 福壽金
english_meaning: gold ornament/ingot inscribed with 'Fu' (fortune) and 'Shou' (longevity)
explanation_mandarin: 指刻有「福」、「壽」等吉祥字樣或以寓意福壽的金飾、金塊，常用作祝壽或賀禮，送給長輩以表祝福。
explanation_english: Refers to a gold ornament or ingot bearing the characters or motifs for 'Fu' (good fortune) and 'Shou' (longevity). Commonly given as a birthday or longevity gift to elders as a blessing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年阿媽生日，我買咗塊福壽金送畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 aa3 maa1 sang1 jat6, ngo5 maai5 zo2 faai3 fuk1 sau6 gam1 sung3 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年媽媽生日，我買了一塊福壽金送給她。
examples.english_sentence: For my mother's birthday this year, I bought her a fushou gold piece (a gold ornament symbolizing fortune and longevity).

mandarin_meaning: 羅非魚 / 吳郭魚（淡水養殖魚類）
english_meaning: tilapia (a common freshwater farmed fish)
explanation_mandarin: 福壽魚指一種常見的淡水養殖魚，台灣與華語地區常稱為吳郭魚或羅非魚。肉質細嫩，多用於清蒸、煎或鹽烤等烹調方式。
explanation_english: “福壽魚” refers to a common freshwater farmed fish (tilapia), also known as wuguo fish or tilapia. It has tender flesh and is commonly cooked by steaming, pan-frying, or grilling with salt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗條福壽魚，打算清蒸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 fuk1 sau6 jyu4, daa2 syun3 cing1 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚買了一條福壽魚，打算清蒸。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a tilapia tonight and plan to steam it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 福壽魚肉質細嫩，唔錯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 sau6 jyu4 juk6 zat1 sai3 non6, m4 co3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 福壽魚肉質細嫩，不錯吃。
examples.english_sentence: Tilapia has tender flesh and tastes pretty good.

mandarin_meaning: 福如东海
english_meaning: May your good fortune be as boundless as the East Sea
explanation_mandarin: 常用的祝賀語，祝願對方福氣像東海一樣廣大、無邊無際，常見於春節或賀壽場合。
explanation_english: A traditional blessing used to wish someone blessings as vast and boundless as the East Sea; commonly used in Lunar New Year greetings and birthday wishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，祝你福如東海，身體健康！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, zuk1 nei5 fuk1 jyu4 dung1 hoi2, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，祝你福如东海，身体健康！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year — I wish you blessings as boundless as the East Sea and good health!

mandarin_meaning: 日本九州北部的城市「福冈」
english_meaning: Fukuoka (a city in northern Kyushu, Japan)
explanation_mandarin: 「福岡」指日本九州地區的一個主要城市，著名的旅遊和美食目的地，漢字寫法為福岡（繁體）或福冈（簡體）。
explanation_english: Refers to the city of Fukuoka in northern Kyushu, Japan — a major city known for tourism and food. The name is written 福岡 (traditional) or 福冈 (simplified).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去福岡旅行，想試吓嗰度嘅拉麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 fuk1 gong1 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 si3 haa5 go2 dou6 ge3 laai1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去福冈旅行，想试试那里的拉面。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Fukuoka next month; I want to try the ramen there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 福岡係九州北部最大嘅城市之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 gong1 hai6 gau2 zau1 bak1 bou6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 sing4 si5 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 福冈是九州北部最大的城市之一。
examples.english_sentence: Fukuoka is one of the largest cities in northern Kyushu.

mandarin_meaning: 福州（Fúzhōu），中国福建省省会
english_meaning: Fuzhou, the capital city of Fujian Province, China
explanation_mandarin: 福州是中国福建省的省会，位于东南沿海、闽江下游流域，是闽东地区的政治、经济和文化中心，当地通行闽东语（福州话）。
explanation_english: Fuzhou is the capital of Fujian Province in southeastern China, located around the lower Min River. It is the political, economic, and cultural center of the Mindong region; the local dialect is Mindong (Fuzhou) Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去福州出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 heoi3 fuk1 zau1 ceot1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜要去福州出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Fuzhou on a business trip next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 福州有好多好食嘅海鮮，值得試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 zau1 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 sik6 ge3 hoi2 sin1, zik1 dak1 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 福州有很多好吃的海鲜，值得一试。
examples.english_sentence: Fuzhou has a lot of delicious seafood worth trying.

mandarin_meaning: 福建（中國的一個省份）
english_meaning: Fujian (a province in southeastern China)
explanation_mandarin: 位於中國東南部的省份，省會是福州。地形多山，海岸線長，閩語種類多且有豐富的華僑文化。
explanation_english: A province in southeastern China with its capital at Fuzhou. It is mountainous with a long coastline, has diverse Min (闽) dialects, and a significant overseas Chinese community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽係福建人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hai6 fuk1 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈是福建人。
examples.english_sentence: My mother is from Fujian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去福建旅行，想試吓當地小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 fuk1 gin3 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 si3 haa5 dong1 dei6 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去福建旅行，想试试当地小吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Fujian next month and want to try the local snacks.

mandarin_meaning: 福氣與德行；（民間）福德正神（即土地公）
english_meaning: good fortune and virtue; (in folk religion) the Earth Deity (Fuk Tak / Tudigong)
explanation_mandarin: 「福德」可指個人所擁有的福氣與品德，也常作「福德正神」的簡稱，指民間信仰中的土地神（俗稱土地公），是掌管一方土地與地方平安的神祇。
explanation_english: “Fuk Dak” can mean a person's good fortune and moral virtue, and is also commonly short for “Fuk Dak Zheng Shen” (the Earth Deity/Tudigong) in folk religion, a local god who oversees land and community well‑being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企對面有座福德廟，附近嘅人都會去拜福德正神求平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 deoi3 min6 jau5 zo6 fuk1 dak1 miu6, fu6 gan6 ge3 jan4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 baai3 fuk1 dak1 zeng3 san4 kau4 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家門口對面有一座福德廟，附近的人都會去拜福德正神求平安。
examples.english_sentence: There's a Fuk Tak temple opposite my house; people nearby go to worship the Earth Deity (Fuk Tak) to pray for safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生積福德，村裏人都好敬重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 saang1 zik1 fuk1 dak1, cyun1 leoi5 jan4 dou1 hou2 ging3 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生積福德，村裏的人都很尊敬他。
examples.english_sentence: He accumulated blessings and virtue throughout his life; the people in the village all respect him.

mandarin_meaning: 善心；慈悲心；願意行善的心
english_meaning: a benevolent/compassionate heart; willingness to do good
explanation_mandarin: 指一種慈悲、善良、願意幫助別人的內心或心態，常用來形容樂於行善或有同情心的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a compassionate, kind-hearted disposition willing to help others; used to describe someone who is benevolent or charitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好有福心，見到流浪貓都會餵佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 fuk1 sam1, gin3 dou3 lau4 long4 maau1 dou1 wui5 wai6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很有福心，看到流浪猫都会喂它们。
examples.english_sentence: He really has a benevolent heart; when he sees stray cats he feeds them.

mandarin_meaning: 福星（fúxīng），指帶來好運或吉祥的人或事物，也可指保佑吉祥的星宿。
english_meaning: lucky star; a person or thing that brings good luck; auspicious/star of good fortune
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容能帶來好運、幸運或吉祥的人或事物。有時也指神話或民間信仰中的吉星。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that brings good luck or fortune. It can also refer to an auspicious star in folklore or belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係我哋嘅福星，自從佢嚟之後，生意好咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 fuk1 sing1, zi6 cung4 keoi5 lai4 zi1 hau6, sang1 ji3 hou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是我们的福星，自从他来之后生意好起来了。
examples.english_sentence: He's really our lucky star — business has improved since he arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次抽獎我贏咗，真係有福星照到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 cau1 zoeng2 ngo5 jing4 zo2, zan1 hai6 jau5 fuk1 sing1 ziu3 dou3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次抽奖我中奖了，真是福星照到了我。
examples.english_sentence: I won the raffle this time — I must have had a lucky star watching over me.

mandarin_meaning: 有吉星照耀；帶來好運（等同於「福星高照」）
english_meaning: to be blessed with good luck; the lucky star shines upon (someone); auspicious fortune
explanation_mandarin: 表示有吉星照耀，帶來好運，常用作祝福或形容運氣很好。
explanation_english: Indicates that a lucky star is shining upon someone, bringing good fortune; used as a blessing or to describe someone having particularly good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我竟然攞到第一名，真係福星拱照！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 ging2 jin4 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 fuk1 sing1 gung2 ziu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我竟然拿到第一名，真是福星拱照！
examples.english_sentence: I unexpectedly got first place in this exam — it's like the lucky star is shining on me!

mandarin_meaning: 吉星高照；幸運降臨，受到吉祥庇佑
english_meaning: Blessed with good luck; an auspicious star shining upon someone; luck is on one's side
explanation_mandarin: 表示有人受到幸運或吉祥的庇佑，常用作祝福語或形容運氣很好。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is blessed with good luck or auspiciousness; commonly used as a blessing or to describe someone who is very fortunate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年到，祝你福星高照，萬事如意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 dou3, zuk1 nei5 fuk1 sing1 gou1 ziu3, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年到了，祝你吉星高照，万事如意。
examples.english_sentence: With the new year here, I wish you good luck and may everything go as you wish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考得咁好，你真係福星高照！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam2 hou2, nei5 zan1 hai6 fuk1 sing1 gou1 ziu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考得这么好，你真是吉星高照！
examples.english_sentence: You did so well on the exam — you're really blessed with good luck!

mandarin_meaning: 福有攸归（古語/成語），意指福分或幸福會歸屬到應當得到的人或地方，常用以表示福氣終會到來。
english_meaning: A classical idiom meaning that good fortune will find its proper place or come to those who deserve it; blessings will eventually arrive.
explanation_mandarin: 出自文言，表示福分有其歸屬，常用來安慰或期望事態會向好的方向發展。
explanation_english: A classical expression indicating that blessings have their destined recipient; often used to comfort someone or to express hope that things will turn out well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好灰心，福有攸歸，總有好嘅日子嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, fuk1 jau5 jau1 gwai1, zung2 jau5 hou2 ge3 jat6 zi2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要灰心，福有攸归，总会有好日子到来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lose heart; good fortune will find its way — better days will come.

mandarin_meaning: 福气（fúqì）：幸福、福分、運氣好或受到恩澤
english_meaning: good fortune; blessings; being fortunate or having luck
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人所擁有的幸福、福分或好運，常用以形容生活中受到的恩澤或幸運際遇。
explanation_english: Refers to the blessings, good fortune, or luck someone has; often used to describe fortunate circumstances or the blessings one receives in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係有福氣，阿媽成日請你食好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 fuk1 hei3, aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 cing2 nei5 sik6 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真有福气，妈妈经常请你吃好东西。
examples.english_sentence: You're really fortunate — your mom often treats you to good food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 能夠有一家人健康平安，已經係一種福氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nang4 gau3 jau5 jat1 gaa1 jan4 gin6 hong1 pang4 on1, ji5 ging1 hai6 jat1 zung2 fuk1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能够有一家人健康平安，已经是一种福气。
examples.english_sentence: Having a family that's healthy and safe is already a kind of blessing.

jyutping: fuk1 mou4 cung4 zi3, wo6 bat1 daan1 haang4
mandarin_meaning: 福无重至，祸不单行（好事不會連續發生，壞事卻往往接二連三）。
english_meaning: Good fortune does not come twice; misfortunes do not come alone. (Good luck is rare, but bad luck often comes in succession.)
explanation_mandarin: 一句諺語，表示好運不會接二連三地來，但不幸或災禍往往會接連發生。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning good luck rarely repeats itself, whereas misfortunes tend to come one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今日炒咗我，屋企又突然漏水，真係福無重至，禍不單行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 caau2 zo2 ngo5, uk1 kei5 jau6 dat6 jin4 lau6 seoi2, zan1 hai6 fuk1 mou4 cung4 zi3, wo6 bat1 daan1 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天炒了我，家裡又突然漏水，真是福无重至，祸不单行。
examples.english_sentence: My boss fired me today and then my house suddenly started leaking — truly misfortunes never come alone.

jyutping: fuk1 mou4 soeng1 zi3, wo6 bat1 daan1 hang4
mandarin_meaning: 福无双至，祸不单行（好运不会成双地到来，灾祸却常常接二连三发生）
english_meaning: Good fortune does not come in pairs; misfortunes rarely come alone.
explanation_mandarin: 一句俗语，意思是好事不常成双出现，而不幸或灾祸往往会接连发生，用来形容倒霉事接二连三地来。
explanation_english: A proverb expressing that good luck rarely arrives in multiples while misfortunes often come in succession; used to describe a run of bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲好事未到，就已經有唔少衰事接踵而至，真係福無雙至，禍不單行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hou2 si6 mei6 dou3, zau6 ji5 ging1 jau5 m4 siu2 seoi1 si6 zip3 zung2 ji4 zi3, zan1 hai6 fuk1 mou4 soeng1 zi3, wo6 bat1 daan1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好事還沒到，倒是有不少倒楣的事接二連三發生，真是福无双至，祸不单行。
examples.english_sentence: Good things haven't come yet, but quite a few unlucky events have happened one after another — truly, good fortune doesn't come in pairs, misfortunes don't come alone.

mandarin_meaning: 福爾摩沙（Fú'ěrmóshā），台灣的舊稱
english_meaning: Formosa (the former name of Taiwan)
explanation_mandarin: 「福爾摩沙」為台灣的舊稱，源自17世紀葡萄牙語 Ilha Formosa，意為「美麗的島」。現多用於歷史或文學語境，或作為古稱、詩意稱呼。
explanation_english: “Formosa” is the historical name for Taiwan, originating from the 17th-century Portuguese Ilha Formosa meaning “beautiful island.” It is commonly used in historical, literary, or poetic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 福爾摩沙係台灣以前嘅名稱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 ji5 mo1 saa1 hai6 toi4 waan1 ji5 cin4 ge3 ming4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 福爾摩沙是台灣以前的名稱。
examples.english_sentence: Formosa is the former name of Taiwan.

mandarin_meaning: 福尔摩沙（臺灣的舊稱）
english_meaning: Formosa (historical name for Taiwan)
explanation_mandarin: 「福爾摩莎」源自葡萄牙語 Ilha Formosa（意為「美麗的島」），是臺灣的舊稱，多用於歷史或文學語境中。
explanation_english: "Formosa" comes from the Portuguese Ilha Formosa (meaning "beautiful island") and is an old name for Taiwan, used mainly in historical or poetic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 台灣以前畀人叫做福爾摩莎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 waan1 ji5 cin4 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 fuk1 ji5 mo1 saa1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台湾以前被称为福尔摩沙。
examples.english_sentence: Taiwan was formerly called Formosa.

mandarin_meaning: 福祉（fú zhǐ）——幸福、福利與安康，常用於指個人或群體的利益與生活品質。
english_meaning: Welfare; well-being; the benefits, blessings or quality of life enjoyed by an individual or group.
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或群體所享有的幸福、利益與安康，常用於討論社會福利、生活品質或政策對人民生活的影響。
explanation_english: Refers to the happiness, benefits, and well-being enjoyed by an individual or group; commonly used when discussing social welfare, quality of life, or how policies affect people's lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該保障市民嘅福祉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 bou2 zoeng3 si5 man4 ge3 fuk1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該保障市民的福祉。
examples.english_sentence: The government should safeguard the welfare of its citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司推出咗多項政策，重視員工嘅福祉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 do1 hong6 zing3 caak3, zung6 si6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 fuk1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司推出了多項政策，重視員工的福祉。
examples.english_sentence: The company rolled out several policies that prioritize employee welfare.

mandarin_meaning: 福禄寿（中國傳統的三位神祇，分別代表福氣、祿（官祿/富貴）和壽），用作祝福語
english_meaning: Fu, Lu, and Shou — the three deities symbolizing good fortune (Fu), prosperity/status (Lu), and longevity (Shou); used as a blessing meaning 'good fortune, prosperity, and long life.'
explanation_mandarin: 指中國民間信仰中的三位神祇：福（賜福）、祿（代表官祿與富貴）、壽（象徵長壽）。合稱常用來祝願他人有福氣、財祿與長壽，亦常見於雕像、繪畫或節慶裝飾中。
explanation_english: Refers to the three traditional Chinese deities Fu, Lu, and Shou, representing good fortune, prosperity/status, and longevity respectively. The term is commonly used to wish someone blessings, wealth/prosperity, and a long life, and appears frequently in statues, paintings, and festive decorations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企擺咗福祿壽嘅神像，保佑全家平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 baai2 zo2 fuk1 luk6 sau6 ge3 san4 zoeng6, bou2 jau6 cyun4 gaa1 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里摆了福禄寿的神像，保佑全家平安。
examples.english_sentence: They placed statues of Fu, Lu, and Shou at home to bless the family with good fortune, prosperity, and longevity.

mandarin_meaning: 福禄双全（既有福气又有俸禄、享有福分與財祿）
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to enjoy both blessings/good fortune and material prosperity (wealth or official emolument); to be fully blessed and prosperous.
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人既有福氣，又有祿（俸祿、財富或地位），生活圓滿富足。常用於祝福語中。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who has both good fortune and material prosperity or official rewards; often used as a blessing or New Year wish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年到，祝你福祿雙全，事事如意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 dou3, zuk1 nei5 fuk1 luk6 soeng1 cyun4, si6 si6 jyu4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年到了，祝你福禄双全，事事如意。
examples.english_sentence: It's the New Year — I wish you both good fortune and prosperity; may everything go well.

mandarin_meaning: 福至心靈 / 靈機一動，突然有好主意或靈感（多帶有幸運或僥倖的意味）
english_meaning: a sudden flash of inspiration; to be struck by a lucky idea or intuition
explanation_mandarin: 形容在恰當或幸運的時刻突然獲得靈感或想出好主意，常帶有僥倖成分。
explanation_english: Describes suddenly getting an inspiration or a clever idea at an opportune or lucky moment; often implies a fortunate or serendipitous flash of insight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰日面試我好緊張，點知一入到房間就福至心靈，答到啲問題好流暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 jat6 min6 si3 ngo5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, dim2 zi1 jat1 jap6 dou3 fong4 gaan1 zau6 fuk1 zi3 sam1 ling4, daap3 dou3 di1 man6 tai4 hou2 lau4 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那天面試我很緊張，沒想到一進房間就靈機一動，把問題都回答得很流暢。
examples.english_sentence: I was really nervous at the interview that day, but as soon as I entered the room I had a sudden inspiration and answered the questions smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 福荫；祖先或神明、權勢者所帶來的庇佑或保佑
english_meaning: blessing; protection or patronage (often from ancestors, deities, or influential persons)
explanation_mandarin: 指因祖先、神明或有權勢者的庇佑而得到的福分或保護；也可引申為依靠這種保護所享有的優待或利益。
explanation_english: Refers to blessings or protective favor received from ancestors, deities, or influential people; can also mean the benefits or preferential treatment gained from such protection or patronage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經常話係祖先嘅福蔭，先有今日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 soeng4 waa6 hai6 zou2 sin1 ge3 fuk1 jam3, sin1 jau5 gam1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常说是祖先的福荫，才有今天。
examples.english_sentence: He often says it's his ancestors' blessing that brought him to where he is today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望多啲福蔭保佑大家平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 do1 di1 fuk1 jam3 bou2 jau6 daai6 gaa1 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望多一些福荫保佑大家平安。
examples.english_sentence: Hope more blessings protect everyone and keep them safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仗住家族嘅福蔭，做事冇咁顧忌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng6 zyu6 gaa1 zuk6 ge3 fuk1 jam3, zou6 si6 mou5 gam2 gu3 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仗着家族的福荫，做事没有那么顾忌。
examples.english_sentence: He leans on his family's influence, so he acts without much restraint.

mandarin_meaning: 福袋 / 抽獎式或驚喜包（通常在新年或商店出售，內含未知物品）
english_meaning: lucky bag; mystery bag; grab bag (a sealed bag sold with unknown contents, often for luck or as a surprise)
explanation_mandarin: 指通常在農曆新年或商店促銷時出售的袋子，裡面裝有未知或隨機的物品，帶有祝福或驚喜的意味。
explanation_english: A bag sold (commonly during Lunar New Year or as a promotional item) containing unknown or random items; meant to bring luck or provide a surprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年我買咗個福袋，希望入面有啲好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 fuk1 doi2, hei1 mong6 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年我买了一个福袋，希望里面有一些好东西。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a lucky bag for the Lunar New Year, hoping there are some good items inside.

mandarin_meaning: 福音（原指基督教的『福音』，即好消息；引申为帶來好處或利好的消息）
english_meaning: gospel; good news — originally the Christian gospel, by extension any welcome news
explanation_mandarin: 「福音」在宗教語境中指基督教的好消息（gospel），在日常用法中也用來表示令人欣喜或帶來好處的消息。
explanation_english: In a religious context, '福音' refers to the Christian gospel. In everyday use it also means welcome news or something that brings a benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對基督徒嚟講，聖經就係福音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 gei1 duk1 tou4 lai4 gong2, sing3 ging1 zau6 hai6 fuk1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对基督徒来说，圣经就是福音。
examples.english_sentence: For Christians, the Bible is the gospel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等咗咁耐，呢個消息真係福音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 gam3 noi6, ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zan1 hai6 fuk1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等了这么久，这个消息真是福音。
examples.english_sentence: After waiting so long, this news is really good news.

mandarin_meaning: 福音派 (fúyīn pài)
english_meaning: Evangelical (Christian) — the evangelical movement or denominations emphasizing the gospel, personal conversion, and evangelism
explanation_mandarin: 指基督教內強調「福音」信息、個人重生（悔改與信主）、聖經權威及傳福音事工的一類教派或運動。
explanation_english: Refers to branches or movements within Christianity that emphasize the gospel message, personal conversion (being born again), the authority of the Bible, and evangelism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間教會屬於福音派，平時好注重個人信仰同傳福音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gaau3 wui2 suk6 jyu1 fuk1 jam1 paai3, ping4 si4 hou2 zyu3 zung6 go3 jan4 seon3 joeng5 tung4 cyun4 fuk1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间教会属于福音派，平时很注重个人信仰和传福音。
examples.english_sentence: That church is evangelical; it usually emphasizes personal faith and evangelism.

mandarin_meaning: 幸運兒；有福氣的人／走運
english_meaning: a lucky person; fortunate; having good luck
explanation_mandarin: 「福頭」是廣東話口語，指常常走運或有好事發生的人，也可說某人遇上幸運的情況。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial usage, "福頭" refers to a lucky person or someone who often experiences good fortune; it can also describe being fortunate in a particular situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個福頭，成日都有好事發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 fuk1 tau4, seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 hou2 si6 faat3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個幸運兒，總是有好事發生。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a lucky person; good things always happen to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今次考試及格，真係有福頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 kap6 gaak3, zan1 hai6 jau5 fuk1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這次考試及格，真是走運／有福氣。
examples.english_sentence: You passed the exam this time — you're really lucky.

mandarin_meaning: 享受別人提供的好處（尤指吃喝或生活上的照顧），有時含依賴或吃別人便宜的貶義
english_meaning: to enjoy benefits or perks provided by others (especially free food or being taken care of); can imply dependence or freeloading
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指因他人或家庭背景而獲得物質或飲食上的好處，常帶有依賴或占便宜的語氣。在香港口語中屬非正式用法或俗語。
explanation_english: A colloquial term meaning to receive or enjoy material benefits or free meals provided by others (often due to family connections or generosity). It is informal and can carry a negative sense of dependence or freeloading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺屋企福食，唔想搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 fuk1 sik6, m4 soeng2 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是待在家裡靠別人供養，不想找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He always stays at home freeloading off others and doesn't want to find a job.

mandarin_meaning: 享福；吃福分（指靠別人的恩惠或享受優渥生活）
english_meaning: to enjoy blessings; to live off others' generosity or enjoy an easy/comfortable life
explanation_mandarin: 「福飯」常見於粵語口語，意指靠別人的恩惠或福氣過舒適日子，也可說某人「食福飯」表示不勞而獲或享受被供養的生活。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to describe enjoying good fortune or living off others' generosity—often implying an easy life or receiving benefits without working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔做嘢，淨係嚟食福飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5, zing6 hai6 lai4 sik6 fuk1 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天不工作，只來吃福飯。
examples.english_sentence: He never works, just lives off others' generosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嫁入豪門之後，佢開始可以食福飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 jap6 hou4 mun4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 hoi1 ci2 ho2 ji5 sik6 fuk1 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫁入豪門之後，她開始可以享福。
examples.english_sentence: After marrying into a wealthy family, she could start enjoying a comfortable life.

mandarin_meaning: 剥夺、剥夺爵位或权利（古文用字）
english_meaning: to strip (someone of rank, title, rights); to deprive (archaic/literary)
explanation_mandarin: “禠”為古漢語詞，多用於文言，表示剥夺、夺去（常指爵位、权利等）。在現代漢語中較少見，通常以“剥夺”代之。
explanation_english: “禠” is an archaic/literary verb meaning to strip or deprive (often of a title, rank, or rights). It appears mainly in classical Chinese and is rare in modern usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 皇帝禠咗佢嘅爵位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 dai3 ci3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 zoek3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 皇帝剥夺了他的爵位。
examples.english_sentence: The emperor stripped him of his noble title.

mandarin_meaning: 祭祀；祭奠（古字）
english_meaning: to perform a sacrificial rite; to offer ritual sacrifices (archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 禡為一個較生僻的古字，常見於古文或史書，用來指祭祀、祭奠先人或祈求祀典的儀式。
explanation_english: A rare, archaic character found in classical texts and historical records; it denotes performing sacrificial rites or offering ritual sacrifices, often for ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「禡」呢個字多見喺古文，用嚟指祭祀先人嘅儀式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa6 ni1 go3 zi6 do1 gin3 hai2 gu2 man4, jung6 lai4 zi2 zai3 si3 sin1 jan4 ge3 ji4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “禡”这个字多见于古文，用来指祭祀先人的仪式。
examples.english_sentence: The character '禡' is often seen in classical texts and is used to refer to ritual ceremonies for honoring ancestors.

mandarin_meaning: 罕见/古词：在现代普通话或粤语中无固定常用含义。字面上可拆作「禡」（古代祭祀用的谷物或相关字义）＋「牙」（牙齒、尖端等），但合用为「禡牙」通常为罕见用法，可能出现在人名、地名或文献误写中。
english_meaning: Obscure / archaic term: not a standard modern Cantonese word. Literally the characters are 禡 (an old character related to sacrificial grain) + 牙 (tooth or fang), but as a compound it has no fixed modern meaning and is rarely seen — it may occur only in proper names, classical texts, or as a typographical/orthographic variant.
explanation_mandarin: 「禡牙」在現代粤語和普通話語境中極為罕見，詞典中通常找不到明確詞條。若遇到，需視具體語境判斷，常見情況為古書用字、地名或打字、轉寫的誤用或變體。
explanation_english: The term is extremely rare in modern Cantonese and Mandarin and is not listed with a standard definition in common dictionaries. When encountered, its meaning depends on context; typical occurrences are in classical texts, as part of a proper name, or as a spelling/typographical variant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「禡牙」呢個詞好罕見，通常喺古文、地名或者打字錯誤先見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa6 ngaa4 ni1 go3 ci4 hou2 hon2 gin3, tung1 soeng4 hai2 gu2 man4, dei6 fong1 ming4 waak6 ze2 daa2 zi6 co3 ng6 sin1 gin3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “禡牙”这个词很罕见，通常只出现在古文、地名或打字错误中。
examples.english_sentence: '禡牙' is a very rare word; it usually only appears in classical texts, place names, or as a typographical error.

mandarin_meaning: 姓氏（禤，xuān）
english_meaning: Surname Xuan (used as a Cantonese family name, pronounced Huen/Hyun)
explanation_mandarin: 禤（xuān）是一個漢字，常用作姓氏。在粵語中為罕見姓氏，常見羅馬化為 Huen 或 Hyun。
explanation_english: 禤 is a Chinese character primarily used as a surname (Xuan). In Cantonese it is an uncommon family name, often romanized as Huen or Hyun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禤先生係我嘅鄰居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hyun1 sin1 saang1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 leon4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 禤先生是我的邻居。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Huen is my neighbor.

mandarin_meaning: 抵禦、防護；（古）駕御、掌控
english_meaning: to guard against; to repel or defend; (classical) to control or manage
explanation_mandarin: 「禦」常見於書面語或與其他字組成詞語（如「禦寒」「禦敵」），表示抵抗或防護。在古文中亦可表示駕御或掌控之意。
explanation_english: The character 禦 is commonly used in written compounds (e.g. 禦寒, 禦敵) meaning to resist or guard against. In classical usage it can also mean to control or drive (as in commanding or managing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣凍，記得著多啲衫禦寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 di1 saam1 jyu6 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气冷，记得多穿点衣服御寒。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold; remember to wear more clothes to keep out the cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城牆用嚴密嘅設施去禦敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 coeng4 jung6 jim4 mat6 ge3 cit3 si1 heoi3 jyu6 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城墙用严密的设施去御敌。
examples.english_sentence: The city walls use strict defenses to repel the enemy.

mandarin_meaning: 御寒（防止受寒、保暖）
english_meaning: to ward off the cold; to keep warm
explanation_mandarin: 指採取衣物或其他措施以防止受寒、保持溫暖。
explanation_english: To take measures (such as wearing warm clothes) to prevent getting cold and to stay warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣轉凍，記得禦寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 zyun2 dung3, gei3 dak1 jyu6 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气转冷，记得御寒。
examples.english_sentence: The weather's turning cold; remember to keep warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門要帶外套禦寒，尤其係夜晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 jiu3 daai3 ngoi6 tou3 jyu6 hon4, jau1 kei4 hai6 je6 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门要带外套御寒，尤其是在夜晚。
examples.english_sentence: When going out, bring a coat to keep warm, especially at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家身體虛弱，冬天要特別注意禦寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 san1 tai2 heoi1 joek6, dung1 tin1 jiu3 dak6 bit6 zyu3 ji3 jyu6 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人家身体虚弱，冬天要特别注意御寒。
examples.english_sentence: Elderly people have weaker health, so they should pay extra attention to keeping warm in winter.

mandarin_meaning: 喜庆、吉祥、幸福（常用于祝贺或纪念场合，如“禧年”）
english_meaning: happiness; auspiciousness; celebratory (often used in compounds like 'jubilee')
explanation_mandarin: “禧”字表示喜庆和吉祥，常见于书面语或祝贺用语与复合词中，如“金禧年”“禧庆”等，带有庆祝、纪念的含义。
explanation_english: The character 禧 denotes joy, auspiciousness, and celebratory sentiment. It is frequently used in formal or ceremonial compounds (e.g., 'jubilee') and in greetings or commemorative terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年係教會嘅金禧年，大家會有大型慶祝活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Gam1 nin4 hai6 gaau1 wui6 ge3 gam1 hei1 nin4, daai6 gaa1 wui5 jau5 daai6 jing4 hing3 zuk1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年是教会的金禧年，大家会有大型庆祝活动。
examples.english_sentence: This year is the church's golden jubilee; everyone will take part in large-scale celebratory events.

mandarin_meaning: 禪（chán）：佛教術語，指禪定或禪宗，強調靜坐、直指人心、見性成佛。
english_meaning: Zen; Chan (Buddhist meditation or the Chan/Zen school emphasizing meditation and insight).
explanation_mandarin: 禪是佛教中與禪定、禪宗相關的概念，常指透過打坐、參禪等實修以求覺悟或心靈平靜。
explanation_english: Refers to the Buddhist concept of meditation (dhyana) and the Chan/Zen tradition, emphasizing seated meditation and direct insight into one’s true nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意睇關於禪嘅書，同埋每日打坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 tai2 gwaan1 jyu1 sim4 ge3 syu1, tung4 maai4 mui5 jat6 daa2 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡看關於禪的書，並且每天打坐。
examples.english_sentence: He likes reading books about Zen and meditates every day.

mandarin_meaning: 禅宗（chánzōng）：中国佛教的一个宗派，重视禅修、直指人心与见性成佛。
english_meaning: Chan (Zen) school of Buddhism — a Chinese Buddhist tradition emphasizing meditation (zen/chan), direct insight into one's true nature, and transmission from master to disciple.
explanation_mandarin: 禅宗是中國佛教的一個重要宗派，起源於印度禪那教義並在中國發展成獨特流派，強調直指人心、見性成佛、以坐禪和公案參究為主要修行方法，並重視師徒相承。
explanation_english: A major school of Chinese Buddhism (known in Japan as Zen) that stresses meditation practice (zazen/zuochan), direct pointing to the mind and seeing one's true nature, often teaching through koans and direct master-disciple transmission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢修習禪宗已有十幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 zaap6 sim4 zung1 ji5 jau5 sap6 gei2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他修習禪宗已有十幾年。
examples.english_sentence: He has practiced Chan (Zen) Buddhism for over ten years.

mandarin_meaning: 禪定（禪那、三摩地）——佛教術語，指透過禪修達到的專注、寂靜與定境
english_meaning: Samadhi / meditative absorption — a Buddhist state of deep concentration and calm achieved through meditation
explanation_mandarin: 禪定是佛教術語，亦稱禪那或三摩地，指修行者通過禪修使心念收攝、專注而達到的寂靜與深入的定境。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term (also called dhyana or samadhi) referring to a deep state of concentrated, tranquil awareness achieved through meditation practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗禪定，完全冇理會外面嘅嘈吵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 sim3 ding6, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 lei5 wui6 ngoi6 min6 ge3 cou4 caau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他進入了禪定，完全不在意外面的喧囂。
examples.english_sentence: He entered samadhi and completely ignored the noise outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學禪定，紓緩日常壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 sim3 ding6, syu1 wun5 jat6 seong4 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想學習禪定，紓緩日常壓力。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn samadhi meditation to relieve everyday stress.

mandarin_meaning: 禅师（禅宗的僧人或修行指导者）
english_meaning: Chan (Zen) master; a Buddhist meditation/master teacher
explanation_mandarin: 禪師通常指禪宗的僧人或修行者，專門指導禪修、打坐以及講解佛法或修行方法。
explanation_english: A Chan (Zen) master — usually a Buddhist monk or practitioner who guides meditation (zazen/zhàn) and teaches Buddhist doctrine and practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋寺廟請咗一位禪師嚟教打坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi6 miu6 ceng2 zo2 jat1 wai2 sin1 si1 lai4 gaau3 daa2 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们寺庙请来了一位禅师来教打坐。
examples.english_sentence: Our temple invited a Chan master to teach meditation.

mandarin_meaning: 禪機（chánjī）
english_meaning: Zen koan; a cryptic hint or riddle used in Chan/Zen to provoke insight; a mysterious or profound hint
explanation_mandarin: 禪機指禪宗用以啟發頓悟的語句、疑問或機鋒（即公案、提示）；也可泛指含有深意、啟發性或玄妙的隱晦言語或寓意。
explanation_english: Refers to a koan or riddle used in Chan/Zen Buddhism to provoke sudden enlightenment; also loosely used for a cryptic, profound hint or remark that leads to insight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰段話有啲禪機，聽落好深奧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 dyun6 waa6 jau5 di1 cin4 gei1, teng1 lok6 hou2 sam1 ou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的那段話有些禪機，聽起來很深奧。
examples.english_sentence: What he said contains some Zen hints; it sounds very profound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禪師出咗一個禪機，考驗徒弟點答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sin4 si1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 cin4 gei1, haau2 jim6 tou4 dai6 dim2 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 禅师出了一个禅机，考验徒弟怎麼回答。
examples.english_sentence: The Zen master posed a koan to test how the disciple would answer.

mandarin_meaning: 禅让：把君位或權力傳讓給他人，尤指古代賢君自願讓位的做法
english_meaning: Abdication; the voluntary transfer of power or the throne to another (often a worthy successor)
explanation_mandarin: 指統治者（多指古代君主）自願把王位或權力讓給他人，通常強調禮讓賢能、傳位給有德之人。
explanation_english: Refers to a ruler (especially in ancient contexts) voluntarily ceding the throne or authority to another, often emphasizing passing power to a worthy or capable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位君主最後選擇禪讓，將皇位傳畀賢能嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 gwan1 zyu2 zeoi3 hau6 syun2 zaak6 sim4 joeng6, zoeng1 wong4 wai6 cyun4 bei2 jin4 nang4 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位君主最後選擇禪讓，將皇位傳給賢能的人。
examples.english_sentence: The ruler eventually chose to abdicate, passing the throne to a capable person.

mandarin_meaning: 禅院；禅宗或佛教寺院、修行場所
english_meaning: Zen monastery; Buddhist monastery; meditation hall
explanation_mandarin: 指供僧侶修行、禪修或打坐的寺院或場所，常與禪宗相關。
explanation_english: A Buddhist monastery or meditation hall where monks or practitioners engage in Zen practice or meditation; often associated with Chan/Zen Buddhism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去禪院打坐，想學習靜心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 cim4 jyun6 daa2 co5, soeng2 hok6 zaap6 zing6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期日去禪院打坐，想學習靜心。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the Zen monastery on Sunday to meditate; we want to learn how to calm our minds.

mandarin_meaning: 礼，礼仪、礼节、礼物等
english_meaning: rite; ceremony; etiquette; gift
explanation_mandarin: 指與儀式、禮節或禮物有關的概念，表示尊重、禮貌或慶典中的行為與形式。
explanation_english: Refers to rites, ceremonies, etiquette or gifts — denotes ceremonious or polite behavior and the forms or items associated with such occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個婚禮好隆重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fan1 lai5 hou2 lung4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个婚礼很隆重。
examples.english_sentence: This wedding ceremony is very grand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街要有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门要有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: Be polite when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗份禮物俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一份礼物给他。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a gift for him.

mandarin_meaning: 礼仪
english_meaning: etiquette; protocol; ceremonial rites; manners
explanation_mandarin: 指社交或正式場合中規範行為與舉止的制度或習俗，包括禮節、儀式和應有的禮貌。
explanation_english: Refers to the rules and conventions that govern behavior and conduct in social or formal situations, including manners, ceremonies, and proper protocol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參加婚禮要注意基本禮儀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 gaa1 fan1 lai5 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 gei1 bun2 lai5 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参加婚礼要注意基本礼仪。
examples.english_sentence: When attending a wedding, you should pay attention to basic etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會為員工提供禮儀培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 wai6 jyun4 gung1 tai4 gung1 lai5 ji4 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會為員工提供禮儀培訓。
examples.english_sentence: The company will provide etiquette training for employees.

mandarin_meaning: 礼仪师（殡葬行业或仪式活动中负责安排与主持礼仪的专业人员）
english_meaning: funeral director / ceremonial master (a professional who arranges and conducts funerals or formal ceremonies)
explanation_mandarin: 负责安排并主持葬礼或其他正式仪式的专业人员，常见于殡葬行业，也可泛指负责礼仪事务的人员。
explanation_english: A professional responsible for organizing and conducting funerals or other formal ceremonies; commonly used in the funeral industry and can also refer more generally to someone in charge of ceremonial etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做禮儀師，要幫家屬安排喪禮同處理各種禮節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 lai5 ji4 si1, jiu3 bong1 gaa1 suk6 ngon1 paai4 song1 lai5 tung4 cyu2 lei5 gok3 zung2 lai5 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是礼仪师，要帮助家属安排丧礼并处理各种礼节。
examples.english_sentence: He is a funeral director; he helps families arrange funerals and handles various ceremonial matters.

mandarin_meaning: 礼券
english_meaning: gift voucher; gift certificate
explanation_mandarin: 指可用來兌換商品或服務的票券，常由百貨公司、商場或商店發行，常用作贈禮或促銷用途。
explanation_english: A voucher or certificate used to redeem goods or services, commonly issued by department stores, malls, or shops, often used as gifts or promotional items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到一張百貨公司嘅禮券，可以喺商場買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 jat1 zoeng1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 ge3 lai5 hyun3, ho2 ji5 hai2 soeng1 coeng4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了一张百货公司的礼券，可以在商场买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I received a department store gift voucher and can use it to buy things at the mall.

mandarin_meaning: 平均分配禮物；公平對待（或禮尚往來）
english_meaning: to distribute gifts/favors evenly; to treat people fairly or reciprocate appropriately
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，由「禮」（禮物/禮節）與「勻」（平均）組成，通常指把禮物或酬謝平均分配，或強調對人要公平、禮尚往來。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression combining 禮 (gifts/courtesy) and 勻 (even). It commonly means to share gifts or favors evenly, to treat people fairly, or to reciprocate appropriately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有啲禮物，大家要禮勻分配。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 di1 lai5 mat6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 lai5 wan4 fan1 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有些礼物，大家要平均分配。
examples.english_sentence: We have some gifts; everyone should distribute them evenly.

mandarin_meaning: 把禮物或利是平均分配
english_meaning: to distribute gifts or red packets evenly
explanation_mandarin: 「禮匀」是非正式的口語或網絡用語，字面由「禮」（禮物、利是）和「匀/勻」（平均、分配）組成，常用於表示把禮物或利是等平均分給多人。此詞較新穎或地方性，並非標準書面語。
explanation_english: “禮匀” is an informal/neologistic Cantonese term formed from 禮 (gifts/red packets) + 匀/勻 (evenly distribute). It means to split or distribute gifts/red envelopes evenly among people. It is colloquial and not standard written usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年啲利是我哋要禮匀畀屋企人，唔好一個人收晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 di1 lei6 si6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lai5 wan4 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4, m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 sau1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過年時紅包要平均分給家人，不要一個人全部收走。
examples.english_sentence: At Lunar New Year, red envelopes should be split evenly among family; don't keep them all for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 礼品 (lǐpǐn)
english_meaning: gift; present; promotional item
explanation_mandarin: 指作為禮節、慶祝或宣傳用途贈送的物品，常見於節日、活動或商業促銷中。
explanation_english: Refers to items given as gifts for etiquette, celebration, or promotional purposes; commonly used during festivals, events, or commercial promotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司派咗新年禮品畀員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 paai3 zo2 san1 nin4 lai5 ban2 bei2 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司发了新年礼品给员工。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave New Year gifts to the employees.

mandarin_meaning: 礼堂 (lǐtáng)：用于举行典礼、集会或演出的室内大厅
english_meaning: auditorium; assembly hall
explanation_mandarin: 指学校、社区或其他场所用来举行典礼、集会、演出或大型活动的室内大厅，通常能容纳较多人。
explanation_english: A large indoor hall in a school, community center, or other venue used for ceremonies, assemblies, performances, or large events; typically seats many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校喺禮堂舉行開學典禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 hai2 lei5 tong4 geoi2 hang4 hoi1 hok6 din2 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校在礼堂举行开学典礼。
examples.english_sentence: The school is holding the opening ceremony in the auditorium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚喺社區中心嘅禮堂有個音樂會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 se5 keoi1 zung1 sam1 ge3 lei5 tong4 jau5 go3 jam1 ngok6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚在社区中心的礼堂有个音乐会。
examples.english_sentence: We have a concert tonight in the community centre's auditorium.

mandarin_meaning: 礼崩乐坏（礼制和乐教崩溃，社会秩序解体）
english_meaning: The collapse of rites and music — a metaphor for the breakdown of social and moral order; societal chaos
explanation_mandarin: 出自古代典籍，原指禮制失序、音樂崩壞，後用以比喻社會道德、制度瓦解，出現混亂局面。
explanation_english: A classical idiom originally describing the ruin of rites and music; now used figuratively to indicate the collapse of social and moral order and ensuing chaos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果政府腐敗，禮壞樂崩，社會好快就會陷入混亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 fu2 baai6, lai5 waai6 lok6 baang1, se5 wui6 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 haam6 jap6 wan6 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府腐败，礼坏乐崩，社会很快就会陷入混乱。
examples.english_sentence: If the government is corrupt and institutions collapse, rites and music fall apart — society will soon descend into chaos.

mandarin_meaning: 礼尚往来 (lǐ shàng wǎng lái)：礼节上讲求互相回报，强调有来有往
english_meaning: Courtesy demands reciprocity; one should return favors or courtesy in kind
explanation_mandarin: 表示當別人對你施以禮遇或好意時，應以同等的禮節或回報回去，強調互相回應與禮尚往來的原則。
explanation_english: Expresses the principle that courtesy and favors should be reciprocated; when someone treats you kindly, you should respond in kind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁幫我，我梗係要禮尚往來，請佢食餐飯先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 bong1 ngo5, ngo5 gang2 hai6 jiu3 lai5 soeng6 wong5 loi4, ceng2 keoi5 sik6 caan1 faan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這麼幫我，我當然要禮尚往來，請他吃頓飯。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me like that; of course I should reciprocate and invite him to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司收到客戶嘅禮物，公司規定要禮尚往來，會回禮一份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sau1 dou3 haak3 wu6 ge3 lai5 mat6, gung1 si1 kwai1 ding6 jiu3 lai5 soeng6 wong5 loi4, wui5 wui4 lai5 jat1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司收到客户的礼物，公司規定要礼尚往来，會回礼一份。
examples.english_sentence: The company received a gift from a client; company policy requires reciprocation, so it will send a return gift.

mandarin_meaning: 禮崩樂壞（lǐ bēng yuè huài）：禮樂失序，比喻社會風俗、道德和政治秩序崩壞，天下大亂。
english_meaning: Literally "rites collapse and music is ruined"; an idiom meaning the collapse of social/moral order or the breakdown of political and cultural norms; social chaos.
explanation_mandarin: 出自古文，原指周代祭祀樂制崩壞，後用來形容社會、政治或道德秩序瓦解、亂象叢生。
explanation_english: A classical idiom originally describing the collapse of ritual and musical order; used metaphorically to describe social, moral, or political collapse and widespread disorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果再咁落去，社會會變到禮崩樂壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 gam2 lok6 heoi3, se5 wui6 bin3 dou3 lai5 baang1 ngok6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再這樣下去，社會會變得禮崩樂壞。
examples.english_sentence: If things continue like this, society will fall into chaos (lit. rites collapse and music ruined).

mandarin_meaning: 礼帽 (lǐmào)
english_meaning: top hat; formal hat
explanation_mandarin: 指在正式或礼仪场合戴的帽子，通常为高顶的礼帽，常与礼服或燕尾服搭配。
explanation_english: A hat worn for formal or ceremonial occasions, typically a tall or dress hat often paired with formal wear or a tailcoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出席婚禮嗰日戴住一頂黑色禮帽，好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 zik6 wan1 lai5 go2 jat6 daai3 zyu6 jat1 ding2 hak1 sik1 lai5 mou2, hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出席婚礼那天戴着一顶黑色礼帽，很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a black top hat when attending the wedding that day; he looked very stylish.

mandarin_meaning: 礼拜（口语，等于“星期”）；也可指宗教礼拜/礼拜仪式
english_meaning: week (colloquial); also a religious service/worship (in other contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语口语中，"禮拜"常用来表示一周或星期（如禮拜一、禮拜日）。在宗教语境中也可表示礼拜或崇拜仪式，但作‘星期’使用时为粤语常用说法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 禮拜 (lai5 baai3) is commonly used colloquially to mean 'week' (equivalent to 星期), as in 禮拜一. In religious contexts it can also mean a worship service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個禮拜我唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这周我没空。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free this week.

mandarin_meaning: 星期一
english_meaning: Monday
explanation_mandarin: 表示一星期中的一天，即星期一，常用於口語，指工作週的第一天或週一。
explanation_english: Refers to Monday, the day of the week (commonly the first workday). Frequently used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我禮拜一要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai5 baai3 jat1 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期一要上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work on Monday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜一會落雨，記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 jat1 wui5 lok6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期一會下雨，記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: It will rain on Monday; remember to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜一見啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 jat1 gin3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期一見！
examples.english_sentence: See you on Monday!

mandarin_meaning: 星期三
english_meaning: Wednesday
explanation_mandarin: 表示一星期中的第三天，在香港廣東話中常用「禮拜三」來說明星期三，等同於普通話的「星期三」。
explanation_english: Refers to the third day of the week. In Cantonese (especially in Hong Kong) people commonly say "禮拜三" to mean Wednesday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我禮拜三要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai5 baai3 saam1 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期三要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go see the doctor on Wednesday.

mandarin_meaning: 星期二 / 周二
english_meaning: Tuesday
explanation_mandarin: 表示每星期的第二天，也就是星期二。粵語口語裡經常用「禮拜」表示「星期」。
explanation_english: Denotes the second day of the week (Tuesday). In Cantonese colloquial speech, 禮拜 is commonly used to mean 'week' (equivalent to 星期).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我禮拜二要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai5 baai3 ji6 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期二要上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work on Tuesday.

mandarin_meaning: 星期五
english_meaning: Friday
explanation_mandarin: 表示一星期的第五天，即星期五。是廣東話中常用的說法，口語色彩較強。
explanation_english: Refers to the fifth day of the week (Friday). A common Cantonese expression for Friday, often used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋禮拜五去睇戲，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai5 baai3 ng5 heoi3 tai2 hei3, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期五去看電影，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to the movies on Friday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個禮拜五係公眾假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lai5 baai3 ng5 hai6 gung1 zung3 gaa3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個星期五是公眾假期。
examples.english_sentence: This Friday is a public holiday.

mandarin_meaning: 星期六
english_meaning: Saturday
explanation_mandarin: 表示一周中的第六天，即星期六，常用于指周末或休息日。
explanation_english: Refers to the sixth day of the week — Saturday — often used to indicate the weekend or a day off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋禮拜六去行街，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai5 baai3 luk6 heoi3 haang4 gaai1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期六去逛街，好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go shopping on Saturday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜六我有排球比賽，可能去唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 luk6 ngo5 jau5 paai4 kau4 bei2 coi3, ho2 nang4 heoi3 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期六我有排球比赛，可能去不了。
examples.english_sentence: I have a volleyball match on Saturday; I might not be able to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司禮拜六照常上班嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lai5 baai3 luk6 ziu3 soeng4 soeng5 baan1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司星期六照常上班吗？
examples.english_sentence: Does the company work as usual on Saturday?

mandarin_meaning: 星期四 / 周四
english_meaning: Thursday
explanation_mandarin: 表示一週的第四天，在香港粵語口語中常用，等同於普通話的「星期四」或「周四」。
explanation_english: Refers to the fourth day of the week. A common colloquial Cantonese term in Hong Kong, equivalent to Mandarin '星期四' (Thursday).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我禮拜四要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai5 baai3 sei3 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期四要上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work on Thursday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋禮拜四見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai5 baai3 sei3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期四見。
examples.english_sentence: See you on Thursday.

mandarin_meaning: 礼拜堂（教堂、礼拜所）
english_meaning: church; chapel; place of worship (for Christian services)
explanation_mandarin: 指基督教舉行禮拜、講道或聚會的場所，相當於教堂或禮拜所。
explanation_english: Refers to a place where Christian worship services, sermons, or gatherings are held; equivalent to a church or chapel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期日會去禮拜堂做禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat6 wui5 heoi3 lai5 baai3 tong4 zou6 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期日會去禮拜堂做禮拜。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to the church to attend the service on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜堂裏面有好多人去聽講道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 tong4 leoi5 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 teng1 gong2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 礼拜堂里面有很多人去听讲道。
examples.english_sentence: Many people go to the church to listen to the sermon.

mandarin_meaning: 星期天 / 星期日
english_meaning: Sunday
explanation_mandarin: 「禮拜天」是粵語口語中表示一週的第七天，即星期日。常在香港和廣東地區使用，等同於「星期天/禮拜日/周日」。
explanation_english: “禮拜天” is the Cantonese colloquial term for the seventh day of the week, i.e. Sunday. Commonly used in Hong Kong and Guangdong, equivalent to 星期天/禮拜日/周日.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我禮拜天想去行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai5 baai3 tin1 soeng2 heoi3 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期天想去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go shopping on Sunday.

mandarin_meaning: 週末（周末）
english_meaning: weekend (the end of the week, typically Saturday and Sunday)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，指一星期的尾聲，通常指週末（星期六與星期日）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning the end of the week — the weekend, typically Saturday and Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個禮拜尾我哋去海邊散步啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 mei5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 saan3 bou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個週末我們去海邊散步吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the beach for a walk this weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你禮拜尾有冇得閒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lai5 baai3 mei5 jau5 mou5 dak1 haan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你週末有沒有空？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free this weekend?

mandarin_meaning: （星期）星期几？
english_meaning: What day of the week?
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，用來詢問某天是星期幾或詢問哪一天（星期）適合、空閒等。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to ask which day of the week something is or which weekday someone is available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日禮拜幾？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lai5 baai3 gei2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天星期几？
examples.english_sentence: What day of the week is it today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你禮拜幾有空？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lai5 baai3 gei2 jau5 hung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你星期几有空？
examples.english_sentence: Which day are you free?

mandarin_meaning: 星期日 / 星期天
english_meaning: Sunday
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語常用詞，表示一週的第七天，即星期日（星期天）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning Sunday, the seventh day of the week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜日我會去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 jat6 ngo5 wui5 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期日我會去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go hiking on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你禮拜日有冇時間？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lai5 baai3 jat6 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你星期日有沒有時間？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have time on Sunday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜日唔好開會，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 jat6 m4 hou2 hoi1 wui6, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期日不要開會，好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Let's not hold the meeting on Sunday, okay?

mandarin_meaning: 禮節、禮貌；社交上的規矩與應有的禮遇（拼音：lǐshù）
english_meaning: etiquette; manners; social niceties or customary courtesies
explanation_mandarin: 指人際交往中應有的禮節和規矩。有時用於否定，如「沒禮數」表示失禮或不懂規矩。
explanation_english: Refers to the manners, etiquette, or customary courtesies expected in social interactions. Often appears in negative expressions (e.g. "no 禮數") to indicate rudeness or lack of proper manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對長輩好有禮數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 coeng4 bui3 hou2 jau5 lai5 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對長輩很有禮數。
examples.english_sentence: He is very courteous toward his elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講真係冇禮數喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 mou5 lai5 sou3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說真的沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that is really rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 返屋企做客要有啲禮數，唔好太隨便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan1 uk1 kei2 zou6 haak3 jiu3 jau5 di1 lai5 sou3, m4 hou2 taai3 ceoi4 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 回家作客要講究一些禮數，不要太隨便。
examples.english_sentence: When visiting someone's home, observe some manners; don't be too casual.

mandarin_meaning: 禮服 (lǐfú)
english_meaning: formal wear; ceremonial dress; evening/formal attire
explanation_mandarin: 指在正式場合穿著的服裝，如婚禮、宴會、典禮等場合所穿的正式衣服。
explanation_english: Clothing worn for formal occasions such as weddings, banquets, or ceremonies — formal or ceremonial attire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚要著禮服去參加婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1maan5 jiu3 zoek3 lai5 fuk6 heoi3 caam1gaa1 fan1lai5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚要穿禮服去參加婚禮。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is going to wear formal attire to the wedding tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 礼、乐、射（三者合称，指礼仪、音乐与射箭）
english_meaning: li, yue, she — rites, music, and archery (classical Confucian arts/skills)
explanation_mandarin: 「禮樂射」為古代儒家所講的項目之一，通常指禮儀、音樂與射箭，常與六藝（禮、樂、射、御、書、數）相關，代表傳統教育與修養的部分內容。
explanation_english: A classical phrase referring to rites (li), music (yue), and archery (she). It is part of the Confucian Six Arts and denotes aspects of traditional education and moral cultivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺儒家教育入面，禮樂射係六藝嘅一部分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 jyu4 gaa1 gaau3 juk6 jap6 min6, lai5 ngok6 se6 hai6 luk6 ngai6 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在儒家教育中，禮樂射是六藝的一部分。
examples.english_sentence: In Confucian education, rites, music, and archery are part of the Six Arts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺博物館見到一幅講緊古代禮樂射嘅壁畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bok3 mat6 gun2 gin3 dou2 jat1 fuk1 gong2 gan2 gu2 doi6 lai5 ngok6 se6 ge3 bik1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在博物館看到一幅講述古代禮樂射的壁畫。
examples.english_sentence: He saw a mural in the museum depicting ancient rites, music, and archery.

mandarin_meaning: 礼乐崩坏
english_meaning: the collapse of rites and music; metaphor for the breakdown of social order and morals
explanation_mandarin: 原指禮制和樂制崩壞，後用以比喻社會秩序、倫理道德或傳統文化瓦解，出現混亂或墮落。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the collapse of ritual and musical systems; now used metaphorically to describe the breakdown of social order, moral norms, or traditional culture leading to chaos or moral decay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家社會道德好似禮樂崩壞咁，好多人成日唔尊重傳統價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 se5 wui6 dou6 dak1 hou2 ci5 lei5 ngok6 bang1 waai6 gam2, hou2 do1 jan4 sing4 jat6 m4 zyun1 zung3 cyun4 tung2 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在社会道德好像礼乐崩坏，很多人经常不尊重传统价值。
examples.english_sentence: It feels like social morality has collapsed — many people no longer respect traditional values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果政府長期無法維持秩序，社會文化有可能出現禮樂崩壞嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 coeng4 kei4 mou4 faat3 wai4 ci4 zat1 zeoi6, se5 wui6 man4 faa3 jau5 ho2 nang4 ceot1 jin2 lei5 ngok6 bang1 waai6 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府长期无法维持秩序，社会文化有可能出现礼乐崩坏的情况。
examples.english_sentence: If the government cannot maintain order over time, social and cultural collapse may occur.

mandarin_meaning: 礼炮（lǐpào），用于仪式或庆典中鸣放以示敬意或庆祝的炮声或礼仪性发射。
english_meaning: saluting gun / ceremonial cannon — a gun or cannon fired as a formal salute or celebratory salute.
explanation_mandarin: 指在國慶、閱兵、迎賓或重要儀式上鳴放的炮聲或炮禮，用以表示敬意、歡慶或隆重氣氛。有時亦泛指慶祝用的禮儀性噴發裝置（如禮花筒）。
explanation_english: Refers to the ceremonial firing of guns or cannons at national days, parades, receptions, or important ceremonies to show respect or celebration. Can also loosely refer to celebratory party cannons (e.g., confetti cannons) in casual contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婚禮上放禮炮，場面好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 lai5 soeng6 fong3 lai5 paau3, coeng4 min6 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婚礼上放礼炮，场面很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: They fired ceremonial salutes at the wedding; the scene was very festive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總統抵達國慶典禮嗰陣，軍隊鳴放咗二十一響禮炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 tung2 dai2 daat6 gwok3 hing3 din2 lai5 go2 zan6, gwan1 deoi6 ming4 fong3 zo2 ji6 sap6 jat1 hoeng2 lai5 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总统抵达国庆典礼时，军队鸣放了二十一响礼炮。
examples.english_sentence: When the president arrived at the National Day ceremony, the military fired a 21-gun salute.

mandarin_meaning: 禮物 (lǐwù)
english_meaning: gift; present
explanation_mandarin: 指贈送給別人的東西，通常用於生日、節日或慶祝場合，表達心意或祝福。
explanation_english: An item given to someone to express appreciation, celebration, or goodwill; commonly used for birthdays, holidays, and special occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份禮物係俾你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 lei5 mat6 hai6 bei2 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份禮物是給你的。
examples.english_sentence: This gift is for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗一個好貴嘅禮物畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 gwai3 ge3 lei5 mat6 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了我一個很貴的禮物。
examples.english_sentence: He/She gave me a very expensive gift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開生日會記得帶禮物嚟啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 saang1 jat6 wui2 gei3 dak1 daai3 lei5 mat6 lai4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開生日會記得帶禮物來啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a gift to the birthday party.

mandarin_meaning: 礼盒 (lǐhé)
english_meaning: gift box; boxed set
explanation_mandarin: 指用來裝禮物或食品的盒子，常在節慶、送禮或促銷活動中使用，例如月餅禮盒、茶葉禮盒等。
explanation_english: A box used to hold gifts or food items, commonly used for presenting gifts during festivals, special occasions, or promotions (e.g., mooncake gift box, tea gift box).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個月餅禮盒送畀屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 jyut6 beng2 lai5 hap6 sung3 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个月饼礼盒送给家人。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a mooncake gift box to give to my family.

mandarin_meaning: 禮節（lǐjié）
english_meaning: etiquette; manners; ceremonial propriety
explanation_mandarin: 指在不同社交或正式場合中應遵守的禮儀、舉止與規範。
explanation_english: Refers to the manners, rites, and conventions observed in social or formal situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺正式場合要有禮節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 sik1 coeng4 hap6 jiu3 jau5 lei5 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在正式場合要有禮節。
examples.english_sentence: You should observe proper etiquette in formal situations.

mandarin_meaning: 礼、义、廉（儒家倫理中的品德項目）
english_meaning: propriety (li), righteousness (yi), and integrity/honesty (lian) — Confucian virtues
explanation_mandarin: 源自儒家倫理，指禮節、義氣與廉潔等道德品質，常用於道德教育與勸導，強調個人與社會之間應有的行為準則。
explanation_english: A set of Confucian virtues referring to propriety, righteousness, and integrity/honesty. Often invoked in moral education and exhortation to describe proper conduct and ethical standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校開咗個教育計劃，強調禮義廉同誠信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 hoi1 zo2 go3 gaau3 juk6 gai3 waak6, koeng4 diu6 lei5 ji6 lim4 tung4 sing4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校開了一個教育計劃，強調禮義廉和誠信。
examples.english_sentence: The school launched an education program emphasizing propriety, righteousness, integrity, and honesty.

mandarin_meaning: 禮、義、廉、恥（四種道德品行）；傳統倫理觀念
english_meaning: The four virtues: propriety, righteousness, integrity, and a sense of shame (a traditional moral concept)
explanation_mandarin: 出自中國傳統倫理，指禮、義、廉、恥四種德行，用以約束和規範個人行為與社會道德。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese moral concept naming four virtues—propriety, righteousness, integrity, and a sense of shame—used to guide personal conduct and social morality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校好重視禮義廉恥，班主任經常教導學生要有正確嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 hou2 zung6 si6 lei5 ji6 lim4 ci2, baan1 zyu2 jam6 ging1 soeng4 gaau3 dou6 hok6 saang1 jiu3 jau5 zing3 kok3 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們學校很重視禮義廉恥，班主任經常教導學生要有正確的價值觀。
examples.english_sentence: Our school places great importance on propriety, righteousness, integrity, and a sense of shame; the homeroom teacher often teaches students to have the right values.

mandarin_meaning: 以禮節或正式方式邀請、聘用（某人擔任職務或出任顧問等）
english_meaning: to formally/respectfully invite or hire someone (e.g., to a post or as a consultant)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用禮貌或正式的方式邀請某人擔任職務或出任顧問，語氣較為尊重與正式，常見於書面或公文場合。
explanation_english: Means to invite or employ someone in a courteous, formal manner (for a post, consultancy, etc.). It carries a respectful, official tone and is often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司禮聘佢做顧問，因為佢喺業界好有聲望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lai5 ping3 keoi5 zou6 gu3 man6, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai2 jip6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 sing1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司礼聘他做顾问，因为他在业界很有声望。
examples.english_sentence: The company formally engaged him as a consultant because he is highly respected in the industry.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）算了；別管了；別再提
english_meaning: Leave it be; forget about it; drop it
explanation_mandarin: 源自英語 'leave it be' 的諧音俚語，用來表示放棄追究、別再管、別再提。常見於香港口語和網絡用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase that phoneticizes the English 'leave it be'. It is used to tell someone to drop an issue, stop pursuing it, or stop mentioning it. Common in Hong Kong colloquial and online speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事就禮衣邊啦，唔好再提。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zau6 lai5 ji1 bin1 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事就算了，不要再提。
examples.english_sentence: Let's just leave this matter be; don't bring it up again.

mandarin_meaning: 礼让；有礼貌地让步或让别人先行
english_meaning: to yield; to give way courteously; to let others go first
explanation_mandarin: 表示有礼貌地让步或让别人先行，常用于交通或社交场合，强调谦让和礼节。
explanation_english: Indicates courteously yielding or giving way to others, often used in traffic or social situations to emphasize politeness and deference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行人見到老人家要禮讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 jan4 gin3 dou3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 jiu3 lai5 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行人看到老人家要礼让。
examples.english_sentence: Pedestrians should give way to elderly people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開車見到行人過馬路要禮讓，避免發生意外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 ce1 gin3 dou3 hang4 jan4 gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 lai5 joeng6, bei6min5 faat3 sang1 ji3 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车看到行人过马路要礼让，避免发生意外。
examples.english_sentence: When driving, yield to pedestrians crossing the road to avoid accidents.

mandarin_meaning: 礼貌 (lǐmào)
english_meaning: politeness; good manners
explanation_mandarin: 指對別人的尊重與舉止得體的行為或態度，表現出有禮節和良好的社交規範。
explanation_english: The quality of being polite — showing respectful, well-mannered behavior toward others according to social norms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好有禮貌，見到人會打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6, gin3 dou3 jan4 wui5 daa2 ziu1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有礼貌，见到人会打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very polite and greets people when meeting them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去人哋屋企要有禮貌，記得除鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 jiu3 jau5 lai5 maau6, gei3 dak1 ceoi4 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去别人家要有礼貌，记得脱鞋。
examples.english_sentence: When visiting someone's home, be polite and remember to take off your shoes.

mandarin_meaning: 禮賓府（政府用來接待國賓或舉行禮賓活動的官邸或場所）
english_meaning: Government House; the official residence or venue used for protocol — hosting state guests, official receptions and ceremonies
explanation_mandarin: 指政府用作接待外國元首或舉行國事、禮賓活動的官邸或場所。在香港語境中常指用來舉行正式招待或國宴的政府官邸（即政府接待場所）。
explanation_english: Refers to the official residence or government venue used for protocol purposes — receiving foreign heads of state, hosting official receptions and state ceremonies. In Hong Kong usage it commonly denotes the Government House used for formal receptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮賓府今晚會舉行國宴，接待外國元首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 ban1 fu2 gam1 maan5 wui5 geoi2 hang4 gwok3 jin6, zip3 doi6 ngoi6 gwok3 jyun4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 禮賓府今晚會舉行國宴，接待外國元首。
examples.english_sentence: The Government House will hold a state banquet tonight to receive foreign heads of state.

mandarin_meaning: 礼遇 (lǐyù)：以礼相待、优待；对贵宾或重要人物给予特殊待遇
english_meaning: courteous treatment; special or preferential treatment (often given to VIPs or honored guests)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以禮貌或尊重的方式對待某人，或給予特殊優待，常用於對待貴賓、嘉賓或重要人物。
explanation_english: To treat someone with courtesy or give them special/preferential treatment. Commonly used when referring to VIPs, honored guests, or important persons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為身份高，喺今次活動得到特別嘅禮遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 san1 fan6 gou1, hai2 gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 dak1 dou3 dak6 bit6 ge3 lai5 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為身份高，在這次活動受到特別的禮遇。
examples.english_sentence: Because of his high status, he received special courtesies at this event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒店為咗歡迎貴賓，特別禮遇佢哋，畀咗升級客房同免費早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 dim3 wai6 zo2 fun1 jing4 gwai3 ban1, dak6 bit6 lai5 jyu6 keoi5 dei6, bei2 zo2 sing1 kap1 haak3 fong2 tung4 min5 fai3 zou2 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店為了歡迎貴賓，特別禮遇他們，給予升級客房和免費早餐。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel gave them special treatment—upgrading their rooms and providing free breakfast.

mandarin_meaning: 礼金
english_meaning: cash gift; monetary gift given on special occasions
explanation_mandarin: 指在婚禮、壽宴、喪禮或其他慶祝或慰問場合以現金形式贈送的禮物，通常裝在紅包或信封內。
explanation_english: Money given as a gift on occasions such as weddings, birthdays, funerals, or other celebrations/condolences; usually placed in a red envelope or envelope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚嗰日收咗好多禮金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 go2 jat6 sau1 zo2 hou2 do1 lai5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚那天收了很多礼金。
examples.english_sentence: They received a lot of cash gifts on their wedding day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺喪禮嗰陣，賓客通常會包禮金表示慰問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 song1 lai5 go2 zan6, ban1 haak3 tung1 soeng4 wui5 baau1 lai5 gam1 biu2 si6 wai6 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在丧礼的时候，宾客通常会包礼金表示慰问。
examples.english_sentence: At funerals, guests usually give cash gifts in envelopes to express condolences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去長輩生日宴，我哋會送啲禮金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 zoeng2 bui3 saang1 jat6 jin6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 sung3 di1 lai5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去长辈的生日宴，我们会送一些礼金。
examples.english_sentence: When attending an elder's birthday banquet, we give some cash gifts.

mandarin_meaning: 禮貌性的客套話；形式上的寒暄（口語、略帶貶義）
english_meaning: polite platitudes; formal pleasantries uttered out of courtesy rather than sincerity (colloquial, mildly pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「禮雲子」為廣東話口語詞，指為了表示禮貌或應付場合而說的客套話、寒暄，通常含有不夠真誠或只是形式性的意味。此詞使用較口語化，在香港粵語社群中偶見，語氣可帶貶義。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to polite phrases or pleasantries said out of courtesy rather than sincerity. It implies formality or emptiness and can carry a mildly derogatory tone. Usage is informal and primarily found in Cantonese-speaking communities (e.g., Hong Kong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣佢成日講啲禮雲子，實際上冇講到重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6 keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 lai5 wan4 zi2, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 gong2 dou3 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候他老是講一些禮節性的客套話，實際上沒有說到重點。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview he kept saying polite platitudes and didn't actually address the key points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢啲禮雲子迷惑，佢其實唔會幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 di1 lai5 wan4 zi2 mai4 wak6, keoi5 kei4 sat6 m4 wui5 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他的客套話迷惑，他其實不會幫你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his polite words; he actually won't help you.

mandarin_meaning: 禮餅（lǐbǐng）：在婚嫁、過大禮或其他喜慶場合用作贈禮或回禮的傳統糕點。
english_meaning: Ceremonial/gift pastries (traditional pastries given as gifts at weddings, betrothals, or other celebratory occasions).
explanation_mandarin: 指在婚禮、訂婚（過大禮）、敬茶或其他喜慶場合作為贈送親友或回禮的中式糕點，常見有喜餅、聘餅、酥餅、蛋黃酥等，帶有祝福與禮節的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to traditional Chinese pastries given as gifts or returned gifts during weddings, betrothal ceremonies, or other celebratory occasions. Common forms include wedding pastries, betrothal cakes, and various filled or flaky pastries, symbolizing blessings and etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋過大禮嘅時候，準備咗好多禮餅畀雙方親戚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gwo3 daai6 lai5 ge3 si4 hau6, zeon2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 lai5 beng2 bei2 soeng1 fong1 can1 cik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們過大禮的時候，準備了很多禮餅給雙方親戚。
examples.english_sentence: When they held the betrothal ceremony, they prepared many ceremonial pastries for relatives on both sides.

mandarin_meaning: 兌換禮餅的券（用於婚禮或節慶作為禮品或贈品）
english_meaning: a voucher/coupon redeemable for gift pastries (e.g., wedding pastries); used as a gift or favor
explanation_mandarin: 指可在指定餅店兌換禮餅（如喜餅、伴手禮等）的紙券或電子券，常見於婚禮、節慶或送禮場合。
explanation_english: A ticket or coupon that can be redeemed at a specified bakery for gift pastries (such as wedding pastries or favors). Commonly used at weddings, festivals, or as gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗我一張禮餅券，下個月我可以去餅店換喜餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 zoeng1 lai5 beng2 hyun3, haa6 go3 jyut6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 beng2 dim3 wun6 hei2 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了我一張禮餅券，下個月我可以去餅店兌換喜餅。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a pastry voucher; next month I can go to the bakery to redeem the wedding pastries.

mandarin_meaning: 祈祷、祈求（向神明或上帝祷告）
english_meaning: to pray; to offer a prayer or petition to a deity; to beseech
explanation_mandarin: 表示向神明、佛像或上帝祈求、祈禱或祝禱。常與“禱告”“祈禱”“禱求”等詞搭配使用。
explanation_english: Indicates praying or making a petition to a deity, Buddha, or higher power. Commonly used in compounds such as '禱告' (to pray) and '禱求' (to beseech).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺廟入面為亡者禱告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 miu6 jap6 min6 wai6 wong4 ze2 tou2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在庙里为亡者祈祷。
examples.english_sentence: They pray for the deceased in the temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風嚟之前，村民上山禱求風平浪靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 lai4 zi1 cin4, cyun1 man4 soeng5 saan1 tou2 kau4 fung1 ping4 long6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风来之前，村民上山祈求风平浪静。
examples.english_sentence: Before the typhoon arrived, villagers went up the mountain to pray for calm winds and seas.

mandarin_meaning: 禱告 / 祈禱 (dǎogào / qídǎo)
english_meaning: to pray; to offer a prayer
explanation_mandarin: 表示向神、上天或超自然力量祈求、懇求或表達心願的行為，常用於宗教或莊重場合。
explanation_english: The act of addressing a deity or higher power to ask, request, or express one's wishes; commonly used in religious or solemn contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都喺教堂禱吿，祈求家人平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 hai2 gaau3 tong4 tou2 gou3, kei4 kau4 gaa1 jan4 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天在教堂祈禱，為家人求平安。
examples.english_sentence: He prays in church every day, asking for his family's safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 神父喺病房入面為病人禱吿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 fu6 hai2 beng6 fong4 jap6 min6 wai6 beng6 jan4 tou2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 神父在病房裡為病人祈禱。
examples.english_sentence: The priest prays for the patient in the ward.

mandarin_meaning: 祈禱；向神明或超自然力量祈求、表達願望或感謝
english_meaning: to pray; prayer — to address a deity or higher power to request help, give thanks, or express wishes
explanation_mandarin: 指向神、上帝或其他超自然力量祈求保佑、表達感謝或陳述願望的言語或行為，既可作動詞也可作名詞（如一段禱告）。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking or communicating with a deity or higher power to request protection, express gratitude, or state wishes; can function as a verb ('to pray') or a noun ('a prayer').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每晚都會禱告，祈求家人平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 maan5 dou1 wui5 tou2 gou3, kei4 kau4 gaa1 jan4 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每晚都會祈禱，祈求家人平安。
examples.english_sentence: He prays every night, asking for his family's safety.

mandarin_meaning: 用祭祀或儀式驅除災禍、消除不祥（讀音：ráng）
english_meaning: to perform rites or rituals to ward off calamities and expel evil or misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語詞彙，指通過祭祀、祈禱或特定儀式以祛除災禍、驅邪避凶，常見於宗教或民間祭祀語境中，如「禳災」。
explanation_english: A classical term meaning to remove or avert calamities through rituals or ceremonies; commonly used in religious or folk-ritual contexts (e.g., '禳災' — to perform rites to avert disaster).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟裡嗰個師父幫村民禳災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 leoi5 go2 go3 si1 fu6 bong1 cyun1 man4 joeng4 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡那個師父幫村民禳災。
examples.english_sentence: The priest at the temple is performing a ritual to ward off calamities for the villagers.

mandarin_meaning: 禸（ròu）——本义为动物行走留下的足迹、踪迹；同时为汉字部首，用于表征与足迹、踪迹有关的字，现代汉语中较少单独使用。
english_meaning: 禸 (ròu / jau6) — originally meaning animal tracks or footprints; also used as a Chinese character radical indicating traces or footprints. Rarely used alone in modern speech.
explanation_mandarin: 禸为汉字部首之一，本义为足迹或踪迹。该字常见于字形学或字典作为部首说明，在现代汉语口语和书面语中单独使用较少。
explanation_english: 禸 is a Chinese radical meaning tracks or footprints. It appears in character composition to suggest meanings related to traces. The character itself is archaic and seldom used alone in modern language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字嘅部首係禸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 bou6 sau2 hai6 jau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字的部首是禸。
examples.english_sentence: The radical of this character is 禸.

mandarin_meaning: 禹（大禹，传说中的治水英雄，夏朝的奠基人），也可作姓氏
english_meaning: Yu (the legendary hero who controlled the Great Flood and founder of the Xia dynasty); also a surname
explanation_mandarin: 禹通常指传说中的大禹，为治水有功、传说中建立夏朝的英雄人物；同时可作为姓氏或出现在人名与地名中。
explanation_english: Refers to Yu the Great, the legendary Chinese hero who controlled the Great Flood and is credited with founding the Xia dynasty; also used as a surname and in personal or place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中國上古傳說有大禹治水嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 gwok3 soeng6 gu2 cyun4 syut3 jau5 daai6 jyu5 zi6 seoi2 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中國上古傳說有大禹治水的故事。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient Chinese legends tell the story of Yu the Great controlling the floods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓禹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓禹。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Yu.

mandarin_meaning: 猿、猴；古地名（古代用字，現代少用）
english_meaning: ape/monkey; an ancient place-name (classical/literary usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「禺」為古文字，常見於古籍或地名中，原指猿猴，也用作古地名或人名的一部分。現代口語中甚少單獨使用，主要出現在書面或專有名詞裡。
explanation_english: The character 禺 is an archaic/literary character that originally refers to apes or monkeys and appears in some ancient place-names. It is rarely used in everyday speech, mainly found in written texts or proper names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書上講「禺」係指一種猿猴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 soeng6 gong2 "jyu4" hai6 zi2 jat1 zung2 jyun4 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古書上說「禺」是指一種猿猴。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient books say '禺' refers to a type of ape.

mandarin_meaning: 禽 (qín)：鳥類、家禽，常用於複合詞如禽流感、家禽等。
english_meaning: bird; fowl; poultry (often used in compounds such as 'avian influenza' or 'poultry')
explanation_mandarin: 表示鳥類或家禽的總稱，也常出現在醫學或畜牧相關詞語中，如「禽流感」、「家禽」。
explanation_english: Denotes birds or poultry in general. Frequently appears in medical or farming compounds, e.g. 'avian influenza' and 'poultry'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有禽流感爆發，農場要加強檢疫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 kam4 lau4 gam2 baau3 faat3, nung4 coeng4 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 gim2 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近爆發了禽流感，農場要加強檢疫。
examples.english_sentence: There has been an outbreak of avian influenza recently; farms need to strengthen quarantine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺農場養咗幾隻家禽，主要係雞同埋鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 nung4 coeng4 joeng5 zo2 gei2 zek3 gaa1 kam4, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 gai1 tung4 maai4 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在農場养了几只家禽，主要是鸡和鸭。
examples.english_sentence: They keep several poultry on the farm, mainly chickens and ducks.

mandarin_meaning: （粗口）去你的；該死的（罵人）
english_meaning: (vulgar) an expletive used to curse someone; roughly 'fuck you' / 'damn you'
explanation_mandarin: 「禽日」是香港廣東話的粗口俚語，用來罵人或表示憤怒、不滿。字面無特別意思，屬於侮辱性語詞，應避免在正式場合使用。
