examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 bing2 ci4 gung1 zing3 ge3 jyun4 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直秉持公正的原則。
examples.english_sentence: He has always upheld the principle of fairness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司秉承家族嘅傳統，堅持做品質優先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bing2 sing4 gaa1 zuk6 ge3 cyun4 tung2, gin1 ci4 zou6 ban2 zat1 jau1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司秉承家族的傳統，堅持以品質為先。
examples.english_sentence: The company carries on the family's traditions and insists on prioritizing quality.

mandarin_meaning: 承襲；遵循（某種傳統、宗旨或教導）
english_meaning: to uphold; to carry on; to inherit or adhere to (a tradition, principle, teaching)
explanation_mandarin: 表示承接並遵循某種傳統、理念或教導，常用於書面語或正式場合。
explanation_english: Indicates taking on and following a tradition, principle, or teaching; commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司秉承「顧客至上」嘅宗旨，一直提供優質服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 bing2 sing4 "gu3 haak3 zi3 soeng6" ge3 zung1 zi2, jat1 zik6 tai4 gung1 jau1 zat1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司秉承「顧客至上」的宗旨，一直提供優質服務。
examples.english_sentence: Our company upholds the principle of 'customer first' and has consistently provided high-quality service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個傳統家族，我哋應該秉承祖先嘅理念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wai4 jat1 go3 cyun4 tung2 gaa1 zuk6, ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 bing2 sing4 zou2 sin1 ge3 lei5 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為一個傳統家族，我們應該秉承祖先的理念。
examples.english_sentence: As a traditional family, we should carry on the principles of our ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢秉承老師嘅教導，繼續努力學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing2 sing4 lou5 si1 ge3 gaau3 dou6, gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他秉承老師的教導，繼續努力學習。
examples.english_sentence: He follows his teacher's guidance and continues to study hard.

mandarin_meaning: 坚持；持守（某种原则或信念）
english_meaning: to uphold; to adhere to; to hold (a principle or belief)
explanation_mandarin: 表示奉持並貫徹某種原則、態度或信念，常用於書面語，強調以該信念作為行事準則。
explanation_english: Means to maintain and act according to a principle, attitude, or belief. Often used in formal or written contexts to emphasize adherence to a guiding principle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋秉持公正同誠信嘅原則去處理呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bing2 ci4 gung1 zing3 tung4 sing4 seon3 ge3 jyun4 zak1 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們秉持公正和誠信的原則來處理這件事。
examples.english_sentence: We handled this matter by upholding the principles of fairness and integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司秉持客戶導向嘅經營方針，致力提高服務質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bing2 ci4 haak3 wu6 dou6 hoeng3 ge3 ging1 jing4 fong1 zan1, zi3 lik6 tai4 gou1 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司秉持以客戶為導向的經營方針，致力提高服務質量。
examples.english_sentence: The company upholds a customer-oriented business policy and strives to improve service quality.

mandarin_meaning: 手持蜡烛；（常用于“秉烛夜谈”）在烛光下交谈或彻夜长谈
english_meaning: to hold a candle; (literary) to talk by candlelight or stay up talking late into the night
explanation_mandarin: 「秉燭」字面意思是手持燭火，常見於古文或書面語，如「秉燭夜談」，表示在燭光下談話或徹夜長談，也用於描寫停電時以燭光相聚的情景。
explanation_english: Literally 'to hold a candle.' Often used in literary expressions (e.g. '秉燭夜談') to describe talking by candlelight or having an intimate, late-night conversation; can also describe sitting together with candles during a power outage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停電嗰陣，我哋只好秉燭喺客廳傾計到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 din6 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 zi2 hou2 bing2 zuk1 hai2 haak3 teng1 king1 gai2 dou3 hou2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停电的时候，我们只好手持蜡烛在客厅聊到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: When the power went out, we could only hold candles in the living room and chat until very late.

mandarin_meaning: 年（古字/異體字）
english_meaning: year (archaic/variant character for 年)
explanation_mandarin: 「秊」是「年」的古字或異體字，常見於古籍、碑刻或正式書寫中，用以表示年份或歲數。在現代漢語中多用「年」替代。
explanation_english: '秊' is an archaic or variant form of the character '年', used in classical texts, inscriptions, or formal writing to denote a calendar year or age. In modern usage '年' is normally used instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係一九三三秊出版嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 jat1 gau2 saam1 saam1 nin4 ceot1 baan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是1933年出版的。
examples.english_sentence: This book was published in 1933.

mandarin_meaning: 秋；秋天
english_meaning: autumn; fall
explanation_mandarin: 表示一年四季中的一個季節，通常位於夏季與冬季之間，氣溫逐漸轉涼，樹葉開始變色並飄落。
explanation_english: The season between summer and winter when temperatures cool and leaves often change color and fall; autumn (fall).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家入秋，天氣開始涼咗，記得帶外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jap6 cau1, tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 loeng4 zo2, gei3 dak1 daai3 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在入秋了，天气开始凉了，记得带外套。
examples.english_sentence: It's now the beginning of autumn; the weather has started to cool, remember to bring a jacket.

mandarin_meaning: 秋刀鱼（太平洋秋刀鱼），一种细长的海鱼，常见于秋季，常用于烧烤或煎食。
english_meaning: Pacific saury (mackerel pike), a slender marine fish commonly eaten in autumn, often grilled or pan‑fried.
explanation_mandarin: 秋刀魚是一種體型細長的海魚，學名為太平洋秋刀魚，在秋季捕獲量多，亞洲地區常以烤、煎等方式食用，是日常常見的海鮮之一。
explanation_english: Autumn knife fish (Pacific saury) is a slim, elongated marine fish caught mainly in autumn. It is commonly eaten in East Asia, typically grilled or pan‑fried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買咗啲新鮮嘅秋刀魚，煎嚟食好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 san1 sin1 ge3 cau1 dou1 jyu4, zin1 lai4 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚买了些新鲜的秋刀鱼，煎来吃很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some fresh saury tonight; pan‑fried they're really tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 秋分（二十四节气之一，太阳直射赤道，昼夜等长）
english_meaning: Autumnal equinox (one of the 24 solar terms; the sun is over the equator and day and night are roughly equal)
explanation_mandarin: 秋分是中國傳統二十四節氣之一，通常在每年九月二十二或二十三日，太陽直射赤道，晝夜時間接近相等，標誌著秋季的中期。
explanation_english: The autumnal equinox is one of the 24 traditional Chinese solar terms, occurring around September 22–23 each year when the sun is over the equator and day and night are nearly equal; it marks the middle of autumn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋分嗰日晝夜差唔多一樣長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 fan1 go2 jat6 zau3 je6 caa1 m4 do1 jat1 joeng6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋分那天昼夜几乎一样长。
examples.english_sentence: On the day of the autumnal equinox, day and night are almost equally long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫話秋分之後要開始收割啲作物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 fu1 waa6 cau1 fan1 zi1 hau6 jiu3 hoi1 ci2 sau1 got3 di1 zok3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农民说秋分之后要开始收割庄稼。
examples.english_sentence: The farmer said they will start harvesting crops after the autumnal equinox.

mandarin_meaning: 秋千 (指供人坐着前後擺動的遊樂設施)
english_meaning: swing (a seat hung by ropes or chains for swinging back and forth)
explanation_mandarin: 指用繩索、鏈條或金屬架懸掛的座位，供人坐着前後擺動，常見於公園或遊樂場。
explanation_english: A seat hung by ropes, chains, or a frame that allows a person to swing back and forth; commonly found in parks and playgrounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有個秋千，好多小朋友鍾意玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 cau1 cin1, hou2 do1 siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 ji3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一个秋千，很多小朋友喜欢玩。
examples.english_sentence: There's a swing in the park; many children like to play on it.

mandarin_meaning: 秋天；秋季
english_meaning: autumn; fall (the season between summer and winter)
explanation_mandarin: 一年四季之一，位于夏季和冬季之间，通常气温转凉，植物开始落叶。
explanation_english: One of the four seasons, between summer and winter; typically brings cooler temperatures and falling leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋天嘅天氣開始轉涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 tin1 ge3 tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋天的天气开始转凉。
examples.english_sentence: The weather starts to get cooler in autumn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意秋天落葉嘅顏色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 cau1 tin1 lok6 jip6 ge3 ngaan4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢秋天落叶的颜色。
examples.english_sentence: I like the colors of the fallen leaves in autumn.

mandarin_meaning: 秋季 (qiūjì)
english_meaning: autumn; fall (season)
explanation_mandarin: 指一年四季中的一个季节，通常介于夏季与冬季之间，天气转凉，许多植物落叶或成熟收获。
explanation_english: Refers to the season between summer and winter when temperatures cool down; leaves often fall and many crops are harvested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋季天氣開始轉涼，記得著多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 gwai3 tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 loeng4, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋季天气开始变凉，记得多穿点衣服。
examples.english_sentence: In autumn the weather starts to get cooler; remember to wear more clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋季係收成嘅季節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 gwai3 hai6 sau1 sing4 ge3 gwai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋季是收成的季节。
examples.english_sentence: Autumn is the harvest season.

mandarin_meaning: 秋后算账（在事後追究或報復、清算）
english_meaning: to settle accounts later; to settle scores; to take revenge or punish someone after the event
explanation_mandarin: 指在事情發生或暫時忍讓之後，再追究、清算或報復，常帶有計較或懲罰的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to pursuing retribution, settling scores, or exacting punishment after the event or after a delay; often implies grudging calculation or retaliation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆暫時冇講嘢，但唔代表佢唔會秋後算帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zaam6 si4 mou5 gong2 je5 , daan6 m4 doi6 biu2 keoi5 m4 wui5 cau1 hau6 syun3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板暂时没有说什么，但并不代表他不会秋后算账。
examples.english_sentence: The boss hasn't said anything for now, but that doesn't mean he won't settle scores later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗安全，最好留底證據，免得將來被秋後算帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 on1 cyun4 , zeoi3 hou2 lau4 dai2 zing3 geoi3 , min5 dak1 zoeng1 loi4 bei6 cau1 hau6 syun3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了安全，最好保留证据，以免将来被秋后算账。
examples.english_sentence: For safety, it's best to keep evidence to avoid being retaliated against later.

mandarin_meaning: 秋后算账（指事後清算、追究責任或報復）
english_meaning: to settle accounts later; to take revenge or seek redress after the event; to settle scores
explanation_mandarin: 指事後對某人或某事進行清算、追究或報復，通常含有報復或懲罰的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to settling accounts or taking revenge after the fact — pursuing responsibility, punishment, or retaliation at a later time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為冇人知？到時候佢哋會秋後算賬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5wai6 mou5 jan4 zi1? dou3 si4 hau6 keoi5 dei6 wui5 cau1 hau6 syun3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為沒人知道？到時候他們會秋後算帳。
examples.english_sentence: You think nobody knows? They'll settle the scores later.

mandarin_meaning: 秋意（qiūyì）：秋天的氣息；秋天帶來的氛圍或感覺
english_meaning: the atmosphere or feeling of autumn; an autumnal mood
explanation_mandarin: 表示秋天的氛圍或季節感受，常用來形容天氣、景色或人的心情帶有秋天的意境。
explanation_english: Refers to the atmosphere or feeling of autumn; commonly used to describe weather, scenery, or a person's mood that evokes the season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家街上有啲秋意，天氣開始涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gaai1 soeng6 jau5 di1 cau1 ji3, tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在街上有些秋意，天氣開始涼了。
examples.english_sentence: There's a bit of autumn in the air on the street now; the weather is starting to get cool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面落葉，帶出濃濃嘅秋意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 lok6 jip6, daai3 ceot1 nung4 nung4 ge3 cau1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡落葉，帶出濃濃的秋意。
examples.english_sentence: The falling leaves in the park give off a strong sense of autumn.

mandarin_meaning: 秋收（指秋季收割庄稼或收获）
english_meaning: autumn harvest; the harvest or reaping that takes place in the fall
explanation_mandarin: 指在秋季进行的收割和收获活动，也可以引申为取得成果或收获的时期。
explanation_english: Refers to the harvesting of crops in autumn; can also be used figuratively to mean a time of reaping results or gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋收嘅時候，農夫好忙，要趕住收割。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 sau1 ge3 si4 hau6, nung4 fu1 hou2 mong4, jiu3 gon2 zyu6 sau1 got3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋收的时候，农民很忙，要赶着收割庄稼。
examples.english_sentence: During the autumn harvest, farmers are very busy, rushing to harvest the crops.

mandarin_meaning: 不侵害一丝一毫；一点也不侵犯或损害
english_meaning: to not infringe upon or harm even the slightest bit; to refrain from causing the slightest harm
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容做事公正、不侵犯或損害他人或物，連很微小的部分也不觸犯。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe acting with scrupulous fairness or restraint, not violating or harming even the smallest part.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢待人處事一向秋毫不犯，從唔會損人利己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 jan4 cyu3 si6 jat1 hoeng3 cau1 hou4 bat1 faan6, cung4 m4 wui5 syun2 jan4 lei6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他待人處事一向秋毫不犯，從不損人利己。
examples.english_sentence: He always deals with people and matters without causing the slightest harm to others; he never hurts others for personal gain.

mandarin_meaning: 秋毫无犯（成语），指连最细微的东西也不侵犯，形容清廉或不侵害他人或财物。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning not to infringe even the tiniest thing; used to describe scrupulous integrity or harmless conduct.
explanation_mandarin: 原指連秋天細小的羽毛或毫毛都不侵犯，後用來比喻為官清廉、毫不侵占、絲毫不侵害他人利益或財物。
explanation_english: Originally referring to not harming even the tiniest autumn hairs; figuratively it denotes being scrupulously honest or not infringing upon others' rights or property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做官一向清廉，秋毫無犯，市民好放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gun1 jat1 hoeng3 cing1 lim4, cau1 hou4 mou4 faan6, si5 man4 hou2 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做官一向清廉，秋毫无犯，市民很放心。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been an honest official and does not commit even the slightest wrongdoing, so the citizens feel reassured.

mandarin_meaning: 日本秋田（縣名）；秋田犬（犬種）
english_meaning: Akita (a prefecture in Japan); Akita (dog breed)
explanation_mandarin: 「秋田」可指日本的地名（秋田縣），也常作為秋田犬的簡稱，表示一種大型犬種。
explanation_english: “秋田” can refer to Akita (a prefecture in Japan) or, more commonly in everyday speech, be short for the Akita dog breed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有隻秋田，佢好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 zek3 cau1 tin4, keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有一只秋田犬，它很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: I have an Akita at home; it's very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜會去秋田旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 cau1 tin4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜会去秋田旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Akita on a trip next week.

mandarin_meaning: 秋田犬（日本犬种，原产于秋田县，英称 Akita 或 Akita Inu）
english_meaning: Akita (a large Japanese dog breed, also called Akita Inu)
explanation_mandarin: 秋田犬是源自日本秋田县的一种大型犬，具有厚重的双层被毛、直立耳朵和卷曲的尾巴，性格通常忠诚且警觉，常被作为家庭宠物和看护犬。
explanation_english: The Akita is a large Japanese dog breed originating from Akita Prefecture, characterized by a thick double coat, erect ears, and a curled tail. Akitas are typically loyal and alert, often kept as family companions and guard dogs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有隻秋田犬，佢好忠心又好錫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 zek3 cau1 tin4 hyun2, keoi5 hou2 zung1 sam1 jau6 hou2 sek3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一只秋田犬，它很忠诚也很疼我。
examples.english_sentence: I have an Akita; it's very loyal and affectionate toward me.

mandarin_meaning: 秋季祭祀；在秋天祭拜祖先或神明的儀式
english_meaning: autumn memorial ceremony; a ritual in autumn to honor ancestors or deities
explanation_mandarin: 指在秋季舉行的祭祀活動，一般用來祭拜祖先或神明，是傳統民俗中的季節性祭典。現代用法有時與掃墓、祭祖相關聯。
explanation_english: Refers to a ritual or ceremony held in autumn to offer sacrifices or pay respects to ancestors or deities. It is a seasonal traditional custom often associated with tomb-sweeping and ancestral veneration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每年秋祭都會去墳墓掃墓同上香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 cau1 zai3 dou1 wui5 heoi3 fan4 mou6 sou3 mou6 tung4 soeng5 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每年秋祭都会去墓地扫墓并上香。
examples.english_sentence: Every year for the autumn memorial we go to the graves to sweep them and burn incense.

mandarin_meaning: 秋色（qiū sè），指秋天的景色與色彩
english_meaning: autumn colors; autumn scenery
explanation_mandarin: 指秋天的景色與色彩，常用來描述秋季特有的金黃、紅葉與蕭瑟氛圍，亦常見於詩詞、文學的表述中。
explanation_english: Refers to the scenery and colors of autumn—golden leaves, red foliage, and the crisp autumn atmosphere; often used in literary descriptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家正係欣賞秋色嘅最好時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zing3 hai6 jan1 soeng2 cau1 sik1 ge3 zeoi3 hou2 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在正是欣賞秋色的最好時候。
examples.english_sentence: Now is the best time to enjoy the autumn scenery.

mandarin_meaning: 秋葵（qiū kuí），一种蔬菜
english_meaning: Okra (lady's finger, gumbo), an edible green pod vegetable
explanation_mandarin: 秋葵是一種長條形的蔬菜，表面有細毛，切開後會有黏滑的膠質，常用於清炒、湯或燉菜中。
explanation_english: Okra is an elongated green vegetable with a slightly fuzzy skin and a mucilaginous (slimy) interior when cut; commonly used in stir-fries, soups, and stews.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗啲秋葵，打算清炒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 cau1 kwai4, daa2 syun3 zing2 cing1 caau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚买了些秋葵，打算清炒。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some okra tonight and plan to stir-fry it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋葵煲湯會令湯變得稠，啱冬天飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 kwai4 bou1 tong1 wui5 ling6 tong1 bin3 dak1 cau4, aam1 dung1 tin1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋葵煲汤会让汤变得较稠，适合冬天喝。
examples.english_sentence: Adding okra to soup can make it thicker, which is nice to have in winter.

mandarin_meaning: 秋天的蟬（詩歌或文學中常用作凋零、哀愁或年老的象徵）
english_meaning: autumn cicada (literary term often used in poetry to symbolize decline, melancholy, or aging)
explanation_mandarin: 「秋蟬」字面上指秋天的蟬。在文學與詩詞中常被用來表達淒涼、衰落或年華老去的感覺，不是日常口語常用詞，偏向書面或詩意用法。
explanation_english: Literally 'autumn cicada.' In literature and poetry it is often used as an image to convey melancholy, decline, or aging. It is a literary/poetic term rather than a common everyday expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚晚聽到樹上有秋蟬叫，總覺得有啲淒涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 maan5 teng1 dou3 syu6 soeng6 jau5 cau1 cim4 giu3, zung2 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 cai1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每晚听到树上有秋蝉在叫，总觉得有点凄凉。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the autumn cicadas singing in the trees every night makes me feel a bit melancholic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詩人經常用秋蟬嚟形容晚景或者傷感的情緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 jan4 ging1 soeng4 jung6 cau1 cim4 lai4 jing4 joeng4 maan5 ging2 waak6 ze2 soeng1 gam2 dik1 cing4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 诗人经常用秋蝉来形容晚景或者伤感的情绪。
examples.english_sentence: Poets often use the autumn cicada to depict decline or melancholic feelings.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）秋天的蝉跌到地上；（引申）比喻突然失勢、丟臉或慘敗
english_meaning: Literally 'an autumn cicada falls to the ground'; figuratively a sudden fall from grace, humiliation, or a major collapse/failure
explanation_mandarin: 此語字面意思為「秋天的蟬跌落地面」。在廣東話口語或俚語中常用作比喻，形容某人或某事由風光、穩定的狀態突然衰落、出醜或遭遇重大挫敗，帶有貶義或嘲諷色彩。
explanation_english: Literally describes a cicada falling to the ground in autumn. In Cantonese colloquial use it is a figurative expression for someone or something that suddenly falls from a former high or respected position, becomes humiliated, or suffers a severe failure. It often carries a mocking or negative tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前做老闆好威，做生意做得好；一次投資失誤之後，真係秋蟬跌落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 lou5 baan2 hou2 wai1, zou6 saang1 ji5 zou6 dak1 hou2; jat1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 ng6 zi1 hau6, zan1 hai6 cau1 sim4 dit3 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前當老闆很有威望，生意做得很好；一次投資失誤之後，真是顏面掃地。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a powerful boss and did great business; after one failed investment he really fell from grace.

mandarin_meaning: 秋风；指秋天的风，也引申为秋天的气息或萧瑟、伤感的情绪
english_meaning: autumn wind; literally the wind of autumn, often used figuratively to evoke the atmosphere of autumn—coolness, desolation, or melancholy
explanation_mandarin: 一般指秋天的風；在文學或口語中常用來表達秋天的氣息、天氣轉涼或帶有蕭瑟、惆悵的情緒，有時出現在成語或俗語中（如「秋風掃落葉」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the wind of autumn. In literal use it denotes the seasonal wind; figuratively it conveys the mood or atmosphere of autumn—cooling weather, desolation, or melancholy. Appears in idioms and literary expressions (e.g., "autumn wind sweeps the fallen leaves").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日有啲秋風，記得著多件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau5 di1 cau1 fung1, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有些秋风，记得多穿一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: There's some autumn wind today; remember to put on an extra layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋風起，落葉飄，天氣開始轉涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 fung1 hei2, lok6 jip6 piu1, tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋风起，落叶飘，天气开始转凉。
examples.english_sentence: The autumn wind rises, leaves drift, and the weather begins to cool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每逢秋天，佢會覺得好傷感，好似畀秋風影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 fung4 cau1 tin1, keoi5 wui5 gok3 dak1 hou2 soeng1 gam2, hou2 ci5 bei2 cau1 fung1 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每逢秋天，他会觉得很伤感，好像被秋风影响。
examples.english_sentence: Every autumn he feels melancholic, as if affected by the autumn wind.

jyutping: cau1 fung1 hei2, saam1 se4 fei4
mandarin_meaning: 秋风一起，蛇变肥；（谚语，指秋季万物丰盛、适合收成或人/事趁机获益）
english_meaning: When the autumn wind rises, the snakes grow fat; a proverb indicating autumn brings abundance — harvest time or a season when people/opportunities prosper.
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指秋風吹來時蛇變得肥壯，是一種季節性觀察的俗語。引申為秋季是豐收或有利可圖的時節，也可用作比喻，形容人或事在合適時機變得興旺或有利可圖。
explanation_english: Literally says that when the autumn wind arrives, snakes become fat — a folk saying based on seasonal observation. Figuratively it means autumn is a time of plenty or opportunity; it can be used to describe people or things prospering when conditions are right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋風起，三蛇肥，啲田快收成，大家趕住落手做工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 fung1 hei2, saam1 se4 fei4, di1 tin4 faai3 sau1 sing4, daai6 gaa1 gon2 zyu6 lok6 sau2 zou6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋風一起，三蛇變肥，田快要收成了，大家趕著去工作。
examples.english_sentence: When the autumn wind comes and the snakes grow fat, the fields are about to be harvested — everyone is busy working.

jyutping: cau1 fung1 hei2, sik6 laap6 mei6
mandarin_meaning: 一到秋天就開始吃臘味（臘腸、臘肉等）；也用來形容季節一來就有相應的習俗或活動
english_meaning: When the autumn wind rises, people start eating preserved meats (lap mei); used to indicate that a seasonal custom or activity begins with the change of season
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的俗語，指一到秋天（特別是天氣轉涼時）人們會製作或食用臘味（如臘腸、臘肉）。同時也可引申為季節來臨時開始的習俗或活動。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial saying meaning that when autumn arrives (or the weather cools), people make and eat preserved meats (lap mei such as lap cheong and cured pork). It can also be used figuratively for customs or activities that start with the season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一到秋天，街市就開始賣臘味，真係『秋風起，食臘味』。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 dou3 cau1 tin1, gaai1 si5 zau6 hoi1 ci2 maai6 laap6 mei6, zan1 hai6 'cau1 fung1 hei2, sik6 laap6 mei6'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一到秋天，市場就開始賣臘味，真是「秋風起，吃臘味」。
examples.english_sentence: When autumn arrives the markets start selling preserved meats — it's truly 'autumn wind rises, eat lap mei'.

mandarin_meaning: 秋季颱風／秋天發生的颱風
english_meaning: an autumn typhoon — a typhoon occurring in the autumn season
explanation_mandarin: 指在秋季發生的颱風，常用於描述秋天襲港或影響華南沿海的颱風。
explanation_english: Refers to a typhoon that occurs in autumn; commonly used to describe typhoons that approach Hong Kong or affect the South China coast during the autumn season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台話會有秋颱嚟，市民要提早做好防風準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 wui5 jau5 cau1 toi4 lai4, si5 man4 jiu3 tai4 zou2 zou6 hou2 fong4 fung1 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台說會有秋颱來襲，市民要提早做好防風準備。
examples.english_sentence: The Observatory says an autumn typhoon will approach; residents should prepare for strong winds in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個秋颱來得好猛，成條海堤都被沖毀晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cau1 toi4 loi4 dak1 hou2 mung6, seng4 tiu4 hoi2 tai4 dou1 bei6 cung1 wai2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場秋颱來得很猛，整條海堤都被沖毀了。
examples.english_sentence: This autumn typhoon hit very hard; the entire seawall was washed away.

mandarin_meaning: 秋高气爽
english_meaning: clear, crisp autumn weather; bright blue skies and refreshing air
explanation_mandarin: 形容秋天天氣晴朗、天空高遠、空氣清新、氣候宜人的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes the typical pleasant autumn weather characterized by clear skies, refreshing air, and a crisp feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今天天氣真係秋高氣爽，啱去公園散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 tin1 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 cau1 gou1 hei3 song2, ngaam1 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气真是秋高气爽，适合去公园散步。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is really clear and crisp today—perfect for a walk in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋高氣爽嘅日子最啱去遠足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 gou1 hei3 song2 ge3 jat6 zi2 zeoi3 ngaam1 heoi3 jyun5 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋高气爽的日子最适合去远足。
examples.english_sentence: Days with clear, crisp autumn weather are best for hiking.

mandarin_meaning: 耗（耗費；消耗）
english_meaning: to consume; to use up; to waste (time, money, energy, resources)
explanation_mandarin: 「秏」為漢字「耗」的異體字，表示消耗或耗費，可用於耗費時間、金錢、精力或資源等。
explanation_english: Variant of the character 耗. Indicates consuming or using up resources such as time, money, energy, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部冷氣好秏電，開少啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 laang5 hei3 hou2 hou6 din6, hoi1 siu2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這臺冷氣很耗電，少開一點吧。
examples.english_sentence: This air conditioner uses a lot of electricity — turn it on less.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁秏我時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 hou6 ngo5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別這樣浪費我的時間。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste my time like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲錢畀賭博秏晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 cin2 bei2 dou2 bok3 hou6 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的錢都被賭博耗光了。
examples.english_sentence: He used up all his money on gambling.

mandarin_meaning: 科；科目；科系；部門
english_meaning: subject; department; branch; field of study
explanation_mandarin: 表示學科、科系或某一專業領域或部門，如電腦科、內科、物理科等。
explanation_english: Refers to an academic subject, department, or a branch/field of specialization (e.g., computer science, internal medicine, physics).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學主修電腦科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 zyu2 sau1 din6 nou5 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學主修電腦科。
examples.english_sentence: I major in computer science at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去醫院睇眼科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 tai2 ngaan5 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去醫院看眼科。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the hospital ophthalmology department today.

mandarin_meaning: 科室主任；某個科/部門的負責人（常用於醫院、學校或機構）
english_meaning: department head; head of a department (often used in hospitals, schools, or other organizations)
explanation_mandarin: 指負責一個科或科室的主管或領導，通常負責該科的行政、教學或業務運作與管理。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in charge of a specific department or section, responsible for administrative, operational, or professional leadership within that department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋醫院嘅骨科主任話下星期會開會，大家要準備好報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji1 jyun2 ge3 gwat1 fo1 zyu2 jam6 waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 hoi1 wui6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zyun2 bei6 hou2 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們醫院的骨科主任說下星期會開會，大家要準備好報告。
examples.english_sentence: The head of orthopedics at our hospital said there will be a meeting next week; everyone should prepare their reports.

mandarin_meaning: 禮儀、儀式（多指宗教或民間的祭祀、法事或典禮）
english_meaning: ritual; ceremonial rites (often referring to religious or folk ceremonial procedures or liturgy)
explanation_mandarin: 科儀通常指宗教、廟宇或民間舉行的儀式、祭祀或法事程序，包含特定的步驟、誦經、祭品與禮節。
explanation_english: Refers to rituals or ceremonial rites, commonly used for religious, temple, or folk ceremonies and liturgies that follow prescribed procedures, chants, offerings, and rites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日村裡有科儀，大家要準時到場燒香拜祭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 cyun1 leoi5 jau5 fo1 ji4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 dou3 coeng4 siu1 hoeng1 baai3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天村裡有科儀，大家要準時到場燒香拜祭。
examples.english_sentence: There is a ritual in the village today; everyone should arrive on time to burn incense and pay respects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟裏嘅法師講緊科儀嘅程序同意義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 leoi5 ge3 faat3 si1 gong2 gan2 fo1 ji4 ge3 cing4 zeoi6 tung4 ji3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡的法師在講科儀的程序和意義。
examples.english_sentence: The temple masters are explaining the procedures and meanings of the ritual.

mandarin_meaning: （非標準用語／罕見）無固定含義；字面上可解作「科（部門/學科）+ 勞（勞動/勞力）」，或作音譯使用
english_meaning: (non-standard/rare) No established meaning; literally can be read as "department/discipline + labour", or may appear as a phonetic/transliterated form or typo
explanation_mandarin: 「科勞」並非常見的廣東話單詞或成語。常見情況包括：可能是網絡用語的音譯、打字錯誤，或以字面拆解作臨時用語。單字「科」讀作fo1，常見於「科學」；「勞」讀作lou4，意思與勞動有關。
explanation_english: "科勞" is not a commonly used Cantonese word or idiom. It may appear as a phonetic/transliterated slang term, a typo, or a coined expression. The character "科" (fo1) often appears in words like "science/department", and "勞" (lou4) relates to "labour/work" when read literally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到有人喺討論區寫「科勞」，但唔知佢意思係乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou3 jau5 jan4 hai2 tou2 leon6 keoi1 se2 "fo1 lou4", daan6 m4 zi1 keoi5 ji3 si1 hai6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到有人在討論區寫「科勞」，但不知道它是什麼意思。
examples.english_sentence: I saw someone write "科勞" in the forum, but I don't know what it means.

mandarin_meaning: （香港）香港科技大學（簡稱）
english_meaning: HKUST (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology) — abbreviation
explanation_mandarin: 「科大」通常指香港科技大學，是香港一所公立研究型大學的常用簡稱。
explanation_english: “科大” is the common short form for the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), a public research university in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥考入咗科大，讀電子工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 haau2 jap6 zo2 fo1 daai6, duk6 din6 zi2 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥考上了科大，讀電子工程。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother got into HKUST to study electronic engineering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去過科大個校園未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 gwo3 fo1 daai6 go3 haau6 jyun4 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去過科大校園嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you been to the HKUST campus?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科大將會舉辦一個公開講座，歡迎學生參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 daai6 zoeng1 wui5 geoi2 baan6 jat1 go3 gung1 hoi1 gong2 zo6, fun1 jing4 hok6 saang1 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科大將舉辦一個公開講座，歡迎學生參加。
examples.english_sentence: HKUST will hold a public lecture, and students are welcome to attend.

mandarin_meaning: 科威特（國名）
english_meaning: Kuwait (country)
explanation_mandarin: 位於阿拉伯半島附近的中東國家，全名為科威特國，首都是科威特城，以石油資源聞名。
explanation_english: A country in the Middle East near the Arabian Peninsula, officially the State of Kuwait. Its capital is Kuwait City and it is known for its oil resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去科威特出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 fo1 wai1 dak6 ceot1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去科威特出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Kuwait on a business trip next month.

mandarin_meaning: 科學 (kēxué)
english_meaning: science; scientific study
explanation_mandarin: 指以觀察、實驗和理論為基礎，系統性地研究自然與物質世界的知識體系與方法。
explanation_english: The systematic study of the natural and physical world through observation, experiment, and theorization; can refer to both the body of knowledge and the methods used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個就對科學好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 zau6 deoi3 fo1 hok6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候就對科學很有興趣。
examples.english_sentence: I've been interested in science since I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個實驗用咗科學方法驗證呢個理論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 jung6 zo2 fo1 hok6 fong1 faat3 jim6 zing3 ni1 go3 lei5 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个实验用了科学方法验证这个理论。
examples.english_sentence: This experiment used scientific methods to verify this theory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我哋需要更多科學證據先可以確定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gang1 do1 fo1 hok6 zing3 geoi3 sin1 ho2 ji5 kok3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我们需要更多的科学证据才能确定。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said we need more scientific evidence to be sure.

mandarin_meaning: 科学园（科技園區）
english_meaning: Science Park
explanation_mandarin: 指以科技研發、創新和初創企業為主的園區或科技園，通常有實驗室、辦公室和配套設施（如香港科學園）。
explanation_english: Refers to a park or campus focused on science, technology R&D and startups, typically housing labs, offices and support facilities (e.g., the Hong Kong Science Park).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺科學園做研發工程師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 fo1 hok6 jyun4 zou6 jin4 faat3 gung1 cing4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在科學園做研發工程師。
examples.english_sentence: I work as an R&D engineer at the Science Park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學園有好多科技公司同初創企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 jyun4 jau5 hou2 do1 fo1 gei6 gung1 si1 tung4 co1 cong3 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科學園有很多科技公司和初創企業。
examples.english_sentence: The Science Park has many tech companies and startups.

mandarin_meaning: 科学家 (kēxuéjiā)
english_meaning: scientist
explanation_mandarin: 指從事科學研究或實驗、在某一科學領域探索、發現和驗證自然規律的人。
explanation_english: A person who conducts scientific research or experiments, specializing in exploring, discovering, and verifying principles within a scientific field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想做一個科學家，細個已經鍾意做實驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 jat1 go3 fo1 hok6 gaa1, sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 zung1 ji3 zou6 sat6 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想當一個科學家，從小就喜歡做實驗。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be a scientist; he has liked doing experiments since childhood.

mandarin_meaning: 科学精神
english_meaning: scientific spirit; scientific mindset or attitude
explanation_mandarin: 指以科学的方法、理性和经验证据来探究、验证和解释事物的态度或精神。强调怀疑、实证和可重复性。
explanation_english: The attitude or mindset that emphasizes using scientific methods, rationality, and empirical evidence to investigate, verify, and explain phenomena; stresses skepticism, evidence, and reproducibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做研究要有科學精神，唔好淨係憑直覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jin4 gau3 jiu3 jau5 fo1 hok6 zing1 san4, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 pang4 zik6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做研究要有科学精神，不要只凭直觉。
examples.english_sentence: When doing research you must have a scientific spirit; don't rely only on intuition.

mandarin_meaning: 科學院（kēxuéyuàn）：從事科學研究或教學的機構
english_meaning: Academy of Sciences; a scientific institute or research academy
explanation_mandarin: 指專門從事科學研究、技術開發或高等科學教育的機構或單位，類似「科学院」或「科學研究院」。
explanation_english: Refers to an institution dedicated to scientific research, technological development, or higher scientific education; similar to an academy of sciences or a research institute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺香港嘅科學院做研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 fo1 hok6 jyun6 zou6 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在香港的科學院做研究。
examples.english_sentence: He/She conducts research at the Academy of Sciences in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府撥款俾科學院研究疫苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 but3 fun2 bei2 fo1 hok6 jyun6 jin4 gau3 jik6 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府撥款給科學院研究疫苗。
examples.english_sentence: The government funded the Academy of Sciences to research vaccines.

mandarin_meaning: 科幻 (kēhuàn)：指以科學或未來科技為基礎的虛構題材。
english_meaning: science fiction (sci‑fi); fiction based on scientific concepts or imagined future technology
explanation_mandarin: 指以科學為基礎，或想像未來科技、外太空、人工智慧等主題的虛構文學、電影或其他媒體類型。
explanation_english: A genre of fiction that is based on scientific concepts or imagines future technologies, space travel, AI, etc.; commonly appears in novels, films, and other media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意睇科幻電影，特別係關於太空旅行嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 fo1 waan6 din6 jing2, dak6 bit6 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 taai3 hung1 leoi5 hang4 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡看科幻電影，特別是關於太空旅行的那些。
examples.english_sentence: I like watching science fiction movies, especially those about space travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一部好出色嘅科幻小說，設定好有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 bou6 hou2 ceot1 sik1 ge3 fo1 waan6 siu2 seot3, sat1 ding6 hou2 jau5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫了一部很出色的科幻小說，設定非常有創意。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a very impressive science fiction novel; the setting is very creative.

mandarin_meaning: 科技 (kējì)
english_meaning: science and technology; technology
explanation_mandarin: 指科學與技術的總稱，常用來描述與技術研發、應用及相關產業的領域。
explanation_english: Refers to the combined fields of science and technology; often used to describe research, development, applications, and industries related to technological innovation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港要大力發展科技產業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jiu3 daai6 lik6 faat3 zin2 fo1 gei6 caan2 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港要大力发展科技产业。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong needs to vigorously develop the technology industry.

mandarin_meaning: 科技大学
english_meaning: University of Science and Technology; Technological University
explanation_mandarin: 指以科技、工程等為重點的高等教育院校，或作為學校名稱的一部分（例如「香港科技大學」）。
explanation_english: Refers to a higher-education institution focused on science, technology, and engineering, or used as part of a school's name (e.g., Hong Kong University of Science and Technology).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺香港科技大學讀緊電腦工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 fo1 gei6 daai6 hok6 duk6 gan2 din6 nou5 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在香港科技大學讀電腦工程。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying computer engineering at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

mandarin_meaning: 科摩罗
english_meaning: Comoros (country)
explanation_mandarin: 科摩罗是位於非洲東部印度洋的一個島國，位於馬達加斯加與莫桑比克之間，首都是莫羅尼。
explanation_english: Comoros is an island country in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa, located between Madagascar and Mozambique; its capital is Moroni.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科摩羅係一個位於印度洋嘅小國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 mo1 lo4 hai6 jat1 go3 wai6 jyu1 jan3 dou6 joeng4 ge3 siu2 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科摩罗是一个位于印度洋的小国。
examples.english_sentence: Comoros is a small country located in the Indian Ocean.

mandarin_meaning: （人名）科文，常作人名或音譯用，無固定詞義
english_meaning: Ke-wen (personal name) — often used as a transliteration; no established lexical meaning
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（專有名詞，罕用/名稱）
explanation_mandarin: 「科文」並非常用的粵語詞彙，通常出現作為人名或音譯（例如 Ke-wen/科文），在一般語境中並無固定的詞義。也可能在專業或機構名稱中作縮寫，但並不普遍。
explanation_english: “科文” is not a common Cantonese lexical item; it is most often encountered as a personal name or a transliteration (e.g., Ke-wen) and has no established independent meaning. It may occasionally appear as an abbreviation in specific institutional names, but this is not widespread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個朋友叫科文，佢成日用英文名 Kewen。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 giu3 fo1 man4, keoi5 seng4 jat6 jung6 jing1 man4 ming4 Kewen.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我朋友叫科文，他经常用英文名 Kewen。
examples.english_sentence: My friend is called Ke-wen; he often uses the English name Kewen.

mandarin_meaning: 科学普及（简称），指以通俗方式向大众传播科学知识
english_meaning: science popularization; popular science (the activity or materials that make scientific knowledge accessible to the public)
explanation_mandarin: “科普”是“科学普及”的简称，通常指通过讲座、书籍、影片等通俗形式把科学知识传播给大众，提升公众的科学素养。
explanation_english: “Ke-pu” is short for scientific popularization. It refers to making scientific knowledge accessible to the general public through talks, books, videos, and other popular formats to improve scientific literacy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書好適合做科普，內容淺顯易懂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 sik1 hap6 zou6 fo1 pou2, noi6 jung4 cin2 hin2 ji6 dung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书很适合做科普，内容浅显易懂。
examples.english_sentence: This book is great for popularizing science; the content is simple and easy to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校舉辦咗一場科普講座，吸引咗唔少學生參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 geoi2 baan6 zo2 jat1 coeng4 fo1 pou2 gong2 zo6, kap1 jan5 zo2 m4 siu2 hok6 saang1 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校举办了一场科普讲座，吸引了不少学生参加。
examples.english_sentence: The school held a popular science lecture that attracted many students to attend.

mandarin_meaning: 預算科目／撥款項目
english_meaning: budget appropriation / budget line item
explanation_mandarin: 在會計或政府預算中，指分類的經費科目或撥款項目，常見於「科、款、項、目」等預算分類用語中。
explanation_english: In accounting or government budgets, refers to a classified budget appropriation or line item. Often appears in budget classification terms such as 'division, appropriation, item, sub-item'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺預算案入面調整咗啲科款，資助教育同醫療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 jyu6 syun3 on3 jap6 min6 tiu4 zing2 zo2 di1 fo1 fun2, zi1 zo6 gaau3 juk6 tung4 ji1 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在預算案中調整了若干科款，以資助教育和醫療。
examples.english_sentence: The government adjusted certain budget appropriations in the budget to subsidize education and healthcare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 查清楚呢筆科款去咗邊先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 cing1 co2 ni1 bat1 fo1 fun2 heoi3 zo2 bin1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先查清楚這筆款項去了哪裡。
examples.english_sentence: First find out where this item of funds went.

mandarin_meaning: （香港俚語）調情、撩人（多為玩笑性質，不一定認真）
english_meaning: A Hong Kong slang term meaning to flirt or tease someone (often playfully and not seriously)
explanation_mandarin: 「科水」是香港廣東話的俚語，常用來形容在網上或現實中輕浮地調情、撩妹或撩人，多為開玩笑性質，未必有認真意思。
explanation_english: "科水" is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to describe flirting or teasing someone (often online). It typically implies playful, not-serious behaviour — chatting someone up or teasing them without genuine intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺聊天室度科水啲女仔，根本唔認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 liu4 tin1 sat1 dou6 fo1 seoi2 di1 neoi5 zai2, gan1 bun2 m4 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常在聊天室調情那些女生，根本不認真。
examples.english_sentence: He often flirts with girls in the chatroom; he's not serious.

mandarin_meaning: 不詳；地區性或罕見俚語，無廣泛記錄
english_meaning: Unclear/rare regional slang with no widely recorded or established meaning
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語（可能為名詞或感嘆詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「科爐」一詞在標準粵語詞典中少有記錄。字面上為「科」與「爐」，但作為俚語其確切含義在公開資料中不明，可能為地區性或圈子內用語。若遇到，應以語境或向當地說話者查詢為準。
explanation_english: The term "科爐" is not widely recorded in standard Cantonese references. Literally it combines the characters for "科" and "爐", but as slang its precise meaning is unclear in public sources. It appears to be a rare or highly local/regional expression; interpret by context or ask local speakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有人喺群組成日講「科爐」，我唔知佢哋講緊咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 jan4 hai2 kwan4 zou2 sing4 jat6 gong2 "fo1 lou4", ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 gong2 gan2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有人在群組裡總是說「科爐」，我不知道他們在說什麼。
examples.english_sentence: Lately someone in the group chat keeps saying "科爐"; I don't know what they mean.

mandarin_meaning: 科特迪瓦（象牙海岸）
english_meaning: Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), a country in West Africa
explanation_mandarin: 科特迪瓦（法語：Côte d'Ivoire），通稱象牙海岸，是位於非洲西部的國家，官方語言為法語，首都為亞穆蘇克羅（行政首都），最大城市為阿比讓。
explanation_english: Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast) is a country in West Africa. Its official language is French; the political capital is Yamoussoukro and the largest city is Abidjan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去科特迪瓦旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 fo1 dak6 dik6 ngaa5 leoi5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去科特迪瓦旅游。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Côte d'Ivoire next month.

mandarin_meaning: 科目 (kēmù)
english_meaning: subject (in school or exam)
explanation_mandarin: 指學校、課程或考試中的單一門類，例如數學、英文等，是教育或考試裡的分類單位。
explanation_english: Refers to a single subject or course within a school's curriculum or an exam (e.g., Mathematics, English); a category used in education and examinations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個學期我要修五科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 jiu3 sau1 ng5 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個學期我要修五門課。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking five subjects this semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最鍾意邊一科？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 jat1 fo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最喜歡哪一科？
examples.english_sentence: Which subject do you like the most?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試包括三個科目嘅筆試同口試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 baau1 kut3 saam1 go3 fo1 muk6 ge3 bat1 si3 tung4 hau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試包括三門科目的筆試和口試。
examples.english_sentence: This exam includes written and oral tests for three subjects.

mandarin_meaning: 科学研究
english_meaning: scientific research
explanation_mandarin: “科研”是“科学研究”的简称，指在科学领域进行系统性研究与实验的活动或工作。
explanation_english: Abbreviation of "scientific research"; refers to systematic research and experimental work carried out in scientific fields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學做科研，專注於基因研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 zou6 fo1 jin4, zyun1 zyu3 jyu1 gei1 jan1 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学做科研，专注于基因研究。
examples.english_sentence: He does scientific research at the university, focusing on gene studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會加大對科研嘅資助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 gaa1 daai6 deoi3 fo1 jin4 ge3 zi1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府说会加大对科研的资助。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will increase funding for scientific research.

mandarin_meaning: 科研 (科学研究)
english_meaning: scientific research; R&D (research and development)
explanation_mandarin: “科硏”为“科研”（科學研究）的變體寫法，指從事或進行科學研究的活動、領域或相關工作。
explanation_english: "科硏" is a variant writing of "科研" (scientific research). It refers to activities, fields, or work involving scientific research or R&D.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學做科硏，主要研究人工智能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 zou6 fo1 jin4, zyu2 jiu3 jin4 gau3 jan4 gung1 zi6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学做科研，主要研究人工智能。
examples.english_sentence: He does research at the university, mainly studying artificial intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有個科硏團隊，負責新產品嘅開發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 go3 fo1 jin4 tyun4 deoi6, fu6 zaak3 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 hoi1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有个科研团队，负责新产品的开发。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has an R&D team responsible for developing new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想做科硏，要讀博士先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 fo1 jin4, jiu3 duk6 bok3 si6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想做科研，要先读博士。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to do research; he needs to get a PhD first.

mandarin_meaning: 科索沃（Kēsuǒwò），位於巴爾幹半島的地區，2008年宣布自塞爾維亞獨立，為一部分國家承認的國家/地區名稱
english_meaning: Kosovo (a territory in the Balkans that declared independence from Serbia in 2008; recognized by some countries)
explanation_mandarin: 科索沃是位於東南歐巴爾幹地區的一個地名。2008年宣布獨立，但國際承認情況存在爭議，並與塞爾維亞關係敏感。
explanation_english: Kosovo is a place name in the Balkans of southeastern Europe. It declared independence in 2008; its international recognition is partial and its status is politically sensitive with Serbia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃下年去科索沃旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 haa6 nin4 heoi3 fo1 sok3 wok6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們計劃明年去科索沃旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We plan to travel to Kosovo next year.

mandarin_meaning: 科技網絡（指科技與互聯網行業）
english_meaning: technology and internet (sector); tech and internet industries
explanation_mandarin: 「科網」是香港常用的縮略語，指與科技和互聯網有關的行業或領域，常用於談論科網股、科網公司或科網經濟。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial abbreviation referring to the technology and internet sector or industry, often used when discussing tech stocks, tech companies, or the tech-and-internet economy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年科網股表現波動，好多投資者好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 fo1 mong5 gu2 biu2 jin2 bo1 dung6, hou2 do1 tau4 zi1 ze2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年科網股表現波動，很多投資者很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: This year tech-and-internet stocks have been volatile; many investors are worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港要發展科網經濟，就要培育更多人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jiu3 faat3 zin2 fo1 mong5 ging1 zai3, zau6 jiu3 pui4 juk6 gang1 do1 jan4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港要發展科網經濟，就要培育更多人才。
examples.english_sentence: For Hong Kong to develop a tech-and-internet economy, it needs to nurture more talent.

mandarin_meaning: 科举（古代选拔官员的考试制度）
english_meaning: imperial examination (the civil service examination system in imperial China)
explanation_mandarin: 科舉是中國古代用來選拔官員的考試制度，始於隋唐並於清末廢除，對教育、社會流動與官僚體制有深遠影響。
explanation_english: The imperial examination system used in imperial China to select civil officials. It developed from the Sui–Tang period and lasted until its abolition in the late Qing, profoundly shaping education, social mobility, and the bureaucracy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代啲讀書人都渴望靠科舉上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 di1 duk6 syu1 jan4 dou1 hot3 mong6 kaau3 fo1 geoi2 soeng5 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的读书人都渴望靠科举出人头地。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, scholars hoped to gain status through the imperial examinations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史課提到科舉制度對中國社會影響好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 fo3 tai4 dou3 fo1 geoi2 zai3 dou6 deoi3 zung1 gwok3 se5 wui6 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史课提到科举制度对中国社会的影响很深。
examples.english_sentence: History class mentioned that the imperial examination system had a deep impact on Chinese society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然科舉已經廢除，但佢嘅價值觀仲係有影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 fo1 geoi2 ji5 ging1 fai3 ceoi4, daan6 keoi5 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gwaan1 zung6 hai6 jau5 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然科举已经废除，但它的价值观仍然有影响。
examples.english_sentence: Although the imperial exams were abolished, their values still have influence.

mandarin_meaning: 罚款；处以金钱处罚
english_meaning: to fine; to impose a monetary penalty (or a fine)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，指对某人处以金钱处罚（罚款），也可指被处以罚款或扣钱。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term meaning to impose a monetary penalty (to fine someone) or to be fined; can also refer to docking money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺停車位唔泊正，俾人科咗五百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ting4 ce1 wai6 m4 bok6 zing3, bei2 jan4 fo1 zo2 ng5 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在停车位没停好，被罚了五百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't park properly in the parking spot and was fined 500 dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司因為佢遲到，科咗佢半日薪水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 keoi5 ci4 dou3, fo1 zo2 keoi5 bun3 jat6 san1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司因为他迟到，扣了他半天的薪水。
examples.english_sentence: The company docked him half a day's pay for being late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰張罰單要快啲交，唔交會俾政府再科你多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zoeng1 fat6 daan1 jiu3 faai3 di1 gaau1, m4 gaau1 wui5 bei2 zing3 fu2 zoi3 fo1 nei5 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那张罚单要快点交，不交的话政府会再罚你更多钱。
examples.english_sentence: You need to pay that ticket quickly — if you don't, the government will fine you even more.

mandarin_meaning: 科長（部門或科室的負責人）
english_meaning: section chief; section head
explanation_mandarin: 表示在機構、部門或科室中負責日常行政、協調與管理工作的職務稱呼，常見於政府機構或大型公司內部職級。
explanation_english: Refers to the position in an organization responsible for overseeing the daily administration, coordination, and management of a section; commonly used in government agencies and larger companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司話下星期安排我上去見科長，要傾新嘅項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 on1 paai4 ngo5 soeng5 heoi3 gin3 fo1 zoeng2, jiu3 king1 san1 ge3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司說下星期安排我去見科長，要商量新的項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company said they'll arrange for me to meet the section chief next week to discuss a new project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺政府度，科長係負責一個科嘅日常行政工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 fu2 dou6, fo1 zoeng2 hai6 fu6 zaak3 jat1 go3 fo1 ge3 jat6 soeng4 hang4 zing3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在政府機構裡，科長負責一個科的日常行政工作。
examples.english_sentence: In government agencies, the section chief is responsible for the daily administrative tasks of a section.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿叔喺社署做科長，平時好忙，要處理好多文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 suk1 hai2 se5 cyu5 zou6 fo1 zoeng2, ping4 si4 hou2 mong4, jiu3 cyu2 lei5 hou2 do1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叔叔在社署當科長，他平時很忙，要處理很多文件。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle is a section chief at the social welfare department; he's usually very busy and has to handle lots of documents.

mandarin_meaning: 科技騷（貶義，指花巧的科技展示或演示，常暗示缺乏實際用途）
english_meaning: tech demo / tech showcase (pejorative: a flashy technology demonstration that often lacks practical value)
explanation_mandarin: 「科騷」為粵語俗語，常作「科技騷」的縮寫，用來形容那些以炫技或噱頭為主、但未必有實際應用的科技展示或演示，語氣多帶批評或嘲諷。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term, short for "科技騷" (technology show). It refers to flashy tech demonstrations or showcases that emphasize gimmicks or spectacle rather than practical utility; often used critically or sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新產品只係一個科騷，冇實際用途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 caan2 ban2 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 fo1 sou1, mou5 sat6 zai3 jung6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個新產品只是一個科騷，沒有實際用途。
examples.english_sentence: This new product is just a tech demo — it has no practical use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者話佢哋嗰場發佈會多數係科騷，主要係吸引投資同宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 waa6 keoi5 dei6 go2 coeng4 faat3 bou3 wui6 do1 sou3 hai6 fo1 sou1, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 kap1 jan5 tau4 zi1 tung4 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記者說他們那場發佈會多半是科騷，主要是為了吸引投資和宣傳。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters said their launch event was mostly a tech-show — mainly aimed at attracting investment and publicity.

mandarin_meaning: 秒 (miǎo) — 时间单位，指一秒钟；也可表示瞬间、极短的时间
english_meaning: second (unit of time); a moment, an instant
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间单位的一秒钟，也可用来指非常短的瞬间或在网络用语中表示“瞬间被抢光/被擊敗”（如“秒殺”）。
explanation_english: Denotes the time unit 'second' (one-sixtieth of a minute); can also mean a very brief instant. In slang contexts (e.g., 秒殺) it means to be taken/sold out or defeated instantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣，等我幾秒鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6, dang2 ngo5 gei2 miu5 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下，等我幾秒鐘。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment, wait a few seconds for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個鐘嘅秒針走得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zung1 ge3 miu5 zan1 zau2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鐘的秒針走得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The clock's second hand is moving fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲熱賣貨好快就被秒殺晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jit6 maai6 fo3 hou2 faai3 zau6 bei6 miu5 saat3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些熱賣的商品很快就被秒殺了。
examples.english_sentence: Those hot-selling items were snapped up in seconds.

mandarin_meaning: 秒回（在几秒内回复）
english_meaning: instant reply; to reply within seconds
explanation_mandarin: 网络/口语用语，表示在几秒内回复信息或訊息，形容回复非常迅速，常见于社交媒体和即时通讯场景。
explanation_english: A colloquial/online slang term meaning to reply to a message within seconds — to respond almost instantly. Commonly used on social media and in instant messaging contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發咗訊息俾佢，佢竟然秒回，真係好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 zo2 seon3 sik1 bei2 keoi5, keoi5 ging2 jin4 miu5 wui4, zan1 hai6 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我发了信息给他，他竟然秒回，真快。
examples.english_sentence: I sent him a message and he replied instantly — so fast.

mandarin_meaning: 秒级差距；以秒为单位的微小差距
english_meaning: a gap of seconds; a very small margin measured in seconds
explanation_mandarin: 指雙方或多方在時間（通常是比賽或計時）上僅相差幾秒的微小差距；也可用作比喻形容非常接近的差距。
explanation_english: Refers to a very small difference measured in seconds (often in races, timings, or comparisons); can also be used metaphorically for a very narrow margin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次馬拉松佢只係輸咗兩秒，真係秒差距。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 maa5 laai1 cung1 keoi5 zi2 hai6 syu1 zo2 loeng5 miu5, zan1 hai6 miu5 caa1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次马拉松他只输了两秒，真是秒差距。
examples.english_sentence: He lost the marathon by just two seconds — a matter of seconds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌同第一位只係有少少秒差距，仲有機會反超。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 tung4 dai6 jat1 wai6 zi2 hai6 jau5 siu2 siu2 miu5 caa1 keoi1, zung6 jau5 gei1 wui6 faan2 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌和第一名之间只有几秒的差距，还有机会反超。
examples.english_sentence: This song is only a few seconds behind the number-one spot; it still might overtake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩隊嘅反應時間相差幾秒，呢啲秒差距決定咗勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 deoi6 ge3 faan2 jing3 si4 gaan3 soeng1 caa1 gei2 miu5, ni1 di1 miu5 caa1 keoi1 kyut3 ding6 zo2 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两队的反应时间相差几秒，这些秒差距决定了胜负。
examples.english_sentence: The two teams' reaction times differed by several seconds; those second-level gaps decided the outcome.

mandarin_meaning: 秒杀（迅速击败或瞬间售罄）
english_meaning: to kill/defeat instantly; to sell out immediately (internet slang)
explanation_mandarin: 原本用於遊戲或武俠語境表示瞬間擊敗對手，現亦常用於網絡或商業語境，表示商品在短時間內被搶購一空或一瞬間被壓倒性擊敗。
explanation_english: Originally from gaming meaning to defeat someone instantly in one hit; now also used online/commercially to mean something is bought out immediately or overwhelmingly beaten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部新電話一開賣就被秒殺晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 jat1 hoi1 maai6 zau6 bei6 miu5 saat3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部新手機一上市就被秒殺了。
examples.english_sentence: That new phone was sold out the moment it went on sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面一招就秒殺咗對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 jat1 ziu1 zau6 miu5 saat3 zo2 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比賽中一招就把對手秒殺了。
examples.english_sentence: He eliminated his opponent in the match in one move.

mandarin_meaning: 秒表 (miǎobiǎo)：用于精确测量经过时间的计时器
english_meaning: stopwatch — a device used to measure elapsed time precisely (usually in seconds)
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于测量经过时间（通常以秒为单位）的计时器，常用于比赛、训练或科学实验中记录时间间隔。
explanation_english: A timer used to measure elapsed time (typically in seconds); commonly used in races, training, labs, and other situations requiring precise timing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽開始，裁判用秒表計時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 hoi1 ci2, coi4 pun3 jung6 miu5 biu2 gai3 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛开始，裁判用秒表计时。
examples.english_sentence: When the race starts, the referee times it with a stopwatch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做實驗嘅時候要用秒表去量反應時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 sat6 jim6 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 jung6 miu5 biu2 heoi3 loeng4 faan2 jing3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做实验的时候要用秒表去量反应时间。
examples.english_sentence: You need to use a stopwatch to measure reaction time during the experiment.

mandarin_meaning: 秒表
english_meaning: stopwatch
explanation_mandarin: 用來測量短時間的計時器，常用於比賽、訓練或實驗中。可指獨立的計時裝置或電子設備內的秒表功能。
explanation_english: A timing device used to measure short intervals, commonly used in competitions, training, or experiments. Can refer to a standalone instrument or a stopwatch function on electronic devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽開始前，裁判會啟動秒錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 hoi1 ci2 cin4, coi4 pun3 wui5 kai2 dung6 miu5 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛开始前，裁判会启动秒表。
examples.english_sentence: Before the race begins, the referee will start the stopwatch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用手機嘅秒錶記錄跑步時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 ge3 miu5 biu1 gei3 luk6 paau2 bou6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用手机的秒表记录跑步时间。
examples.english_sentence: I use the stopwatch on my phone to record my running time.

mandarin_meaning: 秒钟（时间单位）
english_meaning: second (unit of time)
explanation_mandarin: 表示時間的單位，相當於一秒。可用於口語與書面語，表示經過或剩餘的秒數。
explanation_english: A unit of time equal to one second. Used in both spoken and written contexts to indicate elapsed or remaining seconds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我一秒鐘，我即刻嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 jat1 miu5 zung1, ngo5 zik1 hak1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我一秒钟，我马上来。
examples.english_sentence: Wait one second, I'll come right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間淨係得十秒鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 zing6 hai6 dak1 sap6 miu5 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间只剩十秒钟。
examples.english_sentence: There are only ten seconds left.

mandarin_meaning: 秘，意思是秘密；也可作前缀表示隐秘、专有的不公开内容（拼音：mì）
english_meaning: secret; hidden; used as a prefix to indicate something confidential or exclusive
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词/名词；亦可作前缀
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / noun; also used as a prefix
explanation_mandarin: 單字「秘」表示隱秘、不公開的事物，常見於復合詞如「秘方」「秘訣」「秘聞」。
explanation_english: The character '秘' denotes something secret or concealed. It's commonly used in compounds such as 'secret recipe', 'secret tip', or 'secrets/scandals'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係公司嘅秘方，唔可以外傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 bei3 fong1, m4 ho2 ji5 ngoi6 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這是公司的秘方，不可以外傳。
examples.english_sentence: This is the company's secret recipe; it must not be shared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有啲秘訣，令工作做得快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 di1 bei3 kyut3, ling6 gung1 zok3 zou6 dak1 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一些秘訣，讓工作做得更快。
examples.english_sentence: He has some secret tips that make the work go faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章講緊啲歷史嘅秘聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 gong2 gan2 di1 lik6 si2 ge3 bei3 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇文章在講一些歷史的秘聞。
examples.english_sentence: This article discusses some historical secrets/scandals.

mandarin_meaning: 秘史（mìshǐ）：指隱秘或非公開的歷史記載或內幕
english_meaning: secret history; hidden or unofficial historical account
explanation_mandarin: 指隱藏、不為人知或非官方的歷史記載或內幕，常包含秘聞、醜聞或私人軼事，可能來源非正式或有爭議。
explanation_english: Refers to hidden or unofficial historical accounts or behind-the-scenes stories, often involving secrets, scandals, or private anecdotes; sources may be informal or contested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一本關於王朝秘史嘅書，引起好大爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 bun2 gwaan1 jyu1 wong4 ciu4 bei3 si2 ge3 syu1, jan5 hei2 hou2 daai6 zang1 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了一本关于王朝秘史的书，引起很大争议。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a book about the secret history of the dynasty, which caused great controversy.

mandarin_meaning: 秘密（mìmì）；隱藏、不公開的事情或資訊
english_meaning: secret; something hidden or kept from others
explanation_mandarin: 指不讓他人知道或被隱藏起來的事情、資訊或情況，可能是私人或機密的內容。
explanation_english: Refers to information, matters, or situations intentionally kept hidden from others; can describe something private or confidential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個秘密，唔想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 bei3 mat6, m4 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有個秘密，不想說。
examples.english_sentence: I have a secret; I don't want to tell (it).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係秘密，唔好透露俾其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 bei3 mat6, m4 hou2 tau3 lou6 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事是秘密，不要透露給其他人。
examples.english_sentence: This is a secret; don't reveal it to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將秘密藏起嚟，冇一個人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 bei3 mat6 cong4 hei2 lai4, mou5 jat1 go3 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把秘密藏起來，沒有人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He hid the secret; nobody knows.

mandarin_meaning: 秘密武器 (mìmì wǔqì) — 用來比喻達成目標的關鍵手段或優勢
english_meaning: secret weapon — a hidden advantage, decisive tool, or strategy used to gain success
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事在特定情況下能帶來顯著優勢的隱藏手段或策略，常用作比喻。
explanation_english: Refers to a hidden means or strategy that provides a significant advantage in a particular situation; commonly used metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢件事嘅秘密武器係佢嘅人脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 bei3 mat6 mou5 hei3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 jan4 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這件事的秘密武器是他的人脈。
examples.english_sentence: His secret weapon in this matter is his network of contacts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅秘密武器係嗰部新相機，影相好出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 bei3 mat6 mou5 hei3 hai6 go2 bou6 san1 soeng2 gei1, jing2 soeng2 hou2 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的秘密武器是那部新相機，拍照效果很好。
examples.english_sentence: Their secret weapon is that new camera; the photos come out great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嘅秘密武器唔係作弊，而係有系統嘅複習安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 ge3 bei3 mat6 mou5 hei3 m4 hai6 zou6 bei6, ji4 hai6 jau5 hai6 tung2 ge3 fuk1 zaap6 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試的秘密武器不是作弊，而是有系統的複習安排。
examples.english_sentence: The secret weapon for exams isn't cheating but a systematic review schedule.

mandarin_meaning: 秘密警察（指以秘密方式運作、監視和鎮壓異議的警察或機構，常帶政治性）
english_meaning: Secret police (law-enforcement agents or agencies that operate covertly to monitor, suppress, or eliminate political dissent)
explanation_mandarin: 指由國家或政權以秘密方式運作，負責監視、滲透、壓制異議分子或政治反對者的警察組織或機構，常帶有政治鎮壓性質。
explanation_english: Refers to police forces or agencies that operate covertly to surveil, infiltrate, intimidate, arrest, or eliminate political opponents or dissidents; typically associated with political repression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話政府有秘密警察，會暗中監視反對派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zing3 fu2 jau5 bei3 mat6 ging2 caat3, wui5 aam3 zung1 gaam1 si6 faan2 deoi3 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說政府有秘密警察，會暗中監視反對派。
examples.english_sentence: He said the government has secret police that secretly monitor the opposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚畀秘密警察發現，唔敢喺度講太多意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 bei2 bei3 mat6 ging2 caat3 faat3 jin6, m4 gam2 hai2 dou6 gong2 taai3 do1 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕被秘密警察發現，不敢在這裡說太多意見。
examples.english_sentence: He's afraid of being discovered by the secret police and doesn't dare to voice many opinions here.

mandarin_meaning: 秘技 / 秘诀（mìjì）
english_meaning: secret technique; trick; hack; handy tip
explanation_mandarin: 指隐藏或不常公开的技巧或訣竅，通常用来形容能提高效率或解决问题的小窍门，语气有时带玩笑或夸张成分。
explanation_english: Refers to a secret technique or trick — a handy tip or hack that makes something easier or more effective; often used playfully or informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇啲秘技可以分享？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 di1 bei3 gei6 ho2 ji5 fan1 hoeng2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有一些秘技可以分享？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any secret tricks you can share?

mandarin_meaning: 暗中撈取（錢財或好處）；秘密牟利，偷拿回扣
english_meaning: to secretly skim profits or pocket money; to take kickbacks or illicit side earnings
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指在公事或生意中暗自撈取利益或回扣，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to secretly take money or benefits (e.g., skim funds, pocket kickbacks) often with corrupt or dishonest intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面秘撈，偷咗好多公款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 jap6min6 bei3 lou1, tau1 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡暗中撈油水，偷了很多公款。
examples.english_sentence: He was secretly skimming money at the company and stole a lot of funds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做呢單生意唔好秘撈，要講明分賬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ni1 daan1 sang1 ji3 m4 hou2 bei3 lou1, jiu3 gong2 ming4 fan1 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做這筆生意不要暗自撈油水，要說清楚分帳。
examples.english_sentence: Don't secretly take a cut in this deal; make the profit split explicit.

mandarin_meaning: 秘方 (mìfāng) — 秘密的配方或處方
english_meaning: secret recipe; secret formula; special/secret remedy
explanation_mandarin: 指秘密或不公開的配方、處方，常用於家傳藥方、獨門食譜或特效配方。
explanation_english: Refers to a secret or undisclosed recipe/formula, often used for family remedies, unique recipes, or special formulas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個湯係我奶奶嘅秘方，飲咗可以補身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tong1 hai6 ngo5 naai5naai5 ge3 bei3 fong1, jam2 zo2 ho2 ji5 bou2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个汤是我奶奶的秘方，喝了可以补身。
examples.english_sentence: This soup is my grandmother's secret recipe; drinking it can help nourish the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔願透露佢生意成功嘅秘方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 jyun6 tau3 lou6 keoi5 saang1 ji3 seng4 gung1 ge3 bei3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不愿透露他生意成功的秘方。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to reveal the secret to his business success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本食譜有好多秘方，唔好隨便跟住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 sik6 pou2 jau5 hou2 do1 bei3 fong1, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin6 gan1 zyu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本食谱有很多秘方，不要随便照着做。
examples.english_sentence: This cookbook contains many secret recipes; don't follow them blindly.

mandarin_meaning: 秘书
english_meaning: secretary; administrative assistant
explanation_mandarin: 指在公司、機構或個人身邊，負責處理文書、行程安排、聯絡等行政事務的人。
explanation_english: A person who handles clerical and administrative tasks such as correspondence, scheduling, and coordination for a company, organization, or individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司請咗一個新秘書，佢負責整理文件同安排會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 bei3 syu1, keoi5 fu6 zaak3 zing2 lei5 man4 gin6 tung4 on1 paai4 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司聘請了一位新秘书，她負責整理文件和安排會議。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired a new secretary; she is responsible for organizing documents and scheduling meetings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秘書幫老闆處理郵件同電話，保持日常聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 syu1 bong1 lou5 baan2 cyu2 lei5 jau4 gin2 tung4 din6 waa2, bou2 ci4 jat6 soeng4 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘书帮老板处理邮件和电话，保持日常联络。
examples.english_sentence: The secretary handles mail and phone calls for the boss and keeps daily communications.

mandarin_meaning: 秘书台（秘书的办公台或接待/咨询柜台）
english_meaning: secretary's desk / secretariat desk (the reception or secretarial counter where administrative tasks and inquiries are handled)
explanation_mandarin: 指公司、機構或活動中負責接待、收發文件或處理行政事務的秘書所使用的桌子或服務櫃台，也可泛指秘書部門的接待處。
explanation_english: Refers to the desk or counter where secretaries work—handling reception, document submission, and administrative matters. It can also refer generally to the secretarial/reception area of an office or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 文件擺喺秘書台就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man4 gin6 baai2 hai2 bei3 syu1 toi4 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把文件放在秘书台就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Just leave the document on the secretary's desk.

mandarin_meaning: 秘書長 (mìshūzhǎng)
english_meaning: secretary-general; chief secretary/administrative head of an organization
explanation_mandarin: 秘書長是組織、機構或團體中負責日常行政、協調與管理工作的主要職務，通常是秘書處或秘書團隊的領導人。
explanation_english: The secretary-general is the principal administrative officer of an organization, responsible for daily administration, coordination, and management; often the head of the secretariat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係聯合國嘅秘書長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 lyun4 hap6 gwok3 ge3 bei3 syu1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是聯合國的秘書長。
examples.english_sentence: He is now the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議上，秘書長發表咗報告，總結咗呢個年度嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 soeng6, bei3 syu1 zoeng2 faat3 biu2 zo2 bou3 gou3, zung2 git3 zo2 ni1 go3 nin4 dou6 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在會議上，秘書長發表了報告，總結了這個年度的工作。
examples.english_sentence: At the meeting, the secretary-general delivered a report summarizing the year's work.

mandarin_meaning: 秘笈（指秘傳的書籍或收集的祕密技巧、方法）
english_meaning: secret manual; a collection of secret techniques or tips
explanation_mandarin: 指記載秘傳技藝、竅門或秘方的書籍或手稿，也可泛指獨門的技巧或方法，常用於武術、烹飪、工作技巧等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to a secret or esoteric manual that records special skills, tricks, or recipes. It can also broadly mean a set of exclusive tips or techniques, often used for martial arts, cooking, or practical work tips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗我一本秘笈，裏面有啲好實用嘅工作小技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 bun2 bei3 gap1, leoi5 min6 jau5 di1 hou2 sat6 jung6 ge3 gung1 zok3 siu2 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我一本秘笈，里面有一些很实用的工作小技巧。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a secret manual that contains some very useful little work tips.

mandarin_meaning: 保密，不公開說明或宣佈
english_meaning: to keep something secret; not to disclose or announce; to say nothing about it
explanation_mandarin: 指對某事保密，不向外界公開說明或宣佈詳情。
explanation_english: Indicates keeping a matter secret — not revealing, announcing, or explaining details to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司對於呢件事秘而不宣，員工都覺得好奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 deoi3 jyu1 ni1 gin6 si6 bei3 ji4 bat1 syun1, jyun4 gung1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司對於這件事秘而不宣，員工都覺得好奇。
examples.english_sentence: The company kept this matter secret; the employees are curious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對呢個計劃秘而不宣，未有人知詳情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 bei3 ji4 bat1 syun1, mei6 jau5 jan4 zi1 coeng4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們對這個計劃秘而不宣，沒有人知道詳情。
examples.english_sentence: They kept the plan secret; no one knows the details.

mandarin_meaning: 秘制（用秘方或獨特方法製作）
english_meaning: made with a secret recipe; specially prepared (house/special-made)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用秘方或特別方法製作，通常強調風味獨特或配方保密，常見於菜品或調味料的描述。
explanation_english: Indicates something made with a secret recipe or special preparation method, often emphasizing a distinctive flavor or proprietary formula; commonly used to describe dishes or sauces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅秘製燒鴨好正，汁好入味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 bei3 zai3 siu1 ngaap3 hou2 zeng3, zap1 hou2 jap6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的秘製燒鴨很好，醬汁很入味。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's secret-recipe roast duck is excellent; the sauce is very flavorful.

mandarin_meaning: 秘诀 (mìjué)：达到某种效果或成功的秘密方法或关键技巧
english_meaning: a secret, tip, or key method for achieving a desired result or success
explanation_mandarin: 指為了達到某個目的而不公開或特別有效的做法、技巧或關鍵方法，可用於各種情境如工作、烹飪、學習等。
explanation_english: Refers to a special or often not widely known method, trick, or key technique that helps achieve a goal; used for contexts like work, cooking, study, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢教咗我幾個煮嘢嘅秘訣，依家我煮嘢又快又好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 gei2 go3 zyu2 je5 ge3 bei3 kyut3, ji1 gaa1 ngo5 zyu2 je5 jau6 faai3 jau6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他教了我幾個煮菜的秘訣，現在我煮菜又快又好吃。
examples.english_sentence: He taught me some cooking tips; now I cook faster and it tastes better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做演講嘅秘訣係準備周詳同埋多啲練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jin2 gong2 ge3 bei3 kyut3 hai6 zeon2 bei6 zau1 coeng4 tung4 maai4 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做演講的秘訣是充分準備和多加練習。
examples.english_sentence: The secret to giving a good speech is thorough preparation and plenty of practice.

mandarin_meaning: 秘道（mì dào）：秘密的通道、暗道
english_meaning: secret passage; hidden passageway
explanation_mandarin: 指隱藏或秘密的通道，常見於城堡、古建築或小說、電影情節中，常用於避難、逃生或秘密出入。
explanation_english: Refers to a hidden or secret passageway, often found in castles, old buildings, or in fiction; typically used for hiding, escaping, or secret access.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座城堡入面有條秘道，當年用嚟逃走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 sing4 bou2 jap6 min6 jau5 tiu4 bei3 dou6, dong1 nin4 jung6 lai4 tou4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座城堡裡面有條秘道，當年用來逃走。
examples.english_sentence: There is a secret passage inside this castle; it was used back then to escape.

mandarin_meaning: 秘鲁（南美洲的国家）
english_meaning: Peru (a country in South America)
explanation_mandarin: 秘鲁是位于南美洲西部的国家，首都为利马，以安第斯山脉、马丘比丘和亚马逊雨林闻名。
explanation_english: Peru is a country in western South America, with capital Lima, known for the Andes mountains, Machu Picchu, and the Amazon rainforest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秘魯喺南美洲，佢有好多山同雨林。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei3 lou5 hai2 naam4 mei5 zau1, keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 saan1 tung4 jyu5 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秘鲁在南美洲，那里有很多山和雨林。
examples.english_sentence: Peru is in South America; it has many mountains and rainforests.

mandarin_meaning: 租（租赁；出租）
english_meaning: rent; to rent; to lease
explanation_mandarin: 表示支付費用以暫時使用某物，或將物件交付他人使用並收取費用（租賃）。
explanation_english: To pay for the temporary use of something, or to let someone use something in exchange for payment (rent/lease).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想租一間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zo1 jat1 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想租一間房子。
examples.english_sentence: I want to rent a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個單位每個月租兩千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan1 wai6 mui5 go3 jyut6 zo1 loeng5 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個單位每個月的租金是兩千元。
examples.english_sentence: The rent for this unit is 2,000 HKD per month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋已經將間屋租咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 zo1 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們已經把房子租出去了。
examples.english_sentence: They have already rented out the house.

mandarin_meaning: 租住 (zūzhù)
english_meaning: to rent and live in; to reside as a tenant
explanation_mandarin: 表示以租賃方式居住在某處，通常指以租屋或租房的形式居住。
explanation_english: To live in a place by renting it; to reside as a tenant rather than owning the residence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家租住喺九龍嘅一間細單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zo1 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4 ge3 jat1 gaan1 sai3 daan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在租住在九龙的一间小单元。
examples.english_sentence: I'm currently renting and living in a small unit in Kowloon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔想買樓，選擇繼續租住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 dei6 m4 soeng2 maai5 lau4, syun2 zaak6 gai3 zuk6 zo1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不想买房，选择继续租住。
examples.english_sentence: They don't want to buy property; they choose to continue renting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋決定同朋友一齊租住，分擔租金同埋開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 zo1 zyu6, fan1 daam1 zo1 gam1 tung4 maai4 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们决定和朋友一起租住，分担租金和开支。
examples.english_sentence: We decided to rent and live together with friends to share the rent and expenses.

mandarin_meaning: 租借 (zūjiè) — 租用或暫時借用
english_meaning: to rent or lease; to borrow temporarily (often with payment)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以付費或約定方式暫時使用某物，既可指租用（租賃），亦可指臨時借用（借用），常用於設備、車輛或場地等場景。
explanation_english: Indicates temporarily using something by renting or borrowing (often involving payment or an agreement). Commonly used for equipment, vehicles, venues, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家想租借一部單車去市區周圍行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 soeng2 zo1 ze3 jat1 bou6 daan1 ce1 heoi3 si5 keoi1 zau1 wai4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在想租借一輛單車去市區四處逛。
examples.english_sentence: I want to rent a bicycle now to go around the city.

mandarin_meaning: 值得租／值得付費觀看
english_meaning: worth renting; worth paying to watch/use
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俚語，用來表示某樣東西（尤指影視、節目或其他需付費租借的內容）值得花錢租來看或使用，類似「值得租」或「很划算」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial slang term used to say something (especially movies, series, or other rentable/paid content) is worth renting or paying for — similar to 'worth renting' or 'a good value'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇喺網上租嚟睇真係好租值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 hai2 mong5 seong6 zou1 lai4 tai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zou1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部劇在網上租來看真的很值得。
examples.english_sentence: This series is really worth renting online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次租嘅電影好租值，特效同故事都唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zou1 ge3 din6 jing2 hou2 zou1 zik6, dak6 haau6 tung4 gu3 si6 dou1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次租的電影很值得，特效和故事都不錯。
examples.english_sentence: The movie I rented this time was worth it — the effects and story are good.
