examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗰個月費加咗新戲，覺得幾租值所以續訂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go2 go3 jyut6 fai3 gaa1 zo2 san1 hei3, gok3 dak1 gei2 zou1 zik6 so2 ji5 zuk6 deng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們那個月費加入了新片，我覺得挺划算所以續訂了。
examples.english_sentence: They added new films to the subscription, I thought it was pretty worth it so I renewed.

mandarin_meaning: 租务（与租赁有关的事务或管理）
english_meaning: rental matters; tenancy affairs (matters related to leasing or rental management)
explanation_mandarin: 指與租賃有關的各種事務或管理工作，例如簽訂租約、收取租金、處理維修或租務糾紛等。
explanation_english: Refers to matters or administrative work related to leasing/renting, such as signing tenancy agreements, collecting rent, handling repairs, or resolving rental disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司主要負責租務管理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 zou1 mou6 gun2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司主要負責租務管理。
examples.english_sentence: Our company mainly handles rental management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 租務合約到時要續約或者終止，都要注意條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou1 mou6 hap6 joek3 dou3 si4 jiu3 zuk6 joek3 waak6 ze2 zung1 zi2, dou1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 租務合約到期時要續約或終止，都要注意條款。
examples.english_sentence: When the tenancy agreement expires, whether renewing or terminating, pay attention to the terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有任何租務糾紛，請聯絡物業管理處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jam6 ho4 zou1 mou6 gau2 fan1, cing2 lyun4 lok3 mat6 jip6 gun2 lei5 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有任何租務糾紛，請聯絡物業管理處。
examples.english_sentence: If there are any rental disputes, please contact the property management office.

mandarin_meaning: 租务管制（zūwù guǎnzhì），指对房屋租赁、租金及租赁关系进行法律或行政上的限制与规管。
english_meaning: rent control; regulation of tenancy — laws or administrative measures that restrict or regulate rental terms, rents, and landlord-tenant relationships.
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或相關機構對租賃市場採取的管制措施，例如限制租金上漲、規範租約條款或設定租賃保障，以穩定房屋租賃市場及保障租客權益。
explanation_english: Measures by government or authorities to regulate the rental market — for example limiting rent increases, standardizing lease terms, or providing tenant protections — aimed at stabilizing rents and protecting tenants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府考慮實施租務管制，以穩定租金市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 haau2 leoi6 sat6 si1 zou1 mou6 gun2 zai3, ji5 wan2 ding6 zou1 gam1 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府考虑实施租务管制，以稳定租金市场。
examples.english_sentence: The government is considering implementing rent control to stabilize the rental market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果實行租務管制，業主可能會反對某些限制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 sat6 hang4 zou1 mou6 gun2 zai3, jip6 zyu2 ho2 nang4 wui5 faan2 deoi3 mou5 se1 haan6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果实行租务管制，业主可能会反对某些限制。
examples.english_sentence: If rent control is enacted, landlords may oppose some of the restrictions.

mandarin_meaning: 租赁与出售 / 出租和出售
english_meaning: rent and sell; for rent or for sale; leasing and selling
explanation_mandarin: 表示對物業或商品既可出租又可出售的狀態或相關業務，常見於房地產或商舖廣告中。
explanation_english: Indicates that a property or item is available for rent or for sale; refers to leasing and selling (commonly used in real estate or shop listings).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間物業而家租售，歡迎查詢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 mat6 jip6 ji4 gaa1 zou1 sau6, fun1 jing4 caa4 seon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間物業現在出租或出售，歡迎查詢。
examples.english_sentence: This property is currently for rent or for sale; inquiries welcome.

mandarin_meaning: 租金單 / 租賃單（列明應繳租金的帳單或發票）
english_meaning: rent bill; rental invoice (a bill listing rent due)
explanation_mandarin: 指列出應繳租金與相關租賃條款的帳單或單據，常見於房屋、店舖或商業場所的租賃往來。有時也可泛指租賃相關的訂單或記錄。
explanation_english: A bill or invoice that lists rent due and related rental terms, commonly used in housing, shop, or commercial lease contexts. It can also refer more generally to rental orders or records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋主今日寄咗份租單嚟，話下個月要加租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 zyu2 gam1 jat6 gei3 zo2 fan6 zou1 daan1 lai4, waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 gaa1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房東今天寄了一份租單來，說下個月要加租。
examples.english_sentence: The landlord sent a rent bill today and said the rent will increase next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場會寄一張租單俾各個商戶，寫低每個月嘅租金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 wui5 gei3 jat1 zoeng1 zou1 daan1 bei2 gok3 go3 soeng1 wu6, se2 dai1 mui5 go3 jyut6 ge3 zou1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场会寄一张租单给各个商户，写明每个月的租金。
examples.english_sentence: The mall will send a rent bill to each tenant stating the monthly rent.

mandarin_meaning: 租客；租戶；房客
english_meaning: tenant; renter
explanation_mandarin: 指租用房屋或其他物品的人。可指短期或長期租住或租用的人，也常與房東相對。
explanation_english: A person who rents property or other items. Can be a short-term or long-term renter; often contrasted with the landlord.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月有個新租客搬咗入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 jau5 go3 san1 zou1 haak3 bun1 zo2 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月有个新租客搬进来了。
examples.english_sentence: A new tenant moved in this month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係屋主，要記得同租客簽租約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 uk1 zyu2, jiu3 gei3 dak1 tung4 zou1 haak3 cim1 zou1 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是房东，要记得和租客签租约。
examples.english_sentence: You are the landlord; remember to sign a lease with the tenant.

mandarin_meaning: 租户 (承租房屋或其他物品的人或單位)
english_meaning: tenant; lessee; renter
explanation_mandarin: 指承租房屋或其他財物、佔有使用權並支付租金的人或單位，常用於法律和房屋租賃相關語境。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or entity that rents property or other items, occupying the right to use them and paying rent; commonly used in legal and housing rental contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幢樓嘅租戶要求減租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zong6 lau4 ge3 zou1 wu6 jiu1 kau4 gam2 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幢樓的租戶要求減租。
examples.english_sentence: The tenants in that building are demanding a rent reduction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做屋主要留意租戶嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 uk1 zyu2 jiu3 lau4 ji3 zou1 wu6 ge3 kyun4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為房東要留意租戶的權益。
examples.english_sentence: As a landlord, you need to pay attention to tenants' rights.

mandarin_meaning: 租户（拼音：zūhù）——租用房屋或其他财产的人或单位，即“租客”。
english_meaning: Tenant — a person or entity that rents property (especially housing) from a landlord.
explanation_mandarin: 指承租房屋或其他財產的一方，常用於法律、房地產或日常語境中，與房東相對。
explanation_english: Refers to the party who rents property (such as a house or apartment) from a landlord; commonly used in legal, real estate, and everyday contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幢樓入面有好多租戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zong6 lau4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 zou1 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幢樓裡面有很多租戶。
examples.english_sentence: There are many tenants in this building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 房東通知所有租戶，下個月會加租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 dung1 tung1 zi1 so2 jau5 zou1 wu6, haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 gaa1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房東通知所有租戶，下個月會加租。
examples.english_sentence: The landlord notified all tenants that rent will increase next month.

mandarin_meaning: 租房 / 租屋（租房子）
english_meaning: to rent a flat / to rent an apartment or house
explanation_mandarin: 指向房東或中介支付租金以使用住宅（公寓或房屋）的行為，常以月為單位付租。
explanation_english: The act of renting a residence (an apartment or house) from a landlord or agent, typically paying rent on a monthly basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家喺銅鑼灣租樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 tung4 lo4 waan1 zou1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在在銅鑼灣租房子。
examples.english_sentence: I'm currently renting a flat in Causeway Bay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋租樓嗰陣，要簽長期合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou1 lau4 go2 zan6, jiu3 cim1 coeng4 kei4 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們租房的時候，要簽長期合約。
examples.english_sentence: When they rented the flat, they had to sign a long-term contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家租樓好貴，一間樓要幾千蚊一個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou1 lau4 hou2 gwai3, jat1 gaan1 lau4 jiu3 gei2 cin1 man1 jat1 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在租房很貴，一間要幾千塊一個月。
examples.english_sentence: Rent is expensive now; a flat costs several thousand dollars per month.

mandarin_meaning: 租用 (zūyòng)；租借、租赁，即付费使用某物或场所
english_meaning: to rent; to hire; to lease (pay to use something for a period)
explanation_mandarin: 表示以支付费用短期或长期使用某物或场所，常用于租车、租房、租借设备或场地等情境。
explanation_english: Indicates paying to use something for a period (temporary or long-term). Commonly used for renting cars, houses, equipment, office space, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算喺機場租用一部車去市區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 hai2 gei1 coeng4 zou1 jung6 jat1 bou6 ce1 heoi3 si5 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算在机场租一辆车去市区。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to rent a car at the airport to go to the city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要長期租用辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 kei4 zou1 jung6 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要长期租用办公室。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to lease office space long-term.

mandarin_meaning: 租界 (zūjiè)：指19世紀末至20世紀初外國在中國某些城市內享有治外法權或實際管轄的區域（歷史術語）。
english_meaning: Foreign concession: a historical area in a Chinese city under the jurisdiction or administrative control of a foreign power (19th–early 20th century).
explanation_mandarin: 指外國勢力在中國等地通過條約取得的局部管轄權，該區域常由外國駐軍或租界當局管理，法律與行政上與周邊地區不同，屬於歷史概念。
explanation_english: A historical term for areas in Chinese cities ceded or leased to foreign powers, where the foreign authorities exercised legal and administrative control distinct from surrounding areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前上海有好多外國租界，嗰啲地方保存咗唔少西洋風格嘅建築。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5cin4 soeng6hoi2 jau5 hou2 do1 ngoi6 gwok3 zou1 gaai3, go2 di1 dei6 fong1 bou2 cyun4 zo2 m4 siu2 sai1 joeng4 fung1 gok3 ge3 gin3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前上海有很多外国租界，那些地方保留了不少西洋风格的建筑。
examples.english_sentence: Shanghai used to have many foreign concessions; those areas preserved many Western-style buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本歷史書講到租界嘅管治同治安情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 lik6 si2 syu1 gong2 dou3 zou1 gaai3 ge3 gun2 zi6 tung4 zi6 on1 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本历史书讲到了租界的治理和治安情况。
examples.english_sentence: This history book discusses governance and public security in the concessions.

mandarin_meaning: 租约 (zūyuē) — 出租和承租雙方之間的書面合約，規定租金、租期、押金、維修責任等條款。
english_meaning: lease; rental agreement — a contract between landlord and tenant specifying rent, duration, deposit, responsibilities, termination terms, etc.
explanation_mandarin: 指房東與租客簽訂的書面合約，用來明確雙方在租賃關係中的權利與義務，例如租期、租金、押金、維修與終止條款等。
explanation_english: Refers to the written contract signed between a landlord and a tenant that defines the rights and obligations of both parties in a rental relationship, such as rent, term, deposit, maintenance, and termination clauses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同屋主簽咗一份兩年嘅租約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 uk1 zyu2 cim1 zo2 jat1 fan6 loeng5 nin4 ge3 zou1 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和房東簽了一份兩年的租約。
examples.english_sentence: I signed a two-year lease with the landlord.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 租約到期要提前一個月通知屋主，否則要續租或者搬走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou1 joek3 dou3 kei4 jiu3 tai4 cin4 jat1 go3 jyut6 tung1 zi1 uk1 zyu2, fau2 zak1 jiu3 zuk6 zou1 waak6 ze2 bun1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 租約到期要提前一個月通知房東，否則需要續租或搬走。
examples.english_sentence: You must give the landlord one month's notice before the lease expires; otherwise you need to renew the lease or move out.

mandarin_meaning: 租赁 (zūlìn)
english_meaning: to rent; to lease; rental
explanation_mandarin: 指以支付租金的方式暫時使用他人財產（如房屋、設備等）；也可指租賃關係或租賃合同。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of renting or leasing property or equipment in exchange for payment (rent); can also denote the rental relationship or a lease agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算租賃呢間辦公室做公司總部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 zou1 jam6 ni1 gaan1 baan6 gung1 sat1 zou6 gung1 si1 zung2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算租赁这间办公室做公司总部。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to lease this office to use as the company's headquarters.

mandarin_meaning: 租金 (zūjīn)
english_meaning: rent; the payment made for renting property, equipment, or goods
explanation_mandarin: 指為租用房屋、設備或物品而支付的金錢，通常按月或按約定期支付。
explanation_english: Money paid for renting a property, equipment, or item, usually paid monthly or according to an agreed schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月嘅租金幾時交？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 ge3 zou1 gam1 gei2 si4 gaau1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的租金什么时候交？
examples.english_sentence: When is this month's rent due?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個月都要交租金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 gaau1 zou1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个月都要交租金。
examples.english_sentence: I have to pay rent every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你遲交租金，業主可能會收滯納金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ci4 gaau1 zou1 gam1, jip6 zyu2 ho2 nang4 wui5 sau1 zai6 naap6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你迟交租金，房东可能会收滞纳金。
examples.english_sentence: If you pay rent late, the landlord may charge a late fee.

mandarin_meaning: 秤（chéng）：稱重用的器具；也可作動詞，表示稱量重量。
english_meaning: scale; balance (device); to weigh (verb)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來測量重量的器具（如市場或家用的秤）；作動詞時表示對物品進行稱量。
explanation_english: A device used to measure weight (e.g., a market or household scale). As a verb, it means to weigh something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部秤壞咗，唔好再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 cang3 waai6 zo2, m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部秤壞了，不要再用。
examples.english_sentence: This scale is broken; don't use it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢秤咗啲米，話要畀啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cang3 zo2 di1 mai5, waa6 jiu3 bei2 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他秤了些米，說要付些錢。
examples.english_sentence: He weighed some rice and said he'd pay some money.

mandarin_meaning: 先稱一稱 / 先秤一秤（先檢查重量）
english_meaning: weigh first; check the weight first
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，字面意思是先把東西秤一秤，用於買賣或要先確認重量的情況，也可直譯為「先檢查、先確認」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to weigh something first (i.e., check the weight). Used in markets or situations where you want to confirm weight or check something before proceeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺市場，老闆話要秤先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 si5 coeng4, lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 ceng3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在市場，老闆說要先秤（一下）。
examples.english_sentence: At the market, the shopkeeper said to weigh it first.

mandarin_meaning: 秤杆；天平或傳統平衡秤上的橫桿
english_meaning: the beam/rod of a balance or scale; the horizontal bar of a traditional balance scale
explanation_mandarin: 指秤（如天平、傳統平衡秤）上用來支撐或懸掛兩端盤子的桿子，為秤的主要構件之一，也可用於描述傳統秤具。
explanation_english: Refers to the rod or beam of a balance/scale (such as a balance beam) used to support or hang the pans; a primary component of traditional balance scales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條秤桿斷咗，要整返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 cang3 gon1 dyun6 zo2, jiu3 zing2 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這根秤桿斷了，要先修好。
examples.english_sentence: This scale beam is broken; it needs to be repaired first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋修好咗個古董天平嘅秤桿，依家可以再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau1 hou2 zo2 go3 gu2 dung2 tin1 ping4 ge3 cang3 gon1, ji1 gaa1 ho2 ji5 zoi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們修好了那個古董天平的秤桿，現在可以再用。
examples.english_sentence: They fixed the antique balance's beam, and now it can be used again.

mandarin_meaning: 秤盘 (chèngpán)：秤上的盘子，用来放置称重的物品。
english_meaning: scale pan; weighing pan (the plate of a balance used to hold items being weighed).
explanation_mandarin: 指天平或其他秤上用來放置被稱量物品的盤子，是稱重裝置的一部分。
explanation_english: The pan or plate on a balance/scale used to hold the objects being weighed; a component of a weighing instrument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅拎起秤盤，開始將貨物擺上去稱重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu1 ling1 hei2 ceng3 pun4, hoi1 ci2 zoeng1 fo3 mat6 baai2 soeng6 heoi3 cing1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 師傅拿起秤盤，開始把貨物放上去稱重。
examples.english_sentence: The worker picked up the scale pan and began placing the goods on it to weigh them.

mandarin_meaning: 秤砣；天平或秤上的砝碼，用來配重或稱重
english_meaning: a weight used on a balance scale; sinker or counterweight; (figuratively) something that balances or anchors
explanation_mandarin: 指放在秤上用來配重或稱物體重量的鉛塊或砝碼。也可引申為起穩定、平衡作用的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the lump or weight used on a scale to measure mass or act as a counterweight. Can also be used figuratively for something or someone that provides balance or stability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個秤砣好重，搬唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cing3 to4 hou2 zung6, bun1 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個秤砣很重，搬不起來。
examples.english_sentence: The scale weight is very heavy; I can't lift it.

mandarin_meaning: （疑為罕見或誤寫）秤砣；秤上的砝码；比喻具有分量或決定性影響的人或物
english_meaning: Likely a rare/variant spelling of '秤砣' — a scale weight used on a balance; figuratively, someone or something with decisive weight or influence
explanation_mandarin: 此字寫法較少見，常見寫法為「秤砣」（砣，砝碼）。字面上指放在秤上的砝碼，用以平衡與稱重；引申可指在局勢或決策中有分量或關鍵影響的人或事物。由於「鉈」字在日常書寫中不常用，出現時多為異體或誤寫，理解時可與「秤砣」對應。
explanation_english: This form is uncommon and is likely a variant or misspelling of '秤砣' (scale weight). Literally it refers to the weight placed on a balance for measuring; figuratively it denotes a person or thing that carries weight or decisive influence in a situation. Because the character '鉈' is rare in everyday use, treat this entry as corresponding to '秤砣'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個秤鉈唔見咗，秤唔准。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cang3 to4 m4 gin3 zo2, cang3 m4 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个秤砣不见了，秤不准。
examples.english_sentence: The scale weight is missing, so the scale isn't accurate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個項目入面，佢係個秤鉈，大家都要聽佢意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong6muk6 jap6min6, keoi5 hai6 go3 cang3 to4, daai6gaa1 dou1 jiu3 teng1 keoi5 ji3gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个项目里，他是个关键人物，大家都要听他的意见。
examples.english_sentence: In this project he's the key person; everyone needs to listen to his opinion.

mandarin_meaning: 秤头；（口語）分量、份量或影響力
english_meaning: the pan/head/indicator of a scale; (colloquial) the weight, importance, or influence of something or someone
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指秤的部件或秤砣；在粵語口語中也可引申為事物或人的分量、影響力或威望。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a part of a weighing scale (pan/indicator/weight). Colloquially in Cantonese it can be extended to mean the weight, importance, or influence of a thing or person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個秤頭壞咗，唔好再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cang3 tau4 waai6 zo2, m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個秤頭壞了，別再用。
examples.english_sentence: This scale head is broken; don't use it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面好有秤頭，大家都聽佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 jap6min6 hou2 jau5 cang3 tau4, daai6gaa1 dou1 teng1 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡很有分量，大家都聽他說話。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of clout in the company; everyone listens when he speaks.

mandarin_meaning: 秦（指古代的秦國或秦朝，也作為姓氏）
english_meaning: Qin (the ancient Qin state/dynasty in China); a Chinese surname
explanation_mandarin: 「秦」可指中國先秦時期的秦國、後來的秦朝，或用作漢族常見姓氏之一。
explanation_english: Refers to the ancient Qin state or the Qin dynasty in Chinese history, and is also used as a Chinese surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姓秦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing3 ceon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姓秦。
examples.english_sentence: My surname is Qin.

mandarin_meaning: 秦国（战国时期的国家，后建立秦朝）
english_meaning: The State of Qin (an ancient Chinese state that later founded the Qin Dynasty)
explanation_mandarin: 秦國是中國古代的一個諸侯國，於戰國時期崛起，最終統一六國並建立秦朝。
explanation_english: The State of Qin was an ancient Chinese polity during the Zhou dynasty's Warring States period; it rose to power, unified the Six States, and established the Qin Dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秦國最後統一六國，建立咗秦朝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ceon4 gwok3 zeoi3 hau6 tung2 jat1 luk6 gwok3, gin3 laap6 zo2 Ceon4 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秦国最后统一六国，建立了秦朝。
examples.english_sentence: The State of Qin ultimately unified the Six States and established the Qin Dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 史書上記載，秦國喺戰國時代發展好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Si2 syu1 soeng6 gei3 zoi3, Ceon4 gwok3 hai2 Zin3 gwok3 si4 doi6 faat3 zin2 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 史书记载，秦国在战国时代发展得很快。
examples.english_sentence: Historical records state that the State of Qin developed very rapidly during the Warring States period.

mandarin_meaning: 秦始皇（Qín Shǐhuáng），即嬴政，秦朝的開國皇帝，公元前3世紀統一六國，建立中央集權制度。
english_meaning: Qin Shi Huang, the First Emperor of the Qin dynasty (Ying Zheng), who unified China in the 3rd century BCE and established the Qin dynasty and a centralized government.
explanation_mandarin: 秦始皇是中國歷史上第一位稱皇帝的人，統一六國、推行書同文、車同軌等措施，開創秦朝並實行中央集權。
explanation_english: The First Emperor of Qin, credited with unifying the warring states into imperial China, standardizing writing and measurements, and establishing a centralized imperial system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺歷史課我哋學到秦始皇統一咗六國，仲實行咗好多改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 lik6 si2 fo3 ngo5 dei6 hok6 dou3 ceon4 ci2 wong4 tung2 jat1 zo2 luk6 gwok3, zung6 sat6 hang4 zo2 hou2 do1 goi2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在歷史課上我們學到秦始皇統一了六國，還實行了很多改革。
examples.english_sentence: In history class we learned that Qin Shi Huang unified the six states and carried out many reforms.

mandarin_meaning: （書面或古稱）指古琴或與秦地有關的琴
english_meaning: Qin zither; a literary/archaic reference to the guqin (traditional Chinese zither)
explanation_mandarin: 「秦琴」並非廣州話日常口語，屬較書面或古雅的用法，常用來指古琴或泛指與秦地有關的琴器，現代多以「古琴」稱之。
explanation_english: Not a common everyday Cantonese term; a literary or archaic expression used to refer to the guqin (ancient Chinese zither) or a zither associated with the Qin region. In modern usage, the term guqin is more common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意彈秦琴，琴聲好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 taan4 ceon4 kam4, kam4 seng1 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡彈秦琴，琴聲很寧靜。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to play the qin (Qin zither); the sound is very tranquil.

mandarin_meaning: 秧苗；水稻等作物的幼苗
english_meaning: seedling; young plant (especially rice seedlings)
explanation_mandarin: 指農作物的幼苗，尤指插秧時移栽到田裡的稻苗；有時也泛指幼小的植物。
explanation_english: Refers to young plants, especially rice seedlings used for transplanting; can also generally mean young shoots of plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫喺田入面插秧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 fu1 hai2 tin4 jap6 min6 caap3 joeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农夫在田里插秧。
examples.english_sentence: The farmer is transplanting rice seedlings in the field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年雨水唔夠，啲秧長得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 jyu5 seoi2 m4 gau3, di1 joeng1 zoeng2 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年雨水不夠，秧苗長得不好。
examples.english_sentence: This year there isn't enough rain, so the seedlings aren't growing well.

mandarin_meaning: 秧苗；稻苗，指剛栽種或培育中的幼小稻株
english_meaning: rice seedlings; young seedlings (especially rice)
explanation_mandarin: 指插秧或育秧後的幼小稻苗，也可泛指各種作物的幼苗。
explanation_english: Refers to young rice plants after sowing or transplanting; can also be used more generally for young seedlings of crops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要去田度插秧苗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 tin4 dou6 caap3 joeng1 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今天要去田裡插秧苗。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the field today to plant rice seedlings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 田入面啲秧苗已經長高咗，好似好健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin4 jap6 min6 di1 joeng1 miu4 ji5 ging1 coeng4 gou1 zo2, hou2 ci5 hou2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 田裡的秧苗已經長高了，看起來很健康。
examples.english_sentence: The rice seedlings in the field have already grown taller and look very healthy.

mandarin_meaning: 秩序、次第、等級（常見於「秩序」等詞）
english_meaning: order; sequence; rank (often appears in compounds such as '秩序')
explanation_mandarin: 表示次序、秩序或官位等級。單字本身不常單獨使用，常見於「秩序」等複合詞中，指事物排列的規律或社會的井然狀態。
explanation_english: Denotes order, sequence, or rank. The character by itself is not often used alone in modern speech but commonly appears in compounds like '秩序' to refer to the regular arrangement of things or social order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會要有秩序先好發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 jiu3 jau5 zat1 zeoi6 sin1 hou2 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会要有秩序才能好好发展。
examples.english_sentence: Society needs to have order in order to develop well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚聚會搞到好亂，成個場面完全失咗秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok6 maan5 zeoi6 wui6 gaau2 dou3 hou2 lyun6, sing4 go3 coeng4 min6 jyun4 cyun4 sat1 zo2 zat1 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚聚会弄得很乱，整个场面完全失去秩序。
examples.english_sentence: Last night's gathering became very chaotic; the whole scene completely lost its order.

mandarin_meaning: 秩序 (zhìxù)：事物排列的條理；社會的穩定與規範
english_meaning: order; sequence; public order; discipline
explanation_mandarin: 指事物安排的條理或社會、公共場所的穩定與規範，例如維持公共秩序。
explanation_english: Refers to the arrangement or regularity of things, or the stability and rules of society/public spaces (e.g., maintaining public order).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家喺圖書館要保持秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 jiu3 bou2 ci4 zat6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家在圖書館要保持秩序。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone should maintain order in the library.

mandarin_meaning: 称（chēng）：称呼、称赞、称重等
english_meaning: to call/address, to praise, to weigh
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，'称'（繁体為「稱」）讀作 cing1，常用作動詞，表示稱呼別人、稱讚或稱重（用磅秤）等意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '称' (traditional 稱) is pronounced cing1 and is commonly used as a verb meaning to call or address someone, to praise, or to weigh (on a scale).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點稱呼佢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 cing1 fu1 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么称呼他？
examples.english_sentence: How do you address him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都稱讚佢做得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 cing1 zaan3 keoi5 zou6 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都称赞他做得好。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone praises him for doing a good job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要去稱吓啲水果有幾多斤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 cing1 haa5 di1 soeng1 gwo2 jau5 gei2 do1 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要去称一下水果有多少斤。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go weigh how many jin the fruit is.

mandarin_meaning: 移动；迁移；转移
english_meaning: to move; to transfer; to shift; to migrate
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置、狀態或人員等從一處轉到另一處的動作或過程。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of changing position or location, relocating people or things, or transferring from one place/state to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要將辦公室移去旺角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 zoeng1 baan6 gung1 sat1 ji4 heoi3 wong6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要把辦公室搬到旺角。
examples.english_sentence: The company is going to move the office to Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃移民去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 ji4 man4 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划移民到外国。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to emigrate to another country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好移動嗰個插頭，會危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji4 dung6 go2 go3 caap3 tau4, wui5 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要移动那个插头，会很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Don't move that plug; it's dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 移交（把某物、文件或責任轉交給他人或其他單位）
english_meaning: to transfer; to hand over; to turn over (e.g., documents, responsibility, custody)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某項事物、資料、文件或職責從一方交給另一方或其他機構處理。
explanation_english: To hand over or transfer something (such as items, documents, or responsibilities) from one party to another or to another unit for handling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經將文件移交咗畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 man4 gin6 ji4 gaau1 zo2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經把文件移交給你了。
examples.english_sentence: I have already handed the documents over to you.

mandarin_meaning: 移動位置；位移（可指物件、人、骨折等位置改變）
english_meaning: to shift or move position; displacement (of an object, person, bone, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 「移位」通常指把某物或某人從一個位置移到另一個位置；醫學上可指骨頭或器官發生偏移；亦可用於座位或職位調動的情況。
explanation_english: “移位” generally means moving something or someone from one position to another. In medical contexts it can refer to bone or organ displacement. It can also be used for seat changes or position transfers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我把張椅移位少少，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 baa2 zoeng1 ji2 ji4 wai6 siu2 siu2, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫我把椅子移動一下，好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Help me move the chair a little, okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: X光顯示佢條骨移位咗，要開刀整返位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: eks1 gwong1 hin2 si6 keoi5 tiu4 gwat1 ji4 wai6 zo2, jiu3 hoi1 dou1 zing2 faan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: X 光顯示他的骨頭移位了，需要開刀復位。
examples.english_sentence: The X-ray shows his bone is displaced; surgery is needed to reset it.

mandarin_meaning: 移动 (yídòng)
english_meaning: to move; to shift; to relocate; mobile
explanation_mandarin: 表示從一個位置移到另一個位置，或指變換位置、轉移；在複合詞中也可表示「可移動的、行動的」含義。
explanation_english: Indicates changing position from one place to another; to move or relocate. In compounds it can also mean 'mobile' or 'movable'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要移動啲枱，先可以擺多啲椅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji4 dung6 di1 toi2 , sin1 ho2 ji5 baai2 do1 di1 ji2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要把桌子移動一下，才能放更多椅子。
examples.english_sentence: We need to move the tables so we can fit more chairs.

mandarin_meaning: 移动平均线
english_meaning: moving average (line) — a technical analysis indicator showing the average price over a specified period
explanation_mandarin: 一種技術分析指標，用來平滑價格數據、顯示價格隨時間變化的趨勢。常見類型有簡單移動平均線（SMA）和指數移動平均線（EMA）。
explanation_english: A technical analysis indicator that smooths price data by averaging values over a set period, producing a line that helps identify price trends over time. Common types include Simple Moving Average (SMA) and Exponential Moving Average (EMA).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資者通常會睇移動平均線嚟判斷走勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 ze2 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tai2 ji4 dung6 ping4 gwan1 sin3 lai4 pun3 dyun6 zau2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资者通常会看移动平均线来判断走势。
examples.english_sentence: Investors usually look at moving averages to judge the trend.

mandarin_meaning: 迁居；搬迁（居所）
english_meaning: to relocate one's residence; to move house; to emigrate (relocate to another place/country)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把居住地從一處搬到另一處。多用於正式或書面語，範圍可包括同一國內的遷移或移居海外。
explanation_english: Refers to moving one's place of residence from one location to another. Common in formal or written contexts; can mean moving within a country or relocating abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去年因為工作移居咗加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 nin4 jan1 wai6 gung1 zok3 ji4 geoi1 zo2 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去年因為工作移居了加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: He moved to Canada last year because of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算明年移居海外，開始新生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 ming4 nin4 ji4 geoi1 hoi6 ngoi6, hoi1 ci2 san1 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們打算明年移居海外，開始新的生活。
examples.english_sentence: We plan to relocate overseas next year to start a new life.

mandarin_meaning: 移山填海（做極其艱巨或幾乎不可能完成的事）
english_meaning: to move mountains and fill the sea; to undertake a monumental or seemingly impossible task
explanation_mandarin: 出自愚公移山的典故，形容用極大力氣完成艱鉅或幾乎不可能完成的工作，也可指竭盡全力達成目標。
explanation_english: Derived from the fable of Yu Gong moving the mountains; it describes undertaking extremely arduous or seemingly impossible tasks, or exerting every effort to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程規模咁大，要移山塡海先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1cing4 gwai1mo4 gam2 daai6, jiu3 ji1 saan1 tin4 hoi2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程规模这么大，要移山填海才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This project's scale is so large that it would take moving mountains and filling the sea to finish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母為咗個仔嘅前途，願意移山塡海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 wai4 zo2 go3 zai2 ge3 cin4tou4, jyun6 ji3 ji1 saan1 tin4 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母为了孩子的前途，愿意移山填海。
examples.english_sentence: Parents would be willing to move mountains and fill the seas for their child's future.

mandarin_meaning: 移山填海（比喻克服極大困難，完成看似不可能的事）
english_meaning: To move mountains and fill up the seas — to accomplish seemingly impossible tasks; to overcome enormous difficulties through determination and effort.
explanation_mandarin: 成語，字面意思是把山移走、把海填平，常用來形容下定決心、克服巨大困難、完成艱鉅任務。
explanation_english: An idiom literally meaning to move mountains and fill the seas; used to describe resolving to overcome tremendous difficulties or to achieve a seemingly impossible task through great effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算要移山填海，我都會幫你完成呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 jiu3 ji4 saan1 tin4 hoi2, ngo5 dou1 wui5 bong1 nei5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使要移山填海，我也會幫你完成這件事。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it means moving mountains and filling the seas, I will help you finish this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 移师
english_meaning: to relocate forces/operations; to move to another place to continue work or perform
explanation_mandarin: 表示把兵力、队伍、工作或演出等从一个地方转移到另一个地方开展行动或表演。
explanation_english: To transfer troops, a team, operations, or performances to another location to continue activities or carry out tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算下個月移師去新開嘅辦公室繼續運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 ji4 si1 heoi3 san1 hoi1 ge3 baan6 gung1 sat1 gai3 zuk6 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算下个月移师去新开的办公室继续运作。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to relocate to the newly opened office next month to continue operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個戲班今晚會移師到旺角嘅戲院表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hei3 baan1 gam1 maan5 wui5 ji4 si1 dou3 wong6 gok3 ge3 hei3 jyun2 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个戏班今晚会移师到旺角的戏院表演。
examples.english_sentence: The theatre troupe will move to the Mong Kok theatre tonight to perform.

mandarin_meaning: 移情别恋（把感情從原來的對象轉移到別人身上；通常指在戀愛中變心）
english_meaning: To transfer one's affections to someone else; to fall out of love with a previous partner and fall for a new person.
explanation_mandarin: 指把感情從一個人轉移到另一個人身上，通常用來形容在戀愛關係中變心、對原來伴侶失去感情而另結新歡。
explanation_english: Refers to shifting romantic feelings from one person to another. Commonly used to describe becoming emotionally attached to someone new and losing affection for a previous partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明發覺阿珍對佢唔似以前咁熱情，原來佢移情別戀咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 faat3 gok3 aa3 zan1 deoi3 keoi5 m4 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 jit6 cing4, jyun4 loi4 keoi5 ji4 cing4 bit6 lyun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明發覺阿珍對他不像以前那麼熱情，原來她已經移情別戀了。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming noticed Ah Jan wasn't as warm toward him as before — it turned out she had already fallen for someone else.

mandarin_meaning: 移植 (yízhí)：把器官、植物或程式從一個地方或系統搬到另一個地方或系統；也指醫學上的移植手術。
english_meaning: to transplant; to graft; to port (software) — moving organs, plants, or code from one place/system to another.
explanation_mandarin: 「移植」可用於醫學（如器官移植）、園藝（如移栽樹苗或嫁接）以及科技領域（如把程式移植到其他平台）。
explanation_english: Used for medical transplants (organs), horticulture (transplanting/grafting plants), and technology (porting software to another platform).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗心臟移植手術，依家恢復得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 sam1 zong6 ji4 zik6 sau2 seot6, ji1 gaa1 fui1 fuk6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了心脏移植手术，现在恢复得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He had a heart transplant and is recovering well now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將樹苗移植到新嘅花圃，成活率好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 syu6 miu4 ji4 zik6 dou3 san1 ge3 faa1 pou2, sing4 wut6 leot6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把树苗移植到新的花圃，成活率很高。
examples.english_sentence: They transplanted the seedlings into a new flower bed, and the survival rate was high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲開發者成功將個程式移植去 macOS，依家運行好穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hoi1 faat3 ze2 sing4 gung1 zoeng1 go3 cing4 sik1 ji4 zik6 heoi3 macOS, ji1 gaa1 wan6 hang4 hou2 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开发者成功将程序移植到 macOS，现在运行很稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The developers successfully ported the program to macOS, and it runs stably now.

mandarin_meaning: 移民 (yímín)
english_meaning: to emigrate / to immigrate; immigration
explanation_mandarin: 指從一個國家或地區搬遷到另一個國家或地區居住，常用於表示移居或入籍的行為或過程。
explanation_english: Refers to moving from one country or region to another to live; used for the act or process of emigrating/immigrating and related residency changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算移民加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 ji4 man4 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算移民加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to emigrate to Canada.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為工作關係移民咗澳洲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gung1 zok3 gwaan1 hai6 ji4 man4 zo2 ou3 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为工作关系移民了澳洲。
examples.english_sentence: He immigrated to Australia because of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要修改移民政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 sau1 goi2 ji4 man4 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要修改移民政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government is going to revise the immigration policy.

mandarin_meaning: 移民官；出入境管理官員
english_meaning: immigration officer; immigration official
explanation_mandarin: 負責處理出入境、簽證、移民申請及相關檢查與審查工作的政府官員。
explanation_english: A government official responsible for handling immigration matters such as entry/exit checks, visas, and immigration applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺機場入境櫃位，移民官問咗我幾個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gei1 coeng4 jap6 ging2 gwai6 wai2, ji4 man4 gwan1 man6 zo2 ngo5 gei2 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在機場的入境櫃檯，移民官問了我幾個問題。
examples.english_sentence: At the immigration counter in the airport, the immigration officer asked me a few questions.

mandarin_meaning: 移民局（负责管理移民、签证、居留等事务的政府机构）
english_meaning: Immigration bureau/immigration office (government agency handling immigration, visas, residency, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指负责管理移民、签证、居留、入出境等事务的政府机构或部门，常用于泛指处理移民事宜的机关。
explanation_english: Refers to a government agency or department that manages immigration matters such as visas, residence permits, and border/entry control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下星期要去移民局申請簽證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 ji4 man4 guk6 san1 cing2 cim1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下星期要去移民局申请签证。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the immigration office next week to apply for a visa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 移民局話我需要帶啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 man4 guk6 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 daai3 di1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 移民局说我需要带那些文件。
examples.english_sentence: The immigration office said I need to bring those documents.

mandarin_meaning: 移民潮（大批人口在短時間內遷出一地的現象）
english_meaning: a wave of emigration; mass emigration
explanation_mandarin: 指在某段時間內，由於經濟、政治或社會等原因，大量居民同時選擇移居他國或他地的現象。
explanation_english: Refers to a phenomenon in which a large number of people emigrate in a short period, often driven by economic, political, or social reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排香港出現一股移民潮，好多人都諗住搬去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 jin2 jat1 guk6 ji4 man4 ciu4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 lam2 zyu6 bun1 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近香港出現一股移民潮，很多人都打算搬去外國。
examples.english_sentence: Recently Hong Kong has seen a wave of emigration; many people are planning to move abroad.

mandarin_meaning: 请移步/请往里走（礼貌用语）
english_meaning: a polite way to ask someone to move or step this way/please step inside
explanation_mandarin: 「移玉步」是粤语中较客气的用法，常用于招呼或请人往某处移动或进入室内。这里的「玉」为敬辞，用以增加礼貌色彩，类似普通话的“请移步”。
explanation_english: “移玉步” is a Cantonese polite expression used to invite or ask someone to move to a place or to step inside. The character 玉 is an honorific addition to make the phrase more courteous, similar to the Mandarin phrase “请移步.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請移玉步入內，我帶你去會議室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 ji1 juk6 bou6 jap6 noi6, ngo5 daai3 nei5 heoi3 wui6 ji5 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请移玉步入内，我带你去会议室。
examples.english_sentence: Please step inside; I'll take you to the meeting room.

mandarin_meaning: （相当于）移船就岸 / 順勢而為、見機行事，利用有利時機改變做法或採取行動。
english_meaning: To adjust one's actions or position to fit the circumstances; to take advantage of a favorable opportunity and act accordingly.
explanation_mandarin: 指根據當前形勢或機會改變策略或做法，趁有利時機行事，常用以勸人順勢而為或把握機會。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to change plans or move into a favorable position according to circumstances; to seize an opportunity and act appropriately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家機會嚟緊，不如移船就墈，趁勢落手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gei1 wui6 lai4 gan2, bat1 jyu4 ji4 syun4 zau6 ngon6, can3 sai3 lok6 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在機會來了，不如順勢而為，趁勢行動吧。
examples.english_sentence: The opportunity is here now — we'd better adapt to the situation and act while we can.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻用巧妙或欺騙的手段把事情改頭換面、偷換或掩蓋真相。
english_meaning: To use sleight-of-hand or deceptive tricks to substitute or alter something; to cover up the truth by trickery.
explanation_mandarin: 四字成語，常用來形容以巧妙或欺騙的方法把事物偷換、改變表面，以達到掩飾或欺騙的目的。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom describing the use of clever or deceitful methods to swap or alter things, often to conceal the truth or deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺調查入面用咗移花接木嘅方法，想掩飾真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 tiu4 caa4 jap6 min6 jung6 zo2 ji4 faa1 zip3 muk6 ge3 fong1 faat3, soeng2 jim2 sik1 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在調查中用了移花接木的方法，想掩飾真相。
examples.english_sentence: He used sleight-of-hand tactics during the investigation to try to cover up the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 移除（yíchú），去掉或把某物從某處移開或刪除
english_meaning: remove; eliminate; take away; delete
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物從原來位置移開或去掉，可指實體搬走、拔除，也可指資料或設定上的刪除或取消。
explanation_english: Indicates taking something away from its original place or eliminating it; can refer to physically moving/removing an object, surgically taking something out, or deleting/disabling data or settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以幫我移除呢個應用程式嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 ji4 ceoi4 ni1 go3 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我移除這個應用程式嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me remove this app?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定移除過時嘅規則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 ji4 ceoi4 gwo3 si4 ge3 gwai1 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司決定移除過時的規則。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to remove the outdated rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要將腫瘤移除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 zoeng1 zung2 lau4 ji4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說要將腫瘤移除。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the tumor needs to be removed.

mandarin_meaning: 改變風俗習慣，革除陋習，推行新風尚
english_meaning: to change social customs and habits; to reform old practices and promote new social norms
explanation_mandarin: 指通過教育、制度或宣傳等手段，改變社會上不良或落後的風俗習慣，推廣新的風尚與行為模式。
explanation_english: Refers to changing established customs and habits—often by education, policy, or publicity—to eliminate undesirable practices and promote new social norms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要移風易俗，政府要加強教育同宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 ji1 fung1 ji6 zuk6, zing3 fu2 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 gaau3 juk6 tung4 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要移風易俗，政府要加强教育和宣传。
examples.english_sentence: To change social customs, the government must strengthen education and public awareness campaigns.

mandarin_meaning: 蒞臨、光臨（敬語，用於表示對方到來或前往）
english_meaning: to visit; to come (honorific, used to politely refer to someone's arrival or visit)
explanation_mandarin: 「移駕」為敬語用法，原指移動車駕，現多用於書面或正式場合，表示對方蒞臨或前往某處，常見於「移駕光臨／移駕蒞臨」等表達。
explanation_english: An honorific term originally referring to moving one's carriage; now used in formal or written contexts to politely indicate someone's arrival or visit (e.g. "移駕光臨" = "to grace with your presence").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你今日移駕光臨我哋嘅展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam1 jat6 ji4 gaa3 gwong1 lam4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zin2 laan2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝您今天蒞臨我們的展覽。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for gracing our exhibition with your presence today.

mandarin_meaning: 稀、稀薄、稀少、稀疏、（液體）稀薄
english_meaning: thin; dilute; sparse; rare
explanation_mandarin: 表示密度或濃度低，數量少或分佈不密集；也可指液體稀薄。
explanation_english: Indicates low density or concentration, few in number or sparse distribution; can also describe a liquid as thin or dilute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯好稀，唔夠味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 hou2 hei1, m4 gau3 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤很稀，不够味。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup is watery and not flavorful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排人流好稀，商店啲生意唔太好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 jan4 lau4 hou2 hei1, soeng1 dim3 di1 sang1 ji3 m4 taai3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近人流很稀，商店的生意不太好。
examples.english_sentence: Foot traffic has been light lately; the store's business isn't very good.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）亂七八糟；雜亂無章
english_meaning: in a messy, chaotic, or disorderly way; messy
explanation_mandarin: 口語擬聲詞，形容物件被弄得很亂或情況混亂、嘈雜。常見變體有「稀哩嘩啦」。
explanation_english: A colloquial onomatopoeic expression describing things as messy, scattered, or chaotic; often used for disordered scenes or noisy disturbances. Variant: '稀哩嘩啦'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫畀風吹到稀leu leu晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 bei6 fung1 ceoi1 dou3 hei1 lei1 lei1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服被風吹得亂七八糟。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes got blown all messy.

mandarin_meaning: 頭昏昏、精神虛弱或有點醉意／昏沉
english_meaning: feeling woozy/dizzy, faint, or slightly tipsy; drowsy and lethargic
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語形容人覺得頭腦昏沉、無力或有點醉、想睡的狀態，帶有輕微不舒服或無精打采的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adjective describing a state of feeling faint, woozy, drowsy, or slightly tipsy—generally weak, lightheaded, and lacking energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家覺得稀冧冧，想訓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gok3 dak1 hei1 lam5 lam5, soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在覺得頭昏昏沉沉，想睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: I feel woozy and drowsy right now; I want to sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 稀土（稀土元素）
english_meaning: rare earth (rare-earth elements / rare-earth metals)
explanation_mandarin: 稀土通常指一組化學性質相近的金屬元素（以鑭系元素為主），在高科技材料、永磁體、催化劑等領域有重要應用。
explanation_english: Rare earth refers to a group of metallic elements (mainly the lanthanides) with similar chemical properties; they are important for high-tech materials, permanent magnets, catalysts, and other applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司而家專門做稀土材料嘅出口生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 zyun1 mun4 zou6 hei1 tou2 coi4 liu6 ge3 ceot1 hau2 saang1 ji3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司現在專門做稀土材料的出口生意。
examples.english_sentence: Our company now specializes in exporting rare-earth materials.

mandarin_meaning: 稀奇 (xī qí)：罕见；奇怪
english_meaning: unusual; odd; rare
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事罕见或奇怪，不寻常。
explanation_english: Describes something that is uncommon, odd, or unusual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好稀奇，我從來未見過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 hei1 kei4, ngo5 cung4 loi4 mei6 gin3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很稀奇，我从来没见过。
examples.english_sentence: This is very unusual; I've never seen it before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲稀奇嘢，聽落幾有趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 hei1 kei4 je5, teng1 lok6 gei2 jau5 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常说些奇怪的东西，听起来挺有趣的。
examples.english_sentence: He often says odd things; it sounds rather interesting.

mandarin_meaning: 稀少、罕见的来访者；久未到访的客人
english_meaning: a rare or infrequent visitor; a seldom-seen or unexpected guest
explanation_mandarin: 「稀客」指很少来访或久未到访的客人，有时带有敬称或略带玩笑的语气。
explanation_english: “稀客” refers to a guest who visits infrequently or someone seldom seen; it can be used respectfully or playfully to note a rare appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張伯係我哋屋企嘅稀客，成幾個月先嚟一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 baak3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 hei1 haak3, sing4 gei2 go3 jyut6 sin1 lai4 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 张伯是我们家的稀客，几个月才来一次。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle Cheung is a rare visitor at our home; he only comes once every few months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今日有位稀客到訪——係我老細嘅朋友，大家要招呼吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 jat6 jau5 wai2 hei1 haak3 dou3 fong2 — hai6 ngo5 lou5 sai3 ge3 pang4 jau5, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 ziu1 fu1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今天有位稀客到访——是我老板的朋友，大家要招待一下。
examples.english_sentence: A rare visitor came to the company today — he's my boss's friend, so everyone should give him some attention.

mandarin_meaning: 稀少、寥寥无几
english_meaning: sparse; few and far between; very few
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或物很少、稀疏，與「稀少」「寥寥无几」意近。通常用來形容人流、物件數量等稀少的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that people or things are very few or sparse. Similar in meaning to 'sparse' or 'few and far between.' Often used to describe low attendance, scant items, or a sparse distribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日展覽嘅觀眾稀寥寥，場面好冷清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zin2 laam5 ge3 gun1 zung3 hei1 liu4 liu4, coeng4 min6 hou2 laang5 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天展览的观众稀稀寥寥，现场很冷清。
examples.english_sentence: The exhibition had very few visitors; the venue was quite quiet.

mandarin_meaning: 稀少 (xī shǎo) — 稀少、罕見、數量很少
english_meaning: scarce; rare; few; sparse
explanation_mandarin: 表示數量很少、不常見或稀罕，可用來形容物品、現象、人數或可獲得性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is few in number, uncommon, or scarce; used to describe items, occurrences, people, or availability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢類植物喺本地好稀少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leoi6 zik6 mat6 hai2 bun2 dei6 hou2 hei1siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這類植物在本地非常稀少。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of plant is very rare locally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場上供應嘅貨品稀少，要早啲去搶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 soeng6 gung1 jing3 ge3 fo3 ban2 hei1siu2, jiu3 zou2 di1 heoi3 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場上供應的貨品稀少，要早點去搶購。
examples.english_sentence: Supplies in the market are scarce; you need to go early to grab them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話公司嘅職位唔多，空缺好稀少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gung1 si1 ge3 zik1 wai6 m4 do1, hung1 kyut3 hou2 hei1siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說公司的職位不多，空缺很稀少。
examples.english_sentence: He said there aren't many positions at the company; vacancies are very scarce.

mandarin_meaning: 稀少；罕見
english_meaning: rare; uncommon; scarce
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物很少、罕見或不常見，常用來形容稀有的物種、資源或物品。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is scarce, rare, or uncommon; often used to describe rare species, resources, or items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種動物喺香港好稀有，好難見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 dung6 mat6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 hei1 jau5, hou2 naan4 gin3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種動物在香港很稀有，很難見到。
examples.english_sentence: This species is very rare in Hong Kong and hard to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫好稀有，收藏家都想買返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 hou2 hei1 jau5, sou1 cong4 gaa1 dou1 soeng2 maai5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫很稀有，收藏家都想買回來。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is very rare; collectors all want to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 很差、沒用、不可靠（粵語口語）
english_meaning: shabby; flimsy; worthless; useless (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「稀框框」為粵語口語用語，用來形容人或物質量差、沒用、脆弱或不可靠；帶貶義，多用於非正式語境。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe a person or thing as poor in quality, useless, flaky, or unreliable. It is derogatory and typically used in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好買嗰部電視，質素好稀框框。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 maai5 go2 bou6 din6 si6, zat1 sou3 hou2 hei1 kwaang1 kwaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別買那台電視，質量很差。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy that TV; the quality is really bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁稀框框，點可以畀佢負責重要項目？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam2 hei1 kwaang1 kwaang1, dim2 ho2 ji5 bei2 keoi5 fu6 zak1 zung6 joeng6 muk6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事這麼沒能力，怎麼能讓他負責重要項目？
examples.english_sentence: He's so incompetent; how could you put him in charge of an important project?

mandarin_meaning: 稀疏；稀少；不密集
english_meaning: sparse; thinly scattered; not dense
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物分布不密集、間隔較大或數量較少。
explanation_english: Describes something that is thinly scattered or not densely distributed; few in number or spaced far apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲頭髮愈來愈稀疏，真係擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 tau4 faat3 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 hei1 so1, zan1 hai6 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的頭髮越來越稀疏，真是讓人擔心。
examples.english_sentence: My hair is getting thinner and thinner; it's really worrying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排公園入面啲樹種得比較稀疏，睇落唔太靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 di1 syu6 zung3 dak1 bei2 gaau3 hei1 so1, tai2 lok6 m4 taai3 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公園裡面的樹種得比較稀疏，看起來不太好看。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the trees in the park are planted rather sparsely; it doesn't look very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 稀罕（表稀少、罕見；亦有方言義：喜歡、看重）
english_meaning: rare; uncommon; (colloquial) to like or be fond of / to value
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中，'稀罕'既可用作形容詞，表示稀少、罕見；亦常用作動詞，表示喜歡、看重、在乎（屬口語用法）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '稀罕' can mean 'rare' or 'uncommon' as an adjective. Colloquially it is also used as a verb meaning 'to like', 'to be fond of', or 'to value'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好稀罕嗰啲名牌嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 hei1 hon2 go2 di1 ming4 paai4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太喜歡那些名牌東西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very keen on those brand-name items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件古董好稀罕，唔係咁易搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 gu2 dung2 hou2 hei1 hon2, m4 hai6 gam2 ji6 wan2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件古董很稀罕，不是那麼容易找到。
examples.english_sentence: This antique is very rare; it's not easy to find.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁稀罕佢啦，佢都唔理你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 hei1 hon2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 m4 lei5 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那麼看重他，他也不理你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hung up on him; he doesn't care about you.

mandarin_meaning: 稀薄（空气、气氛、关系等稀少、稀疏、浓度低）
english_meaning: thin; sparse; rarefied (low density or concentration); faint/weak (as in feelings or relations)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物的密度或濃度很低，分佈稀疏；也可用來形容感情、關係等淡薄。
explanation_english: Describes something of low density or concentration and a sparse distribution; can also describe weak or faint feelings/relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺高山上面，空氣好稀薄，呼吸都有啲困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gou1 saan1 soeng6 min6, hung1 hei3 hou2 hei1 bok6, fu1 kap1 dou1 jau5 di1 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在高山上面，空气很稀薄，呼吸都有点困难。
examples.english_sentence: On high mountains the air is very thin, and breathing can be somewhat difficult.

mandarin_meaning: 稀释（使浓度降低；比喻削弱或淡化）
english_meaning: to dilute; to reduce concentration; to weaken or make less intense (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用液体加入溶剂或用其他方式使物質的浓度降低；也可引申为削弱、淡化某种效果或印象。
explanation_english: To make a solution less concentrated by adding a solvent; figuratively, to weaken, lessen, or make something less pronounced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯果汁太濃，要加啲水稀釋先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 gwo2 zap1 taai3 nung4, jiu3 gaa1 di1 seoi2 hei1 sik1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這杯果汁太濃，要加點水稀釋一下。
examples.english_sentence: This juice is too concentrated; add some water to dilute it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果繼續咁樣稀釋公司嘅資源，啲項目就做唔成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gai3 zuk6 gam2 joeng6 hei1 sik1 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 jyun4, di1 hong6 muk6 zau6 zou6 m4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果繼續這樣稀釋公司的資源，項目就無法完成。
examples.english_sentence: If the company's resources keep getting diluted like this, the projects won't be doable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話啲印象畀時間稀釋咗，唔再咁清晰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 di1 jan3 zoeng6 bei2 si4 gaan1 hei1 sik1 zo2, m4 zoi6 gam2 cing1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說那些印象被時間稀釋了，不再那麼清晰。
examples.english_sentence: He said the impressions have been blurred by time and are no longer so clear.

mandarin_meaning: 稀饭 / 粥 (xīfàn / zhōu)
english_meaning: congee; rice porridge
explanation_mandarin: 指用大量水把米煮到稀爛成湯狀的飯，常作早餐或慰藉食物。在華語中也常稱為「粥」或「稀飯」。
explanation_english: Rice cooked with plenty of water until soft and soupy; congee or rice porridge. Commonly eaten for breakfast or as comfort/comforting food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食稀飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 hei1 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃稀饭／粥。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat congee tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日早餐都食稀飯同油條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zou2 caan1 dou1 sik6 hei1 faan6 tung4 jau4 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天早餐都吃稀饭和油条。
examples.english_sentence: He always eats congee and youtiao for breakfast.

mandarin_meaning: 稅 (shuì)，指政府依法律向個人或企業徵收的財政收入
english_meaning: tax; duty; a compulsory charge imposed by a government on individuals or businesses
explanation_mandarin: 指政府根據法律或規定向個人、企業或交易徵收的金錢，用於公共支出。
explanation_english: Money collected by the government from individuals, businesses, or transactions according to law or regulation, used for public expenditures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要交稅，唔可以逃稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaau1 seoi3, m4 ho2 ji5 tou4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要繳稅，不能逃稅。
examples.english_sentence: We have to pay taxes; we can't evade them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今年要補交稅款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 jiu3 bou2 gaau1 seoi3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今年需要補繳稅款。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to make a supplementary tax payment this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 進口貨物會有關稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeon3 hau2 fo3 mat6 wui5 jau5 gwaan1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 進口貨物會有關稅。
examples.english_sentence: Imported goods are subject to tariffs.

mandarin_meaning: 稅（稅金，徵收的款項）
english_meaning: tax; duty (government-imposed charge)
explanation_mandarin: 指政府向個人或企業徵收的款項（稅金），也可指徵稅的行為或相關事務。
explanation_english: Refers to money levied by the government on individuals or businesses (taxes); can also denote the act of levying taxes or tax-related matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司要交好多稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 jiu3 gaau1 hou2 do1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司要繳很多稅。
examples.english_sentence: This company has to pay a lot of taxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買嘢嗰陣啲價錢已經包埋稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 je5 go2 zan6 di1 gaa3 cin2 ji5 ging1 baau1 maai4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買東西的時候價格已經包括稅了。
examples.english_sentence: The price already includes tax when buying things.

mandarin_meaning: 税制 (shuìzhì)
english_meaning: tax system; taxation system; tax regime
explanation_mandarin: 指國家或地區關於徵稅、稅種、稅率及稅收管理的制度與規範。
explanation_english: Refers to the system and rules a country or jurisdiction uses to levy taxes, including types of taxes, rates, and administration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會檢討稅制，減輕市民嘅負擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 gim2 tou2 seoi3 zai3, gaam2 hing1 si5 man4 ge3 fu6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會檢討稅制，減輕市民的負擔。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will review the tax system to reduce the burdens on citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 税务
english_meaning: tax matters; taxation; tax affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指與徵稅、稅收管理、稅務處理相關的事務或工作，例如稅務申報、稅務審核和稅務優惠等。
explanation_english: Refers to matters related to taxation and tax administration, such as tax filing, tax audits, and tax benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要向稅務局申報收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hoeng3 seoi3 mou6 guk6 san1 bou3 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要向税务局申报收入。
examples.english_sentence: We need to report our income to the tax office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅稅務問題好複雜，最好搵會計師幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 seoi3 mou6 man6 tai4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, zeoi3 hou2 wan2 wui6 gai3 si1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的税务问题很复杂，最好找会计师帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: The company's tax matters are complicated; it's best to get an accountant to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 稅務優惠可以減低你嘅負擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 mou6 jau1 wai6 ho2 ji5 gaam2 dai1 nei5 ge3 fu6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 税务优惠可以减轻你的负担。
examples.english_sentence: Tax incentives can reduce your burden.

mandarin_meaning: 税务；与税收有关的事务或管理工作
english_meaning: tax affairs; matters related to taxation or tax administration
explanation_mandarin: 指與稅收、稅務管理、稅務申報等相關的工作或事務。
explanation_english: Refers to matters or work related to taxes, tax administration, and tax filing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月要做稅務申報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 zou6 seoi3 mou6 san1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月要做税务申报。
examples.english_sentence: We need to do tax filing next month.

mandarin_meaning: 税务局
english_meaning: tax bureau; tax office; revenue department
explanation_mandarin: 負責徵收稅款與管理稅務事務的政府機構或部門。
explanation_english: A government office or department responsible for collecting taxes and handling tax-related matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去稅務局交文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 seoi3 mou6 guk6 gaau1 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去税务局交文件。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the tax bureau next month to submit documents.

mandarin_meaning: 税务局
english_meaning: tax office / tax authority (Inland Revenue Department)
explanation_mandarin: 負責徵收稅款和稅務管理的政府機構；在香港常指稅務局（Inland Revenue Department）。
explanation_english: A government agency responsible for collecting taxes and administering tax matters; in Hong Kong it commonly refers to the Inland Revenue Department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去稅務局交表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 seoi3 mou6 guk6 gaau1 biu2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去税务局交表。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the tax office today to submit a form.

mandarin_meaning: 稅務師
english_meaning: tax advisor / tax agent / tax consultant
explanation_mandarin: 指提供稅務諮詢、申報或代理等專業服務的專業人士，類似稅務顧問或稅務代理人。
explanation_english: A professional who provides tax-related services such as consultation, tax filing, and representation; similar to a tax advisor, tax agent, or tax accountant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我請咗一位稅務師幫我申報個人所得稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceng2 zo2 jat1 wai6 seoi3mou6si1 bong1 ngo5 san1bou3 go3 jan4 so2dak1seoi3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我請了一位稅務師幫我申報個人所得稅。
examples.english_sentence: I hired a tax advisor to help me file my personal income tax.

mandarin_meaning: 税单
english_meaning: tax bill; tax notice; tax assessment
explanation_mandarin: 由稅務機關發出的列明應繳稅款或補稅金額的單據或通知。
explanation_english: A document or notice issued by tax authorities that lists the taxes owed or any additional tax assessment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到最新嘅稅單，要喺月底之前繳交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 zeoi3 san1 ge3 seoi3 daan1, jiu3 hai2 jyut6 mei5 zi1 cin4 gaau2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了最新的稅單，要在月底之前繳交。
examples.english_sentence: I received the latest tax bill; I have to pay it before the end of the month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府寄嚟一張補稅嘅稅單，話我哋少報咗收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gei3 lei4 jat1 zoeng1 bou2 seoi3 ge3 seoi3 daan1, waa6 ngo5 dei6 siu2 bou3 zo2 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府寄來一張補稅的稅單，說我們少報了收入。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent a supplemental tax bill saying we underreported income.

mandarin_meaning: 稅單；納稅通知單
english_meaning: tax bill; tax notice; tax assessment
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或稅務機關發出的書面通知，列明應繳納的稅款金額與繳納期限，常見於個人或公司的所得稅、差餉、物業稅等。
explanation_english: A written notice issued by tax authorities indicating the amount of tax due and the payment deadline; commonly used for income tax, rates, property tax, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱收到張稅單，唔知幾時要交錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou3 zoeng1 seoi3 daan1, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 jiu3 gaau1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛收到稅單，不知道什麼時候要交錢。
examples.english_sentence: I just received the tax bill and don't know when it's due.

mandarin_meaning: 稅基 (shuìjī)
english_meaning: tax base
explanation_mandarin: 指可被徵稅的基礎或範圍，如收入、財產、交易等，是用來計算稅收金額的依據。
explanation_english: The base or scope subject to taxation—such as income, property, or transactions—used as the basis for calculating tax liabilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果擴大稅基，可能會令到好多人要繳稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 kwok3 daai6 seoi3 gei1, ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 jiu3 gaau2 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果擴大稅基，可能會導致更多人要繳稅。
examples.english_sentence: If the tax base is broadened, it may result in more people having to pay taxes.

mandarin_meaning: 税基；指用作計算稅款的基礎或範圍（例如收入、財產等）
english_meaning: tax base; the base (amount, value, or items) on which taxes are calculated
explanation_mandarin: 稅基是指用作計算或徵收稅款的基礎，例如個人或企業的應稅收入、財產或交易金額。稅基的範圍和定義會影響政府稅收的規模與公平性。
explanation_english: The tax base is the foundation used to calculate or levy taxes — for example, a person's or company's taxable income, property, or transaction value. How the tax base is defined and its scope affect the size and fairness of government revenue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果稅基俾侵蝕，政府嘅稅收會減少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 seoi3 gei1 bei2 cam1 sik6, zing3 fu2 ge3 seoi3 sau1 wui5 gaam2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果稅基被侵蝕，政府的稅收會減少。
examples.english_sentence: If the tax base is eroded, the government's tax revenue will decrease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 擴大稅基可以幫政府多籌款，用嚟改善公共服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kwok3 daai6 seoi3 gei1 ho2 ji5 bong1 zing3 fu2 do1 cau4 fun2, jung6 lai4 goi2 sin6 gung1 gung6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 擴大稅基可以幫助政府多籌款，用來改善公共服務。
examples.english_sentence: Broadening the tax base can help the government raise more funds to improve public services.

mandarin_meaning: 税务局；负责征收税款和管理税务的政府机构
english_meaning: tax office / tax bureau (government agency responsible for tax collection and administration)
explanation_mandarin: 指负责征收税款、处理税务事务和管理税收的政府机构。粤语中常用来指代税务机关或税务部门。
explanation_english: Refers to a government agency responsible for collecting taxes and administering tax matters. In Cantonese it is commonly used to denote the tax authority or tax office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去稅局交稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 seoi3 guk6 gaau1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去税务局交税。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the tax office tomorrow to pay taxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要去稅局查資料，睇下有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 heoi3 seoi3 guk6 caa4 zi1 liu6, tai2 haa6 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說要去税务局查资料，看看有没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: He said he needs to go to the tax office to check the documents and see if there are any problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要向稅局申報收入，記得準備齊文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jiu3 hoeng3 seoi3 guk6 san1 bou3 sau1 jap6, gei3 dak1 zeon2 bei6 cai4 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要向税务局申报收入，記得準備齐文件。
examples.english_sentence: The company must report its income to the tax office; remember to prepare all the documents.

mandarin_meaning: 税务局；税务机关
english_meaning: tax office; tax authority
explanation_mandarin: 指负责征收税款和管理税务事务的政府机构；在香港口语中常用来指税务署或税务部门。
explanation_english: Refers to the government office responsible for collecting taxes and administering tax matters; in Hong Kong colloquially used to refer to the Inland Revenue Department or tax authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 稅局今朝打嚟問我啲報稅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 guk6 gam1 ziu1 daa2 lai4 man6 ngo5 di1 bou3 seoi3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 税务局今天早上打电话来问我的报税资料。
examples.english_sentence: The tax office called this morning to ask about my tax filing information.

mandarin_meaning: 稅收（政府徵收的稅款或整體稅收收入）
english_meaning: tax(es); taxation; tax revenue
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或主管機關徵收的稅款，或整體來自各種稅收的收入。
explanation_english: Refers to taxes collected by the government or the total revenue generated from various taxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府今年嘅稅收比去年多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gam1 nin4 ge3 seoi3 sau1 bei2 heoi3 nin4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府今年的稅收比去年多。
examples.english_sentence: The government's tax revenue this year is higher than last year's.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果減稅，可能會令稅收減少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gaam2 seoi3, ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 seoi3 sau1 gaam2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果減稅，可能會導致稅收減少。
examples.english_sentence: If taxes are cut, tax revenue may decrease.

mandarin_meaning: 稅收（shuìshōu），指政府徵收的各種稅款與稅務收入
english_meaning: tax revenue; taxes; taxation (the revenue collected by the government through taxes)
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或權力機構透過稅制從個人或企業徵收的金錢，用於公共支出與服務。
explanation_english: Refers to money collected by the government or authorities from individuals and businesses through taxes, used to fund public expenditures and services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府每年嘅稅收都用嚟改善公共服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 mui5 nin4 ge3 seoi3 sau1 dou1 jung6 lai4 goi2 sin6 gung1 gung6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府每年的稅收都用來改善公共服務。
examples.english_sentence: The government's tax revenue each year is used to improve public services.

mandarin_meaning: 税款（shuìkuǎn）：應向政府繳納的稅金或稅額
english_meaning: taxes; tax payment; amount of tax payable
explanation_mandarin: 指政府向個人或單位徵收、應繳納的金額，用以支付公共開支或履行稅務義務。
explanation_english: Refers to money payable to the government as taxes collected from individuals or entities; the amount of tax owed or paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要如期交稅款，否則會被罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 jyu4 kei4 gaau1 seoi3 fun2, fau2 ze2 wui5 bei6 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司必须按时缴纳税款，否则会被罚款。
examples.english_sentence: The company must pay the taxes on time, otherwise it will be fined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅稅款比去年多，我哋要預早安排財政。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 seoi3 fun2 bei2 heoi3 nin4 do1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jyu6 zou2 ngon1 paai4 coi4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的税款比去年多，我們要提前安排財政。
examples.english_sentence: This year's taxes are higher than last year's; we need to arrange finances in advance.

mandarin_meaning: 税率 (shuìlǜ)
english_meaning: tax rate
explanation_mandarin: 指政府對收入、商品交易或財產徵收稅款時所採用的比例，通常以百分比表示。
explanation_english: The percentage at which taxes are levied on income, transactions, property, etc.; usually expressed as a percentage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會喺下年調高稅率，生意會受影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 hai2 haa6 nin4 tiu4 gou1 seoi3 leot6, saang1 ji3 wui5 sau6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會在明年提高稅率，生意會受到影響。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will raise tax rates next year; businesses will be affected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓時要留意印花稅率，同埋首期比例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau4 si4 jiu3 lau4 ji3 jan3 faa1 seoi3 leot6, tung4 maai4 sau2 kei4 bei2 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買房時要注意印花稅率以及首付款比例。
examples.english_sentence: When buying a property, pay attention to the stamp duty rate and the down payment ratio.

mandarin_meaning: 稅率 (shuìlǜ)
english_meaning: tax rate
explanation_mandarin: 表示徵稅的比率，通常以百分比表示，用來計算應繳稅款占應稅金額的比例。
explanation_english: The percentage at which taxable income or value is taxed; used to calculate the proportion of tax payable relative to the taxable base.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話下年會調高稅率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 haa6 nin4 wui5 tiu4 gou1 seoi3 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說明年會提高稅率。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will raise the tax rate next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 稅率高，市民嘅負擔會增加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 leot6 gou1, si5 man4 ge3 fu6 daam1 wui5 zang1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 稅率高，市民的負擔會增加。
examples.english_sentence: High tax rates will increase the burden on citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 稅收的種類/類別（如增值稅、所得稅、消費稅等）
english_meaning: type of tax; tax category (e.g., VAT, income tax, excise tax)
explanation_mandarin: 指不同類型的稅，按徵收對象或徵收方式劃分，例如增值稅、所得稅、消費稅等。
explanation_english: Refers to different kinds or categories of taxes, classified by subject or method of collection, for example value-added tax, income tax, or excise tax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會考慮引入新嘅稅種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 haau2 leoi6 jan5 jap6 san1 ge3 seoi3 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會考慮引入新的稅種。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it would consider introducing a new type of tax.

mandarin_meaning: 稅階（税收按收入或標準劃分的級別）
english_meaning: tax bracket (a level or band of income subject to a particular tax rate)
explanation_mandarin: 指根據收入或其他標準將應稅金額劃分為不同等級，每個等級適用不同的稅率，常用於個人或公司所得稅的計算。
explanation_english: The division of income (or other taxable base) into levels or bands, each subject to a specific tax rate; commonly used when calculating personal or corporate income tax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你嘅收入升咗去下一個稅階，你就要畀多啲稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ge3 sau1 jap6 sing1 zo2 heoi3 haa6 jat1 go3 seoi3 gaai1, nei5 zau6 jiu3 bei2 do1 di1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你的收入升到下一個稅階，就要繳更多稅。
examples.english_sentence: If your income moves into a higher tax bracket, you'll have to pay more taxes.

mandarin_meaning: 稅項／稅目
english_meaning: tax item; tax charge; taxable item
explanation_mandarin: 指需徵收或需要繳納的稅務項目或類別，例如某一類商品或服務所屬的稅目。
explanation_english: Refers to a tax item or category of tax that is levied or payable, e.g., a specific tax applied to a type of good or service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要列出所有稅項，唔可以漏報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 lit6 ceot1 so2 jau5 seoi3 hong6, m4 ho2 ji5 lau6 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要列出所有稅項，不能漏報。
examples.english_sentence: The company must list all tax items; they cannot omit any.

mandarin_meaning: 税项（税目、应缴的税款或税种）
english_meaning: tax item; tax charge; tax category
explanation_mandarin: 指账单或税务文件中列出的各项应缴税款或税种，常用于财政、会计和法律等正式语境。
explanation_english: Refers to individual tax items or charges listed on a bill or tax document (types of taxes or amounts payable). Commonly used in financial, accounting, and legal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要申報所有稅項。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 san1 bou3 so2 jau5 seoi3 hong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要申报所有税项。
examples.english_sentence: The company must declare all tax items.

mandarin_meaning: 秆；植物的莖或稈，尤指谷物的秸稈
english_meaning: stalk; stem; straw (the stalk of cereal crops)
explanation_mandarin: 指植物的莖或秆，常用來指穀物、稻、麥等作物收割後剩下的秸稈，可用作飼料、覆蓋物或製作堆肥。
explanation_english: Refers to the stalk or stem of a plant, commonly the straw left after harvesting cereals like rice or wheat; often used for animal bedding/forage, mulching, or compost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農民用稻稈做堆肥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 man4 jung6 dou6 gon2 zou6 deoi1 fei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農民用稻稈做堆肥。
examples.english_sentence: Farmers use rice straw to make compost.

mandarin_meaning: chéng — 表示程度、次序、過程、路程，也用於計算機的“程式”等詞。
english_meaning: chéng — degree/extent; order/sequence; process; itinerary/journey; program (in computing).
partOfSpeech_english: noun (often a bound morpheme used in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 單字「程」常用於合成詞，表示程度（程度）、次序或過程（程序、進程）、路程（行程），在計算機語境下也表示程式、程序等。
explanation_english: The character "程" appears mainly in compounds and denotes degree, order/sequence, process, or journey/itinerary. In computing contexts it is used for program/process (e.g., 程式).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅中文程度好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zung1 man4 cing4 dou6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的中文程度很高。
examples.english_sentence: His Chinese proficiency is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要安排旅行嘅行程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 on1 paai4 leoi5 hang4 ge3 hang4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要安排旅行的行程。
examples.english_sentence: I need to arrange the itinerary for the trip today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式有錯，要修正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 jau5 co3, jiu3 sau1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序有错误，需要修正。
examples.english_sentence: This program has errors and needs to be fixed.

cantonese: 程尋磨鉸叉燒包，老鼠唔食豆沙包
jyutping: cing4 cam4 mo4 gaau2 caa1 siu1 baau1, lou5 syu2 m4 sik6 dau6 saa1 baau1
mandarin_meaning: 費盡心思卻得到不合意的結果；白費力氣
english_meaning: To go to great lengths but end up with something unsuitable or unwanted; wasted effort
explanation_mandarin: 這句話用來形容花了很多工夫或心機去做一件事，結果得到的東西並不是自己想要的，或是努力沒有得到回報，相當於「白費心機」或「徒勞無功」。句中用菠蘿包、叉燒包、豆沙包等食物作比喻，帶有廣東話的口語色彩。
explanation_english: This Cantonese proverb describes putting in a lot of effort or trouble only to receive an outcome that is unsuitable or unwanted — essentially wasted effort. The phrase uses bun types (char siu bun, red-bean bun) as a humorous, colloquial metaphor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣買貴嘅衫送畀佢，但佢唔鍾意，真係程尋磨鉸叉燒包，老鼠唔食豆沙包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 maai5 gwai3 ge3 saam1 sung3 bei2 keoi5, daan6 keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3, zan1 hai6 cing4 cam4 mo4 gaau2 caa1 siu1 baau1, lou5 syu2 m4 sik6 dau6 saa1 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣買貴的衣服送給她，但她不喜歡，真是白費心機。
examples.english_sentence: You bought expensive clothes for her but she doesn't like them — it's really a waste of effort.

mandarin_meaning: 程序 (chéngxù)：步骤、流程；计算机程序
english_meaning: procedure; process; program (computer)
explanation_mandarin: 表示处理事情的步骤或顺序，也可指计算机上的程序（程式）。常用于工作流程、会议议程或软件开发等语境。
explanation_english: Refers to a sequence of steps or the order of operations; can also mean a computer program. Commonly used for workflows, meeting agendas, or software.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程序仲未完成，要等上司批核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 zeoi6 zung6 mei6 jyun4 sing4, jiu3 dang2 soeng5 si1 pai1 hat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序还没完成，要等上司批核。
examples.english_sentence: This procedure isn't finished yet; we need approval from the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一個新嘅電腦程序，可以自動化成個流程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 din6 nou5 cing4 zeoi6, ho2 ji5 zi6 dung6 faa3 sing4 go3 lau4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了一个新的电脑程序，可以把整个流程自动化。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a new computer program that can automate the whole process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議有既定程序，請大家依次發言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 jau5 gei3 ding6 cing4 zeoi6, ceng2 daai6 gaa1 ji1 ci3 faat3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议有既定程序，请大家依次发言。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting has a set agenda; please speak in turn.

mandarin_meaning: 程序正義／程序公正（指司法或行政等過程中程序的公正性與透明度）
english_meaning: Procedural justice; fairness and transparency of procedures (e.g., legal or administrative processes)
explanation_mandarin: 指在司法、行政或決策過程中，透過公平、透明且符合法律程序的方式保障當事人的權利與程序上的正當性。
explanation_english: Refers to the fairness and transparency of procedures in judicial, administrative, or decision-making processes, emphasizing protection of parties' procedural rights and legitimacy of the process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢單司法案件入面，程序公義好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 daan1 si1 faat3 on3 gin6 jap6 min6, cing4 zeoi6 gung1 ji6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這宗司法案件中，程序公義非常重要。
examples.english_sentence: Procedural justice is very important in this legal case.

mandarin_meaning: 程度（chéngdù）：范围、水平、程度
english_meaning: degree; extent; level; standard
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物的程度、范围或水平，例如能力的高低、事情的严重性或進展的程度。
