examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hung1 soeng2 laa1, sat6 zai3 di1 heoi3 zou6 di1 gai3 waak6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是空想了，先務實一點去做些計劃。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep daydreaming; be more practical and actually make some plans first.

mandarin_meaning: 空中作战；（网络口语）指网上的言语争斗
english_meaning: air combat (dogfight); (slang) online/verbal fight or debate
explanation_mandarin: 「空戰」原指空中作戰、空中格鬥（如戰機之間的交火）。在網絡或口語語境中，也常用來形容純粹以言語或網上爭吵、口水戰，沒有實體衝突。
explanation_english: Originally refers to aerial combat or dogfights between aircraft. In colloquial/online usage it can mean a purely verbal or online fight/debate (a 'word battle') with no physical confrontation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩架戰機喺空中展開空戰，互相追打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaa3 zin3 gei1 hai2 hung1 zung1 zin2 hoi1 hung1 zin3, wu6 soeng1 zeoi1 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两架战机在空中展开空战，互相追打。
examples.english_sentence: Two fighter jets engaged in an air battle, chasing and attacking each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺網上互相鬧交，但只係得空戰，冇真刀真槍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 wu6 soeng1 naau6 gaau1, daan6 zi2 hai6 dak1 hung1 zin3, mou5 zan1 dou1 zan1 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在网上互相吵架，但只是空战，没有真刀真枪。
examples.english_sentence: They were arguing online, but it was only an 'air battle'—no real physical fighting.

mandarin_meaning: 空手、兩手空空；徒手、未帶武器
english_meaning: empty-handed; with nothing in one's hands; unarmed
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有帶任何東西，兩手空空；也可指徒手或未攜帶武器。可單獨使用或做複合詞（如「空手道」）。
explanation_english: Indicates having nothing in one's hands (empty-handed); can also mean unarmed or without weapons. Can be used alone or in compounds (e.g. "空手道").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日去市場買嘢，結果空手返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 si5 coeng4 maai5 je5, git3 gwo2 hung1 sau2 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天去市場買東西，結果空手回來。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the market today to buy something but came back empty-handed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方發現疑犯係空手，冇帶武器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 faat3 jin6 ji4 faan6 hai6 hung1 sau2, mou5 daai3 mou5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方發現疑犯是空手，沒有帶武器。
examples.english_sentence: The police found the suspect was unarmed and had no weapons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾年空手道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 nin4 hung1 sau2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他學了幾年空手道。
examples.english_sentence: He has studied karate (empty-hand way) for several years.

mandarin_meaning: 空手而归（没有带回任何东西）
english_meaning: to return empty-handed; to come back with nothing
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有得到任何東西就返回，常用於購物、求職、投資等情況，屬於動詞短語或成語用法。
explanation_english: Indicates returning without obtaining anything. Commonly used for situations like shopping, job hunting, or failed investments. Functions as a verb phrase/idiom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去街市買魚，但係賣晒，最後空手而回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 jyu4, daan6 hai6 maai6 saat3, zeoi3 hau6 hung1 sau2 ji4 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去市場買魚，但都賣完了，最後空手而歸。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the market to buy fish, but they were all sold out, so I returned empty-handed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去咗幾間公司面試，都冇落實，總係空手而回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 gei2 gaan1 gung1 si1 min6 si3, dou1 mou5 lok6 sat6, zung2 hai6 hung1 sau2 ji4 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去好幾家公司面試，都沒能成功，總是空手而歸。
examples.english_sentence: I went to several companies for interviews but didn't succeed, so I always ended up empty-handed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次投資失敗，最後空手而回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 baai6, zeoi3 hau6 hung1 sau2 ji4 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次投資失敗，最後空手而歸。
examples.english_sentence: His investment failed this time, and he ended up returning empty-handed.

mandarin_meaning: 空手道（kōngshǒudào），指一種起源於日本的武術和搏擊運動，也作為競技運動和自衛術。
english_meaning: Karate (a Japanese martial art focused on unarmed combat, practiced as self-defense and sport).
explanation_mandarin: 空手道是源自日本的一種武道，強調徒手攻防、型（kata）與對打（kumite），可作為健身、競技與自衛術。
explanation_english: Karate is a Japanese martial art emphasizing unarmed techniques, forms (kata), and sparring (kumite); practiced for fitness, competition, and self-defense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個學咗幾年空手道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hok6 zo2 gei2 nin4 hung1 sau2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候學了幾年空手道。
examples.english_sentence: I studied karate for several years when I was a child.

mandarin_meaning: 空投 (kōngtóu) — 指由飛機或直升機從空中投放物資、兵力；也指加密貨幣或營銷活動中免費發放代幣或贈品
english_meaning: airdrop — to drop supplies or personnel from aircraft; also the free distribution of tokens or giveaways (crypto/marketing)
explanation_mandarin: 原指由飛機或直升機將物資或人員從空中投放到地面；近年在加密貨幣和市場營銷中，指免費發放代幣或贈品以吸引用戶或宣傳活動。
explanation_english: Originally refers to delivering supplies or personnel from aircraft to the ground; recently used in crypto and marketing to mean the free distribution of tokens or giveaways to attract users or promote projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍機喺山區空投咗物資畀受災嘅村民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 gei1 hai2 saan1 keoi1 hung1 tau4 zo2 mat6 zi1 bei2 sau6 zoi1 ge3 cyun1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军机在山区空投了物资给受灾的村民。
examples.english_sentence: Military aircraft airdropped supplies to villagers affected by the disaster in the mountain area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目會空投一啲代幣，吸引新用戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 wui5 hung1 tau4 jat1 di1 doi6 bai6, kap1 jan5 san1 jung6 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目会空投一些代币，以吸引新用户。
examples.english_sentence: This project will airdrop some tokens to attract new users.

mandarin_meaning: 空旷（kōngkuàng），寬闊且空無或人很少的地方
english_meaning: spacious; open; wide and largely empty or sparsely populated
explanation_mandarin: 形容地方寬闊而且空無或人很少，可用來描述公園、廣場、街道等。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is wide and empty or sparsely populated; often used for parks, plazas, streets, and open areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個公園好空曠，啱晒放風箏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gung1 jyun4 hou2 hung1 kong3, aam1 saai3 fong3 fung1 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個公園很空旷，適合放風箏。
examples.english_sentence: That park is very open — perfect for flying kites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚嗰條街好空曠，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 go2 tiu4 gaai1 hou2 hung1 kong3, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上那條街很空旷，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: That street is very empty at night; be careful when walking.

mandarin_meaning: 空架子；徒有其表，只有形式沒有實質
english_meaning: an empty shell; mere formality or hollow framework without real substance
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容只有外在形式或表面功夫，但缺乏實際內容或效果的事物或做法。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that has only outward form or appearances but lacks real content or effectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得幾好聽，但其實淨係空框框，冇用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 gei2 hou2 teng1, daan6 kei4 sat6 zing6 hai6 hung1 kwaang1 kwaang1, mou5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說得挺好聽，但其實只是空架子，沒用。
examples.english_sentence: You talk well, but it's just empty rhetoric — useless.

mandarin_meaning: 空档（空闲时间；时间或安排上的间隙）
english_meaning: a free slot or spare time; a gap/interval in a schedule; an opportunity
explanation_mandarin: 指日程中的空閒時段或兩件事之間的間隙，也可指可利用的機會或空位。
explanation_english: Refers to a free period in someone's schedule or a gap/interval between things; can also mean an available opportunity or slot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜有啲空檔，可以約你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 di1 hung1 dong2, ho2 ji5 joek3 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下星期有一些空档，可以約你吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: I have some free time next week, I can meet you for a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台今個星期冇空檔播新劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 mou5 hung1 dong2 bo3 san1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台這個星期沒有空檔播放新劇。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station has no slots this week to air the new drama.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以利用空檔溫習，唔好拖到最後先做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 lei6 jung6 hung1 dong2 wan1 zaap6, m4 hou2 to1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以利用空档複習，不要拖到最後才做。
examples.english_sentence: You can use spare moments to review; don't leave it until the last minute.

mandarin_meaning: 徒然高興；一場空歡喜（以為會發生好事，結果落空）
english_meaning: false joy; to be prematurely or falsely pleased — hope raised then disappointed
explanation_mandarin: 指因誤解或事情未成真而白白高興，最終失望。
explanation_english: Refers to being happy for nothing — excitement or hope that turns out to be unwarranted when the expected outcome does not happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為攞到嗰份工，點知公司改變計劃，結果淨係空歡喜一場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5wai6 lo2 dou3 go2 fan6 gung1, dim2 zi1 gung1si1 goi2 bin3 gai3 waak6, git3 gwo2 zing6 hai6 hung1 fun1 hei2 jat1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以為拿到了那份工作，結果公司改變計劃，最後只是空歡喜一場。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I'd gotten that job, but the company changed plans — in the end it was just a false joy.

mandarin_meaning: 空壳公司
english_meaning: shell company (a company with no substantial assets or operations, often used for holding assets or concealing transactions)
explanation_mandarin: 指名義上存在但沒有實際業務或資產的公司，通常用於避稅、資金轉移或掩飾交易來源。
explanation_english: Refers to a company that exists in name only without significant assets or real business operations; often used for tax avoidance, moving funds, or concealing the origin of transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司睇落好似淨係紙面存在，實際上係一間空殼公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 zing6 hai6 zi2 min6 cyun4 zoi6, sat6 zai3 soeng6 hai6 jat1 gaan1 hung1 hok3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司看起來只是紙面存在，實際上是一家空壳公司。
examples.english_sentence: That company appears to exist only on paper; in reality it is a shell company.

mandarin_meaning: 空气；气氛
english_meaning: air; atmosphere; mood
explanation_mandarin: 指包围我们的可呼吸气体混合物；也可指某个场所或情境的环境氛围、气氛。
explanation_english: The mixture of gases surrounding us that we breathe; also used to refer to the atmosphere or mood of a place or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅空氣好新鮮，適合散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 hung1 hei3 hou2 san1 sin1, sik1 hap6 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的空气很新鲜，适合散步。
examples.english_sentence: The air here is very fresh, suitable for a walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議入面嘅空氣好尷尬，大家都唔出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 ge3 hung1 hei3 hou2 gaan1 gaai3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议里的气氛很尴尬，大家都不出声。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere in the meeting was awkward; everyone stayed silent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企入面嘅空氣好悶，開窗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 jap6 min6 ge3 hung1 hei3 hou2 mun6, hoi1 coeng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屋子里的空气很闷，开窗吧。
examples.english_sentence: The air inside the house is stuffy; open the window.

mandarin_meaning: 空气净化器
english_meaning: air purifier
explanation_mandarin: 一種用來過濾並淨化室內空氣的電器，用以去除灰塵、花粉、異味、細菌和其他污染物。
explanation_english: A device used to filter and purify indoor air, removing dust, pollen, odors, bacteria, and other pollutants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企啲空氣唔好，我諗住買部空氣清新機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 di1 hung1 hei3 m4 hou2, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 bou6 hung1 hei3 cing1 san1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的空氣不好，我打算買一台空氣淨化器。
examples.english_sentence: The air at home is bad; I'm planning to buy an air purifier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開返部空氣清新機會令室內冇咁多塵同異味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 faan1 bou6 hung1 hei3 cing1 san1 gei1 wui5 ling6 sat1 noi6 mou5 gam2 do1 can4 tung4 ji6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開啟空氣淨化器會讓室內少些灰塵和異味。
examples.english_sentence: Turning on the air purifier will reduce dust and odors in the room.

mandarin_meaning: 空气刘海
english_meaning: airy bangs / see-through wispy bangs
explanation_mandarin: 一种刘海样式，特点是发量看起来稀薄、轻盈、透出额头，通常来自韩日发型流行趋势，给人柔和、自然的感觉。
explanation_english: A type of fringe/bangs that are thin, lightweight, and see-through—often from Korean/Japanese hairstyle trends—giving a soft, natural look that reveals part of the forehead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢剪咗個空氣瀏海，好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zin2 zo2 go3 hung1 hei3 lau4 hoi2, hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她剪了空气刘海，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She got airy bangs; they look really pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想試下空氣瀏海，但唔知啱唔啱我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 si3 haa5 hung1 hei3 lau4 hoi2, daan6 m4 zi1 aam1 m4 aam1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想试试空气刘海，但不知道适不适合我。
examples.english_sentence: I want to try airy bangs, but I don't know if they'll suit me.

mandarin_meaning: 空洞、泛泛、缺乏实质内容或具体依据
english_meaning: vague; empty; superficial; lacking concrete substance or specifics
explanation_mandarin: 指内容空洞、不具体、缺乏实质性或具体依据，流于表面。
explanation_english: Describes something that is superficial or lacking in concrete substance or concrete details; vague and empty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個論點好空泛，冇實質根據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 leon6 dim2 hou2 hung1 faan6, mou5 sat6 zat1 gan1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个论点很空泛，没有实质根据。
examples.english_sentence: This argument is very vague and lacks substantive support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 空泛嘅承諾聽多咗，做嘢要睇成效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung1 faan6 ge3 sing4 nok6 teng1 do1 zo2, zou6 je5 jiu3 tai2 sing4 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空泛的承诺听多了，做事要看成效。
examples.english_sentence: I've heard too many empty promises; actions need to show results.

mandarin_meaning: 放鴿子；爽約；不接電話或不回覆（被ghost）
english_meaning: to stand someone up; to fail to show up for an arranged meeting; to ghost someone (not respond)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指約好見面或聯絡時，對方沒有出現或不回應，等於『放鴿子／爽約』，亦可指被對方在消息上無回覆（ghost）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning someone fails to show up for an arranged meeting or does not respond (i.e., stands someone up or ghosts them).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日約佢出嚟，點知佢竟然空波我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 joek3 keoi5 ceot1 lai4, dim2 zi1 keoi5 ging2 jin4 hung1 bo1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天約他出來，結果他竟然放我鴿子。
examples.english_sentence: I asked them out today, but they stood me up.

mandarin_meaning: 空洞 (kōngdòng)：空的、沒有實質內容；比喻內容空虛或缺乏深度
english_meaning: hollow; empty; lacking substance (physically or figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指內部為空或比喻言論、內容缺乏實質、空虛或空泛、沒有深度。
explanation_english: Describes something physically hollow or, figuratively, something (speech, writing, ideas) that lacks substance, depth, or genuine content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說話好空洞，聽落冇真實嘅內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3waa6 hou2 hung1 dung6, teng1 lok6 mou5 zan1sat6 ge3 noi6jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的话很空洞，听起来没有真实的内容。
examples.english_sentence: His words are hollow; they don't seem to have any real substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個石像入面係空洞，可以放嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sek6zoeng6 jap6min6 hai6 hung1 dung6, ho2 ji5 fong3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个石像里面是空洞的，可以放东西。
examples.english_sentence: The statue is hollow inside; you can put things inside it.

mandarin_meaning: 空无一人
english_meaning: completely deserted; not a single person present
explanation_mandarin: 表示某处一个人都没有，形容非常空旷或无人的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that a place has not a single person; describes a completely deserted or uninhabited state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放學嗰陣，操場上空無一人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 hok6 go2 zan6, cou1 coeng4 soeng6 hung1 mou4 jat1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放学的时候，操场上空无一人。
examples.english_sentence: After school, the playground was completely empty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 深夜街道空無一人，只有路燈閃爍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 je6 gaai1 dou6 hung1 mou4 jat1 jan4, zi2 jau5 lou6 dang1 sim2 seok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 深夜街道空无一人，只有路灯闪烁。
examples.english_sentence: The streets were deserted late at night, with only the streetlights flickering.

mandarin_meaning: 空白 (kōngbái) — 沒有內容的地方；空格、空缺；（比喻）記憶或思緒一片空白
english_meaning: blank; empty space; vacancy; (figuratively) a blank in memory or mind
explanation_mandarin: 表示某處沒有內容或留空的部分，例如表格上的空格或文件的空白處；也可用於比喻，表示記憶、思緒等突然一片空白。
explanation_english: Indicates an empty area or blank space (e.g., a blank field on a form); can also be used figuratively to mean a sudden blank in one's memory or mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份表格個地址欄留咗空白，記得填返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 go3 dei6 zi2 laan4 lau4 zo2 hung1 baak6, gei3 dak1 tin4 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份表格的地址欄留了空白，記得填上。
examples.english_sentence: The address field on this form was left blank—remember to fill it in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一問到嗰個問題我個腦即刻空白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 man6 dou3 go2 go3 man6 tai4 ngo5 go3 nou5 zik1 hak1 hung1 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一被問到那個問題我腦袋立刻一片空白。
examples.english_sentence: When asked that question, my mind went completely blank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 履歷表上有段時間留咗空白，面試官問佢點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 lik6 biu2 soeng6 jau5 dyun6 si4 gaan1 lau4 zo2 hung1 baak6, min6 si5 gun1 man6 keoi5 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 履歷表上有段時間留白，面試官問他為什麼。
examples.english_sentence: There was a gap on his resume; the interviewer asked him why.

mandarin_meaning: 无风不起浪 / 空穴来风（消息或传闻通常有一定根据）
english_meaning: There's no smoke without fire; rumors usually have some basis.
explanation_mandarin: “空穴来风”原指风会从洞穴吹出来，比喻消息或传闻不可能凭空产生，通常暗示其背后有一定的根据或来龙去脉。
explanation_english: Literally 'wind comes from a hollow.' It means rumors or news rarely arise from nothing — they often have some basis (similar to 'there's no smoke without fire').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有傳聞話公司會裁員，空穴來風，大家要提防同埋及早準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 cyun4 man4 waa6 gung1 si1 wui5 coi4 jyun4, hung1 hyut3 loi4 fung1, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 tai4 fong4 tung4 maai4 gap3 zou2 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有传闻说公司会裁员，空穴来风，大家要提防并及早准备。
examples.english_sentence: There's been a rumor the company will lay off staff; where there's smoke there's fire — we should be careful and prepare early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為冇聽到就係冇事，空穴來風，最好去查清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai6 mou5 teng1 dou3 zau6 hai6 mou5 si6, hung1 hyut3 loi4 fung1, zeoi3 hou2 heoi3 caa4 cing1 cou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为没听到就没有事，空穴来风，最好去查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume nothing's wrong just because you didn't hear about it; rumors usually have some basis — it's best to check it out.

mandarin_meaning: 空空如也
english_meaning: completely empty; nothing at all
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某處或某物完全沒有東西，徹底空無一物。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a place or thing that is entirely empty, containing nothing at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個抽屜係空空如也，冇嘢喺入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cau1 toi5 hai6 hung1 hung1 jyu4 je5, mou5 je5 hai2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抽屉是空空如也，里面什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: The drawer was completely empty; there was nothing inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅口袋空空如也，連零錢都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau2 doi6 hung1 hung1 jyu4 je5, lin4 ling4 cin2 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口袋空空如也，连零钱都没有。
examples.english_sentence: His pockets were completely empty; not even loose change.

mandarin_meaning: 空窗期（感情上指單身期；也指某事物或工作上的空檔期）
english_meaning: a period of being single (between relationships); a gap or hiatus between events or activities
explanation_mandarin: 通常指感情上暫時沒伴、處於單身的時期；也可用來比喻工作或計劃中的空檔、暫停階段。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a period when someone is temporarily single (between relationships); can also figuratively mean a gap or pause in work or plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺空窗期，都唔急住拍拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 hung1 coeng1 kei4, dou1 m4 gap1 zyu6 paak3 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在处于空窗期，并不急着谈恋爱。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently in a period of being single and isn't in a hurry to start a relationship.

mandarin_meaning: 空笼；空的籠子；引申為空洞、沒有實質內容
english_meaning: empty cage/basket (literal); figuratively: empty, hollow, without substance or result
explanation_mandarin: 原指沒有東西的籠子或籃子。也可引申用來形容事物空洞、徒然或沒有實際內容或結果。
explanation_english: Primarily refers to a cage or basket that is empty. Figuratively used to describe something hollow, empty of substance, or resulting in no concrete outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個雞籠係空籠，啲雞已經飛咗走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai1 lung4 hai6 hung1 lung4, di1 gai1 ji5 ging1 fei1 zo2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个鸡笼是空笼，鸡已经飞走了。
examples.english_sentence: This chicken cage is empty; the chickens have already flown away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲承諾係空籠，實際上冇任何跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 sing4 nok6 hai6 hung1 lung4, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 jam6 ho4 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的承诺是空洞的，实际上没有任何跟进。
examples.english_sentence: His promises are hollow; in reality there is no follow-through.

mandarin_meaning: 空缺 (kōngquē)：職位或名額尚未被填補、有人擔任或某處出現的空位、缺口。
english_meaning: vacancy; an unfilled position or opening; a gap or void
explanation_mandarin: 指職位、名額或位置沒有被佔據或尚未填補，也可用於比喻性的缺口或空白。
explanation_english: Refers to a position, post, or slot that is unoccupied or unfilled; can also be used metaphorically for a gap or void.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有一個空缺，正在招人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 go3 hung1 kyut3, zing3 zoi6 ziu1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有一个空缺，正在招人。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a vacancy and is hiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職位有兩個空缺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 jau5 loeng5 go3 hung1 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个职位有两个空缺。
examples.english_sentence: This position has two vacancies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢心裏有一個空缺，好難填補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sam1 leoi5 jau5 jat1 go3 hung1 kyut3, hou2 naan4 tim4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他心里有一个空缺，很难填补。
examples.english_sentence: There is a void in his heart that's hard to fill.

mandarin_meaning: 空置 (kōngzhì) — 空着、未被占用
english_meaning: vacant; unoccupied; left empty
explanation_mandarin: 表示某处或某物没有被占用或使用，可作动词或形容词，常用于描述房屋、单位、职位等处于空着未使用的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that a place or item is not occupied or in use. Can function as a verb or adjective, commonly used for properties, units, rooms, or positions that are left empty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幢樓有好多單位空置咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zong6 lau4 jau5 hou2 do1 daan1 wai6 hung1 zi3 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼有很多单位空置了很久。
examples.english_sentence: Many units in this building have been vacant for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 空中翻轉（體操動作，如前空翻、後空翻）
english_meaning: an aerial flip/flip in the air (gymnastic/acrobatic move, e.g. front flip, backflip)
explanation_mandarin: 指在空中做翻轉的體操或特技動作，包括前空翻、後空翻或側翻等，也可作動詞使用表示做空翻。
explanation_english: Refers to a flipping maneuver performed in the air (gymnastics/acrobatics), such as front flips, backflips, or side flips. Can be used as a noun or as a verb meaning to perform such a flip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台做咗一個精彩嘅空翻，贏得全場掌聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 zing1 coi2 ge3 hung1 faan1, jing4 dak1 cyun4 coeng4 zoeng2 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上做了一个精彩的空翻，赢得全场掌声。
examples.english_sentence: He did an impressive aerial flip on stage and won a round of applause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友學緊空翻，要慢慢嚟，先唔會受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hok6 gan2 hung1 faan1, jiu3 maan6 maan6 lai4, sin1 m4 wui5 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在学空翻，要慢慢来，才不会受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are learning flips; go slowly so they don't get injured.

mandarin_meaning: 听错（尤其指把外语歌或话语误听成有意思的中文）；网络用语（源自日语soramimi）
english_meaning: mishearing; mondegreen; (specifically) misheard lyrics—often hearing foreign-language words as similar-sounding words in one's own language (soramimi)
explanation_mandarin: 「空耳」是網絡常用語，源自日語「soramimi」，指把聽到的語音（常見於外語歌曲或片段）誤聽成另一個有意思的詞語或句子；泛指聽錯、誤聽的情況。
explanation_english: An internet slang term (from Japanese 'soramimi') meaning a mishearing—especially when foreign-language lyrics or speech are heard as similar-sounding words in one's native language. More generally, it refers to any instance of hearing something incorrectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多人喺網上放空耳片段，將外語歌聽成中文，好好笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 fong3 hung1 ji5 pin3 dyun6, zoeng1 ngoi6 jyu5 go1 teng1 sing4 zung1 man4, hou2 hou2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多人在网上放空耳片段，把外语歌听成中文，很好笑。
examples.english_sentence: Recently many people upload soramimi clips online, turning foreign-language songs into Chinese — it's very funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為佢講緊『我係你爸爸』，其實只係空耳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai6 keoi5 gong2 gan2 'ngo5 hai6 nei5 baa1 baa1', kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 hung1 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他在说『我是你爸爸』，其实只是空耳。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he was saying 'I'm your dad', but it was just a mishearing.

mandarin_meaning: 空腹（沒吃東西／肚子空），也可表示餓
english_meaning: on an empty stomach; hungry
explanation_mandarin: 「空肚」在廣東話中表示胃裏沒有食物、處於空腹的狀態，也可用來表示感到餓。常用以描述吃東西前或未進食的情況。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '空肚' denotes having an empty stomach or being hungry. It describes the state of being on an empty stomach and can function like an adjective or adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好空肚飲咖啡，會胃痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hung1 tou5 jam2 gaa3 fe1, wui5 wai6 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要空腹喝咖啡，會胃痛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink coffee on an empty stomach; it can cause stomach pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早空肚跑步可能會冇力氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 hung1 tou5 paau2 bou6 ho2 nang4 wui5 mou5 lik6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上空腹跑步可能會沒力氣。
examples.english_sentence: Running in the morning on an empty stomach may leave you feeling weak.

mandarin_meaning: 做空股票 / 空頭頭寸（賣空股票）
english_meaning: short a stock / short position (selling borrowed shares expecting the price to fall)
explanation_mandarin: 在股票市場中，空股指做空某隻股票，即借入股票賣出，期望價格下跌後再買回以賺取差價。視語境可做動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: In the stock market, '空股' refers to shorting a stock — borrowing shares to sell now in the hope the price falls so you can buy them back cheaper and profit from the difference. It can be used as a verb or a noun depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁公司消息唔好，做咗啲空股，最後賺咗一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 gung1 si1 siu1 sik1 m4 hou2, zou6 zo2 di1 hung1 gu2, zeoi3 hau6 zaan6 zo2 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁公司消息不好的時候做了些空股，最後賺了一筆。
examples.english_sentence: He shorted some stocks when the company's news was bad and ended up making a profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做空股有風險，如果市場突然反彈，你可能會蝕好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hung1 gu2 jau5 fung1 him2, jyu4 gwo2 si5 coeng4 dat6 jin4 faan2 daan6, nei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 sik1 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做空股票有風險，如果市場突然反彈，你可能會虧很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: Shorting stocks is risky; if the market suddenly rebounds you could lose a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 肚子餓；空腹
english_meaning: hungry; having an empty stomach
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，字面是「腸空」，用來表達肚子餓或空腹的狀態，常用於日常會話。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "empty intestines," used to say one is hungry or has an empty stomach. Common in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家空腸，去食早餐先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hung1 coeng4, heoi3 sik6 zou2 caan1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在肚子餓，先去吃早餐吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm hungry now; let's go eat breakfast first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話空腸，其實淨係想食零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 hung1 coeng4, sat1 hai6 zing6 hai6 soeng2 sik6 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是說肚子餓，其實只是想吃零食。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying he's hungry but actually just wants snacks.

mandarin_meaning: 空腹（胃裏沒有食物／禁食的狀態）
english_meaning: on an empty stomach; fasting (having no food in the stomach)
explanation_mandarin: 指胃裏沒有食物，處於未進食或需禁食的狀態，常用於醫療或飲食提醒。
explanation_english: Refers to having an empty stomach or being in a fasting state; commonly used in medical or dietary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要空腹先可以驗血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 saang1 waa6 jiu3 hung1 fuk1 sin1 ho2 ji5 jim6 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要空腹才能验血。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you need to be fasting before the blood test.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好空腹飲藥，會傷胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hung1 fuk1 jam2 joek6, wui5 soeng1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要空腹服药，会伤胃。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take medicine on an empty stomach; it can hurt your stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝空腹跑步，覺得有啲頭暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hung1 fuk1 paau2 bou6, gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 tau4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上空腹跑步，觉得有点头晕。
examples.english_sentence: I ran this morning on an empty stomach and felt a bit dizzy.

mandarin_meaning: 空虚
english_meaning: empty; hollow; feeling of emptiness or void
explanation_mandarin: 表示內心或事物在內容或情感上感到空洞、沒有實質或滿足感的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a state of feeling empty or hollow, lacking substance or emotional fulfillment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分手之後，我覺得好空虛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 hung1 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分手之后，我感到很空虚。
examples.english_sentence: After the breakup, I felt very empty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假冇嘢做，我覺得好空虛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 mou5 je5 zou6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 hung1 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假沒事做，我感到很空虚。
examples.english_sentence: On holiday with nothing to do, I feel empty.

mandarin_meaning: 空袭 (kōngxí)
english_meaning: air raid; airstrike; aerial attack
explanation_mandarin: 由飛機、導彈或其他航空器從空中對地面或海上目標發動的攻擊。可作名詞（一次空袭）或動詞（對某地進行空袭）。
explanation_english: An attack launched from the air—by aircraft, missiles, or other aerial weapons—against ground or sea targets. Can be used as a noun (an air raid) or a verb (to air-raid).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 空襲警報響咗，大家快啲入返防空洞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung1 zaap6 ging2 bou3 hoeng2 zo2, daai6 gaa1 faai3 di1 jap6 faan1 fong4 hung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空袭警报响了，大家快点进入防空洞。
examples.english_sentence: The air-raid siren went off — everyone quickly get into the air-raid shelter.

mandarin_meaning: 空話（沒有實質內容或不能兌現的言語／承諾）
english_meaning: empty words; idle talk; promises without substance
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有內容、沒有實際意義或無法兌現的言語或承諾，常用來形容虛假的說話或空洞的保證。
explanation_english: Words or promises that lack substance or real intent; talk that is hollow, insincere, or cannot be backed up by action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲空話，實際上冇做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 hung1waa6, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說空話，實際上沒有做事。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying empty words but doesn't actually do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再畀我聽空話啦，畀返啲具體行動啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 bei2 ngo5 teng1 hung1waa6 laa1, bei2 faan1 di1 geoi3tai2 hang4dung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再讓我聽空話了，給我一些具體的行動吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give me empty words anymore; show some concrete actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府講太多空話，市民開始唔信佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 gong2 taai3 do1 hung1waa6, si5man4 hoi1ci2 m4 seon3 keoi5dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說太多空話，市民開始不相信他們。
examples.english_sentence: The government utters too many empty words; citizens are beginning to distrust them.

mandarin_meaning: 空调（kōngtiáo）
english_meaning: air conditioner; air conditioning
explanation_mandarin: 指用于调节室内温度和湿度的电器或系统，也可泛指空调设备。
explanation_english: An appliance or system used to regulate indoor temperature and humidity; refers to an air conditioner or air-conditioning system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，開吓空調先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 jit6, hoi1 haa5 hung1 tiu4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么热，开一下空调吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot, turn on the air conditioner for a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 空谈（kōngtán）：指沒有實際內容或行動的言談，徒有言辭
english_meaning: empty talk; idle talk — talk that has no practical content or action behind it
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词（可作名词指空洞的言谈，或作动词表示徒然地谈论）
explanation_mandarin: 常用來形容只有說話沒有行動或實際成果的情況，含貶義，強調徒有言辭而無實效。
explanation_english: Used to describe speech that lacks practical action or results; carries a negative connotation implying mere rhetoric without substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淨係講唔做就係空談。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing6 hai6 gong2 m4 zou6 zau6 hai6 hung1 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光说不做就是空谈。
examples.english_sentence: All talk and no action is just empty talk.

mandarin_meaning: 空手；兩手空空（沒帶任何東西）
english_meaning: empty-handed; not carrying anything
explanation_mandarin: 表示身上沒有帶任何東西、兩手空空。可作字面意思（如沒帶行李或沒帶武器），也可比喻用來表示沒有收穫或資源。
explanation_english: Indicates not carrying anything on one's person — literally 'empty-bodied' or 'empty-handed'. Can be used literally (no luggage, no weapons) or figuratively (having no gains or resources).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢空身返嚟，啲行李全部遺落咗喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 san1 faan1 lai4, di1 haang4 lei5 cyun4 bou6 wai4 lok6 zo2 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他空手回來，行李全都落在家裡。
examples.english_sentence: He came back empty-handed; all his luggage was left at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢空身而回，乜都冇買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 hung1 san1 ji4 gwai1, mat1 dou1 mou5 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次他空手而回，什麼都沒買到。
examples.english_sentence: This time he returned empty-handed; he didn't buy anything.

mandarin_meaning: 輕裝靈活、行動敏捷（不帶累贅，動作靈活）
english_meaning: lightly equipped / unencumbered and nimble; quick and agile
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，形容一個人沒有負擔或裝備輕便，因此動作靈活、反應快。也可指處於空手或簡單狀態，行動敏捷。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase describing someone who is lightly equipped or unencumbered and therefore nimble and quick in movement or reaction. It can imply being empty‑handed or traveling light, allowing easy mobility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢空身伶俐，喺人群入面好容易閃開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 san1 ling4 lei6, hai2 jan4 kwan4 jap6 min6 hou2 ji6 sim2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他輕裝靈活，在人群中很容易閃開。
examples.english_sentence: He's light and agile; he can easily slip through the crowd.

mandarin_meaning: 空军；（俚语）被放鸽子/被放飞机（約會或見面時對方未出現）
english_meaning: air force; (slang) to be stood up (i.e., someone fails to show up for a date/meeting)
explanation_mandarin: 一方面是軍事用語，指空中作戰的軍隊（空軍）。另一方面在粵語/香港口語中有俚語用法，說「做空軍」或「做咗空軍」表示被人放鴿子、約會或約定見面時對方沒有出現。
explanation_english: Literally the military 'air force'. In Hong Kong Cantonese it also has a slang sense: saying someone 'did 空軍' (or 'was 空軍') means they were stood up — the other person failed to show up for a date or appointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥係空軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 hai6 hung1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥是空军（空中部队）。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother is in the air force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚約會佢又做空軍，等咗成個鐘都冇人出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 joek3 wui6 keoi5 jau6 zou6 hung1 gwan1, dang2 zo2 sing4 go3 zung1 dou1 mou5 jan4 ceot1 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚跟他約會他又把我放鴿子，等了整整一個小時都沒出現。
examples.english_sentence: He stood me up again for our date tonight — I waited a whole hour and he didn't show up.

mandarin_meaning: 空运（通过航空运输货物或人员）
english_meaning: air transport; air freight; to airlift
explanation_mandarin: 指利用飛機或航空方式運送貨物或人員，也可指緊急空運、空投等行為。
explanation_english: Refers to transporting goods or people by aircraft (air freight/airlift); can also mean emergency airlift or air delivery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批貨要用空運寄去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai1 fo3 jiu3 jung6 hung1 wan6 gei3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這批貨要用空運寄到美國。
examples.english_sentence: This batch of goods needs to be sent to the United States by air freight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為趕時間，我哋決定空運啲樣品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gon2 si4 gaan3, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 hung1 wan6 di1 joeng6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為趕時間，我們決定把樣品空運過來。
examples.english_sentence: Because we're short on time, we decided to air-freight the samples.

mandarin_meaning: 空邮；航空邮件
english_meaning: airmail
explanation_mandarin: 指通过航空运输寄送的邮件或邮寄方式，即航空邮件。通常用于国际或长距离的邮寄，速度一般比陆运或海运快，但费用较高。
explanation_english: Refers to mail sent by air transport (airmail). Commonly used for international or long-distance mailing; typically faster than surface mail but usually more expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想寄呢包衫返香港，可以用空郵嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gei3 ni1 baau1 saam1 faan1 hoeng1 gong2, ho2 ji5 jung6 hung1 jau4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把这包衣服寄回香港，可以用空邮吗？
examples.english_sentence: I want to send this package of clothes back to Hong Kong. Can I use airmail?

mandarin_meaning: 空镜（头）/ 空镜头
english_meaning: empty shot; an image or camera shot with no people or main action (used as establishing shot, cutaway, or B-roll)
explanation_mandarin: 指影視或新聞拍攝中沒有主要人物或動作的畫面，用作襯景、片頭或剪輯時的過渡素材，也常稱為空鏡頭或B-roll。
explanation_english: Refers to a film or news camera shot that shows an empty scene (no main人物 or action), used as an establishing shot, transitional footage, or B-roll for editing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演叫攝影師拍多幾個空鏡留返剪接用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do6 jin2 giu3 sip3 jing2 si1 paak3 do1 gei2 go3 hung1 geng3 lau4 faan1 zin2 zip3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 導演讓攝影師多拍幾個空鏡，以便剪輯使用。
examples.english_sentence: The director told the cameraman to shoot a few extra empty shots for editing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報道中成日用城市嘅空鏡做片頭畫面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 zung1 sing4 jat6 jung6 sing4 si5 ge3 hung1 geng3 zou6 pin3 tau4 waa6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞報導中經常用城市的空鏡作為片頭畫面。
examples.english_sentence: News reports often use empty city shots as opening visuals.

mandarin_meaning: 空闲
english_meaning: free time; idle; not busy
explanation_mandarin: 表示有空余时间或不忙，可作名词（空闲时间）或形容词（不忙的、闲暇的）。
explanation_english: Indicates having free time or being not busy; can function as a noun (free time) or an adjective (idle/not busy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日有冇空閑？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 jau5 mou5 hung1 haan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天有空吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free today?

mandarin_meaning: 空闲 (kòngxián)
english_meaning: free time; spare time; idle
explanation_mandarin: 表示有空余的时间或处于闲置、没有事情做的状态，可以用来休息或做其他活动。
explanation_english: Indicates having free or spare time, being unoccupied or available to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你下個禮拜有冇空閒？我想約你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 mou5 hung1 haan4? ngo5 soeng2 joek3 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你下个礼拜有空吗？我想约你吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Are you free next week? I'd like to invite you to dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我好忙，冇乜空閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 hou2 mong4, mou5 mat1 hung1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我很忙，没什么空闲。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very busy lately and don't have much free time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你今晚有空閒，我哋可以去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gam1 maan5 jau5 hung1 haan4, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你今晚有空，我们可以去看电影。
examples.english_sentence: If you're free tonight, we can go to the movies.

mandarin_meaning: 空间 (kōngjiān)
english_meaning: space; room; area; (also figuratively) scope or opportunity
explanation_mandarin: 表示物理上的空間或範圍，也可指抽象的餘地或活動空間。
explanation_english: Refers to physical space or area; can also mean figurative room/opportunity or scope for action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房有好多空間，擺得落大型傢俬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong4 jau5 hou2 do1 hung1 gaan1, baai2 dak1 lok6 daai6 jing4 gaa1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間房有很多空間，可以放得下大型家具。
examples.english_sentence: This room has a lot of space and can fit large furniture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要啲安靜嘅空間嚟諗嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 di1 on1 zing6 ge3 hung1 gaan1 lei4 nam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要一些安靜的空間來思考。
examples.english_sentence: I need some quiet space to think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市嘅公共空間要設計得好，先至吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 ge3 gung1 gung6 hung1 gaan1 jiu3 cit3 gai3 dak1 hou2, sin1 zi3 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市的公共空間要設計得好，才能吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: A city's public spaces need good design to attract people.

mandarin_meaning: 空投；被上級指派（通常指不經本地或基層程序直接任命）
english_meaning: airdrop; to parachute in (literally to descend by air; figuratively to appoint someone from above without local selection)
explanation_mandarin: 「空降」可指實際的空中降落或空投物資，也可作比喻，指人被上級直接派到某地或職位，通常含有不經當地程序或引起不滿的意思。
explanation_english: “空降” can mean the literal act of descending or air-dropping by air (e.g., supplies or troops). Figuratively, it refers to someone being 'parachuted in' — appointed or sent in from above without local selection or consultation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救援物資係用空降方式運落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 wun4 mat6 zi1 hai6 jung6 hung1 gong3 fong1 sik1 wan6 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救援物资是用空投的方式运下来的。
examples.english_sentence: The relief supplies were air-dropped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被公司空降嚟做總經理，員工好唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 gung1 si1 hung1 gong3 lai4 zou6 zung2 ging1 lei5, jyun4 gung1 hou2 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被公司空降来当总经理，员工很不满。
examples.english_sentence: He was parachuted in by the company as general manager; the employees are very unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 空隙 (kòngxì)：縫隙、間隔；也指時間上的空檔或可利用的空間/機會。
english_meaning: gap; space; interval; crevice; a spare moment or opportunity
explanation_mandarin: 指物體之間的縫隙或間隔，也可指時間或活動中的空檔、可利用的空間或機會。
explanation_english: Refers to a physical gap or interval between things, or a temporal gap — a spare moment or opportunity that can be used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車站月台同車門之間有個空隙，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1zaam6 jyut6toi4 tung4 ce1mun4 zi1gaan1 jau5 go3 hung1sik1, siu2sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车站月台和车门之间有一个空隙，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: There's a gap between the platform and the train door — be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵個空隙傾吓呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5dei6 jiu3 wan2 go3 hung1sik1 king1 haa5 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找个空隙谈谈这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a gap to talk about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆身有啲空隙要填好先先可以做下一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4san1 jau5 di1 hung1sik1 jiu3 tim4 hou2 sin1 sin1 ho2 ji5 zou6 haa6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙体有些空隙要先填好才能做下一步。
examples.english_sentence: There are some gaps in the wall that must be filled before doing the next step.

mandarin_meaning: 航空事故；飛機失事
english_meaning: air crash; aviation accident (plane crash)
explanation_mandarin: 指飛機或其他航空器發生的重大事故，通常造成傷亡與損失。
explanation_english: Refers to a major accident involving an aircraft, typically resulting in casualties and damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚有架客機喺海面發生空難，機上有多人死傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 maan5 jau5 gaa3 haak3 gei1 hai2 hoi2 min6 faat3 saang1 hung1 naan6, gei1 soeng6 jau5 do1 jan4 sei2 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚一架客機在海面發生空難，機上有人死傷。
examples.english_sentence: Last night a passenger plane crashed at sea; there were deaths and injuries on board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 空難調查依家仲喺進行，當局暫時未能公布原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung1 naan6 diu6 caa4 ji1 gaa1 zung6 hai2 zeon3 hang4, dong1 guk6 zaam6 si4 mei6 nang4 gung1 bou3 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空難調查現在仍在進行，當局暫時未能公布原因。
examples.english_sentence: The investigation into the air crash is still underway; authorities have not yet released the cause.

mandarin_meaning: 空头支票；比喻做出承诺但无法兑现或没有兑现意图的保证
english_meaning: a bad/insufficient-funds check; figuratively, an empty promise or pledge that will not be fulfilled
explanation_mandarin: 原指支票因賬戶餘額不足而不能兌現，現常用來比喻言而無信、只做表面承諾而無實際行動。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a check that cannot be cashed due to insufficient funds; commonly used figuratively for promises or pledges that are not backed up by action — empty promises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢答應借錢畀我，但最後交咗一張空頭支票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 jing6 ze3 cin2 bei2 ngo5, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 gaau1 zo2 jat1 zoeng1 hung1 tau4 zi1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答應借錢給我，但最後交了一張空头支票。
examples.english_sentence: He promised to lend me money, but in the end he handed me a worthless check.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府不停發表承諾，但只係開空頭支票，冇實際行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bat1 ting4 faat3 biu2 sing4 nok6, daan6 zi2 hai6 hoi1 hung1 tau4 zi1 piu3, mou5 sat6 zai3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不停發表承諾，但只是開空头支票，沒有實際行動。
examples.english_sentence: The government keeps making promises, but it's only issuing empty promises with no real action.

mandarin_meaning: 空頭白契（空洞的承諾/空頭支票）
english_meaning: an empty promise; a pledge or guarantee that will not be honored
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有實際履行的承諾或書面保證，形同空頭支票，通常用來形容言而無信或毫無保障的承諾。
explanation_english: Refers to a promise or written guarantee that lacks real intention or ability to be fulfilled — essentially an empty or worthless promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢答應幫我搬屋，但最後只係留下一張空頭白契，乜都冇做到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 jing3 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 zi2 hai6 lau4 haa6 jat1 zoeng1 hung1 tau4 baak6 kai3, mat1 dou1 mou5 zou6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应帮我搬家，但最后只是留下了一张空头白契，什么都没做到。
examples.english_sentence: He promised to help me move, but in the end it was just an empty promise — he didn't do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 穿 (chuān)：穿戴（衣物）、穿過、穿透
english_meaning: to wear; to put on; to pierce; to go through
explanation_mandarin: 表示穿上衣物或配件；也可表示穿過、穿透某物或通過某處。
explanation_english: Indicates putting on clothes or accessories; can also mean to pass through or pierce something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日會穿件新衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 wui5 cyun1 gin6 san1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天會穿一件新衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wear a new shirt today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雨水穿透咗我對鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 seoi2 cyun1 tau3 zo2 ngo5 deoi3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雨水把我的鞋子穿透了。
examples.english_sentence: The rain soaked through my shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支箭穿透咗個目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 zin3 cyun1 tau3 zo2 go3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這支箭穿透了目標。
examples.english_sentence: The arrow pierced the target.

mandarin_meaning: 穿山甲（chuānshānjiǎ），一種有鱗片的哺乳動物，俗稱穿山甲或鱗甲獸。
english_meaning: Pangolin, a scaly anteater (a mammal covered in scales).
explanation_mandarin: 穿山甲是鱗甲目的哺乳動物，身體被硬鱗覆蓋，主要以螞蟻和白蟻為食，因非法獵捕和走私而成為受威脅的物種。
explanation_english: A mammal of the order Pholidota covered in overlapping scales, feeding mainly on ants and termites. Pangolins are threatened due to illegal hunting and trafficking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 穿山甲係受到非法獵捕同走私威脅嘅動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 saan1 gaap3 hai6 sau6 dou3 fei1 faat3 lit6 bou6 tung4 zau2 si1 wai1 hip3 ge3 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 穿山甲是受到非法猎捕和走私威胁的动物。
examples.english_sentence: Pangolins are animals threatened by illegal hunting and smuggling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人會食穿山甲嘅鱗片，呢啲做法對保育好唔利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 wui5 sik6 cyun1 saan1 gaap3 ge3 leon4 pin2, ni1 di1 zou6 faat3 deoi3 bou2 juk6 hou2 m4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人会吃穿山甲的鳞片，这些做法对保护工作很不利。
examples.english_sentence: Some people eat pangolin scales; these practices are very harmful to conservation efforts.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）穿搭失敗；衣著或造型看起來很不合適，形象崩壞
english_meaning: slang for a fashion fail; when someone's outfit or styling looks bad or ruins their image
explanation_mandarin: 「穿崩」常用於網路或娛樂圈，形容某人穿著或造型出現嚴重不適合、顯老或破壞整體形象的情況，亦可泛指造型失敗。
explanation_english: Common online/entertainment slang describing when someone's outfit or styling seriously fails—looking unflattering, aging them, or ruining their overall image. Can be used broadly for a styling/fashion failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰日著嗰套衫真係穿崩咗，整體好唔協調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 jat6 zoek3 go2 tou3 saam1 zan1 hai6 cyun1 bong1 zo2, zing2 tai2 hou2 m4 hip3 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那天穿的那套衣服真的穿崩了，整體很不協調。
examples.english_sentence: The outfit he wore that day was a real fashion fail; the whole look was very uncoordinated.

mandarin_meaning: 走遍各州各省；到处奔走、到处跑
english_meaning: to travel across provinces/states; to go all over the place; to travel far and wide
explanation_mandarin: 形容到处奔波、走过许多地方或到不同省份/地区，常用于描述频繁出差、旅行或四处奔走。
explanation_english: Describes traveling through many provinces or regions; to go all over the place. Often used to describe frequent travel, business trips, wandering, or running about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵生意，佢成日穿州過省。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wan2 saang1 ji3, keoi5 sing4 jat6 cyun1 zau1 gwo3 saang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了找生意，他经常跑遍各州各省。
examples.english_sentence: To find business, he often travels across provinces.

mandarin_meaning: 刺心；使人感到心痛或深受觸動
english_meaning: to pierce the heart; to deeply hurt or profoundly move someone
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用語，形容一句話、消息或事令人大感刺痛或深受感動，像被刺入心中一樣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing a remark, news, or event that 'pierces the heart'—i.e. deeply hurts or strongly moves someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講真係穿心邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 cyun1 sam1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼說真的很刺心。
examples.english_sentence: What you said really pierced my heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢走咗，我覺得好穿心邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 zau2 zo2, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 cyun1 sam1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他離開了，我覺得很心痛。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that he left made me feel heartbroken.

mandarin_meaning: 穿插（将某些事物或内容插入或夹杂在其他事物之间，交替出现）
english_meaning: to intersperse; to insert or alternate items among others; to interleave
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某些內容插入或交替放在其他內容之間，常用於描述安排、表演、敘事或報告時的穿插與交替手法。
explanation_english: To insert or alternate items among others; commonly used to describe mixing elements into a sequence (e.g., examples in a talk, flashbacks in a show) to vary pacing or provide context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺報告入面穿插咗幾個實例，咁樣聽眾會容易理解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 cyun1 caap3 zo2 gei2 go3 sat6 lai6, gam2 joeng6 teng1 zung3 wui5 jung4 ji6 lei5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在報告中穿插了幾個實例，這樣聽眾比較容易理解。
examples.english_sentence: I interspersed several examples in the presentation so the audience could understand more easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 劇集每一集會穿插啲回憶場面，幫助交代角色嘅過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gek6 zaap6 mui5 jat1 zaap6 wui5 cyun1 caap3 di1 wui4 jik1 coeng4 min6, bong1 zo6 gaau1 doi6 gok3 sik1 ge3 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劇集每一集會穿插一些回憶場面，幫助交代角色的過去。
examples.english_sentence: Each episode intersperses flashback scenes to help explain the characters' pasts.

mandarin_meaning: 穿梭（來回往返、在兩處之間頻繁移動或穿行）
english_meaning: to shuttle (back and forth); to move frequently between places; to weave through
explanation_mandarin: 表示在兩個或多個地點之間來回往返或在空間中穿行、穿越（常用於交通、往返通勤或穿過人群等情況）。
explanation_english: Indicates moving back and forth between two or more places or weaving through a space (commonly used for transport services, commuting back and forth, or moving through crowds).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵喺繁忙時間不停穿梭，車廂好擠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 hai2 faan4 mong4 si4 gaan3 bat1 ting4 cyun1 so1, ce1 soeng1 hou2 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁在繁忙时间不停穿梭，车厢很拥挤。
examples.english_sentence: The subway shuttles back and forth during peak hours and the carriages are very crowded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日喺港島同九龍之間穿梭返工，好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 hai2 gong2 dou2 tung4 gau2 lung4 zi1 gaan1 cyun1 so1 faan1 gung1, hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天在港島和九龍之間穿梭上下班，很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He shuttles between Hong Kong Island and Kowloon for work every day; it's tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救生艇喺濃霧中穿梭去救援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 sang1 ting5 hai2 nung4 mou6 zung1 cyun1 so1 heoi3 gau3 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救生艇在濃雾中穿梭去救援。
examples.english_sentence: The lifeboats shuttle through the thick fog to carry out rescues.

mandarin_meaning: 穿梭巴士 / 接驳巴士
english_meaning: shuttle bus
explanation_mandarin: 指在兩點之間頻繁往返、作短程接駁或接送服務的巴士，常見於機場、酒店與會場之間或公司上下班路線。
explanation_english: A bus that runs frequently between two points as a short-distance connector or pick-up/drop-off service; commonly used between airports, hotels, event venues, or for company commutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場有免費穿梭巴士接送乘客往返航站樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 jau5 min5 fai3 cyun1 so1 baa1 si2 zip3 sung3 sing4 haak3 wong5 faan1 hong4 zaam6 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场有免费穿梭巴士接送乘客往返航站楼。
examples.english_sentence: The airport has free shuttle buses transporting passengers between the terminals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由酒店去會場有穿梭巴士，唔使自己搵車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 zau2 dim3 heoi3 wui6 coeng4 jau5 cyun1 so1 baa1 si2, m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 wan2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从酒店去会场有穿梭巴士，不用自己找车。
examples.english_sentence: There's a shuttle bus from the hotel to the venue, so you don't need to find your own transport.

mandarin_meaning: 穿梭机（如穿梭巴士、航天穿梭機）
english_meaning: shuttle (e.g., shuttle vehicle/bus or space shuttle)
explanation_mandarin: 指來回穿梭運行的交通工具或航天器。口語上也可指提供接駁服務的車輛（如機場穿梭巴士）。
explanation_english: Refers to a vehicle or spacecraft that shuttles back and forth. Commonly used for shuttle buses/services and for a space shuttle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰架穿梭機下星期會升空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaa3 cyun1 so1 gei1 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 sing1 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那架穿梭機下星期會升空。
examples.english_sentence: That shuttle will lift off next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場有穿梭機往返唔同航站樓，旅客可以免費搭乘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 jau5 cyun1 so1 gei1 wong5 faan2 m4 tung4 hong4 zaam6 lau4, leoi5 haak3 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 daap3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场有穿梭机往返不同航站楼，旅客可以免费搭乘。
examples.english_sentence: The airport has shuttle services between different terminals; passengers can ride them for free.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）穿过桥；通过桥梁
english_meaning: to pass through/go across a bridge (literal); occasionally used metaphorically to mean to cross or bridge a gap
explanation_mandarin: 表示穿过桥的动作，主要是字面用法；在某些语境下可作比喻，用来表示跨越或经由某途径。
explanation_english: Denotes the action of passing across or through a bridge. Primarily a literal verb; sometimes used metaphorically to mean crossing or bridging a gap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要穿橋返去市中心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cyun1 kiu4 faan1 heoi3 si5 zung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要通过桥回到市中心。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go across the bridge to return to the city center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橋壞咗，暫時冇得穿橋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kiu4 waai6 zo2, zaam6 si4 mou5 dak1 cyun1 kiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桥坏了，暂时不能通过。
examples.english_sentence: The bridge is broken, so you can't go across for now.

mandarin_meaning: 被擱置、被冷藏／被忽視（某事被放到抽屜底下，指不再處理或被晾著）
english_meaning: to be shelved/put on the back burner; to be ignored or set aside (literally 'put into the bottom of a drawer')
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面是放到櫃桶底部，意指某事或某人被忽視、擱置、不再處理或被冷落，有時也帶有被偷偷藏起來、不公開處理的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase. Literally 'to put into the bottom of a drawer.' It means to shelve something, set it aside, ignore it, or keep it out of sight — often implying the matter is being quietly put aside or neglected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個企劃做唔成，最後畀人穿櫃桶底咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 kei5 waak6 zou6 m4 sing4, zeoi3 hau6 bei2 jan4 cyun1 gwai6 tung4 dai2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个企划没做成，最后被人给擱置了。
examples.english_sentence: The project didn't go through and in the end was shelved.

mandarin_meaning: 輸光／破產；遭受重大金錢損失（俚語）
english_meaning: to lose all one's money; to go bust; to suffer heavy financial losses (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容在投資、賭博或經營上輸光錢、虧損慘重或破產。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing losing all one’s money or suffering heavy financial losses, often from investing, gambling, or business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢炒股炒到穿水晒，啲積蓄全部冇埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau2 gu2 caau2 dou3 cyun1 seoi2 saai3, di1 zik1 cuk1 cyun4 bou6 mou5 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他炒股炒到輸光了，積蓄全部沒了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost everything trading stocks; all his savings are gone.

mandarin_meaning: 被揭發（通常指隱瞞的戀情或不當關係被發現）
english_meaning: to be exposed (usually a secret romantic relationship or affair being discovered)
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，常用於香港粵語，指秘密的戀情、出軌或不當關係被他人發現、拍到或揭發。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term (common in Hong Kong) meaning that a secret relationship, affair, or improper relationship has been discovered, photographed, or exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個上個星期喺酒吧畀人影到，已經穿煲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 soeng6 go3 sing1 kei4 hai2 zau2 baa1 bei2 jan4 jing2 dou3, ji5 ging1 ceon1 bou1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們兩個上星期在酒吧被人拍到，已經被揭發（戀情）了。
examples.english_sentence: They were photographed together at a bar last week — their relationship has already been exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾人穿煲呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 ceon1 bou1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心點，不要讓人發現／揭穿（你們）。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful — don't let people find out.

mandarin_meaning: 穿着 (chuānzhuó)：穿衣服、佩戴（指穿着衣物或配件）
english_meaning: to wear; be wearing (clothes or accessories)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人穿着衣物或佩戴配件，既可描述穿衣動作，也可表示穿著的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is wearing clothes or accessories; can describe the action of putting on clothing or the state of being dressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日穿着條新衫，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 cyun1 zoek3 tiu4 san1 saam1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿着那件新衣，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He is wearing that new outfit today; it looks very nice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外面好凍，記住穿着多啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngooi6 min6 hou2 dung3, gei3 zyu6 cyun1 zoek3 do1 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外面很冷，记得多穿点衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold outside — remember to wear more clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你穿着咁正式去面試喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cyun1 zoek3 gam2 zing3 sik1 heoi3 min6 si3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你穿得這麼正式去面試啊。
examples.english_sentence: You're dressed so formally for the interview.

mandarin_meaning: 穿洞 / 刺破、戳破（某物）
english_meaning: to pierce/make a hole in something; to puncture or tear, creating a hole
explanation_mandarin: 用於描述把物件刺破、戳破或打出一個洞，亦可指物件出現破洞。
explanation_english: Used to describe piercing, puncturing, or making a hole in an object; also refers to an object having a hole or tear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心將件衫穿窿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 gin6 saam1 cyun1 lung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把衣服弄破了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally tore a hole in my shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個膠袋畀針穿窿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gaau1 doi2 bei2 zam1 cyun1 lung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 塑料袋被針戳破了。
examples.english_sentence: The plastic bag was punctured by a needle.

mandarin_meaning: 破水；羊水破裂
english_meaning: to have one's water break (rupture of the amniotic sac)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指孕婦的羊膜囊破裂，羊水流出，通常表示即將分娩或需要到醫院檢查處理。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning the pregnant woman's amniotic sac has ruptured and amniotic fluid is flowing out; usually indicates labor is imminent or medical attention is needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱穿咗羊水，已經入咗醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceon1 zo2 joeng4 seoi2, ji5 ging1 jap6 zo2 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她剛剛破水，已經入院了。
examples.english_sentence: She just had her water break and has been admitted to the hospital.

mandarin_meaning: 穿耳 / 打耳洞
english_meaning: to pierce one's ears; ear piercing
explanation_mandarin: 指在耳朵上打洞以便戴耳環或耳飾，口語也常說「打耳洞」。
explanation_english: Refers to piercing the ear to wear earrings or other ear jewelry; colloquially also called getting one's ears pierced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想去穿耳，但係媽媽唔畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 heoi3 cyun1 ji5, daan6 hai6 maa4 maa1 m4 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她想去穿耳，但媽媽不允許她。
examples.english_sentence: She wants to get her ears pierced, but her mother won't allow it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上星期去穿耳洞啦，好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 sing1 kei4 heoi3 cyun1 ji5 dung6 laa1, hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上星期去打耳洞了，很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I got my ears pierced last week; it was painful.

mandarin_meaning: 穿越（动词）：1. 穿过、通过；2.（文学/影视）时间或空间的穿越（如穿越到古代）
english_meaning: to pass through or traverse; (in fiction) to travel through time or across into another era/space
explanation_mandarin: “穿越”可以指实体上穿过某處，也常用於小說或影視中表示人物從一個時空/時代移動到另一個時空/時代（時間旅行的情節）。
explanation_english: “穿越” can mean physically passing through a place, and is also widely used in fiction to describe characters traveling across time or into another era/space (time travel trope).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意睇穿越小說，成日幻想自己可以穿越返去古代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 tai2 cyun1 jyut6 siu2 syut3, sing4 jat6 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 ho2 ji5 cyun1 jyut6 faan1 heoi3 gu2 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢看穿越小说，总是幻想自己可以穿越回到古代。
examples.english_sentence: He likes reading time-travel novels and often daydreams about being able to travel back to ancient times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋穿越條隧道就到海灘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cyun1 jyut6 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 zau6 dou3 hoi2 taan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们穿过那条隧道就到海滩。
examples.english_sentence: If we go through the tunnel we'll reach the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇講一個現代人穿越到古代嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 gong2 jat1 go3 jin6 doi6 jan4 cyun1 jyut6 dou3 gu2 doi6 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧讲述一个现代人穿越到古代的故事。
examples.english_sentence: This show tells the story of a modern person who travels back to ancient times.

mandarin_meaning: 穿越时空（穿越時間和空間，通常指時間旅行或超越時空的情況）
english_meaning: to travel through time and space; time travel; to transcend time/space
explanation_mandarin: 指穿越時間與空間，常見於科幻作品，也可作比喻用來形容跨越時代或場所的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to traveling through time and space. Commonly used in science fiction, and sometimes metaphorically to describe crossing eras or contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我可以穿越時空，我會去見未來嘅自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 cyun1 jyut6 si4 hung1, ngo5 wui5 heoi3 gin3 mei6 loi4 ge3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我可以穿越时空，我会去见未来的自己。
examples.english_sentence: If I could travel through time, I would go meet my future self.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影講述一個人穿越時空去改變過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 gong2 seot6 jat1 go3 jan4 cyun1 jyut6 si4 hung1 heoi3 goi2 bin3 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述一个人穿越时空去改变过去。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the story of a person traveling through time to change the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係可以穿越時空，社會會面臨好多倫理問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 cyun1 jyut6 si4 hung1, se5 wui6 wui5 min6 lam5 hou2 do1 leon4 lei5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的可以穿越时空，社会会面临很多伦理问题。
examples.english_sentence: If time travel were actually possible, society would face many ethical issues.

mandarin_meaning: 穿透 (chuān tòu)：穿过并透过；刺入或渗透；也可比喻上深入、渗透。
english_meaning: to penetrate; to pass through or pierce; (of light, sound, or signals) to transmit through; figuratively, to pervade or penetrate.
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体、光线、声音、信号等从一侧穿过到另一侧，或比喻事物深入、渗透到内部。
explanation_english: Indicates that an object, light, sound, or signal passes through from one side to another, or figuratively that something penetrates or pervades inward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光線可以穿透窗簾，照到入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 sin3 ho2 ji5 cyun1 tau3 coeng1 lim4, ziu3 dou3 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光线可以穿透窗帘，照到里面。
examples.english_sentence: The light can penetrate the curtains and reach inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅聲音有好強嘅穿透力，聽落好清晰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 seng1 jam1 jau5 hou2 koeng4 ge3 cyun1 tau3 lik6, teng1 lok6 hou2 cing1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音穿透力很强，听起来很清晰。
examples.english_sentence: His voice has strong penetrating power; it sounds very clear.

mandarin_meaning: 穿过；通过（有时也表示穿戴）
english_meaning: to pass through; to go through; (sometimes) to have worn
explanation_mandarin: 表示從一側穿過某物或某地方，或在某些語境下表示曾經穿戴過某件衣物。
explanation_english: Indicates moving through or passing from one side to another (e.g., through a tunnel or crowd). In some contexts it can also mean having worn a piece of clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我穿過條隧道返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cyun1 gwo3 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我穿过隧道回家。
examples.english_sentence: I passed through the tunnel to go home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢穿過人群行上台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyun1 gwo3 jan4 kwan4 haang4 soeng5 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿过人群走上台。
examples.english_sentence: He pushed through the crowd to get on stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以前冇穿過呢件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 cin4 mou5 cyun1 gwo3 ni1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以前没穿过这件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't worn this piece of clothing before.

mandarin_meaning: 穿金戴银（穿戴很多金银首饰，打扮奢华、炫耀财富）
english_meaning: To wear gold and silver; to be lavishly adorned with jewelry; ostentatiously dressed to show off wealth.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人穿戴大量金銀珠寶，打扮很華麗或刻意炫耀財富，常帶有貶義或指誇耀之意。
explanation_english: Describes someone dressed in lots of gold and silver jewelry—lavishly adorned, often to show off wealth. Can carry a pejorative sense of ostentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日穿金戴銀，好似好有錢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 cyun1 gam1 daai3 ngan4, hou2 ci5 hou2 jau5 cin2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天穿金戴银，好像很有钱似的。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears gold and silver, as if he's very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個歌星上台時穿金戴銀，閃到我眼都花晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 go1 sing1 soeng5 toi4 si4 cyun1 gam1 daai3 ngan4, sim2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个歌星上台时穿金戴银，闪得我眼睛都花了。
examples.english_sentence: That pop star was wearing lots of gold and silver on stage; it was so flashy it made my eyes hurt.

mandarin_meaning: 穿针；（作“穿针引线”）牵线搭桥、居中介绍
english_meaning: to thread a needle; (idiom) to act as an intermediary or matchmaker, to arrange introductions
explanation_mandarin: 可指把線穿過針眼，屬於縫紉動作；在慣用語“穿針引線”中，則比喻居中牽線、牽線搭橋或替人做中介、介紹關係。
explanation_english: Literally, to thread a needle (a sewing action). Idiomatically, in the phrase '穿針引線', it means to act as an intermediary or matchmaker — to arrange introductions or connect people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就識得穿針，縫衫好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 sik1 dak1 cyun1 zam1, fung4 saam1 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小的時候就會穿針，縫衣服很拿手。
examples.english_sentence: He learned to thread a needle when he was young and is good at sewing clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我穿針引線，介紹返啲人畀我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 cyun1 zam1 jan5 sin3, gaai3 siu6 faan1 di1 jan4 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我牽線搭橋，介紹一些人給我嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you put in a good word for me and introduce some people to me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司入面好識穿針引線，成日幫大家打點關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hou2 sik1 cyun1 zam1 jan5 sin3, sing4 jat6 bong1 daai6 gaa1 daa2 dim2 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡很會穿針引線，經常幫大家打理關係。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at networking within the company and often helps manage people's connections.

mandarin_meaning: 牵线搭桥
english_meaning: to act as an intermediary; to arrange introductions or facilitate connections
explanation_mandarin: 比喻居中撮合或安排聯繫，促成雙方見面、合作或撮合婚事等。
explanation_english: A figurative expression meaning to mediate or broker introductions—connecting parties to enable meetings, deals, or matches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多得佢穿針引線，我哋先至可以同客戶見面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 dak1 keoi5 cyun1 zam1 jan5 sin3, ngo5 dei6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 tung4 haak3 wu6 gin3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多虧他牽線搭橋，我們才得以和客戶見面。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to him arranging introductions, we were able to meet the client.

mandarin_meaning: 牽強附會；強行把無關的事物聯繫起來以支持某種說法
english_meaning: to make far-fetched connections; to force an interpretation by linking unrelated facts
explanation_mandarin: 比喻武斷地把不相干的事情聯繫起來，以支持自己的觀點或論點，常含批評意味。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to arbitrarily connect unrelated facts to support a viewpoint — often a criticism of someone making forced or strained interpretations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺證據未夠嘅情況下，佢唔好穿鑿附會，亂咁解釋啲資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 geoi3 mei6 gau3 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6, keoi5 m4 hou2 cyun1 zoek3 fu6 wui6, lyun6 gam2 gaai2 sik1 di1 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在證據不足的情況下，他不要牽強附會，亂解釋資料。
examples.english_sentence: In the absence of sufficient evidence, he shouldn't make far-fetched connections or misinterpret the data.

mandarin_meaning: 穿云箭
english_meaning: an arrow that pierces the clouds; metaphorically, something extremely fast, powerful, decisive, or striking
explanation_mandarin: 原指能射穿雲霄的箭，常用作比喻，形容速度極快、威力強大或氣勢驚人的一擊或表現，偏書面或文學用法。
explanation_english: Literally an arrow that pierces the clouds. Used metaphorically to describe something extremely fast, forceful, decisive, or spectacular — often used in literary or descriptive contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰一記射門，好似穿雲箭咁，直接入網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 jat1 gei3 se6 mun4, hou2 ci5 cyun1 wan4 zin3 gam2, zik6 zip3 jap6 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那一下射門像穿雲箭一樣，直接進了球網。
examples.english_sentence: His shot was like an arrow piercing the clouds — it went straight into the net.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅高音段像穿雲箭，直衝上去，令人震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 gou1 jam1 dyun6 lok6 zoeng6 cyun1 wan4 zin3, zik6 cung1 soeng5 heoi3, ling6 jan4 zan3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌的高音段像穿雲箭般直衝上去，令人震撼。
examples.english_sentence: The song's high section soars like an arrow piercing the clouds — it's truly striking.

mandarin_meaning: 突；突然（表示出乎意料或瞬间发生）
english_meaning: sudden; abrupt; unexpected; (used as a verb/prefix in compounds indicating a sudden action or occurrence)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 形容词 / 动词（在复合词中）
explanation_mandarin: 「突」常用来表示事态在瞬间或出乎意料地发生，常见于合成词如「突然」「突發」「突襲」。在粤语中常读作 dat6，用于表达突然而来的变化或动作。
explanation_english: The character 突 denotes something sudden or abrupt, often used in compounds such as 'suddenly', 'sudden occurrence', or 'raid/attack'. In Cantonese it is commonly pronounced dat6 and denotes an unexpected or instantaneous change or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣突變，落起大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dat6 bin3, lok6 hei2 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气突变，下起大雨。
examples.english_sentence: The weather changed suddenly and it started to pour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然唔嚟上課，大家好驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 m4 lai4 soeng5 fo3, daai6 gaa1 hou2 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然不来上课，大家很惊讶。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly didn't come to class; everyone was surprised.

mandarin_meaning: 突兀：突然、顯得不協調或高聳、突出的意思
english_meaning: abrupt; conspicuous; out of place; startlingly prominent or awkwardly protruding
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物看起來突然、不協調、顯得突出或高聳，常用來描述景物或言行與環境不合。
explanation_english: Describes something that appears sudden, incongruous, or strikingly prominent—often used for objects or behavior that stand out awkwardly or tower over surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座山喺城市入面顯得好突兀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 saan1 hai2 sing4 si5 jap6 min6 hin2 dak1 hou2 dat6 ngat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座山在城市里面显得很突兀。
examples.english_sentence: That mountain looks very out of place in the city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅提議喺會議入面聽落有啲突兀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tai4 ji5 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 teng1 lok6 jau5 di1 dat6 ngat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的提议在会议中听起来有点突兀。
examples.english_sentence: His proposal sounded a bit out of place in the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 突出（tūchū）：显著、凸出；可表示在某方面比周围更明显或物理上凸出
english_meaning: to stand out; prominent; to protrude; to highlight/emphasize
explanation_mandarin: 表示在外表或某個方面比周圍更顯眼或更重要；也可指物體在表面上凸出來。
explanation_english: Indicates being conspicuous or more prominent than the surroundings; can also mean physically protruding or to highlight/emphasize something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺班上表現好突出，成日考第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baan1 soeng6 biu2 jin2 hou2 dat6 ceot1, sing4 jat6 haau2 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在班上表现很突出，经常考第一。
examples.english_sentence: He stands out in class; he often gets first place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊石頭突出咗路面，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 sek6 tau4 dat6 ceot1 zo2 lou6 min6, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块石头从路面突出，很危险。
examples.english_sentence: This rock is protruding from the road; it's dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告要突出重點，唔好寫太多冇關嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 dat6 ceot1 zung6 dim2, m4 hou2 se2 taai3 do1 mou5 gwaan1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告要突出重点，别写太多无关的内容。
examples.english_sentence: This report should highlight the key points; don't write too much irrelevant stuff.

mandarin_meaning: 突厥（图jukè）指突厥语系的民族及其所建立的汗国
english_meaning: Turkic (the Turkic peoples) / the Turkic khaganates
explanation_mandarin: 突厥指历史上居住在中亚和东亚的突厥语族民族及他们建立的若干汗国，如东突厥汗国、西突厥汗国等，常用于指代这些民族或相应的政权。
explanation_english: Refers to the Turkic peoples (a group of Turkic-speaking peoples) and the historical Turkic khaganates (e.g. the Eastern and Western Turkic Khaganates). Used to denote the people or their states in history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中世紀嘅突厥建立咗好幾個汗國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 sai3 gei2 ge3 dat6 kyut3 gin3 laap6 zo2 hou2 gei2 go3 hon4 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中世纪的突厥建立了好几个汗国。
examples.english_sentence: The Turkic peoples in the Middle Ages established several khaganates.

mandarin_meaning: 突围 (tūwéi)：突破包围或封锁；引申为在困境或竞争中取得突破
english_meaning: to break out (of an encirclement); to break through (a blockade or a difficult situation); figuratively, to achieve a breakthrough
explanation_mandarin: 指從包圍或封鎖中突破解脫，亦可用來比喻在困境、競爭或瓶頸中取得突破。
explanation_english: Means to break out of an encirclement or blockade; metaphorically used for overcoming a difficult situation or making a breakthrough in competition or a stalemate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊終於喺今場比賽突圍成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 zung1 jyu1 hai2 gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 dat6 wai4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队终于在这场比赛突围成功。
examples.english_sentence: The team finally managed to break through in this match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港競爭咁大嘅市場，要突圍唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ging6 zang1 gam2 daai6 ge3 si5 coeng4, jiu3 dat6 wai4 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港竞争这么大的市场，要突围不容易。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong's highly competitive market, it's not easy to break through.

mandarin_meaning: 突破包围的子弹；比喻用來突圍或冲破困局的手段或措施
english_meaning: breakout bullet; literally a bullet used to break out of an encirclement, figuratively a tactic or measure used to achieve a decisive breakthrough
explanation_mandarin: 「突圍彈」原指能突破包圍、打開缺口的彈藥，口語和網絡語境中常用作比喻，指用來打破僵局或突破困境的手段、策略或一次性有效的舉措，既可用於衝突或抗爭場景，也可用於商業、宣傳等比喻用法。
explanation_english: Literally a bullet used to break through an encirclement. In colloquial and online Cantonese it is often used metaphorically to mean a tactic, measure, or one-off action that opens a way out of a deadlock or achieves a decisive breakthrough. It can be used in protest/military contexts or metaphorically in business, marketing, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威嗰陣，有人用突圍彈去打開警察嘅封鎖線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 go2 zan3 , jau5 jan4 jung6 dat6 wai4 daan6 heoi3 daa2 hoi1 ging2 caat3 ge3 fung1 so2 sin3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威期间，有人使用突围弹打开警察的封锁线。
examples.english_sentence: During the protest, some people used breakout bullets to open the police cordon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司推出嗰個創意廣告成咗佢哋嘅突圍彈，成功打入新市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 teoi1 ceot1 go2 go3 cong3 ji3 gwong2 gou3 sing4 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 dat6 wai4 daan6 , sing4 gung1 daa2 jap6 san1 si5 coeng4 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司推出的那則創意廣告成了他們的突圍彈，成功打入新市場。
examples.english_sentence: The company's creative ad became their breakout tactic and successfully entered the new market.

mandarin_meaning: 突围而出（突破包围或在困境/竞争中脱颖而出）
english_meaning: to break through an encirclement or barrier; to emerge from a difficult situation; figuratively, to stand out or break out from competition
explanation_mandarin: 指突破包围或從困境中脱身，也可比喻在激烈竞争中脱颖而出、取得突破性进展。
explanation_english: Refers to breaking through an encirclement or escaping a difficult situation; figuratively, it means to distinguish oneself or achieve a breakthrough amid strong competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺激烈嘅競爭中，呢間新創公司成功突圍而出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gik6 lit6 ge3 ging6 zaang1 zung1, ni1 gaan1 san1 cong3 gung1 si1 sing4 gung1 dat6 wai4 ji4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在激烈的竞争中，这家新创公司成功突围而出。
examples.english_sentence: Amid fierce competition, this startup successfully broke through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救援隊喺夜晚突圍而出，成功救出被困嘅居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 wun4 deoi6 hai2 je6 maan5 dat6 wai4 ji4 ceot1, sing4 gung1 gau3 ceot1 bei6 kwan3 ge3 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救援队在夜晚突围而出，成功救出被困的居民。
examples.english_sentence: The rescue team broke through at night and successfully rescued the trapped residents.

mandarin_meaning: 突如其來（突然、出乎意料地發生）
english_meaning: sudden; unexpected; all of a sudden; coming out of the blue
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事情發生得非常突然，出乎意料。可作狀語或定語使用。
explanation_english: Describes something happening very suddenly and unexpectedly; can be used adverbially or adjectivally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場雨突如其來，冇帶遮嘅人都濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 jyu5 dat6 jyu4 kei4 loi4, mou5 daai3 ze1 ge3 jan4 dou1 sap1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場雨突如其來，沒帶傘的人都濕透了。
examples.english_sentence: The rain came suddenly; people who didn't bring umbrellas got completely soaked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細突如其來話要停咗個計劃，成個團隊都嚇一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dat6 jyu4 kei4 loi4 waa6 jiu3 ting4 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6, sing4 go3 tyun4 deoi6 dou1 haak3 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板突然說要停止這個計劃，整個團隊都嚇了一跳。
examples.english_sentence: The boss suddenly announced they would stop the project; the whole team was startled.

mandarin_meaning: 突尼斯（國名）
english_meaning: Tunisia (country)
explanation_mandarin: 北非的一個國家，全稱突尼斯共和國，首都是突尼斯市。
explanation_english: A country in North Africa, officially the Republic of Tunisia, with its capital at Tunis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去突尼斯旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 dat6 nei4 si1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去突尼斯旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to Tunisia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 突尼斯係北非一個國家，擁有悠久嘅歷史同文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dat6 nei4 si1 hai6 bak1 fei1 jat1 go3 gwok3 gaa1, jung2 jau5 jau4 gau2 ge3 lik6 si2 tung4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 突尼斯是北非一個國家，擁有悠久的歷史和文化。
examples.english_sentence: Tunisia is a country in North Africa with a long history and culture.

mandarin_meaning: 突尼西亞（國名，位於北非）
