examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為人低調，立身處世好圓滑，先可以喺商界生存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 jan4 dai1 diu6, laap6 san1 cyu3 sai3 hou2 jyun4 waat6, sin1 ho2 ji5 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 sang1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人低調，立身處世很圓滑，才能在商界生存。
examples.english_sentence: He is low-key and tactful in his dealings, which allows him to survive in the business world.

mandarin_meaning: 立陶宛（Lìtáowǎn）——位於波羅的海東岸的北歐國家
english_meaning: Lithuania — a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe
explanation_mandarin: 立陶宛是位於波羅的海東岸的主權國家，首都是維爾紐斯。中文標準譯名為「立陶宛」。
explanation_english: Lithuania is a sovereign state on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea in Northern Europe. Its capital is Vilnius. The standard Chinese name is 立陶宛.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去立陶宛旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 laap6 tou4 waan6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個月會去立陶宛旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Lithuania next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 立陶宛嘅首都係維爾紐斯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laap6 tou4 waan6 ge3 sau2 dou1 hai6 wai4 ji5 nau2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 立陶宛的首都是維爾紐斯。
examples.english_sentence: Lithuania's capital is Vilnius.

mandarin_meaning: 多管閒事、插手
english_meaning: to meddle; to butt in; to interfere in others' affairs
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語/俚語，用來形容不必要或不受歡迎地插手、干預別人的事情，相當於「多管閒事」、「插手」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe unnecessarily or unwelcome meddling in others' affairs, equivalent to 'to butt in' or 'to interfere'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好立雜啦，呢啲嘢唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 laap6 zaap6 laa1, ni1 di1 je5 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別多管閒事，這些事情和你無關。
examples.english_sentence: Don't meddle; this matter doesn't concern you.

mandarin_meaning: 惹事 / 搗亂
english_meaning: to cause trouble; to make a fuss; to stir up trouble
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，表示挑起事端、製造麻煩或胡鬧，常用於責備或告誡別人不要惹事。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang meaning to stir up trouble, make a fuss, or cause mischief; often used to reprimand or warn someone not to cause problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度立雜嘢，大家專心做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 lap6 zaap6 je5, daai6 gaa1 zyun1 sam1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在這裏惹事，大家專心做事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble here; everyone focus on work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺學校立雜嘢，老師都頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 lap6 zaap6 je5, lou5 si1 dou1 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在學校惹事，老師很頭痛。
examples.english_sentence: He often causes trouble at school; the teacher is fed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做只會立雜嘢，解決唔到問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zi2 wui5 lap6 zaap6 je5, gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做只會製造麻煩，解決不了問題。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that will only stir things up and won't solve the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 站着吃（站著吃東西，常見於街頭小吃或沒有座位的情況）
english_meaning: to eat while standing; standing-up eating (often at street-food stalls or when there are no seats)
explanation_mandarin: 指站著吃東西，通常用於街邊小食檔、快餐或座位不足的情況，也帶有匆忙、快速解決一餐的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to eating while standing, commonly at street-food stalls or when seating is unavailable; often implies a quick or informal meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去嗰間街市小食檔，人好多，冇位坐，大家都係立食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 go2 gaan1 gaai1 si5 siu2 sik6 dong3, jan4 hou2 do1, mou5 wai2 co5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 laap6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去那個市場的小吃檔，人很多，沒位子坐，大家都站著吃。
examples.english_sentence: We went to that market snack stall tonight; it was very crowded with no seats, so everyone ate standing up.

mandarin_meaning: 立体 (三维的；有层次、立体感)
english_meaning: three-dimensional; stereoscopic; multi-dimensional
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有長、寬、高三個維度的空間特性；也可引申為具有層次、立體感或多面向的特性。
explanation_english: Describes something that has three spatial dimensions (length, width, height); can also be used figuratively to mean having depth, layers, or being multi-faceted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影有好真實嘅立體效果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 jau5 hou2 zan1 sat6 ge3 laap6 tai2 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影有很真實的立體效果。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has very realistic three-dimensional effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅分析好立體，考慮到好多層面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fan1 sik1 hou2 laap6 tai2, haau2 leoi6 dou3 hou2 do1 cang4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的分析很立體，考慮到很多層面。
examples.english_sentence: His analysis is very multi-dimensional, considering many aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個模型係立體嘅，可以由唔同角度睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mou4 jing4 hai6 laap6 tai2 ge3, ho2 ji5 jau4 m4 tung4 gok3 dou6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個模型是立體的，可以從不同角度觀察。
examples.english_sentence: This model is three-dimensional and can be viewed from different angles.

mandarin_meaning: 立體感（指事物的三維效果或空間深度感）
english_meaning: sense of three-dimensionality; sense of depth; three-dimensional effect
explanation_mandarin: 指視覺上或感官上能感受到物體具有立體、層次或空間深度的效果，常用於攝影、設計、化妝或虛擬實境等領域。
explanation_english: Refers to the perception that an object or scene has volume, dimensionality, or spatial depth. Commonly used in contexts like photography, design, makeup, and virtual reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅相冇乜立體感，睇落好平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 soeng2 mou5 mat1 laap6 tai2 gam2, tai2 lok6 hou2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張照片沒有什麼立體感，看起來很平。
examples.english_sentence: This photo lacks a sense of depth; it looks flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化妝可以增加面部嘅立體感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fa3 zong1 ho2 ji5 zang1 gaa1 min6 bou6 ge3 laap6 tai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化妝可以增加面部的立體感。
examples.english_sentence: Makeup can enhance the three-dimensionality of the face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: VR遊戲嘅立體感好強，好似真實咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: VR jau4 hei3 ge3 laap6 tai2 gam2 hou2 koeng4, hou2 ci5 zan1 sat6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: VR遊戲的立體感很強，像真的一樣。
examples.english_sentence: The VR game's sense of depth is strong; it feels almost real.

mandarin_meaning: 立体声 (lìtǐshēng)
english_meaning: stereo; stereophonic sound
explanation_mandarin: 指通過左右聲道（或多聲道）呈現的聲音效果，讓聲音具有空間感和方向感，常用於音響、錄音和播放設備。
explanation_english: Refers to stereophonic sound produced by two or more channels (typically left and right), creating a sense of space and directional audio; commonly used in speakers, recordings, and playback equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部收音機有立體聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau1 jam1 gei1 jau5 laap6 tai2 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台收音机有立体声。
examples.english_sentence: This radio has stereo sound.

mandarin_meaning: 黏乎乎／黏人的；緊貼著、黏住（口語）
english_meaning: clingy; stuck to; sticky (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容人很黏人、緊貼別人或物件；也可用來指某物黏緊、難以脫離。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term describing someone who is very clingy or something that is stuck tight and won't come off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細佬今日好黐人，成日立黐黐跟住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci1 jan4, sing4 jat6 laap6 ci1 ci1 gan1 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小弟今天很黏人，整天黏在我身邊。
examples.english_sentence: My little brother is really clingy today; he keeps sticking to me.

mandarin_meaning: 站 / 站着；车站
english_meaning: to stand; station (e.g., bus/train/subway station)
explanation_mandarin: “站”在粤语中可作动词，表示直立、站立或站起；也可作名词，指车站、站台等地点。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "站" can be a verb meaning to stand or to stand up, and a noun referring to a station or stop (e.g., bus/train/subway station).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺火車站等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 fo2 ce1 zaam6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在火车站等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait for you at the train station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請站起身，面向前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 zaam6 hei2 san1, min6 hoeng3 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请站起来，面向前。
examples.english_sentence: Please stand up and face forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個巴士站成日好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baa1 si2 zaam6 sing4 jat6 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个公交车站经常很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This bus stop often has many people.

mandarin_meaning: （說法或理由）站不住腳 / 站不住腳
english_meaning: to be untenable; to be indefensible; not to hold up (an argument)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词短语 / 形容词性短语（谓语/表语）
explanation_mandarin: 表示某个说法、理由或论点不能成立、经不起推敲或无法自圆其说。
explanation_english: Indicates that a claim, reason, or argument is untenable or cannot withstand scrutiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰個解釋太牽強，根本站不住腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 go3 gaai2 sik1 taai3 hin1 koeng4, gan1 bun2 zaan6 bat1 zyu6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那个解释太牵强，根本站不住脚。
examples.english_sentence: His explanation is too far-fetched and utterly untenable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你用呢啲資料嚟支持，嗰個論點就站不住腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jung6 ni1 di1 zi1 liu6 lai4 zi1 ci4, go2 go3 leon6 dim2 zau6 zaan6 bat1 zyu6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你用这些资料来支持，那个论点就站不住脚。
examples.english_sentence: If you use these pieces of data to support it, that point doesn't hold up.

mandarin_meaning: 站岗 (zhàn gǎng)：在某处值勤、守卫
english_meaning: to stand guard; to be on sentry/watch duty
explanation_mandarin: 指在某個位置值勤、守衛或巡邏，負責警戒、檢查或保護場所；口語中也可指暫時在某處看守或協助維持秩序。
explanation_english: To be on duty guarding a post or location — standing watch, patrolling, checking people or maintaining security. In everyday use it can also mean temporarily watching over a place or helping maintain order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我喺大門口站崗，負責檢查來訪者嘅證件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 hai2 daai6 mun4 hau2 zaam6 gong1, fu6 zaak3 gim2 caa4 loi4 fong3 ze2 ge3 zing3 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我在大门口站岗，负责检查来访者的证件。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I'm standing guard at the main gate, responsible for checking visitors' IDs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺軍營站崗，要好夜先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 gwan1 jing4 zaam6 gong1, jiu3 hou2 je6 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在军营站岗，要很晚才回家。
examples.english_sentence: He's on guard duty at the barracks and won't get home until very late.

mandarin_meaning: 站牌（公交站牌）
english_meaning: bus stop sign; stop-board indicating bus/tram stop and route info
explanation_mandarin: 指設於路邊、標示巴士或電車停靠位置及路線資訊的標牌或牌子，常見於城市的巴士站或電車站。
explanation_english: A sign or board at a bus/tram stop that marks the stopping point and typically displays route numbers, schedules, and related information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個站牌寫住幾多號巴士會停？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaam6 paai4 se2 zyu6 gei2 do1 hou6 baa1 si2 wui5 ting4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个站牌写着几号巴士会停？
examples.english_sentence: Which bus numbers stop at this bus stop sign?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 站牌上有個時間表，顯示每班車嘅開出時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaam6 paai4 soeng6 jau5 go3 si4 gaan3 biu1, hin2 si6 mui5 baan1 ce1 ge3 hoi1 ceot1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 站牌上有个时间表，显示每班车的开出时间。
examples.english_sentence: There's a timetable on the bus stop sign showing each service's departure times.

mandarin_meaning: 站立（zhànlì）
english_meaning: to stand; to stand upright
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或物由坐、躺等姿势变为直立状态，或保持直立不动。
explanation_english: To assume or maintain an upright, standing position (for a person or object).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為受傷，冇辦法站立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 sau6 soeng1, mou5 baan6faat3 zaam6 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為受傷，沒辦法站立。
examples.english_sentence: He can't stand because of his injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 士兵要學習正確嘅站立方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 bing1 jiu3 hok6 zaap6 zing3 kok3 ge3 zaam6 laap6 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 士兵要學習正確的站立方法。
examples.english_sentence: Soldiers need to learn the correct way to stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路開始學站立，屋企人好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 zaam6 laap6, uk1 kei5 jan4 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩開始學站立，家人很高興。
examples.english_sentence: The child is beginning to learn to stand, and the family is very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 在每一站都停靠（不是快車/直達）
english_meaning: to stop at every stop; not express; making frequent stops
explanation_mandarin: 通常用來形容巴士、電車或列車在每一站都停靠，表示不是快線或直達。也可引申為某事物頻繁停頓、進展緩慢或效率低下。
explanation_english: Typically used to describe buses, trams, or trains that stop at every station, meaning they are not express. Figuratively it can mean frequent stops or slow/inefficient progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日搭巴士，佢係站站停，成程好塞車，遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 daap3 baa1 si2, keoi5 hai6 zaam6 zaam6 ting4, sing4 cing4 hou2 sak1 ce1, ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天坐公交车，它每一站都停，全程很塞车，結果迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: I took the bus today; it stopped at every stop, the whole trip was jammed, and I ended up late.

mandarin_meaning: 站长（车站负责人；网站管理员）
english_meaning: station master; station manager; webmaster/site administrator
explanation_mandarin: 指負責一個車站（如地鐵、火車、巴士站）管理與運作的人；在網路語境中也可指網站或論壇的管理員。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in charge of running and managing a station (e.g., subway, train, bus). In online contexts it can also mean the webmaster or site administrator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵站長今朝出嚟解釋事故嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 zaam6 zoeng2 gam1 ziu1 ceot1 loi4 gaai2 sik1 gu3 si6 ge3 jyun4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁站长今天出来解释事故的原因。
examples.english_sentence: The subway station master came out this morning to explain the cause of the accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個網站嘅站長已經三日冇回覆訊息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 mong5 zaam6 ge3 zaam6 zoeng2 ji5 ging1 saam1 jat6 mou5 wui4 fuk1 seon3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个网站的站长已经三天没有回复消息。
examples.english_sentence: The webmaster of that website hasn't replied to messages for three days.

mandarin_meaning: 站头；车站（口语）
english_meaning: bus stop; station (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指巴士、電車或其他公共交通工具的停靠點，即「巴士站/車站」。亦可泛指在站點附近的位置。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a public transport stop (e.g., bus or tram stop). It corresponds to 'bus stop' or 'station' and can refer to the area around the stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺站頭等咗半個鐘先有車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 zaam6 tau4 dang2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 sin1 jau5 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在站头等了半个小时才有车。
examples.english_sentence: I waited at the bus stop for half an hour before a bus came.

mandarin_meaning: （用作副词）竟然，出乎意料
english_meaning: unexpectedly; surprisingly
explanation_mandarin: 作副词用，表示出乎意料或令人惊讶的情形，常见於“竟然”等用法，口語及書面皆可使用。
explanation_english: Used as an adverb to indicate surprise or an unexpected result. Commonly appears in the form '竟然' and is used in both spoken and written Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你竟然唔記得我生日？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ging2 jin4 m4 gei3 dak1 ngo5 saang1 jat6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你竟然忘记了我的生日？
examples.english_sentence: You actually forgot my birthday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然考到第一名，真叻！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 laak6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然考到第一名，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He actually got first place—really impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我竟然忘咗帶鎖匙出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ging2 jin4 mong4 zo2 daai3 so2 si4 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我竟然忘了带钥匙出门。
examples.english_sentence: I actually forgot to bring my keys when leaving.

mandarin_meaning: 竟然
english_meaning: unexpectedly; surprisingly; actually
explanation_mandarin: 表示出乎意料，强调某事与预期相反或令人惊讶。
explanation_english: Indicates surprise or that something happened contrary to expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然唔記得咗我嘅生日！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 ngo5 ge3 saang1 jat6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然忘記了我的生日！
examples.english_sentence: He actually forgot my birthday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣預報話會落雨，但竟然出咗太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, daan6 ging2 jin4 ceot1 zo2 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣預報說會下雨，但竟然出太陽了。
examples.english_sentence: The forecast said it would rain, but surprisingly the sun came out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然考到第一名！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然考到第一名！
examples.english_sentence: He surprisingly got first place!

mandarin_meaning: 章；章節；章程；印章；（姓）章
english_meaning: chapter; section; article (of rules); seal/stamp; (surname) Zhang
explanation_mandarin: “章”常用來表示書本或文章的章節，也可指規章、章程或印章。此外，“章”也是一個中文姓氏。
explanation_english: “章” is commonly used to mean a chapter or section of a book or article; it can also refer to regulations/articles (e.g. company articles) or a seal/stamp. It is also a Chinese surname (Zhang).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書有十章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 sap6 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书有十章。
examples.english_sentence: This book has ten chapters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅章程要更新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zoeng1 cing4 jiu3 geng1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的章程要更新。
examples.english_sentence: The company's articles need to be updated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓章，大家叫佢章先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 zoeng1, daai6 gaa1 giu3 keoi5 zoeng1 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓章，大家叫他章先生。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Zhang; everyone calls him Mr. Zhang.

mandarin_meaning: 做事或表達的方法、規則與條理；文章、佈局的結構與安排（章程和方法）
english_meaning: an orderly method or system; the structure, arrangement, or rules for doing something
explanation_mandarin: 指做事、表達或布局有條理、有規矩的方式，也可指文章或作品的章節與安排。
explanation_english: Refers to a systematic, orderly way of doing or presenting things; can also mean the structure or arrangement of a piece of writing or work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好有章法，唔會亂嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 zoeng1 faat3, m4 wui5 lyun6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很有章法，不會亂來。
examples.english_sentence: He works very methodically and doesn't act haphazardly.

mandarin_meaning: 章程 / 章程（組織或機構訂定的規則、條款）
english_meaning: articles; regulations; bylaws (rules or charter of an organization or company)
explanation_mandarin: 指組織、公司或社團等訂定的規則、制度或條款，通常規範內部運作、權利與義務，例如公司章程或社團章程。
explanation_english: Refers to the rules, regulations, or articles established by an organization, company, or association that govern internal operations, rights, and obligations (e.g., articles of association, bylaws).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅章程要喺股東大會通過先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zoeng1 cing4 jiu3 hai2 gu2 dung1 daai6 wui2 tung1 gwo3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的章程要在股東大會通過才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company's articles must be approved at the shareholders' meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 章節（書籍或文章中劃分出的章和節，表示內容的結構單位）
english_meaning: chapter; section; a structural unit of a text
explanation_mandarin: 指書籍、文章或其他文本中分割出的章和節，用來組織和呈現內容的結構單位。
explanation_english: Refers to the chapters and sections in books, articles, or other texts; units used to organize and present content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅章節安排得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zoeng1 zit3 on1 paai4 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書的章節安排得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The chapters and sections of this book are organized very clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以按章節搵返相關內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 on3 zoeng1 zit3 wan2 faan1 soeng1 gwaan1 noi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以按章節找到相關內容。
examples.english_sentence: You can find the relevant content by chapter/section.

mandarin_meaning: 章鱼 (海洋软体动物)
english_meaning: octopus
explanation_mandarin: 一种海洋头足类软体动物，具有八条触腕，常见于海鲜菜肴（如章鱼烧）和海洋生态中。
explanation_english: A marine cephalopod with eight arms; commonly found in ocean environments and used as food (e.g., takoyaki).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食章魚燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 zoeng1 jyu4 siu1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃章鱼烧。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat takoyaki tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 竣 (jùn)：完成、結束，常用於書面語，如「竣工」。
english_meaning: to finish; to complete; completed (often used in formal/written contexts, e.g. 竣工).
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情結束或完成，多用於正式或書面語，常見搭配如「竣工」、「工程竣事」。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is finished or completed. Commonly used in formal or written contexts; frequently appears in compounds like 竣工 (completion of construction).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座大樓已經竣工，可以入伙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 daai6 lau4 ji5 ging1 zeon3 gung1, ho2 ji5 jap6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座大楼已经竣工，可以入伙。
examples.english_sentence: This building has been completed and is ready for occupancy.

mandarin_meaning: 竣工；工程或建筑施工完成
english_meaning: to finish construction; (of a project/building) to be completed
explanation_mandarin: 表示工程、建筑等施工完成，达到可以使用或交付的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that construction or an engineering project has been completed and is ready for use or handover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座橋終於竣工，可以通車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 kiu4 zung1 jyu1 zeon3 gung1, ho2 ji5 tung1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座桥终于竣工，可以通车。
examples.english_sentence: This bridge has finally been completed and can be opened to traffic.

mandarin_meaning: 童（tóng），常指小孩或與童年有關的事物，如兒童、童年、童話等。
english_meaning: child; youth; relating to childhood (used mainly in compounds, e.g., children, fairy tale).
explanation_mandarin: 「童」通常用來表示小孩或與童年有關的概念，多見於複合詞中，如「兒童」、「童年」、「童話」。
explanation_english: The character denotes a child or things related to childhood. It is commonly used in compounds such as '兒童' (children), '童年' (childhood), and '童話' (fairy tale).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個小童喺公園度玩緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 siu2 tung4 hai2 gung1 jyun4 dou6 waan2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩子在公园里玩。
examples.english_sentence: That child is playing in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 不欺骗任何人；公平诚信（成语，表示对所有人都一视同仁、公平对待）
english_meaning: to be honest and fair to everyone; not to cheat the young or the old (idiom indicating fairness and integrity)
explanation_mandarin: 原意為不欺騙兒童和老人，現用來形容公平誠實、對所有人不弄虛作假，常用來形容商家或人的行為可靠、公平。
explanation_english: Originally means 'do not deceive children or the elderly.' Now used to describe fairness and honesty toward everyone, often said of trustworthy merchants or behaviour that is equitable and free of deception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭一向童叟無欺，價錢公道，唔會欺騙人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 jat1 hoeng3 tung4 sou2 mou4 hei1, gaa3 cin2 gung1 dou6, m4 wui5 hei1 pin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店一向童叟无欺，价格公道，不会欺骗顾客。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has always been honest and fair to everyone; the prices are reasonable and they don't cheat customers.

mandarin_meaning: 童子（tóngzǐ）— 小孩；男童；亦可指寺庙或宗教中担任杂务或学徒的童仆、童役（俗称童子）。
english_meaning: child; boy; (in religious contexts) temple acolyte or novice
explanation_mandarin: “童子”原指儿童或少年，在书面语和历史、宗教语境中常见；在寺庙或道观中可指帮忙的童仆或学徒（童子）。现代口语中常用“细路/小孩”更普遍。
explanation_english: Literally 'child' or 'boy'. Used in literary, historical, or religious contexts; in temples it can mean an acolyte or novice who helps with chores. In everyday speech speakers more often say 'child' or 'kid'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個童子喺街度玩波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 tung4 zi2 hai2 gaai1 dou6 waan2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩在街上玩球。
examples.english_sentence: That child is playing ball on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寺廟入面有幾個童子幫手打掃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 miu6 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 go3 tung4 zi2 bong1 sau2 daa2 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺庙里有几个童子在帮忙打扫。
examples.english_sentence: There are several temple acolytes helping to clean inside the temple.

mandarin_meaning: 小孩的尿液；（俚語）用來罵人膽小、沒用、軟弱
english_meaning: literally 'child's urine'; (slang, vulgar) used as an insult to call someone cowardly, useless, or weak
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（亦作俚語性貶義用法）
explanation_mandarin: 本詞字面意思是「小孩的尿」，在口語或粗俗語境中作貶義用法，用以形容某人膽小、懦弱或無用，帶有侮辱性。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a child's urine. In colloquial and vulgar usage it is a pejorative term used to describe someone as cowardly, weak, or worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢膽小到好似童子尿，咩都唔敢試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daam2 siu2 dou3 hou2 ci5 tung4 zi2 niu6, me1 dou1 m4 gam2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他膽子小得像小孩的尿一樣，什麼都不敢試。
examples.english_sentence: He's so timid—like 'child's urine'—he doesn't dare to try anything.

jyutping: tung4 zi2 gwan1 tiu3 daan6 cong4
mandarin_meaning: 像童子军在蹦床上跳 — 形容像小孩一樣活躍、胡鬧或過度興奮地到處跳動
english_meaning: Like a Boy Scout bouncing on a trampoline — describes acting childishly, hyperactive, or bouncing around energetically
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容一個人很活躍、像小孩子一樣不停跳動或胡鬧，帶有輕鬆、戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial slang phrase used to describe someone who is very energetic or childishly hyper, literally like bouncing on a trampoline; often playful or teasing in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聚會上阿明好似童子軍跳彈床咁不停跳嚟跳去，搞到大家笑翻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi6 wui6 soeng6 aa3 ming4 hou2 ci5 tung4 zi2 gwan1 tiu3 daan6 cong4 gam2 bat1 ting4 tiu3 lai4 tiu3 heoi3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 siu3 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在聚會上，阿明像童子军在蹦床上跳一樣不停地跳來跳去，把大家都逗笑了。
examples.english_sentence: At the party, Ah Ming kept bouncing around like a Boy Scout on a trampoline, making everyone laugh.

cantonese: 童子軍跳彈床 - 是鳩但
jyutping: tung4 zi2 gwan1 tiu3 daan6 cong4 si6 gau1 daan6
mandarin_meaning: 一個帶有粗俗語氣的廣東話俚語，用來形容某人行為幼稚、無聊或愚蠢，具有貶義。
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese slang phrase used to describe someone's behavior as childish, pointless, or stupid; a derogatory, colloquial expression.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語 / 感嘆語（貶義短語）
explanation_mandarin: 此短語把「童子軍跳彈床」作為比喻，暗示笨拙、幼稚或無意義的行為，後綴「是鳩但」帶有粗口成份，語氣強烈且貶損。
explanation_english: The phrase uses the image of 'scouts jumping on a trampoline' as a metaphor for clumsy, childish, or pointless behavior; the suffix 'is gau1 daan6' (鳩但) adds a vulgar, insulting tone. It is colloquial and derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲做法，簡直係童子軍跳彈床——是鳩但。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zou6 faat3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 tung4 zi2 gwan1 tiu3 daan6 cong4 — si6 gau1 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的做法簡直就是「童子軍跳彈床——是鳩但」，既幼稚又愚蠢（帶粗口語氣）。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is basically 'scouts jumping on a trampoline — damn stupid' — childish and pointless (vulgar tone).

jyutping: tung4 zi2 gwan1 tiu3 daan6 cong4
mandarin_meaning: 像童子军在蹦床上跳（比喻行為幼稚或精力過剩、亂跳亂鬧）
english_meaning: Literally 'Boy Scouts jumping on a trampoline' — used figuratively to describe someone acting childishly, bouncing around energetically or behaving in a chaotic, unfocused way
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，常用來形容某人精力旺盛、東跳西跑或行為幼稚、不專心。語氣通常帶有戲謔或輕微批評。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase used to describe someone who is overly energetic, bouncing around, acting childish or not concentrating. The tone is often playful or mildly critical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司入面童子軍跳彈牀，冇集中做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 tung4 zi2 gwan1 tiu3 daan6 cong4, mou5 zap1 zung6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天在公司裡像童子軍在彈床上跳，無法集中做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always bouncing around in the office like Boy Scouts on a trampoline and can't focus on work.

mandarin_meaning: 童子鸡
english_meaning: suckling chicken; young chicken (used in Cantonese cuisine)
explanation_mandarin: 指尚幼的小雞，肉質細嫩，常見於廣東菜中作白切、燒或蒸等做法。
explanation_english: A young (suckling) chicken with very tender meat, commonly used in Cantonese cuisine for poaching (white-cut), roasting, or steaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋訂咗隻童子雞，一齊食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 deng6 zo2 zek3 tung4 zi2 gai1, jat1 cai4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们订了一只童子鸡，一起吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: We ordered a suckling chicken tonight — let's eat together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒樓嘅白切童子雞好出名，肉質好嫩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lau4 ge3 baak6 cit3 tung4 zi2 gai1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, juk6 zat1 hou2 nan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒楼的白切童子鸡很有名，肉质很嫩。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's poached (white-cut) suckling chicken is famous — the meat is very tender.

mandarin_meaning: 童子鸡（指年幼的鸡，常用于粤菜烹调）
english_meaning: young chicken (culinary term); spring chicken
explanation_mandarin: 指年幼、肉質細嫩的雞，常用於廣東／粵菜的烹調，例如清蒸、燉湯或煲雞湯，被視為滋補食材。
explanation_english: Refers to a young, tender chicken commonly used in Cantonese cuisine (e.g. steamed, braised, or made into soup). It is prized for its delicate meat and is considered nourishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋煲咗隻童子鷄湯，好補身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 bou1 zo2 zek3 tung4 zi2 gai1 tong1, hou2 bou2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們煲了隻童子鸡汤，很補身。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we made a young chicken soup; it's very nourishing.

mandarin_meaning: 童工（指未成年人從事有償勞動的人）
english_meaning: child laborer; child worker
explanation_mandarin: 指未成年的兒童或青少年從事有償工作，通常涉及剝削或違反最低就業年齡的情況，很多國家和地區予以限制或禁止。
explanation_english: Refers to a child or minor engaged in paid work, often involving exploitation or work below legal minimum age; commonly restricted or prohibited in many jurisdictions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲工廠仲請童工，情況好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gung1 cong2 zung6 ceng2 tung4 gung1, cing4 fong3 hou2 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些工厂还雇用童工，情况很严重。
examples.english_sentence: Some factories still employ child laborers; the situation is very serious.

mandarin_meaning: 童年 (tóngnián) — 兒時、孩提時代
english_meaning: childhood
explanation_mandarin: 指人年幼時期的時光與經歷，通常指從嬰兒期到青少年早期的那段時間。
explanation_english: Refers to the period of being a child and the experiences during that time, typically from infancy through early adolescence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅童年喺鄉下度過，留下咗好多美好嘅回憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 tung4 nin4 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 dou6 gwo3, lau4 haa6 zo2 hou2 do1 mei5 hou2 ge3 wui4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的童年在鄉下度過，留下了很多美好的回憶。
examples.english_sentence: I spent my childhood in the countryside and left many wonderful memories.

mandarin_meaning: 童心；孩童般的纯真、天真或童真之心
english_meaning: childlike heart; childlike innocence; a sense of wonder or innocence associated with children
explanation_mandarin: 表示像孩子般的纯真與好奇心，常用來形容即使長大仍保有童真、天真的人或態度。
explanation_english: Refers to a childlike innocence or heart — retaining curiosity, wonder, and simplicity like a child. Often used to describe someone who remains playful or innocent despite growing up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲有童心，睇到動畫片會好興奮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 jau5 tung4 sam1, tai2 dou3 dung6 waa6 pin3 wui5 hou2 hing1 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仍有童心，看到动画片会很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: He still has a childlike heart; he gets very excited when he watches cartoons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師讚佢有童心，教學更有創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 zaan3 keoi5 jau5 tung4 sam1, gaau3 hok6 gang3 jau5 cong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师称赞他有童心，教学更有创意。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher praised that he has childlike innocence, which makes his teaching more creative.

mandarin_meaning: 仍保有童心；未失去童真
english_meaning: still retains a child's heart; has not lost childlike innocence
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容雖然年紀已大，但仍保有孩子般的天真、好奇或愛玩的性格。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, despite their age, still retains childlike innocence, curiosity, or playfulness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然已經三十多歲，但童心未泯，仲鍾意玩模型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 ji5 ging1 saam1 sap6 do1 seoi3, daan6 tung4 sam1 mei6 man5, zung6 zung1 ji3 waan2 mou4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雖然已經三十多歲，但童心未泯，還喜歡玩模型。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's already in his thirties, he still has a child's heart and likes playing with models.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友見到新嘅玩具就開心，但大人有時都會童心未泯，一齊玩得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 gin3 dou3 san1 ge3 waan2 geoi6 zau6 hoi1 sam1, daan6 daai6 jan4 jau5 si4 dou1 wui5 tung4 sam1 mei6 man5, jat1 cai4 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友看到新玩具會開心，但大人有時也會童心未泯，大家一起玩得很開心。
examples.english_sentence: Kids get excited when they see new toys, but adults sometimes still retain childlike innocence and have a lot of fun playing together.

mandarin_meaning: 童星（指兒童時期成名的演員或藝人）
english_meaning: child star (a performer who became famous as a child)
explanation_mandarin: 指在兒童時期因演戲、唱歌、拍廣告等表演活動而成名的演員或藝人。
explanation_english: Refers to an actor or performer who became famous during childhood, typically through acting, singing, or appearing in commercials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個已經係童星，拍過好多廣告同電視劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 hai6 tung4 sing1, paak3 gwo3 hou2 do1 gwong2 gou3 tung4 din6 si6 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她小時候就是童星，拍過很多廣告和電視劇。
examples.english_sentence: He/She was a child star, having appeared in many commercials and TV dramas.

mandarin_meaning: 童書 / 兒童書籍（為兒童創作或出版的書）
english_meaning: children's book(s)
explanation_mandarin: 指為兒童創作或出版的書籍，內容通常較淺顯、圖文並茂，適合幼兒或學童閱讀。
explanation_english: Books produced for children; usually written in simple language and often illustrated, aimed at toddlers or school-aged kids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間書店有好多童書，啱細路仔睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 syu1 dim3 jau5 hou2 do1 tung4 syu1, ngaam1 sai3 lou6 zai2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家书店有很多童书，适合小孩子看。
examples.english_sentence: This bookstore has many children's books; they're suitable for young kids to read.

mandarin_meaning: 童生（tóngshēng）：古代對年輕讀書人或科舉考生的稱呼；也可泛指兒童或學生。
english_meaning: Originally a term for a young scholar or imperial-examination candidate; can also mean a child or student.
explanation_mandarin: 古代科舉體制下的稱謂，指未登科或年輕的讀書人、考生。現多見於文學或歷史語境，也可泛指兒童、學生。
explanation_english: A historical term used in the imperial examination system to refer to young students or examinees. Today it is mainly used in literary or historical contexts and can generally mean a child or pupil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視劇入面嗰個人係明朝嘅童生，日日去私塾讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 kek6 jap6 min6 go2 go3 jan4 hai6 ming4 ciu1 ge3 tung4 saang1, jat6 jat6 heoi3 si1 suk1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视剧里面那个人是明朝的童生，天天去私塾读书。
examples.english_sentence: The person in the TV drama is a tongsheng (a young scholar) from the Ming dynasty who goes to a private school to study every day.

mandarin_meaning: 童真 (tóngzhēn)，指孩子般的純真與單純
english_meaning: childlike innocence; purity and naivety characteristic of children
explanation_mandarin: 指孩童特有的單純、無邪與好奇心，也可用來形容成年人仍保有孩童般的純真（眞為繁體異體字，等同「真」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the purity, naivety, and curiosity typical of children; can also describe adults who retain a childlike purity (the character 眞 is a traditional variant of 真).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲有好多童眞，成日對世界充滿好奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 tung4 zan1, sing4 jat6 deoi3 sai3 gaai3 cung1 mun5 hou2 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他還保有很多童真，總是對世界充滿好奇。
examples.english_sentence: He still has a lot of childlike innocence and is always curious about the world.

mandarin_meaning: 童真 (tóngzhēn): 兒童純真、天真的特質或成年人保有的純真心態
english_meaning: childlike innocence; purity; naivety
explanation_mandarin: 指兒童純潔、天真無邪的特質，也可用來形容成年人保有的單純、純真心態。
explanation_english: Refers to the pure, innocent qualities of children; can also describe an adult's retained childlike purity or naivety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲保留住童真，面對困難都會帶住樂觀嘅態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 bou2 lau4 zyu6 tung4 zan1, min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4 dou1 wui5 daai3 zyu6 lok6 gun1 ge3 taai3 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仍然保留着童真，面對困難也會帶著樂觀的態度。
examples.english_sentence: He still retains his childlike innocence and faces difficulties with a positive attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幅畫充滿童真，睇落好感人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fuk1 waa6 cung1 mun5 tung4 zan1, tai2 lok6 hou2 gam2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幅畫充滿童真，看起來很感人。
examples.english_sentence: That painting is full of childlike innocence and looks very touching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大人偶爾都需要返返童真，唔好咁複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 jan4 au2 ji5 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 faan1 faan1 tung4 zan1, m4 hou2 gam3 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大人偶爾也需要找回童真，不要那麼複雜。
examples.english_sentence: Adults sometimes need to rediscover their childlike innocence and not be so complicated.

mandarin_meaning: 童装（兒童服裝）
english_meaning: children's clothing; kids' clothes
explanation_mandarin: 指供兒童穿著的各類衣物，亦常用作商店或商品的分類名稱。
explanation_english: Clothing designed for children; garments for infants and kids. Also used as a retail or product category.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間商店有好多靚嘅童裝，啱晒小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 soeng1 dim3 jau5 hou2 do1 leng3 ge3 tung4 zong1, ngaam1 saai3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間商店有很多漂亮的童裝，非常適合小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: This store has many nice children's clothes, perfect for kids.

mandarin_meaning: 童言無忌 (tóng yán wú jì)：小孩子說話無所顧忌，天真直率，可能會說出讓人尷尬或受傷的話。
english_meaning: Children speak without inhibition; innocent bluntness that may cause embarrassment or hurt.
explanation_mandarin: 形容小孩說話直接、天真，不太顧及場合或他人感受，因此有時會說出不合時宜或傷人的話。
explanation_english: Describes how children speak plainly and without tact; their innocent frankness can sometimes be inappropriate or hurtful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路有時真係會童言無忌，唔識得有啲說話會傷到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 jau5 si4 zan1 hai6 wui5 tung4 jin4 mou4 gei3, m4 sik1 dak1 jau5 di1 syut3 waa6 wui5 soeng1 dou3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子有時真的會童言無忌，不知道有些話會傷到人。
examples.english_sentence: Children can really speak without restraint; sometimes they don't realize their words can hurt others.

mandarin_meaning: 童话（指儿童或大众的幻想故事）
english_meaning: fairy tale; fairy story
explanation_mandarin: 指為兒童或大眾創作的幻想故事，常包含魔法、擬人化的動物或超自然情節；也可比喻美好但不真實的情況。
explanation_english: A type of story, often for children, featuring fantasy elements such as magic, talking animals, or the supernatural; also used metaphorically for situations that are unrealistically ideal or fairy-tale-like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，我最鍾意聽童話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 teng1 tung4 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我最喜欢听童话。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I liked listening to fairy tales the most.

mandarin_meaning: 童谣；兒童歌謠（兒歌）
english_meaning: nursery rhyme; children's song
explanation_mandarin: 指為兒童創作或傳唱的簡短歌謠，通常節奏簡單、易記，有助語言和記憶發展及娛樂。
explanation_english: A short song or rhyme for children (nursery rhyme), usually simple and catchy, used for entertainment and to help language and memory development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽仲會唱童謠俾細路仔聽，幫佢哋瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 zung6 wui5 coeng3 tung4 jiu4 bei2 sai3 lou6 zai2 teng1, bong1 keoi5 dei6 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽還會給孩子們唱童謠，幫助他們入睡。
examples.english_sentence: Mothers also sing nursery rhymes to children to help them fall asleep.

mandarin_meaning: （通常指男性）處男；指未有性經驗的人
english_meaning: virgin (usually male); a person who has not had sexual intercourse
explanation_mandarin: 來源受日語影響的詞彙，指未有性經驗的人，日常或網絡語境中常用來指男性處男，有時帶戲謔或貶義色彩。
explanation_english: A term (influenced by Japanese) referring to someone who has not had sexual intercourse; often used to denote a male virgin. In everyday or online contexts it can carry teasing or derogatory tones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係童貞，唔想講經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 tung4 zan1, m4 soeng2 gong2 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是童貞，不想談論經歷。
examples.english_sentence: He says he's a virgin and doesn't want to talk about his experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，『童貞』呢個字有時係網絡用語，帶住玩笑或者輕視嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, 'tung4 zan1' ni1 go3 zi6 jau5 si4 hai6 mong5 lok6 jung6 jyu5, daai3 zyu6 waan2 siu3 waak6 ze2 hing1 si6 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，『童貞』這個詞有時是網絡用語，帶有玩笑或輕視的意思。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, the term '童貞' is sometimes used online, carrying joking or dismissive connotations.

mandarin_meaning: 童军（參加童子軍組織的人或該組織）
english_meaning: scout (member of the scouting organization); the scouting organization
explanation_mandarin: 指參加童子軍組織的人或指該組織，通常涉及戶外活動、露營、急救等技能訓練與品格教育。
explanation_english: Refers to a member of the scouting organization or the organization itself; typically involves outdoor activities, camping, first-aid training, and character education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個係童軍，學過紮營同急救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hai6 tung4 gwan1, hok6 gwo3 zaat3 jing4 tung4 gap1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候是童軍，學過紮營和急救。
examples.english_sentence: I was a scout when I was a kid; I learned camping and first aid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家係童軍隊嘅隊長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hai6 tung4 gwan1 deoi6 ge3 deoi6 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是童軍隊的隊長。
examples.english_sentence: He is now the leader of the scout troop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有興趣報名做童軍嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 bou3 ming4 zou6 tung4 gwan1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有興趣報名當童軍嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you interested in signing up to be a scout?

mandarin_meaning: 童顏（童稚的面容；看起來年輕或像孩子般的臉）
english_meaning: youthful face; childlike/baby-faced appearance
explanation_mandarin: 指面容看起來年輕、稚嫩，像小孩子或比實際年齡年輕的樣子。可用來描述人的外貌特徵。
explanation_english: Refers to a face that looks young or childlike — someone who appears younger than their actual age. Used to describe a person's appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有童顏，睇唔出佢已經三十幾歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 tung4 ngaan4, tai2 m4 ceot1 keoi5 ji5 ging1 saam1 sap6 gei2 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她有童顏，看不出她已經三十幾歲。
examples.english_sentence: She has a youthful face; you can't tell she's already in her thirties.

mandarin_meaning: 童养媳（tóng yǎng xí）：被家庭從小收養、預定將來嫁給家中兒子的女孩，常見於舊時婚姻習俗。
english_meaning: A girl taken in and raised from childhood by a family to be married to their son; a child bride raised by the future husband's family.
explanation_mandarin: 指某些社會裡，家庭從小收養女孩並安排她將來嫁給家中兒子的習俗或現象，歷史上常伴隨權利不平等與剝削。
explanation_english: Refers to the practice or phenomenon in which a family takes in a young girl and raises her to become the future wife of their son; historically associated with inequality and exploitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前有啲農村會有童養媳嘅習俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 jau5 di1 nung4 cyun1 wui5 jau5 tung4 joeng5 sik1 ge3 zaap6 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有些農村會有童養媳的習俗。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, some rural areas had the custom of raising child brides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係作為童養媳被帶入呢個家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zok3 wai6 tung4 joeng5 sik1 bei6 daai3 jap6 ni1 go3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她作為童養媳被帶入這個家庭。
examples.english_sentence: She was brought into the family as a child bride.

mandarin_meaning: 童黨（指由未成年人或少年組成、從事打架、搶劫、滋事等非法或擾亂治安活動的小團體）
english_meaning: juvenile gang; a group of youngsters involved in criminal or disorderly activities
explanation_mandarin: 指由兒童或青少年組成、從事打鬥、偷竊、滋事等違法或擾亂秩序行為的團體，常帶有貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of children or youths who engage in fighting, theft, vandalism, or other illegal/disorderly behavior; carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市中心最近有班童黨成日喺街度滋事，啲店舖都好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 zung1 sam1 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 baan1 tung4 dong2 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zi1 si6, di1 dim3 pou3 dou1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近市中心有些童黨老是在街上滋事，店铺都很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: Recently there have been gangs of youngsters causing trouble in the city center, and the shops are afraid.

mandarin_meaning: 竖；豎立；垂直
english_meaning: to erect; to stand upright; vertical
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物豎起或直立，也可用作形容詞表示垂直、直立的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates placing something upright or standing erect; can also describe something vertical/upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將一支旗竪喺屋企門口，等人知呢度係佢屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 jat1 zi1 kei4 syu6 hai2 uk1 kei5 mun4 hau2, dang2 jan4 zi1 ni1 dou6 hai6 keoi5 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把一面旗子竖在家门口，让人知道这是他家。
examples.english_sentence: He put a flag up at the front of his house so people would know it's his home.

mandarin_meaning: （动词）耗尽、用尽；尽力
english_meaning: to exhaust; to use up; to do one's utmost (in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把力量、资源等用尽或尽最大努力，常见于“竭尽”、“竭尽所能”等词语中。
explanation_english: Indicates exhausting resources or making every effort; commonly appears in compounds like '竭盡所能' (to do one's utmost).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經竭盡所能幫我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 git3 zeon6 so2 nang4 bong1 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经竭尽所能帮助我们。
examples.english_sentence: He has already done everything he can to help us.

mandarin_meaning: 竭尽全力、尽力而为
english_meaning: to do one's utmost; to try one's best; to exert all one's strength
explanation_mandarin: 表示用盡全力去做某事，常用於書面或較正式的語境，通常置於動詞之前作狀語。
explanation_english: Indicates exerting all one's effort to do something. Often used in formal or written contexts and typically appears before a verb as an adverbial modifier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會竭力幫你完成呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 git3 lik6 bong1 nei5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會竭力幫你完成這個計劃。
examples.english_sentence: I'll do my utmost to help you complete this project.

mandarin_meaning: 竭盡全力
english_meaning: to do one's utmost; to exert all one's strength/effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示用盡全部力量或資源去做某事，強調盡最大努力。
explanation_english: Expresses using all one's strength or resources to do something; emphasizes making the greatest possible effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗今次嘅比賽，我哋會竭盡全力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 wui5 git6 zeon6 cyun4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了這次的比賽，我們會竭盡全力。
examples.english_sentence: For this competition, we will do our utmost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗搵錢，日以繼夜咁竭盡全力工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 wan2 cin2, jat6 ji5 gai3 je6 gam2 git6 zeon6 cyun4 lik6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了賺錢，日以繼夜地竭盡全力工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works day and night, exerting all his strength to earn money.

mandarin_meaning: 竭尽所能
english_meaning: to do one's utmost; to make every possible effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示尽最大努力、用尽一切能力去完成某事。
explanation_english: Indicates making every possible effort; using all one's ability to accomplish something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫公司渡過難關，佢竭盡所能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bong1 gung1si1 dou6gwo3 naan6gwaan1, keoi5 kit3 zeon6 so2 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮助公司度过难关，他竭尽所能。
examples.english_sentence: To help the company through its difficulties, he did everything he could.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗照顧重病嘅媽媽，竭盡所能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 ziu3gu3 zung6beng6 ge3 maa4maa1, kit3 zeon6 so2 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了照顾重病的妈妈，竭尽所能。
examples.english_sentence: He did everything he could to care for his seriously ill mother.

mandarin_meaning: 端（duān）：末端、開端；端正、正直；用雙手端拿（如端茶）。
english_meaning: end/edge or beginning; upright/proper; to hold/bring with both hands (e.g. to serve tea).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「端」字用法多樣：可作名詞指末端或開端；作形容詞表示端正、正直；作動詞表示用雙手端、拿或奉上。
explanation_english: The character "端" has multiple uses: as a noun it can mean end/edge or beginning; as an adjective it means upright or proper; as a verb it means to hold or bring something with both hands (e.g. to serve).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都好端正，做事好有規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 dyun1 zing3, zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 gwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是很端正，做事很有規矩。
examples.english_sentence: He is always very proper and is very disciplined in how he does things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你端杯水嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 dyun1 bui1 seoi2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我幫你端杯水來。
examples.english_sentence: I'll bring you a cup of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 端午節我哋會一齊食粽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun1 ng5 zit3 ngo5 dei6 wui5 jat1 cai4 sik6 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 端午节我们会一起吃粽子。
examples.english_sentence: We'll eat zongzi together at the Dragon Boat Festival.

mandarin_meaning: 端倪：事情的端緒、跡象或線索
english_meaning: a sign, clue, or hint; the first indication or trace of something
explanation_mandarin: 指事情發展的初步跡象或端緒，常用來描述能揭示某情況或問題的線索。
explanation_english: Refers to the initial signs, traces, or clues of an event or situation; used to describe indications that reveal how something may develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事開始有啲端倪，可能唔係咁簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hoi1 ci2 jau5 di1 dyun1 ngai4, ho2 nang4 m4 hai6 gam2 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事开始有些端倪，可能不是那么简单。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is beginning to show some signs; it might not be so simple.

mandarin_meaning: 端午节（农历五月初五的传统节日）
english_meaning: Dragon Boat Festival (traditional festival on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month)
explanation_mandarin: 中国传统节日，通常在农历五月初五，人们会赛龙舟、吃粽子、挂艾草等以驱邪避疫的习俗。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese festival held on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. Customs include dragon boat races, eating zongzi (rice dumplings), and hanging mugwort to ward off evil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋端午會食粽、賽龍舟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dyun1 ng5 wui5 sik6 zung3, coi3 lung4 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们端午会吃粽子、赛龙舟。
examples.english_sentence: During the Dragon Boat Festival we eat zongzi and race dragon boats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 端午通常係農曆五月初五。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun1 ng5 tung1 soeng4 hai6 nung4 lik6 ng5 jyut6 co1 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 端午通常是在农历五月初五。
examples.english_sentence: The Dragon Boat Festival usually falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.

mandarin_meaning: 端午节 (Duānwǔ Jié)
english_meaning: Dragon Boat Festival (traditional Chinese festival held on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month)
explanation_mandarin: 中国的传统节日，农历五月初五，人们赛龙舟、吃粽子，习俗之一是纪念爱国诗人屈原，也称端阳节。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese festival on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month. Customs include dragon boat racing and eating zongzi; it is associated with commemorating the poet Qu Yuan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 端午節我哋會去睇龍舟、食粽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun1 ng5 zit3 ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 tai2 lung4 zau1, sik6 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 端午节我们会去看龙舟、吃粽子。
examples.english_sentence: For the Dragon Boat Festival we go watch dragon boat races and eat zongzi.

mandarin_meaning: 端正 (duānzhèng)：端莊、正直、合乎規範或整潔得體
english_meaning: upright; proper; decent; neat; correct
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的品行端正、為人正直，或形容儀表、穿著、擺放等整潔得體；亦可表示做法合乎規範、正確。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is morally upright or having a neat, proper appearance; can also refer to behavior, dress, or arrangement that is correct, proper, or orderly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣好端正，望落好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng6 hou2 dyun1 zing3, mong6 lok6 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他長得端正，看起來很有禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: He has a decent appearance and looks polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好端正，大家都好尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 dyun1 zing3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很端正，大家都很尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: He is an upright person; everyone respects him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會要著得端正，唔好太隨便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 jiu3 zoek3 dak1 dyun1 zing3, m4 hou2 taai3 ceoi4 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會要穿著端正，不要太隨便。
examples.english_sentence: You should dress properly for meetings; don't be too casual.

mandarin_meaning: 端庄 (duānzhuāng)：庄重、稳重、有礼貌的举止或仪表
english_meaning: dignified; poised; decorous; stately
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人的儀態、穿著或舉止莊重、得體、不輕佻。
explanation_english: Describes a person's appearance, dress, or behavior as dignified, modest, and appropriate for formal or serious contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着得好端莊，啱去出席正式場合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dak1 hou2 dyun1 zong1, aam1 heoi3 ceot1 zik6 zing3 sik1 coeng4 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿得很端莊，適合出席正式場合。
examples.english_sentence: She dresses in a dignified manner, suitable for formal occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢舉止端莊得體，畀人好正面嘅印象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi2 zi2 dyun1 zong1 dak1 tai2, bei2 jan4 hou2 zing3 min6 ge3 jan3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她舉止端莊得體，給人很正面的印象。
examples.english_sentence: Her manner is dignified and appropriate, giving a very positive impression.

mandarin_meaning: 端详（仔細打量、審視）
english_meaning: to look at carefully; to scrutinize; to appraise
explanation_mandarin: 仔細觀察或打量某人或某物的外貌或細節，通常用於觀察、審視的動作。
explanation_english: To observe or examine someone or something closely to assess appearance or details; commonly used to indicate scrutinizing or appraising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢端詳住相片上面嘅細節，好似搵緊啲線索。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dyun1 soeng4 zyu6 soeng2 pin3 soeng6 min6 ge3 sai3 zit3, hou2 ci5 wan2 gan2 di1 sin3 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他端詳著相片上的細節，好像在找一些線索。
examples.english_sentence: He examined the details in the photo, as if looking for clues.

mandarin_meaning: 竞（競）；竞争、竞赛、争夺（jìng）
english_meaning: to compete; competition; contend; vie
explanation_mandarin: 表示争夺、竞赛或互相较量，常用於複合詞如「競爭」「競選」「競賽」。
explanation_english: Expresses contesting, competing, or vying; commonly appears in compounds such as 競爭 (competition), 競選 (campaign), 競賽 (contest).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間公司喺市場上競爭得好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 ging6 zaang1 dak1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩家公司在市場上競爭得很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies are fiercely competing in the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次競選嘅過程真係好激烈，候選人互相競爭支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ging6 syun2 ge3 gwo3 cing4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gik1 lit6, hau6 syun2 jan4 wu6 soeng1 ging6 zaang1 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次競選的過程真的是很激烈，候選人互相競爭支持。
examples.english_sentence: This election campaign was really intense; the candidates are competing for support.

mandarin_meaning: 竞价/竞标（出价以争取某物或服务）
english_meaning: to bid; competitive bidding; bid price
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词/名词（可作动词表示出价，亦可作名词表示競價行為或價格）
explanation_mandarin: 指為取得某項物品、服務或合約而相互出價、競相抬高價格的行為，常見於拍賣、招標或線上廣告投放等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of offering prices competitively to obtain an item, service, or contract. Common in auctions, tenders, or online ad keyword bidding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件古董會喺拍賣會上競價出售。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 gu2 dung2 wui5 hai2 paak3 maai6 wui6 soeng6 ging3 gaa3 ceot1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件古董會在拍賣會上競價出售。
examples.english_sentence: This antique will be sold through competitive bidding at the auction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺搜尋引擎上競價關鍵詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 sau2 cam4 jan5 cing4 soeng6 ging3 gaa3 gwaan1 gin6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要在搜尋引擎上對關鍵詞進行競價。
examples.english_sentence: We need to bid on keywords in the search engine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去競價嗰塊地出咗幾多價？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 ging3 gaa3 go2 faai3 dei6 ceot1 zo2 gei2 do1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去競價那塊地出價多少？
examples.english_sentence: How much did you bid for that plot of land?

mandarin_meaning: 競技 / 競賽（尤指體育或技藝方面的對抗性比賽）
english_meaning: competition; competitive sport; to compete (in sports or skill contests)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指競賽、比賽，尤指體育或技藝方面的對抗性比賽；也可作動詞，表示進行競技或較量。
explanation_english: Refers to contests or competitions, especially in sports or skill-based events; can function as a noun (a competitive event) or a verb (to compete).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電子競技越嚟越多人關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 zi2 ging6 gei6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1 jan4 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電子競技越來越受歡迎。
examples.english_sentence: E-sports are becoming more and more popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好強嘅競技精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 koeng4 ge3 ging6 gei6 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很強的競技精神。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong competitive spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆奧運有好多高水平嘅競技項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gaai3 ou3 wan6 jau5 hou2 do1 gou1 seoi2 ping4 ge3 ging6 gei6 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本屆奧運有很多高水準的競技項目。
examples.english_sentence: This Olympics features many high-level competitive events.

mandarin_meaning: 竞投 / 竞标
english_meaning: to bid; to compete for a contract/opportunity by submitting offers
explanation_mandarin: 指為了獲得合約、工程或其他機會而競相提交投標、出價或申請。
explanation_english: To compete by submitting bids or offers in order to obtain a contract, project, or other opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政府項目有好多公司會競投。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3fu2 hong6muk6 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1si1 wui5 ging3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政府项目有很多公司会竞投。
examples.english_sentence: Many companies will bid for this government project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算競投嗰個工程合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2syun3 ging3 tau4 go2 go3 gung1cing4 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算竞投那个工程合约。
examples.english_sentence: We plan to bid for that construction contract.

mandarin_meaning: 竞走（競走）
english_meaning: racewalking; race walk (athletic event)
explanation_mandarin: 指田徑運動中的競走項目，即以特定步態行走並以速度競賽的運動。
explanation_english: Refers to the athletics event racewalking, a competitive discipline where athletes walk at speed following specific technique rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意睇競步比賽，尤其係奧運嘅競步項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 ging6 bou6 bei2 coi3, jau4 kei4 hai6 ou3 wan6 ge3 ging6 bou6 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢看竞走比赛，尤其是奥运的竞走项目。
examples.english_sentence: I like watching racewalking competitions, especially the Olympic racewalking events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係專業競步運動員，今朝晨早練咗兩個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zyun1 jip6 ging6 bou6 wan6 dung6 jyun4, gam1 ziu1 san4 zou2 lin6 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是专业的竞走运动员，今天早晨练了两个小时。
examples.english_sentence: He is a professional racewalker; he trained for two hours this morning.

mandarin_meaning: 竞争
english_meaning: competition; to compete
explanation_mandarin: 指為了獲得有限的資源、利益、地位等而進行的相互爭奪，可以作名詞或動詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or process of rival parties striving for limited resources, benefits, or status; can be used as a noun or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間公司喺呢個市場入面好激烈競爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 ni1 go3 si5 coeng4 jap6 min6 hou2 gik1 lit6 ging3 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩家公司在這個市場裡競爭得很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies are fiercely competing in this market.

mandarin_meaning: 竞争力
english_meaning: competitiveness; competitive strength
explanation_mandarin: 指個人、企業或產品在市場上與其他競爭對手相比，能取得優勢的能力或程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability or strength of a person, company, or product to compete successfully against rivals in the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅產品質素高，所以喺市場上有好強嘅競爭力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 zat1 sou3 gou1, so2 ji5 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 jau5 hou2 koeng4 ge3 ging3 zang1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司的產品質量高，所以在市場上有很強的競爭力。
examples.english_sentence: This company's products are of high quality, so it has strong competitiveness in the market.

mandarin_meaning: 竞猜；互相竞争地猜测
english_meaning: to guess competitively; a guessing contest
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛或娛樂場合中，互相競爭地進行猜測或推測的行為。
explanation_english: To make guesses competitively, often in games, contests, or entertainment contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家嚟競猜邊個會贏啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 lai4 ging3 caai1 bin1 go3 wui5 jing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家来竞猜谁会赢。
examples.english_sentence: Let's guess who will win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺電視節目入面做競猜遊戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 jap6 min6 zou6 ging3 caai1 jau4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在电视节目里面做竞猜游戏。
examples.english_sentence: They played a guessing game on the TV show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂競猜，等我有資料先講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 ging3 caai1, dang2 ngo5 jau5 zi1 liu2 sin1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱猜，等我有资料再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't guess randomly; wait until I have the information.

mandarin_meaning: 竞赛；比赛
english_meaning: competition; contest
explanation_mandarin: 指為了選拔、競爭或娛樂而舉辦的比賽活動，通常有規則和名次評定。
explanation_english: Refers to an organized contest or competition held for selection, rivalry, or entertainment, typically with rules and rankings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下個月會舉行一場校際競賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 geoi2 hang4 jat1 coeng4 haau6 zai3 ging3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校下个月会举行一场校际竞赛。
examples.english_sentence: The school will hold an interschool competition next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺校內歌唱競賽攞咗第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 haau6 noi6 go1 coeng3 ging3 coi3 lo2 zo2 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在校内歌唱比赛中获得了第一名。
examples.english_sentence: He won first place in the school's singing competition.

mandarin_meaning: 競輪（凱林賽），一種日本起源的場地自行車競賽（Keirin），常與博彩相關。
english_meaning: Keirin — a track cycling race originating in Japan, often held in velodromes and commonly associated with betting.
explanation_mandarin: 競輪（凱林賽）是在場地賽道上進行的自行車競速比賽，選手通常先跟隨領騎員逐步加速，最後數圈脫離領騎者衝刺決勝負。此項目在日本發展成熟，並常作為合法博彩的對象。
explanation_english: Keirin is a form of track cycling race that originated in Japan. Riders follow a pacer for part of the race and then sprint in the final laps to determine the winner. Keirin events are often organized for the purpose of betting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去場館睇競輪比賽，好刺激！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 coeng4 gun2 tai2 ging3 leon4 bei2 coi3, hou2 cik1 gik1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去場館看競輪比賽，很刺激！
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the velodrome tonight to watch a keirin race — it's very exciting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去日本睇競輪，仲會落注搏一把。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 tai2 ging3 leon4, zung6 wui5 lok6 zyu3 bok3 jat1 baa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常去日本看競輪，還會下注碰碰運氣。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to Japan to watch keirin races and even places bets to try his luck.

mandarin_meaning: 竞逐（争夺、争取）
english_meaning: to vie for; to compete for; to strive to obtain
explanation_mandarin: 表示為了獲得某個目標或利益而與他人競爭、爭奪。
explanation_english: Indicates competing with others to obtain a goal, prize, or advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間公司為咗贏得市場而競逐同一個客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 jeng4 dak1 si5 coeng4 ji4 ging6 zuk6 tung4 jat1 go3 haak3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩家公司為了贏得市場而競逐同一個客戶。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies competed for the same client to capture the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選手們喺賽道上競逐，爭奪冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 sau2 mun4 hai2 coi3 dou6 soeng6 ging6 zuk6, zang1 dyut6 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 選手們在賽道上競逐，爭奪冠軍。
examples.english_sentence: The athletes vied for the championship on the track.

mandarin_meaning: 竞选（參加选举以争取当选）
english_meaning: to run for office; to campaign in an election
explanation_mandarin: 指為爭取公職或公民代表資格而進行的競選活動或參選行為，包括宣傳、拉票、辯論等。
explanation_english: Refers to participating in an election campaign to compete for a public office or representative position, including activities like campaigning, canvassing, and debates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會競選市長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 ging6 syun2 si5 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說會競選市長。
examples.english_sentence: He said he will run for mayor.

mandarin_meaning: （竞饮）喝酒比赛；比谁喝得多或喝得快
english_meaning: drinking contest; to compete in drinking (who can drink more or faster)
explanation_mandarin: 指以喝酒作比賽，參加者互相比拼喝酒的量或速度，也可作動詞表示參加此類比賽或互相較勁喝酒。
explanation_english: Refers to a contest where participants compete by drinking (amount or speed). Can be used as a noun (a drinking contest) or as a verb (to take part in such a contest).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚酒吧有個競飲比賽，啲人飲到爛醉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zau2 baa1 jau5 go3 ging3 jam2 bei2 coi3, di1 jan4 jam2 dou3 laan6 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚酒吧有個喝酒比赛，大家都喝得烂醉。
examples.english_sentence: There's a drinking contest at the bar tonight; people are drinking themselves senseless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識飲，唔好同佢競飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 jam2, m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 ging3 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不太能喝，別和他比喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: He can't hold his liquor; don't compete with him in a drinking contest.

mandarin_meaning: 竹，竹子 (zhú)
english_meaning: bamboo
explanation_mandarin: 竹是一種多年生的禾本科植物，莖中空且堅韌，可用於建築、製作家具、工藝品，或食用其嫩芽（竹筍）。
explanation_english: Bamboo is a perennial woody grass with hollow, strong stems used for construction, furniture, crafts, and as food (bamboo shoots).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵竹長得好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 zuk1 coeng4 dak1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這棵竹長得很高。
examples.english_sentence: This bamboo grows very tall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食竹筍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 zuk1 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃竹筍。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating bamboo shoots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人用竹搭棚架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 jung6 zuk1 daap3 paang4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人用竹子搭棚架。
examples.english_sentence: Workers use bamboo to build scaffolding.

mandarin_meaning: （常與「麵」連用）指用竹桿拍打麵團製成的廣式手工麵（竹昇麵）；也可指用來拍打麵團的竹桿。
english_meaning: A Cantonese handmade noodle made by pounding dough with a bamboo pole (bamboo-pounded noodles); can also refer to the bamboo pole used to pound the dough.
explanation_mandarin: 廣東傳統製麵方法，把麵團放在板上以竹桿反覆拍打，使麵筋成形，口感彈牙。常見用法為「竹昇麵／竹升麵」。
explanation_english: A traditional Cantonese noodle-making technique where dough is repeatedly pounded with a bamboo pole to develop gluten and a springy texture. Commonly referred to as '竹昇麵' (bamboo-pounded noodles).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食竹昇麵，嗰間舖啲麵好彈牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 zuk1 sing1 min6, go2 gaan1 pou3 di1 min6 hou2 daan6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃竹昇面，那間店的麵很有嚼勁。
examples.english_sentence: I feel like having bamboo-pounded noodles tonight — the noodles at that shop are very chewy.

mandarin_meaning: 做竹昇麵（以竹桿或竹製機具壓製麵條）的人；操作竹昇製麵機的工人（香港俗稱）。
english_meaning: a person who operates a bamboo-press noodle machine; maker of bamboo-pressed noodles (Hong Kong colloquial).
explanation_mandarin: 「竹升仔」是香港口語，指在茶餐廳或小食店負責用竹昇（竹製或以竹為名的壓麵機）製作手工麵條的工人或師傅。寫法有時見作「竹昇仔」或「竹升仔」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial term for a person who operates a bamboo-press noodle machine or makes bamboo-pressed (hand-pressed) noodles in eateries. The term is informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間茶餐廳仲有個竹升仔，日日朝早整新鮮竹升麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 zung6 jau5 go3 zuk1 sing1 zai2, jat6 jat6 ziu1 zou2 zing2 san1 sin1 zuk1 sing1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家茶餐廳還有個竹昇仔，每天早上都做新鮮的竹昇麵。
examples.english_sentence: That cha chaan teng still has a 'zuk sing zai' — they make fresh bamboo-pressed noodles every morning.

mandarin_meaning: （無完全對應）常用來貶稱愛慕虛榮、喜歡炫耀名牌或誇張打扮的女子
english_meaning: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term (derogatory) for a materialistic, showy woman who likes to flaunt brands or flashy fashion
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語的俗稱（口語、帶貶義），用來形容喜歡炫耀、追逐名牌或過度打扮以示身份的女性。詞源口語化，使用時可能冒犯他人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese label (usually derogatory) for women perceived as materialistic and eager to show off designer goods or flashy outfits. Informal and potentially offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個係典型嘅竹升女，成日炫耀啲名牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hai6 din2 jing4 ge3 zuk1 sing1 neoi5, seng4 jat6 syun3 jiu6 di1 ming4 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個是典型的竹升女，經常炫耀名牌。
examples.english_sentence: That one is a typical '竹升女', always showing off designer brands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣講，叫人竹升女好容易令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 gong2, giu3 jan4 zuk1 sing1 neoi5 hou2 ji6 ji6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那樣說，叫人竹升女很容易讓人反感。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put it that way — calling someone a '竹升女' easily comes across as offensive.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）指與傳統麵舖、竹昇麵有關，或形容打扮樸實、接地氣、在街坊小店工作的年輕女性（口語用法、地區性詞彙）
english_meaning: slang for a young woman associated with traditional noodle shops (especially places making 竹昇麵) or used jokingly/affectionately for a girl who is simple, down-to-earth, and works in neighbourhood food stalls (colloquial, regional)
explanation_mandarin: 「竹升妹」為粵語口語用法，字面與「竹昇麵」（一種以竹桿製作的傳統麵）有關。通常用來指在此類麵舖工作的女生，或泛指打扮樸實、接地氣的年輕女性；語氣可中性、親切或略帶戲謔，屬地區性俚語。
explanation_english: “竹升妹” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term derived from 竹昇麵 (a traditional noodle made with a bamboo pole). It often refers to girls who work at such noodle shops, or more generally to young women who are plain, down-to-earth, and local. The tone can be neutral, affectionate, or mildly teasing; it is regional slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿芬係個竹升妹，喺嗰間麵舖做咗幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 fan1 hai6 go3 zuk1 sing1 mui6, hai6 go2 gaan1 min6 pou3 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿芬是個「竹升妹」，在那間麵舖做了好幾年。
examples.english_sentence: A-fan is a '竹升妹' — she's worked at that noodle shop for several years.

mandarin_meaning: 網路或公開場合的文字爭論、口水戰
english_meaning: a flame war / war of words (usually online or in public comment threads)
explanation_mandarin: 「竹戰」為香港粵語俗語，常用於形容網上或留言區出現的激烈文字對罵或互相抨擊，可作名詞（發生了一場竹戰）或動詞（兩派開始竹戰）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "竹戰" refers to a heated exchange of words—often online—where parties attack each other verbally. It can be used as a noun (there was a 竹戰) or a verb (they started 竹戰).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 討論區啲留言又變成竹戰，雙方互相攻擊好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou2 leon6 keoi1 di1 lau4 jin4 jau6 bin3 sing4 zuk1 zin3, soeng1 fong1 wu6 soeng1 gung1 gik1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 討論區的留言又變成了竹戰，雙方互相攻擊很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The forum comments turned into a '竹戰' again; both sides attacked each other fiercely.

mandarin_meaning: 竹林（成片生長的竹子）
english_meaning: bamboo grove; bamboo forest
explanation_mandarin: 指成片生長竹子的林地或小竹叢，常用來描述竹子密集生長的地方。
explanation_english: A stand or grove of bamboo — an area densely populated by bamboo plants; can refer to a small grove or a larger bamboo forest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條山徑穿過一片竹林，風一吹就沙沙作響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 saan1 ging3 cyun1 gwo3 jat1 pin3 zuk1 lam4, fung1 jat1 ceoi1 zau6 saa1 saa1 zok3 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條山路穿過一片竹林，風一吹就沙沙作響。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain path passes through a bamboo grove; when the wind blows it rustles softly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶室後面有個細小竹林，坐喺度好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 sat1 hau6 min6 jau5 go3 sai3 siu2 zuk1 lam4, co5 hai2 dou6 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家茶室後面有一片小竹林，坐在那裡很寧靜。
examples.english_sentence: There is a small bamboo grove behind this teahouse; sitting there is very peaceful.

mandarin_meaning: 竹枝；（文）指一種民間歌謠形式，見於「竹枝詞」
english_meaning: bamboo twig/branch; (literary) a type of folk lyric (see '竹枝詞')
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指竹子的細枝、竹枝條，常用作簡單的工具或燃料。2) 在文學上，「竹枝」常指民間歌謠的一種形式（如竹枝詞），用以記錄鄉村生活或民間故事。
explanation_english: 1) The slender branch or twig of a bamboo, often used as a simple tool or fuel. 2) In literature, '竹枝' refers to a form of folk lyric (e.g. '竹枝詞') used to record rural life or popular tales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條竹枝好細，唔夠結實做支撐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 zuk1 zi1 hou2 sai3, m4 gau3 git3 sat6 zou6 zi1 caang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這根竹枝很細，不夠結實做支撐。
examples.english_sentence: This bamboo twig is very thin, not sturdy enough to act as a support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唱起阿嫲教我哋嘅竹枝詞，感覺好懷念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 coeng3 hei2 aa3 maa4 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zuk1 zi1 ci2, gam2 gok3 hou2 waai4 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們唱起奶奶教我們的竹枝詞，感覺很懷念。
examples.english_sentence: We sang the bamboo-branch songs that our grandmother taught us; it felt very nostalgic.

mandarin_meaning: 竹枝词（一種中國古代的民歌體詩歌，常描寫民間風俗、男女愛情與市井生活）
english_meaning: Bamboo-branch poems — a type of Chinese folk lyric/short poem, often depicting popular life, love, and local customs
explanation_mandarin: 竹枝詞是中國古代一類短小的民歌體詩歌，最早見於樂府與民間歌謠，多描寫市井生活、男女愛情和地方風俗，語言通俗，便於傳唱。
explanation_english: Zhu zhi ci (bamboo-branch poems) are a short folk-lyric form from classical China, recorded in Yuefu and popular songs. They typically describe everyday life, romantic encounters, and local customs, using plain language suitable for singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近喺圖書館借咗本講唐朝詩歌嘅書，入面有介紹竹枝詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 ze3 zo2 bun2 gong2 Tong4 ciu1 si1 go1 ge3 syu1, jap6 min6 jau5 gaai3 siu6 zuk1 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近在图书馆借了一本讲唐朝诗歌的书，里面有介绍竹枝词。
examples.english_sentence: I recently borrowed a book about Tang-dynasty poetry from the library; it includes an introduction to bamboo-branch poems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 竹枝詞多描寫民間男女愛情、風俗同埋市井生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 zi1 ci4 do1 miu4 se2 man4 gaan1 naam4 neoi5 oi3 cing4, fung1 zuk6 tung4 maai4 si5 zeng2 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 竹枝词多描写民间男女爱情、风俗和市井生活。
examples.english_sentence: Bamboo-branch poems often depict folk love between men and women, local customs, and common urban life.

mandarin_meaning: 竹棚（zhúpéng）：用竹子搭建的临时棚屋或摊位
english_meaning: bamboo shed / makeshift bamboo stall or canopy
explanation_mandarin: 用竹子搭建的简易棚屋或遮蔽物，常用作临时遮挡、存放工具或摆摊售卖。
explanation_english: A simple shed or stall made of bamboo, usually temporary and used for shelter, storage, or as a market stall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺市場對面搭咗個竹棚賣雜貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 si5 coeng4 deoi3 min6 daap3 zo2 go3 zuk1 paang4 mai6 zaap6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在市场对面搭了一个竹棚卖杂货。
examples.english_sentence: He set up a bamboo stall across from the market to sell sundries.

mandarin_meaning: 竹竿 (zhú gān) — 用竹子做成的長桿
english_meaning: bamboo pole; bamboo stick
explanation_mandarin: 指用竹子製成的長桿，常用於撐起、搭建臨時棚架、釣魚等用途。
explanation_english: A long pole made from bamboo, commonly used for supporting structures, erecting temporary shelters, fishing, and similar purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人用竹竿搭棚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 jung6 zuk1 gon1 daap3 paang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人用竹竿搭棚。
examples.english_sentence: The workers used bamboo poles to build a temporary shelter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用竹竿釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zuk1 gon1 diu3 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用竹竿钓鱼。
examples.english_sentence: He uses a bamboo pole to fish.

mandarin_meaning: 竹荪（食用真菌）
english_meaning: bamboo fungus / bamboo pith (an edible mushroom)
explanation_mandarin: 一种食用真菌，学名竹荪（Phallus indusiatus），子实体呈伞状并常带网裙，质地细嫩，常用于汤品或粤菜中，味道鲜甜。
explanation_english: An edible fungus commonly called bamboo fungus or bamboo pith (Phallus indusiatus). It has a delicate texture and a veiled/netted appearance; widely used in soups and Chinese cuisine for its subtle, sweet flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯入面有竹笙，好鮮甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 jap6 min6 jau5 zuk1 sang1, hou2 sin1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤里有竹荪，很鲜甜。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup contains bamboo fungus; it's very flavorful.

mandarin_meaning: 竹笋 (zhúsǔn)
english_meaning: bamboo shoot
explanation_mandarin: 指可食用的竹子的嫩芽，常作蔬菜或烹調配料，質地脆嫩，味道鮮美。
explanation_english: The edible young shoot of bamboo, commonly used as a vegetable or ingredient in Asian cuisines; tender and crunchy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝去街市見到啲竹筍好新鮮，我買咗幾個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 heoi3 gaai1 si5 gin3 dou2 di1 zuk1 syun2 hou2 san1 sin1, ngo5 maai5 zo2 gei2 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上去菜市場看到一些竹笋很新鮮，我買了幾個。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I went to the wet market and saw some very fresh bamboo shoots; I bought a few.

mandarin_meaning: 竹篙（用來撐船或測水深的竹竿）；亦可出現在成語中（如「以一竹篙打翻一船人」）
english_meaning: bamboo pole (used for punting a boat or measuring water depth); appears in idiom meaning to condemn all because of one)
explanation_mandarin: 指用竹子製成的長竿，常用來撐船或在淺水處探測深度；在口語或成語中也可出現，比喻事物或人的牽連（例如「以一竹篙打翻一船人」表示因一人之過而連累一群人）。
explanation_english: A long pole made of bamboo, commonly used to punt a boat or probe water depth in shallow areas. It also appears in idiomatic expressions (e.g., "to condemn everyone because of one person").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 船夫用竹篙撐船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun4 fu1 jung6 zuk1 gou1 caang1 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船夫用竹篙撐船。
examples.english_sentence: The boatman uses a bamboo pole to push the boat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為一個壞人就以一竹篙打翻一船人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 jat1 go3 waai6 jan4 zau6 ji5 jat1 zuk1 gou1 daa2 faan1 jat1 syun4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因為一個壞人就以一竹篙打翻一船人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't condemn everyone because of one bad person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用長竹篙量水深，決定邊度可以過河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung6 coeng4 zuk1 gou1 loeng4 seoi2 sam1, kyut3 ding6 bin1 dou6 ho2 ji5 gwo3 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們用長竹篙量水深，決定哪裡可以過河。
examples.english_sentence: They used a long bamboo pole to gauge the water's depth and decide where to cross the river.

mandarin_meaning: 竹篙灣（香港地名；字面意思為「竹竿灣」）
english_meaning: Zhugao Wan / Bamboo Pole Bay (a bay/place name in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的地名，指一處海灣。詞義字面為「竹篙（竹竿）灣」，名稱可能來自漁民或沿岸居民使用竹桿作標記、停泊或疏浚工具的習俗或地形特徵。
explanation_english: A place name in Hong Kong referring to a bay. The literal meaning is "bamboo-pole bay"; the name likely originated from fishermen or local residents using bamboo poles as markers, mooring posts, or from a landscape feature resembling bamboo poles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去竹篙灣行沙灘，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 zuk1 gou1 waan1 hang4 saa1 taan1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期天去竹篙灣的沙灘，好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to the beach at Zhugao Wan this Sunday?

mandarin_meaning: 愛管閒事的人；多管閒事的（俚語）
english_meaning: a busybody; a meddler (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容喜歡插手或干涉別人私事、愛管閒事的人，帶有貶義。字面上帶有「用竹篙去戳/插」的意象，比喻愛打探或干預別人的事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who is a busybody or meddler — a person who pokes into others' affairs. Literally evokes the image of poking with a bamboo pole, used metaphorically and usually pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日插手別人嘅事，真係一個竹篙精。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 caap3 sau2 bit6 jan4 ge3 si6, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 zuk1 gou1 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是插手別人的事情，真是一個愛管閒事的人。
examples.english_sentence: He always meddles in other people's affairs; he's really a busybody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做竹篙精，尊重下佢哋嘅私隱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 zuk1 gou1 zing1, zeon1 zung6 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 si1 jan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要當個愛管閒事的人，尊重他們的隱私。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a busybody; respect their privacy.

mandarin_meaning: 竹篾（zhúmiè）：用來編織籃子、簸箕、席子等的細長竹條。
english_meaning: bamboo splints / bamboo strips used for weaving baskets, mats, sieves, etc.
explanation_mandarin: 指把竹子劈成的細長條，通常用作編織或製作日常器具的材料。
explanation_english: Refers to thin, narrow strips of bamboo split from bamboo culms, commonly used as material for weaving or making everyday items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅用竹篾編籃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu6 jung6 zuk1 mit6 bin1 laam4.
